description: BOS Zahořanská 10 is a traditional running race organized by SK Zahořany under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany. The eighth edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and features a main race for men and women over 10.2 km with an elevation gain of +250 m in forest terrain around Zahořany and Pleš. In addition to the main race, there is a supporting run of 5.5 km and children's races of various lengths. Timing and results are provided by the agency 4Timing using chip technology. Registration is available online and on-site with different fee categories for adults, juniors, and children.
course_highlights: Main race 10.2 km with an elevation gain of +250 m
Forest course around Zahořany and Pleš (490 m above sea level)
Supporting race 5.5 km with an elevation gain of +125 m
additional: Timing and results are provided by the agency 4Timing using chip technology. The race is under the auspices of the municipality of Zahořany and organized by SK Zahořany. Children's races range from 50 m to 1200 m. Registration is possible online and on-site with higher starting fees for on-site registration. The terrain is off-road, registration is available online and on-site, children's races are held, results count towards the Brdský Running Cup, original medals are awarded, and support is given to non-profit organizations.

name: Maraton a půlmaraton okolo Hracholuské přehrady
location: Hracholuská přehrada, Pňovany, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The marathon and half marathon around Hracholuská Dam is an event held on May 31, 2026, offering a beautiful natural circuit around the dam. The route mainly runs on paved paths along the water surface with a few short sections of natural terrain, giving it a slight trail character without unnecessary difficulties. An exceptional experience is crossing the Pňovanský Bridge with breathtaking views of the dam and surrounding landscape. The race circuit measures 21.1 km, the exact distance of a half marathon, and is suitable for runners seeking a combination of beautiful nature, motivating atmosphere, and a pleasant profile of the track.
course_highlights: Mainly paved paths along the water surface with short sections of natural terrain
Crossing the Pňovanský Bridge with views of Hracholuská Dam
Circuit length of 21.1 km with a pleasant track profile
additional: The route is slightly trail-like with a combination of paved roads and natural terrain. GPX map of the route can be downloaded. The race is organized by Sportovní klub Marathon Plzeň. The event includes both marathon and half marathon, with a varied course passing through forests, meadows, and roads, with a total elevation gain of 433 meters for the half marathon.

name: Hněvošická desítka
description: The Hněvošice Ten is a sporting running event organized by the Sokol Hněvošice Physical Education Union, which takes place on May 31, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds. The run offers an opportunity for active recreation in the beautiful surroundings of the village of Hněvošice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes sports traditions in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds
Run in the pleasant natural environment of Hněvošice
Sporting atmosphere within the local community
additional: The event takes place at the TJ Sokol Hněvošice grounds, Lesní 242, 747 35 Hněvošice. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Sokol Hněvošice, z.s. The duration of the event is not specified. Option to add to Google Calendar. The race is intended for runners of all levels, and the day also includes a colorful run or walk in the afternoon.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Lesná
location: Lesná, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various destinations, including Lesná, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km, an experiential route of 20 to 30 km, and children's races. The routes are suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers, offering a diverse sporting challenge for all age groups. The series is organized by Živé Sokolovsko z.s. and Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s. in cooperation with local municipalities.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the beautiful nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential route 20 - 30 km with map navigation
Children's races from 200 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in various locations of the Ore Mountains. Besides running, participants can also take part in canicross, walking with point finding according to a map, and children's races. The routes are diverse and lead through the beautiful nature of the region. The event features various routes, children's categories, the option for individual route selection, starts from 07:30, and awards after 13:00. Registration is available at sokotime.cz.

name: Mezinárodní běh Měška a Doubravky
description: The International Měško and Doubravka Run is a summer running race for adults with a distance of 12.5 km, starting in Mirošov and ending in Meziměstí at the AQA Land swimming pool. The race is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix and takes place through picturesque landscapes of the Polish-Czech border region, between meadows and forests. The start is at the amphitheater on Parkowa Hill at 11:00 AM, with the finish and award ceremony at the swimming pool. Free bus transportation from Meziměstí to Mieroszów is provided for Czech participants. Registration is free and can be done online or on the race day at the venue.
course_highlights: 12.5 km course between Mirošov and Meziměstí
Picturesque landscape of the Polish-Czech border region with meadows and forests
Start next to the amphitheater on Parkowa Hill, finish at AQA Land swimming pool in Meziměstí
additional: The bus for Czech participants departs at 9:15 AM from the Meziměstí swimming pool towards Mieroszów. Registration on race day begins at 9:30 AM at the race office or online. The winners are announced at the swimming pool after the race. The race includes various categories and is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: 1. Zielony Półmaraton
location: Chojnowski Park Krajobrazowy, Konstancin-Jeziorna, Mazowieckie, Poland
price_range: bezpłatne dla dzieci i uczniów szkół podstawowych, dorośli od 60 zł do 100 zł w zależności od terminu zapisów
description: "Running, not clicking! - Konstancin-Jeziorna 2026" is a charity run over a distance of 5 km, which will take place on May 24, 2026, in the picturesque Chojnowski Landscape Park. The route consists of two loops of 2.5 km each, passing through pine and mixed forests, with a gentle terrain profile suitable for runners of all levels. The start and finish are located at the forest parking lot on Od Lasu street, providing easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. The event combines sports competition with integration and support for the local community, and all proceeds will be donated to the Special Schools Team in Pęcherach.
course_highlights: Route in Chojnowski Landscape Park - a valuable natural area south of Warsaw
Two loops of 2.5 km each through mature pine and mixed forests
Gentle terrain profile with slight inclines, suitable for beginners and advanced runners
additional: The run is a charity event, and all funds will be donated to the Special Schools Team in Pęcherach. Participation of primary and secondary school students is free of charge. The start and finish are at the forest parking lot, enabling easy access and convenient conditions for spectators. During the break between the main run and the awards ceremony, children's races on distances of 250 m and 500 m will be held. The route is scenic, forest terrain, children's races, support for a local school, registrations at the office on the day of the event, various distances for children.

name: 13. Bieg 10km Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Race is one of the most important 10 km running events in Greater Poland, organized since 2012. It attracts top Polish athletes as well as runners from abroad, creating a unique atmosphere of sporting emotions and energy. The course is interesting and varied, with forest accents and runs through the streets of Swarzędz. The event also features a Family Run and starts for athletes in active wheelchairs. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, enriching the running festival with additional excitement.
course_highlights: Dynamic course profile with forest accents
Attractive route through the streets of Swarzędz
New course edition highly appreciated by participants
additional: The event will include the 6th Family Run for participants of all ages and starts for athletes in active wheelchairs. There is an opportunity to purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. In 2026, the Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon returns, marking the fifth edition of this distance within the festival. The event covers various age categories, offers the chance to buy commemorative T-shirts, and features a wide range of attractions and support for participants.

The routes have PZLA and World Athletics certifications, ensuring high quality and the possibility of obtaining official results. The races are designed to enable participants to achieve their best results. The next edition will take place on May 31, 2026, and we warmly invite you to participate.
course_highlights: Routes entirely on the paths of TAURON Silesian Park
PZLA and World Athletics certifications
Route designed for achieving the best results
additional: Registration for the races is open until May 22, with a limited number of packages. The event promotes sports activity and supports charitable causes.

description: The 45th Jubilee Krotoszyn Run is an annual running event held in Krotoszyn, scheduled for May 30 and 31, 2026. The event features races for children and youth at the Municipal Stadium, as well as main races through the city streets over distances of 10 km and 5 km. The start and finish are located at the stadium, and the route runs through the streets of Krotoszyn, allowing participants to experience the city's atmosphere. The run is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of various skill levels to spend active time.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Krotoszyn
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Krotoszyn
Children and youth races at the stadium divided into age categories
additional: Children and youth races take place on May 30 from 2:00 PM at the Municipal Stadium with a warm-up led by a coach. Children's age categories have different distances ranging from 100 m to 1200 m. The race office will be open on May 30 and 31, 2026, where registration is possible if there are available start spots (without a t-shirt). Registrations are open until April 15, 2026, available online with race packages and discounts for residents. The races will be held at the stadium and through the city streets, with various age categories.

name: 5. Półmaraton Szpot Swarzędz
description: The 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon is a unique running event scheduled for May 31, 2026, in Swarzędz. The course consists of two loops totaling 21.097 km, scenic and dynamic, leading around Lake Swarzędz. The race combines sporting excitement with professional organization, a special atmosphere, and spectator support, creating an unforgettable running celebration. As part of the Swarzędz Running Festival, there are also 10 km races and a Family Run, making the event attractive for different age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Course around Lake Swarzędz, scenic and dynamic
Two loops totaling 21.097 km
Course sometimes shaded, ensuring comfort during the run
additional: As part of the Swarzędz Running Festival, three races take place: the Half Marathon, 10 km, and Family Run. Participants can purchase a special commemorative T-shirt. The event combines sports, educational, and charitable aspects. The organizer ensures professional organization, safety, as well as unique medals and prizes. The race atmosphere is supported by enthusiastic spectators and extensive media coverage. The course around Lake Swarzędz includes educational and charitable elements, the opportunity to buy a commemorative T-shirt, and is part of the Swarzędz Running Festival.

name: Bieg z okazji Dni Ziemi Ropczyckiej 2026
description: The Ropczyce Earth Day Run is a 10 km race taking place on May 31, 2026, in Ropczyce. This running event is organized on the occasion of the local holiday and attracts runners looking to spend active time on a moderate-distance course. The race route runs through the scenic terrain of Ropczyce, and participants can expect typical May weather with temperatures around 20 degrees Celsius. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event.
course_highlights: Distance of 10 km
Course in Ropczyce, Poland
Typical May weather around 20°C, cloudy
additional: Please verify event details with the organizer before registration. The event includes training preparations, and the route passes through picturesque areas of Ropczyce. May weather usually favors runners, with temperatures around 20°C and average rainfall of 55 mm.

name: Marceliński Bieg Wiosenny 2026
description: Marceliński Spring Run 2026 is cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form for collecting the start package. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event will take place on May 31, 2026 at 10:00 AM. Registration details are not provided, and the route includes the area of Marceliński Forest.

name: Szybka Piątka 5K FAST RUN Kupienino 31.05.2026
location: Kupienino, gmina Świebodzin, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Fast Five 5K FAST RUN is a new running event that will take place for the first time on May 31, 2026, in Kupienin near Świebodzin. The race offers a fast, 5-kilometer distance, ideal for runners seeking a dynamic challenge. The event is organized with running enthusiasts in mind, who want to test their speed on a scenic route.
course_highlights: Distance of 5 km - fast street run
Scenic route around Kupienin
First edition of the event
additional: 5 km races, first edition, local organization

name: 16 Kogeneracja Biegaj w Siechnicach
location: Siechnice, Wrocław County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 80-100 zł, z zniżkami dla mieszkańców gminy
description: The 16th Cogeneration Run in Siechnice is a street race on distances of 5 km and 10 km, which will take place on May 31, 2026. The race route runs through the streets of Siechnice, with participants completing a 5 km loop, which those running 10 km do twice. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and the recreational values of the Siechnice municipality. In addition to the main races, there are also races for children and youth. The start and finish are located on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street, with the start scheduled for 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: Street route in Siechnice with a 5 km loop
10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km loop
Start and finish on Kościelna Street at the intersection with Jana Pawła II Street
additional: Race office and deposit at Jana Pawła II Street next to the Municipal Office. Pickup of race kits on Saturday and Sunday morning. The race kit includes an Oshee isotonic drink, an Eatyx bar, and a race number. At the finish line, there is a medal and a recovery meal. Participant limit is 700 people. Youth races and the Young Engineer Run for children up to 7 years old. Free parking near the LA Stadium/Błękitna Laguna open from 9:00 to 15:00, recommended parking at the PKP station and Toro Park shopping center. A new system for issuing race numbers with a QR code. The participant limit is 700, with online registration available. The event also includes youth and children’s races, promoting health and recreation.

name: 3 Zduńskowolski Festiwal Biegowy
description: The 3rd Zduńskowolski Running Festival is an anniversary street race through the city of Zduńska Wola, organized on the occasion of the 200th anniversary of granting city rights. The event features races of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), with start and finish lines located at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street. The course runs through the city streets and the Zapolice municipality area to the village of Brzeski in the Sędziejowice municipality, where the turnaround point for the half marathon is situated. Several hundred participants take part in the event, which has an urban and street race character.
course_highlights: Course through the streets of Zduńska Wola
Turnaround point in the village of Brzeski in Sędziejowice municipality
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium on Łaska Street
additional: Several hundred participants take part in the event. The event is organized by the Zduńska Wola City Office. The half marathon course is 21 km with a turnaround in Brzeski. Available races include 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon. There is no information about start waves, participant limits, registration fees, or additional services. The event includes races for different age groups and skill levels, as well as attractions for families and participants of all ages.

name: 4 Bieg Zawierciański
location: Stadionie OSIR w Zawierciu, Zawiercie, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Klub Sportowy „Warto Biegać” i Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Zawierciu
description: The 4th Zawiercie Running Race is a running event organized by the Sports Club "Warto Biegać" and the Sports and Recreation Center in Zawiercie. The competition takes place at the OSIR Stadium in Zawiercie and includes two distances: a main race of 10 km and a companion race of 5 km. The race route runs through the streets of Zawiercie, is properly secured and closed to traffic, and each kilometer is marked. The event aims to popularize running and integrate runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Race route through the streets of Zawiercie
Marking of each kilometer of the route
Closure of the route to traffic and security measures
additional: Race office open from 7:00 to 8:30 at the OSIR Stadium, with the possibility of collecting start packages also on Saturday from 16:00 to 19:00. The time limit for 10 km is 1:30, and for 5 km is 1:00. Electronic timing with a transponder chip placed on the shoe. Participants must wear start numbers pinned to the front of their shirts. It is forbidden to move on the route on bicycles, roller skates, skateboards, and other devices without the organizer's permission. Distances are 10 km and 5 km, with a time limit of 1:30 for 10 km and 1:00 for 5 km, start packages can be picked up on the day of the event, route security, a limit of 500 participants, electronic registration from December 6, 2025, to May 15, 2026.

name: Bieg o Koronę Księżnej Dąbrówki
organizer: Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Dopiewie
description: The Queen Dąbrówka Princess Crown Run is a jubilee, fifteenth edition of the running event traditionally held on the last Sunday of May. The main race over a distance of 10 km runs through forest paths surrounded by greenery, providing pleasant conditions for running on a soft surface. Nordic walking enthusiasts can participate in a 7.5 km route, and younger participants can compete on shorter distances ranging from 200 to 1000 meters. The start and finish are located on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. The event is family-oriented and integrative, promoting physical activity among residents of the Dopiewo Municipality.
course_highlights: Main race 10 km through forest paths surrounded by greenery
Nordic walking over 7.5 km
Children's races from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: Children's races start at 10:15 AM, the main race at 12:00 PM, and the Nordic walking march at 12:02 PM. The race office and packet pickup are available in the days prior to the race at the GOSiR Dopiewo sports hall and on the race day on Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka. Individual and team classifications, including classifications for people with disabilities and residents of the Dopiewo Municipality and LINEA Developer estates. Teams must be mixed (women/men). Distances: 10 km, 7.5 km, children's races; start location on the edge of the Palędzko-Zakrzewski forest near Parkowa Street in Dąbrówka; date: May 31, 2026; registrations are already open.

name: Festiwal Biegowy Szpot
description: The Szpot Swarzędz Running Festival is a unique running event scheduled for May 31, 2026. The festival features three races: the 5th Szpot Swarzędz Half Marathon, the 13th Szpot Swarzędz 10 km Run, and the 6th Szpot Swarzędz Family Run. The half marathon course consists of two loops around the picturesque Swarzędzkie Lake, while the 10 km race offers a dynamic profile with forest accents and city streets. The event combines sport, education, and charity activities, with participants enjoying a rich gastro zone, partner expo, recovery meal, massages, and a charity auction. The festival is open to everyone, including participants in active wheelchairs and seniors over 70 years old, who can start free of charge.
course_highlights: Half marathon course: two loops around Swarzędzkie Lake
10 km course: dynamic profile with forest accents and streets of Swarzędz
Event includes three races and offers a rich gastro zone and expo
additional: Participants aged 70+ have a free start package for the 10 km and half marathon. Limited edition commemorative T-shirts available for runners and families. Debut of active wheelchair athletes in the 10 km race. After the race, recovery meal, stretching, and massages at the finish line, as well as a charity auction. The area includes the surroundings of Swarzędzkie Lake, with discounts for families and veterans, and new accessibility amenities.

name: Krakowski Bieg Swoszowicki
description: The Krakow Swoszowicki Run is a family running event organized in the beautiful Spa Park in Swoszowice, in the south of Krakow. It offers a variety of competitions: the main 10 km race, a 5 km race, a family mile, and races for children aged 1 to 11 years. The event combines generations, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as integrating residents of Krakow and the surrounding areas. Besides sports competition, participants can enjoy attractive start packages and a family picnic.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race through the streets of Swoszowice district X and surrounding areas
Family mile on a 1.6 km distance with intergenerational rivalry
Races for children from 50 to 300 meters, adapted to different age groups
additional: The start package includes gadgets from sponsors, a race number, and a commemorative medal upon completion. Identification and signed declarations are required when collecting the package. The race takes place on the weekend before Children's Day, and the program also features a family picnic. The event supports sick children, is held in the beautiful location of Spa Park, and enjoys high attendance and cooperation with the city of Krakow.

name: LoveLasTrail
description: Love'Las Trail Przystań is a unique forest run held in the picturesque Mazovian forests, in the heart of the Ostrołęka Forest District. This sports and recreational event combines competition with a love for nature, promoting a healthy lifestyle and social integration. Routes of varying difficulty are available for runners at different levels of advancement, as well as for families and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. The atmosphere of the run is full of positive energy and respect for nature, as confirmed by participants of previous editions.
course_highlights: Cross-country routes in the heart of Mazovian forests of varying difficulty
Scenic forest trails around the Ostrołęka Forest District
Distances from a family-friendly 2 km to a challenging run of about 20 km
additional: Race office open from 7:30 to 9:30. Start times for individual distances: 08:00 Forest Deer Marathon (42 km), 09:00 King of the Forest (about 20 km), 10:00 Winds Run (5 km) and Wolf Route (10 km), 10:05 Jackal Nordic Walking (5 km), 10:15 Green Adventure (family run/walk 2 km). The registration fee includes a start number, a returnable chip, a commemorative gadget, a medal, a recovery meal, and a sweet treat. For distances of 5 km, 10 km, 20 km, and Nordic Walking, an Open classification for Women and Men is conducted with trophies for the best. Participants have access to training plans and support, and the event includes various race categories, including marathon, 20 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a family run. Registration is open until May 25, 2026.

name: Mazowiecka Piętnastka
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mińsku Mazowieckim
description: The Mazovian Fifteen is a jubilee, 30th edition of the national street race organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Mińsk Mazowiecki. The event will take place on May 31, 2026, and is a perfect opportunity for a sporting celebration in a picturesque city. The race is street-based and attracts runners from all over Poland, offering an attractive route and professional organization.
course_highlights: Street route in Mińsk Mazowiecki
Jubilee, 30th edition of the race
Organizer: MOSiR Mińsk Mazowiecki
additional: street race, date May 31, 2026, Mińsk Mazowiecki, PZLA certification, registration closed

name: Mokotowski Bieg SGH
description: The Mokotowski SGH Run is the largest charity run organized by students in Poland, combining sport with helping those in need. The event takes place in the heart of Mokotów, Warsaw, and attracts hundreds of participants — students, alumni, residents, and running enthusiasts. The race route runs through the streets of Mokotów with the finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens, and every step has a real impact on the lives of those in need thanks to the support of the 'Akogo?' Foundation. It is not only a sporting event but also a community, solidarity, and the energy of student engagement.
course_highlights: Routes of 5 km and 10 km through the streets of Mokotów
Finish line in the SGH Rector's Gardens
Run for children and entire families
additional: The event includes a meeting and attractions zone for partners, a joint warm-up before the start, and medal awards after the race. The run has a charitable character, with proceeds going to the 'Akogo?' Foundation supporting people in a coma. The event promotes community integration among students and residents of Warsaw, encouraging a healthy lifestyle and helping others.

name: Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challange
description: The Rio de Janeiro Virtual Challenge is a virtual event that takes you on a route through the vibrant streets and breathtaking landscapes of Rio de Janeiro, known as the Marvelous City. Participants can track their progress using a mobile app, logging various physical activities that are automatically converted into distance covered. The challenge offers the flexibility to choose your own pace and duration, as well as individual or team participation. Additionally, for every progress made in the challenge, organizers plant trees or prevent plastic bottles from reaching the ocean, supporting environmental protection.
course_highlights: 198 km (123 miles) route through Rio de Janeiro
8 virtual postcards to unlock during the challenge
Integration with popular fitness apps and smartwatches
additional: Participants have access to a private Facebook group where they can share experiences and motivate each other. The challenge allows logging of any distance-based activities, including yoga or weightlifting. Participants can choose their own start date and challenge duration. Access to a mobile app on iOS and Android for tracking progress. Participants can complete the challenge at any time; medals and apparel are available, and participation supports ecological initiatives.

name: Stryszów w Biegu
description: Stryszów Municipality invites you to the sporting event "Stryszów Run," which will take place on May 31, 2026. The race route runs through picturesque areas of the municipality, including fields, forests, and views of Lake Mucharskie and surrounding hills. The event offers three distances suitable for different skill levels: 6 km for families and beginners, 10 km for runners seeking a challenge, and a 21 km mountain half-marathon for experienced competitors. The goal of the event is to promote physical activity, integrate residents, and showcase the natural attractions of the region.
course_highlights: The route runs through fields and forests
View of Lake Mucharskie
Hilly and mountain character of the half-marathon
additional: Three distances: 6 km, 10 km, 21 km; limit of 300 participants; start and finish at the LKS "Chełm" Stryszów facility; online registration until May 24; the event promotes physical activity and the natural attractions of the region.

name: UltraPark Weekend
description: UltraPark Weekend is an ultra running festival taking place in Pabianice from May 29 to May 31, 2026. The event features three main competitions: UltraPark 48h, UltraPark 24h, and UltraPark 100 km, which are also the Polish championships in their categories. The races attract long-distance runners, offering challenging routes and a unique competitive atmosphere. The organizer is the Sports Club "O Co Biega" from Pabianice.
course_highlights: Routes of UltraPark 48h and UltraPark 24h
UltraPark 100 km route
Event held in Pabianice
additional: The event includes various ultramarathon distances, with opening and closing ceremonies during the 48-hour race; registration details are not yet available

description: The 5th Kolei Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.1 km long taking place on May 31, 2026, in Lemany near Szczytno. The route runs along a bike path on an old railway line and municipal roads, offering scenic views and well-equipped hydration and nutrition points. The event is organized by the District Sports, Tourism, and Recreation Center in Szczytno and the Local Tourism Organization of Szczytno County. In addition to the half marathon, there are children's races and a 5 km run, making the event attractive for various age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Route along a bike path on an old railway line
Hydration points at 5.5 km, 10.5 km, and 16 km
Nutrition point at 10.5 km of the route
additional: The start package includes a bib number, a commemorative T-shirt, a finisher medal, and a timing chip (to be returned at the finish line). Minors must present written consent from legal guardians. The organizer provides a meal and water for all participants. The participant limit is 150 paid entries. Cash prizes are awarded to the top three finishers in the Open categories for women and men, as well as in additional categories such as uniformed services and county. The race promotes physical activity; participants receive medals and T-shirts. Online registration is available. The event takes place along the old railway line route.

name: X Charytatywny Gminny Bieg Między Wiatra...
description: The 10th Municipal Charity Run Between Windmills is an annual running event held in Łukaszów, aimed at promoting running, sports, and a healthy lifestyle. The run is charitable, and all proceeds are donated to support those in need. The course runs along a scenic loop around the windmills in Łukaszów, and participants can choose from several distances, including a children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking. Organizers provide electronic timing and a warm meal and drinks for participants.
course_highlights: Loop around the windmills in Łukaszów
5 km and 10 km courses with a time limit of 1 hour and 30 minutes
Children's run approximately 500 meters on the recreational square
additional: The participant limit is 200 people across all distances. Timing is provided by Sports Timing Poland using electronic chips worn on the leg. Chips must be returned after the run or a fee of 50 PLN applies for loss. Participants must check in at the race office, open from 8:30 to 10:35. The organizer provides a warm meal, cakes, water, coffee, and tea for participants. The event is a municipal charity run scheduled for May 31, 2026, supporting local initiatives.

name: XI Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski
location: Park Miejski im. A. Mickiewicza, Sieradz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: Sieradzki Cross Towarzyski is an annual running event organized by the Sieradz Biega Sports Club, promoting running and integrating the running community of Sieradz. The race takes place in A. Mickiewicz City Park on a 2 km loop covered with gravel, marked every 500 meters. The event lasts 6 hours, during which participants compete to complete as many laps as possible, with the option to take breaks and return to the course. The event is social and promotional in nature, and participants receive electronic lap and time measurement.
course_highlights: 2 km loop in A. Mickiewicz City Park in Sieradz
100% gravel surface
Lap markings every 500 m
additional: The race runs from 11:00 to 17:00, participants can pause and resume at any time but must stay within the designated transition zone during breaks. Each participant receives a returnable start number with a chip for electronic lap and time measurement. The participant limit is 250 people. Minors (ages 16-17) can participate with parental consent and can run up to 10 km (5 laps). The race involves running on a 2-kilometer park loop, with electronic timing, commemorative medals, awards for the best, and starter packs.

description: TAURON Run for Angels is a charity run organized in Katowice that supports the beneficiaries of the Guardian Angels House. The event takes place in Kościuszko Park and combines sports with helping children in need. Participants can choose the main 5 km run, children's races in various age categories, and a virtual run. The entire registration fee is donated to support educational, therapeutic, and upbringing activities for nearly 600 children from difficult backgrounds. The event also features a family picnic full of attractions, and each participant receives a commemorative medal and a gift.
course_highlights: Main run over 5 km in Kościuszko Park in Katowice
Children's races in various age categories
Opportunity to participate in a virtual run from anywhere
additional: Children aged 0-6 can accompany a guardian on the main route free of charge after prior registration via the form. The event also includes a full-day Family Picnic with attractions. Prizes and trophies are awarded for the top three places in the men's and women's categories as well as in children's races. The registration fee is a donation and is non-refundable. The 5 km distance includes various age categories, children's races, a virtual run, family attractions, with registration deadlines on May 15 and May 27.

The event features distances of 10 km and 5 km for running, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking walk, with open, age, and local resident classifications. The start and finish are located at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for tangible prizes for participants, and the race office is open a few hours before the start.
course_highlights: Distances: 10 km run, 5 km run, and 5 km Nordic Walking walk
Start and finish at Powstańców Wielkopolskich Street near Primary School No. 2 in Kostrzyn
Classifications: OPEN, age-based, and for residents of Kostrzyn municipality
additional: Race office open from 15:00 to 16:30. The organizer plans to hold a raffle for a tangible prize worth at least 500 PLN among all race participants. Mini Kurdeszowa Za(Dyszka) are children's races on distances from 100 m to 800 m depending on age categories, with commemorative medals for all participants. The event also includes training sessions, prize draws, and is part of local sports attractions.

name: XXXIX Bieg Stolemów
location: Stadion 'Arena Mistrzów', Gniewino, Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Kaszubskie Stowarzyszenie Kultury Fizycznej Żukowo oraz Gminny Ośrodek Turystyki i Sportu w Gniewinie
description: The 39th Stolem Run is an annual 10 km race organized at the 'Arena Mistrzów' Sports Stadium in Gniewino. The event also includes races for children and youth, a 5 km Nordic Walking march, and a recreational walk-run. Participants can enjoy electronic timing, medals for all participants, and prizes for the best. For those wishing to participate virtually, there is an option for a virtual run from May 27 to June 4, 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with certification
Nordic Walking march over 5 km
Children's and youth races over shorter distances
additional: The event begins with the opening of the race office at 11:00 AM, where start numbers and chips are issued. A café, deposit, and changing facilities are available. The preschool run of 80 meters is free, and every participant receives a medal. The recreational walk-run over 1200 meters requires no registration and is free of charge. Participants are classified into 15 age categories. On-site registration for the 5 km and 10 km races is possible. A free bouncy castle is available for the youngest participants, and there is coffee and cake from KGW Perlino on site. Participants can choose from various distances and age categories, and the event also features attractions and decorations at the stadium.

name: Świętokrzyski Bieg Europejski
description: The Świętokrzyski European Run is a 5-kilometer street race held in Kielce, promoting physical activity and the spirit of the European community. The race course runs through the city streets, offering participants a sporting challenge in a friendly atmosphere. The event is part of the Funduszowego Maja 2026 activities in the Świętokrzyskie Voivodeship, encouraging movement and local community integration.

Race promoting physical activity and European spirit
Organized as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026 in Świętokrzyskie
additional: Street race in Kielce, 5 km, event as part of Funduszowego Maja 2026.

description: The Berounka Running Series in Zadní Třebaň is a picturesque race held in the beautiful nature of the Central Bohemian Region. The route runs along the Berounka River, across meadows with views, the Liteň educational trail, and a scenic landscape reminiscent of Tuscany. The race culminates with a run to the highest point of the course in Doubce and a final downhill to the finish line in a pleasant camp with refreshments. Each participant receives a start number, and the top three in each category earn diplomas and medals.

Liteň educational trail along the Stříbný Stream and historic waterworks
Run to the highest point of the course in Doubce with beautiful viewpoints

The top three in each category receive diplomas and medals. The route is marked with red and white banners and red ground arrows. Recommended arrival time is by 17:45. The finish is in a camp with refreshments and seating. The race offers online and on-site registration, refreshments, baggage storage, and medals for category winners. The series includes a total of 12 races with point scoring for the best 10, and winners receive diplomas and medals.

name: dm Firmenlauf Saarbrücken
description: The dm Corporate Run Saarbrücken is a sporting event for teams and companies taking place on June 2, 2026, in downtown Saarbrücken. The 5 km flat and asphalted course runs from the State Theatre along the Saar River and through the city center, accompanied by great atmosphere and spectator cheers. After the run, participants can enjoy an after-run party with live music, awards ceremony, and refreshments. The run promotes team spirit, movement, and communal celebration in a relaxed setting.
course_highlights: 5 km flat, asphalted course through Saarbrücken city center
Course refreshment at kilometer 2.5 at Staden with water
Atmospheric finish at the Saar riverbank and St. Johanner Market
additional: Race bibs are collected and distributed internally by the team captain. Late registrations are possible online until shortly before the start and at the race bib distribution. description: The Westerwälder Backyard Ultra 2026 is a unique ultramarathon taking place in Höchstenbach in the Westerwald (Rhineland-Palatinate). The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere with electronic lap counting, catering at the start/finish area, and a medal for everyone who completes at least one lap. Additionally, part of the entry fee is donated to local youth work and a tree planting project.
course_highlights: 6.706 km long loop course with 71 meters of elevation gain per lap
Running on forest, woodland, and meadow paths
Electronic lap counting via RaceResult
additional: Number bib distribution begins on June 5, 2026, at 5:00 PM. Mandatory briefing 15 minutes before the start. Catering with runner-friendly drinks and snacks at the start/finish area. Tenting/pavilion setup is limited. Shower tags available on site. No refund of entry fee in case of non-participation; substitute runners allowed. Waiting list available when full. Part of the entry fee is donated to youth work and a tree planting project. Medal for all who complete at least one lap. Award ceremony shortly after the event ends. Participants can camp or set up pavilions in the start/finish area. The registration fee includes a donation to a charitable cause, plus €1.50 per lap (up to a maximum of 10 laps). The event is limited to 200 participants and begins on June 5, 2026, at 7:00 PM.

name: Borkener Citylauf
description: The Borken City Run is a traditional popular race that has been held annually in the city center of Borken since 1987. The event offers runs for young and old on a closed 2.5 km circuit that passes through the city center, the city park, and the marketplace. Starting and finishing at the marketplace, the City Run is a popular running event that appeals to both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event is organized by the Borken City Sports Association and several local clubs, offering a family-friendly atmosphere with various age groups and awards.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit through the city center, city park, and marketplace
Start and finish at the marketplace in Borken
Various distances for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 2:00 PM until 30 minutes before the respective race start for a fee of €2.00 at the Borken Tourist Information. Race bibs will be issued from 2:00 PM. Transponders are collected after crossing the finish line for a refundable €2.00. Races for different age groups, online registration, on-site late registration possible, special support for young runners with guide children.

name: Freundschaftslauf
description: The SaarLANDlauf is a friendship run around Saarland, held in 20 stages along the Saarland circular hiking trail with a total distance of approximately 400 kilometers. The runs are guided friendship runs organized by local sponsors and are aimed at experienced runners who can comfortably complete a half marathon. The goal is to strengthen the community of Saarland runners and running clubs and to explore the most beautiful corners of Saarland together. Participation is free of charge, but a small donation is gladly appreciated.
course_highlights: 20 stages each approximately 20 km long
Routes run along the Saarland circular hiking trail with plenty of inclines and descents
Guided runs without markings, GPS data provided
additional: The runs are not competitions but friendship runs. There are no running guides or markings; instead, GPS data of the routes are provided. The event promotes sociability and community, with a cozy gathering after the runs. Changing rooms, showers, and parking are available at the meeting points. Participants explore the mystical swampy Rötelsteinpfad region, with scenic views of the Nahe. The event is part of a multi-day, regionally focused running event with several stages and route options.

name: Heider Abend-Stadtlauf
description: The Heider Evening City Run is a traditional race in Heide organized by MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide. The event offers runners of various performance levels the opportunity to compete on an attractive course through the city. The race is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and support from the local sports club. The route is well marked and provides a varied running experience in the beautiful surroundings of Heide.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city center of Heide
Well marked race route with diverse cityscape
Organized by the traditional MTV von 1860 e.V. Heide
additional: The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community through sporting activities in Heide.

name: Rohrener Volkslauf
description: The 48th Rohrener Volkslauf takes place on Friday evening in Monschau, Germany. Various competitions are offered, including a 4.2 km and a 10 km race for adults, as well as a separate 10 km event for walkers and Nordic walkers. The races follow a rolling course and all finish at Im Johannesfeld in Monschau. In addition to adults, younger runners also participate, and registration is done online through the organizer.
course_highlights: Rolling course through Monschau
Finish at Im Johannesfeld
Separate 10 km for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: The shorter races start first, followed by the walkers and Nordic walkers, with the 10 km runners starting last. Typical weather in June is around 23°C with mostly sunny days. Event features a rolling course, online registration, including children and youth races as well as walking events.

name: Saalfelder Bambini-Schloßparklauf
organizer: Saalfelder Leichtathletik-Verein e.V. und Thüringer Leichtathletik Verband e.V.
description: The Saalfeld Children's Castle Park Run is a traditional children's race taking place on June 5, 2026, starting at 5:00 PM in the Saalfeld Castle Park. The event is aimed at children born between 2017 and 2023, who will run one or two laps depending on their age. The race is organized by the Saalfeld Athletics Club e.V. and offers a child-friendly atmosphere for the youngest runners. Registration is available online, at the start, or by phone.
course_highlights: Races for children aged 3 to 9 years
Lap length varies depending on age group (1 or 2 laps)
Event held in the idyllic Saalfeld Castle Park
additional: Registration is possible online, at the start, or by phone with Uta Weber (Tel.: 0176/84770473). There are no entry fees. The races are divided by birth year, with each group running 1 or 2 laps. A liability disclaimer for damages and injuries applies. The event is organized by the Saalfeld Athletics Club e.V. The children's race takes place in the castle park and is part of the Saalfeld Kulmberg Run, with dates and results available.

name: Spargellauf
description: The WERNER Spargellauf in Deinste is a 5.5 km relay race that takes place annually and will celebrate its 20th anniversary in 2026. Teams of five runners run together through the asparagus fields, with an asparagus stalk serving as the baton. The race is suitable for all fitness levels, from beginners to professionals, and fun is the main focus, as the winning team is drawn by lot. In addition to the race, there is a culinary mile with regional specialties and a family program with a bouncy castle and other attractions. For the anniversary, a special running shirt is offered, and a large after-show party takes place.
course_highlights: 5.5 km long course through the Deinste asparagus fields
Relay race with an asparagus stalk as the baton
Suitable for all fitness levels, walking, strolling, or running possible
additional: Anniversary 2026 with after-show party, anniversary magazine, lucky wheel, and special anniversary dishes and drinks. The winning team is drawn by lot and receives regional products (asparagus, potatoes, ham, strawberries). Anniversary running shirt with individual team name or logo available for order until May 16. Culinary mile with a variety of foods and drinks. Family program with a bouncy castle. Anniversary event with after-show party, running shirt offer, music, and catering along the course.

name: Stapelmoorer Run-Fun-Loop
description: The Stapelmoorer Run Fun Loop is a 10 km race measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), starting and ending at the sports field of Teutonia Stapelmoor. The course takes runners through the scenic surroundings of Stapelmoor, with sections along farm roads, school routes, and village streets. The event is part of the Teutonia Stapelmoor running community and offers participants a well-organized and varied running route in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km DLV-measured course
Start and finish at the sports field of Teutonia Stapelmoor
Course passes through farm roads, school routes, and village streets
additional: Registration online until the day of the event, start and finish at the sports field in Stapelmoor, including Nordic walking without timing.

name: Warnemünder Stapellauf
description: The Warnemünde Launch is a small race held in June in Rostock, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany. The event offers short distances of 555 meters and 9.3 kilometers, ideal for runners seeking a straightforward racing experience. The courses bear local nautical names reflecting Warnemünde's coastal identity, including the 5 Nautical Miles Run (9 km) and the 3 Nautical Miles Run (6 km). Results are managed via my.race|result, and the event is listed in the running.de calendar.
course_highlights: Short distances: 555 m and 9.3 km
Local nautical names of the runs (5 Nautical Miles Run, 3 Nautical Miles Run, 3 Cable Lengths Run)
Event location Warnemünde with coastal character
additional: The event takes place on June 5, 2026, in Warnemünde. Typical June weather includes maximum temperatures around 23°C and minimums around 13°C, with mostly sunny days. Detailed course information is not available; results are provided online. The event also includes race courses related to maritime navigation, engineering sciences, and logistics; results are available online.

name: Kolem Trpaslíka v Hybrálci
description: The Dwarf Around Hybrálek race is a 10 km running event that primarily takes place on forest unpaved paths in the Hybrálek area near Jihlava. This race is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy the natural terrain of Vysočina. The course is suitable for forest running enthusiasts and those seeking a pleasant sporting experience in nature.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 10 km
Mostly forest unpaved paths
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup
additional: The race offers various courses around Hybrálek, including options for shorter distances, and is suitable for all age groups. A friendly atmosphere is prepared along with the opportunity to meet the Vysočina running community.

name: Valašské kilo
description: Valašské Kilo is a challenging 100 km ultramarathon run through the beautiful and hilly landscape of Wallachia with at least 3,500 meters of elevation gain. The race is a challenge not only for experienced athletes but also for those who want to push their limits and experience an adventure in the terrain. After a mass start at 22:00, participants plan their own route between control points within a 30-hour time limit. The race headquarters is at ZŠ Žerotínova in Valašské Meziříčí, where a gymnasium, showers, and a dining hall are available. Valašské Kilo offers freedom and space for navigation in the terrain and is one of the best ultramarathons in the Czech Republic.
course_highlights: 100 km route with at least 3,500 meters of elevation gain
Flexible route choice between control points (Krpály)
Challenging terrain of Wallachia with hills and natural beauty
additional: The race has a 30-hour time limit. Participants receive a card with control points at the start, which they must visit. The race facilities are open from approximately 16:00 on Friday to 12:00 on Sunday and include a gymnasium, showers, dining hall, drinking water, and a luggage storage. Each participant must provide their own route map. The race focuses on endurance walking and running, emphasizing resilience and the ability to handle the demanding terrain in the Wallachia region.

name: Dopesace Backyard Ultra
description: Dopesace Backyard Ultra is an endurance race held in the Aš Forests, where a loop of nearly 7 kilometers is run every hour. The race continues as long as there is only one runner who can complete more laps than the others. This unique format emphasizes not only speed but primarily endurance and determination. The winner receives a silver coin and the opportunity to represent the Czech Republic at the team world championship in October 2026. The race atmosphere is unforgettable and the event is also connected with a charitable project.
course_highlights: Loop length of 6.71 km with an elevation gain of approximately 80 m
Race held in the Aš Forests, start and facilities at Kemp Pod Rozhlednou
Each lap begins exactly one hour after the previous one, with strict time discipline
additional: Pre-race presentation is possible on the evening before the race between 5 PM and 7 PM or in the morning on the race day from 8 AM to 9:15 AM. Participants must be over 18 years old. Each lap must be completed within 60 minutes, otherwise disqualification follows. No assistance or aids, including trekking poles, are allowed on the route. The race is connected with charity, where runners contribute 1-10 CZK for each completed kilometer to a selected project. The race takes place in the Aš Forests, with a requirement to use a headlamp during night sections. Registration is mandatory. The event has a charitable dimension and emphasizes community atmosphere and endurance.

name: 2. Jenaer Backyard Ultra
description: The 2nd Jena Backyard Ultra is a unique 'Last Human Standing' race in Jena-Cospeda, Thuringia. All participants start simultaneously every hour on a 6.7 km loop, which they must complete within an hour. Those who fail to finish the loop or give up are eliminated. The race ends when only one runner remains, having completed the loop within the time limit. In addition to individual standings, there is a team classification for teams of up to three participants, which accumulate the most laps over the duration.
course_highlights: 6.7 km long loop with some steep climbs
Beautiful nature and rewarding views
Start and finish at the sports field Cospeda in Jena
additional: Arrival from 05.06.2026 16:00 is possible. Tent facilities are available on the event grounds, but there are no parking spaces for caravans, campers, or cars. Parking is only permitted in designated areas on Mühlenweg, a few minutes' walk from the site. Basic supplies of drinks, fruit, vegetables, and snacks are provided during the event. The race starts at 6:00 AM; participants must bring their own food and drinks. Tent and parking facilities are available. The participant limit has already been reached; all spots are booked.

name: 41. Internationaler Sollinglauf
organizer: Laufgruppe des Dasseler Sport-Clubs von 1920 e.V.
price_range: €5.00 bis €35.00 je nach Veranstaltung und Anmeldedatum
description: The 41st International Solling Run will take place on June 6, 2026, in the Solling area near Dassel. The event offers various race distances from 400 meters up to the Leaders Academy Solling Marathon over 42.5 km. The courses lead through the diverse landscape of the Solling and provide suitable options for ambitious runners as well as recreational runners and walkers. The event is organized by the Dasseler Sport-Club von 1920 e.V. and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and attractive prize money.
course_highlights: Marathon over 42.5 km through the Solling area
Various distances from 400 m to 42.5 km
Walking and hiking options with a time limit of 6 hours
additional: Walking and hiking are possible on various routes, registration for these is only on-site. Swapping start numbers or running a different route than registered is not allowed. There is a time limit of 6 hours for walking and hiking on the race courses. Multiple running and walking options, registration on-site possible, age-dependent prices.

price_range: 8,5 km: 12 EUR, Jugend 5 EUR, Schüler frei

tiers.description: Schüler m/w gebohren 2010 und jünger: FREI

description: The Below, Memorial, and Heidelauf is a traditional race through the Wittstocker Heath and forest, organized annually by LC Dosse Wittstock e.V. The 8.5 km course is open to women, men, and youth, offering a varied natural scenery. In addition to the main race, there are classifications for youth and students as well as a school cup ranking. The event is part of the Brandenburg Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere with trophies for overall winners and certificates for all participants.
course_highlights: Course through the Wittstocker Heath and forest
Natural, varied terrain on the race route
Refreshments on the course provided by the organizer
additional: Trophies for the overall winners of the race routes, certificates available upon request, 2nd Sparkasse OPR School Cup with prizes for the three schools with the most participants, late registration deadline ends on 24.05.2025 at 9:30 AM, participation at own risk, liability disclaimer for accidents, theft, and damages, start and finish at the Stadion des Friedens, Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Str.62, 16909 Wittstock. Course through the Wittstocker Heath and forest, online registration, participation at own risk

name: Finkenwerder Insellauf (mit HH-Meisterschaften 5 km)
description: The Finkenwerder Island Run takes place on June 6, 2026, in Finkenwerder, Hamburg, and offers a diverse running program for all age groups. The main races are held on an exactly measured, flat 5 km loop course through green oases and along the Elbe, ideal for fast times and the Hamburg Championships over 5 km. In addition to the main routes, there are age-appropriate runs for children and adolescents as well as relay and walking competitions. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere, with start and finish directly at the Finkenwerder Market Square and a sustainable event concept with reusable cups and recycling medals.
course_highlights: 5 km flat, precisely measured loop course with approximately 6 meters of elevation
Course runs through green oases and along the Elbe
Start and finish directly at the Finkenwerder Market Square
additional: Late registrations are possible until about one hour before the start (6:15 PM) at the Market Square with an additional fee. Showers and changing rooms are available at the Gorch-Fock-Halle approximately 250 meters away. The event is part of the BSV Summer Cup and the Hamburgiade. It features a sustainable organization with reusable cups, recycling medals, and waste reduction. The award ceremony begins around 8:15 PM at the Market Square. The course follows the Elbe route, registration is available online and on-site, start at 7:15 PM, award ceremony around 8:15 PM, no escort vehicles allowed, sustainable organization with reusable cups and recycling medals.

name: Hahnenkammlauf
description: The Hahnenkammlauf in Edelsfeld is an idyllic forest run that will already be in its 23rd edition in 2026. The event is open to runners of all ages, from children to experienced athletes, and offers varied routes around the sports grounds at Hahnenkamm. Due to the renovation of the sports field, the course has been adjusted. The run is part of the Amberg-Sulzbach District Cup and annually motivates around 250 participants to achieve sporting success in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Idyllic forest course around Hahnenkamm
Year-round marked routes from 1,000 meters
Adjusted course due to sports field renovation
additional: Number bib collection from 1:30 PM at the sports clubhouse. Children's runs from 3:00 PM (400m and 600m for toddlers, 1,000m and 2,000m for school children) with subsequent award ceremony. Youth, women’s, and men’s runs start from 5:15 PM. The courses are divided according to DLO age classes and are also relevant for the district cup and municipal evaluation. Online payment of the starting fee is possible, as well as payment on the day of the event. Children's run training begins in May as preparation for the race. Routes at Hahnenkamm, online registration available, late registrations accepted until 2:00 PM on race day, bib collection at the sports clubhouse, course secured by fire brigade, free refreshments, medical support by First Responders.

name: Lingelbacher Windmühlenlauf
description: The Lingelbacher Windmill Run is a traditional running event in Lingelbach near Alsfeld, which will take place for the 21st time in 2026. The race is organized by TSV Lingelbach 1925 e.V. and offers various running distances for children, students, and adults. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the scenic route around Lingelbach. The registration fee is paid in cash on site at the race bib distribution.
course_highlights: Various distances (700 m, 5.3 km, 10 km)
Hilly routes for a sporting challenge
Suitable for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
additional: The registration fee is payable in cash on site at the race bib distribution. The event takes place in June, with typical temperatures around 23°C; various categories including children and walking; cash payment possible on site.

name: Oranienburger Stundenlauf
description: The Oranienburg Hour Run is a varied race event on the track behind Oranienburg Castle. The event offers different competitions with time limits of 15, 30, and 60 minutes, as well as a 400-meter children's run and Nordic walking. The races are divided by age groups and gender, and all fully completed laps within the time limit are counted. Each finisher receives a medal, and there are certificates as well as award ceremonies for the top runners.
course_highlights: Running on the track behind Oranienburg Castle
Scoring based on fully completed laps within the time limit
Various competitions from 15 to 60 minutes, including children's runs and Nordic walking
additional: Maximal 100 participants per start. Registration fees: €2.00 for children, €5.00 for adults. Registration exclusively online via myracepartner.com. Payment methods: direct debit, PayPal (group registrations only direct debit). Each finisher receives a medal, certificates are available online. Award ceremonies for children's and youth races as well as main runs according to age groups and overall ranking. The event is part of the EMB-Energy Cup Oberhavel and offers online registration and parking facilities.

name: Silberberglauf
price_range: regulärer Preis bis 01.06.2026, Last Minute bis 05.06.2026, vor Ort ab 08:30 Uhr

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Anmeldung zum regulären Preis ist bis zum 01.06.2026 möglich.

description: The 41st Silberberglauf on June 6, 2026, offers runners and walkers varied routes around the Silberberg near Ilmenau. With distances of 21.1 km, 11 km, 6 km, as well as children's runs over 2.5 km and 0.6 km, there is something for all age groups and performance levels. The event is part of the Sparkassencup Saalfeld-Rudolstadt and the TLV-Cup and promises a sporty atmosphere with catering, medals, and award ceremonies. The children's sports festival in the afternoon rounds off the family-friendly event.
course_highlights: Half marathon with approximately 600 meters of elevation gain
11 km route with approximately 250 meters of elevation gain and Nordic walking classification
Children's runs and children's sports festival in the afternoon
additional: Race bib distribution on race day from 07:30 to 08:45 for main races, children's runs from 14:00. Last-minute registration on-site until 08:30 for main races and until 14:40 for children's runs. Catering at the routes and at the sports field, changing facilities, toilets, finisher medals, and certificates. Using poles is mandatory for the 11 km route; running with poles is prohibited. Baby joggers, dogs, and bicycle accompaniment are not allowed for safety reasons. All routes close at 13:00. Trail terrain, online registration via Race Result, safety rules regarding equipment, participation in multiple cups.

name: Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow LC/NLC
description: The Stadtwerke Inselseelauf Güstrow is a traditional race event taking place on June 6, 2026, in Güstrow, Germany. Organized by Tri Fun Güstrow e. V., the event offers various distances for different age groups. The main race includes a 10 km course for runners from U20 and older, complemented by shorter races for youth and children. The 48th edition of this local event is held at the InselseeHeidberg bathing beach and promises a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting.
course_highlights: Start at the InselseeHeidberg bathing beach in Güstrow
10 km main race for U20 and older
Shorter races for youth and children classes
additional: The event includes a 10 km main race, a 5 km road race for JU14, JU16, and JU18, as well as a 1.2 km race for KU10 and KU12. Typical June weather in Güstrow is around 23°C with mostly sunny days and an average of 65 mm of precipitation. The event is part of the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. The weather in June in Güstrow is typically pleasantly warm, around 23°C.

name: Usedom Beach Marathon - 6. Juni 2026
price_range: 42€ für den Marathon, 99€ für die Staffel
description: The Usedom Beach Marathon is Germany's first beach marathon and takes place on June 6, 2026, on the island of Usedom. The runs take place exclusively on sand along the Baltic Sea coast, without asphalt or road traffic, offering a unique natural and running experience directly by the sea. Participants can choose from a marathon, half marathon, 10 km short distance, or a relay marathon. The event combines sporting challenge with a special beach atmosphere and a professional program at the finish area in Ahlbeck.
course_highlights: Running exclusively on sand without asphalt or road traffic
Start in Zinnowitz, finish in Ahlbeck (Marathon)
11 aid stations with water, isotonic drinks, bananas, gels, and cola
additional: The marathon has a time limit of 7 hours (cut-off at 16:00). Exceeding the time limit results in no further course security or catering. The relay consists of 5 segments with at least 3 runners per team, with classifications for female, male, and mixed teams. Start areas are Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, with a common finish area in Ahlbeck. There is a professional entertainment and information program from 10:00 to 18:00 at the finish area. Running on sand, no asphalt course, start and finish areas in Zinnowitz, Koserow, or Ahlbeck, including catering, medal, certificate, and shuttle transfers.

name: Wremer Deichlauf
location: Wremen, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wremer Deichlauf is the traditional highlight of the sports season of TuS Wremen 09 and warmly invites all running enthusiasts. There are two courses offered: a short loop of 5,300 meters and a long route of 15,900 meters through the green marsh. The courses mainly run on paved bike and farm roads and also go off the dike directly along the water and mudflats. There is also a separate walking competition on the short loop.
course_highlights: Course mainly on paved bike and farm roads
Run directly along the water and mudflats on the Treibselräumweg
Two distances: 5.3 km and 15.9 km through the green marsh
additional: Walking competition on the 5,300-meter loop. The event is the highlight of the sports season of TuS Wremen 09. The courses are mainly paved and also run off the dike along the water. Courses mainly on paved bike or farm roads, run along water and mudflats, walking competition on the short course.

name: Trutnovská 10
location: Paradráze, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trutnovská 10 is a traditional running race with a 12-year history, offering unforgettable experiences in the beautiful environment of Trutnov's Para forest park. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, and offers a choice of several routes: 5 km loop, 10 km loop, and canicross over 3 km. For children, there is a children's cross with obstacles adapted to age categories and an accompanying program. Trutnovská 10 is suitable for beginners and experienced runners who want to experience the atmosphere of a mass start and connect with nature in the heart of the Krkonoše mountains.
course_highlights: Para forest park with forested paved paths
Routes of 5 km, 10 km, and canicross 3 km loop
Children's cross with obstacles adapted to age
additional: The start and finish of the race are in the Paradráha Trutnov area. The routes are not certified. Children's categories have various lengths from 200 m to 1500 m with obstacles such as climbing, crawling, and slalom. The difficulty of the obstacles is adapted to the age so that everyone can manage them. The race offers different distances, including canicross, and focuses on a community and family atmosphere with accompanying activities such as yoga, a bouncy castle, and refreshments.

name: Jesenická šedesátka
location: Zámecké náměstí, Jeseník, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Jesenická šedesátka is a hiking and running event along the ridges of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, offering beautiful natural surroundings and the opportunity to test your endurance against time. The 60 km route is designed for more experienced participants aged at least 16 years and includes refreshment stations. The event is traditional and popular, with timing measured by chip technology and results announced at the finish. Organizers emphasize safety and a relaxed atmosphere, making the race suitable for both runners and tourists.
course_highlights: Hiking and running event along the ridges of Hrubý Jeseník
Refreshment stations at 6 locations on the 60 km route
Time limits and timing measured by chip technology
additional: On the 60 km route, there are refreshment options at 6 locations, including 5 control points managed by the organizers. The organizers use chip technology for timing and ranking. After the race, results are announced at 20:30 at the finish line. Children up to 12 years old are recommended to complete the 25 km route with adult supervision. In case of withdrawal from the route, it is necessary to inform the organizers to prevent unnecessary search efforts. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, with start and finish at Zámecké náměstí in Jeseník. The routes pass through the ridges of Jeseníky. Registration begins in April.

description: The Devil's Ultratrail is an outdoor run through mountains, valleys, castles, and waters in the mysterious nature of Kokořínsko and the Máchovo region. It offers a main route of 66.6 km with beautiful scenery and well-stocked refreshment stations, suitable even for beginner ultramarathoners. The race is part of the Ultracup series and is also the final stage of the 8-day Devil's Challenge 666 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly, and participants will enjoy unforgettable experiences in the picturesque terrain.
course_highlights: Trail through mountains, valleys, castles, and waters of Kokořínsko and Máchovo region
Well-stocked refreshment stations along the route
Picturesque nature and family-friendly race atmosphere
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup for drinks at refreshment stations, with the option to order a devil's running cup, T-shirt, or socks. The race capacity is limited, and registration for the main race on June 6, 2026, is sold out, but spots may become available before the event. The Devil's Challenge 666 km is an 8-day stage race with GPS trackers and online timing. The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with the possibility of earning ITRA points. Registrations are sold out, capacity is limited, and the race offers a family atmosphere and bus transportation to the start.

name: Vybarvený běh
description: Color Run in Kroměříž is an unconventional running event where the focus is not on time but on fun and coloring participants during the course. Every runner will enjoy the joy of movement and the colorful atmosphere at the Great Square. The event is suitable for all age groups, including children who must be accompanied by an adult. The Color Run is a great opportunity for families and individuals who want to experience a sports day full of colors and music.
course_highlights: Run at the Great Square in Kroměříž
Applying colors to oneself and others during the course
Music accompaniment and lively atmosphere

The race offers routes for all age groups and performance levels, from children's races to recreational runners and experienced marathoners. Thanks to its flat profile, the course is ideal for achieving personal bests, and runners can choose from various distances according to their abilities and goals.

name: Kwietny Bieg
description: Kwietny Bieg in Lisowice is a unique 24-hour relay race that commemorates the spirit of freedom awakened by Pope John Paul II during his first pilgrimage to Poland. The race takes place on an approved loop measuring 1352 meters, which is well marked and illuminated after dark. The event is open to all interested and is gaining popularity, attracting a record number of participants. Anyone who covers a distance of 10 Kwietne Miles (35.3 km) receives a certificate and a commemorative medal. It is not only a sporting competition but also a community and an atmosphere full of positive energy.

additional: The race takes place on a 24-hour loop, with participants running in a relay with a white-red sash. After completing 10 Kwietne Miles (35.3 km), participants receive a certificate and medal. The route is illuminated after dark, and the race is open and free of charge. A 24-hour relay race on a 1352 m route with PZLA approval, free participation, record number of participants.

name: Everstener Brunnenlauf 2026
description: The Everestener Brunnenlauf is a traditional running event in Oldenburg taking place on June 7, 2026. Various competitions are offered, including school runs, a corporate and introductory run over 6.3 km, and a popular race over 10 km. The course runs through the Eversten district, starting on Wienstraße and ending in Eversten Holz. The event is known for its large number of participants and family-friendly atmosphere, appealing to both hobby and ambitious runners.
course_highlights: Start on Wienstraße, finish in Eversten Holz
10 km race with three laps plus 400 m
Corporate and introductory run over 6.3 km with team scoring
additional: Start and finish are located in Eversten: start on Wienstraße, finish in Eversten Holz. The sports hall on Feststraße serves as the registration, bib number distribution, changing and shower facilities, as well as for the award ceremony. There is a late registration fee of 5 euros; late registrations are only possible on the Saturday before the race. A free start for fast 10 km runners with proof of best times is possible. Parking is recommended at the large P+R parking lot Prinzessinweg. Participants can look forward to various categories such as corporate run and IT-City-Battle; detailed information on registration and results is available on the website.

name: Frankenthaler Strohhutfestlauf
description: The Frankenthaler Straw Hat Festival Run 2026 will take place on Sunday, June 7th, starting at 10:00 AM. The event offers races for all age groups, including a toddler run over 120 meters, a school run over 2.7 kilometers, and a main race over 5.5 kilometers. The goal is to be active together, have fun, and color Frankenthal pink. The event is organized by the Landfrauenverband Pfalz e.V. and invites everyone - members, families, friends, and interested parties - to a sporty and joyful day.
course_highlights: Toddler run (120 m) for the little ones
School run over 2.7 km
Main race over 5.5 km
additional: Registration please with the spelling LandFrauen Lambsheim (with capital F). Registration also via QR code on the flyer or with Alice Höfer. Multiple distances: toddler run (120 m), school run (2.7 km), main run (5.5 km); registration online or on the event day; race course in the city of Frankenthal; festive atmosphere with award ceremonies.

name: Freystädter Volksfestlauf
price_range: Erwachsene: 10,00 Euro, Schüler: 5,00 Euro, Bambini: 4,00 Euro
description: The Freystadt Folk Festival Run is a traditional running event in Freystadt, Bavaria, held annually as part of the Freystadt Folk Festival. The races start and end at the town hall at the marketplace and offer various distances for adults, students, and children. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, with awards for the best runners and teams as well as special classifications. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports center, and the award ceremony takes place in the festival tent or outdoors.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town hall at the marketplace in Freystadt
Course routes are available online in advance
Running routes for different age and performance groups
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start at the town hall, with a late registration fee of 3.00 euros. The award ceremony for students takes place around 11:00 AM at the town hall, for adults and youth from approximately 1:00 PM in the festival tent or outdoor area. Changing rooms and showers are available at the TSV sports center, Allersberger-Straße 23, Freystadt. Prizes are awarded for the top finishers, certificates for places 1-3, and additional certificates can be accessed online. Special classifications and team competitions are also planned. Courses for different age groups, online registration, award ceremonies at the town hall and in the festival tent, changing rooms at the TSV sports center.
