description: The Haster Volkslauf 2026 will take place on June 7th in Osnabrück-Haste and offers runs for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes a children's run, an inclusive fun run, as well as short and long-distance races. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Haste and is recognized as an approved race by the German Athletics Association. Participants will receive medals, trophies, and an award ceremony immediately after the race on the sports field. Additionally, the race supports a donation campaign for "Jede Oma zählt" through the registration fee.
course_highlights: Children's run with parents on a stadium lap
Inclusive fun run over 2.3 km
Short distance/walking 5.5 km
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 11 a.m. until 30 minutes before the respective start. The late registration fee for the 5 km and 10 km runs is €3, while there is no late fee for the inclusive fun run. Registration fees are collected via direct debit for online registration. Race bibs can be picked up in advance at the Active Sportshop Osnabrück. Toilets and showers are available at the sports field. The cool "Jede Oma zählt" race shirt can be purchased for €25 while supplies last. All participants receive medals (except for short and long-distance races, where trophies are awarded to the top three women and men). Terrain: stadium and road race, registration online and on-site, no dogs or baby joggers allowed.

name: Hopfengarten-Pokallauf - Landescup 9
description: The Hopfengarten Pokal Run is part of the Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt and will take place on June 7, 2026, in Magdeburg. The event is organized by the Athletics Association Saxony-Anhalt e.V. and is open to runners of all ages. The State Cup offers a sporting platform for ambitious runners and promotes running in the region. The races must be registered via the LADV registration portal, and age group and distance recommendations of the association apply.
course_highlights: Varied courses for different age groups
Part of the renowned Novo Nordisk State Cup Saxony-Anhalt
Event in the sports region of Magdeburg
additional: All races must be registered through the LADV registration portal. Age group and distance recommendations must be observed. The event is part of the State Cup, which includes a series of races in Saxony-Anhalt. The race takes place in typical June weather with temperatures around 13-23°C. Registration is via the official channels of the state association. The event is open to all age groups and promotes regional running sports.

name: Lauf um die Himmelsschaukel Bründersen 2026
description: The run around the Himmelsschaukel in Bründersen is a traditional timed race in the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup. Various distances from 400 meters to 20 kilometers are offered, suitable for all age groups, from toddlers to seniors. The event takes place at the sports field in Bründersen and features a varied course through the beautiful surroundings. The race is part of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. and combines athletic competition with community spirit and regional connection.
course_highlights: Course lengths from 400 m to 20 km
Timed race in the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup
Event location at sports field Bründersen with natural surroundings
additional: Age groups: Toddlers, children U10 to U12, youth U14 - U18, women and men seniors. The venue is the sports field in Bründersen, Naumburger Straße 60, 34466 Wolfhagen. The race is embedded in the club life of TSV Bründersen 1967 e.V. The race offers a varied course through the picturesque surroundings of Bründersen. Results and further details are available on the official website.

name: Lingener Citylauf
description: The Lingen City Run is a traditional race held annually on and around the Lingen marketplace. For the 35th time, the city center transforms into a sporting stage full of energy and community. The event offers various distances, including a 5 km and 10 km run, as well as a 10-kilometer relay race with up to 100 teams. The course runs through the city center and is part of the EL Cup. The event is a highlight for runners and spectators from the region and beyond.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Lingen marketplace
Course through the city center of Lingen
Participation in the EL Cup with 5 km and 10 km runs
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day until 45 minutes before the start for a fee of €3.00. Bib number pickup begins on race day from 10:00 AM. Changing rooms and sanitary facilities are available at the Bäumerstraße sports hall, approximately 500 meters from the marketplace. Timing is done with transponders on the bib numbers, which must be returned after the race. Parking options include the underground parking lot at the marketplace and the Alter Pferdemarkt parking lot. Downtown parking is limited on the event day due to street closures. Start and finish are on the Lingen marketplace, parking is available in the city center, changing rooms are in the Bäumerstraße sports hall, and there is no timing for the children's race.

name: Pfreimdtaltrail 2026
description: The Pfreimdtaltrail is a trail half marathon around Trausnitz, taking place on June 7, 2026. The course covers approximately 21 kilometers with about 450 meters of elevation gain and offers diverse landscapes along the Pfreimd, including steep ascents, downhill sections, and scenic stretches along the Goldsteig. The event is registered as a UTMB Index Race and is open to runners aged 16 and older. In addition to the sporting challenge, the race provides a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, an award ceremony, and catering by TSV Trausnitz.
course_highlights: Steep ascent immediately after the start with the most elevation gain up to kilometer 8
Long downhill section after the first aid station at Hochspeicher
Scenic 5 kilometers along the Goldsteig with river views and multiple refreshment stations
additional: Race bib distribution from 7:30 a.m., late registration possible up to 30 minutes before the start (subject to availability), participant limit 250, refreshments at several points, free photos in JPG format, award ceremony with prizes, catering with coffee, cake, and barbecue by TSV Trausnitz, route check runs before the event with registration via email required. Trail approximately 21 km with 450 meters of elevation, registration on an external site, route checks and T-shirt included with registration by April 15.

name: Schwäbische Zeitung Halbmarathon
description: The Swabian Newspaper Half Marathon in Sigmaringen is a challenging and inspiring running event organized by a dedicated team of runners for runners. The event offers a beautiful setting and optimal conditions for personal bests or supporting a good cause. The organizing team places great emphasis on community experience, safety, and a great atmosphere along the course. The running group Limitless Hybrid Running Club supports participants with joint training sessions and individual training plans.
course_highlights: Beautiful setting in Sigmaringen
Professional course planning and safety
Refreshment stations along the route
additional: Joint training with Limitless Hybrid Running Club and LG Winterlingen, training times Sunday 10:00 AM and Thursday 5:30 PM, individual training plans available. Course profile, start times, race categories, refreshment stations, award ceremony, parking facilities, pacemakers, sponsors, timing

name: Spechaa Lauf Spöck
description: The 5th Spechaa Run will take place on June 7, 2026, as part of the TV sports festival in Stutensee-Spöck. Offered are a 10 km main race, a 5 km beginner race, and a 5 km walking route. The courses run over forest and agricultural paths with start and finish on the TV sports grounds. The races are part of the Stutensee Cup with individual and team rankings, together with other races in the region.
course_highlights: Courses over forest and agricultural paths
Start and finish on the TV sports grounds Spöck
Part of the Stutensee Cup with rankings for multiple races
additional: The race is embedded in the TV sports festival. There are individual and team rankings for the Stutensee Cup, which includes additional races in the region. The courses start and end on the TV sports grounds, registration is exclusively online, and results are available online.

description: The ZVO Energie Street Run around Ratekau takes place on June 7, 2026, for the 36th time and offers runners courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km, as well as a children's run over 400 meters. The routes are officially measured and suitable for personal bests, with start and finish at the sports field of TSV Ratekau. There are suitable races for all performance levels, including a student cup running throughout the calendar year. The event places great emphasis on safety with street closures and provides refreshments along the course and at the finish area.
course_highlights: Officially measured and PB-eligible courses over 2, 5, 10, and 15 km
Start and finish at the sports field of TSV Ratekau
Separate classification according to DLO category with awards on stage
additional: Late registrations are possible from June 1st online and on-site for a fee of €3. Registration pack pickup on June 6th from 17:00 to 19:00 and on June 7th from 08:00 to 10:00. Timing is done via an integrated transponder on the bib number. There are two refreshment stations along the course and food at the finish. Changing and shower facilities are available. The streets along the route are closed to traffic to ensure safety. The route runs through Ratekau, with safety measures including street closures, a student cup throughout 2026, measured race courses, and family-friendly event.

name: Mnichovohradištská patnáctka, memoriál ing. Josefa Hrona
location: Náměstí T.G. Masaryka, Mnichovo Hradiště, Czech Republic
description: The Mnichovohradištská Fifteen is a road race with a slightly hilly turnaround course of 15 km, held in Mnichovo Hradiště at T.G. Masaryk Square. The course is well-paved with marked kilometers, allowing runners to plan their pace effectively. The race is organized as a memorial to Ing. Josef Hron and offers a pleasant atmosphere for all runners. The start is at 10:00 AM, and the organizer is Vladimír Koudelka. The race is suitable for runners seeking a quality road race with tradition.
course_highlights: Slightly hilly turnaround road
High-quality asphalt surface
Marked kilometers on the course
additional: The race is a memorial to Ing. Josef Hron. The organizer is Vladimír Koudelka, contact by phone at 606 432 483. The course is a turnaround with marked kilometers. The race is dedicated to the memory of Ing. Josef Hron and offers two course lengths (15 km and 25 km). The start is at 10:00 AM, and registration is possible online and on-site.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups. Each participant competes primarily against themselves, which creates a friendly and motivating atmosphere. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, contributing to a pleasant running experience. This race is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners who want to test their speed over a short distance.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km)
Race in the picturesque Smetanovy Sady park in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race is part of a broader sports calendar and is suitable for runners of all levels, with no specific fees or registration conditions published yet.

name: Běh přes Červený vrch
description: The Red Hill Run is a traditional running race organized by Atletický klub ISCAREX in the picturesque environment of Dolní Čermná in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a technically interesting course with gentle undulations and numerous turns, suitable for a wide range of runners from hobby athletes to experienced competitors. The event is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and provides quality facilities for both participants and spectators. Registration is available online and on-site on the race day, which takes place on June 7, 2026.
course_highlights: Technically interesting course with a hilly profile
Numerous turns on paved roads
Picturesque natural environment of Dolní Čermná
additional: The race is part of the Iscarex Cup series, offers races for children and adults, registration until 11:30 AM, the race takes place in June 2026.

name: Chotucká šlapka
location: Zámecký park, Křinec, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: Chotucká šlapka is a traditional running race in Křinec, which was established in 2012 as a duathlon and has been held as a pure trail run since 2020. The race offers two courses - a main 11 km route and a half-distance 5.5 km route, mainly along trail paths with a small portion of asphalt. The start and finish are in the castle park, and the course runs through scenic countryside with several hills and refreshment stations. The race is open to the general public with a limited capacity of 100 runners and offers personalized bib numbers, refreshments, and wooden medals for all participants.
course_highlights: The course consists of a 5.5 km loop with 80% trail and 20% asphalt
The main race runs two loops (11 km), the half-distance one loop (5.5 km)
The route passes through the castle park, Bažantnice, cemetery, Chotuc, and other natural areas
additional: The race capacity is limited to 100 runners. The bib number is personalized with the runner's name upon registration by 30.05.2026. There are men's and women's changing rooms, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, and wooden medals for all participants. Results are announced after the last runner finishes. Children's races start at 11:00 with staggered starts from 12:00. The race takes place on June 7, 2026, and includes children's races. It is part of the Postřižinská Running League.

description: Babický trail 1/4 marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful environment of Babický Forest. The race offers two main routes of 10.55 km and 5.95 km, which mainly run through forest paths and trails with gentle elevation. In addition to the main races, there are also children's categories with shorter distances. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and emphasizes community atmosphere and the joy of movement in nature. The capacity of the main race is limited to 200 participants, so early registration is recommended.
course_highlights: The route mainly runs through forest paths and trails in Babický Forest
The main race is 10.55 km long with an elevation gain of 160 m
Children's races with distances from 300 m to 1500 m
additional: Registration and pick-up of race numbers take place from 08:30 to 09:45. The children's races start from 09:45 to 10:01, and the main race begins at 11:00 simultaneously for the 1/4 and 1/8 marathons. The capacity of the main race is limited to 200 participants. Parking is available at the Babice Sports Complex and in surrounding streets, with a request not to park at the entrances to residential houses. The main race route is 38% on forest roads, 56% on forest trails, and 6% on roads. The race offers medals for participants, online registration, limited capacity for the main race, and results service.

name: Skalecký kros
location: Skalka, Mníšek pod Brdy, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: Skalecký cross-country is a traditional running race held in the picturesque Baroque area of Skalka in Mníšek pod Brdy. It offers courses of 10 km, 5 km, and children's races, which run through forest paths and asphalt. The main race starts at 11:30 and is suitable for the general public, including children and youth. The organizer is SK Mníšecko, z.s., which ensures quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: The course runs through forest paths and asphalt
Start and finish in the Baroque area of Skalka
Main course length approximately 10 km
additional: Registration is available online and on-site. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Children's races are available. Results are published in the system and in PDF. The organizers provide timing and statistics. Start and finish in the Baroque area of Skalka. The race includes various course lengths, with the main race starting at 11:30, on surfaces of forest paths and asphalt, including children's races.

name: Červenkovská desítka
description: The Červenkovská ten is a road race over 10 km held in July near Olomouc. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and the Great Prize of the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners. The course is a loop, starting from Červenka, passing through Dětřichov to Renot and back, mostly on the road. Participants are divided into age categories, and winners in each category will receive material prizes. The results will be announced at the venue at the Hostinec u Nádraží and will be published on the website hanackybeh.cz.
course_highlights: Loop course from Červenka through Dětřichov to Renot and back
Course runs on the road
Start and finish at Hostinec U Nádraží in July
additional: Registration of participants takes place on-site. Participants must have a chip card with a credit of at least 150 CZK; otherwise, the credit must be topped up. The race is run according to road running rules, each at their own risk. The race is at participants' own risk, registration is with a chip card and credit conditions, and participants can look forward to small material prizes for category winners.

name: Milada Run
location: Milada Lake, Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem District, Czech Republic
description: Milada Run is a popular sporting event held in the unique landscape of the former lignite mine, which has been transformed into a beautiful natural environment of Lake Milada. The race offers various routes including a half marathon, 10 km, and children's races, which run along hilly and flat paths with views of the lake. The atmosphere of the race is family-friendly and welcoming, suitable for all ages and running levels. All races are part of the Milada Tour series, which is appreciated by participants for its high quality and popularity.
course_highlights: Half marathon route with two laps, one with views directly over the lake
10 km route on paved paths with a flat profile suitable for all runners
Children's races 500 m and 1 km near the main beach with parental supervision
additional: Start number with name upon registration fee payment by May 16, 2026. Medals for all participants. Official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and picked up on race day. Free children's T-shirt for the first 100 registered children. The race capacity is 500 participants. Family and friendly atmosphere. Series point scoring for the main adult routes. Routes: half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children's races; held at Lake Milada; accompanying program for children; registration and winners' ceremony.

name: Konopišťská desítka
location: Konopiště u Benešova, Benešov, Czech Republic
description: Konopišťská desítka is a traditional 10 km running race held in the beautiful environment of the natural theater and park of Konopiště near Benešov. This race is part of the Benešov Running Festival and offers the opportunity to compete in the main race, relay races, and children's categories. The event is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to enjoy running in picturesque nature with quality organization. The jubilee 30th edition will take place on June 7, 2026.
course_highlights: The course runs through the natural theater and park of Konopiště
10 km race with relay and children's categories available
Picturesque environment with quality technical support and SPORT BASE timing
additional: The race is part of the Benešov Running Festival. The organization includes children's races, relays, and the Be Fit run. Timing is provided by SPORT BASE. The organizers provide technical support, and the results are announced on-site. Results are available online and in PDF format. The race takes place on June 7, 2026, with online registration available. The event includes various age categories and relay races.

name: Bolfánek třikrát jinak
description: Bolfánek Three Ways is a running race organized by Pro Sport Activities agency in Chudenice, Plzeň Region. The race is part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' series and offers an unconventional format where participants cover the course in three different ways. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own children's categories. Organizers emphasize the sporting experience in beautiful nature and a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Three different ways to complete the course within one race
Beautiful nature and terrain around Chudenice
Categories for children with attractive children's routes
additional: Relay running is possible, with a relay team consisting of 3 runners, each running one part of the race. Relay entries are sent via email. Material prizes are prepared for the top three in individual categories and relays. Kindergarten and elementary school students from Kryry and residents of Kryry have free start. The race includes three runs with uphill sections, stairs, and forest trail; registration is possible online or on-site; the event is part of the 'Lookouts in Motion' series.

description: The Mnichovice Run is an amateur running race set in the beautiful Central Bohemian landscape, featuring a challenging course approximately 7-8 km long with an elevation gain of around 200 meters. The race offers varied terrain including paved roads, forest, meadows, and pastures, where you may be accompanied by domestic and wild animals. The start and finish are newly located at the Šibeniční vrch sports complex on the Podhorky playground. All participants will receive a commemorative medal and diploma, category winners will be awarded cups and a small surprise. The Mnichovice Run is part of the series of running races for the Ladov Region Cup, and everyone who completes the race healthy and safe is a winner.
course_highlights: Distance of 7-8 km with an elevation gain of approximately 200 m
Terrain includes paved roads, forest, meadows, and pastures
Challenging sections with steep ascents and descents
additional: All competitors will receive start numbers and medals; the top three in the women’s and men’s categories will receive cups and surprises. Registration and pick-up of start numbers are from 9:00 to 9:45. Refreshment stations with drinking water are available on the course, with additional refreshments at the Šibeniční vrch restaurant. Dogs are not allowed on the course. The race capacity is a maximum of 100 runners. Parking is available on Bezručova Street near the elementary school. The race is intended for adults aged 15 and over. Registration is from 9:00 to 9:45, with refreshments included in the entry fee and medals for all participants. Parking is accessible at ZŠ Bezručova and at the Podhorky playground. Entry with dogs on the course is not permitted.

description: Babický trail 1/4 marathon is a traditional running race held in the beautiful Babice forest near Říčany. It offers two main routes of 10.55 km and 5.95 km with elevation gains of 160 m and 60 m respectively, mostly along forest paths and trails. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own shorter courses. The event has a community-oriented atmosphere, with organizers emphasizing a friendly environment and support for the running community in Babice.
course_highlights: The main race route runs through Babice forest with an elevation gain of 160 m over 10.55 km
Mostly forest paths and trails with minimal asphalt sections
Children's races with courses from 300 m to 1500 m, suitable for various age groups
additional: Registration and pick-up of race numbers take place from 08:30 to 09:45. Children's races start from 09:45 to 10:01, with the main race starting at 11:00 for both 1/4 and 1/8 marathons. The capacity of the main race is limited to 200 participants. Online registration is available, with an additional fee of 100% if registering on the morning of the race. Parking is available at the sports complex and surrounding streets, with a request not to park at the entrances to residential houses. The course runs through the forest, with limited capacity for the main race; children's races are unlimited. Start at the Babice Sports Complex.

name: Bieg pod Tysiącletnimi Dębami
location: Kazimierz Biskupi, Gniezno County, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Run under the Thousand-Year-Old Oaks is a unique sporting event held in the picturesque Kazimierz Biskupi, in the heart of the Puszcza Bieniszewska. The race combines sport, history, and the beauty of local nature, leading participants through the avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Reserve. The event is open to experienced runners, amateurs, and families, offering races on various distances as well as Nordic Walking marches. The organizers are the Active Kazimierz Biskupi Association and the Kazimierz Biskupi Municipality, and the tradition of the race dates back to the early 21st century.
course_highlights: The route runs through a scenic avenue of thousand-year-old oaks in the Pustelnik Reserve
The race takes place in the heart of the Puszcza Bieniszewska, offering contact with nature
Available race distances are 10 km and 5 km, as well as a 5 km Nordic Walking march
additional: Verification and distribution of start numbers take place the day before the race (June 6, 2026) from 17:00 to 20:00 and on the race day from 8:30 to 12:15. The main race over 10 km starts at 13:00, the accompanying race over 5 km and the 5 km Nordic Walking march start at 13:10. The time limit to complete the race is 14:40. The award ceremony and event conclusion will be at 14:45. Participant limits are 250 for the main race, 150 for the accompanying race, and 100 for Nordic Walking. additional: Toddlers run for free, entry fees for children, adolescents, and adults are moderate. Toddlers, walkers, and Nordic walkers are stopped but not classified. The event is listed on laufen.de. Typical June weather: around 23°C, mostly sunny. Night race, multiple distances, events for all ages, part of Nordhessencup Laufserie

name: Gänseliesellauf
location: Krischerstraße, Monheim am Rhein, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Stadt Monheim am Rhein, Sportgemeinschaft Monheim 1894/1968 e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: inklusive 100 Meter-Lauf für alle keine Anmeldegebühr

description: The 40th Gänseliesellauf will take place on June 12, 2026, in Monheim am Rhein and traditionally opens the city festival. There will be five different races for various age groups, from a 900-meter run for kindergarten children to a 10-kilometer race for adults. The event is organized by the city of Monheim am Rhein in cooperation with the sports club Monheim 1894/1968 e. V. and offers not only athletic competition but also a diverse supporting program with catering and festival activities. The races start and end on Krischerstraße, and all participants receive certificates that can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Start and finish on Krischerstraße at house number 10
Five races for different age groups and distances
Event as part of the Monheim city festival with festival program
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each race. Certificates can be downloaded after the race via my.raceresult.com. Refreshing drinks and food are available near the races. The event is supported by MEGA Monheimer Elektrizitäts- und Gasversorgung GmbH. Various race distances, registration by email, certificates available online, city festival program

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2026 Lauf 1: 36. Donoper Volkslauf
description: The Lippe Summer Series 2026 is a three-part running event taking place from June 12 to June 26, 2026, in the Schieder-Schwalenberg region. The first race, the 36th Donoper Volkslauf, is organized by SC Donop 1948 e.V. and features a varied course of 7,777 meters around the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop. The series combines athletic challenge with nature experience and community and is open to runners, walkers, and hikers.
course_highlights: 7,777 meters of varied course profile
Start and finish at the Donop sports field in Blomberg-Donop
Part of a three-part running series through the most beautiful landscapes of the region
additional: The Lippe Summer Series includes three races on three consecutive Fridays. In addition to the race, walking and hiking are also possible. The event is supported by the KOLIBRI Förderverein für offene Kinder- und Jugendarbeit Schwalenberg e.V. The event takes place on roads and in the terrain, with temperatures around 23°C in June. It is a social run suitable for the whole family.

name: Aschauer Bankerl-Lauf
location: Aschau im Chiemgau, Rosenheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Aschauer Bankerl Run is a convivial evening run set in the idyllic Chiemgau landscape, open to all running enthusiasts. For the fifth time, the organizer Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. invites participants to a race event without timing, where the focus is on the joy of movement. Various distances are offered, ranging from about 1 km (Bambini run) to 7 km. Part of the proceeds will be donated to a good cause, making the event socially engaged.
course_highlights: Idyllic landscape in Chiemgau
Distances from approx. 1 km to 7 km
Evening run without timing with accompanying runners
additional: Accompanying runners are available for more leisurely participants. In the finish area, there are water, coffee, cake, and other refreshments. Part of the proceeds benefits the Benedetto-Menni-Nest, a shared living community for people with special support needs in Aschau. Race for all age groups, donations for charitable purposes, online registration, accompanying runners, refreshments at the finish area

name: Citylauf Grevenbroich
description: The City Run Grevenbroich is a family-friendly running event with nine different races that appeals to sports enthusiasts of all ages. The event offers ideal courses, top entertainment, and excellent organization supported by the entire city. In addition to the athletic competition, there is an attractive supporting program and coveted prizes for the best participants. The races range from short Bambini and school runs to open to all and city championship races over 5 km and 10 km.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 700 m to 10 km
City championship race in the Sparkassen Run over 10 km
Family event with nine races and great supporting program
additional: Nine races with start times from 5:30 PM to 8:40 PM, including Bambini, school, and relay competitions. Certificates for all participants as well as medals and prizes for the best. Timing is provided by TAF-Timing. The event is a major city event with strong support and a supporting program. Multiple race distances, online registration, chip timing, results since 2015, anniversary event in 2026.

name: Deichlauf Neuwied

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Jugend ab 12 Jahre (Jg. 2014) bis 19 Jahre (Jg. 2007) 8,- EUR

description: The Deichlauf Neuwied is a traditional running event in Rhineland-Palatinate that appeals to runners of all ages. It offers various competitions, including children and youth runs, an Olympic school relay, 5 km and 10 km runs, as well as walking/nordic walking. The course runs along the dyke and provides an attractive running backdrop. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and attracts around 2,000 participants annually.
course_highlights: Running course along the dyke
Diverse competitions from 600 m relay to 10 km run
Attractive running backdrop in Neuwied
additional: Showers are not available. Medical services are on site at the finish and along the course. Photos and videos are taken by an authorized service provider and may be published. Late registrations are possible online until June 11, 2026, and on the day of the event until one hour before the respective start. Participants are insured under the sports insurance contract of the Sportbund Rheinland. Various categories for children, youth, and adults; registration until May 31, 2026; results and certificates available online.

name: Derentaler Löwenlauf
description: The Derentaler Löwenlauf is a traditional race in the Weser Uplands, designed as a sporting family event for all age groups. The event offers various distances that lead through the beautiful Derentaler farmland and Steinbachtal valley. A special focus is on celebrating diversity, tolerance, and working together, supported by a donation to the "augen auf!" foundation per participant. The race is organized with great heart by the Weserbergland Runners Derental and promises an unforgettable day for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors.
course_highlights: 3 km Schülerlauf ab 8 Jahren
6 km Runde durch die Derentaler Feldmark
12,7 km Strecke inklusive Steinbachtal
additional: One euro per participant is donated to the "augen auf!" foundation. The race is conceived as a family festival with various distances for all age groups. Multiple distances (300 m, 10 km), no official timing, special route due to construction work, fundraising for the 'Augen auf!' foundation.

name: Holstenköstenlauf
organizer: SVT Neumünster in Kooperation mit BMS Die Laufgesellschaft mbH
price_range: 10 km Lauf: 23,00 Euro bis 26,00 Euro, 5 km Lauf: 13,00 Euro bis 16,00 Euro, Holstenkösten-Becher: 12,00 Euro
description: The Holstenköstenlauf in Neumünster is a traditional city run that takes place as part of Schleswig-Holstein's largest city festival, the Holstenköste. The event offers races for all age groups, from children to adults, and runs through various districts of Neumünster. The 10 km course is officially measured according to DLV rules and promises an attractive route through the city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld. All finishers receive a coveted festival medal as a memento of the event.
course_highlights: Attractive course through city center, Tungendorf, and Brachenfeld
10 km course officially measured according to DLV rules
Start and finish at Kleinflecken, identical start and finish line
additional: Race bib distribution on June 10 and 11, 2026, timing with transponder (timing fee 3.00 euros, waived if using own BMS chip), race bib is non-transferable and must be worn at the front of sportswear, Holstenkösten mug can be pre-ordered (12.00 euros) and will be handed out at race bib pickup. Participation is possible for various age groups, registration online or on-site, race bib pickup in the foyer of the city hall, refreshments on the course and at the finish, award ceremonies in the evening.

name: Kleinbahn-Lauf
description: The Kleinbahn Run in Rhauderfehn is an experiential race without timing, appealing to runners and walkers on 5- and 10-kilometer routes. Additionally, there are children's races for kindergarten and elementary school children, enthusiastically accompanied by parents and grandparents. The 10 km loop runs from the marketplace along the Hauptfehnkanal, through the villages of Holtermoor and Rhaude, and back to the finish via the East Frisia hiking trail. The 5 km route also starts from the marketplace, goes over the East Frisia hiking trail, and returns to the finish. The race offers a beautiful opportunity to experience the region on varied paths.
course_highlights: 10 km loop along Hauptfehnkanal and East Frisia hiking trail
5 km loop with a circuit through Rhaudermoor and East Frisia hiking trail
Children's races for kindergarten and elementary school children
additional: The race is a community run without timing. Training plans for different performance goals are offered. The event is suitable for both runners and walkers. It takes place in June, with typical weather around 23°C. There are bus transportation options from Rhauderfehn to Ihrhove, as well as showers and changing facilities on site. Competitions are also offered for children and adolescents.

name: Krackenlauf 2026
description: Krackenlauf Großlangheim takes place on Friday, June 12, 2026, and offers races for various age groups and performance levels. There is a Bambini race over 800 meters, a school race over 2000 meters, a main race over 7500 meters, and a walker competition over 6000 meters. The event is a popular local running event with unchanged times and distances, open to all running enthusiasts. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: Bambini race 800 meters
School race 2000 meters
Main race 7500 meters and walker 6000 meters
additional: The races and distances remain unchanged compared to previous years. Registration is done online via RaceResult. There are races for children, students, the main race, and walkers. The event takes place in the evening. The event offers various categories, including children's races, main race, and walker competition. Registration will be later via RaceResult, and the event takes place in Großlangheim.

name: Meine Nacht - Kirche laufend erleben
description: The "Meine Night" charity relay race is a community running event in Meine, organized to benefit charitable causes. The event promotes team spirit and athletic effort in a special atmosphere. Participants experience a varied course that runs through the community and strengthens the sense of community.
course_highlights: Relay race format for teams
Course through the community of Meine
Charity run with social engagement
additional: Charity run, registration available via the website, event promotes community and spirituality

name: Oesterweger Feuerwehrlauf
description: The Oesterweger People's and Fire Brigade Run in Versmold offers a diverse running program for all age groups and skill levels on June 12, 2026. From short Bambini and school runs without an entry fee to an officially measured 10 km road race and a team and fire brigade run over 6 km, there is something for everyone. The flat, asphalted routes lead through the town center and provide plenty of motivation from spectators. Walkers can also enjoy a beautiful 6 km tour through the rural countryside in parallel.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted routes through the town center of Oesterweg
10 km loop course with four equal laps plus an introductory lap
6 km laps for team and fire brigade run as well as walking
additional: Bambini run (450 m) and school run (1.2 km) are free of charge. The school run is scored for participants up to 11 years old, and the taster run for up to 15 years old. The team and fire brigade run consists of teams of four participants each. Walkers start parallel to the fire brigade run from the back rows to avoid disturbing the runners. Various distances available, online registration, race brochures for download, special categories for fire brigade and teams, results on TimeTeamJung.

name: Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf
description: The Schwerter Ruhrstadtlauf takes place on June 12, 2026, at the GWG-Schwerte-Arena and welcomes numerous runners in a proven format. The afternoon is dedicated to younger participants with shorter distances, while the longer races in the evening are the main attraction. Especially popular are the relay races for children and youth, as well as the Nordic walking competition along the scenic Ruhrtalradweg. The course for the 10 km run is measured according to DLV standards and is a loop course over asphalted and paved paths through a forest area, with the finish line in the stadium.
course_highlights: 10 km course measured according to DLV standards
Loop course over the asphalted Ruhrtalradweg and paved forest paths
Finish in the stadium of GWG Schwerte Arena
additional: Race bib distribution and late registration on June 11, 2026, from 6 to 7 PM at the competition office. Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before the start of each category for a fee of €3 (children's races are free). Included in the registration fee are timing via disposable transponder, personalized certificate, shower facilities at the VfB Westhofen club house, baggage storage without liability, water service at the 5 km and 10 km runs, and drinks at the finish area. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The event offers a variety of running options for all age groups and supports community sports. Registration is via the official website, and the event takes place on a Friday in June.

name: Sommer-Abend-Lauf
description: The Summer Evening Run in Steinach is a popular running event celebrating its 10th edition on June 12, 2026. It offers a main race of 5 and 10 kilometers on a scenic, flat course as well as various children's runs. The event attracts many running enthusiasts from the region and beyond each year and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish at the school. The races take place in the evening, offering a special running experience in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Flat, scenic running course through Steinach
5 km or 10 km main race (1 or 2 laps of 5 km each)
Children's runs on school streets with 375 m, 750 m, and 1100 m
additional: Children's runs start staggered from 6:00 PM (Bambini 375 m), 6:30 PM (school children 750 m), and 7:00 PM (school children 1100 m). The main race starts at 8:00 PM with start and finish at the school. Changing facilities are available in the gymnasium and festival hall. Flat course, online registration possible, family- and company-friendly.

name: Spendenlauf LT Phoenix Dudweiler
description: The LT Phoenix Dudweiler charity run is a running event where all entry fees and donations benefit the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar. Participants have the opportunity on-site to learn about the important work of the organization. The run not only promotes the health and well-being of the runners but also supports a significant social cause in the Saarbrücken region.
course_highlights: Charity run in favor of the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar
Event in Saarbrücken-Dudweiler
Information about the work of the supported organization on-site
additional: Participation in the run is linked to a club insurance, which requires prior registration with the sports officer Fabiola Marx (Phone: 06897 761487, Email: fabi.marx@web.de). No published start times or prize categories are available on the website. The run is part of the activities of the running group "Rennschnecke" Dudweiler e.V. and offers the opportunity to learn about the work of the Children's Hospice and Palliative Care Team Saar on-site. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels.

name: Volksbank Ettlinger Altstadt-Lauf
location: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen, Ettlingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Volksbank Ettlinger Old Town Run will take place on June 12, 2026, at the Volksbank Arena in the Stadtgarten Ettlingen. The course runs through the historic old town with a mix of paved streets and cobblestone alleys, passing landmarks such as the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Town Hall Bridge with the St. Nepomuk stone statue. Various races are offered for students, youth, a 10 km main race, and an inclusion run. The event is family-friendly and offers competitions suitable for all ages.
course_highlights: Course through historic old town alleys and paved streets
Passing the Baroque Ettlingen Palace and the Town Hall Bridge with St. Nepomuk statue
Loop course with start and finish in Schöllbronner Straße
additional: There is a timing service with pacemakers for finish times between 40 and 60 minutes, recognizable by large balloons. Original old town run race shirts made of breathable Coolmax material can be pre-ordered for 19 euros, with the deadline for orders on May 6, 2026. Courses: 1 km students' run, 2.95 km students' run, 10 km main run, 3.525 km inclusion run; start times from 6:00 PM; venue: Volksbank Arena, Stadtgarten Ettlingen; approximately 1,500 participants; including tandem runs for the inclusion run; large post-race party.

name: Voxtruper Volkslauf
description: The 13th Voxtruper Volkslauf on June 12, 2026, in Osnabrück offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes courses from 0.4 km for children to the main race over 9.8 km with 182 meters of elevation. The runs take place through a very beautiful landscape with several refreshment points to ensure participants' well-being. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event, and the event emphasizes a safe and smooth process without dogs and baby joggers.
course_highlights: Very scenic race with different courses
Main race 9.8 km with 182 meters of elevation
Multiple refreshment points depending on the course (up to four for 9.8 km)
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the respective race. Dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. Certificate printing online and result lists at www.laufen-os.de. Refreshment points: 1 at 3.9 km, 2 at 5.5 km, 4 at 9.8 km. Participants can register on-site; no dogs or baby joggers allowed; the courses are designed to be scenic.

name: Přes tři hráze Opatov
description: Over three dams, the Opatov traditional running race takes place in Opatov on the Vysočina region, and is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup series. The race offers various courses, including the main route of 8.8 km for men and veterans up to 69 years old, and shorter distances for women, veterans over 70, juniors, youth, and children. The course mainly runs along field and forest paths, including passing through three dams of local ponds, which gives the race a unique character. The event is open to a wide age range and emphasizes sporting experiences and support for the running community in the region.
course_highlights: The course passes over three dams of ponds around Opatov
Various distances from 210 m to 8.8 km for different age categories
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup series
additional: The main loop course is 4.4 km with field and forest paths (30% asphalt), races for children from 210 m to 1.5 km, the event is focused on a wide age range and veterans.

name: TATRA FEST 2026
location: Zakopane, Tatra County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.description: Early Bird – 460 zł dla zawodników, którzy opłacą udział do 31.12.2025

tiers.label: tier_2

description: Tatra Fest is a unique mountain festival held in Zakopane, combining various outdoor disciplines including mountain running, climbing, cycling, trekking, and family activities. The event features demanding runs through the Tatra trails, such as the Tatra Fest 68 km race and the Tatra Fest Run 22 km, offering participants unforgettable experiences in the picturesque landscapes of the Tatras. The event attracts both professionals and amateurs, promoting physical activity, contact with nature, and ecological responsibility. Organizers invite everyone to celebrate life and the mountain spirit together.
course_highlights: Tatra Fest Bieg 68 km: a skyrunning route with an elevation gain of 5000 m, running above 2000 m above sea level, with exposed trails and cable lines
Tatra Fest Run 22 km: route through Magura Witowska, Mietlówka, Butorowy Wierch, and Gubałówka with rocky paths and views of the Tatras
Start and finish at the Municipal Park in Zakopane, with time limits at key points on the route
additional: The Tatra Fest 68 km race has time limits at key points: 7:30 at Kasprowy Wierch (11 km), 10:00 at the PTTK Shelter on Hala Ornak (24 km), 14:00 and 17:00 at the PTTK Shelter on Polana Chochołowska (39 and 49 km), and 21:00 at the finish line in the Municipal Park. The Tatra Fest Run 22 km start package includes transfer to the start location. The finish at the Municipal Park in Zakopane provides meals and drinks. The event includes various distances, such as 68 km, 22 km, 11 km, as well as vertical and family competitions. Races take place on scenic routes in Zakopane, including the Municipal Park, Kasprowy Wierch, and Polana Chochołowska.

name: 12. Heilwald Marathon
location: Heilwald, Bad Lippspringe, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 12th Heilwald Marathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Bad Lippspringe. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, totaling 42.3 km, and runs through the unique Heilwald, which offers a special running experience with its calming upland climate and diverse forest. The event is a private running event with self-supply, where timing is done manually and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.
course_highlights: Six laps of 7.05 km through the Bad Lippspringe Heilwald
Diverse forest with calming upland climate
Course measured with a survey wheel and GPS watch
additional: Self-supply with provisions, as runners pass by the car after each lap. Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, a photo of the clock on race day must be emailed as proof. No showers or changing facilities are available. Participant limit 18, minimum age 18. Organizer assumes no liability. Participation at your own risk. Consent to the creation and use of photos, result lists, and videos is given upon registration. Course: 6 laps of 7.05 km in the Heilwald; self-supply; no showers; participation at own risk; participant limit 18; registration until the day before at 6 pm.

name: 13. Himmelswegelauf
description: The 13th Himmelswegelauf on June 13, 2026, takes participants through a unique cultural landscape around Nebra (Unstrut). The running routes connect significant archaeological sites such as the Pömmelte ring sanctuary, the Goseck solar observatory, and the site of the Nebra sky disk. The start and finish are at the Arche Nebra visitor center, close to the sky disk, which is considered the oldest concrete depiction of the cosmos. In addition to the marathon, half marathon, and the 10 km sky disk run, there are also walking, cycling tours, and hikes to the site. The event is under the patronage of the Prime Minister of Saxony-Anhalt and offers a culturally and sportingly appealing experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Arche Nebra, near the Nebra sky disk
Routes pass by the 4,000-year-old Pömmelte ring sanctuary
Marathon starts at the 7,000-year-old Goseck solar observatory
additional: Race number pickup and late registration are possible on the day of the event, with different times for marathon, half marathon, sky disk run, walking, and cycling tours. The event offers not only running disciplines but also walking, cycling tours, and hikes. The award ceremonies are hosted by Radio SAW presenter Holger Tapper. The event is open to runners, cyclists, walkers, and hikers, with registration required. The date is planned for June 13, 2026.

name: 14. Glück-Lauf
description: The Glück-Lauf in Salzgitter-Gebhardshagen is a versatile running event that appeals to both families and experienced runners. With distances ranging from 1.2 km for children to a challenging trail half marathon over 21.2 km with nearly 400 meters of elevation gain, the event offers something for everyone. Approximately 400 participants, including hobby runners, competitive athletes, and local club runners, share the race day. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized refreshment stations along the course.
course_highlights: Trail half marathon with approximately 21.2 km and nearly 400 m elevation gain
Children's run over 1.2 km with participation from U8 children
Refreshment stations and preparation for sunny weather
additional: The event includes a 10.8 km course with a remarkable story of a 64-year-old runner who overtook younger competitors. Participants are encouraged to prepare for the sun with caps, scarves, and hydration packs. The event attracts both children and experienced runners and is a local highlight in Gebhardshagen. Distances range from 1.2 km to 21.2 km, including a trail half marathon, family and competitive events. Weather in June is usually warm and sunny. Registration is available online and on-site.

name: 15. Fullestrand-Ultramarathon
description: The Fullestrand Ultramarathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Kassel and offers a challenging 46.5 km course along the Fulda River with approximately 350 meters of elevation gain. The route starts in Kassel and runs upstream along the Fuldahöhenweg and back along the Fuldaradweg, passing through diverse landscapes and natural areas. The event is organized by Laufwerk Kassel under the leadership of Sylke Kuhn and combines athletic challenge with the beauty of North Hesse's nature and culture.
course_highlights: 46.5 km long course along the Fulda with about 350 meters of elevation
Sections on the Fuldahöhenweg (marking X17) with some elevation gain
Return route on the Fuldaradweg R1 through Fulda meadows, Bugaseen, and Kassel districts
additional: Meet at 7:58 AM at the start. Start and finish are at Auedamm 17 in Kassel, opposite the pancake house next to the Auebad. The route partly runs on bike paths and requires use of the harbor bridge traffic lights. The event is organized by Sylke Kuhn, who also manages other marathon and ultramarathon races in the region. The course includes flat paths, single trails with mud, no markings, water stations available, time limit of 8 hours.

name: 18. Edeka Ladage-Lauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 3 € Teilnehmer:innen: Kindergarten­kinder laufen eine etwa 600 m und Grundschüler:innen eine 900 m lange Strecke.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2014 und jünger (U12) | Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2013 (U16)
