description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen is a traditional community race with a variety of competitions for all age groups. The event takes place at the sports facility of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule and offers diverse loop courses used by children from kindergarten age to experienced runners. The longer runs follow a slightly modified 2.5 km loop with start and finish near the event area, creating a special atmosphere. In addition to the athletic competition, community experience is also emphasized, supported by a prize draw and an enthusiastic volunteer team.
course_highlights: Varied loop courses on the school grounds for children
Slightly modified 2.5 km loop for longer runs with start/finish near the event area
Atmospheric course through residential streets, field paths, and athletics tracks
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site up to one hour before each start, with additional fees (€5 including €2 deposit for rental bib). Kindergarten children and elementary school students run an exciting loop course on the school grounds. The longer runs use a 2.5 km loop, which is run twice (5 km) or four times (10 km). Participation in the charity run includes automatic entry into the prize draw. The proceeds from the charity run go to the craft community of the Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is organized by SG Bredenbeck-Holtensen e.V. and takes place on the grounds of Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, featuring various race categories and a focus on community and health. Participation supports the local community and promotes youth sports.

name: 23. Sudenburg-Lauf - Der Lauf mit dem Lächeln
description: The Sudenburg Run is a race under the motto "Run for Runners by Runners" and takes place on June 13, 2026, at the Heinrich-Germer Stadium in Magdeburg. The event is characterized by enthusiasm for running and the Sudenburg district. There are various race routes for children, teenagers, and adults that lead through the city and the stadium. The focus is on encouraging as many people as possible to run and to do so with a smile on their face.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heinrich-Germer Stadium with a final stadium lap
Round course of 2.2 kilometers, run two or five times depending on the distance
The route passes through Salzmannstraße, Walmbergsweg, Braunlager Straße, Halberstädter Straße, and Lemsdorfer Weg
additional: Race bib pickup on June 12, 2026, from 14:30 to 18:00 at Sporthaus sport39 (Halberstädter Str. 21) or on the event day until 9:00 at Heinrich-Germer Stadium. Late registrations are possible from June 8, 2026, until the day of the event, but with a late registration fee. There is an award ceremony for children's races at 10:15 a.m. and for the longer races at 11:45 a.m. Participation conditions include liability waiver, fair play, and waste disposal obligations. The races are scoring routes for SRL MD and EOC-Cup. Online registration only; participation in June 2026; part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP Series; the goal is to promote the joy of running in the city.

name: 5. Biber Backyard Ultra
description: The Biber Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra-running event in Simmerath/Lammersdorf scheduled for June 13, 2026. Participants run a 6.7-kilometer loop every hour with varying elevation gains until only one runner remains. The course passes through forest and field paths as well as trails with a challenging incline. The event is characterized by its special Ultra-Backyard format, where each loop must be completed within one hour. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and challenges endurance and tactics alike.
course_highlights: 6.7 km loop with approximately 110 meters of elevation during the day
Trail passages and many forest and field paths
Hourly start with one hour per loop
additional: Registration traditionally opens on December 6 at 00:01. The course is divided into a day and a night section. There is no lap time measurement; only the number of completed laps is counted. Start announcements are made 3, 2, and 1 minute before each lap. Personal support and aids during the lap are not allowed. The event has a family atmosphere with sponsorship from outdoor manufacturer OMM. The course is split into day and night segments, with 110 meters of elevation during the day and 60 meters at night. Catering is available at the start/finish area, along with showers, sanitary facilities, accommodation options, and community events on site.

name: DUD Ultra
description: The DUD Ultra 70km is a road ultramarathon in Duderstadt, Germany, taking place on a short loop around the Duderstadt Wall. The loop is under 5 km long with 36 meters of elevation gain per lap, allowing runners to complete the same course multiple times throughout the day. The race has a time limit of 12 hours, a participant cap, and an entry fee of 100 euros. The compact course layout enables spectators to see the runners multiple times, as a single aid station services the entire loop. The DUDultra organizer also offers additional distances such as 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay race.
course_highlights: Loop under 5 km with 36 m elevation gain per lap
Compact course with a single aid station
Spectators can see runners multiple times along the course
additional: The race has a 12-hour time limit and a participant cap. There are additional distances offered as part of the event: 50 km, 100 km, and a 100 km relay for four runners. Weather conditions in June are typically around 23 °C with a minimum of 13 °C and mostly sunny. The race takes place on a loop around the Duderstadt Wall, with limited participant numbers and multiple ultra distances available.

name: Ottermeerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Einzelläufer 25 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Staffeln 50 Euro bis 09. Juni 2026

description: The Ottermeer Run in Wiesmoor is a traditional race taking place on June 13, 2026. The event offers a varied course with an encouraging atmosphere and is open to individual runners and relay teams. Notably, there is a 6-hour ultramarathon, which is part of the Nordcup and is aimed at runners aged 18 and above. Every finisher receives a personalized medal in the shape of the Ottermeer contours with the mascot Otti as a reward.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the cafeteria 'Lüttje Haven' in Wiesmoor
Varied course with motivating spectator cheers
Personalized medal in the shape of the Ottermeer contours with mascot Otti
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 09:00 AM until one hour before the start. The minimum age for individual ultramarathon runners is 18 years, for relay teams 8 years. Michis Physiotherapy offers massages on-site for donations. The bib number must be visibly worn on the chest and returned after the race. The number of participants is limited to 400. Participation from 18 years, medal with Ottermeer motif, on-site physiotherapy support, accompanying program, team and family event.

name: 24h Lauf Halberstadt
price_range: 25 € für den 24h Lauf, andere Laufzeiten variieren
description: The 24-hour race at Friedensstadion Halberstadt will take place on June 12, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM and is organized by VfB Germania Halberstadt in cooperation with the Halberstadt Leisure and Sports Center. The goal of the race is to keep the tartan track continuously occupied by runners for the entire 24 hours. The event is part of the VfB Germania club festival, which features various sports departments and invites participation. In addition to the race, traditional activities such as pulling a coach on the track are offered. The event provides a sporting challenge and a social program for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: 24 hours of continuous running on the tartan track at Friedensstadion
Event embedded in the VfB Germania club festival with diverse sports offerings
Traditional coach-pulling on the track as a special highlight
additional: The race takes place on the tartan track of Friedensstadion. It is aimed that the track will be continuously occupied by runners throughout the entire 24 hours. The club festival offers, in addition to the race, the opportunity to try various sports such as archery, table tennis, judo, athletics, and gymnastics. Multiple race distances, club festival, Harzer Lauf-Cup race series, registration until June 4, 2026, live results on-site and online.

name: Ahrathon Erlebnislauf
location: Weingut Sonnenberg, Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany

price_tiers.distance: 21 km Halbmarathon I - Nur schnelle Läufer!!! - Vor KHM

description: The Ahrathon experience run on June 13, 2026, in Bad Neuenahr-Ahrweiler offers a diverse running experience from a 500m kids' run to the 42km marathon. The start and finish are located at the Sonnenberg winery, where a family festival and a closing festival with live music take place. The course leads through the picturesque Ahr Valley with refreshment stations offering water, fruit, wine, and gourmet snacks. The event is characterized by a special atmosphere with wine presentations and creative costume runs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sonnenberg winery in Bad Neuenahr
Refreshment stations with water, fruit, isotonic drinks, and wine from renowned wineries
Family festival at the start/finish area and closing festival 'Rock & Wine' from 5:00 PM
additional: Refreshment stations offer water, isotonic drinks, fruit, energy bars, and at selected stations, wine from renowned wineries. Marathon participants pass refreshment points twice, while half marathon and 21km races pass once. There is a family festival at the start/finish area and a closing festival with live music from 5:00 PM. Age group winners receive wine gifts, costume runners are judged for creativity, and there are material prizes for the winners of the shorter races. The event features wine tastings, distances from 5 km to marathon, costume runs, along the wineries in the Ahr Valley.

name: Fischland-Darss-Zingst-Ultramarathon (FDZU)
description: The Fischland-Darss-Zingst Ultramarathon (FDZU) is the longest nature experience run in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern and takes place on June 13, 2026, for the 10th time. The route leads through the unique Baltic Sea coastal landscape from Rostock to Stralsund and offers runners a special natural experience along the peninsulas and islands of the region. The race is characterized by its tradition and the special flair created by the combination of nature, challenge, and community. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, with the deadline on May 31, 2026.
course_highlights: Scenic diversity along the Baltic Sea coast from Rostock to Stralsund
Natural experience on the peninsulas Fischland, Darß, and Zingst
Route sections around the Saaler Bodden and on the islands of Poel and Usedom
additional: The start takes place early in the morning at 04:06 AM in the glow of flickering fire bowls. The route has been updated and includes location information for all supply points. Registration is exclusively via the Tollense Timing GmbH portal. There are prizes for the fastest male and female runners on the main route. Nature experience run, route length over 117 km, relay and beach sections, sand passages, elevation profile up to 23 meters, registration required.

name: Gaißeschennerlauf Kieselbronn
description: The Gaißeschennerlauf is an annual running event organized by the Kieselbronn Gymnastics Club in Kieselbronn, Baden-Württemberg. The race has been held regularly since 2003 and is part of a local popular race series. The event offers runners the opportunity to experience a scenic route, which is presented on the website with a video and external profiles on AllTrails. The name Gaißeschennerlauf gives the event a special local identity.
course_highlights: Two distances: 450 m and 21 km
Route profiles available on AllTrails
Part of a regional popular race series
additional: Registration is via MY RACE RESULT. The weather in June is typically mild with an average of 23 °C and occasional rain. Registration via MY RACE RESULT; race on the sports grounds Heinloch and surrounding area; takes place in June 2026

name: Harsefelder Lauf- und Musikfestival
organizer: Lauftreff Harsefeld, LSC Harsefeld, Stadtmarketing Harsefeld
description: The 20th Running and Music Festival in Harsefeld will take place on June 13, 2026, and combines athletic challenges with musical entertainment. Runners of all ages can participate in various distances, from children's and toddler runs to short, long-distance, and relay races. In the evening, the market street transforms into a lively party zone with an open-air disco and live music. The festival is a regular part of the Harsefeld event calendar and offers, in addition to sports, a colorful children's program and culinary stands.
course_highlights: Children's run approx. 2,000 meters
Short distance approx. 5,100 meters and long distance approx. 10,200 meters
Relay 4 × approx. 2,550 meters
additional: Registration opens on April 1, 2026. Official festival running shirts with logo available for order. Anniversary gift for all runners upon pickup of the bib number. Schools and kindergartens can run checks that are honored on stage. Open-air disco until 11 PM with 2006 revival party. Various race distances, children's program, music & party, registration from April 1, 2026, festival shirts, sponsors: Friedrich and Margret Tobaben Foundation.

name: Himmelgeister Brückenlauf
location: Steinkaul, Himmelgeist, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Himmelgeister Bridge Run is a traditional half marathon that has been held annually in Düsseldorf-Himmelgeist since 2004. The course runs along the Rhine almost into the heart of Düsseldorf and offers a scenic running route. The race starts early in the morning around 8 a.m. at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the post-run party in the beer garden of Haus Krevet. In 2026, the race will take place for the last time, as the organizing team will withdraw after the anniversary.
course_highlights: Run along the Rhine with a view of Düsseldorf
Start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist
8 refreshment points along the 21.1 km course
additional: Race bib collection on June 12 from 1 p.m. to 7 p.m. and on June 13 from 6:15 a.m. to 7:45 a.m. at the starting point. Timing is done with a chest transponder behind the race bib. Clothing can be left at the beer garden of Haus Krevet at your own risk. Post-run party with raffle and award ceremony starting around 10:30 a.m. Separate awards for the best women, men, and teams; no age group classifications. Recommended travel by bus line 835 or carpooling; parking at Aldi parking lot is prohibited. Anniversary race, start at Steinkaul in Himmelgeist, last event in 2026, participation according to DLV guidelines, no shower facilities, online results and photos.

name: Hohenlimburger Lennelauf
description: The 3rd Hohenlimburger Lennelauf will take place on June 13, 2026, around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg. The event is aimed at runners and walkers of all ages and offers suitable distances for every age group. The race is organized by the Elseyer Turnverein 1881 e.V., known for its diverse sports programs for the whole family. The event promises a sporty and communal atmosphere in a beautiful park setting.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lennepark in Hohenlimburg
Suitable for runners and walkers of all ages
Family-friendly event
additional: The race offers various distances for running and walking, suitable for all age groups. Registration is via the Elseyer Turnverein. Telephone contact times are available on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Fridays at specific times. The course is on asphalt, spikes are not allowed, limited starting spots, on-site catering, use of transponders for timing.

name: Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail
price_range: 15.- € bis 18.- € für Erwachsene, kostenlos für Kinder und Jugendliche
description: The Holzgerlinger Lauf - Waldtrail takes place in 2026 for its 41st edition and is part of the Schönbuch Cup as the third scoring race. The course runs in two laps over tartan track, asphalt, and forest ground through the beautiful Holzgerlinger forest. The first half is mostly flat, while the second half is hilly with a final ascent accompanied by drum sounds. Overall, runners pass through the filled stadium three times, where spectators cheer with music – at the start, after the first 5 km lap, and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Two laps over tartan track, asphalt, and forest ground
Beautiful, wind-protected run through the Holzgerlinger forest
Three passes through the filled stadium with music and spectator cheering
additional: The race offers 5 km and 10 km courses with elevation profile. On June 6, 2026, a taster run without registration will take place. The course is well paved and mainly through the forest. In 2024, the event was listed among the top 100 best running events by the Württemberg Athletics Association (WLV). The event also includes a taster run for newcomers, team and pair competitions, and an after-race party.

name: Kalimandscharolauf 2026
description: The 13th Kalimandscharolauf 2026 will take place on June 13, 2026, in Zielitz and is organized by SV Kali Wolmirstedt e.V. Athletics Department. The event is hosted by K+S Minerals and Agriculture GmbH, Zielitz Plant. The race is an off-stadium event and offers runners an attractive course in the Magdeburg/Börde region. Registration is open until June 6, 2026.
course_highlights: Run across the greened Friedrichshall slag heap with scenic views
Hilly, challenging course for various disciplines
Diverse accompanying program including walking and Nordic walking
additional: The event includes categories such as Magdeburg, Börde, and mountain running, with registration closing on June 6, 2026. It is part of a sustainable concept utilizing former industrial sites.

name: Kefenröder Dorflauf
description: The 35th Village Run in Kefenrod will take place on June 13, 2026, and is organized by the Turnverein 1908 Kefenrod e.V. The event offers runners of all ages the opportunity to participate in a traditional race set in the idyllic surroundings of Kefenrod. Registration is available through the Oberhessencup website, allowing for easy pre-registration. The race is a staple of the club's activities and promotes community and sporting exchange in the region.
course_highlights: Four laps through Kefenrod with varied elevation profile
Course lengths of 1 km and 10 km for different performance levels
Festive award ceremony with culinary offerings and a communal atmosphere
additional: Registration is via the Oberhessencup website (ohc18). No start times or fee structures are directly provided on the website. The race is part of the club life of TV 1908 Kefenrod e.V. and is included in the local race calendar. Besides the competition, it offers a convivial atmosphere with coffee, cake, beer, and barbecue specialties at the award ceremony.

name: Kehler-Rheinuferlauf
description: The Kehler Rhine Bank Run is a traditional race event celebrating its 10th anniversary, taking place in Kehl am Rhein. The event offers races for children and teenagers, a 5 km corporate run, as well as 5 km and 10 km main races on measured loop courses. The route runs attractively along the Rhine and through the Rhine floodplain, with musical entertainment along the way. Part of the registration fees will be donated to the Kehler animal shelter, making the race socially committed.
course_highlights: 5 km course through the Kehler Rhine floodplain and over the Passerelle to Strasbourg
10 km course with an additional section on forest paths in the Kehler Rhine forest
Mostly asphalted route with musical entertainment along the course
additional: Personalized bib numbers for registrations until 31.05.2026. Bib number pickup from 4:00 PM at the KFV club house in the Rhine stadium. Beverage stations at km 3, 6, 8, and at the finish with still water. Separate changing rooms and showers for men and women available. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start. Valuables can be stored at the late registration desk (no liability). There is a finish buffet after the race. Companies can set up a stand (3x3m) in front of the grandstand for €200, including three race entries. Courses on a measured loop course, bib numbers for registrations until 31.05.2026, registration for corporate runners and children’s races possible, donations to the Kehler animal shelter.

name: Ketteler-Lauf, Lauf dem Krebs davon
description: The Ketteler Run is a charitable race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Offenbach and is themed "Run Away from Cancer." The event supports the care of cancer patients through the proceeds of the run. The starting shot will be at 3:00 PM on Oberen Grenzstraße in Offenbach. Pre-registrations allow for the collection of race numbers and finisher T-shirts as early as June 12 at the Ketteler Hospital. The event is an established tradition and combines athletic commitment with a social cause.
course_highlights: Start on Oberen Grenzstraße, approx. at house number 119, Offenbach
Charitable run in support of the care of cancer patients
Opportunity to pick up race numbers and finisher T-shirts in advance at Ketteler Hospital
additional: Race numbers and finisher T-shirts can be picked up on June 12, 2026, from 2:00 PM to 4:30 PM at the reception area of Ketteler Hospital. On the day of the event, pickup is possible from 12:00 PM to 2:00 PM in the hospital courtyard. The run includes distances of 5 km and 7 km, with on-site registration available. The event is part of an annual series of charity runs to combat cancer and offers finisher T-shirts to participants.

name: Kidsmarathon
description: The Pillenstein KIDSmarathon on June 13, 2026, is an inclusive running event for up to 4,000 children aged 1 to 11 years. Children can choose their distance freely, with fun and participation as the main focus. There is no timing, and all participants are winners. The event offers a great atmosphere with a varied program and is barrier-free, enabling children with disabilities to participate.
course_highlights: Barrier-free routes of 200m, 400m, and 800m
Running distances for children aged 1 to 11 years freely selectable
Accompanying persons can run if needed
additional: No timing, all children are winners. Puma Finisher Shirt for early registration and while supplies last. Medical care available if needed. Safety and road closures are ensured. Late registrations are no longer possible; the event is fully booked. A companion can be provided for children with special needs. Distances: 200m, 400m, 800m; no timing; barrier-free routes; participation from 1 year old; no late registrations; including Finisher Shirt with early booking.

name: Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf
location: Kurpark Bad Nenndorf, Bad Nenndorf, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf Bad Nenndorf is a traditional, DLV-approved popular race and part of the Schaumburger Laufserie. It takes place in the beautiful spa park of Bad Nenndorf and offers courses for various age and performance groups, including 1000 m, 2500 m, 5 km, 10 km, as well as 5 km walking and Nordic walking. The event is family-friendly and attracts many participants running on paved paths through the park. In addition to the sporting competition, there is an attractive supporting program and good infrastructure with changing rooms and shower facilities.
course_highlights: Course route on paved paths through the spa park
Start and finish on the Kurpromenade at the Wandelhalle
Variety of distances from 1000 m to 10 km as well as walking variants
additional: Changing rooms and shower facilities are available at the sports center, accessible by bus shuttle. Insurance coverage is provided through the LSB contract. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Medical support is guaranteed. A maximum of 300 starters for the 1000 m and 2.5 km races. 5 km Nordic walking and walking with timing without placement. First race for the Samtgemeindepokal. Scoring race of the Schaumburger Laufserie. The race is held as part of the Landesgartenschau, with various distances and a family-friendly atmosphere. Early registration is possible, and the event is open to all age groups.

name: Lauf um den Senftenberger See
description: The 49th run around Lake Senftenberg will take place on June 13, 2026, offering runners various course lengths around the picturesque Lake Senftenberg. The event is open to all age groups and skill levels, from children to the challenging 17.7 km lakeside loop. The races start at 09:00 AM in front of the Seesporthalle Großkoschen, with a friendly atmosphere and comprehensive catering as well as changing and washing facilities. Registration is available online via myRacePartner, with late registration possible until the day of the event for a small fee.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Senftenberg with a length of 17.7 km
Additional distances: 10.0 km, 5.4 km, 3.2 km, and a 200 m children’s run
Start and finish at the Seesporthalle Großkoschen with good infrastructure
additional: Late registrations are possible online from June 12, 2026, 18:00 until June 13, 2026, 09:00, for a late registration fee of €2.00. Parking instructions and snack provisions are free until 13:00 on the day of the event. Changing and washing facilities are available at the start and finish areas. Participation is at your own risk with a liability waiver from the organizer. Registration is via myRacePartner; free parking until 13:00; availability of changing and washing facilities; children’s and family runs included.

name: Luckenwalder Turmfestlauf
description: The Luckenwalde Tower Festival takes place from June 12 to June 14, 2026, around the Market Tower in Luckenwalde. It is a traditional city festival that is open and accessible to all visitors, regardless of their financial means. The festival offers a diverse cultural program and invites guests from near and far to celebrate together. The city relies on an open festival organized by locals for locals and welcomes voluntary donations to support the event.
course_highlights: Various race distances, including a 10 km main run and an 800 m sprint
Integrated into the large Tower Festival with cultural and family-friendly activities
Children's and youth races as well as relay races for all age groups
additional: The Tower Festival begins each of the three days at 12:00 PM. The festival operations end at 1:00 AM on Friday and Saturday, and at 10:00 PM on Sunday. No regular cultural fee is charged; instead, voluntary donations are requested, which can be handed in at the Tourist Information. The Tourist Information is open during regular hours. The event takes place as part of the Luckenwalde Tower Festival, celebrated from June 12 to June 14, 2026, in Luckenwalde, featuring music, food, rides, and family activities.

name: Mut-Lauf
description: The MUT-LAUF Kiel is an annual running event that advocates for greater openness and courage in dealing with mental health issues. The goal is to make a stand against stigma and to raise awareness for mental health. The run represents communal activity without competitive pressure and is open to all people, regardless of age, fitness level, or physical limitations. In addition to the run, there is a diverse accompanying program with music, interviews, culinary offerings, and a market of possibilities with information on mental health and prevention.
course_highlights: Run for everyone without competitive pressure, also for wheelchair users
Event held on the Moorteichwiesen in Kiel
Supporting program with music, interviews, and a market of possibilities
additional: Registration is available online via the Davengo portal or in person at the KIELER FENSTER, Ambulant Center. The event takes place annually on the Saturday before the start of Kiel Week. There is an accompanying program with participatory activities for the whole family and a market of possibilities with self-help groups and social organizations. The MUT-LAUF 2026 will be held on June 13, 2026, with registration through the Davengo portal. Participation fees are €10 for adults and €5 for children. Information about self-help groups and a friendly supporting program are offered.

name: Nordheimlauf
description: The Nordheim Run takes place on June 13, 2026, in Nordheim (Württemberg) and celebrates its 25th anniversary. Five different races are offered, including children's runs, a para-run, a school run, a fun run, and the main 10 km race. The course is varied, fully asphalted, and features approximately 150 meters of elevation gain in the main race. Timing is done electronically with transponders, and refreshments are provided along the route and at the finish. The race is part of the Ensinger-Zabergäu-Cup 2026 and offers a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Varied, fully asphalted course
Approximately 150 meters of elevation gain in the 10 km main race
Refreshment stations with mineral water along the route and at the finish
additional: Start and finish area at the sports grounds on Lauffener Straße opposite the outdoor pool. Timing with transponder on the shoe, which must be returned after the race (rental costs included in the entry fee). Online registration until June 10, 2026, 10 PM; late registrations on race day until one hour before the respective start. Nordic walkers will have their times recorded but will not be included in the rankings. Fruit provision from the 10 km main race. Group registration for teams is possible. Course profiles, parking options, route over 5 and 10 km, varied asphalted routes with about 150 meters of elevation, team competitions, online registration available.

name: Oelder Citylauf
description: The Oelder City Run is a traditional race classic in the heart of Oelde, inspiring runners of all ages for over 45 years. The event offers a diverse program with children’s, school, and inclusion runs as well as road races over 5 km and 10 km. The races take place in front of a large audience with a fairground character and are part of the Volksbank Cup race series. The course is internationally measured and runs through the city center of Oelde with start and finish at the marketplace.
course_highlights: Internationally measured 2.5 km loop, which is run multiple times depending on the distance
Course runs through the city center of Oelde with start and finish at the marketplace
Various races for all age groups including children’s and inclusion runs
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for a late registration fee of 3.00 EUR. Race documents will be issued at the event center on the marketplace. Certificates for children’s and children’s runs are available on-site, for other races online. Shower facilities are available at the sports hall of the comprehensive school Oelde, approximately 300 meters from the finish. Registration is via Raceresult; the event is known for its diverse categories and friendly atmosphere.

name: OSTSEE Run
description: The OSTSEE Run by ROTEC is a sporting highlight as part of the OSTSEE Sports Games in Cottbus. The race offers an attractive course for runners and walkers and is embedded in a diverse sports and leisure program with numerous other competitions and activities. The event is aimed at sports enthusiasts of all ages and offers, in addition to the athletic competition, a lively supporting program and a large OSTSEE Party with free admission. The combination of sporting event and festival makes the OSTSEE Run a special experience in the region.
course_highlights: Start and finish at APEX Ostsee-Sportpark Cottbus Willmersdorf
Course for running and walking as part of the SPARKASSEN Half Marathon
Diverse supporting program with sports and leisure activities
additional: OSTSEE Party with free entry in the evening from 8:00 PM in the festival tent. Free OSTSEE Shuttle Service from the main train station to the sports park. Diverse supporting program with children's runs, beach tennis, volleyball, archery, and other sports. Start times from 8:45 AM, registration possible, participation in a trial run with registration until 12.06.26

name: OSTSEE Sparkassen Halbmarathon
description: The SPARKASSEN Half Marathon will take place on June 13, 2026, in Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee. The course covers 21 kilometers and starts at 10:00 AM from the Möbel Höffner grounds. Participants can pick up their race documents from 7:00 AM at the start and finish area. The race is suitable for participants aged 18 and over and offers an attractive route along the Baltic Sea coast. There is no registration on-site; registration must be completed in advance.
course_highlights: 21-kilometer course along the Baltic Sea coast
Start and finish at the Möbel Höffner grounds
Race through Timmendorfer Strand and Niendorf/Ostsee
additional: Race documents available from 7:00 AM at the start and finish area. No on-site registration possible. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Course length is 21 km.

name: Panorama-Baumwipfel-Lauf 2026
price_range: 2,00 € für bestimmte Läufe, andere nicht spezifiziert
description: The Panorama Tree Top Run 2026 is an attractive running event in the Steigerwald, attracting runners from all over Germany. The varied routes lead through vineyards and the Steigerwald Nature Park with winding trail and forest paths. The half marathon and 12 km routes run over the tower of the Tree Top Path Steigerwald and back over the Oberschwarzach Herrenberg. Start and finish are at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastiani House Oberschwarzach, and the running route offers new beautiful views after every bend.
course_highlights: Routes through vineyards and Steigerwald Nature Park
Winding trail and forest paths
Half marathon and 12 km over the tower of the Tree Top Path Steigerwald
additional: The event includes several race distances, including family and experience runs, with start and finish at the Panorama Terrace at the sports facility / Sebastiani House Oberschwarzach. Registration is online, the routes are scenic and lead through forest and vineyard paths.

name: Rettichfestlauf
description: The Rettichfestlauf in Schifferstadt is a traditional running event taking place on June 13, 2026. The races lead on fast and varied courses around the Waldfesthalle, partly on asphalt paths and partly on forest trails. Distances offered include 5 km and 10 km, as well as shorter runs for children, toddlers, and minis. The event is family-friendly and offers suitable running opportunities for all age groups.
course_highlights: Course route near the Waldfesthalle with asphalt and forest paths
Loop length of the main routes 2.5 km
Fast and varied running courses
additional: Start times: School run (1200 m) at 17:30, toddler run (650 m) at 17:45. There is also a mini run over 200 m without timing. Registration is expected to start in March 2026. The event takes place at the Waldfesthalle in Schifferstadt. Start and finish at the Waldfesthalle, online registration, children and school runs, timing with transponder, catering at the finish area.

name: ROCKS AND RUN 3. Rielingshäuser Steinbruch-Lauf
location: Rielingshäuser Steinbruch, Marbach am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The ROCKS AND RUN 3rd Rielingshäuser Quarry Run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Marbach am Neckar. The race offers a distance of 2.5 km for all age groups, including special runs for children and adolescents. It is a great opportunity for families to be active together and enjoy the sporting atmosphere. The event typically occurs in June with mild temperatures and mostly sunny days.
course_highlights: 2.5 km course
Runs for all age groups including Youngster-Run and Kids-Run
Event location at Rielingshäuser Quarry near Marbach am Neckar
additional: The event is family-friendly with special runs for children and adolescents. The weather in June is typically mild and sunny with temperatures around 23°C and occasional rain. The event takes place in Marbach am Neckar, with typical weather around 23°C and occasional rain. It is ideal for families and running enthusiasts seeking a relaxed and social running event.

name: Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg
description: The Skatstadtmarathon Altenburg is a challenging running event taking place on June 13, 2026, in Altenburg. Participants can choose from various distances, including marathon, relay marathon, half marathon, 13.3 km run, fitness run, student and children's races, as well as walking events. The course leads through the historic city of Altenburg with diverse sections, including climbs in the city forest and along the Great Pond. The accompanying program offers not only a sporting challenge but also a variety of entertainment with music, a children's festival, and a lecture by running legend Uta Pippig.
course_highlights: Start at the Altenburg marketplace with a view of the Red Spitze
700-meter-long ascent through the city forest to the Bismarck Tower, the highest point of the course
Refreshment points at 5 km and 7.5 km, as well as atmosphere and party at the refreshment stations
additional: Race number pickup and late registration on June 12 from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on the event day from 7:00 AM until 30 minutes before each start at 'Goldener Pflug'. Changing rooms, showers, and baggage storage are available on site. Extensive accompanying program with sports fair, lectures, live music, children's festival, and a big party on the event day. The marathon has a time limit of 6 hours and 30 minutes, with the turnaround point closing after 2 hours and 45 minutes for the second lap. Runner catering, medical support, cultural program, professional timing, collectible race bibs, drinks, hot meals, showers, event T-shirts (pre-order until March 31, 2026), and secure baggage storage.

name: Steinfurter Altstadt - Abendlauf
description: The Steinfurt Old Town Evening Run is a traditional race event that will take place on June 13, 2026, marking its 38th edition. Organized by the Turnerbund Burgsteinfurt, the race offers various age categories and distances that run through the historic old town of Steinfurt. The event is particularly family-friendly and is characterized by a lively atmosphere with large starting fields. For young runners, medals and trophies are awarded, making the race a popular event for young and old alike.
course_highlights: Runs through the historic old town of Steinfurt
Age categories from children to masters athletes
Medal and water bottle for every young runner at the finish line
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on the day of the event from 1 PM at the old town hall at the market square. Late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Each young runner receives a medal and a water bottle; the top three in each category are awarded trophies. Races for different age groups, on-site registration, medals, trophies, reusable race bibs, entry fee via SEPA direct debit, no refunds available.

name: Straßenlauf Gollhofen mit Mittelfränkischer Meisterschaft über 10 km
location: Gollhofen, Landkreis Neustadt an der Aisch-Bad Windsheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Gollhofen Road Race takes place on June 13, 2026, for the 26th time and includes the Middle Franconia Championship over 10 km. The event is organized by FC Gollhofen and offers runners the opportunity to participate in a traditional competition. Further details and information are available in the announcement on the website. The event is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km road race with Middle Franconia Championship
Traditional race with over 25 years of history
Event in the municipality of Gollhofen, Würzburg district
additional: On June 14, 2026, starting at 1:00 PM, the German Sports Badge will be awarded. The girls' trial training is on July 4, 2026, from 10:00 AM with registration until June 26 via email. Registration for the road race is via the link provided on the website. Further details are included in the flyer and the announcement. The race takes place on a street course at the Gollhofen sports facility. Registration is online, and the event also includes youth categories. The event offers a good opportunity to meet the running community in the region.

name: Söltjerlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 3,- € Kinder und Jugendliche bis einschl. Jg. 2007

description: The Söltjerlauf in Bad Münder is a charity run in the beautiful Süntel, where every lap counts. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels, from children to marathon runners, and features a shaded forest circuit approximately 3.8 km long with a refreshment point. Participants have four hours to run as many laps as possible, with proceeds going to a good cause. The event promotes team spirit and health and invites attendees to stay after the run with catering and an award ceremony.
course_highlights: Shaded forest circuit approx. 3.8 km
Refreshment point on the course
Atmosphere at the Bergschmiede inn with catering
additional: Shuttle service from 09:30 AM is available to arrive on time for the 11:00 AM start. Late registrations are possible online until 12.06.2026 with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Each participant receives a certificate indicating the kilometers run. The top individual finishers and the top 10 teams will receive prizes. Parking is limited; it is recommended to use alternative parking and the shuttle bus. Dogs are only allowed on a short leash and are not permitted as team members. The competition is open to all age groups, with sponsors donating per lap for local projects. Venue at the Bergschmiede, supported by local sponsors such as Sparkasse Hameln-Weserbergland and Ardagh Group.

name: Tollenseseelauf
description: The Neubrandenburg Tollense Lake Run is a scenic race around Lake Tollense that attracts over 2,000 runners annually. With various distances suitable for young and old, the race offers a diverse running festival in a family-friendly atmosphere. The course is challenging with some elevation, which is why the race is also known as "The Toughest in the North." Over 300 volunteers ensure an unforgettable running experience with certificates, functional T-shirts, and trophies for the best performers.
course_highlights: Race courses around the picturesque Tollense Lake
Challenging elevation on all routes
Family-friendly running festival with a variety of distances
additional: All participants receive a certificate and a functional T-shirt. Trophies are awarded to the top 3 overall male/female finishers, with medals and certificates for age group winners. There is a bus transfer for relay teams, which is requested during registration. Multiple distances are available, including relay marathon and children's runs; registration at tollenseseelauf.de; well-known event in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.

name: Volksbank Haren Citylauf
description: The 27th Volksbank Haren City Run will take place on June 13, 2026, and offers an attractive, fast course through the center of Haren. The 5 km and 10 km runs are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are eligible for rankings, making them ideal for competitive athletes as well as recreational runners. There are also special races for children and adolescents over 400 m, 750 m, and 1.5 km. Additionally, there is a team classification in the 5 km run, where teams from companies, clubs, or groups are scored.
course_highlights: Attractive and fast course through the center of Haren
5 km and 10 km courses are DLV-measured and eligible for rankings
Special races for children and adolescents over 400 m, 750 m, and 1.5 km
additional: Finishers' shirts are provided to all participants of the 5 km and 10 km runs. Payment of entry fees is via direct debit. There is a team classification in the 5 km run for teams of at least 3 people. Participation is free for children from Haren's daycare centers and schools if their institution participates. Large trophies and certificates are awarded for school rankings. Free participation for children in school and daycare teams, registration until June 7, 2026. Prizes for winners and teams. Parking facilities nearby.

name: Waaker Bystopen-Attacke

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Familienlauf 2,5 km Kinder ab 6 Jahre 15,00 EUR

description: The Waaker Bystopen Attack is an obstacle race in Lower Saxony around the Waaker Büsteppe in the Göttingen Forest. The event offers courses of 2.5 km (family run), 5 km, and 10 km with over 30 natural and artificial obstacles. Participation is possible both as an individual runner and in teams, with team scoring requiring at least 4 runners. In addition to the main race, there is a Bambini Attack for the little ones, which runs without registration. The event emphasizes experience, team spirit, and outdoor activity in nature.
course_highlights: Over 30 natural and artificial obstacles
Course around the 387.2-meter-high Waaker Büsteppe
Refreshment points with water and fruit along the route
additional: Start documents can be collected from 08:00 at the Waake sports field. Bib numbers are attached to the wrist and additionally written on upper arms and lower legs; no longer any bibs on the stomach. There are two refreshment points on the course and one at the start-finish area. After the race, showers and sanitary facilities are available at the Waake elementary school. Food and drinks such as beverages, grilled items, fries, cake, and more are provided before, during, and after the race. Bags can be deposited free of charge and supervised in a truck. The Bambini Attack takes place parallel on the sports field without registration. Warm-up before each start. Obstacle race, family run, team and relay classifications, online registration, T-shirt optional for a fee.

name: Waldlauf Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen
description: The 45th Forest Run in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen is organized by SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V., Department of Recreational Sports and Athletics. The races take place on Saturday evening in early summer and feature courses through the forest in the hilly Swabian Alb region on well-maintained, partly asphalted paths. There are various competitions for different age groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km hobby run, and a 2 km students' run. The event is family-friendly and offers electronic timing as well as refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: Courses through the forest in the hilly Swabian Alb region
Well-maintained paths, partly asphalted and free of traffic
Water stations at km 3 and 7 (10 km) or km 3 (5 km)
additional: Late registrations are possible until 5:30 PM on the day of the event with a late registration fee of €2.00. Start and finish are located at the sports grounds of SV 1923 Ohmenhausen e.V. in Reutlingen-Ohmenhausen, Hornstraße. The course is not wheelchair accessible, dogs and baby joggers are not allowed. All finishers of the 5 km and 10 km runs receive a free non-alcoholic Berg Cyriakus. Electronic timing with transponder, certificates, and result lists are available online. There is a mixed-team classification in the main race (at least 3 runners). Pre-registration is open until June 10, 2026; late registrations on the event day are possible. Dogs are prohibited, baby joggers are not permitted, water and drinks are available along the course, and electronic timing is provided.

name: Werner Volksbank Stadtlauf 20. Team- / Firmenlauf
description: The 24th Werner Volksbank City Run 20. Team / Corporate Run will take place on June 13, 2026, in Werne. This running event offers the opportunity to be active together with colleagues or friends and to strengthen team spirit. The event includes two distances, 1 km and 10 km, and is especially aimed at teams and companies who want to run together.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km and 10 km
Start location in Werne
Typical June weather with an average of 23°C and mostly sunny days
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The event promotes physical activity and team spirit, with registration via Raceresult. The weather in June is expected to be warm and sunny at around 23°C.

name: Autohaus Lutz Nightrun
organizer: SV 1911 Traisa e.V. und Turngemeinde 1879 Traisa
description: The Autohaus Lutz Nightrun is a short race taking place on June 13, 2026, in Mühltal-Traisa. The event offers two distances, 650 meters and 5.6 kilometers, and is held in typical June weather with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The run is ideal for runners seeking a short, fast challenge. Please check the details directly with the organizer before registering.
course_highlights: Two distances: 650 m and 5.6 km
Event location Mühltal-Traisa
Typical June weather with around 23 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please verify event details with the organizer before registration. Short distance of 650 m, longer route of 5.6 km, start times from 6:30 PM, main race at 10:00 PM, including children's and relay races.

name: Bürgerlauf Visbek
location: Pastors Wisk Visbek Park, Visbek, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 1st Bürgerlauf Visbek will take place on June 13, 2026, in Park Visbek (Pastors Wisk) and offers a varied program for runners of different age groups and performance levels. The event includes children’s and school runs as well as middle-distance and main runs over 5 km and 10 km, complemented by a walking or hiking route. Bib number distribution will be on the day of the event from 3:00 PM, and all runs will be professionally timed. The proceeds will benefit the Bürgerstiftung Visbek, making the race a sporting event with social commitment.
course_highlights: Runs in Park Visbek with a natural course
Professional timing for all races
Part of the Volksbanken Laufcup in Vechta
additional: Bib number distribution on the day of the event from 3:00 PM. Late registrations and payments on-site are possible in individual cases. Parking is available near the Catholic parish hall, St. Raphael kindergarten, the sports and swimming hall, Gerbertschule, and Blumen Ostmann. Catering with a beverage cart as well as fries and bratwurst on site. The event is registered with the German Athletics Association and insured. Terrain: city/flat, online registration until June 11, 2026, bib numbers from 3:00 PM, professional timing, parking nearby, on-site catering.

name: Drebber-Marathon
location: Schulstraße 1, Jacobidrebber, Drebber, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Drebber Run on June 13, 2026, offers a diverse selection of competitions for all age groups and performance levels. The course takes place on an officially measured 2.34 km loop through the district of Jacobidrebber, with start and finish at the sports field. In addition to individual and relay competitions from children's runs to the marathon, there is an attractive supporting program for spectators and participants. Especially emergency services are invited to participate as a relay team in the Blue Light Cup and showcase their performance.
course_highlights: Officially measured 2.34 km loop through Jacobidrebber
Start and finish at the sports field with decorated course
Various distances from 500 m children's run to marathon
additional: The route will be closed from 1:00 PM, and spectators and participants are asked not to cycle on the course from 2:30 PM. Parking is available at the sports field, and directions are signposted. There is a dedicated start program for children from 2:30 PM with bib number distribution at the club house. A supporting program with catering and activities for children is available on the schoolyard. Certificates with photos will be sent after the run. The event honors winners in various age groups and team classifications. Emergency services can participate with relay teams in the Blue Light Cup and will receive a code for a free starting fee upon registration. The start and finish are located in front of the school at Schulstraße 1, Drebber. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and community involvement.

name: Dünenlauf
description: The Dünenlauf Sandhausen takes place on June 13, 2026, at the Walter-Reinhard-Stadium and offers flat, varied courses through forest and over a sand dune. There are runs for children (Bambini), 5 km, and 10 km with timing. The event is a DLV-approved popular race and takes place in all weather conditions. Catering is provided, and the course is closed to road traffic.
course_highlights: Flat, varied course through forest and over a sand dune
Refreshment station on the 10 km course after approximately 5 km
Bambini runs take place in the stadium
additional: Race bib distribution in the 1st floor of the Walter-Reinhard-Stadium. Bambini runs start from 3:00 PM in several blocks with timing. The 5 km run starts at 5:00 PM, and the 10 km run at 6:00 PM. Changing rooms are available in the stadium. First aid support provided by the DRK local group Sandhausen. The course is closed to road traffic. Prizes and certificates for the top three in each age group. Flat, varied course through forest and sand dune, refreshment stations on the course, online registration, in all weather, start at Walter-Reinhard-Stadium.

name: Enni Donkenlauf
description: The ENNI-Donkenlauf on June 13, 2026, in Neukirchen-Vluyn offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The courses mainly run over flat, asphalted, and low-traffic economic roads and side streets, ideal for fast times. In addition to competitions, there are non-competitive runs and walking offers open to everyone. The event is family-friendly and includes special classifications for schools and youth groups.
course_highlights: Flat, predominantly asphalted and low-traffic economic roads and side streets
Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses
Minis-Run and Donki@school on the synthetic track of the sports center
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible from 11:30 a.m. in building "G". The Minis-Run and Donki@school runs take place on the synthetic track of the sports center. For safety reasons, dogs, baby joggers, and bike escorts are not allowed. Parking spaces are limited; it is recommended to travel by bicycle or public transport. Smoking is prohibited throughout the school grounds, and dogs are not allowed on the sports field. Various distances (500 m to 10 km) can be registered for either on-site or online. No age group classifications are available for some runs.

name: Mattoni 1/2Maraton Olomouc 2026
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc 2026 is a traditional half marathon that takes you through the beautiful historic center of Olomouc. The start and finish are at Horní náměstí, where you can admire the Holy Trinity Column and the town hall with a unique astronomical clock. During the race, you will enjoy the city's atmosphere, historic buildings, and beautiful parks. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and also offers accompanying programs.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Horní náměstí with sights such as the Holy Trinity Column and astronomical clock
The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc with beautiful parks
City atmosphere and rich history during the race
additional: The race is part of the Mattoni Running Festival with accompanying runs such as the Šantovka 5 km run, dm family mile, dm bambini run, and relay half marathon. Starts are divided into several time waves from 15:00 to 19:00. A mobile app, RunCzech, provides all race information and a virtual package. The race course includes historic streets, parks, and city roads; the route is certified and fully closed to traffic; the event offers technical support, refreshment stations, and medical services.

name: Horem dolem Chospílem
description: Horem dolem Chospílem is an interval running race 9.2 km long, taking place on meadows and field roads around Postřekov in the Chospíl area. The race is part of the Běžec Chodska series and offers runners a pleasant terrain with a natural atmosphere. It starts in intervals, which provides an interesting racing format. This race is suitable for runners seeking a combination of nature and sporting challenge in the Plzeň Region.
course_highlights: The course is 9.2 km long on meadows and field roads
Interval start of the race
Natural environment around Postřekov in Chospíl
additional: The race takes place on June 13, 2026, results and participant lists are available on the website. Exact registration information is not provided.

name: Sokolovský  ¼ maraton
organizer: Živý kraj – Destinační agentura pro Karlovarský kraj, z.s.
description: The Sokolov Quarter Marathon is a running event scheduled for June 13, 2026, in Sokolov, Karlovy Vary Region. The course primarily passes through scenic parts of the city and surrounding nature, with a race distance of approximately 10.5 km. The event is suitable for recreational runners as well as those who want to experience the race atmosphere in a beautiful environment. Organizers emphasize a friendly atmosphere and sporting experiences for all participants.
course_highlights: Scenic course passing through Sokolov and surrounding natural scenery
Approximate length of 10.5 km suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Relaxed and friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race is part of the Color Run Sokolov, registration and details are not specified, the race is suitable for the general public.

name: Barevný běh Sokolov
description: Color Run You Can't Escape is a colorful run and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends. There are two routes to choose from: 5 km with five colorful zones and 1.5 km with three colorful zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences full of colors, music, and laughter. The run takes place in Sokolov on June 13, 2026, and is part of a year-round colorful tour across several cities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colorful zones
1.5 km route with 3 colorful zones and Urban Challenge zone
Colorful zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event is a full-day entertainment from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM with music, themed zones, photo booths, and 360° video. The starter pack includes a T-shirt, start number, medal, and other accessories. The event is also suitable for children, who can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. No timing is measured; the focus is on joy and shared experience. Registrations are already open. The event will be held on June 13, 2026, in Sokolov. The routes pass through Sokolov Island and the surrounding area, focusing on fun and community.

name: Run Labe Run

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné pro ročník 2026 je 17 000 Kč za tým.

description: Run Labe Run is a relay race for runners consisting of up to 12 team members, taking place from June 13 to June 14, 2026. The race route runs from Špindlerův Mlýn to Děčín along the Elbe River, covering a total of 380 km divided into 36 segments of varying difficulty. The race starts in 8 waves from 5:00 AM to 11:00 AM and offers categories including mixed teams of 10-12 runners, mixed teams of 6-9 runners, women's teams, and veterans. Teams compete for prizes in several categories, and registration is open until March 31, 2026, or until capacity is reached.
course_highlights: Route length of 380 km divided into 36 segments with difficulty levels from 1 to 5
Start in Špindlerův Mlýn, finish in Děčín near the castle
Race held in 8 start waves from 5:00 to 11:00
additional: Maximum number of runners per team is 12. The captain's meeting will be held online on May 24, 2026, at 7:00 PM. Teams from previous editions have priority registration from June 26, 2025. The race starts in 8 waves from 5:00 to 11:00. Teams are not considered registered until payment is credited to the account. Registration opens on July 1, 2025, with the deadline on March 31, 2026, or until capacity is filled. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of the Krkonoše Mountains and along the Elbe River.

name: JEŠTĚD SUMMER RUNNING WEEKEND
location: Skokanský areál u Ski Ještěd, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd Summer Running Weekend is a trail running weekend race held in the beautiful environment of the Ski Jumping Area at Ski Ještěd in the Liberec Region. It offers various running disciplines including a 24-hour run, marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from experienced ultramarathoners to families with children. The routes lead through picturesque mountain terrain with significant elevation changes and stunning views of the Ještěd Ridge. The event is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series and provides quality facilities and atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Picturesque mountain routes on the Ještěd Ridge
Significant elevation gain up to 1390 m on longer distances
Various race lengths including 24-hour run, marathon, and shorter runs
additional: The race offers various running disciplines including a 24-hour run, marathon, half marathon, and shorter distances. The routes are challenging with significant elevation changes and lead through mountain terrain. The event includes facilities with refreshments and accommodation options. There are children's races on shorter distances for kids. The races take place on terrain around the ski jumping hills, with registration and detailed route information available on the website. The event also features trail camps, merchandising, partner zones, and ecological measures.

name: Dobročinný běh po stopách Silver A
location: Pardubice, Pardubice District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
price_range: startovné na charitativní účely, přesná částka není uvedena
description: We invite you to the 3rd annual charity run and walk 'In the Footsteps of Silver A', organized by the Zámeček Memorial in Pardubice. The event is suitable for athletes and non-athletes, children and adults, and the registration fee is donated to charitable causes. The run offers two routes - a shorter five-kilometer and a longer ten-kilometer, and there is also a children's race approximately one kilometer long. Additionally, there is a guided city walk to places associated with the Silver A landing, starting from the Zámeček Memorial.
course_highlights: Two running routes: 5 km and 10 km
Children's race approx. 1 km
Guided city walk following the Silver A landing
additional: Registration begins at 2:00 PM, with the event expected to end at 6:00 PM. The registration fee includes a public transport ticket. Online registration is available until June 11, after which registration can be done on-site on the day of the event. The proceeds from the registration fee are allocated to charitable purposes, specifically for the purchase of a stroller for four-year-old Viktorka, who has an autism spectrum disorder. Routes include 5 km, 10 km, and a children's race, with a guided city walk starting from the Zámeček Memorial. The registration fee includes a public transport ticket, supports local charity, and promotes historical awareness.

name: Hradecký koloběh
location: Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
description: The Hradecký koloběh is a mixed pairs race held in the beautiful environment of the city forests with the starting point at Biřička. The race combines running and cycling, with one team member running and the other cycling, and exchanges between competitors are allowed at any time during the race, adding strategy and dynamism. The event promotes team spirit and the joy of movement and offers OPEN and FAMILY categories. The race is supported by the city of Hradec Králové and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organizational service.
course_highlights: Beautiful environment of city forests
Combination of running and cycling with free exchanges between competitors
Start at Biřička in Nový Hradec Králové
additional: The start package includes a race number, organizational support, baggage storage, toilets, event staff, refreshments at the finish line, and photographs (not guaranteed for everyone). Facilities include toilets, storage, catering, and parking. It is recommended to park in the parking lot on Partyzánská Street; parking is prohibited on Mužíkova Street, where the situation is monitored by the municipal police. Prizes are awarded for 1st to 3rd place in categories. Terrain: 90% forest paths, 10% asphalt roads. Elevation gain of 108 meters. Categories OPEN and FAMILY. Start at Biřička, Nový Hradec Králové.

name: Jinecký kros
organizer: Městys Jince a Jinečáček, z. s.
description: Jinecký cross-country is a traditional running race held in Jince, offering a challenging route approximately 5.7 km long with an elevation gain of around 178 meters. The start and finish are located at the football field near Biokoupaliště, which provides facilities for competitors including parking, changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The course runs on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows, includes running over a wooden bridge, asphalt roads, and a climb to Vystrkov Hill. The race is suitable for adults and children, who have their own categories. The main race starts at 11:00.
course_highlights: The route crosses a wooden bridge over Ohrazenický Stream
Challenging ascent to Vystrkov Hill with an elevation gain of about 30 m
Surface of the course combines asphalt, forest paths, and meadows
additional: Facilities include parking, changing rooms, showers, toilets, and a refreshment stand. Registration is possible until June 13, 2026, at 17:00, or on-site on the race day. Children's races are part of the program. The course has an elevation gain of +178m and -187m, with start and finish at the SK Jince 1921 sports complex. The course is approximately 5.7 km long, terrain: asphalt, forest paths, meadows; children's races; start at the football field near Biokoupaliště.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc
description: Mattoni Running Festival Olomouc is a popular running event held in the historic center of Olomouc. The race offers an attractive route through the picturesque streets of the city, suitable for both experienced runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of the RunCzech running league and provides a unique atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can enjoy quality facilities and support throughout the race.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Olomouc
Pleasant urban environment with cultural monuments
Part of the RunCzech running league with professional organization
additional: The event includes various race categories, an expo, and accompanying activities. Registration is done via the RunCzech website. The races are certified and suitable for all age groups.

name: Jindřichohradecký půlmaraton
location: Jindřichův Hradec, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Jindřichohradecký half marathon 2026 is the tenth anniversary edition of the running race, offering a unique experience combining the picturesque historic city center, water-side sections, and natural passages with significant elevation changes. The race is open to individuals for 21.1 km, as well as teams in relay races, families, and schools in shorter runs. The atmosphere is enhanced by fans, music, and organizational support including refreshment stations and showers. A special Rebel Run for schools is also prepared, focusing on team cooperation rather than time. The race starts on June 13, 2026, and participants will receive an original medal and can win material prizes.
course_highlights: Beautiful combination of city and nature - historic streets and peaceful countryside around Jindřichův Hradec
Sections along water and natural passages with notable elevation changes
Unforgettable atmosphere with fans, music, and encouragement on the track
additional: The race program includes the Rebel Run start at 15:00, Family Run at 16:00, and the main half marathon and relay race at 17:00. There are refreshment stations, showers, baggage storage, professional photos and videos from the track and finish line. The Rebel Run is a special team race for elementary schools, where the focus is on teamwork and participation rather than time. The course passes through the historic center and natural passages, with various races including relays, family, and school runs, as well as refreshments, showers, facilities, medals, and prizes.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SUMMER - Running Weekend
description: LEKI Ještěd Summer - Running Weekend is part of the prestigious Ještěd Skyrace series, which offers challenging and beautiful routes in the mountainous terrain of the Ještěd Ridge. The races are designed for a wide range of runners from children to experienced skyrunners, with distances from 200 meters up to 42 km. The event takes place in a picturesque setting near the ski jumps on Ještěd and offers a unique outdoor running experience with significant elevation gain. The running weekend is complemented by accompanying programs, refreshments, and the possibility of accommodation nearby the races.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain routes with elevation gain up to 1390 m
Routes of various lengths from children's races to 42 km ultramarathon
Scenic environment of Ještěd Ridge with views and technical sections
additional: The winners' announcement takes place from 16:00. The races are held at the area near the ski jumps on Ještěd. There are children's races, refreshments, and an accompanying program. Accommodation and volunteer support are available. The routes are technically demanding with significant elevation gain. The race emphasizes ecology, for example by not using disposable cups, and offers a wide range of activities during the weekend.

Unique atmosphere with live music and artistic experiences
