Participation is at your own risk. There are trophies and material prizes for the top three finishers in each distance and category, as well as cash prizes for the fastest team. Multiple race distances, team competition, online registration via RUNTIMING, no late registrations on the event day, medals and T-shirts for participants.

name: Drei-Länder-Lauf
description: The Three-Country Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in Arenshausen and connects the regions of Thuringia, Lower Saxony, and Hesse. The event offers various race distances, including 1.2 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 13 km, some of which are loop courses and others are point-to-point routes. In addition to the main races, there is a Bambini run for preschool children without timing, as well as Nordic walking as a non-competitive activity. The run has a long tradition as a symbol of the region's unification after German reunification.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Arenshausen
Loop courses for 1.2 km, 2 km, and 13 km runs
5 km run as a point-to-point course with a stadium lap
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start with an additional fee of 2.00 EUR, excluding children's runs. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall. Parking is available directly at the sports field in Arenshausen. Nordic walking (approx. 8 km) starts around 14:00 without ranking or entry fee. Bambini run (400 m) for preschool children without timing or placement. No entry fee for the main race, online registration from May 1 to June 11, 2026. Parking available, changing rooms and showers at the sports hall.

name: Schackenslebener Hopfenlauf
location: Sportplatz Schackensleben, Schackensleben, Börde, Saxony-Anhalt, Germany
description: The Schackensleben Hopfenlauf is a traditional running event in Schackensleben, about 25 km west of Magdeburg in the Börde district. The start and finish of all courses are at the sports field, from where various distances are offered: 400 meters for children, 1.4 km for youth, as well as 6.0 km and 10.8 km for adults. The longer routes lead through the town and the surrounding landscape with typical Börde hilly profile, on roads and paved field paths. Refreshments are available with drinks, coffee, cake, and grilled food, and after crossing the finish line, there is a raffle with attractive prizes. The Hopfenlauf is part of the Novo Nordisk Landescup and the Elbe-Ohre-Cup.
course_highlights: Routes through the town and the surrounding area with Börde-typical hilly profile
Run on roads and paved field paths with multiple refreshment stations
Start and finish at the sports field with good changing and shower facilities
additional: The 0.4 km and 1.4 km routes are completed on the track and immediate surroundings. After crossing the finish line, participants receive drinks and fruit for energy. In the club house at the sports field, there is excellent catering with coffee, cake, lard sandwiches, drinks, and grilled food. Traditionally, a raffle with attractive prizes takes place parallel to the award ceremony. Multiple distances, online registration, facilities such as changing rooms, showers, catering, and raffle. Supports the German athletics system through official timing.

name: REWE Women´s Run Hamburg
description: The REWE Women's Run Hamburg is a road race for beginner and ambitious female runners in the Elbe metropolis Hamburg. The event offers a 10 km measured loop course starting and finishing at Ballindamm. In addition to the main race, there is also the REWE Girl’s Run for girls aged 5 to 10 over 1 kilometer. Participants receive a finisher medal and can use showers and changing facilities after the race.
course_highlights: Measured 10 km loop course according to IWB and AIMS
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg
Girl’s Run over 1 km for girls aged 5 to 10
additional: Showers and changing facilities are available after the race at Gerhart-Hauptmann-Platz. There is a clothing deposit for personal items. The bib number includes a disposable timing chip and must be worn visibly on the running shirt. Photos can be purchased after the race from a photography partner. The event also includes a Girls’ Run over 1 km for girls aged 5 to 10, starting at 11:30 AM. It offers changing and shower facilities as well as on-site catering.

name: Eschathlon - Der Eschborner Halbmarathon
description: The Eschathlon is a popular city run in Eschborn that attracts numerous running enthusiasts every year. The focus is on the half marathon, which features an attractive course around Eschenplatz. In addition to the half marathon, there are other competitions such as 10 km run, 5 km run, 20 km relay, FIT walk, and children's races. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with an accompanying program and catering, making it ideal for runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Loop course around Eschenplatz in Eschborn
Relay exchange zone at Neugasse 1A
Course with refreshment stations and volunteer positions
additional: Start and finish are located at Eschenplatz in Eschborn. The 20 km relay consists of 4 x 5 km laps with a exchange zone at Neugasse 1A. T-shirt guarantee is available for registrations until April 30. Late registrations are possible until the day of the event, but without T-shirt guarantee. The accompanying program and catering are available from 09:00 to 14:00 on site. Half marathon on June 14, 2026, children's races, relay races, registration from the end of March, early bird discounts until April 30, additional quota from May 1.

name: EVL-HalbMarathon Leverkusen
description: The EVL Half Marathon in Leverkusen is a traditional and challenging half marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, for the 24th time. The course covers 21.1 kilometers through the sports city of Leverkusen, including a special highlight: passing through the BayArena, the home stadium of Bayer 04 Leverkusen. The hill climb on Sauerberg presents an additional challenge. The race is open to all performance levels, from beginners to elite runners, and offers a unique running experience with lots of atmosphere and community spirit.
course_highlights: Course runs right through the BayArena
Hill climb on Sauerberg
Varied 21.1 kilometers through Leverkusen
additional: Start and finish on Bismarckstraße between Ostermann-Arena and BayArena. Participants must be born in 2010 or earlier for the half marathon, 2016 or earlier for the 10 km run, and 2018 or earlier for the 5 km run. Bib numbers are non-transferable and must be worn visibly. There are also Bambini runs with available spots. The event shirt for 2026 is available. The organizer recommends a good training structure with regeneration and nutrition tips from running coach Andrea von Horn. The event takes place in all weather conditions. The course passes through Leverkusen, including the BayArena; registration for Bambini runs; event shirt and merchandise; podcast with tips and stories.

name: Heidenheimer Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The Heidenheimer Sparkassen City Run on June 14, 2026, offers diverse races for beginners to half marathon runners through the city center of Heidenheim. The half marathon takes place on two nearly identical laps through the city, passing landmarks such as the Pauluskirche, the city library, and Brenzpark. The event also includes 10 km and 5 km runs as well as school and children’s races. All participants receive timing with an integrated transponder in their bib number and a generous finish area with refreshments.
course_highlights: Half marathon on two nearly identical laps through Heidenheim
Course runs through city center, Brenzpark, and past Schlossarkaden
Finish area next to Pauluskirche with large spectator support
additional: Timing is done via single-use transponders in the bib number. Functional shirts in city run design can be ordered during registration. Baggage drop-off from 7 a.m. in the town hall underground parking garage. Medical support provided by the German Red Cross. Award ceremonies take place in front of Pauluskirche. Photos will be made available online after the race. Event in Heidenheim with various race distances, online and on-site registration, bib number pickup, medical support, baggage storage, and refreshments on race day.

name: Herzogstadtlauf Straubing
description: The Herzogstadtlauf in Straubing is a traditional community run taking place on June 13 and 14, 2026, appealing to runners of all ages. From children's races to various distances including the BMW Half Marathon, the event offers a diverse program with attractive routes through the historic city and the city park. In addition to the sporting challenge, a comprehensive supporting program with stage performances and DJ music creates a lively atmosphere. The event promotes community and health and is a highlight in the Eastern Bavarian running calendar.
course_highlights: Loop course through the historic area of Straubing with start and finish at Hagen
Route along Joseph-von-Fraunhofer-Halle, ice stadium, and former LAGA site
Varied routes through city park, old town, and city center with notable points such as Ludwigsplatz and Theresienplatz
additional: On Saturday, children's races with multiple start times from 15:30 to 19:00 are held; on Sunday, main races start from 09:00 with warm-up program. There is a functional shirt available in a special design offered annually. Registration is possible online, including group and corporate registrations. For children's races, a school registration with card is possible until April 17. The supporting program features stage performances, cheerleaders, and DJs to entertain during the event. Various race routes, functional shirts, medals, refreshments, timing by ZEITGEMAESS, sports physiotherapy support, certificates, prizes, vouchers, and a free finisher video are provided.

name: Hohenneuffen-Berglauf mit BW Trail
description: The 37th Hohenneuffen Mountain Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Linsenhofen with the finish at Hohenneuffen Castle. The main course covers 9.3 km with approximately 535 meters of elevation gain and 180 meters of descent. Additionally, there is the 24th Student Mountain Run with various distances and elevation gains, open to participants from 1st grade onwards. The start is in Balzholz at the town hall, and the finish is at the Kindergarten Jahnstraße. We look forward to many runners from near and far.
course_highlights: 9.3 km course with approx. +535 / -180 meters of elevation
Start in Balzholz at the town hall, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle
Student mountain run with distances from 1.56 km to 3.25 km and up to 100 meters of elevation
additional: Course length approx. 9.3 km, elevation gain approx. +535 / -180 meters, online registration, children and youth races, start in Linsenhofen, finish at Hohenneuffen Castle

name: Internationaler Brüder-Grimm-Lauf
organizer: Verein zur Förderung des Brüder-Grimm-Laufes e.V.
price_range: Startgebühr, ermäßigt für Mitglieder: 5 Euro Rabatt, sonst unklar
description: The International Brothers Grimm Run is a traditional 3-day event that takes place from Hanau, the birthplace of the Brothers Grimm, over approximately 82 km to Steinau, where the fairy tale collectors spent their childhood. The route is divided into 5 stages and offers a challenge for both recreational runners and competitive athletes. The course runs along historic trade routes, past historic buildings, scenic landmarks, as well as spa and leisure resorts in the Spessart and picturesque villages in the Kinzig Valley. The event will be held from June 12 to June 14, 2026, with registration opening on November 11, 2025.
course_highlights: Approximately 82 km long route from Hanau to Steinau in 5 stages
Course along centuries-old trade routes and historic buildings
Scenic sights and spa towns in the Spessart and Kinzig Valley
additional: The route is mostly asphalted, partly through open terrain and forest. The elevation profile is flat with minimal inclines (maximum height approx. 130 m). The stages include paths such as bike paths, forest trails, and paved roads. Start and finish points of each stage are in different towns along the route, e.g., Niederrodenbach, Neuenhaßlau. The event is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners. Multi-day running event, 5 stages, registration from November 11, 2025, participant limit 550, individual stage booking possible.

name: Mainauenlauf 2026
description: The Mainauenlauf 2026 will take place on June 14th on the grounds of the former State Garden Show in Bayreuth. The scenic, challenging hilly course runs through green park areas with magnificent panoramas over the city. Various distances are offered, including 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, Nordic walking, as well as children's and youth runs. A special highlight is the atmospheric finish line in the Finisher Park with excellent catering and a unique finisher medal. Additionally, city championships across all distances will be held for the first time.
course_highlights: Challenging hilly 5 km loop with 85 meters of elevation per lap
Highest point of the course: Col Bellota
Finish in the Mainauenlauf Finisher Park with catering and medal
additional: Showers are open at the School Center East until 3:00 PM. There is a photo booth at the start/finish area. Clothing bags can be handed in at the Finisher Park and collected until 3:00 PM. Group warm-up on Saturday at 6:30 PM in the Finisher Park. Refreshment stations at km 2, 3, 6, 7 with water, isotonic drinks, baked goods, and fruit. Sanitary facilities are available near the finish area and at the Sports Center East. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, relay races, Nordic walking, children's and youth runs; start on the grounds of the State Garden Show; refreshments at several points; finish in the Finisher Park.

name: Mendener Citylauf mit Halbmarathon und Schülerläufen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km 10 € (Team Meldung ab 6 Starter/-innen erhalten 25% Nachlass)

description: The 10th Menden City Run on June 14, 2026, offers an athletically attractive and exciting running event with fast courses in the city center of Menden. The event includes children's runs, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. Several event points along the route create a lively atmosphere, and participants are enthusiastically received at the finish on the town hall square. The Marathon Club Menden e.V. warmly invites runners of all generations to participate in this traditional race.
course_highlights: Fast courses through the city center of Menden
Multiple event points for good atmosphere along the course
Finish on the town hall square with enthusiastic reception
additional: Participation fees for children and students from Menden kindergartens and schools are covered when registering centrally through their respective schools via Mendener Bank eG or the Menden Sports Association. Team registrations from 6 runners receive a 25% discount on the 5 km distance. Online registration with direct debit or PayPal is possible. Late registrations on the event day are also possible. The course is in Menden, registration online, late registration on the event day, parking at Neumarkt.

name: Metropolmarathon
organizer: Laufteam Fürth 2010 und Team Klinikum Nürnberg
description: The Sparkassen Metropolmarathon 2026 takes place on June 13 and 14 in the cities of Fürth and Nuremberg. The running event connects two cities with varied course routes, numerous competitions, and a colorful supporting program. With around 9,000 participants and 600 volunteers, the Metropolmarathon offers a weekend full of activity, fun, and community. The races range from marathon, half marathon, 10 km runs, and Nordic walking to children's and youth races.
course_highlights: Start in Fürth, finish at the main market in Nuremberg
Varied routes with many refreshment stations
Professional support from the Laufteam Fürth 2010 and Team Klinikum Nürnberg clubs
additional: Pacemakers are used in the half marathon and marathon. There are individual certificates available for download, medical services, changing and shower facilities. A prize draw for participants who also take part in the DATAGROUP Triathlon Nuremberg 2026 is offered. Routes: marathon, half marathon, 10K, Nordic walking, youth race, KIDSmarathon; start in Fürth, finish in Nuremberg; supporting program along the route; refreshments, pacemakers, certificates, medical services, changing rooms, and showers.

name: Nesselwanger Seenlauf
description: The 1st Nesselwanger Seenlauf, presented by Endress+Hauser and organized by the Skiklub Nesselwang e. V., is the successor to the previous company run and is aimed at people of all ages. The race promotes movement and community and offers various routes for children, teenagers, adults, and families, also suitable for strollers. The start and finish are located at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event appeals to individuals as well as companies, clubs, and running groups.
course_highlights: Baby race approx. 0.4 km for birth years 2019-2021
Children's race approx. 1.6 km for U10, U12, U14
Lake run approx. 10.7 km with start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu
additional: Start and finish at the Trendsportzentrum Allgäu. The event includes several runs: Baby race (0.4 km), Children's race (1.6 km), Village run (5.2 km), and Lake run (10.7 km). The race is also suitable for families with strollers. Routes for children, families, companies, and clubs; registration until June 4, 2026; participation from age 4; various competitions including baby race, children's race, village run, and lake run.

name: NEW-Citylauf
description: The 25th NEW-City Run in Erkelenz on June 14, 2026, is a popular running event that takes runners of all performance levels through the city center. The event offers a sporty and communal atmosphere that appeals to both beginners and ambitious athletes. With a varied course and an exciting atmosphere, the NEW-City Run is a highlight in the regional event calendar. Participating invites you to experience the joy of running together with family and friends.
course_highlights: Course through Erkelenz city center
Varied running route
Sporty atmosphere and communal experience
additional: The event takes place on Sunday, June 14, 2026. Registration and further information are available at www.new.de/laufserie. The organizer is the city of Erkelenz, contact via city marketing. Run in the city center, anniversary, suitable for all performance levels.

name: Niederelberter Gickellauf
description: The Niederelberter Gickellauf is a popular running event in Niederelbert that offers various race distances for children and adults. In addition to children's races over 800 meters and 2 kilometers, there are also 5- and 10-kilometer courses. The event is embedded in a family festival that promotes social togetherness and emphasizes the recreational sports philosophy of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. The run encourages both sporting ambition and community spirit in the region.
course_highlights: Children's races over 800 m and 2 km
Race courses over 5 km and 10 km
Family festival with various highlights
additional: The Gickellauf takes place as part of a family festival that promotes social cohesion across departments. Children's and adult races are offered, the event is part of the recreational sports program of SV Blau-Weiss 1908 Niederelbert e.V. Various courses, online registration possible, no entry fee

name: RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf
description: The RVB Harlingerland Volkslauf takes place in 2026 for the 43rd time and is organized by the Laufreff Schafhauser Wald e.V. in Dunum, Lower Saxony. The event is supported by the Raiffeisen-Volksbank eG, Aurich, and offers a friendly and welcoming atmosphere for runners and walkers of all performance levels. The courses lead through the beautiful Harlinger landscape with start and finish in Dunum. In addition to the Volkslauf, there are also walking and Nordic walking options as well as an extensive photo and results archive from previous years.
course_highlights: Start on Vorackkerweg, finish at Dunum School
10 km Volkslauf with 2 laps
Half marathon and other routes with interactive course maps
additional: The event includes various distances: 10 km Volkslauf (2 laps), half marathon, 5 km Volkslauf, 7.5 km walking, and children’s and youth runs. Start and finish are in Dunum, and the courses are available as interactive maps. Training times for the Laufreff are Mondays at 19:00 and Wednesdays at 18:00, each meeting at the NIGE sports field or stadium at Peldmühle from September. Everyone is welcome, from beginners to professionals. The event takes place in June, with official, homologated courses for official performance records. It supports the German solidarity system in sports and is aimed at runners of all ages, including children and adolescents.

name: saarBRÜCKENlauf
description: The Laufgemeinschaft Saarbrücken cordially invites you to the saarBRÜCKENlauf, a guided run over (almost) all the bridges in the state capital Saarbrücken. Two course lengths are offered: a 10 km loop with 7 bridges and a 20 km loop with 17 different bridges. The run is not a competition but a pleasure run with various pace groups to collectively manage the challenging route with ramps, stairs, and many turns. The start is at 10 a.m. at the Kulturbiergarten opposite the Kraftwerk Römerbrücke.
course_highlights: Guided run over (almost) all Saarbrücken Saar bridges
Two course lengths: 10 km with 7 bridges and 20 km with 17 bridges
Challenging route with ramps, stairs, and frequent turns
additional: There are different pace groups (60, 70, 80 minutes for the short course and 2:00, 2:20, 2:40 hours for the long course). No timing, no bib numbers. Participation only for sufficiently trained runners without health concerns. The run is not a competition but a pleasure run. Due to the route, groups should stay together; falling back into slower groups is possible. The run is a guided pleasure run without timing, suitable for groups and offers refreshments at the finish area at Kulturbiergarten. The event is only suitable for fit runners.

name: Sauerland-Höhenflug-Trailrun
description: The Sauerland Höhenflug Trail Run is a popular running event in Sauerland, taking place on June 14, 2026. The event offers various course lengths from 0.4 km up to the half marathon, running through the diverse landscape of Sauerland-Höhenflug. The trail run is open to runners of all ages and performance levels and is organized by the Skiclub Hagen-Wildewiese e.V. in cooperation with Sauerland Tourism and the Sauerland-Rothaargebirge Nature Park. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup and features a special sprint classification on the last 200 meters of the longer courses.
course_highlights: Courses from 0.4 km to half marathon through Sauerland
Sprint classification on the last 200 meters at 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Various age groups and categories, including youth runs
additional: The trail run includes multiple age groups and distances, including children’s runs, youth races, and main courses. Timing is provided by RaceResult through Time and Voice. The final times for the half marathon are limited to 3:15 hours. The event is part of the Volksbank-Sauerland-Laufcup 2025. Late registrations are possible on-site, with an additional fee of €3. Course lengths: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; online registration; natural experience in Sauerland; annual event in June.

name: Sparkassenlauf
location: Hessisch Lichtenau, Landkreis Kassel, Hessen, Germany
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event with DLV-certified courses over 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The races lead through Wittringer Forest and feature a flat, fast loop on paved hiking trails, asphalt, and tartan track. All participants receive a personalized bib with their name as well as a finisher medal. The event also hosts the district championships in road running and offers net times and live timing.
course_highlights: Flat, fast loop through Wittringer Forest on paved hiking trails and asphalt
Start and finish at the stadium on Bohmertstraße with entry on the tartan track
Two refreshment stations along the course, with additional stations if needed
additional: Personalized bibs with first names for all participants. Net times and live timing are provided. The course is certified by DLV until 2027 and eligible for best lists. Official bike escorts and marshals ensure a safe flow of runners. The cut-off time for the Fun Walk is 10:15 AM. The race is part of the district championships, offering medals, shirts, and a festive atmosphere, including live results and personal support.

name: Stadtlauf Kappeln Rund
description: The Kappeln City Run Loop is a traditional race event held annually in Kappeln, Schleswig-Flensburg district. The event offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to run on a diverse course through the city and surrounding area. The race is organized by TSV Kappeln and is a popular event for sports enthusiasts from the region. The atmosphere is family-friendly and motivating, with a well-organized process and friendly support.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city of Kappeln and the surrounding landscape
Varied terrain with city and nature sections
Well-marked and supervised running route
additional: The event is organized by TSV Kappeln, which also offers additional sports programs and training times for various sports. There is a participant list, results, and a live tracking list for the race. More details about the schedule, course, timing, and awards are available on the website. The event includes running and Nordic walking competitions, with results usually available shortly after crossing the finish line, and offers for children and youth.

name: Taunussteiner Waldlauf 30.7
description: The Taunusstein Forest Run is a traditional running event that has been attracting around 700 runners annually for over 30 years to the picturesque forests and hills of the Untertaunus. The main course over 15 kilometers offers a challenging experience with varied terrain and approximately 250 meters of elevation. For beginners and children, there are shorter distances of 5 and 2 kilometers, ideal for experiencing the race atmosphere. The event is characterized by its scenic diversity and a lively program at the finish area.
course_highlights: Scenic routes through forests and fields between Hahn, Wingsbach, and Watzhahn
Main course 15 km with about 250 meters of elevation and challenging profile
Refreshment stations at km 3, 6, 7, 10, and 13 on the 15 km course
additional: Start and finish at the Gesamtschule Obere Aar (Pestalozzistraße 3, 65232 Taunusstein). Bib number pickup from 07:30 in the cafeteria of IGS Obere Aar, recommended to collect at least 40 minutes before start. Cut-off time for the 15 km race is 2 hours and 30 minutes. All finishers receive a medal. The fastest men and women in each distance will receive prizes, which are only handed out on race day. 2 km runners participate in a raffle. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Walkers are allowed, will be scored separately, but without prizes. On-site registration is possible for an additional fee of 2 €. Results and certificates are available online. There are refreshments, cake, a barbecue, and drinks in the start/finish area. The event is family-friendly, welcomes walkers, and offers catering and drinks at the finish area. Registration is possible both online and on-site.

name: TVE-Sommerlauf 2026
description: The TVE Summer Run is a traditional community race organized by the Turnverein 1890 Edingen e.V. in Edingen-Neckarhausen. The event offers races for various age groups from the youngest to seniors, with official timing and certificates. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is eligible for best lists. Runners enjoy a varied route along the Neckar with start and finish at the stadium.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Sports & Recreation Center with a track lap
Course runs along the Fischkinderstube and along the Neckar towards Wieblingen
Officially measured and best list-eligible course
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start of each race, provided the participant capacity has not been reached, with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Certificates can be downloaded online and printed out by participants. There are age group and overall winners' classifications with material prizes for places 1-3. Running and Nordic Walking event, various distances, registration until June 13, 2026.

name: Alfelder Bernd Meyer Staffelmarathon

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Freizeit-, Vereins- und Schulteams beträgt 70 € (10 € pro Starter)

description: The Alfeld Bernd-Meyer Relay Marathon is a traditional relay marathon taking place on June 14, 2026, in Alfeld (Leine). The event is aimed at runners from the entire region and is organized jointly by several local running clubs and the city of Alfeld. The course is approximately a 3 km loop, run twice, starting and finishing at the marketplace. Each team consists of 7 runners who must be registered by name, and timing is done electronically with disposable transponders. In addition to the relay marathon, there is also a children's run of about 700 meters.
course_highlights: Loop course of about 3 km, to be run twice
Start and finish at the marketplace in front of the citizen's office
Course through the city center and park areas with varied route
additional: Each relay team consists of 7 persons, who must be registered by name and adhere to the order on the day of the event. The starting numbers are personalized and equipped with disposable transponders for electronic timing. Participants can keep their bib numbers as souvenirs. A maximum of 80 teams can participate. The children's run starts at 10:30 a.m. (girls) and 10:45 a.m. (boys) over approximately 700 meters. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere, including preparatory and training sessions, and is a significant event in the regional running calendar.

name: Bad Kohlgruber Schluchtlauf
location: Sport- und Freizeitzentrum am Erle, Bad Kohlgrub, Oberbayern, Germany
description: The Bad Kohlgruber Gorge Run is a scenic race in the pre-Alpine region, which, despite its name, is not a mountain run. The course is gently hilly and consists of 20% asphalt and 80% forest paths. The event takes place at the sports and leisure center at Erle in Bad Kohlgrub and offers free drinks along the route and at the finish. Refreshments such as coffee, cake, food, and drinks are available, and certificates are provided for all participants as well as trophies for the class winners.
course_highlights: Gently hilly pre-Alpine course
20% asphalt, 80% forest paths
Free drinks around 6 km and at the finish
additional: Number bibs can be collected from 07:45 AM; award ceremony around 11:00 AM in the finish area; medical support provided by the Bad Kohlgrub mountain rescue; in case of fewer than 6 participants in a category, awards are given in the next lower category; event takes place in all weather conditions; road traffic regulations must be observed; course runs through pre-Alpine land, field paths, forest paths, and asphalt sections; no mountain running characteristics; free drinks; prizes for all participants; trophies for the top runners in each category; event takes place regardless of weather

name: Barmstedter Stadtlauf
description: The 22nd Barmstedt City Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Barmstedt. The event offers measured loops over 5 km and 10 km, which are eligible for best lists. In addition to the main races, there are also Nordic walking, walking, as well as children's and Bambini runs. Start and finish are at the marketplace in Barmstedt, and the course runs through the city center and around Rantzauer See with various surfaces such as cobblestones, asphalt, and firm sandy paths.
course_highlights: Measured loops over 5 km and 10 km, eligible for best lists
Course through Barmstedt city center and around Rantzauer See
Various surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, firm sandy paths
additional: Timing is done with a rental chip on the ankle (except for children's runs), which is retained at the finish. Chips not returned will be charged at 40 euros. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed for safety reasons. There are different age classes and minimum ages for the races. The course may vary slightly due to construction work; updates will be posted on the website. Courses are measured, various surfaces, online registration possible, no late registrations, catering and medals included.

name: Barsbütteler Volkslauf
description: The Barsbüttel Volkslauf is a traditional running event held annually in June at the sports field in the Sports Center Barsbüttel. The event offers various running distances from 400 meters to 10 kilometers, mostly flat and running over asphalted or firm sandy agricultural paths. The courses mostly run through the traffic-free Barsbüttel farmland and offer beautiful views, especially on the longer 5 km and 10 km routes. Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. Refreshments for runners and spectators are also provided.
course_highlights: Running routes mostly flat and run over asphalted or firm sandy agricultural paths
Courses run through the traffic-free Barsbüttel farmland with beautiful views
10 km route runs along a small avenue and past the Stapelfelder Moor
additional: Times are measured electronically, and all participants receive a certificate afterwards. The shortest route (400 m) takes place entirely on the tartan track in the stadium. The 1 km and 2 km routes partially lead out of the stadium, while the longer routes (5 km and 10 km) offer beautiful views and run over firm sandy paths and asphalted field paths. Refreshments for runners and spectators are provided. Event takes place on roads, registration online via TrainerDay, catering for participants and spectators.

name: BORNE TO RUN (48-Stunden-Lauf)
description: BORNE TO RUN is a 48-hour charity run in Unna that presents an extreme challenge for endurance and willpower. Participants are pushed to their limits over long, demanding hours. This race is aimed at runners who are ready to face a real test and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 48-hour run with distances of 43.2 km and 172.8 km
Event location in Unna with typical June weather around 23°C and mostly sunny
Charity event focused on endurance and willpower
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The run takes place from June 12 to June 14, 2026. Registration is possible until June 11, 2026. Donations go to the German Children's Hospice Service and NABU.

name: Donatus-Lauf
location: Sportgelände SC Fortuna Liblar, Hamburg-Rissen, Hamburg, Germany
description: The Donatus Run takes place on June 14, 2026, around Donatus Lake at the SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds in Hamburg-Rissen. The event offers various race distances from 400 meters for children, 1200 meters for school children, up to the half marathon and 10 km main race. The races are designed for different age groups and provide a family-friendly atmosphere with additional walking and family runs. The course is varied and well marked, with start and finish areas located very close to Erftstadt train station. After the races, award ceremonies are held promptly, and certificates can be downloaded online.
course_highlights: Varied course lengths from 400 m to half marathon
Start and finish area near Erftstadt train station with good accessibility
Family run and Nordic walking as additional offerings
additional: Late registrations are only possible until the participant limit is reached and incur an additional fee of 3 euros. Award ceremonies take place directly after each race on the sports grounds. Parking is only available at Erftstadt train station, which is just 100 meters from the start and finish areas. Certificates can be downloaded online as PDFs and printed. Courses around Donatus Lake, online registration, parking at Erftstadt train station, start and finish areas at SC Fortuna Liblar sports grounds.

name: Eifelmarathon
description: The Eifel Marathon on June 14, 2026, in Waxweiler offers a diverse running event with a marathon, ultramarathon, trail run, half marathon, 10 km fitness run, hiking marathon, and children's run. The courses lead through the scenic Eifel region with varying elevation gains and well-equipped refreshment stations. Start and finish are in Waxweiler, with a shuttle service for the half marathon start in Hamm. The event is part of the new Mini-Cup Germany and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with medals for all participants.
course_highlights: Marathon course with 42.195 km and 764 meters of elevation
Ultramarathon with 51.4 km and 983 meters of elevation, including a scenic forest loop
Half marathon starting in Hamm with shuttle service, running along the reservoir and the Prüm river back to Waxweiler
additional: Race bib pickup on Saturday, June 13, 2026, from 17:00 to 19:00 with a pasta party. On race day (June 14, 2026), bib pickup from 07:00 to 09:00. The finish cutoff time for all runs is 16:00. Every participant receives a medal. Refreshment stations are staffed from 09:30. Shuttle service for the half marathon from Waxweiler to Hamm. Hiking marathon approximately 30 km on the Eifel Marathon course. Part of Mini-Cup Germany with prize money for participants completing three German races. Course approximately 30 km (Waxweiler - Hamm - Waxweiler), start at 08:00, finish cutoff at 16:00, refreshment stations from 09:30, marked course, medals for all participants.

name: Famberglauf
description: The Famberglauf is a running event held in June in Fambach, organized by SV Schwarz-Weiß Fambach 09 e.V. The program offers four different distances: a half marathon of 21.1 km, the 10.9 km Famberglauf, the 5 km Famberg Sprint, and a 1000 m children's run. The event is aimed at runners of all ages and performance levels and emphasizes a family-friendly club race rather than a major competition.
course_highlights: Half marathon of 21.1 km
Various distances from 1000 m to 21.1 km
Event in Fambach with a family club character
additional: The event includes four races on the same day, including a children's run. The number of participants is low, indicating a family club event. The weather in June is typically sunny with temperatures around 23 °C. Multiple race distances, including half marathon, sprint, and children's run; event part of the landscape cup 'Rhön - Thüringer Wald - Werratal'; limited participant numbers possible.

name: h Lauf Reichenau
description: The Reichenau 24-hour race is an exceptional ultra-distance run on Reichenau Island, appealing to individual runners, six-person teams, and corporate teams. The event takes place around the clock, from Saturday noon to Sunday noon, challenging participants' endurance and stamina on a prepared course around Hochwart. The race has established itself as an impressive sporting challenge, attracting both amateur athletes and ambitious competitors. The atmosphere is characterized by community and sporting ambition, supported by a runner's camp and dedicated organization.
course_highlights: Loop course around Hochwart on Reichenau Island
Running continuously for 24 hours from Saturday 12 PM to Sunday 12 PM
Prepared field paths and scenic route
additional: Participation possible as an individual runner, six-person team, or corporate team. There is a runner's camp at the 'Mofarennen-Acker' as a resting place. The event is organized by two running clubs. The best individual runners are awarded with vegetables. The course around Hochwart features unpaved paths, no asphalt, and is suitable for both hobby and professional runners. The route is closed to traffic.

name: Hahner Kitzenhauslauf
description: The Hahner Kitzenhauslauf is a popular running event in the tri-border area of Germany, Belgium, and the Netherlands. The natural, hilly, and varied courses in the southern Aachen region offer runners a challenging and scenic experience. The event has a long tradition and attracts runners from the region and beyond. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized competitions.
course_highlights: Natural running routes in the southern Aachen region
Hilly and varied terrain
Scenic course layout
additional: Courses for children, students, ten-kilometer race, half marathon; scoring races of the Regio Aachen Laufcup; catering, certificates, photos, live results

name: Integrationslauf des VfB Reichenbach
description: The VfB Reichenbach Integration Run in Reichenbach-Steegen is an annual running event that has enriched the community calendar since 2016. The race promotes togetherness and integration through sport by overcoming barriers and enabling the building of contacts. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a shared sporting experience in the region.
course_highlights: Fun run in the local community of Reichenbach-Steegen
Promotes integration and community through sport
Held since 2016 with a break during the COVID-19 pandemic
additional: The event takes place on the sports grounds in Reichenbach-Steegen and fosters community spirit through sporting activities for all age groups.

name: KarlsruheLäuft 100 Jahre Berufsfeuerwehr Karlsruhe
description: The Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade will celebrate its 100th anniversary in 2026 with a diverse event program for the entire city. The anniversary includes sporting competitions, historical highlights such as classic car meetings and hand-pump fire engine competitions, as well as ceremonial acts and castle light shows. The events offer exciting insights into the history and technology of the fire brigade and invite everyone to join in celebrating and remembering.
course_highlights: Various running distances including children's runs, relay races, 5 km and 10 km
Festive anniversary of the Karlsruhe Professional Fire Brigade with a special focus on fire brigade themes
Event location near the West Fire Station - Günther Klotz Anlage
additional: The anniversary year 2026 offers, in addition to sporting competitions, historical events such as the classic car meeting with around 120 historic fire engines and the competition for historic hand-pump fire engines. There is also a Landesflorianifeier, a theater performance for children, and diverse insights into fire brigade technology and history. The events take place among other locations at Karlsruhe Castle and the Daxlanden fire station. The registration deadline is June 10, 2026; the event is part of the anniversary celebrations and is open to runners of all ages.

name: Kirchenkirnberger Wald- und Wiesenlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder- und Jugendläufe, Startgebühren für längere Rennen
description: The 3rd Kirchenkirnberger Forest and Meadow Run will take place on June 14, 2026, in Murrhardt. It is a short race with two distances, passing through forest and meadow landscapes. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere with typical June weather, mild temperatures, and mostly sunny days. Runners of all ages are warmly invited to participate and enjoy the nature around Murrhardt.
course_highlights: Run through forest and meadow landscapes
Two distances: 450 m and 10.8 km
Typical June weather with mild temperatures and sunshine
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. Event in June with routes through nature, focusing on community and health, regional event

name: Kirschlauf
description: The Cherry Run in Kleinfahner, organized by USV Erfurt, is a traditional race with over 20 years of history. On June 14, 2026, the 24th edition will take place, featuring scenic routes with challenging elevation paths. The event offers various distances, including a main race over 14 kilometers, a fun run over 4.5 kilometers, as well as children's and toddler races. The award ceremony is traditionally conducted by the Thuringian Cherry Queen, and the race is part of the TLV Running Cup.
course_highlights: Main race over 14 kilometers with scenic elevation path and views over the northern Thuringian Basin
4.5 km fun run with challenging topography in the Imtal valley
Finish through cherry orchards above Kleinfahner with spectacular views
additional: Race bibs are available from 8:00 a.m. at the event tent near the mill. Late registrations are possible online from June 13 at 2:00 a.m. and on race day until 30 minutes before the start, with a fee of 5 euros. Award ceremonies will begin around 9:45 a.m. for children's races and around 11:30 a.m. for other races. Registration is open until June 9, 2026; late registrations are possible. The course features elevation paths and finishes in Kleinfahner, including children's races and Nordic walking.

name: Ludwigsluster Schlossgartenlauf
description: The Ludwigslust Castle Garden Run takes place on June 14, 2026, in the Ludwigslust Castle Park and offers runners of all ages a diverse selection of courses. The distances range from 2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, complemented by walking routes over 5 and 10 km. A new addition to the program is a toddler run for the little ones without registration and scoring, which is rewarded with an official medal at the finish line. The event is traditional and warmly invites both beginners and professionals to enjoy the beautiful park landscape.
course_highlights: Running courses through the historic Ludwigslust Castle Park
Varied distances from 2 km to 15 km as well as walking routes
Toddler run for children born in 2021 and later with medal
additional: The toddler run is without registration, free of charge, and without scoring, approximately 500-600 meters long. Accompanying adults are explicitly welcome. Registration for the other runs begins on March 15. Run in Ludwigslust Castle Park, no registration required, no fees, no scoring, medals for all participants, parking available, drinks and refreshments, changing and shower facilities, 40th anniversary in 2026, route partially outside the park due to park restrictions, post-race party as part of the Linden Festival.

name: Melibokuslauf mit 3. Mountainbike-Gipfelsprint
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional running and mountain biking event in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place in 2026 for the 55th time. It offers various running routes, including a half marathon trail, a 10 km and a 5 km running trail, as well as youth races for children and teenagers. Additionally, the mountain bike summit sprint takes place, featuring a challenging course with 450 meters of ascent and 130 meters of descent over approximately 13.4 km. The running routes are evaluated by ITRA and offer diverse trails in nature around the Melibokus. The event is open to runners and mountain bikers, with e-bikes not permitted.
course_highlights: Half marathon trail with 21.2 km length
Mountain bike summit sprint with 450 m ascent and 130 m descent over approx. 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated running routes with diverse trails
additional: Race packets and late registrations from 8:00 AM at Sperbergrund, 500 meters above the Bürgerhaus Sonne. Mountain bike summit sprint starts at 09:00 AM, half marathon at 09:30 AM, 10 km run at 09:45 AM, 5 km run at 10:00 AM. Youth races start from 11:00 AM. Gravel bikes are allowed in the mountain bike summit sprint, e-bikes are not. Results are available immediately after the race in the large sports hall at Melibokusschule. GPX files of the routes are available. The mountain bike summit sprint route length is approximately 13.4 km. Online registration is possible, with GPX downloads available. Public transport stops are in Alsbach-Hähnlein. Age restrictions apply for the competitions.

name: Ortslauf Wallertheim
description: The Wallertheim local race is a traditional running event held annually in Wallertheim and is part of the Wingertscup. It offers various distances from 900 meters for children to 10 kilometers for experienced runners, as well as a 5 km walking route. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, electronic timing with transponder technology, and convenient online registration. It is open to runners of all performance levels and provides a sporting community experience in the beautiful nature of Rheinhessen.
course_highlights: Distances from 900 m to 10 km
Electronic timing with transponder technology
Part of the Wingertscup with point collection opportunities
additional: Online registration via br-timing.de with direct debit; event is the 3rd stage in the Wingertscup; routes for children, beginners, experienced runners, and walkers; team registrations possible via provided form. Registration until June 12, 2026, late registrations until 30 minutes before start are possible, changing and shower facilities in the multi-purpose hall, catering with cake buffet, prizes for winners and certificates for all participants.

name: Isernhagener Volkslauf
description: The 25th Volkslauf Isernhagen will take place on June 14, 2026, and offers a warm welcome to runners of all ages and skill levels. There are four race distances to choose from: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and the classic 10 km run, which is measured by the NLV and counts towards the Laufpass. The event is characterized by well-marked courses, professional timing with the runtiming system, and a lively Volkslauf atmosphere with over 400 participants. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt. Late registrations on the day of the event are not possible.
course_highlights: Four race distances: 1 km, 3.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
10 km course measured by the NLV and Laufpass-eligible
Professional timing with runtiming system
additional: Registration is available online via the RUNTIMING portal until June 11, 2026, 24:00. Late registrations on the event day are not possible. All participants receive a refreshment at the finish line. T-shirts and medals are included in the entry fee for children and teenagers; adults can optionally purchase a T-shirt for €15. The event takes place in any weather. Start and finish are located at the sports grounds of TSV Isernhagen, Auf der Heide 32, 30916 Isernhagen H.B. Parking is available nearby. More than 400 participants annually. Online registration via RUNTIMING, no registration on the event day.

name: 55. Melibokus Lauf
description: The Melibokus Run is a traditional race in Alsbach-Hähnlein, taking place on June 14, 2026, for the 55th time. The event offers various running courses, including a half marathon trail, a 10 km and a 5 km running trail, as well as a mountain bike summit sprint. The courses are evaluated by ITRA and feature diverse trails with challenging climbs and beautiful views. There are dedicated school runs for children and teenagers over 400 m, 800 m, and 1500 m. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with start and finish in Sperbergrund.
course_highlights: Half marathon trail (21.2 km) with challenging trails
Mountain bike summit sprint: 450 m ascent, 130 m descent over approximately 13.4 km
ITRA-evaluated courses with available GPX files
additional: Start and late registration from 8:00 AM in Sperbergrund, 500 m above the Bürgerhaus Sonne. Mountain bike summit sprint starts at 9:00 AM, half marathon at 9:30 AM, 10 km at 9:45 AM, 5 km at 10:00 AM. School runs start from 11:00 AM at the sports grounds at Hinkelstein. Gravel bikes are allowed in the mountain bike summit sprint, e-bikes are not. Late registration incurs an additional fee of €3.00 each. Results are available immediately after the race in the large sports hall at Melibokusschule. The race also includes mountain bike summit sprints and trail running elements; registration required; detailed course and event information available.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem Kravaře
location: Zámecký park, Kravaře, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Castle Park Run in Kravaře is a traditional running race organized by the Prajzský Running Club Kravaře, held in the picturesque castle park in Kravaře. The race offers a main course of 8.7 km for adults and shorter distances for children according to age categories. The surface consists of gravel paths, and the course is run over three loops within the park. The event is suitable for recreational runners and families with children, with pleasant facilities and refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs through three loops in the castle park
Surface made of gravel paths
Main course length of 8.7 km for adults
additional: Registration for children is from 8:30 to 9:10, children start at 9:15. Children's categories are divided by age with course lengths from 150 m to 1800 m. Refreshments for adults include cake and drinks, children receive a sweet reward. Facilities include changing rooms and showers at the MFK Kravaře complex. Trail run on gravel paths in the castle park, registration for adults and children, various age categories, refreshments, and prizes.

name: Půlmaraton okolo Prahy 4
location: Žluté lázně, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Half Marathon around Prague 4 is a unique individual running race that offers a meditative running experience on a varied profile city trail. The course measures approximately 21 kilometers and runs around the perimeter of the Prague 4 district, allowing participants to get to know the local geography and their own running form. The race takes place without a mass start; runners start individually or in small groups between 9:00 and 10:00, which eliminates stress and crowding at the start and on the course. After a successful premiere, this half marathon is held for the second time and is suitable for everyone who wants to combine athletic performance with a pleasant experience in nature and the city.
course_highlights: City trail with a varied profile
Circuit approximately 21 km around Prague 4
Individual start between 9:00 and 10:00 without mass gathering
additional: The race is individual with a flexible start between 9:00 and 10:00; participants can run alone or in groups, using a map on their mobile or on paper. The race is held without crowds at the start, on the course, or at the finish, ensuring a relaxed experience. The course is marked, with a start between 9:00 and 10:00, and the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series. Running is at your own risk; extra caution is advised when crossing roads.

name: Přespolní běh areálem zdraví Chábory
location: Chábory u Dobrušky, Chábory, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country running at the Chábory health area is a traditional race organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Chábory, held in the picturesque health area near Dobruška. The race offers a main run of 10,000 meters and additional categories on a 3,330-meter circuit, designed for men, women, juniors, and the general public from 4 to 90 years old. The event is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix in running and is suitable for all generations with the motto "BE FIT!". Participants can look forward to diplomas, material prizes, and a raffle, with the overall winner of the main race receiving a traveling trophy.
course_highlights: Circuit of 3,330 meters on field and forest paths
Main race of 10,000 meters
Categories for everyone from 4 to 90 years old
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:30, with an entry fee of 50 CZK paid during registration as a contribution to administration and refreshments. Results announcement and prize presentation are scheduled for 11:25. Runners participate at their own risk and must comply with current hygiene measures. The race will be held on June 14, 2026, with registration possible until June 13, 2026, 20:00. In addition to the main 10,000-meter race, shorter distances are available. Awards include diplomas, prizes, and a trophy for the overall winner.

name: Chaloupecký kros
location: Chaloupky, Komárov, South Bohemia, Czech Republic
description: Chaloupecký cross country is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Chaloupky near Komárov. The race offers two main routes approximately 8 km and 4 km long, which run on asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. The main race starts at 10:00 AM, and participants can enjoy a combination of natural beauty and sporting challenge. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and is suitable for the general public without children's categories.
course_highlights: Surface: asphalt, forest paths, meadows
Course lengths: 8 km and 4 km
Start in Chaloupky near Komárov
additional: The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Children's races are not part of this event. The course surface is a combination of asphalt, forest paths, and meadows. Distances: 8 km and 4 km, start at 10:00 AM, no children's races, different lengths for various categories.

name: Běh na Hraničář
location: Lesní divadlo u Úhlavy, Nýrsko, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: The Border Runner is a traditional and prestigious uphill running race held in the picturesque environment near the forest theater at Úhlava in Nýrsko. The 5 km course with an elevation gain of 380 meters passes through the ruins of Pajrek Castle and ends at the top of Hraničář with a stunning view of Ostrý Hill. The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup and has been held again since 2020 after a three-year break. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own.
course_highlights: Start at the forest theater near Úhlava
Elevation gain of 380 meters over 5 km course
Finish at the top of Hraničář with a view of Ostrý Hill
additional: The race is part of the Czech Uphill Running Cup. After the race, participants must return to the start on their own. The race includes a main category of 5 km and children's runs; registration takes place on-site from 9:15 to 10:15; the course is mainly trail with a hilly profile and an ascent to the top of Hraničář.

name: Dobývání Dívčích hradů
description: Climbing Dívčí Hrad is a 2 km uphill race with an elevation gain of 135 meters, held in Hlubočepy, Prague 5. This race is part of the Hill Running series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The course runs through scenic terrain with beautiful views, making the race attractive to mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts. The race is suitable for anyone looking to test their endurance and strength in a hilly environment.
course_highlights: Length of the course 2 km with an elevation gain of 135 m
Challenging uphill run in Prague's Hlubočepy
Part of the Hill Running series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race is part of the cycling segment - duathlon, with the possibility of participating in various categories and results recorded by over 78 runners in the past.

description: The 17th Elbląg Piekarczyk Run is an annual running event held in Elbląg, attracting runners for distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a Mini Piekarczyk Run for children. The event is characterized by a unique atmosphere of sporting excitement and integration, and participants receive exclusive collectible medals. Organizers provide comfortable start conditions, including a race office with packet pickup, deposit, and sanitary facilities. The run is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete on scenic city routes.
course_highlights: Routes for 5 km and 10 km runs through the streets of Elbląg
Mini Piekarczyk Run for children in various age categories
Unique collectible medal combined with other city runs
additional: Start packages can be collected at the Ogrody Shopping Center (Saturday 12:00-18:00) and at the Helena MOSiR Ice Rink hall (Sunday 7:30-9:30 for the 5 km and 10 km runs, 7:30-13:30 for the Mini Run). Participants have access to deposit, changing rooms, and showers at the ice rink hall. The Mini Piekarczyk Run includes several age categories for children with different distances from 50 m to 600 m, starting at 12:35 on Sunday. Distances of 5 km and 10 km, team classification, registration discounts, limited spots, online registration.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: Charity Run FOUR SEASONS - Stage IV is a sporting event organized in Oława, in the park near the train station. Participants can take part in a run of about 5 km or a Nordic Walking walk on the same route. The event is charitable and coordinated by the Active People Association "Run Oława" and the Oława City Office. The race office is open on the day of the run from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for the same day. The event is supported by local partners, and the timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: Route of the run and walk approximately 5 km long
Start and finish in the park near the train station in Oława
Opportunity to participate in the run or Nordic Walking walk
additional: Race office open on the day of the run from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Registration for the run has been closed. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555), Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Runs of about 5 km, registration closed, events include various seasons, charity actions for Michał Proć, accompanying attractions, prize draws, massages, bike trips, and meals.

name: Dziki Trail
description: Dziki Groń is a challenging mountain route of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail® run, guided by tourist, courier transfer, and through the Małe Pieniny meadows. The race offers scenic views of the Tatra Mountains and the Beskid, with start and finish lines located at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. The course is designed for experienced mountain runners who want to face natural, demanding terrain. The event is part of the Pieniny Ultra-Trail mountain running festival, which promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region.
course_highlights: Route guided by tourist and courier transfer trails
Views of the Tatra Mountains and Beskid
Passing through the Małe Pieniny meadows
additional: Start and finish at Plac Dietla in Szczawnica. Race office and EXPO located in Park Górny in Szczawnica. There are 5 refreshment points along the route, including one at 12 km near the Shelter. Mandatory equipment required according to the regulations. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the Pieniny region. Registration opens in November 2025, event date is June 14, 2026. The course length is approximately 64 km. The event takes place in Szczawnica, featuring mountain trails and the Małe Pieniny meadows.

name: Grodziski Półmaraton Słowaka
location: Grodzisk Wielkopolski, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Hunters Grodziski Half Marathon "Słowaka" is an annual running event organized since 2007 in Grodzisk Wielkopolski. The race commemorates the patron of the local high school, Juliusz Słowacki, and promotes a healthy lifestyle and sports activity among residents. The half marathon route is flat, runs through the city streets in two loops, with numerous refreshment and nutrition points. After the race, participants receive medals and can enjoy a hot meal and drinks. The event is also an opportunity to promote the city and the local running community.
course_highlights: Flat route, through city streets, two loops of about 10.5 km each
Route marked every 1 km with vertical and horizontal signs
Four nutrition points and four refreshment points on each loop
additional: The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours. The race office is located at Grodzisk Sports Hall at ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A. Timing is done using chips in the start numbers. After the race, the organizer provides a hot meal and drinks. A team classification is conducted for the 5 km distance. The start limit for the 5 km and 10 km races is 500 people combined. Registration and packet pickup are in Grodzisk Wielkopolski, ul. Żwirki i Wigury 2A, on June 13, 2026 from 12:00 to 20:00 and June 14, 2026 from 6:00 to 8:00. Training from the moment of registration until the event.

name: IV Charytatywny Bieg z Żonkilem
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland

The competition will take place on June 13-14, 2026, at the Gwaruś Recreation Center in Suszec. Participants can compete in distances of 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21 km), as well as in races for children and youth. For the most persistent, combined classifications are prepared for the 5+21 km and 10+21 km distances with material prizes. The atmosphere of the event is friendly and encourages participation from both amateurs and more experienced runners.

description: The 9th Charity Run for the Golden Coin in Olsztyn is an annual running event organized by the Future for Children Foundation, which supports sick and disabled children from Warmia and Mazury. The main race over a distance of 5 km takes place by Lake Ukiel and is friendly for all participants, including beginners. The event features a family picnic and numerous attractions, and participation in the run is not only a sporting competition but primarily a support for children in need. The start of the main race is scheduled for 4:30 PM, and the route is scenic and accessible also for those who prefer walking.
course_highlights: Scenic route by Lake Ukiel in Olsztyn
5 km distance suitable for runners and walkers
Family picnic and numerous attractions accompanying the run
additional: Side starts for children and youth on distances adapted to age, with the first children's race over 400 m at 3:35 PM. The time limit for the 5 km main run is 1 hour. The event has a charitable character, supporting rehabilitation and treatment of children from the region. Special guest is Krystyna Abramczyk Puzio, multiple Polish and world champion in weightlifting. The event includes various distances from 200 m for children to 5 km for adults, with participant limits and online registration. All proceeds are allocated to charitable causes, and participants receive medals and souvenirs.

name: COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn
description: The COOL-BEACH-TRAIL Schellbronn is a mountain run and trail running event with a distance of 3.14 km. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Bad Wildbad and offers runners a challenging and varied course. It is part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge and attracts trail running enthusiasts who want to combine nature and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Trail run on a 3.14 km long course
Mountain run character with varied terrain
Part of the Sauerland Trailrunning Challenge
additional: The event is part of a series of trail and mountain runs in the region, with results and media coverage available. The course is diverse and offers both sporting challenge and natural experience.

name: 95. Terrainkurweg Marathon
description: The 95th Terrainkurweg Marathon in Salzgitter is a challenging run on a hilly course with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain and loss. The route passes through the Vöppstedter Forest, past the Liebenburg Forest House, and along the Salzgitter golf course. The event is not an official DLV event and is aimed at well-trained runners. Catering is provided in a covered area with drinks and snacks.
course_highlights: 9.1 km long loop through the Vöppstedter Forest
Round course with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain and loss
Course route along the Salzgitter golf course
additional: Catering in a covered area with hot tea, broth, cola, water, spritzers, as well as pretzels, nuts, bananas, cake, and chocolate bars. No liability, participation at own risk. Not an official DLV event. The marathon is part of an event in the Terrainkurweg area taking place in the Salzgitter region. No specific information on registration or participation fees is available.

The race starts at 6:00 PM in Stromovka Park, directly in front of Výstaviště Praha Holešovice, which is easily accessible by tram. The race is designed for teams and is suitable for corporate team building, school events, or other groups seeking a sporting atmosphere and shared fun. After the race, a Team Box with comfortable facilities and catering for participants and their fans is available.

Start and finish in Stromovka Park, Prague
Easy tram access to Výstaviště Holešovice station

The start and finish are at Výstaviště Praha Holešovice.

This race is part of the SABZO series and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy natural terrain and forest atmosphere. It is suitable for everyone who enjoys running in nature and wants to experience a sporting challenge in a peaceful forest setting.

Trail running in Krč Forest
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race is part of the SABZO series, offering various course lengths including 6 km, 3 km, 12 km, and activities for families with children in Krč Forest.

name: LKZ Firmenlauf
description: The LKZ Company Run is organized by MTV Ludwigsburg in cooperation with the Ludwigsburg Kreiszeitung and will take place on June 17, 2026. The 4.5 km course runs around the Ludwig-Jahn Stadium and MTV Ludwigsburg. Over 100 companies send several thousand runners, Nordic walkers, and walkers each year, supported by numerous volunteers. Besides the sporting competition, fun and community spirit are the main focus, celebrated after the race with cool drinks and an after-run party. MTV members can participate free of charge.
course_highlights: 4.5 km course around Ludwig-Jahn Stadium
Start and finish at MTV Ludwigsburg
Strong participation from over 100 companies with several thousand participants

Race distance approximately 4.5 km, registration via email, free participation for MTV members, event on June 17, 2026, including team pavilions and awards for winners.

name: Sommernachtslauf am Hufeisen
description: The Summer Night Run at Hufeisen is a traditional race in the municipality of Linsengericht, organized by the Gelnhausen Running Team for over 20 years. The event is characterized by its family-friendly nature and its great popularity in the Main-Kinzig district. The start and finish area is located at the Hufeisen parking lot, nestled in a forested area between the districts of Geißlitz, Großenhausen, and Lützel. As part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge, the race is a fixed component of the regional running series and offers runners an attractive course in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Hufeisen parking lot in a forested area
Course mainly through the closed forest area of Vorspessart
Beautiful views of the Kinzig and Biebertal valleys
additional: The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge, the largest running series in the region. The event has a family-friendly character and enjoys steady popularity. The course is run respectfully on forest paths to protect nature and wildlife. The race is known for fast times, takes place in the Hufeisen forest area, and features various race categories including children and youth competitions.

description: The Little Monaco Run is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This race is part of the long-standing history of running events organized by the KRB Chrudim club and offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on interesting courses. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all levels who want to experience the atmosphere of a quality sporting event in a pleasant environment.

A traditional running event with a long history in the Pardubice Region
Friendly atmosphere and quality organization by the KRB Chrudim club

description: The Olympic Run is a traditional sporting event organized by the Czech Olympic Committee, taking place as part of Olympic Day on June 17, 2026, in Zlín. This run connects different generations and levels of runners, from children to adults, and promotes Olympic values such as friendship, fair play, and respect. Participants can choose from shorter and longer routes, with the race complemented by sports and educational activities. The registration fee supports children's sports through the Czech Olympic Foundation. The event is open to everyone who wants to experience the joy of movement and support a good cause.
course_highlights: Routes for adults and children of various age groups
Time measurement with chip timing
Start and registration on the meadow near the sports complex Komec, Brno - Komárov
additional: Registrations are only available online until June 5, 2026; on-site registration is not possible. The first 150 adults and 70 children registered by March 31 will receive a free T-shirt (registration with T-shirt and size selection required). The route is not wheelchair or handbike accessible. Facilities include a changing room, storage, and toilets. Time measurement is provided by chip timing. Registration begins on June 19, 2026; the event takes place in Zlín as part of Olympic Day; focused on promoting friendship and Olympic values.

The race offers a classic five-kilometer course on a tartan track for adults and several children's races over shorter distances. The event supports sports participation for children from socially disadvantaged families, with part of the registration fee donated to the Czech Olympic Committee. Registrations are conducted online, and the race starts at 6:00 PM, broadcast live on Czech Radio.

description: The Olympic Run in Čelákovice is a traditional running race with its fifth edition in 2026. The race offers two routes for adults, 5 km and 10 km, which run along flat terrain along the Elbe River with beautiful views and interesting sites such as the railway bridge, St. Wenceslas Chapel, and the courtyard of the Municipal Museum. For children, shorter distances from 200 m to 1500 m are prepared, which also pass through the municipal museum. The start and finish are at the athletic track of the municipal stadium in Čelákovice. Registration is available online until June 5, 2026, and the main race starts at 6:00 PM.

The entire route is flat with minimal elevation gain

If you fill in a nickname by May 7, it will be printed on the start number. The route is flat, registration only online until June 5, 2026, the main race starts at 6:00 PM, with the possibility to try the OCR park, food trucks for refreshments, accompanying program, parking on U Kapličky and Na Nábřeží streets.

name: Olympijský běh - Červená Lhota
location: Červená Lhota, Jindřichův Hradec, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Olympic Run in Červená Lhota is a traditional race that starts at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle. Participants will run along the blue tourist trail through the villages of Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of the Kardaš pond, mainly on field and forest paths. The start is ceremoniously initiated with a shot from a historical firearm, and by participating, you support the Czech Olympic Foundation. The race is open to adults over 15 years old and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere with refreshments provided by volunteer firefighters.
course_highlights: Start at the fairy-tale Červená Lhota Castle
The route follows the blue tourist trail through Samosoly, Pohoří, and the dam of Kardaš pond

additional: The start and finish are at different locations: start at Červená Lhota Castle, finish in Kardašova Řečice at the cider house. Participants are transported by bus from the registration site (Kardašova Řečice cider house) to the start. There are changing rooms, a storage area, and toilets available; showers are not provided. Refreshments are arranged by volunteer firefighters. The race is started with a shot from a historical firearm by the castle steward. Registration is only available online; on-site registration is not possible. The race is for runners over 15 years old; younger participants are not permitted at this location. Age requirement: from 15 years old. No participation for disabled or under 15. Transportation: bus from Kardašova Řečice. Facilities: changing rooms, storage, toilets; no showers. The program includes the start, refreshments, and award ceremony.
