description: The Hradecký Cross is a traditional 10 km trail race held in the forests around Biřička in Hradec Králové. The race offers a unique experience of natural terrain with fewer asphalt sections, suitable for the general public and recreational runners. The event is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia in running and attracts competitors of all levels every year. The course runs through two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain, highlighting the beauty and challenge of the race.
course_highlights: The course runs through forest paths around Biřička
Two 5 km loops in slightly hilly terrain
Suitable for the general public and recreational runners
additional: Forest paths, minimal asphalt sections; registration on-site or online; race takes place on June 21, 2026, start at 10:00 AM; race length 10 km

name: Ivčin kopeček
description: Ivčin kopeček is an uphill race 3.4 km long with an elevation gain of 240 meters, which is part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and the surrounding area. This race offers runners a challenging yet attractive course in the beautiful natural environment of Beroun in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for mountain running and uphill running enthusiasts who want to test their endurance and strength on a short but intense route. The race is open to the general public and welcomes all runners who want to enjoy a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Length of the course 3.4 km with an elevation gain of 240 m
Challenging uphill run in the natural environment of Beroun
Part of the Hill Running Series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Registration is possible at the Na Černém vršku pub in Beroun, early arrival is recommended due to limited parking.

Each child participant in the races will receive a commemorative T-shirt, a medal, and a sweet treat at the finish line. It is one of the largest running events in the region, combining athletic competition with fun for the whole family.

The race will take place on June 21, 2026, at 6:00 PM at the premises of the Local Cultural Institution Kasztelania in Kije, where the start and finish lines will be located. Participants can compete over two distances: 10 km and 5.5 km ("Plus Five"), running or Nordic walking with poles. The event offers a great atmosphere, cash and material prizes, and commemorative medals and starter packs for all participants.

Route allows running and Nordic walking
Start and finish at the premises of the Local Cultural Institution Kasztelania in Kije

The route is in the shape of the letter "T" and consists of two loops of 5 km each, running through the streets of the town, with turnaround points near a chapel and Brzozowa Street. The start and finish are located at the Social High School No. 5 at 41 Herbert Street. The race is organized by enthusiasts from the STO-nogi group, who promote running among residents and visitors.

Street race through Milanówek with turnaround points near a chapel and Brzozowa Street
Start and finish at SLO No. 5, 41 Herbert Street

The event includes a 10 km race through the streets of Milanówek, with online registration and available training plans for preparation. Participants can also take part in accompanying night events.

description: The 10th Ostróda St. George's Half Marathon is a jubilee edition of the half marathon held in Ostróda. The race route runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through the city streets, consisting of two identical loops with a total length of 21.098 km. The race starts and finishes at the Amphitheater at 17a Mickiewicza Street, with hydration points approximately every 4 km. Organizers provide a commemorative medal, a voucher for a recovery meal, and the option to choose a package with or without a T-shirt. The event is charitable, supporting the rehabilitation of girl Maja.
course_highlights: Route runs along the promenade by Lake Drwęckie and through Ostróda streets
Two identical loops totaling 21.098 km
Hydration points approximately every 4 km (4 points per loop)
additional: The participant limit is 400 people, with start and finish at the Amphitheater at 17a Mickiewicza Street. The time limit to complete the route is 3 hours. The race kit includes an individual number, a deposit bag, safety pins, a commemorative medal, and a voucher for a recovery meal. After June 10th, registration is only possible at the race office (June 20-21) with a basic package priced at 180 PLN. The timing chip is rented and must be returned after the race. The participant limit is 170 out of 400 spots. The registration fee includes medals, bags, and a meal voucher. The proceeds support a charity campaign for Maja's rehabilitation. The route is not PZLA certified. Hydration points are every 4 km, with a 3-hour time limit.

name: XI Bieg Terenowy Zgierz Malinka
location: MOSiR Zgierz Malinka, Zgierz, Łódzkie, Poland
description: The 11th Zgierz Malinka Cross Country Run is a trail race held on the forested areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka. The route features varied terrain, including ascents, descents of different lengths and inclines, large sandy patches, and narrow sections through bushes. The cross-country nature of the course attracts runners seeking an escape from asphalt or preparing for mountain races. The event takes place on three distances: 4 km, 8 km, and 12 km, as well as a 4 km Nordic walking march and races for children and youth. Participants receive symbolic medals referencing the raspberry, and the top competitors in the categories of women and men at each distance receive trophies.
course_highlights: The route runs through the forested areas of MOSiR Zgierz Malinka
Varied terrain with ascents, descents, sand, and narrow sections in bushes
Cross-country character of the course, unusual for urban areas
additional: All participants start simultaneously regardless of the distance. There are races for children and youth on distances of 150 m (ages 0-6) and 800 m (ages 7-15). The race village at MOSiR Zgierz Malinka offers numerous attractions, including playgrounds, a pump truck track, beach volleyball courts, mini football and basketball fields, swimming areas, a kayak rental, and a golf shooting range. The event includes various distances, children's races, medals, electronic timing, and sports attractions on site.

The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times, with a kilometer marker each. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas, and both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs can participate. The organizers are the Jerzy Kukuczka University of Physical Education in Katowice and the State Fire Service Katowice.

The limit of participants for the main race is 300 people, ensuring an intimate atmosphere.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 2
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that divides the classic distance of 42.195 km into seven pleasant evening stages, each between 5 and 7 kilometers. The course runs in loops through the beautiful landscape around Osterode in the Harz foreland. The race is open to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers, and also offers an additional kids' stage for younger participants. The event is organized by local clubs and will take place for the 18th time in 2026.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each in loops
Landscape in the Harz foreland around Osterode
Additional kids' stage over 750 meters in Schützenpark

The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshment stations and social activities at the finish area. Registration is mainly via email, and the courses are tailored to each day's stages.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 3
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km stages from island to island. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad and offers a unique running experience with maritime flair, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer. Due to limited capacity on the ferries and infrastructure, the number of participants is limited, ensuring an exclusive and well-organized event.

Approximately 10 km running distance per stage
Landscape with dunes, beaches, and UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer

Stage race across seven islands, no waiting list, limited participant capacity, no transfers of starting places.

description: The EWE North Sea Run on Baltrum is the third stage of a popular race series on the East Frisian Islands. The car-free island of Baltrum offers a peaceful, natural setting with wide sandy beaches and the Wadden Sea, making it ideal for runners seeking nature and relaxation. The start and finish are located at the village square in front of the town hall, and the event is well suited for families, hikers, and anyone looking to escape everyday stress. The award ceremony takes place on the same day at the village square.

Run through the car-free, natural island of Baltrum with wide sandy beaches
Charming village atmosphere and Wadden Sea environment

Toilets at several locations near the harbor, town hall, Spa House, SindBad, multi-purpose hall, and sanitary building Ost. Award ceremony at 14:00 at the village square in front of the town hall. The award ceremony takes place at 14:00. The event is part of the larger North Sea Run event, which takes place from June 20 to 27, 2026, on multiple islands.

name: Sommerlauf Baierbrunn
description: The Summer Run Baierbrunn is a traditional race that has been held annually since 2015 and brings together the entire community of Baierbrunn. The event is open to professional and amateur runners of all ages and offers various courses through the surrounding forests with diverse terrain. After races for different age groups and distances, a summer festival for all participants and friends of SC Baierbrunn takes place. The course is marked and cordoned off, with refreshment stations along the way.
course_highlights: Beautiful course through surrounding forests
Course with inclines and declines, not suitable for personal bests
Refreshment stations along the route

Timing is done with Datasport race number transponders. Showers are available in the changing rooms of the SCB clubhouse near the sports and community center. The course is limited to a maximum of 80 participants per race. Awards ceremony approximately 30 minutes after the last finisher. Baierbrunn S-Bahn station is nearby. Following the race, there is a summer festival of SC Baierbrunn. Races for various age groups, including children’s, school, youth, hobby, main race, and Nordic walking; registration is recommended; the event concludes with a summer festival.

name: Kros Sázava
description: Cross Sázava is a running race in Pikovice, Central Bohemia, offering three routes of different lengths and elevation gains. The longer route measures 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m, the medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m, and the hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m. All routes are exclusively through nature, ensuring beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in a picturesque environment.
course_highlights: Longer route 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 m
Medium route 10 km with an elevation gain of approximately 230 m
Hobby route 5 km with an elevation gain of 120 m
additional: routes 15.5 km, 10 km, 5 km; scenic trail along Sázava River and forest paths; scenic and technical sections

Three distances are offered: the Mini Marathon of approximately 4.2 km, the Mini Half Marathon of approximately 2.1 km, and the Bambini Run of approximately 333 meters. All races start and finish at the stadium, with the longer routes passing through the beautiful Günther Klotz Anlage. The event is designed inclusively and offers all children a medal and a personalized online certificate. Timing is done via a chip in the start number.

Mini Marathon and Mini Half Marathon pass through the Günther Klotz Anlage
Inclusive event with accompaniment allowed for children with disabilities

Distances: approximately 4.2 km, 2.1 km, 333 m; registration on the event day; inclusion for children with disabilities; start at Carl-Kaufmann Stadium.

The race offers various categories for all age groups from young children to adults, including the Prague Championship in cross-country running. The course mainly runs on grass and occasionally on gravel, ensuring an interesting and challenging terrain. The race is complemented by refreshments and easy access by public transport and car. Start numbers and chips are issued on-site on the day of the race.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 4
location: Schwiegershausen, Osterode am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Osterode Stage Marathon is a unique marathon that takes place over seven pleasant evening stages, each 5 to 7 kilometers long, around Osterode am Harz. The fourth stage leads through the beautiful Beber Nature Reserve in Schwiegershausen, featuring varied paths made of gravel, concrete, and grass surfaces. Start and finish are at the Schwiegershausen sports hall, and the route offers a great view of the Harz mountains as well as a mix of gentle and steep sections. The race is open to all who are physically capable of running about 7 kilometers at a time and promotes the community of regional clubs.
course_highlights: Beber Nature Reserve with varied paths

Multi-stage marathon event, scenic route through Beber, start and finish in Schwiegershausen.

The event is limited to 22 participants and is open to runners aged 18 and above. Timing is done manually with a stopwatch, and a voluntary donation for environmental or social projects is requested.

Self-sufficient with refreshments at your own car after each lap

Course: 7 laps of 6.10 km each; self-sufficient with refreshments; no showers/changing rooms on site; participation from 18 years; registration by the day before at 6 pm; maximum 22 participants.

The event is known for its family-friendly vibe and an attractive route through the pedestrian zone.

description: The 1st AOK Corporate Run Renningen will take place on June 24, 2026, in Renningen and offers a great team event for colleagues. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each. The run is part of the BW-Running-Corporate Run series and emphasizes inclusion as well as shared experience and celebration. After the run, there will be free finish line refreshments and an award ceremony with musical accompaniment.
course_highlights: Course length approx. 4.6 km, consisting of two laps of 2.3 km each
Group warm-up program shortly before the start
Free finish line refreshments with Erdinger Alkoholfrei, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: From 5:00 PM, a DJ will provide entertainment on stage. After the run, there will be an award ceremony and musical entertainment. Registrations are possible by email until one day before the event, on the day of the event only on-site for a fee. The minimum age for participation is 16 years. Open to all, including an inclusion run, online registration until June 15, 2026, participant limit of 1200 people.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (7) – červnový
location: U Kempinku, Praha 4-Braník, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Come run on a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník, where personal records are often broken! The race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA, which takes place every month. The course is measured by a certified measurer, and it is possible to run the limit for the Czech Championships (MČR) on the 10 km. After the race, you can evaluate your performance and recharge energy at the restaurant in the Hamr Braník complex. We reward the best runners and loyal participants.
course_highlights: Fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured by a certified measurer
Opportunity to run the limit for the Czech Championships (MČR) on 10 km
additional: Registration from 18:00 at the blue tent by the cycle path U Kempinku 2, Prague. Start of 10 km at 19:00, start of 5 km at 19:05. After the race, electrolyte drink, and the possibility of refreshments (food and beer) at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage in the organizer’s tent. Toilets available at the Hamr Braník complex (300 m from the start). Cancellation possible until 23.06.2026 19:00 with a refund of the entry fee. Recommended parking P+R at Nádraží Braník or in surrounding streets. The course is measured by a certified measurer, online registration or on-site registration available, race chip timing, refreshments on site, parking at Nádraží Braník, cancellation possible up to 24 hours before the race.

name: 18. Osteroder Etappenmarathon - Etappe 5
location: Dorste, Osterode am Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: TG LaPeKa, MTV Osterode, MTV Förste, TSV Schwiegershausen, TSC Dorste, MTV Freiheit, SFC Harz-Weser
description: The 18th Osterode Stage Marathon divides the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km into seven pleasant evening stages of 5 to 7 kilometers each. The runs take place on circular routes through the beautiful landscape around Osterode in the Harz foreland. The event starts on Sunday, June 21, 2026, in Förste, with a new stage each day until Saturday, June 27, 2026. In addition to runners, walkers and Nordic walkers are also warmly invited. There is also a kids' stage over 750 meters on June 27 in the Schützenpark.
course_highlights: Seven stages of 5 to 7 km each on circular routes
Landscape in the Harz foreland around Osterode
Kids' stage over 750 m in Schützenpark
additional: Start times of the stages: Sunday 21.06.2026 at 10:45 AM, Monday to Friday at 6:45 PM, Saturday 27.06.2026 at 4:00 PM. Award ceremony on Saturday at 6:00 PM with a raffle of prizes. Participation is possible for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. No club membership required. Minors need written parental consent. 7 stages, 5-7 km per stage, medical service, free drinks, commemorative gift, marathon certificate, no club membership required.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 5
price_range: 32,00 € – 37,00 € für Shirts, 10,00 € – 15,00 € für Tücher und Flaschen
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 km per stage on the islands of Borkum, Juist, Norderney, Baltrum, Langeoog, Spiekeroog, and Wangerooge. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad and offers a unique running experience with maritime flair and natural scenery. Due to limited capacity, the race is very popular and already fully booked early.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands
Approximately 10 km running distance per stage
Running through dune landscapes and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wattenmeer
additional: Race bibs are issued approximately 1 hour after arrival of the special ferry on the island until 30 minutes before the start. The bib with integrated chip for timing is used for all stages. The start and finish of the first stage (Borkum) are located on the promenade. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on the islands. There is no waiting list, backup list, or transfer of starting places. Functional shirts, headbands, and other merchandise items can be purchased additionally. Stages on seven North Sea islands, no waiting list, limited participant capacity due to infrastructure, race in June 2026, including island walks and community experience.

name: Bremer Firmenlauf zur Spätschicht
description: The Bremen Company Run for the Spätschicht is a communal running event covering approximately 5 km around the Weserwehr in Bremen, emphasizing team spirit and camaraderie. The event is aimed at companies, friend groups, and running communities who wish to run or walk together without competitive pressure. New in 2026, there will be an official timing for all participants who want to measure their athletic ambition. After the run, a lively after-run festival with music, food, and drinks provides a relaxed conclusion to the evening.
course_highlights: Loop course of about 5 km through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee, and Yachthafen
Start and finish area behind Paulaner’s in Wehrschloss
At least one refreshment point along the route and catering at the finish
additional: Teams must consist of at least 5 people. Official timing is new in 2026 and optional. Late registration is possible on the day of the event online, but only via direct debit. Bib numbers must be worn visibly on the chest; bib bands are not allowed. Showers and changing facilities are available on site. The course is a loop that is run once. The route passes through Pauliner Marsch, Werdersee, and Yachthafen. Registration is online, participation is possible from 5 people, including refreshments on the route and music at the festival. The event is open to everyone, regardless of performance level.

name: DAK FIRMENLAUF Nordhessen 2026
description: The DAK Corporate Run North Hesse has been organized since 2011 by FTSV Heckershausen 1890 e.V. and is under the motto "Running together - for your health. A lifetime.". The run promotes health and fun in movement and is aimed at teams and individual participants. The course is approximately 5.3 km long and mainly runs over unpaved paths with a short asphalt section. The event takes place on June 25, 2026, at 6:30 PM and offers refreshing beverages and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5.3 km long
Mostly unpaved paths, about 1 km asphalt
Refreshment stations approximately every 2 km and at the finish area
additional: Race documents can be collected in teams on the day of the event at the Stahlbergbaude sports clubhouse. Changing facilities and showers are available at the Rasenallee sports hall next to the event grounds. Public transportation: RegioTram 4, Heckershausen stop, about 500 meters walking distance to the sports facility. Parking is available at the Rasenallee sports center or in the streets of the Heckershausen district. Please observe the traffic regulations. Event date: 25.06.2026, course and registration details on the website, results will be published online.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Langeoog (5. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. It takes place in 2026 from June 20 to June 27 and attracts running and walking enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad. The 5th stage leads to the car-free island of Langeoog, which impresses with its 14 km long sandy beach, dunes, tides, and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park. Start and finish are centrally located at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße, and the event offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and nature experience.
course_highlights: Car-free North Sea island Langeoog with 14 km sandy beach
Run through dunes, tides, and salt marshes in the Wadden Sea National Park
Start and finish at the corner of Barkhausenstraße/Gartenstraße/Kurstraße
additional: Race number pickup from 11:30 am to 1:30 pm at the House of the Island. Sports bag storage from 1:00 pm to 4:00 pm at the House of the Island. Changing rooms and showers in the swimming pool, toilets at the House of the Island. Award ceremony at 4:30 pm at the start/finish area on Barkhausenstraße. Race bib with integrated chip for timing will be issued and is valid for all stages. Stage race across seven islands, registration only in advance, limited participant capacity due to ferry capacities, merchandise available.

name: Firmenlauf Bremerhaven
description: The 9th Bremerhaven Company Run will take place on Thursday, June 25, 2026, and is aimed at employees and trainees from companies, authorities, and other organizations. Participants run a 6 km loop starting from the North Sea Stadium through Speckenbüttler Park. With a participant limit of 500 people, the run offers a great opportunity for teams to compete athletically and have fun together. There is a free start discount for groups with at least 10 registered participants until the end of May. The event is well established and enjoys great popularity in the region.
course_highlights: 6 km loop from North Sea Stadium through Speckenbüttler Park
Run for employees and trainees from companies and authorities
Limited parking, alternative options recommended
additional: Participant limit of 500 people. For every 10 registered participants in a group, there is a free start discount on the entry fee until the end of May. Limited parking at North Sea Stadium, use of alternatives recommended. Registration possible.

name: Běh Vídrholcem
description: The Vidrholcem Run is a popular running race held in Prague 9-Klánovice. This race is part of the local running calendar and attracts runners of all levels who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a picturesque setting. The event is organized under the auspices of the Czech Running and the Czech Athletic Federation, and offers not only competition but also the joy of movement in nature.
course_highlights: Picturesque course in the natural environment of Prague 9-Klánovice
Organized by Czech Running and the Czech Athletic Federation
Open to runners of all levels
additional: The race is held regularly and offers various course lengths, including approximately 3.5 km routes, with results and statistics available on the website.

name: Osnabrücker Mittsommernachtslauf
location: Sportplatz RW Sutthausen, Osnabrück, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The charity Midsummer Night Run in Osnabrück-Sutthausen will take place on June 26, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM and offers a relaxed running event for all age groups in support of the non-profit organization Zusammen-Bewegen e.V. The course runs from the RW Sutthausen sports field into the Hörner Bruch forest area, where one lap is approximately 3 kilometers long. There are various race distances from 500 meters for children to 10 km for adults, with participation without individual timing. After the run, participants can enjoy the evening with food and drinks.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the RW Sutthausen sports field
Run through the Hörner Bruch forest area with approximately 3 km per lap
Refreshment station along the route
additional: Start of the children's run at 7:00 PM (500 m), start of running, walking, Nordic walking, and strolling at 7:30 PM. Participation without individual timing, clock at the start-finish area. Showers and changing facilities available. Due to limited parking, it is recommended to arrive on foot, by bike, or carpool. Refreshment station along the route. Cozy conclusion with food and drinks after the run. Forest course, online registration, no individual timing, refreshment station, showers and changing rooms available.

name: Mittsommernachtslauf Hannover
location: Vereinsheim des HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Midsummer Night Run Hannover is an urban running event held on the longest day of the year along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover. Various distances are offered: 7.7 km individual run, 21.1 km individual run, and a 23.1 km relay with three participants. The event is part of the Laufpass of the Hannover region and offers a special atmosphere with start and finish at the club house of HRC Hannover. There are two refreshment points on the course providing water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels, and timing is done with rental chips. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 5:00 PM.
course_highlights: Course along the idyllic Leine floodplains in Hannover
Two refreshment points with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels
Start and finish at the club house of HRC Hannover
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 5:00 PM. Timing is done with rental chips worn on the foot and returned at the finish. Showers and changing rooms are available to a limited extent at the Angaria club house nearby and at the Center for University Sports (100 meters on foot). Bags can be deposited in front of the tent opposite the club house before the start. Access by city train to Königsworther Platz, about 500 meters on foot; parking is available at the Center for University Sports. Distances: 7.7 km, 21.1 km, relay 23.1 km; start and finish at the club house of HRC Hannover, Weddigenufer 23; online registration until 25.06.2026, late registration on-site possible.

name: Altstadtfestlauf in Lauf
location: Lauf an der Pegnitz, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 10 km Hauptlauf: € 20,- bei online Anmeldung bis 24.06.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5 km/5 km Nordic Walking: € 15,- bei online Anmeldung bis 24.06.2026

description: The Old Town Festival Run in Lauf an der Pegnitz takes place annually on Friday evening to open the Old Town Festival on the last weekend of June. It is considered the world's largest class reunion and offers runners a special experience with a backdrop unique to this event, such as the pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge. There is a 10 km main race with a turnaround point at the Lebenshilfe in Schönberg, as well as a 5 km run including Nordic Walking with a turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße. The event combines athletic competition with a social occasion and also supports social projects.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with turnaround point at the Lebenshilfe in Schönberg
5 km run and Nordic Walking with turnaround point on Ottensooser Straße
Pack of runners on the Lauf Water Bridge as a unique backdrop
additional: Race packets and late registrations are possible on race day from 14:00 to 17:00 in the finish area (Nürnberger Tor, Friedensplatz 1, 91207 Lauf). An additional fee of €3 applies for late registrations, payable in cash. If registered by June 19, 2026, participants receive a personalized bib with their name. €1 of the registration fee is donated to Lebenshilfe im Nürnberger Land. The race takes place annually on the last weekend of June, with start times at 18:00 for the 10 km race and at 18:05 for Nordic Walking. The course is scenic and promotes community spirit as well as charitable causes.

name: Bergdorfmeile
description: The Bergdorfmeile is a traditional race over a historic course of 8.88889 km in Karlsruhe-Hohenwettersbach, taking place on Friday, June 26, 2026. The route is more challenging than a flat city course due to approximately 140 meters of elevation, but designed so that recreational runners can also participate comfortably. The race starts at 7:00 PM on Lindenstraße and ends at the sports field of SV Hohenwettersbach. In addition to the main race, there is a youth run of about 2 km for children and teenagers. Each participant receives a high-quality functional shirt, and there is chip timing with a start number.
course_highlights: Historic course of 8.88889 km with approximately 140 meters of elevation
Start in Lindenstraße, finish at the sports field of SV Hohenwettersbach
Refreshment stations at kilometer 5 and at the finish
additional: Race number and functional shirt distribution on June 26, 2026, from 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM at the schoolyard, Kirchplatz, directly at the start. Late registrations are possible on the event day within the participant limit. Luggage storage from 5:00 PM at the start, pickup until 9:00 PM at the finish. Showers are available at SV Hohenwettersbach. Chip timing with a start number to be worn on the chest. Cut-off time is 8:15 PM; participants who reach the parking lot at Lambrechtshof (approx. km 3.8) later than 7:34 PM will be disqualified. The event is limited to about 1,000 participants, with chip timing and an online results list. The course is challenging with about 140 meters of elevation difference.

name: Bietigheimer Fackellauf
description: The Bietigheim Torch Run is a special running experience that takes place annually in Bietigheim-Bissingen. The 10 km race runs over three laps on a flat, paved field path between Bietigheim and Ingersheim, illuminated by torches. Start and finish are at the parking lot of the Olymp company, where a unique atmosphere with music, food, and drinks awaits participants. The race begins on June 26, 2026, at 10 PM and offers a atmospheric night event for all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10 km race over three laps
Paved, flat field path between Bietigheim and Ingersheim
Course illuminated by torches
additional: Race bibs are issued exclusively at the stand in the start/finish area. No Nordic walking poles or other items are allowed on the race route. Registration is only possible online. The registration deadline is June 26, 2026, at 12 PM. Torch-lit course, nighttime event, music, food, and drinks at start/finish area.

name: Burg-Lauf Eppstein
description: The Eppstein Castle Run is a traditional race classic in the Taunus region, taking place annually since 1986 and attracting up to 500 runners as well as numerous spectators. The varied course of 7.777 km runs through forest, the historic old town, and twice around the medieval castle before ascending the Schmerzberg to the finish at the sports field of TSG Eppstein. The event offers not only a sporting competition but also a social program with a cake stand, the Castle Run glass, and refreshments. The race is suitable for both ambitious runners and running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the special atmosphere and the challenge of the 'Old German Mile.'
course_highlights: 7.777 km long course, adapted to topographical conditions
Route through forest, old town, and twice around the medieval castle
Finish ascent at Schmerzberg back to the sports field of TSG Eppstein
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 5:00 PM until half an hour before the start at the sports field 'Am Bienroth'. Chip timing is used. Prizes and material awards are given to the fastest participants, as well as medals for school relay teams. Important notes regarding travel due to partial closure of B455 should be observed. The Eppstein train station is easily accessible via S2, about a 15-minute walk from the station to the start. The race takes place on varied, topographically adapted terrain. Registration is possible online and on the day of the event. Awards, medals, and prizes are available for the winners.

name: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Gedächtnislauf 2026
location: Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadion, Schwalmtal, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Dr. Ernst van Aaken Memorial Run takes place at the Dr. Ernst van Aaken Stadium in Schwalmtal and offers a diverse running program on late June evening. The OSC Waldniel organizes ten races with over 1,000 participants from various age and performance categories, from youth to seniors. The event combines track and road races, including a 5-kilometer road run and the 5000-meter "Run of the Aces" for more experienced runners. Participation is possible individually, as a team, or in the elite field, welcoming both beginners and seasoned athletes. The run honors Ernst van Aaken, founder of OSC and supporter of the women's marathon.
course_highlights: Combination of track and road races
5-kilometer road run and 5000-meter Run of the Aces
Diverse age and performance categories up to M75/W75
additional: The event takes place late in the evening in June. Ten races are offered, with over 1,000 runners participating. The event honors the founder of OSC and supporter of the women's marathon, Ernst van Aaken. Typical weather in June is sunny with temperatures around 23 °C. Various race distances, team competitions, online registration, and parking information should be noted.

name: Lippe-Sommer-Serie 2025 Lauf 3: Sommerlauf um den SchiederSee
description: The summer run around Lake Schieder is part of the Lippe Summer Series 2025 and takes place on June 26, 2026, in Schieder-Schwalenberg. The event offers two distances, 1 km and 8.3 km, and is suitable for runners of all performance levels. The course leads scenic around Lake Schieder and promises pleasant summer weather with an average of 23°C and mostly sunny days. Results can be considered in official athletics best lists.
course_highlights: Scenic course around Lake Schieder
Two distances: 1 km and 8.3 km
Pleasant summer weather with an average of 23°C
additional: The event recommends verifying details with the organizer before registration. Results can be included in official athletics best lists. Weather in June is typically sunny with temperatures around 23°C, creating ideal conditions for a summer run. The event is part of the annual Lippe Summer Series, known for its friendly atmosphere in the region.

name: Oberhausener Kleeblatt-Lauf
description: The 1st Oberhausen Cloverleaf Run on June 26, 2026, is a new running event that invites runners of all ages to the Niederrhein Stadium. Organized by the Rot-Weiß Oberhausen Endurance Team with support from the Oberhausen Sports Association, the race aims to bring together people from across the city — from beginners to ambitious athletes. The course mostly runs on a lit and kilometer-marked running trail along the Rhine-Herne Canal and offers an attractive running opportunity that can be used year-round. After the race, the leisure area of the Sports Association invites participants to relax, socialize, and celebrate together.
course_highlights: 7.8-kilometer loop course along the Rhine-Herne Canal
Illuminated and kilometer-marked running trail, usable year-round
Starting point at Slinky Springs to Fame with route leading to Waghalsbrücke
additional: The event is open to all performance levels and aims to become a regular fixture in Oberhausen's sports calendar. After the race, there will be an accompanying program with food and drinks at the leisure area of the Sports Association to promote community and exchange. Run on an illuminated course along the Rhine-Herne Canal, various race distances for all age groups, registration until June 21, 2026.

name: Retzbachlauf Gaimersheim
price_range: Erwachsene: 14 EUR, Schüler/Jugendliche: 5 EUR, Bambini: frei
description: The Retzbachlauf in Gaimersheim is a traditional race event taking place on June 26, 2026, in the Retzbachpark. The event includes various age categories from children to youth, as well as a fun run and main race. The course is a flat loop, mostly on gravel paths, and counts towards the Sport IN Laufcup standings. Races start from late afternoon, and results are published promptly after the races. The event is family-friendly and offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat loop course
Mostly on gravel paths
Start and finish in Retzbachpark Gaimersheim
additional: Start times for the races are staggered from 17:10 (Children U7/U8) to 19:00 (Youth U18/U20, Fun Run, Main Race). Distribution of race bibs begins at 16:00 at the start/finish area. Arrival by bus and train is possible, with stops nearby. Parking is available but not on the parking lot of the adjacent Edeka market. Results are published on-site as quickly as possible after the races. The event takes place on public roads, registration on-site is possible until 30 minutes before the start. Arrival by bus or train is recommended, with parking at EDEKA, sports hall, and other locations.

name: Weezer Sommerabendlauf
description: The Weezer Summer Evening Run is a popular running event that has been held annually since 2019 in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park in Weeze. After cancellations due to the pandemic in 2020 and 2021, the race is now attracting large numbers of participants again, with over 380 finishers in 2025. The event offers various race distances, including children and youth runs, and starts on June 26, 2026, at 5:00 PM. Timing is done with a bib chip, and attractive prizes are awarded to clubs with the most finishers.
course_highlights: Weeze local circuit over the new Niers Bridge and through the zoo
Children's run approx. 300 m with loop from Bahnstraße
Start and finish in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park
additional: Registration deadline is June 24, 2026, at midnight. Online registration is available via raceresult with SEPA direct debit. Late registrations are possible in cash or by card on site. Bibs with chips must be returned on race day; the chip deposit of €3 will be refunded. There are no changing rooms or showers; toilets are available at the community center. Eight tickets for the 1Live San Hejmo Festival will be awarded to the club with the most adult finishers (excluding TSV Weeze). Race in Vittinghoff-Schell-Park, online registration possible, late registrations on site until 45 minutes before start, start times between 6:00 PM and 7:30 PM.

name: Wiesengrundlauf
description: The Wiesengrund Run in Haselbachtal is a regional running event held annually on the Friday evening after the summer solstice. The municipality of Haselbachtal invites runners of all ages to participate in distances ranging from 600 meters to 11.6 kilometers. The event is part of the Saxony Energy Runner Cup and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with awards for winners and age groups. The start and finish are located at the Wiesengrund sports field in Bischheim. The premiere in 2025 was a great success with numerous participants and a diverse accompanying program.
course_highlights: Distances from 600 m to 11.6 km
Start and finish at the Wiesengrund sports field in Bischheim
Participation in the Saxony Energy Runner Cup
additional: Start and finish at the Wiesengrund sports field in Bischheim, Jahnstraße 13. Accommodation options for athletes are available at the parking area for caravans and motorhomes by prior reservation at 03578/3094117 or via email. Strava segments for long, short, and children’s routes are available. Distances between 600 m and 11.6 km, registration via Baer-Service, start and finish at the Wiesengrund sports field in Bischheim, parking spaces available for overnight stays.

name: Filsum Löppt
description: Filsum Löppt is a traditional community race held annually on the last Friday of June as part of the sports days of SV Blau-Weiß Filsum e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from children to experienced runners, on varied paved side roads and footpaths around Filsum. The start and finish of all races are located at the sports field, which also provides changing rooms and showers. The course is well marked and secured by numerous course marshals, with refreshment stations along the main routes. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization with electronic timing.
course_highlights: Running courses on paved side roads and footpaths in beautiful Filsum
Kilometer markings and multiple refreshment stations along the route
Start and finish at the sports field with changing rooms and shower facilities
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day from 5:00 PM until 30 minutes before the respective start with a late registration fee of €4 (for the 400 m kids' loop €1). Electronic timing is done with transponders on the back of the bib number (except for the 400 m kids' loop). Bib numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. The participant limit for main races (5.2 km, 5.2 km walking, 10.3 km) is 500 runners/walkers. Start and finish are at the sports field with changing rooms and showers. Children's races take place on grass and secured routes. Courses: 400m kids' loop, 2 km school run, 5.2 km run & walk, 10.3 km run; participant limit 500; registration opens on 02.04.2026; on-site catering.

name: Osterrönfelder Moorlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kinderlauf (1,17 Km auf maximal 50 Teilnehmer/Innen begrenzt)

description: The Osterrönfelder Moorlauf takes place on June 26, 2026, in Osterrönfeld and offers runners of all ages a varied running experience. The event includes a children's run over 1.17 kilometers, a fun run over 5 kilometers, and the Moorlauf over 10 kilometers. The course starts at the sports field on Aukamp Street and leads through the scenic moorland. Timing is done with transponders, and participants receive certificates, medals, and trophies. The event is family-friendly and offers showers and parking on site.
course_highlights: Start at the sports field in Aukamp Street
Run through the moorland
Three distances: 1.17 km children's run, 5 km fun run, 10 km Moorlauf
additional: Race packets will be distributed on the day of the event from 4:00 PM at the sports hall Fehmarnstraße 2. Timing is with transponders that must be worn on the ankle and returned after the race (40 euro fee for loss). Showers and parking are available at the sports hall. For the 5- and 10-kilometer runs, a voucher for a grilled sausage is included in the registration fee. Late registrations on the event day are possible for a fee of 2 euros, subject to availability of start numbers. Terrain: Moorlauf, registration at the sports hall, timing with transponders, certificates and medals, parking behind the sports hall.

name: Excalibur Race MOON Zámek Duchcov
location: Duchcov Castle, Duchcov, Ústí nad Labem Region, Czech Republic
description: Excalibur Race MOON Castle Duchcov is an obstacle race held from June 26 to 28, 2026, in the historic surroundings of Duchcov Castle and its vicinity. Participants will follow in the footsteps of the legendary Giacomo Casanova and will face a fast course with beautiful views of the Ore Mountains, the Central Bohemian Uplands, and the Bílina Mine. The race features modern and certified obstacles on professional aluminum structures, emphasizing safety and quality. The atmosphere is complemented by a knightly theme, connecting physical challenge with values of honor, loyalty, and cooperation. A rich program and facilities including refreshments and service are prepared for both competitors and fans.
course_highlights: The course runs along the castle staircase and adjacent meadows with views of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands
Modern obstacles on aluminum structures with TÜV certification and regular inspections
Atmosphere inspired by the legend of Giacomo Casanova and knightly stories
additional: Start package, electronic timing chip, online results, photos and videos from the race, fresh fruit and refreshing drinks on the course and at the finish line, rescue and event services, facilities for competitors and their families at the race center, fan zones and entertainment activities for children and adults, the opportunity to watch the race from attractive locations. The race takes place at Duchcov Castle, offering various routes from 6 to 12 km with obstacles and scenic surroundings. Registration and details about prices are available on the official website.

name: Mistrovství světa veteránů v běhu do vrchu - nahoru
location: Janské Lázně, Trutnov, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The 2026 World Veterans Mountain Running Championship in Janské Lázně is a prestigious international veterans' mountain running race attracting athletes from over 30 countries. The races take place on challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing runners' endurance and strength. Organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and the race offers several course variants with different lengths and elevation gains.

Registration requires agreement with WMRA rules and anti-doping regulations. The organizers are TJ Maratonstav Úpice, WMRA, ČAS, and ČABDV under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. The event takes place in Janské Lázně on June 28, 2026, with the possibility for veterans' categories to participate. The race focuses on mountain running with demanding ascents and beautiful Krkonoše nature.

The event is part of a series of races organized since 2014 by a group of enthusiasts who emphasize the aesthetics of the routes and the popularization of running. After the race, participants will receive unique medals, different from those in the spring edition, encouraging collection. Picturesque and aesthetic routes
Night edition with unique medals

name: GDYNIA ULTRA WAY
description: Gdynia Ultra Way is a mountain race by the sea scheduled for June 26-27, 2026, in Gdynia and the surrounding Kashubia region. Participants can choose from five distances, ranging from 14 km to 160 km, with varied elevation gains and scenic routes. The start and finish are in different locations, and the organizer provides transportation to the start of the longest distance. It is a unique opportunity to challenge oneself with a demanding course and enjoy the beauty of the seaside nature.

100 km distance with +/- 2267 m elevation, start in Gdynia at 21:00
Routes run through Kashubia and seaside areas with control points and time limits

The event features both summer and winter editions, with routes passing through various towns in the region, providing unforgettable experiences for runners of all levels.

The race route is demanding and full of emotions, giving participants the opportunity to test their strength over a distance of 100 km. In 2026, organizers are introducing a new feature - the Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km, as well as the Night Mountain Marathon over 42 km. The event attracts runners from all over the country, offering rich start packages and numerous attractions, including personalized medals and aid stations along the route.
course_highlights: Demanding route in mountain conditions
Night ultramarathon over 100 km
New: Sudecki Morning Half Marathon over 21 km

Demanding mountain route, medal personalization options, availability of nutrition and accessories, accommodation from Friday to Sunday, route mostly marked.

name: Australijska Dyszka w Pszczelniku
description: Australian 10K in Pszczelnik is a 10 km race that will take place on June 26, 2026, in Siemianowice Śląskie, at the Pszczelnik Park area. The course consists of four loops, with all participants starting together. After each loop, the 20 slowest runners, who took the longest time to complete it, are eliminated and receive a so-called "almost medal" at the finish. The final loop is run by the top competitors fighting for victory. The race is open to individuals over 16 years of age.
course_highlights: 10 km course consisting of four loops
Start and finish at MOSiR "Pszczelnik" facility in Pszczelnik Park
Elimination system removing the 20 last runners after each loop
additional: Participants start together, and after each loop, the 20 last runners are eliminated regardless of gender, receiving an "almost medal". Entry fees can be paid via the DOTPAY system after filling out the registration form. Park area, online registration, participant limit, fee deadline June 5, 2026.

name: Biegaj z Duchami
description: Run with ghosts is a unique night cross-country race taking place on June 26, 2026, in Leśniów. Participants will face two routes of 15 km and 9 km, full of dark corners and surprises that create an atmosphere full of thrill. The race encourages dressing up as apparitions, ghosts, and other spooky characters, adding magic and atmosphere to the event. It is not only a competition but also a test of endurance and courage in the dark, where participants confront their own weaknesses and mysterious figures along the route.
course_highlights: Night run in the glow of flashlights through mysterious paths of ExtremeJura
Two routes: 15 km for advanced runners and 9 km, also suitable for Nordic walking
Dark corners and numerous surprises on the route
additional: Race office open on June 26, 2026, from 20:00 to 21:30. Participants are encouraged to dress up as apparitions, ghosts, vampires, or other spooky characters to enhance the mystical atmosphere of the run. Routes of 9 km and 15 km, night start, costumes as ghosts, Jura terrain, flashlight required, registration on the website and by phone.

name: 6. Hofer Backyard Ultra
description: The Hof Backyard Ultra is a unique ultramarathon event taking place on June 27, 2026, in Hof (Bavaria). The race starts at 9:00 AM and is by definition "open-ended," meaning it only ends when only one runner remains or all have dropped out. The course consists of a 6.706-kilometer loop with approximately 80 meters of elevation gain, running through forest and woodland paths as well as asphalt. The event attracts participants from all over Germany and beyond, offering a special challenge for runners who want to test and push their limits.
course_highlights: 6.706-kilometer loop with approx. 80 meters of elevation gain
Course runs on forest and woodland paths as well as asphalt
Marked with Hof Backyard Ultra arrows
additional: Maximum of 100 starting spots. Check-in on June 26, 2026, from 7:30 AM at Hof Airport. 200 free parking spaces approximately 100 meters from the start/finish area. From round 13 onwards, a headlamp is required at night. Timing can continue beyond 24 hours, as the race is open-ended. The course includes paved paths, gravel and forest trails, and the runway at Hof Airport. Registration is online. Accommodation recommendations available. Maximum of 100 participants. Race duration until the last runner finishes.

name: Besenbinder Lauf - Rund um Hainrode
description: The 1st Besenbinder Run - Around Hainrode is a running event in the South Harz, organized by ASV 1902 Sangerhausen. The event takes place on June 27, 2026, in Hainrode and offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to participate in a sporting competition. The course runs around Hainrode and promises a varied running environment in nature. The event is open to children, adolescents, active participants, and masters.

Event in a natural environment
Suitable for different age and performance classes
additional: Registration is possible until June 24, 2026; the venue is Hainröder Hauptstraße 60A, Hainrode; no specific terrain information available.

name: Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon
description: The Remmers-Hasetal-Marathon in Löningen is an established running event in northern Germany, taking place on June 27, 2026, for the 24th time. The flat, scenic course runs on a loop through the Hasetal valley, half of which is on the Hasetal cycling trail, and is measured and eligible for best lists by the DLV. In addition to the marathon, half marathon, relay marathon, corporate relay, Nordic walking, walking, and student races are offered. The event is known for its great atmosphere, support from spectators and volunteers, and the subsequent Marathon Night with a live band on the marketplace.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Hasetal with beautiful scenery
Loop course with 2 laps for the marathon, half on the Hasetal cycling trail
Start and finish at Löningen marketplace with subsequent Marathon Night party
additional: Start and finish at Löningen marketplace with info and sales stands as well as an event stage. The course passes through the Werwer Fuhren forest area and diverse Geest landscapes. Catering is organized by the altar boys of St. Vitus Löningen. The event is certified as a 'Three-Star Race'. It also includes a charity campaign 'Running to Help in Löningen', a marathon brochure, and usually takes place in June.

name: EWE-Nordseelauf 2026 - Spiekeroog (7. Etappe)
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian North Sea islands, attracting running enthusiasts from Germany and other countries for over two decades. The 7th stage takes place on June 27, 2026, on the car-free island of Spiekeroog, which impresses with pristine nature, endless beaches, and a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish of the stage are located on Gartenweg near the spa park. The event offers a unique running experience in a special island landscape, combining athletic challenge with natural enjoyment.

Start and finish on Gartenweg near the spa park
Relaxed atmosphere with endless beaches and island charm

Stage race across 7 North Sea islands, no waiting list, limited capacity due to ferry and infrastructure, registration already fully booked.

name: Fischerhuder Sommerlauf
description: The Fischerhude Summer Run, organized by the Sports Friends Fischerhude e.V., will take place on June 27, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM. The event provides a family-friendly atmosphere with free hot and cold drinks at the finish area as well as changing and shower facilities after the run. Entertainment is provided by a DJ, and after the races, an after-run party with barbecue, cocktails, and drinks will take place.

Relay over 2x5 km for teams

name: Südeichsfeldlauf

course_highlights: Half marathon 21.1 km with 445 meters of elevation
Large run 11.3 km with 210 meters of elevation
Small run 5.9 km with 111 meters of elevation
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible from 8:00 to 8:45 am. All finishers receive medals. Scenic running route around Tübingen
Community running experience in university sports

On-site registration until 1 hour before start. Refreshments on the course and at the finish. Shower facilities at the sports home.

Drinks along the route and refreshments at the finish line

name: MÜRITZ-LAUF
description: The MÜRITZ-LAUF is a race around Germany's largest inland lake, Lake Müritz, taking place on June 27, 2026, in Waren (Müritz). name: Oberlichtenauer Sommerlauf

The award ceremony takes place immediately after the children's races. The popular sport run begins at 10:25 AM, and the main race starts at 10:30 AM. The running group is led by Patrick Thomschke (department head) and Jens Schäfer (manager). The event typically takes place in summer temperatures around 23°C. Registration and further details are available on the official website. The race is a great opportunity for runners to achieve personal bests and experience the beautiful Saxon landscape.

name: Ravensburger Stadtlauf
organizer: Stadt Ravensburg, Sportverband Ravensburg, Wirtschaftsforum Pro Ravensburg
description: The Ravensburg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, in the historic Old Town of Ravensburg and offers a unique running experience amidst the picturesque city center. The event is in its 35th edition and invites both active runners and spectators to enjoy the special atmosphere. The organizers are the City of Ravensburg, the Ravensburg Sports Association, and the Pro Ravensburg Business Forum. The race is hosted by LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V. The event promises exciting and entertaining running sports in the sports city of Ravensburg.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Old Town of Ravensburg
Unique running experience in the city center
Atmosphere with enthusiastic spectators along the route
additional: Organizers: City of Ravensburg, Ravensburg Sports Association, and Pro Ravensburg Business Forum; Host: LG Welfen / TSB 1847 Ravensburg e.V.; Information from the Office for Education, Social Affairs, and Sports of the City of Ravensburg at Tel: 0751 822443; Event time from 16:00 to 22:00. The race takes place in Ravensburg's city center, especially at Marienplatz. Registration is possible until June 24, 2026. The event is free for spectators.

name: Schöneicher Eichkaterlauf
location: Schöneiche bei Berlin, Oder-Spree, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The 14th Eichkaterlauf on June 27, 2026, in Schöneiche offers a diverse running program for all age and performance levels. From short Bambini and children's runs to popular races and the challenging 12 km main event, there is something for everyone. The courses lead through the beautiful nature of Schöneiche and invite participants to a sporting community experience. The event is family-friendly, and registration is conveniently available online with the possibility of late registration on race day.
course_highlights: Varying distances from 400 m to 12 km
Nature courses through Schöneiche
Family-friendly event with Bambini and children's runs
additional: Online registration closes on 26.06.2026 at 12:00 PM. Late registrations are possible on race day directly on site. The event takes place at Dorfaue / Ecke Stegeweg (near the festival grounds) in Schöneiche. Various race distances, online registration, family-friendly, nature courses

name: Sommerlauf des LSV Porz
location: Gut Leidenhausen, Köln-Porz, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 2 € am Veranstaltungstag, sonst keine expliziten Angaben
description: The summer run of LSV Porz is a popular race in the recreational area Gut Leidenhausen in Cologne-Porz. It takes place as the Ingeborg Urbach Memorial Run and offers courses between 1 km and 5 km for ambitious runners and recreational joggers. The 5 km and 10 km routes are measured by the DLV and are eligible for best lists, with the 5 km loop considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne. An entry fee also supports Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Waldschule Leidenhausen.
course_highlights: Run in the recreational area Gut Leidenhausen
5 km and 10 km routes measured by the DLV and eligible for best lists
The 5 km loop is among the fastest running routes in Cologne
additional: Registration deadline is June 23, 2026. On the day of the event, late registration is possible for a fee of 2 €, students are exempt from the late registration fee. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Bibs must be worn on the chest. 1 euro per participant is donated to Brusthilfe Deutschland e.V. and the Waldschule Leidenhausen. Terrain in the recreational area Leidenhausen, registration via SEPA direct debit, bib on the chest, medals for all pre-registered participants, award ceremonies for the top runners, online certificates available.

name: Stadtlauf Abensberg 2026
location: Stadion in Abensberg, Abensberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Abensberg City Run takes place on June 27, 2026, at the new stadium in Abensberg. The event is a special highlight of the athletics department of TSV Abensberg, which actively promotes recreational sports with great commitment. By participating in the city run, you support local running sports and send a message for a vibrant sports culture. The race offers a great opportunity to collect kilometers together for a new tartan track and modern training equipment.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the new stadium in Abensberg
Running together to support the expansion of sports facilities
Recreational sports event focused on community and enjoyment of movement
additional: Training for youth and adults takes place on Mondays from 6:00 PM to 7:30 PM at the stadium, for children aged 6 and above on Fridays from 5:00 PM to 6:30 PM. There is a running group on Mondays from 7:00 PM to 7:45 PM. Participation in the city run supports the development of a new tartan track and modern training equipment. City run on 27.06.2026, running event, support for running sports, participation promotes local sports culture.

name: Taunus Trailrun
description: The 8th Kreissparkasse Limburg Taunus-Trail-Run is a nature-oriented trail run that predominantly takes place on natural field, forest paths, and single trails in the Selters-Eisenbach region. The course may include muddy and slippery sections depending on the weather, making the run particularly challenging. The long-distance race is highly valued by the regional trail community. The event offers electronic timing, a pre-race briefing, and an award ceremony after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Natural field, forest paths, and single trails
Muddy and slippery sections depending on weather conditions
Recognition of the long-distance race by the regional trail community
additional: The event takes place in all weather conditions. Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before the respective start, but without a guaranteed starting place and with a 1€ surcharge. Bib number distribution, changing rooms, showers, drinks, and catering are available on-site at the sports field Eisenbach. All participants receive a finisher sausage or a vegetarian alternative. Timing is conducted electronically by RaceR. An emergency vehicle from the German Red Cross (DRK) is stationed in the finish area. The event is officially registered with the Limburg-Weilburg Athletics District and the Hessian Athletics Association. The event will be held on June 27, 2026, with start and finish points in Selters-Eisenbach. The event is organized on a volunteer basis and emphasizes the autonomy of runners through GPS-supported navigation. It is recommended to plan overnight stays in the region.

description: The Volksbank-Bever Race takes place on June 27, 2026, at the Beverstadion in Ostbevern. The event offers various running competitions, including a relay half marathon and individual races for runners born from 2012 onwards. The course is measured by the DLV and is part of the Volksbank Cup Race Series. Refreshments and catering are available at the finish area, and changing and shower facilities are directly at Beverstadion.
course_highlights: DLV-measured course
Relay exchange zone at Beverstadion
Start and finish at Beverstadion Ostbevern
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 2 p.m. until 30 minutes before the respective race, with an additional fee of €2. For all athletes, running shirts, mineral water, non-alcoholic beer, and Fassbrause are available at the finish area. Changing and shower facilities are located directly at Beverstadion. The relay exchange zone is at Beverstadion. The event offers a pleasant running atmosphere with catering, changing rooms, and showers. Registration and results are available on the official website.

name: EWE Nordseelauf - Etappe 7
price_range: 37,00 € für Funktionsshirt (Preise variieren je nach Produkt und Zeitraum), sonst keine expliziten Teilnahmegebühren genannt
description: The EWE North Sea Run is a traditional stage race across seven different East Frisian Islands on the North Sea coast of Lower Saxony. Over eight days, participants run, walk, or Nordic walk approximately 10 kilometers per stage, enjoying the unique nature, maritime flair, and healthy high-sea climate. The event attracts running enthusiasts from all over Germany and abroad and offers a fair competitive experience with a family-friendly atmosphere. Due to limited capacities on the islands, the number of participants is restricted, ensuring an exclusive running experience.
course_highlights: Stage race across seven East Frisian Islands with about 10 km per stage
Running routes along beaches, dune landscapes, and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Wadden Sea
Start and finish points centrally located on the islands, e.g., promenade on Borkum and spa square on Norderney
additional: Race bibs are issued on each island approximately 1 hour after arrival of the special ferry until 30 minutes before the start. Race bibs with integrated chip for timing are provided. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available on the islands. Sports bag storage is offered. Award ceremonies take place in the afternoon on each island. Optional race bib pickup can be arranged on the Friday before the race in Bensersiel. Functional shirts, headbands, and bottles are available as merchandise. The stage race takes place on seven North Sea islands, with no waiting list and a limited number of participants due to infrastructure and ferry capacities.

name: XTrail Breitnau
description: The XTrail Breitnau is a versatile running event in the Hochschwarzwald that brings together runners and Nordic walkers of all ages in one day. Four different races are offered: the popular XT-Run with half marathon and 10 km routes, the XT-Walk with 12 and 8 km routes, the XT-Challenge as an obstacle sprint for age groups U8 to U20, and the XT-Kids race for the youngest participants. The courses lead through varied terrain with trails, steep ascents, and panoramic views, and offer an attractive starter package as well as professional timing. The event is organized by the Skizunft Breitnau e.V. and takes place on June 27, 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course with steep ascents and trails through the Ravennaschlucht
Nordic walking routes on natural paths through moss, fir forest, and Hohwartshöhe
Obstacle sprint with serpentines ascent and varied course layout in the spa garden
additional: Race bib distribution on the day of the event from 08:00-11:00 and 12:30-13:45 at the fire station. For XT-Kids and XT-Challenge, bibs are issued as sets per club. Participation conditions and equipment requirements must be observed, e.g., trail running shoes with profile sole for RUN, Nordic walking poles for WALK. Nutrition is provided on the course and at the finish, personal digital certificate, finisher medal for XT-Kids, exclusive trophies and prizes for overall and age group winners. Late registrations with fee are possible until June 26 at 18:00, and on the event day until one hour before start. Multiple race types, routes, age groups, online registration, bibs, nutrition, prizes, and possible route changes.

description: Lužany Forest Run is a traditional running race held in the recreational area of the village of Lužany near Jičín, specifically at the campsite by Marešák Pond. The jubilee 50th edition will take place on June 27, 2026, and offers various categories and distances suitable for a wide range of runners, including children. The race is supported by the Hradec Králové Region and organized by the Municipality of Lužany, ELMAT Kůtek s.r.o., and TJ Sokol Lužany. Participants can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary rewards for the best competitors in each category.

name: Žhavé běhy Slováckého léta
location: Uherské Hradiště, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The fiery runs of Slovácké léto are traditional running races held in the historic center of Uherské Hradiště. Participants can choose from three routes of 5, 10, and 21 kilometers, which lead through scenic countryside along the Morava River, through Kunovský les forest park, and the Novoveská lakes. The races are suitable for all runners, from beginners to experienced athletes, and offer a unique experience of movement in the beautiful environment of Slovácko. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square, adding to the race's atmosphere of the city's historic heart.
course_highlights: Route runs through the historic center of Uherské Hradiště
Running along the Morava River and its confluence with Olšava
Connection with Kunovský les forest park and Novoveská lakes
additional: The start and finish of the races are at Masaryk Square in Uherské Hradiště. The routes are laid out on city and natural paths, including cycle paths. The races are part of the sports-cultural festival Slovácké léto, which also offers other sports and cultural activities. The festival is suitable for all age groups, including families with children. The course includes the city center, the river, parks, and cycle paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: XIII Dycha Anny Wazówny
location: Brodnica, Brodnica County, Kuyavian-Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Anna Wazówna Ten is a street race over a distance of 10 km, which will take place in Brodnica. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your form over a medium distance, and the organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to different levels of advancement. The race is open and friendly to runners, offering expert support and the chance to participate in a sporting event in the picturesque city of Kuyavian-Pomeranian.
course_highlights: Street course of 10 km
Picturesque areas of Brodnica
Suitable for intermediate difficulty level
additional: The organizer offers training plans from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level and expert support. The event includes various distances, including the main 10 km race, as well as races for children and a 3 km run. Registrations are available online, and the event promotes active spending of time and exploring the region.

name: Supermaraton Gor Stolowych
location: Karlów, Kłodzko County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The Supermarathon of the Table Mountains is a demanding mountain run held in the picturesque Table Mountains near Karpacz. The route follows tourist trails, characterized by high technical difficulty, numerous rocks, turns, and significant elevation changes. Participants can expect variable conditions, including possible snow cover and ice, as well as the requirement to have appropriate equipment. The event is part of the Grand Prix DFBG mountain running series and attracts ultra and half-marathon mountain running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The route follows tourist trails of the Polish Table Mountains
High elevation gains and technical difficulties with numerous rocks and turns
Possible heavy snow and ice, snowshoes are permitted
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 7 hours. The race office and start are located at the Training and Educational Center of the Table Mountains National Park in Karpacz. Participants can use deposit services (limit 3 kg) delivered to the finish line. The route is marked with organizer’s tape. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions, with the possibility of shortening the route in difficult conditions. After the race, a recovery meal and award ceremony are scheduled. The time limit for completing the race is 11 hours for the ultramarathon and 5 hours for the half-marathon. The route includes elevation gains of +2400/-2300 meters for the ultramarathon and +1050/-925 meters for the half-marathon. The event is part of the mountain running series in the region.

The participant limit is 300, with online registration. The time limit is 6 hours. The route runs through park and forest areas. Individual and team classifications are available.

description: The 13th Cichociemnych Run is a cross-country race organized in Sochaczew, dedicated to the memory of Polish heroes, the Cichociemni soldiers. It is a unique opportunity to get closer to the banks and bed of the Bzura River and feel the wind in your hair during sporting competition.

On an officially measured, flat, and asphalted 21.0975 km course, up to 24,000 runners experience a unique running party through the Hanseatic city. The route passes approximately 50 sights and is accompanied by numerous event points with DJ support and live music. The event is known for its great atmosphere and the traffic-free course, secured by police and marshals.

description: The 24-Hour Burginsellauf in Delmenhorst is a challenging ultramarathon on a flat, approximately 1.3 km long loop course along the Burginsel and Graftwiesen. The event offers individual and team competitions as well as a 6-hour run and a 3-hour student run. The route is traffic-free, illuminated, and mostly shaded, making it ideal for endurance runners looking to test their limits. During the run, there is a 24-hour open refreshment station and a tent area for rest breaks. The German Championship in the 24-hour run is held as part of this event.
course_highlights: Flat, approximately 1.3 km long loop course along the Burginsel and Graftwiesen
Traffic-free, illuminated, and predominantly shaded route
Automatic digital timing with live intermediate standings
additional: The race starts on June 27, 2026 at 12:00 PM and ends on June 28, 2026 at 12:00 PM. The course is measured according to DLV standards. Showers and changing rooms are approximately 250 meters away in the Stadtbad-Turnhalle. Public parking and motorhome spaces are available on the Graftwiesen. For teams, 5 starting places are included in the entry fee; additional persons cost 20 EUR each. Relay participants must be registered via a link in the confirmation email. There will be a large laser show and live music in the evening. The event also includes a 3-hour student run starting from age 8, with catering included, race numbers with chips, a medal for 24-hour runners, a participant limit due to high demand, and a tent area for rest.

name: AHRTuS-Lauf mit Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
description: The AHRTuS Run is a club-organized race day above Calvary Hill in Ahrweiler, prepared by volunteers from TuS Ahrweiler in Quarzkaul. The program begins with races for toddlers, children, and adolescents, followed by 5 km and 10 km runs as well as a 6.2 km Nordic walking route. The adult course mainly runs through shady forest paths and narrow trails with some elevation, including a climb through Maibachklämmchen with numerous wooden bridges. The 10 km race is also the final event of the Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup, where club teams compete for the last points. The event combines a family-friendly atmosphere with sporting competition and offers medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Shady forest paths and narrow trails
Climb through Maibachklämmchen with many wooden bridges
10 km race as the final of the Ahrtal-TEAM-Cup
additional: The event offers races for toddlers, children, and adolescents, a 6.2 km Nordic walking option, finisher medals for children, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas. The participant number is approximately 250 runners. Besides the races, the event features family activities, medals for finishers, a bouncy castle, a play bus, and live music at the start and finish areas.

The course runs within the controlled zone of the Marine Aviation Support Base Nordholz and offers participants a special atmosphere with views of historic and modern aviation history. After the race, there is an opportunity to visit the Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM. The event is ideal for runners seeking an extraordinary and unforgettable running experience.
course_highlights: Course over the grounds of Nordholz Airfield
Route within the controlled zone of Marine Aviation Support Base Nordholz
Close to the Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM

The event offers various categories, including children's runs, duathlons, and cycling races, as well as entertainment, registration, and charity activities. After the race, there is an opportunity to visit the nearby Marine Aviation and Airship Museum AERONAUTICUM.

name: Hardtwaldlauf 2026
description: The Hardtwaldlauf in Karlsruhe is a traditional race event taking place on June 28, 2026, for the 40th time. Offered are races over 5 km and 10 km, running through the Hardtwald forest and suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The event features professional timing with disposable transponders and a friendly atmosphere with certificates and prizes for various age groups. The race bibs are distributed on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m., and changing and shower facilities are available on-site.

The city run combines athletic challenge with community and a special atmosphere in one of Germany's most beautiful cities.

Run through the heart of Germany's oldest city

The project not only promotes sports but also social cohesion and the joy of movement. The goal is to give children new courage after life setbacks and to highlight the societal importance of physical activity.
