The event includes various race distances, including children's runs, with attractive routes through vineyards and nature reserves. There is a Youth Trail suitable for young runners, and with the T Ch Challenge, runners can experience various routes over two days. Pasta party on Friday evening (€10) available upon registration. Dogs are allowed in the event area at Seegarten but not in the beach bath. KidsRun is a short loop on the event grounds. Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups on the last Sunday of each month in Steinheim. Weekly summer holiday runs during the summer break every Tuesday evening at 7:00 PM. Year-end run at the end of the year with a 10 km race and afterwards punch & mulled wine. Registration for all runs is via the partner Datasport. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible until shortly before the race. The event takes place at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr and is a popular opportunity for runners to prepare for the marathon. It is recommended to check the details with the organizer before registering.

name: Uni-Lauf Bamberg
description: The Bamberg University Run is an open community race and will take place for the 12th time in 2026. It includes various race distances, including a 10 km main race, which is also held as the Bavarian University Championship and Upper Franconian Championship, a 10 km relay race, a 2 km students' run, and a 500-meter children's run. The flat, officially measured course leads through ERBA Park, along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain forest, and the city center of Bamberg, offering scenic views of historic buildings. The event provides a family-friendly atmosphere and is open to runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Flat loop course with start and finish in the courtyard of the university building
Course runs along the Main-Danube Canal, through the Hain, and the city center with views of the Old Town Hall and Michaelsberg Monastery
Relay handover at Buger Spitze at km 5.5
additional: Start times: 500 m children's run at 9:15 a.m., 2 km students' run at 9:30 a.m., 10 km main race at 10:00 a.m. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 8:00 a.m. to 9:30 a.m. on-site (cash only). In the finish area, there will be water, energy drinks, fruit, and baked goods. Two refreshment stations on the 10 km route (around km 5 and km 7). Starting positions are assigned in blocks based on expected finish time (under 40 min, 40-50 min, 50-60 min, over 60 min). Team rankings and special awards for the fastest Bamberg students and Bavarian University Championship. Participation is open to all performance levels; registration exclusively online; parking available at the underground garage on the premises; public transport connection via bus No. 906, stop Spinnerei.

name: Weiner Family Run 2026
description: The Wiener Family Run 2026 is a family-friendly running event organized by the running club of FC Schwarz-Weiß Weiner on June 28, 2026. It is aimed at runners, walkers, children, and toddlers, offering various distances from approximately 500 meters up to 10 kilometers. The focus is on the joy of movement and shared experience in a relaxed atmosphere. The start and finish area is located in the Sparkassenpark Weiner, and the routes lead through the Weiner farming community. Additionally, participants can enjoy a family-friendly program with moderation and catering.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in Sparkassenpark Weiner
Route through the Weiner farming community
Distances from toddler run (approx. 500 m) to 10 km
additional: Online registration from February 7, 2026 via my race|result. Family-friendly program with moderation and catering for participants. Races for all age groups including toddlers, children/teenagers, 5 km, and 10 km. Multiple race distances, family-friendly event, online registration from February 7, 2026, start and finish in SW Weiner Sparkassenpark.

name: Zwiefalter Berglauf
description: The 20th Zwiefalter Mountain Run will take place on June 28, 2026, in Zwiefalten and offers a varied program for runners of all performance levels. The event includes several races, including the Great Mountain Run over 9.8 km, the Sparkassen Run over 6 km, a Genusslauf (Nordic Walking) also over 6 km, as well as children's races. The course leads through an idyllic landscape with partly protected areas and provides a great opportunity to engage in sports together and have fun. The event is aimed at young and old and promotes movement within the community.
course_highlights: Great Mountain Run over 9.8 km with challenging terrain
Sparkassen Run and Genusslauf (Nordic Walking) over 6 km
Idyllic landscape with sections through protected areas
additional: Race bib distribution begins at 8:00 AM in the start/finish area, closing 20 minutes before each start. Award ceremony starts around 12:45 PM at the event site. Shower facilities available at the sports clubhouse. Participation in timing for the Genusslauf without placement, with an alphabetical finish list. Raffle of race bibs with prizes for all participants. Kilometer collection activity with recognition of the largest collectors during the award ceremony. The event promotes movement for all age groups and performance levels. Courses: 9.8 km mountain run, 6 km run, children's and Nordic Walking races; online registration; start at Zwiefalten sports grounds; award ceremony from approximately 12:45 PM.

name: Sloupský lesní běh
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Sloup Forest Run is a traditional road race held in the picturesque environment of Sloup in the Moravian Karst. The course measures 11.5 kilometers and is characterized by significant elevation gain, making it a challenging and attractive race for runners. The event has a long-standing history and attracts runners from the surrounding area who enjoy the beauty of nature and the sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course length of 11.5 km
Significant elevation gain on the course
Road race in the natural environment of the Moravian Karst
additional: The race takes place in June 2026, with a history of events since 2016, and is designed for runners of all levels who want to experience running in nature with technical challenges.

name: Lochovice - Plešivec
description: Lochovice - Plešivec is a running race as part of the Brdský Running Cup, held on June 28, 2026, in Lochovice. The course is approximately 5.5 km long with an elevation gain of 350 meters, starting with 2 km on asphalt and continuing through forest paths with a steeper incline around the 3rd kilometer. The finish is at the top of Plešivec, offering a beautiful view. The event also includes children's races and a family run to support the local hospice Mezi břehy.
course_highlights: Approximate course length of 5.5 km with 350 m elevation gain
2 km on asphalt, the rest through forest paths with steep ascent at 3 km
Finish at the top of Plešivec with a beautiful view
additional: Transport of marked luggage (clothing for changing) by off-road vehicle to the top of Plešivec at 10:20. Fabián's Run - children's competitions from 11:10. Family run to support the hospice Mezi břehy starts at 10:30. The course includes asphalt and forest sections; transportation to the top of Plešivec is provided at 10:20; the event features children's races and activities supporting outdoor activities.

The main race of 21.1 km takes place on a loop course repeated three times, along asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain. In addition to the main race, shorter courses are available for youth, pupils, and preschool children, making the event attractive to a wide age range of runners. After the race, refreshments are provided, and the winner of the main race receives a monetary prize. The start is traditionally at the square in Nové Veselí.

Course runs on asphalt roads and third-class roads with minimal elevation gain
Loops for youth and preschool children on local roads and the square

The winner of the main race receives a monetary prize of 2000 CZK plus 1000 CZK for breaking the course record. Each runner can request a diploma with their placement and time achieved. The race will take place on June 28, 2026, with the main race starting at 9:45 AM. The event is open to the general public, including youth, veterans, and children.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Potůčky
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful scenery of the Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various locations, including Potůček, where the main race covers 6 to 9 km and an experiential trail of 20 to 30 km. In addition to running, there are also routes for walking and children's races. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicross enthusiasts, children, and walkers, offering an opportunity to enjoy the stunning nature of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential trail 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 200 m to 1600 m

The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with the Destination Agency Ore Mountains z.s. and the involved municipalities. name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Lomnická etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven consecutive days, with the Lomnická stage being one of its parts. This race is among the most demanding ultramarathons in the Czech Republic and offers runners a challenge in the form of long distances and difficult terrain in the South Moravian Region. The race is intended for experienced ultramarathon runners who want to test their endurance and strength in beautiful nature. The Lomnická stage takes place around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova and is part of the entire ultramarathon series.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging terrain of the South Moravian Region
Beautiful natural scenery around Olešnice and Lomnice u Tišnova
additional: The race passes through various parts of Moravia, with start and finish in Olešnice or Lomnice u Tišnova, and is designed for experienced ultramarathoners. Registration is possible through the contact details provided on the official website.

description: The Great Izerska Loop is a scenic half marathon held as part of the Izerski Running Weekend in Szklarska Poręba. The route runs through the streets of the town and along the trails of the Izerskie Mountains, offering runners contact with nature and mountain scenery. The race is recreational and sports-oriented, promoting physical activity and popularizing running. Participants use electronic timing, and the time limit to complete the course is 3 hours.

The surface of the route includes paved paths and forest roads
Finish line at the Municipal Stadium on Plac Sportowy in Szklarska Poręba

Participants shortening the route are disqualified. The event includes various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and Nordic Walking, with online registration and routes in mountain terrains. It has been held since 2013, featuring well-known athletes and course records.

name: XVIII Bieg w pogoni za żubrem
description: The XV Run in Pursuit of the Bison is an annual running event held in Niepołomice, attracting runners of various distances. The competition offers routes of 8 and 15 kilometers as well as a race for children, making the event appealing to a wide range of participants. The race course runs through scenic areas, combining athletic competition with the beauty of the surrounding nature. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 8-kilometer race route through scenic areas of Niepołomice
Longer 15-kilometer route for more advanced runners
Special race for children promoting physical activity among the young
additional: forest terrain, registration via form on the website, sports and recreational event

The routes of varying lengths and difficulty levels lead through wild, unknown terrains, offering participants unforgettable views and challenges. The event attracts both experienced ultramarathon runners and trail enthusiasts who want to face demanding terrain and the beauty of nature. Organizers provide full support at nutrition points and necessary equipment, ensuring safety and comfort for participants.

name: Łabiszyński Bieg Świętojański

The main race over 5 km starts at 10:00 AM, followed by children's and youth races in four age categories. Participants of the main race will receive a medal and a sweet snack, while younger competitors will receive a medal and a surprise. After the races, the best runners will be awarded. Main race route of 5 km

The races pass through diverse landscapes with refreshment stations along the course and provide a family-friendly atmosphere with medical support from the Red Cross. After the race, showers are available, and Nordic walking is also possible without timing.

10 km route with an additional 4.3 km loop for a total of 14.3 km
Refreshment stations and medical support from the Red Cross
additional: School run 2 km start 6:30 PM; 5.3 km start 7:00 PM; 10 km and 14.3 km start around 7:10 PM; Nordic walking without timing on 5 km or 10 km possible; Registration on site or with form, payment in cash on site; Showers available after the race; Registration for the school run mainly through schools. Routes, registration on site or via form, refreshments, showers, awards, parallel beer evening with brass music

The route takes you through a scenic landscape around Großostheim and combines athletic challenge with nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere. The race is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar and invites both hobby and competitive runners alike.

Great views around Großostheim
Various distances from 750 m to 10 km

Start and finish at the same location with available parking
Evening start time with registration from 17:00 to 17:45

The race is open to runners aged 18 and over, with a participant limit of 18 persons, and only takes place if at least five participants register.

name: 36. Göttinger Altstadtlauf

In addition to the races, team competitions for companies are offered, making it a social highlight during the Saarburg Market Days.

name: Marburger Nachtmarathon
description: The Marburg Night Marathon takes place on July 3, 2026, for the 27th time and is the largest running event in the Middle Hessen region. The event offers a classic marathon, a half marathon, and a relay marathon with up to four participants. The course runs through the picturesque old town of Marburg, along the Lahn River, and features a flat, record-eligible loop with views of the Landgrave Castle and the Elisabeth Church. The start is atmospherically at 7 PM on the historic marketplace, and the finish is at the university stadium. All participants receive a high-quality medal depicting a notable Marburg building each year.
course_highlights: Flat, record-eligible loop course
Course runs through the old town and along the Lahn
Views of Landgrave Castle and Elisabeth Church
additional: The relay marathon consists of four runners, each covering approximately ten kilometers. The first relay runner starts at the marketplace, with the exchange zone located on Frankfurt Street. Each relay team receives a bib number on an elastic bib band. Safety pins are provided at registration. The number of participants is limited to ensure safety and a carefree running experience. Start and finish are at the university stadium, about 1 km from the starting point. The course runs within the city of Marburg, starting at Georg-Gaßman Stadium, with relay exchanges in Frankfurt Street. Registration begins on March 1, 2026.

name: Rotenburger Strandfestlauf - Rotenburg rennt
location: Rotenburg an der Fulda, Hesse, Germany
price_range: 1 Euro Startgeld für Bambini, vergünstigte Preise für Schüler- und Jugendläufe
description: The Rotenburg Strand Festival Run takes place annually on the first Friday of July as part of the traditional hometown and beach festival in Rotenburg an der Fulda. The flat and fast course runs through the city center and offers various competitions for youth, main runners, elite, and teams as well as walking. New are the precisely measured school and elite runs as well as the beer mile, where fun is the main focus. The event combines sporting ambition with social togetherness and is a highlight in the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: Flat and fast running course through the Rotenburg city center
School run exactly 1248 meters - homage to the founding year of Rotenburg
Elite run over 1.609 km (land mile) with participation requirements
additional: No registration on site possible, only pre-registration via specialized portals. No longer 5 km and 10 km routes, instead a 1.5 km course run five times for the main race. Beer mile without timing with four alcohol-free beer breaks of 400 m each. Participation requirements for the elite run (men: 03:10 min/km, women: 03:30 min/km). Youth, main, elite, and team runs, walking, preparation through running clubs, supported by Sparkasse.

name: Traunreuter Stadtlauf

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Onlineanmeldung bis 27.06.2026: 21 € (Eure Startunterlagen werden mit der Post verschickt)

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Onlineanmeldung bis 01.07.2026: 21 € ( Eure Startunterlagen müssen am 03.07.2026 ab 15:30 Uhr vor Ort abgeholt werden )

description: The 23rd City Run Traunreut will take place on July 3, 2026, as a major recreational sports event in Traunreut, Bavaria. The course runs over a flat, measured, and asphalted loop of 7 km, starting and ending at the Town Hall Square. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers not only the main race but also a children's race and relay races. Food and drinks are available at the town square, and after the race, an after-race party provides entertainment.
course_highlights: 7 km flat, measured, and asphalted loop
Start and finish at Town Hall Square Traunreut
Water stations along the course and refreshments at the finish
additional: Race bibs and transponders are sent by mail or can be picked up on site. Cut-off time is 55 minutes after the start. Changing and shower facilities are available in the gymnasium of the Wer. After-race party with DJ Jochen from 8:15 PM at the Town Hall Square. Moderation by Peter Maisenbacher and Hans Pagatsch. Refreshments provided free of charge by Steiner Brewery at the finish. The event includes a children's race, relay race, and city run, with participation conditions and program details. The event takes place annually in July.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Bystřická etapa
location: Bystřice nad Pernštejnem, Morava, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon is an international stage running race held over seven marathons in seven consecutive days. The Bystřice stage is one of its parts, offering a challenging and long run in the picturesque environment of Moravia. The race is designed for experienced ultramarathoners seeking a challenge in the form of long stages and beautiful nature. Come test your strength in this prestigious ultramarathon and experience the unique atmosphere of a stage race.
course_highlights: Stage race over 7 marathons in 7 days
Challenging Moravian terrain with beautiful views
International participation and prestigious running event
additional: The race is part of the ultramarathon series, with a length of 42.2 km in the Bystřice stage, and is part of the ČAU ULTRA CUP 2019.

name: 01. Okertalsperren Ultra-Marathon
location: Altenau im Harz, Goslar, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 01 Okertalsperren Ultra Marathon will take place on July 4, 2026, in Altenau in the Harz. The course covers 47.4 km and consists of three laps of a 15.8 km mostly flat route around the main arm of the Okertalsperre. The route runs along the forebay, over the dam and the main dam wall, offering a scenic running course with slight inclines. The event is suitable for experienced runners, self-supply is recommended, and timing is done independently. After the race, participants receive certificates via email, and the results are published on the website.
course_highlights: Three laps of 15.8 km around the Okertalsperre
Crossing the forebay dam and main dam wall
Mostly flat course with slight inclines
additional: Self-supply is recommended, e.g., from the trunk of your own car. Timing is done independently with a running watch or mobile phone, proof via photo or screenshot sent by email to the organizer. Certificates are sent as PDFs via email. Result lists are published on the website. The race takes place on July 4, 2026. It is a self-supported event without an explicit registration fee, where participants must verify their results. The course consists of three laps of 15.8 km around the reservoir.

name: 10. Hochkippenlauf
description: The 10th Hochkippenlauf will take place on July 4, 2026, at the Profen Stadium and is organized by SV Eintracht Profen. Various races are offered for different age groups, from a toddler race over distances for youth to 10 km races for adults. The event is part of a sports festival held from July 3 to July 5, 2026. The race provides a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Toddler race 400 m (one stadium lap)
Courses of 2.1 km, 4.2 km, and 5 km for youth
10 km race for U18, U20, and adults
additional: The race is part of a sports festival taking place from July 3 to July 5, 2026. The toddler races are held on a stadium lap. The race takes place at Profen Stadium, with warm and sunny weather in July. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to win prizes in various categories.

name: 23. Schneekopflauf
location: Schmiedefeld am Rennsteig, Thüringer Wald, Germany
description: The Schneekopflauf is one of the most beautiful and challenging mountain runs in Germany, taking place in the Thuringian Forest. The course runs from Schmiedefeld over the Große Finsterberg to the Schneekopf and covers 12.7 and 22.2 kilometers full of inclines and elevation gain. This race is especially suitable for experienced runners who want to test their limits. Since 2025, there is also a Schneekopf hike for Nordic walkers and hikers, who will also be rewarded with a medal at the summit.
course_highlights: Course length of 12.7 km and 22.2 km with challenging inclines
Elevation gain from start to summit at 978 m
Run through the Thuringian Forest with breathtaking views
additional: Registrations are possible from 26.06.2026 until 30.06.2026, 23:59. A cancellation is possible until 30.04.2026 with a 50% refund minus a 5 EUR processing fee. An upgrade from 12.7 km to 22.2 km is possible against payment of the difference; no refund if downgrading. Start places are not transferable. Steep, challenging, elevation gain, mountain run, Nordic walking, hike.

name: 40. Schweriner Fünf-Seen-Lauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Kostenfreie Teilnahme für Kinder bis 12 Jahre

description: The Schwerin Five Lakes Run is a traditional race in northern Germany, taking place on July 4, 2026, for the 40th time. The event offers various running routes around the five lakes in Schwerin, including a half marathon, 15 km run, 10 km run, 5 km run, and a nautical mile for children. Runners experience a scenic course with start and finish at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz. The event is known for its good organization, family-friendly atmosphere, and diverse categories, including corporate and school rankings.
course_highlights: Running routes around five lakes in Schwerin
Start and finish at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz
Various distances from 1.852 km to half marathon
additional: Start and finish are at Bertha-Klingberg-Platz in Schwerin. The event offers a combined ranking for runners completing both the 10 km run and the half marathon. Timing is done with foot chip, and medals are awarded to all participants. There are special categories for corporate teams, families, and schools. Children under 10 years old may only participate in the 5 km and 10 km routes if accompanied by an adult. Multiple routes are available, including half marathon, 15 km, 10 km, 5 km, and a nautical mile for children; registration can be done online or by mail; entry fee can be paid via SEPA direct debit, credit card, or bank transfer.

name: 46. Küstenkanallauf
description: The 46th Coastal Canal Run will take place on July 4, 2026, in Friesoythe. The event offers races over 22 km, 11 km, and 5.5 km, as well as walking and hiking routes. The course runs scenicly along the Coastal Canal and is suitable for runners of all performance levels. The event is traditional and organized by KC Ikenbrügge von 1971 e. V.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Coastal Canal
Various distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km
Offers walking and hiking routes
additional: Start times: Runners for 5.5 km, 11 km, and 22 km start at 17:00; walking and hiking start at 16:15. Registration is via an online form on the website or by contact, providing name, year of birth, club, and location. The race is a local event with a friendly atmosphere, attracting numerous runners from the region annually. Registration, results, and further details are available on the official website and in the race announcement.

name: 9. Bremer Brückenlauf
price_range: ab 8,00 € bis 45,00 € je nach Kategorie und Frühbucherstatus
description: The Bremen Bridge Run on July 4, 2026 invites runners to experience Bremen from a unique perspective. The course crosses bridges over the Weser, the Kleine Weser, and the Werdersee, offering a maritime flair right in the city. Various distances are offered, including a half marathon, 10 km run, 5 km run, a special 5 km underwear run, and children's races. The event promises good mood, a summer atmosphere, and breathtaking views of Bremen and the Weser.
course_highlights: Run across multiple bridges in Bremen
Course over Weser, Kleine Weser, and Werdersee
Officially measured, top list eligible courses
additional: Optional medal engraving (€10 adults, €7.50 children). Start times vary by distance from 16:30 (Underwear Run) to 18:15 (5 & 10 km walking). All main races are DLV-measured and top list eligible. Children's races are privately measured. There is an alphabetical entry list for walkers and Nordic walkers. Participation conditions and age classes are clearly defined. Round course with official measurement, age categories, scoring categories, medal engraving possible, including Nordic walking.

name: Auenwaldlauf
price_range: kostenlos bis 12 Euro (je nach Lauf), keine expliziten Gesamtpreise
description: The Auenwaldlauf is a traditional running event in Auenwald-Hohnweiler, taking place on July 4, 2026. The event offers various race distances for children, adolescents, and adults with a friendly and family-oriented atmosphere. Start and finish are located at the multi-purpose hall in Hohnweiler, and all finishers receive a medal. The races are divided by age and are awarded with trophies, certificates, and material prizes.
course_highlights: 1.8 km students' run with turnaround point at the municipal border of Auenwald
5 km course through Auenwald with varied route over Kaffeeberg and Buckelhalde
10 km course with turnaround in Oberbrüden and return along the Holzbach
additional: Number bib distribution from 4:30 PM at the multi-purpose hall in Hohnweiler. Late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start, sometimes with a late registration fee of 3.00 euros. The scoring is age-appropriate with medals for all finishers, trophies, and certificates for the top finishers. Women and men are scored separately. Courses: 5 km, 10 km, children's runs, Nordic walking; water stations along the routes; anniversary classification with 30 km; online registration; start times for different categories between 5:45 PM and 8:00 PM; event takes place at the multi-purpose hall in Hohnweiler.

name: Benkhauser Schlosslauf
location: Schloss Benkhausen, Espelkamp, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 600 m Kinderlauf kostenlos, 2 km Schülerlauf 4,00 € (bis 14.06.), 6,5 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 10,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), 20,8 km 12,00 € (bis 14.06.), Preise steigen nach dem 14.06.
description: The Benkhausen Castle Run is a sporting race event that takes place in 2026 for the second time and is held against the unique backdrop of Benkhausen Castle. The event offers varied running routes on paved side streets and footpaths in the beautiful Benkhausen. Start and finish are located at the castle square in Benkhausen, where race bibs are also distributed. The event is open to running enthusiasts of all ages and includes various distances, including children’s and school runs.
course_highlights: Running routes on paved side streets and footpaths in the beautiful Benkhausen
Start and finish at the historic castle square in Benkhausen
Kilometer markings along the route for orientation
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day from 12:30 PM until 60 minutes before the start, provided the participant limit has not been reached, with a late registration fee of 2 euros. The number of participants is limited to 200 runners per main race (6.5 km, 10.8 km, 20.8 km), with a maximum of 600 registrations overall. Race packets will be available from June 30, 2026, at Drogerie Emmerling and on race day at the castle square. Timing is done with disposable chip technology. Shower and changing facilities are available at Benkhausen Elementary School. Children’s and school runs receive medals for all participants without timing or awards ceremony. The well-known host Heino Krüger will accompany the races. Registration opens on February 1, 2026; late registrations are possible on-site; participant limit for the main races is 200 per distance, with a maximum of 600 registrations; timing with chip; event held as part of a sports festival.

name: Degmarner Kocherlauf (Wertungslauf zum Drei Flüsse Cup)
price_range: 12 EUR pro Lauf, 47 EUR für die Cup-Voranmeldung für alle 6 Läufe
description: The Degmarn Kocherlauf takes place on July 4, 2026, in Degmarn and is a sporting highlight of the region. The 10 km main race is the fourth scoring event of the renowned 3-Flüsse-Cup, which connects six regional fun runs. In addition to the main race, there are competitions for various age groups and running levels, including walking and children's races. Following the races, the sports festival with music, food, and drinks invites participants to stay and enjoy – a festival for the whole family.
course_highlights: 10 km main race as the centerpiece of the event
Diverse competitions for all age groups and running levels
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup with regional significance
additional: Immediately after the race, a sports festival with music, good food, and refreshing drinks takes place. The race is open to individual runners, corporate teams, and walking participants. There are courses for 10 km, 5 km, and children's races. Various distances (0.25 km to 10 km), family and hobby runs, sports festival with music and catering, part of the Three Rivers Cup.

name: Eicherscheider Heckenlauf mit Halbmarathon 2026
description: The 46th Eicherscheider Hedge Run with Half Marathon will take place on July 4, 2026, in Simmerath-Eicherscheid in the Eifel. The races lead through the hilly beech hedge landscape around the federal gold village Eicherscheid on the edge of the Eifel National Park. Competitions are offered over 5 km, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.0975 km), each run on a hilly loop course. Children's and youth competitions are also part of the event. The start times are staggered in the afternoon and evening, allowing for a relaxed participation.
course_highlights: Hilly loop courses through the beech hedge landscape
Run through the federal gold village Eicherscheid on the edge of the Eifel National Park
Family-friendly event with children and youth competitions
additional: The competitions start in a staggered manner: 5 km at 15:45, 10 km at 16:35, and the half marathon at 18:00. The finish line is the same for all competitions. For precise location details, RUNME Premium is required. There are also competitions for children and adolescents; further information can be found in the official announcement of the organizer. The event is family-friendly, with start times varying depending on the distance. Registration is via the official website.

name: Fichtelgebirgsmarathon mit Halbmarathon und 10km-Lauf
description: The Fichtelgebirgsmarathon on July 4, 2026, is the largest running event in the Fichtel Mountains with three different courses for young and old. The races feature challenging elevation gains and beautiful landscapes, guaranteeing participants a unique natural experience. The event has been organized for over 20 years by sports enthusiasts who are members of the IfL-Fichtelgebirge, ensuring perfect organization. Online registration is available until July 2, 2026.
course_highlights: Marathon with 42 km and 800 meters of elevation
Half marathon with 21 km and 400 meters of elevation
10 km run with 225 meters of elevation and finish line in the Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad
additional: The event is organized by volunteer club members. There are three routes with different elevation profiles and lengths. The finish line for all routes is in the Kurpark Bad Alexandersbad. Detailed route data is available on Komoot. The event is known for its challenging course with elevation gains and the beautiful nature of the Fichtel Mountains. Online registration is possible until July 2, 2026.

name: Gocher Steintorlauf
description: The 30th Goch Steintorlauf will take place on July 4, 2026, as part of the Goch Football Summer. Organized by SV Viktoria Goch, Department of Athletics/Running Group, over 800 runners of various age groups are expected in the city center of Goch. The event offers races ranging from a children's run to a 2,000m hobby group and corporate run, up to a general public course around the Steintor. The event provides suitable distances for both competitive athletes and hobby runners in an open and healthy outdoor atmosphere.
course_highlights: Runs around the historic Steintor in the city center of Goch
A variety of distances from children's run to general public course
Integration into the Goch Football Summer with over 800 participants
additional: Registration is via TAF-Timing. The event is conceived as an open-air event within the framework of the Goch Summer. Races are offered for different age groups and performance levels, including children's run, 2,000m hobby group and corporate run, as well as general public courses. The event takes place all day from 08:00 to 17:00. Running event with various distances, registration via TAF-Timing, registration deadline is June 17, 2026.

name: Hochstraßenlauf
description: The Hochstraßenlauf in Weisendorf is a traditional running event taking place on July 4, 2026, for the 40th time. Start and finish are at the Heimatverein Weisendorf Museum. Due to the high temperatures of recent years, the start time has been moved to the morning to provide better conditions for runners. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with scoring for the Weisendorf City Championship.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Heimatmuseum Weisendorf
Run through the surroundings of Weisendorf with scenic routes
Various age groups and scoring for Weisendorf City Championship
additional: Please bring safety pins for the bib number. Participation conditions and data protection form for children under 16 must be brought along. Scoring for the Weisendorf City Championship is available when providing postal code 91085 and registering accordingly. The event takes place in the morning to avoid the heat and offers a wide range of running and walking options. Registration is possible until July 2, 2026.

name: Honiglauf des TuS Horn
description: The traditional Honey Run of TuS Horn offers running and walking routes for all age groups around Horn. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, where winners are rewarded with a glass of the coveted Horn honey. Various distances from children’s to 10 km runs enable participation for children, teenagers, and adults. The event takes place at the Horn community center and offers not only sporting ambition but also fun and community.
course_highlights: Running and walking routes around Horn
Distances from 150 m to 10 km for all age groups
Winners rewarded with Horn honey
additional: Registrations are possible until 1 hour before the respective start with a late registration fee of €2.00. The start and finish are at the Horn community center, Hauptstr. 18. Showers are available for women at the community center and for men at the sports clubhouse at the sports field. The top finishers receive trophies or medals and a glass of honey, all participants receive certificates and material prizes. Honey is raffled among the present walkers. No specific information on course length, registration, or other race details available.

name: KIT-Meisterschaft über 10km
description: The KIT Championship over 10 km takes place on July 4, 2026, in Karlsruhe. The flat, officially measured course runs from the Institute for Sports and Sports Science via the KIT Campus South through the Hardtwald forest and ends in the athletics stadium. The event is open to students, staff, and external participants and offers age group classifications as well as a team ranking. The award ceremony will be held at the institute's stadium.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 10 km course
Route through paved paths and well-maintained forest trails in Hardtwald
Finish on the blue tartan track of the athletics stadium
additional: Late registrations are possible on July 3, 2026, from 13:00 to 14:00, as well as on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start. Timing is done via RFID chip on the bib number. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Institute for Sports and Sports Science. The participant limit is 1200. 10 km flat, measured course through Hardtwald and campus, registration via RaceResult, start and finish at KIT Campus South, late registration possible, start on July 4, 2026.

name: Kondelwaldlauf, Rund um Bengel und Springiersbach
price_range: ohne Startgeld (kostenlos für Bambinilauf), sonst nicht explizit erwähnt
description: The Kondelwaldlauf in Bengel is a versatile running competition taking place on July 4, 2026, around Bengel and Springiersbach. The courses lead over meadows, asphalt, and forest paths, offering some inclines especially in the fun run and main race. There are rankings and attractive prizes for all age groups, while Nordic walking and the children's run are without timing. The event is organized by the Turn- und Sportverein Bengel 05 e.V. and provides changing and shower facilities directly at the sports field.
course_highlights: Courses over meadows, asphalt, and forest paths
Fun run and main race with inclines
Start and finish at the sports field in Bengel
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start against a late registration fee of 2.00 €. Changing and shower facilities are available in the Bengel gymnasium next to the sports field. Parking is available in front of the gymnasium. In the fun run and main race, age group rankings are based on DLO. For 5 km and 10 km runs, the first place in each age group receives a 'winner's shoe', as well as material prizes for places 1 to 3. Results lists are available online or can be requested via email. Various race categories including walking, children’s and youth runs; registration online or on-site; event takes place around Bengel and Springiersbach.

name: Reutlinger Solcom-Altstadtlauf
description: The Reutlingen Solcom Old Town Run is a popular running event in Reutlingen that appeals to both children and adults. On glorious summer weather, numerous runners participate, all starting in light blue sports shirts. After a two-year break, the joy and excitement among participants were especially high. The event is organized by the Friends of Eduard Spranger School, who also sponsor the T-shirts. The results of the races are available online.
course_highlights: Course through the historic Old Town of Reutlingen
Participation of children and adults
Organization and sponsorship by the Friends of Eduard Spranger School
additional: The event is often fully booked. There are special light blue sports shirts for participants, sponsored by the Friends. Race results are available online at https://reutlinger-solcom-altstadtlauf-2022.racepedia.de/ergebnisse. The run takes place on July 4, 2026, and regularly attracts many participants from the region. Results are published online.

name: St. Georgener Stadtfestlauf
location: Roter Löwe, Hauptstraße 18, St. Georgen im Schwarzwald, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
organizer: Förderverein TV St. Georgen e. V. und Stadt St. Georgen
price_range: Schülerlauf: 3,00 €, 5 km-Lauf: 5,00 €, 10,5 km-Lauf: 12,00 €, Halbmarathon: 12,00 €, St. Georgener Gesundheitslauf: 8,00 €
description: The 14th City Festival Run in St. Georgen im Schwarzwald will take place on July 4, 2026, and offers races for various age groups and performance levels. The event includes Bambini runs, school runs, a 5 km run, a 10.5 km run, and a half marathon. Start and finish are at the Red Lion in Hauptstraße 18. The races are part of the Intersport-Denzer-Cup and also feature team and corporate cup rankings. Additionally, there is a health run without timing, which also allows Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Diverse routes from approximately 400 m to half marathon
Start and finish at the historic Red Lion in Hauptstraße
Scoring races as part of the Intersport-Denzer-Cup with team and corporate cups
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until one hour before the respective race start at the Citizens' Hall, Red Lion. Race bibs are issued from 11 a.m. at the Citizens' Hall, Red Lion. The award ceremony takes place in stages after the races, including around 3:30 p.m. for the school run and 5 km run, and around 5:00 p.m. for the 10.5 km run and team rankings. The health run allows all types of running including Nordic walking and is conducted without timing and placement. Multiple competitions including children's runs, corporate and team rankings; online registration available; start and finish at Red Lion, Hauptstraße 18; route maps available for download.

name: Stadtlauf - Nördlingen läuft rund
description: The Nördlingen City Run takes place on July 4, 2026, and offers races for children, students, adults, and walkers. The approximately 6 km main race runs through and around the historic old town of Nördlingen. The focus is on team spirit and the enjoyment of movement, with every participant receiving a medal at the finish. The event is open for individual and group registrations and promotes a shared running experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 6 km long main race through and around Nördlingen's old town
Children's and students' races with 400 m and 800 m laps
Start and finish area at the marketplace with route through Daniel, Obstmarkt, Hallgasse, and Schäfflesmarkt
additional: Pre-registrations are possible until June 19, 2026. On-the-day registrations are possible with a late registration fee of 2 euros. In case of high participant numbers, children's races will be separated into girls' and boys' groups. There are individual and team rankings, with the top three fastest teams in the main race (6 km) being honored. No award ceremony is held for walkers; the focus here is on health. Tables for socializing after the race can be reserved via email. Distances: 400 m children's race, 7 km main race; medals for all finishers; prizes for the fastest company teams and the teams with the most participants; registration until June 19, 2026; the event takes place in any weather.

name: Wangener Altstadtlauf
description: The Wangener Old Town Run has been a fixture on the event calendar in Wangen im Allgäu for over 25 years. The races take place in the historic old town with narrow alleys, cobblestones, and the large marketplace, creating a special atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there are children's and school runs as well as the "Wangener Stolperer," where participants can run as many laps as possible within 30 minutes. The event is aimed at both competitive runners and hobby athletes and promotes a communal sporting experience in the city center.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town with narrow alleys
Cobblestones as a special surface
Large marketplace as a distinctive section of the course
additional: The "Wangener Stolperer" is a 30-minute run where each participant decides how many laps they can complete within the given time. There are also children's and school runs alongside the main race. The event is open to all age and performance levels. It includes races for children, students, and hobby runners, with distances ranging from 0.46 km to 5.19 km. The 'Wangener Stolperer' is a special highlight, allowing participants to run as many laps as possible in 30 minutes. The event fosters community spirit and sporting enthusiasm in the historic old town.

name: Windener Landschaftslauf
location: Am Forst, Winden bei Nassau, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Windener Landscape Run is a running and hiking event in Winden near Nassau, Germany. The event offers courses over 200 meters, 5 km, and 10 km for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. Start and finish are located at Am Forst, and the event originated from the 775th anniversary of the village, giving it a family-friendly and communal character. The races start sequentially in the afternoon, with the 5 km race beginning before the 10 km race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Am Forst in Winden
Courses for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
Community event with origins in the 775th village anniversary
additional: The 5 km course starts in the afternoon, followed by the 10 km course. The weather in July is typically sunny with temperatures between 15 and 25 °C and an average of 75 mm of precipitation. The event is focused on community and nature experience, with a family-friendly atmosphere and various running options.

name: Wybelsumer Polderlauf
description: The Wybelsumer Polderlauf is a running event for children and adults held at the sports field in Wybelsum, Emden. Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V., the race offers a sporting opportunity for the whole family in a friendly and welcoming atmosphere. The event is part of the diverse event calendar of Emden and promotes the local community and sports.
course_highlights: Running event for children and adults
Location: Sports field Wybelsum, Emden
Organized by SV Frischauf Wybelsum e. V.
additional: The event includes various race distances for all age groups and is a popular regional event in the Krummhörn region.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - červenec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps around a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant will be rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each runner, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Registration is held on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00 AM. The race can be completed on foot, by bike, rollerblades, or car. The route is on the road, 3.2 km long, and suitable for all age groups.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - červenec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. Timing is recorded for each runner, and results are published online.
course_highlights: The course runs along the asphalt paths of Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km + 70 m)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, roller skates, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents and a non-guarded storage area for belongings, as well as mobile lockers for valuables. WC cabins are available on site. The race time, adjusted by age coefficient, counts towards the annual Pancake Cup. The race takes place in Stromovka Park, registration is voluntary, with a start at 9:07 AM. There are changing rooms and toilets, and parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island.

name: Třtická punčocha
description: Třtická Punčocha is a traditional summer running race held since 1980 in the village of Třtice, always on the first Sunday of July. The race is 8.8 km long and attracts runners from all over Bohemia. Originally intended for children, today it offers categories for adults based on age and gender. In addition to the summer run, a Christmas run of 4.8 km is also held in the village on December 26. The races are popular and have a long-standing tradition with results and photos archived on the village's website.
course_highlights: Distance of 8.8 km in the summer run
Categories based on age and gender (A, B, C, D, E)
Traditional race organized since 1980 in the pleasant environment of Třtice
additional: The race is divided into categories based on age and gender: Category A up to 39 years, B 40-49 years, C 50-59 years, D over 60 years, E women. Results and photos from previous years are available on the website. In addition to the run, there is a children's playground and sports facilities, a tennis court, and a community hall, which was renovated in 2024/2025. The race offers various age categories, including children and adults, and is part of the local sports calendar. Results and photos are regularly published on the official website.

name: Náchod - Dobrošov
description: Military Fortress Dobrošov is located near the town of Náchod in the Kladské Pomezí area in the Orlické Mountains. The fortress is an important part of Czechoslovakia's border fortifications and offers visitors tours of the main bunkers, ammunition depot, barracks, and infirmary. An educational trail runs through the entire fortress, guiding visitors along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa. The surrounding area is rich in hiking and cycling trails, allowing visitors to explore the beauty of the Orlické Mountains and nearby historic towns.
course_highlights: Tour of artillery bunkers and fortifications from the Czechoslovak border defense period
Educational trail Fortress Dobrošov running along the line of fortifications to Běloves Spa
Hiking and cycling trails in the area with views and access to other military fortresses
additional: Parking at the fortress is free. The visitor center, including restrooms, closes 60 minutes before the end of opening hours. There are 171 steps leading to the underground, with a constant temperature of 6°C. Group size is limited to a maximum of 28 people. The last tour begins 90 minutes before closing. Accommodation options in family pensions and mountain hotels are available in Deštná in the Orlické Mountains. The race is part of the regional sports calendar, with participants able to use the surrounding hiking and cycling trails. Exact registration details and race length have not yet been published.

name: MUM - Moravský Ultramaraton / Cimrmanova etapa
location: Lomnice u Tišnova, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: MUM - Moravian Ultramarathon / Cimrmanova stage is the final seventh stage of the international stage race held in Lomnice u Tišnova. The race offers a challenging and diverse terrain with an elevation gain of 740 meters, presenting a challenge for experienced ultramarathon runners. The start is interval-based according to the order from the previous six races, which increases competitiveness and tension. This race is ideal for runners seeking a combination of technical difficulty and stage racing in the beautiful nature of South Moravia.
course_highlights: Challenging and diverse terrain
Elevation gain of 740 meters
Interval start based on the order from previous stages
additional: The race is the final stage of the international stage race with an interval start based on the order from the previous six races. The start location is at the elementary school in Lomnice u Tišnova. Challenging terrain, interval start, part of a stage race.

name: Grill Run=Fun 2026
description: Grill+Run=Fun 2026 is a race organized in Palowice that combines athletic competition with a friendly atmosphere and fun. The event starts at 08:00, and participants can expect professional RFID timing measurement and comprehensive technical support. The event is organized by the LUXTORPEDA Association, which guarantees high-quality organization and support for runners. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and feel the spirit of sports community.
course_highlights: Professional RFID timing measurement
Start and finish in Palowice
Organized by the experienced LUXTORPEDA Association
additional: The race offers professional timing using RFID technology, an electronic LED clock at the finish line, and results available live on time-sport.pl. The organizer also provides the possibility to rent race numbers and chips and to prepare personalized certificates for participants. Event date: 2026-07-04; Location: Palowice; Registration deadline: 2026-07-01; Participant requirements: own water bottle; The course covers approximately 82.5 km (11 laps).

name: XXIV Atlantis Bieg Opolski
location: Wyspa Bolko, Opole, Opole County, Poland
description: The 24th Atlantis Opole Race is an annual run held since 2003 on the first Saturday of July on Bolko Island in Opole. The race route runs through a designated zone of silence and greenery in the city center, offering participants the opportunity to compete over distances of 5 km and 10 km. Since 2015, the race has been called Atlantis Opole Race, thanks to the support of Atlantis-Deweloper. The event is organized by the Opole Running Association, which promotes physical activity and sports integration within the local community.
course_highlights: Route on Bolko Island - a green and quiet zone in the center of Opole
Two distance options: 5 km and 10 km
Race takes place on the first Saturday of July, traditionally since 2003
additional: Volunteers support the organization of the race in various teams, including the race office, start/finish area, deposits, route security, and refreshment points. The association involves people of different ages and encourages cooperation in organizing the event. The event takes place in urban areas, including streets and parks, with registration available at designated locations. The race enjoys great interest from the local community and attracts participants from various regions.

name: Grill+Run-Fun
description: The 8H GRF 'Szychta na Gichcie' Ultramarathon is a unique running event held on forest trails of the Palowice Lake District. The competition lasts 8 hours, during which participants face endurance challenges and enjoy contact with nature. The event is organized by the Luxtorpeda Association and attracts long-distance endurance enthusiasts. The event also features races for children, emphasizing its family-friendly character. The start and finish are located at the Orzeł Palowice sports field.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Palowice Lake District
Time format - an 8-hour race
Family races for children during the event
additional: Participants must have their own water bottle or cup. The race office is open from 6:15 AM, technical briefing at 7:45 AM. The race starts at 8:00 AM and ends at 4:00 PM. Award ceremonies are planned for 4:30/5:00 PM. During the event, children's races in memory of Jacek Kostrzewa are also organized. The event includes grilling and participant integration, online registration is available, and the route runs through picturesque forest areas of Palowice.

name: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny
description: Kaliski Półmaraton Nocny Bursztynowa Hellena is a unique night half marathon held in Kalisz. The event attracts hundreds of runners from various cities, offering a unique atmosphere and a running challenge during nighttime hours. The half marathon route takes runners through charming parts of the city, providing unforgettable experiences. The event has its tradition and is very popular among amateur and professional runners.
course_highlights: Night run through the streets of Kalisz
Half marathon course length (21.097 km)
Sporting celebration atmosphere with hundreds of runners
additional: Start at 10:00 PM, the run lasts until 2:00 AM. The list of confirmed participants is available online. The event has a limited number of spots, currently over 860 participants confirmed. The event includes a half marathon, with the route passing through sports facilities and streets of Kalisz. Registration is online, and participants can expect a well-organized event with rich accompanying activities.

name: Mam Marzenie 12.RAZ 25h RUN
organizer: Fundacja Mam Marzenie oraz Ruchowa Akademia Zdrowia (RAZ Szczecin)
description: 25h RUN is a unique running event organized by the Mam Marzenie Foundation, which combines sport with charity. The anniversary, 10th edition of the race, takes place by Lake Arkonka in Szczecin and aims to fulfill the dream of Marleny, a beneficiary, to travel to the island of Zakynthos. Participants run for 25 hours, and each kilometer covered brings them closer to achieving this goal. It is not only a sports challenge but also an opportunity to work together for children in need.
course_highlights: The race lasts 25 hours, which is a unique endurance challenge
The route is located by the picturesque Lake Arkonka in Szczecin
The event combines physical activity with a charity action to fulfill children's dreams
additional: The organizer is the Mam Marzenie Foundation, which has fulfilled over 10,000 children's dreams since 2004. The event is charitable, and each kilometer run contributes to realizing the dream of a beneficiary. Registration is available on the external website https://raz.szczecin.pl/. The event supports fundraising to fulfill a child's dream, registration is done via the website, and participants can count on support and motivation during the all-day run.

name: VI Półmaraton Gęstwinami Murckowskimi
location: Murcki Forest, Katowice, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 5th Gęstwinami Murckowskimi Half Marathon is a race organized by the W Kręgu Natury Association, taking place in the picturesque forests of Murcek in Katowice. The half marathon route runs through varied forest terrains, offering participants contact with nature and a unique atmosphere. The event is an excellent opportunity for active outdoor recreation, suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Organizers provide convenient public transportation access and parking near the start.

Access to a change zone for relay teams

Date: 2026-07-04; location: Katowice; information about training and preparations.

name: XI Janikowska ZaDyszka
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Janikowie
description: The 11th Janikowska ZaDyszka is an annual street race organized in Janikowo, attracting runners from various age groups and skill levels. The event takes place on a 10 km route, providing participants with professional timing measurement using Chronotrack technology. The event is organized by the Janikowo Sports and Recreation Center, and timing is handled by STS-Timing, ensuring high reliability and organizational support. The race is open and friendly to all physical activity enthusiasts.

Professional timing measurement with active Chronotrack chips
Organized by the local Sports and Recreation Center

No information about wave starts, participant limits, or additional services. Date: 2026-07-04, location: Janikowo, event aimed at runners of various skill levels.

name: XI Krokowska 10
description: The 11th Kraków 10K is one of the events within the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series, taking place on July 4th in Żarnowiec. The race offers a 10 km distance that runs through the picturesque areas of Kashubia, combining athletic competition with the beauty of the region. The Kaszuby Biegają series is the largest running event in northern Poland, promoting physical activity and local culture. Participants can expect professional organization and unique medals assembled from individual stages.
course_highlights: Picturesque routes of Kashubia
10 km distance in northern Poland terrain
Part of the Kaszuby Biegają series with a unique assembled medal
additional: The Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series includes 11 events in various locations across the region. Participants can collect unique medal elements by running distances of 5 km and 10 km. There is also an option to participate in Nordic Walking races at selected stages. Shorter distances from 400 to 800 meters are prepared for children. Registration is available on the portal zapisy.info. The 10 km race, options for local runners, and virtual participation will be available with registration starting from December 2025. The event commemorates Jacek Bandurski.

name: XXVI Bieg o Kryształową Perłę Jeziora Na...
location: Kretowiny, Gmina Rybno, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 26th National Run for the Crystal Pearl of Lake Narie is the main race covering a distance of 31.13 km, held in a picturesque location by Lake Narie in Kretowiny. The start and finish are located at the Main Beach in Kretowiny. The event includes age categories for men and women, and participants can look forward to a ceremonial opening and closing of the race with award ceremonies. The event is nationwide and attracts runners from various age groups.
course_highlights: Distance of 31.13 km by Lake Narie
Start and finish at the Main Beach in Kretowiny
Age categories for men and women
additional: Registration and distribution of start packages take place from 8:00 to 9:30. The ceremonial opening of the race is at 9:50, and the closing with award ceremonies is around 14:30 at the stage near the Main Beach. The race is held on the main beach in Kretowiny, with an award ceremony and participant registration on site; the event is part of the Crystal Pearl Run series.

name: Dorfener Stadtlauf
organizer: Förderkreis Dorfen e.V. und die Stadt Dorfen
description: The 23rd Dorfener City Run will take place on July 5, 2026, offering runners the choice between 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, which has been part of the program since 2023. The routes lead through the green Isental, a peaceful landscape that is only occasionally interrupted by music pieces. The finish line at the town square is accompanied by many spectators and forms the highlight of the race. Additionally, there are popular children's runs, making the city run an event for all age groups.
course_highlights: Route through the green Isental
Quiet natural sections with musical accompaniment
Finish at the lively town square of Dorfen
additional: Practice run on June 16 at 7 PM at the Dorfen Market Church; children's runs included in the program; finish line under many spectators at the town square; organizer is the Förderkreis Dorfen e.V.; race distances: 5 km, 10 km, half marathon; start at Unterer Marktplatz; passes through the Isental; children's runs available

name: Dorflauf TSV Wiera
description: The 6th Village Run TSV Wiera will take place on July 5, 2026, in Schwalmstadt and is officially registered with the German Athletics Association. The event offers races over 600 meters and 10 kilometers. The results will be included in the official athletics rankings, making the competition particularly attractive for ambitious runners. The race is held in typical July weather with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions.
course_highlights: Distances: 600 m and 10 km
Official registration with the German Athletics Association
Results are recorded in official rankings
additional: Typical July weather: around 25°C, low of 15°C, 75 mm average precipitation, mostly sunny weather in July: approx. 25°C, sunny; start location in Schwalmstadt; results are included in official rankings

name: Eselsburger-Tal-Lauf
description: The 28th Eselsburger Tal Run will take place on July 5, 2026, in Herbrechtingen and is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. The varied courses lead through the scenic landscape of the Eselsburger Valley and offer ideal conditions for both ambitious athletes and recreational runners. Especially the youngest can compete in the Bambini run and school run, while the half marathon, as the main discipline, covers two laps in the nature reserve. In addition to the sporting competition, the focus is on a shared experience with a friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Courses through the scenic Eselsburger Valley
Half marathon with two laps in the nature reserve
Children's runs for Bambinis (500 m) and school children (800 m)
additional: Start times: Bambini run at 8:30 AM, school runs from 8:50 AM, 5.5 km / 10 km / half marathon from 9:15 AM. Race number pickup on July 4 from 1:00 PM to 4:00 PM and on July 5 from 7:00 AM. Electronic timing with disposable transponder. Changing rooms and showers in the Neue Bibrishalle. Medical services provided by Bergwacht Herbrechtingen. Award ceremony and raffle with valuable prizes after the competitions. Courses from 500 m to half marathon, family-friendly, nature reserve, various running disciplines.

name: Eßlinger Zeitung Lauf
description: The Esslinger Zeitung Run, also called EZ Run, is a traditional community race in Esslingen am Neckar that has been held annually since 1999. Organized by the Esslinger Zeitung and TSG Esslingen, it is the largest amateur sports event in the Esslingen district. Since 2003, the main race has been over a 10 km course, which runs on a 2.5 km loop through the city center and is considered challenging due to cobblestone passages. In addition to the main race, there are also children’s and students’ runs. The EZ Run is a member of the German Road Races.
course_highlights: 10 km main race on a 2.5 km loop through the city center of Esslingen
Course with cobblestone passages, making it challenging
Children’s and students’ runs as part of the program
additional: The main race was shortened to 7.5 km in 2015 due to extreme heat. The course is measured according to DLV guidelines with the Jones-Counter. Main race over 10 km, member of the German Road Races, event since 1999

name: Kraftsolmser Dorflauf
description: The Kraftsolmser Village Run is a popular running event in Kraftsolms that attracts runners from the region and beyond. The event offers challenging courses over 5.4 km and 10.4 km, which run through the community. The race is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and sporting challenges, as evidenced by multiple course record breaks. The start traditionally takes place at the village square in Kraftsolms, and the event is increasingly popular with participants.
course_highlights: Challenging courses over 5.4 km and 10.4 km
Start and finish at the village square in Kraftsolms
Course records on the 5.4 km distance
additional: The race takes place at the village square in Kraftsolms. The event attracts over 130 participants, including many from the community of Waldsolms and neighboring communities. There is strong participation from local clubs and runners. The event is part of an inclusive sports program of the club Sportfreunde Kraftsolms. The race is held mainly on asphalted roads and field paths, with safety measures provided by the fire brigade. There are various registration options, including online registration, on-site registration, and registration on the event day. The event is a well-established community event with a sporting character.

name: Neuendettelsauer Kirchweihlauf - 10 KM DLV-genehmigt
description: The 27th Neuendettelsauer Kirchweihlauf is a DLV-approved 10-kilometer race taking place on July 5, 2026, in the town center of Neuendettelsau. The event is organized by the BLV Kreis Ansbach and hosted by the TSC Neuendettelsau Athletics Department. The race offers an attractive course for runners of all ages and performance levels in the Middle Franconia region. Registration is possible until June 30, 2026.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer course in the town center of Neuendettelsau
DLV-approved race with official timing
Event in the Middle Franconia region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Registration until June 30, 2026, the race takes place in the town center of Neuendettelsau, typical summer weather around 25°C.

name: Petersberg Berg-Crosslauf

The event offers races for various age groups, from toddler runs to school children, as well as main and hobby runs. Timing is electronic, and late registration is possible up to 60 minutes before the start. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a comprehensive supporting program with catering, games and fun for children, as well as an award ceremony with prizes for the fastest participants.
course_highlights: New trail course for 5.2 km and 10.0 km
Electronic timing with online access to times, certificates, and finish line videos
Various races for all age groups from toddler runs to main race
additional: Late registration is possible up to 60 minutes before the start of each competition. Timing is carried out electronically by SAS-Zeitmesssysteme GmbH with online access to times, certificates, and finish line videos. There is an award ceremony with prizes for overall and age group rankings. Catering includes coffee, cake, snacks, and sausages. Medals are awarded to toddlers immediately at the finish line. Trail course, children's program, supporting program, catering, late registration up to 60 minutes before start.

name: Stadtlauf Wolfratshausen
description: The Wolfratshausen City Run is a flat, officially measured loop course through the historic old town of Wolfratshausen, ideal for personal best times. The race offers a variety of options including a 10 km main run, a 5 km hobby run, and relay competitions for all age and performance levels. The event is part of the Raiffeisen Oberland Challenge and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere with prizes for children and team competitions. The 25th City Run will take place on July 5, 2026, and warmly invites runners to participate.

Course runs through the Wolfratshausen old town
Offers including 10 km main run, 5 km hobby run, and relay competitions

name: SVE-Steinwiesenlauf
description: The Steinwiesenlauf of SV Eidelstedt Hamburg is a popular running event that attracts numerous participants annually. The event offers various races for all age groups, from toddler runs to school children and main races of 5 km and 10 km. The course includes a section over a highway bridge and features exciting competitions with a family-friendly atmosphere. The race traditionally takes place on the weekend and has seen increasing participant numbers.
course_highlights: Toddler run with a full stadium lap
School children race with double crossing of the highway bridge
5 km and 10 km main races with exciting competitions
additional: The toddler run starts at 9:00 AM, followed by the school children race at 9:15 AM. The event is family-friendly with medal ceremonies and mascots. The number of participants has increased significantly in recent years, with a record of 350 registrations at the fifth edition. Multiple competitions, including children and youth races as well as main races for adults; the event takes place in Ellerbek; sold out in 2026 with 350 participants.

description: The 44th VR-Bank Run "Around the Veste Coburg" on July 5, 2026, is one of the most popular running events in the Coburg region. The main race over 10 km leads through the idyllic Hofgarten, past the impressive Veste Coburg, to the airfield, and back to the sports grounds of TV 1848 Coburg. In addition to the main race, there is a 1.6 km children's and youth run as well as a 400 m Bambini run for the youngest participants. The event offers a lively atmosphere with refreshment stations and a fan mile, providing extra motivation for the runners.

Refreshment station at kilometer 3.5 at the airfield
Fan mile at kilometer 8 for additional motivation

Flat course on city and club grounds.

name: VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrücker Staffelmarathon
location: Schloss- und Rosengarten, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The VW - THIEL Rheda-Wiedenbrück Relay Marathon is a traditional relay marathon taking place on July 5, 2026, in the castle and rose garden in Rheda-Wiedenbrück. The flat, well-maintained course runs over a two-kilometer loop through the historic castle park, which is to be completed 21 times. The event is organized by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which has been hosting this relay marathon since 2013 and has built an engaged running community. The relay marathon offers runners an attractive and varied running route without disruptive street crossings in a beautiful park landscape.
course_highlights: Flat, well-maintained 2 km loop through the castle park
Start and finish in the rose garden with a view of the historic castle
No disruptive street crossings on the course

The event is organized by LG Burg Wiedenbrück, which also conducts other running events. Photos and videos of past relay races are available on the website. Registration is via my.raceresult.com, and the race is part of a relay marathon; results are available on the day of the event.

name: Wilhelmsfelder Kerwelauf
description: The Wilhelmsfelder Kerwelauf takes place on July 5, 2026, for the 24th time and offers runners and walkers various routes in the beautiful landscape around Wilhelmsfeld. The start is at the Odenwaldhalle at an altitude of 365 meters, from where the races lead over varied paths with inclines and refreshment stations. The timing is done electronically using a chip on the bib number. The event is traditional and is aimed at runners of all ages who want to enjoy the magnificent air and scenic charms of the air spa town.

Routes with challenging inclines, including to the 500 m high Prinzensitz and the highest point Holzapfelbaum (505 m)
Refreshment stations along the route, e.g., at 2 km, Prinzensitz, and Sitzbuch-Hütte

name: Širokodolská časovka

The start is interval-based every minute from 10:00 AM, with registration taking place on-site from 8:45 to 9:45. After the run, there is a cycling discipline, which is not part of the running cup. The entry fee is a symbolic 50 CZK, making the race accessible to the general public.
