name: Aichacher Stadtlauf
description: The Aichach City Run is a traditional running event organized by LC Aichach for over 40 years. The event offers races for various age groups and skill levels, including school and youth runs as well as competitions through the historic old town of Aichach. The races take place in the Wittelsbacher Land and are characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and good organization. Training opportunities for preparation are offered at the Landkreisstadion.
course_highlights: Runs through the historic old town of Aichach
Various distances for children, youth, and adults
Training opportunities at Josef-Bestler-Stadion
additional: Preparatory training evenings at Landkreisstadion on 03.06.2026 and 17.06.2026 from 6:30 PM. Children's training on Friday in the Vierfachturnhalle. Registration for championships is via Mathias Bronner (mbronner@gmx.net). The event also includes training sessions in June 2026 and other local running events. Registration and detailed information should be inquired with the organizer.

name: Alb-Run Heroldstatt
location: Sportzentrum Heroldstatt, Bannholz 10, Heroldstatt, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
organizer: SC Heroldstatt e.V. in Kooperation mit SUN Sportmanagement GmbH

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Startgebühr beträgt für beide Strecken 36,00 EUR.

description: The Sparkassen Alb-Run in Heroldstatt is a running event for endurance athletes taking place on July 11, 2026. The varied course leads through the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Swabian Alb with beautiful landscapes, small trails, and a reasonable amount of elevation gain. There are two attractive distances to choose from: 9 km and 16 km. The event offers professional timing, on-course refreshments, finish line refreshments, baggage storage, showers, and a supporting program for a comprehensive running experience.
course_highlights: Run through the UNESCO Biosphere Reserve Swabian Alb
Varied course with small trails and approximately 350 meters of elevation gain
Two distances: 9 km (orange markers) and 16 km (blue markers)
additional: Start and distribution of race packets at the Heroldstatt Sports Center. Race packets can be picked up on July 10, 2026, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on July 11, 2026, from 11:00 to 12:30. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible on-site on July 11, 2026, from 11:00 to 12:30, subject to availability. Timing is done with ankle transponders, which must be returned before leaving the finish area. The course is marked with white-red streamers and colored arrows. Baggage storage is available in the finish area. Showers and charging stations are available. Fans are welcome as pedestrians and cyclists on the course. Trail race with scenic highlights, small trails, and elevation gain; start on July 11, 2026, at 13:00 at the Heroldstatt Sports Center, Bannholz 10.

name: Bad Buchauer Stadtlauf mit Federseehalbmarathon
description: The 25th Bad Buchau City Run with Federsee Half Marathon will take place on July 11, 2026, offering runners a varied experience. The half marathon route leads through the historic city center of Bad Buchau, the spa park, and the largest nature reserve in southwest Germany around Lake Federsee. The course is mostly flat with an elevation difference of approximately 35 meters and runs partly on asphalt, partly on gravel paths, as well as about 1 km of wooden walkway through a pristine primeval forest. Along the route, several refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit are set up.
course_highlights: Half marathon route around Lake Federsee in the largest nature reserve in southwest Germany
Start and finish in the historic city center of Bad Buchau with two small laps through the city and spa park
Approximately 1 km long wooden walkway through pristine primeval forest
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day until 30 minutes before the respective start. Late registration fee: €5 for half marathon and 10 km run, €3 for 5 km run. Race documents can be picked up from 07:00 at the race office in the foyer of the Bad Buchau spa center. Along the route, there are 8 refreshment stations with water; at Seekirch (km 12) and at the finish, additional isotonic drinks and fruit are offered. Parking and footpath maps to shower facilities are available. Course maps, online registration, late registration on race day, parking, refreshment stations, scenic wooden walkway.

name: Bahnstadtlauf 2026
price_range: 11€ für Erwachsene, 5€ für Kinder und Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für Kinder und Jugendliche unter 16 Jahren

description: The Bahnstadtlauf in Heidelberg is a family-friendly race with various distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The event takes place as part of the Bahnstadt Festival and offers exciting races as well as live music and catering. The courses run through the Bahnstadt, with short-term changes possible due to construction work. The races include children's runs, school runs, as well as 5 km and 10 km races with age group classifications.
course_highlights: Course through the Bahnstadt Heidelberg
Children's and school runs with age-appropriate distances (1.1 km and 2.2 km)
5 km and 10 km races with age group classification and award ceremony
additional: Registration and bib distribution are possible from 16:00 to 17:30. Late registrations are accepted until 45 minutes before the respective start with a late registration fee of €4, provided there are still starting places available. Award ceremonies take place after each race. During the Bahnstadt Festival, there will be live bands and catering on site. Course changes possible due to construction work, timing with Race Result, multiple race categories, start times from 17:30.

name: Bergheide-Cross 2026
description: The SCB Langendamm invites you to the 4th Bergheide-Cross 2026. The course runs from the access road of the shooting range of the local small-bore rifle club through the recreational and landscape protection area "Osterberg". The race offers three distances for different evaluation and age groups, as well as walking on the shorter route. Additionally, there is a student race over 1000 meters for children and adolescents. The event is approved by the DLV and takes place on July 11, 2026, starting at 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Course through the landscape protection area "Osterberg"
Start at the access road of the shooting range of the local small-bore rifle club
Three distances: 10.4 km, 5.2 km, and 1000 m student race
additional: The 1000-meter student race is for children and adolescents aged 6 to 14, and registration is only on-site and free of charge. The 5.2 km race is open from age 14, and the 10.4 km route from age 16. The main race starts at 5:00 PM, and the student race begins at 4:00 PM. Walking is offered on the shorter route. Free registration for the student race on-site, race in the Osterberg nature area, family-friendly event.

name: Crosslauf Fichtenau
price_range: 13 Euro für den Crosslauf, 10 Euro für den Jedermannslauf, 3 Euro Nachmeldegebühr
description: The cross-country race in Fichtenau is a traditional running event taking place on July 11, 2026, as part of the Festival at the Lake. The event offers two varied courses through the beautiful community of Fichtenau: a fun run over 5.2 km for everyone who enjoys movement, and a challenging cross-country race over 10 km for sporting challenges. The races are held in the so-called "Magic Triangle" of Crailsheim/Dinkelsbühl/Ellwangen and attract runners of all ages. The organizing team looks forward to numerous participants and offers convenient registration with SEPA direct debit.
course_highlights: Two varied running courses through the community of Fichtenau
Fun run over 5.2 km ideal for recreational athletes
Cross-country race over 10 km as a sporting challenge
additional: Registration closes 30 minutes before the start. Late registrations on the event day incur an additional fee of 3 euros. The entry fees can be conveniently paid via SEPA direct debit. Race distances: 5.2 km and 10 km, registration until July 8, 2026, start at the Festival at the Lake, sporting challenge, online registration possible

name: Dietfurter 7-Täler-Lauf
location: Sportplatz der 7-Täler-Halle, Dietfurt an der Altmühl, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 33rd 7-Täler-Lauf in Dietfurt an der Altmühl will take place on July 11, 2026, and is a traditional race that counts as a scoring event for the BLSV-Läufercup 2026. For the first time, there is an option to participate in the walking category. Also new is the Team-Fun Run, where teams of at least three people compete for prizes for the fastest team, the coolest outfit, and the lucky loser. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with race number distribution, changing rooms, and showers in the 7-Täler-Halle, as well as medals for children and awards for the best in each age group.
course_highlights: Run through seven valleys in the scenic surroundings of Dietfurt
First-time availability of walking category
Team-Fun Run with special prizes for teams
additional: Late registrations are possible on July 11, 2026, from 15:30 until one hour before the start at the 7-Täler-Halle, with a late registration fee of 5€. Race number distribution, changing rooms, and showers are located in the 7-Täler-Halle. Children receive a medal immediately after crossing the finish line. Team scoring is only possible with group registration. The race takes place on July 11, 2026, at 16:00, at the sports field of the 7-Täler-Halle. No information on prices or registration is provided.

name: LAUF10
description: LAUF10! is a training project of the Bavarian Athletics Association designed to get couch potatoes fit for a 10-kilometer run in ten weeks. The program is aimed at everyone who wants to run from zero to ten kilometers and has already inspired many thousands of participants. In addition to running, there is an official fan shirt that can be ordered. LAUF10! promotes the joy of running and fitness within a supportive community.
course_highlights: 10 kilometer running course
Training program over ten weeks
Official functional shirt as a fan item
additional: The official LAUF10! shirt (functional shirt by ERIMA) can be ordered for 24.90 euros plus shipping. Shipping will begin no earlier than the end of March. LAUF10! is a project of the Bavarian Athletics Association with extensive partner associations and training offers. Training starts on 27.04.2026, final run on 11.07.2026 in Wolnzach, specifically designed for beginners.

name: Sauerborner Laufabend
description: The Sauerborner Laufabend is an established running event in Bad Soden-Neuenhain, taking place on July 11, 2026. The races start and end at the Sauerborn sports field and lead over a profiled course with asphalted field and paved forest paths. Two distances are offered, 5 km and 10 km, open to different age groups. The event is family-friendly and offers changing rooms and shower facilities in the nearby sports hall.
course_highlights: Profiled course over asphalted field and paved forest paths
Start and finish at Sauerborn sports field
Elevation profile of the course available
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start without a late registration fee. Race documents can be collected from 4 p.m. at the sports field. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall at Sauerborn. Limited parking spaces at the sports field. Animals, scooters, inline skates, skateboards, bicycles, and Nordic walking poles are not allowed on the course. Participation is at your own risk. The course runs over asphalted field and forest paths; registration until July 9, 2025; limited parking; changing rooms and showers available; observe safety rules.

name: Sidonia-Escape-Lauf
description: The Escape Walk "Sidonia 1639" is an exciting outdoor team event in Kelberg, ideal for friends, families, and birthday celebrations. Over a course of approximately 4 km in the nearby forest, participants are tasked with supporting Sidonia in the year 1639 during the turmoil of the Thirty Years' War by solving mysterious clues. The game lasts between 2.5 and 3 hours and is suitable for participants aged 9 to 99. Participants solve challenging tasks at seven puzzle locations and experience a fascinating story full of secrets and adventures. The start and finish are at the family swimming pool in Kelberg, and the necessary game backpacks are issued at the town hall.
course_highlights: Approximately 4 km long adventure trail in the forest
7 puzzle locations with mystical clues
Start and finish at the family swimming pool Kelberg
additional: The game can be booked for 2 to 8 people per team. There are 5 puzzle backpacks available, which are handed out at different times to maintain the mystical atmosphere. The event takes place from March to October in good weather and requires sturdy footwear and appropriate outdoor clothing. Tips and solutions are included in the backpack. The game is played at your own risk. Free parking is available at the town hall and swimming pool. The Escape Walk event is seasonal, running from March to October, weather-dependent, and requires sturdy footwear. The running event will take place in July 2026; details about distances and registration are available on the race registration page.

name: Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf
price_range: Spende zugunsten der Kinder- und Jugendarbeit des SCO
description: The Tanzenhaider Weiherlauf is a traditional race in Oberreichenbach scheduled for July 11, 2026. The course runs through scenic landscapes with ponds, forests, and historic paths, offering a varied and natural running experience. There are different competitions for participants of all ages, including the main race, youth and children’s runs, as well as Nordic walking. The event provides not only a sporting challenge but also Franconian specialties and a family-friendly atmosphere with award ceremonies and on-site medical services.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports home Oberreichenbach
The race course passes the community pond and the picturesque village of Tanzenhaid
Sections with forest paths, historic trade routes, and several ponds
additional: Pre-registrations until June 13 receive a free T-shirt. Entry fees are debited via direct debit, with refunds available up to two weeks before the event. Late registrations are to be paid in cash with an additional fee. Catering includes Franconian specialties and a salad buffet at the sports home. Medical services are provided by BRK. Results lists and certificates are available online. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The 10 km main race can be registered for online with direct debit; a T-shirt is included if registered by June 13. Refreshments include water. The event features a night run with effects, creative relay and costume competitions.

name: Taubertaltrail
description: The Taubertal Trail is a spectacular trail running event that takes participants through the breathtaking landscapes of the three valleys in the Taubertal. The event invites runners of all performance levels to test their limits and experience nature on challenging courses. Organized by SC Adelshofen e. V., the Taubertal Trail offers a unique combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty.
course_highlights: Run through three picturesque valleys in the Taubertal
Marked trails with varied terrain
Stunning natural and landscape views
additional: Mandatory equipment from 11 km: at least 0.5 liters of liquid, own cup or flask, mobile phone with emergency numbers, ID and health insurance card, weather-appropriate clothing and suitable footwear. Wear race bib visibly at the front. Trail markings may be missing due to weather conditions; a GPX file is recommended. Waste disposal only allowed in refreshment zones. Medical care provided by medical services, fire brigade, and course marshals along the route. Distances range from 5 km to 60 km, including trail and hike disciplines, with a children's trail and diverse terrain through fields, meadows, forests, and vineyards. Participants receive medals, certificates, showers, and on-site catering.

name: X-treme Battle Heroldstatt
description: The X-treme Battle Heroldstatt is a challenging obstacle course and trail run on the Swabian Alb that tests strength, endurance, and willpower. Participants can choose between an obstacle course with exciting challenges and an adrenaline rush or a varied cross-country run without obstacles over a 16 km route with approximately 350 meters of elevation. The course leads through the natural landscapes of the Swabian Alb with beautiful scenery and small trails. A real highlight for endurance athletes and teams who want to compete together.
course_highlights: 16 km long route with approx. 350 meters of elevation
Varied course with small trails and beautiful landscapes
Top-class obstacle course with exciting challenges
additional: Start and distribution of race materials at the Heroldstatt Sports Center. Distribution times: Friday 18:00 - 20:00, Saturday 12:00 - 14:00. Parking in the Heroldstatt industrial area, access to the sports center is closed during the event. Drinks and catering are provided. There is also a Kids Battle on Sunday, 12.07.2025 at 14:30. Route: 16 km with approx. 350 meters of elevation, obstacles, trails, landscapes; start at Heroldstatt Sports Center; parking in the industrial area; race number distribution on 10.07.2026 and 11.07.2026.

name: Běhej lesy Klínovec
location: Vrcholek Klínovec, Krušné hory, Czech Republic
description: Run Forests Klínovec is a trail race in the Ore Mountains, taking place on July 11, 2026. The race offers various routes including short and long distances, as well as a charity race. The start is at the top of Klínovec with the option to take the cable car up and run down to the Klínovec Ski Area. The race is part of the international UTMB Index Races and features special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start at the top of Klínovec with a run down to the Ski Area
Speed section Conti Speed Section over 150 meters
500m finish straight Generali Investments Finish with timed segment
additional: The race is included in the UTMB Index Races with international points. The course features special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish with rewards for the fastest runners. The start is at the top of Klínovec with the possibility of taking the cable car up. The finish straight is extended to 500 meters and is timed for performance analysis. Routes include various lengths from 3 to 50 km, suitable for the general public including children, registration is possible on-site, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Libečovská 14
location: Podkozí, Libečov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Libečovská 14 is a race of 14.2 km with an elevation gain of approximately 170 meters, which runs on asphalt and terrain. This race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup and offers runners an interesting combination of asphalt and trail sections. The course is suitable for runners seeking a challenge with gentle inclines and varied surfaces. The race takes place in the picturesque area of Podkozí in the Central Bohemian Region and attracts runners from the wider surroundings.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 14.2 km
Elevation gain approx. 170 m
Course runs on asphalt and terrain
additional: The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup, offers a diverse course suitable for runners seeking a challenge, and takes place in the picturesque environment of Podkozí.

name: Králický Sněžník Beze stopy
location: Heřmanice u Králík, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Králický Sněžník BEZE STOPY is a challenging mountain run with a length of 14 km and an elevation gain of 1050 meters, taking place from Heřmanice through Klepáč and Malý Sněžník to the top of Králický Sněžník. The course offers beautiful ridge runs with views into the Polish Kladská Basin and the Dolnomoravský Valley, including short and demanding descents. The race is intended for mountain terrain enthusiasts and is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Iscarex Cup. For younger runners, a shorter course of 5 km with an elevation gain of 440 meters is prepared. The main race starts at 9:30, and the junior race begins at 11:00.
course_highlights: Mountain trails with an elevation gain of 1050 m over 14 km
Ridge run with views into the Polish Kladská Basin and the Dolnomoravský Valley
Challenging descents and goat trail terrain
additional: The junior race starts at 11:00 with transportation to the start at 10:15 from the accreditation site. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Iscarex Cup. The event takes place on July 11, 2026, with online registration available from January 1, 2025. The start and finish are in Heřmanice u Králík, and the course includes border roads and goat trails, with a short asphalt section after the start.

name: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov
description: Hvězdonice - Ondřejov is an uphill race 5.75 km long with an elevation gain of 255 meters, starting in Hvězdonicích. This running race offers challenging terrain and beautiful views in the Central Bohemian Region. It is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in the form of ascent and wanting to test their strength in mountain running. The race is part of the Svět běhu running series and attracts runners from the surrounding area.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 5.75 km
Elevation gain 255 m
Start in Hvězdonicích
additional: The race is held regularly in July, registration and further information are not explicitly provided, but the event is well known among the running community in the region.

name: MiniTMMTR - TransMoravský Masochistický Terénní Běh
organizer: Česká atletická unie (ČAU) ve spolupráci s Tomášem Ruskem
description: MiniTMMTR is a challenging trail run of 100 km starting in Lomnice in the South Moravian Region. The route passes through beautiful areas of the Blansko District to Luleč, where there is a turnaround point, and then runs back along the same path. The race is part of the TransMoravian Masochistic Trail Run, known for its length, demanding profile, and usually warm weather in the summer. The run offers the opportunity to experience some of the most beautiful places in Moravia and enjoy running in the forest and on deserted roads. The race was founded by Czech ultramarathon runner Tomáš Rusek and humorously bears the name masochistic, reflecting its difficulty.
course_highlights: The route passes through beautiful areas of the Blansko District
Turnaround point in Luleč, run there and back
Running in the forest and on deserted roads
additional: Trail race, marked route, refreshment stations, online tracking option, registration and accommodation nearby

name: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka
description: Bukowiecka Dziesiątka is a 10 km race organized in Bukowiec, attracting runners eager to challenge a moderately difficult course. Every participant who crosses the finish line will receive a commemorative medal. The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec, ensuring organizational convenience. We invite all running enthusiasts to participate in this event, which combines sporting competition with a local atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km course in Bukowiec
Race office in the sports hall in Bukowiec
Commemorative medal for every finisher
additional: The race office is located in the sports hall in Bukowiec. Every runner who crosses the finish line receives a medal. There is an online registration form that allows quick contact with the organizer and system administrator. Registration is conducted online, the event is local, and results are available electronically.

name: X Świerczyniecki Bieg Uliczny
description: The 10th Swierczyniec Street Run for the Mayor's Cup is an annual running event organized in Swierczyniec. The race takes place on the streets of the town, with the start scheduled for 10:00 AM. The organizer is the Volunteer Fire Department of Swierczyniec, and the timing is professionally measured using RFID technology. The race attracts both local runners and sports enthusiasts from the surrounding area, offering exciting competition and community integration.
course_highlights: Street race in the picturesque town of Swierczyniec
Professional electronic timing with RFID technology
Start at 10:00 AM, July 11, 2026
additional: The race organizer is the Volunteer Fire Department of Swierczyniec. Registrations close on July 10, 2026, at 23:59. Timing is conducted electronically using RFID technology. Live results and personalized certificates with race times are available for download from the website. The event includes two distances: 5 km and 10 km, with the start at 10:00 AM.

name: 8. Barigauer Turmlauf
description: The Barigauer Tower Run is a traditional race in Oberhain near Königsee, taking place on July 12, 2026. The event offers runners an attractive course with scenic sections around the Barigauer Tower. The race is aimed at ambitious runners and running enthusiasts seeking a sporting challenge in a natural environment. The organization is carried out by the Königsee Running Club, which ensures a family-friendly atmosphere and smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Scenic course around the Barigauer Tower
Natural running paths in Oberhain (Königsee)
Traditional race with a family atmosphere

name: BÄRENFELS SOMMERTRAIL 63-KM mit MARATHON, HALBMARATHON und 11-KM
description: The BÄRENFELS SUMMER TRAIL on July 12, 2026, offers an unforgettable trail experience in the pristine nature of the Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park. The event includes four distances ranging from 11 km to 63 km with challenging elevation gains and takes place on a wild and romantic trail loop around Bärenfels. Runners and walkers can enjoy the diverse landscape of Nahesteig and look forward to an athletic adventure in a unique natural setting.
course_highlights: Wild and romantic trail loop around Nahesteig
Elevation gain from 350 to 1800 meters depending on the distance
Nature experience in Saarland-Hunsrück-Hochwald National Park
additional: Early start for walkers at 07:00 AM. Cut-off time for 42 km and 63 km at 8:00 PM. On-site registration possible for an additional 5€. Registration is done online via form with subsequent transfer of the organizer fee (IBAN provided after registration). Info via WhatsApp at 0151-111-988-00. Trail and nature run in Saarland/Pfalz National Park, online registration, start times at 09:00 AM, early start for walkers at 07:00 AM.

name: Dinkelsbühler Staffellauf
description: The Dinkelsbühl Relay Race takes place on July 12, 2026, in the historic old town of Dinkelsbühl. The relay consists of four runners, each completing approximately a 3-kilometer loop around the old town. The course passes landmarks such as the Old Promenade, the Wörnitztor gate, the city park, and the music pavilion, accompanied by an inclusive drumming group. There is also a Funtasia Kids-Run with age-appropriate circuits for children. The event offers not only a sporting competition but also a lively supporting program with music, a bouncy castle, and catering.
course_highlights: Loop around the historic old town approximately 3 km long
Passage by Wörnitztor gate and city park with music pavilion
Children's courses of 700 m and 1200 m on well-visible loops
additional: Start and finish are at the triple gymnasium Ulmer Weg 6, Dinkelsbühl. Distribution of start documents and late registration from 08:45 AM. Moderation and DJ entertainment from 09:00 AM. Warm-up for children before the Kids-Runs. After the relay race, award ceremony and raffle. The course is marked with arrows and well visible for spectators. There is a supporting program for children with a bouncy castle, free ice cream, coffee & cake, as well as food and drinks. The relay course was changed in 2025 and includes a sharp right turn at the highest point. Course: approximately 3 km loop; registration, award ceremony, raffle, catering; baton exchange with relay baton; start at the triple gymnasium Ulmer Weg 6.

name: Dodenauer Volkslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Gemeinschaft Eder (LG Eder) / TSV Dodenau

price_tiers.distance: Mittel- und Langstrecken (5 km und 10 km)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Mittel- und Langstrecken (5 km und 10 km)

description: The Dodenau Volkslauf is a recreational running event for everyone with start and finish at the multi-purpose hall Dodenau in Battenberg-Dodenau. The event offers various distances from children to half marathon as well as Nordic walking. To be included in the top list, membership in an athletics club or a LG is required. Registration is done online until about one week before the race, late registrations are possible at the start.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the multi-purpose hall Dodenau
Distances for children, short, medium, and long runs as well as half marathon
Nordic walking on 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registrations are possible at the start from 07:45 AM until 45 minutes before the respective start. For inclusion in the top list, the club or LG must be specified in the registration. Terrain: Multi-purpose hall Dodenau, online registration, various running distances, Nordic walking

name: int. Rosskopflauf
location: Heuweiler, Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 21st Rosskopflauf on July 12, 2026, in Heuweiler offers diverse running courses from 450 meters for children up to the challenging 18.4 km Rosskopflauf with 560 meters of elevation. Additionally, there is the 10 km Wildtalereck-Run, walking routes, as well as races for school children and youth. The event is part of the Black Forest Mountain Running Cup and the Black Forest Run Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated childcare for children and youth.
course_highlights: 18.4 km Rosskopflauf with 560 meters of elevation
10 km Wildtalereck-Run
Running courses from 450 m for children up to youth and walking routes
additional: Prizes are awarded to the overall winners of the Rosskopflauf, Wildtalereck-Run, and Run Cup, respectively for places 1-3. Children and youth also receive prizes for places 1-3. Adults forego material prizes in favor of a good cause. Child and youth supervision includes a sports program during the summer holidays. The race takes place in July, with typical warm and sunny weather. There are various distances, including children and youth competitions, and accommodations near the start/finish area. Registration is possible via the website.

name: Kappelseelauf Rentweinsdorf
description: The Kappelseelauf in Rentweinsdorf is a popular running event that has been held annually since 2008 and has become a fixed date for amateur runners. The event offers a diverse program for all age and performance groups, from children and school runs to Nordic walking and the half marathon. The varied routes lead through an idyllic natural landscape around Lake Kappelsee, the Hutseedamm with castle views, as well as Rentweinsdorf's main forest and Eichelberg. Refreshments are available along the course and at the finish line with drinks, fruit, cake, and bratwurst.
course_highlights: Routes around Lake Kappelsee and Hutseedamm with views of the Rotenhan family castle
Attractive running routes through Rentweinsdorf's main forest and Eichelberg
Idyllic natural landscape with varied and scenic profiles
additional: Registration and late entries on July 11, 2025, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM at the sports clubhouse and on race day from 7:30 AM. Late registration fee on race day is 3€. Parking is available directly at the sports grounds with signage. Showers and changing rooms are available on the sports field. All participants receive a drink voucher. Children and school runners receive a medal. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Races for all age and performance groups, refreshments and drinks at the finish line, bib number distribution on July 11 and 12, 2026, parking at the sports grounds, showers/changing rooms available, weather-dependent cancellation possible.

name: Monzinger Wingertslauf
description: The Monzingen Vineyard Run on July 12, 2026, offers two attractive race distances of 7.5 km and 15.5 km through the beautiful landscape around Monzingen. The routes mainly run on field paths and are profiled, with the longer route including a steep single-trail section. Walkers are also welcome on the 7.5 km route, with the emphasis on fun in sport. The event is easily accessible by train, and the award ceremony takes place at the club house at the sports field.
course_highlights: 7.5 km route with 145 m elevation gain, refreshment station at km 4
15.5 km route with 330 m elevation gain, two laps with a steep single-trail section of about 250 m per lap
Routes consist of 80% field paths and are profiled
additional: Late registrations are possible if not all 150 starting places are booked, with a 1 € late registration fee. The award ceremony takes place at the club house at the sports field, about 500 m on foot from the start/finish. Parking is available at the sports field. There are wine gifts for the top three men and women in both races as well as vouchers for a pizza evening for new course records. The journey can also be conveniently made by train, as Monzingen has a train station. Carpooling options are offered. Catering at certain kilometer points, well accessible by public transport, sponsored by Lauf-Abenteuer Marathonreisen.

name: Nußlocher Wiesenlauf
description: The Nußlocher Wiesenlauf is a traditional race event in Nußloch, held annually at the Max-Berk-Stadion and the surrounding region. The event offers races over 5.3 km and 10 km, which are circular courses on asphalt and forest paths. The 10 km route is measured and approved according to DLV guidelines, making the competition particularly attractive for ambitious runners. The event is well organized and hosted by the SG Nußloch Athletics Department, which also manages online registration and participant support.
course_highlights: 5.3 km and 10 km circular courses
Route over asphalt and forest paths
10 km route measured and approved according to DLV guidelines
additional: Online registration is available from 17.05. to 11.07., 22:00 via raceresult.com. The event location is the Max-Berk-Stadion at Rudolf-Harbig-Straße 2, 69226 Nußloch. Race distances are 5 km and 10 km, registration online from 17.05., bibs available at Marathonshop Wiesloch, including route map, results, and photos.

description: The 41st Pönitzer Volkslauf will take place on July 12, 2026, in Pönitz and invites runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers to a sporty and social event. The course leads through the charming landscape of Holsteinische Schweiz with romantic hedgerows, summer fields, and peaceful meadows. At Sportpark Pönitz, participants can expect a friendly atmosphere with refreshments, show performances, and an award ceremony. All participants will receive a commemorative medal, and there are attractive prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Landscape of Holsteinische Schweiz with hedgerows, fields, and meadows
Start and finish at Sportpark Pönitz with a summer atmosphere
Refreshments and show performances at the event location
additional: All participants receive a commemorative medal. The award ceremony begins at 11:15 AM with medals for overall winners (places 1-3) and trophies as well as certificates for age group winners and placers. Members of SVG Pönitz pay half of the entry fee. The event offers refreshments, show performances, and a friendly atmosphere for athletes, companions, and spectators. Runners can choose between half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and Nordic walking; start times from 8:30 AM; community and nature experience.

location: Vereinsgelände des TV Nöttingen, Nöttingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Running Race takes place on July 12, 2026, at the club grounds of TV Nöttingen. The race starts at 9:30 AM and offers a 5 km course for runners as well as Nordic walkers. Afterwards, all participants and visitors are invited to a communal lunch and a lively family afternoon with grilled food. The event is a great opportunity for sports enthusiasts and families to spend an active and social day together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the club grounds of TV Nöttingen
5 km race and 5 km Nordic walking course
Family-friendly program with lunch and entertainment
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 9 AM on site. The start of the 5 km race and Nordic walking is at 09:35 AM. After the race, there will be a communal lunch and a lively afternoon program for the whole family. Start at the club grounds, pre-registration from April 15 to July 9, 2026, late registrations on site until 9 AM are possible (registration fee + 2€).

description: The Düren City Run on July 12, 2026, offers a diverse running experience in the city center of Düren with competitions for children, hobby, and ambitious runners. The routes lead through urban passages, along the Rur River, and through green park areas, with start and finish lines centrally located at the marketplace. A highlight is the First or Burst eliminator race on a 500-meter loop course. All participants receive an official MIZUNO participant shirt, a finisher medal, and access to the finish line refreshments.
course_highlights: 5 km run: flat, varied course through the city center and along the Rur
10 km run: large city loop with lively city center sections and natural passages
First or Burst: eliminator race on a 500 m loop course in the city center
additional: The official MIZUNO participant shirt is mandatory and serves as start authorization. Electronic timing with online certificate. Finish line refreshments at Kaiserplatz for all finishers. The children's run is free and features a Kids Activity Area with various stations. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the competitions on the marketplace. Routes include the city center, children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and First or Burst; registration includes T-shirt, goodies, electronic timing, certificate, and refreshments; event at the marketplace with award ceremonies and partner activities.

description: The Steinenberger Forest Run is a traditional race event set in a picturesque forest landscape near Rudersberg. The event offers various distances from 2 km for students up to the half marathon, suitable for ambitious runners as well as families and beginners. The race is characterized by challenging, diverse courses with partly hilly terrain and is designed as a sporting summer event with a family-friendly character. Additionally, each participant's donation supports local clubs and institutions.
course_highlights: Various distances from 2 km to half marathon
Forest and nature courses with some challenging elevation gains
Family-friendly sports event with children's races and team competitions
additional: The race starts in waves with main runs at 9:00 AM, followed by Nordic walking and children's races. For youths aged 16 and above, there is a new 5 km leisure run with fewer elevation gains. €1.00 is donated per participant to local clubs and institutions. The student race (2 km) is free but requires registration. The event is conceived as a family festival with sports activities for all age groups. Multiple race distances, charity fundraising, family activities, online registration available.

name: Vierländer-Eck Lauf
location: Sportgelände VfB Bösingen, Bösingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Four-Country Corner Run in Bösingen is a running event featuring a main race, a middle-distance race, and a children's run, taking place on July 12, 2026. The course leads from the sports grounds of VfB Bösingen past the Four-Country Corner through the districts of Waldmössingen and Seedorf back to the starting point. The profile is hilly, and the route alternates between asphalt and gravel paths. Catering is provided along the course and at the finish area, and participants can shower at the sports clubhouse. The award ceremony will be held afterwards at the sports clubhouse.
course_highlights: Hilly profile with asphalt and gravel paths
Course passes the Four-Country Corner
Start and finish at the sports grounds of VfB Bösingen
additional: Catering along the course for main race participants and at the finish area for all runs. Each children's run participant receives a medal. Showers are available at the sports clubhouse. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a fee of 3 euros. Parking is available around the sports grounds. Registration is open until July 9, 2026, with late registration until 30 minutes before the start. Catering, showers at the sports clubhouse, award ceremony at the sports clubhouse, parking available.

name: S-Race
location: Kolonáda Ferdinandova pramene, Mariánské Lázně, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: S-Race is an OCR run in Mariánské Lázně, held in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade. The race offers courses of 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km, mainly along paved forest paths with more than 20 obstacles on one lap. There are races tailored for children according to age categories. The start and finish are located directly at the colonnade, where facilities such as changing rooms, toilets, a storage area, and refreshments are available. The race is suitable for a wide age range and features interval starts with a program for children during the main race.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs along paved forest paths
More than 20 obstacles on the 6 km loop, 40+ on the 12 km, 60+ on the 18 km
Start and finish in front of the Ferdinand Spring colonnade in Mariánské Lázně
additional: Interval start of the main race every 120 seconds for 5 runners, starting with the 18K course, then 12K and 6K. Registration and chip pickup on race day from 8:00 to 9:15 for the main race, from 12:30 to 13:45 for the children's race. Participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. Male and female changing rooms, toilets, storage, and refreshments are available. During the main race, a program for children is prepared. The terrain includes paved forest paths and obstacles; the race is open to the general public, including younger participants born in 2011 or later who need parental consent; the race takes place on July 12, 2026.

name: Koblížkový pasecký běh
location: Paseka u Olomouce, Olomouc District, Olomouc Region, Czech Republic
description: The Koblížkový Pasecký Run is a traditional road race in Paseka near Olomouc, offering a course length of 8.2 km. The race takes place on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths, passing through the village, along a cycle path to the sanatorium, and through the Odborný léčebný ústav park, returning to the start at the municipal office. The first categories start in the afternoon, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners and spectators. The event is organized by Ivan Elischer, who ensures smooth proceedings and support for the runners.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths
Passes through the village of Paseka and along a cycle path to the sanatorium
Includes the Odborný léčebný ústav park
additional: The race starts at the municipal office in Paseka. The course is suitable for running on asphalt, cobblestones, and park paths. The organizer is Ivan Elischer, who is available for contact and information. The event takes place on July 12, 2026, with registration and further details available on the official website. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.

name: Halda Trail Run
location: Kuřimská Nová Ves, Brno-Country District, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an off-road adventure running race in Kuřimská Nová Ves, which takes you through the picturesque landscape of the Haldy stream valley and the Libochovka river. The longest route measures approximately 24 km and includes 23 water crossings that are runnable and pleasantly refreshing in summer. The race offers three route length options (4 km, 14 km, and 24 km), which connect and allow changing the distance even during the race. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, with panoramic views, two short steep ascents, and varied terrain, appreciated by both casual runners and ambitious trail runners.
course_highlights: 23 water crossings up to ankle-deep, runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views, two short steep ascents with more than 30% incline
Course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. When entering the second lap (14.5 km), the time gate closes at 12:00, slower runners will be stopped and scored on the intermediate route. Routes of 4 km, 14 km, and 24 km connect and it is possible to change the route length during the race. The terrain is a combination of difficult terrain (stones, roots), light terrain, and asphalt. The course will be thoroughly marked with arrows and ribbons. Trail, water crossings, scenery, challenging terrain, registration details are not specified.

description: Summer morning run is a trail running race held in Štítná nad Vláří - Popov, offering two routes approximately 7 km and 15 km long. The race takes place on varied terrain including asphalt, forest paths, and hills, with beautiful views and challenging sections that test runners' physical fitness. The start and finish are located at the pub in Popov, and the atmosphere of the race is friendly and family-oriented, emphasizing safety and participant responsibility. The race is part of the Zlín Runs series and is organized by the Martinát family and their friends.
course_highlights: Trail race with a mix of asphalt and forest paths
Challenging ascent to the saddle below Hložecká Chapel
Beautiful views of Popov and the surrounding landscape
additional: Registration is possible online up to 2 working days before the race and also on-site until 9:30 AM. Timing is measured using Race Result chip technology. Refreshments (water, Kofola) are provided on the course, and at the finish line, there are sweets, fruit, and for pre-registered participants, goulash. The start and finish are at the pub in Popov, parking is available at the bus stop according to organizer instructions. Children under 15 must be accompanied by a person over 18, and youth aged 15-18 start with written consent from legal guardians. The race takes place on July 12, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM, registration closes 2 days before the race, with chip timing. Suitable for runners aged 15 and above.

name: Běh o Ludgerův meč
description: The Ludger's Sword Run is the third edition of a running race organized by the Náchod Running Club in cooperation with the municipality of Hořičky. The race is part of the Primátor CUP running series and the Velká cena východních Čech cup. The routes lead around Hořičky with beautiful views of Kladské pomezí, in gently rolling terrain with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt. There are courses for children, a main race of 8 km, and a FIT route of 4 km. The start and registration take place at the area near the football field in Hořičky.
course_highlights: Main race 8 km in gently rolling terrain with gravel and forest paths
FIT route 4 km with minimal asphalt
Beautiful views of Kladské pomezí
additional: Registration from 8:00 at the area near the football field in Hořičky. Registration closes 30 minutes before the start for children categories, and at 10:00 for adults. Children's races start from 9:00 to 9:35 depending on age categories. The main race and the FIT route start at 10:30. The registration fee includes timing with chip technology, homemade buns, cakes, juice, and tea at the finish. Parking is provided at the football field with instructions from organizers. Prizes for the fastest children, medals and material prizes in adult categories, and monetary prizes for the top three men and women overall in the main race (600 CZK, 400 CZK, 200 CZK). Terrain: gently rolling with surfaces of gravel, forest paths, and minimal asphalt; online registration via sportchallange.cz; the race includes medals and prizes; held at the area near the football field in Hořičky.

name: Bajoro 26
description: Bajoro 26 is a 10 km race scheduled to take place on July 12, 2026, in Starogard Gdański. It is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a scenic route and prepare for the start with dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. Organizers offer expert support and detailed training instructions, making this event attractive for both beginners and more experienced runners. Bajoro 26 is a medium difficulty event held on asphalt surface, ideal for improving condition and competing in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km distance on asphalt surface
Medium difficulty route
Scenic surroundings of Starogard Gdański
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level. The organizer provides expert support and detailed training instructions. There is an option to use a platform for managing the race profile and marketing cooperation for organizers. The event is planned for summer 2026 and is aimed at runners of different age groups and skill levels, with the possibility to participate in the 10 km competition.

description: Two laps along the wall is a traditional cross-country race in Prague's Hvězda Park, offering courses for men, women, and children. Men run the main course of 7.8 km along the perimeter walls of the park, women have a shortened course of 4 km but can also run the men's course. There are two shorter loops prepared for children. After the race, participants can enjoy a raffle and substantial refreshments.
course_highlights: The course runs along the perimeter walls of Hvězda Park
The main men's course is 7.8 km long with a total elevation gain of approximately 120 meters
The women's course is 4 km long with an elevation gain of approximately 60 meters, with the option to run the men's course
additional: Registration on site is possible from 16:30 to 18:00 (children from 16:00 to 16:30). Runners will receive an electronic chip for precise timing. The start and finish are in Hvězda Park at the main entrance from Vypich. There is substantial refreshments including non-alcoholic drinks, beer, and bread with English bacon. After the race, a raffle with material prizes takes place. Mobile toilets are available. The race offers refreshments, electronic timing, a raffle with material prizes, and various age categories including children.

description: The REWAG Corporate Run on July 15, 2026, is one of the largest running events in the Regensburg region and offers a unique opportunity to run together with colleagues in a relaxed atmosphere, exchange ideas, and celebrate. The event is limited to 3,000 participants and attracts numerous companies and runners. In addition to the sporting experience, the run supports the Regensburg Obesity Center for Children and Adolescents, Jumpakids, with a donation. Registration opens on May 1, 2026, and is available for individuals and groups.
course_highlights: Large corporate run event with 3,000 starting places
Running and celebrating together in a relaxed atmosphere
Supporting the social project Jumpakids
additional: Registrations are possible from May 1, 2026, at 9 a.m. Group registrations are possible and facilitate team scoring. Changes and reservations are possible until July 6, 2026. Re-registrations after the registration deadline are only possible on-site for a fee of 5 euros. Start at Stadtwerk.Donau-Arena, registration from May 1, 2026, start time at 6 p.m., participation only with registration and payment, participant limit of 3,000 runners.

name: SUNSET Hamburg 2026
description: The Altra Sunset Hamburg takes place on Wednesday, July 15, 2026, at Wilhelmsburger Inselpark. The race offers an attractive approximately 5 km loop course made of asphalt and paths, which can be run 1 to 3 times, allowing distances of about 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km. Participants can flexibly choose the number of laps on the event day, with a control point counting the laps. Additionally, there is a relay race where the distance is run four times, with teams of 2 to 4 runners. The event is open to all who are trained and have no medical concerns; club membership is not required.
course_highlights: Approximately 5 km loop course in Wilhelmsburger Inselpark
Asphalt and paths as terrain
Control point for lap counting on the course
additional: Race bibs are issued from 17:30. The event ends at 21:30, sunset is at 21:41. The race distance can be flexibly chosen on the event day. The relay consists of 2 to 4 runners; team members do not need to be named. Eligibility is age-based: 5 km from 2016, 10 km from 2012, 15 km from 2010. The race takes place in Wilhelmsburger Inselpark, registration is possible online, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, or 15 km depending on the number of laps, including a control point for lap counting.

name: Lauf um und am Gartower See
location: Nordufer des Gartower Sees, Gartow, Lüchow-Dannenberg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The run around and along Gartower See is a traditional race event held on the north shore of Gartower See in Gartow. The course offers a natural setting with views of the lake and the surrounding Gartower Tannen, making it ideal for runners of all ages. The event is organized by the sports club SV Gartow, which has been committed to sports and community in the region since 1946. Start and finish are centrally located in the town, creating a family-friendly and welcoming atmosphere.
course_highlights: Natural course along Gartower See
Start and finish in the heart of Gartow
Run through the Gartower Tannen and the idyllic Elbtalaue
additional: SV Gartow is a traditional club with over 600 members offering a variety of sports and regularly hosting regional events. The race is embedded in a lively sports community with voluntary engagement. There are no fixed training times for triathlon, but individual arrangements and competitions take place. The event occurs in a scenic environment that also provides opportunities for relaxation and enjoying nature. It includes runs for children, teenagers, adults, and seniors, with start times from 7:00 PM. It is a great opportunity to experience nature and stay active.

name: Halda
description: HALDA TRAIL RUN is an outdoor adventure running race through the beautiful landscape of the Halda stream valley and the Libochovka creek. It offers three routes of 4, 14, and 24 kilometers, which are interconnected and allow for changing the distance during the race. The course mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails, featuring 23 stream crossings, two short steep ascents, and panoramic views. The race is suitable for both casual runners and ambitious trail runners, and is thoroughly marked with arrows and flags.
course_highlights: 23 stream crossings up to ankle-deep, runnable and refreshing in summer
Panoramic views, two short steep ascents with more than 30% incline
The route mainly runs through forests and meadows away from main tourist trails
additional: The time limit for the longest route is 3 hours. When entering the second lap (14.5 km), the time gate closes at 12:00, slower runners will be stopped and scored on the intermediate route. The terrain is a combination of difficult terrain (stones, roots), light terrain, and asphalt. It is permitted to change the route to a shorter variant during the race. Routes 4 km, 14 km, 24 km; trail terrain, brooks, scenic views, time limit 3 hours.

description: Lower Silesian Mountain Running Festival is a prestigious trail event held in the picturesque Landek-Zdrój. During the festival, participants can challenge themselves with various routes of different distances and elevation gains, from short night runs to mountain ultramarathons. The event attracts mountain running enthusiasts, offering unforgettable views and technically demanding courses. In 2026, the festival will take place from July 16 to 19, with a rich accompanying program and professional organization.
course_highlights: 7 Peaks Route - approximately 240 km with an elevation gain of about 7670 m
Super Trail - 130 km with the highest point around 1425 m above sea level
Night Trail - 15 km, ideal for beginners with beautiful views
additional: Possibility to purchase a commemorative technical T-shirt (99 PLN) and running arm warmers (60 PLN). During the festival, DFBG CAMP will be held (May 7-10, 2026). Starts take place at various locations in Landek-Zdrój and the surrounding area. Deposits and relay exchanges are available on the routes. A rich accompanying program is organized, including an opening ceremony and award ceremony. The event lasts four days, covering different distances, and participants can buy commemorative T-shirts and running arm warmers. Registration opens on November 17, and participants can enjoy various amenities such as expo and accommodation.

name: Freiberger Bürgerfestlauf
description: The Freiberg Citizens' Festival Run is one of the largest citizen festival running events in Germany and takes place on July 17, 2026, in Freiberg. Over 1,600 runners participate in four different distances ranging from 600 meters to 10 kilometers. The event is characterized by a high finisher rate of over 95% and is accompanied by a subsequent citizens' festival with live music on the marketplace. The start and finish are located in the center of Freiberg, creating a lively and communal atmosphere.
course_highlights: Four race distances: 600m Kids' Run, 1km School Run, 5km Health Run, 10km OptiMove Run
Start and finish at Freiberg Marketplace
Timing with disposable transponder and a cut-off time of 1:20 hours for the 10km race
additional: Race documents and registration on-site at PRISMA on the marketplace on July 16 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on July 17 from 15:00. Award ceremony starting around 20:00 on the Seebühne. Changing rooms and showers available at the City Hall and the indoor swimming pool. Parking at the Wasen sports center (5-10 minutes walk). Beverage service during the race and from 18:00 during the citizens' festival provided by local clubs. Online registration available. Open to all age groups. Festive program with music.

name: Kölner Zoolauf
description: The Cologne Zoo Run is a unique running event at Cologne Zoo, taking place on July 17, 2026, for the 13th time. It offers four different races for all age groups, from baby and children's runs to ambitious 10 km races. The course runs through the zoo and past numerous animal enclosures, making the run a special experience. Official timing and certificates are included for most races, and the event emphasizes safety and family-friendliness.
course_highlights: Loop course of 1.62 km through Cologne Zoo with views of numerous animal enclosures
Option to run between 1 and 6 laps (1.6 km to 10.05 km)
Start and finish in front of the main entrance of Cologne Zoo
additional: Start times: BabyRun 6:15 PM, KidsRun 6:30 PM, TopRun 7:00 PM, FunRun 8:15 PM. Preferred start numbers available for an additional fee of approximately €3. Late registrations on-site until the day of the event are possible, with a late registration fee of €5. Participation with dogs, strollers, walking sticks, and music devices is not allowed. Official timing is provided for all races except the BabyRun. Certificates can be printed online. Safety and supervision of children in the start and finish areas are organized. Four race categories (Baby, Kids, Top, Fun), online registration, no refunds for non-participation, participation only with bib and chip, no participation with dogs or headphones.

name: Schwanberglauf Iphofen-Castell
description: The Schwanberglauf is a traditional race over 10.4 kilometers from Iphofen to Castell, taking place on July 17, 2026, for the 42nd time. The course combines challenging ascents through vineyards and forest sections with an idyllic finish in the castle park in Castell, accompanied by a wine festival atmosphere. The event is open to runners and walkers of all performance levels and supports social institutions with proceeds. The organization is volunteer-based by TG Kitzingen in cooperation with the SBL team.
course_highlights: Start at Rödelseer Tor in Iphofen with steep ascent through vineyards
Water stations at kilometer 3, 6.5, and just before kilometer 7
Finish in the castle park in Castell with wine festival atmosphere
additional: Race bibs are issued from 3:30 PM in the Karl-Knauf-Halle, Iphofen. Group placement based on 10 km race time. Toilets available in the Karl-Knauf-Halle. Free bus transfer from the finish in Castell back to the start in Iphofen (departure 4:50-5:45 PM, approximately every 10 minutes). Luggage transport by VW van. Medical services provided by the Bavarian Red Cross. Shower facilities in Castell (men in the Meierei, women in the sports club). Every finisher receives a bottle of mineral water from Franken Brunnen. Course: 10.4 km, start in Iphofen, finish in Castell, refreshments along the route, shower facilities in Castell, electronic timing, award ceremony at the wine festival, online registration, overnight stay in Iphofen recommended.

name: Běh o Neplachovský Hrneček
description: The Neplachov Cup Run is a traditional running race held in Neplachov, South Bohemia, which will take place for the 14th time on Friday, July 17, 2026. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and is supported by the South Bohemian Region budget. The event offers a sporting experience in the beautiful regional environment and attracts runners from the surrounding area. Organizers warmly invite all runners to participate in this popular event.
course_highlights: 10 km course with asphalt and natural sections
Includes various age categories including children
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: The course consists of two five-kilometer loops, registration is available via the website, and results are accessible online. The run is supported by the South Bohemian Region.

name: Kružberský Tesák
location: Kružberský přehradní areál, u přehrady Kružberk, Kružberk, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kružberský Tesák is a sporting event held at the Kružberk Dam area, offering routes and categories for experienced racers, semi-advanced runners, and complete beginners. The race is suitable for solo runners, hikers, and families with children. The event also features Pejskiáda, an entertaining exhibition and competitions for dogs of all sizes and breeds. Organizers Kateřina and Lucie, nature and sports enthusiasts with dogs, aim to create a friendly atmosphere and ensure enjoyable experiences for all participants.
course_highlights: Routes suitable for runners of various levels from beginners to experienced
Surroundings of Kružberk Dam with beautiful nature and views
Pejskiáda with exhibition and competitions for dogs of all breeds and sizes
additional: Registration opens in May 2026. After submitting the application, a variable symbol for payment of the start fee will be sent to the participant's account. Payment must be made as soon as possible after registration. The event includes dog competitions and exhibitions, suitable for families with children and dog lovers. A two-day event with the option to camp in tents, competitions, and a traveling trophy for the winners.

description: Leśna Eko Piątka is a race organized in Piekary Śląskie that promotes the city and supports integration and addiction prevention among children and youth. The race route runs along asphalt and gravel roads in the Dioblina forest, with start and finish lines located at the MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street. The event is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Piekary Śląskie and offers participants a starter pack with a bib number, time measurement, medal, and medical care. The time limit to complete the course is 45 minutes, and the participant limit is 500 people.
course_highlights: Race route along asphalt and gravel roads in the Dioblina forest
Start and finish at MOSiR stadium at 3 Olimpijska Street
Checkpoints along the route and a 45-minute time limit
additional: Race office open on July 17, 2026 from 16:00 to 18:30 at 3 Olimpijska Street. Nearby facilities include changing rooms, deposit, and toilets. The starter pack includes a bib number, electronic time measurement, medal, medical care, surprises, and the option to use a deposit. An additional shirt can be purchased until June 18, 2026, for 70 PLN. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle, physical activity, and social integration. The participant limit is 500 people, and fees can be paid online or in cash. Starter packs include items such as shirts, making them attractive to participants.

name: Night Run Gdynia
description: Night Run Gdynia is a nocturnal 5-kilometer race held along the Baltic Sea coast as part of the IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends. After dark, when city lights reflect on the asphalt and water, hundreds of runners set out on a spectacular route through the streets of Gdynia. This event has become an important and eagerly awaited element of the city's sports calendar, combining athletic competition with a unique nighttime running atmosphere.
course_highlights: 5 km race route along the Baltic Sea coast
Night race with spectacular city lighting reflecting on asphalt and water
Event held as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends
additional: The race takes place as part of IRONMAN Poland triathlon weekends in Gdynia, Warsaw, and Poznań. It attracts hundreds of runners and is a regular feature of these sporting events. The route is along the seaside, with a participant limit of 1500. Starting fees are 60 zł, 75 zł, 90 zł, and 100 zł.

name: 1. Stoppelfeld Ultra

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Stoppelfeld Ultra 2026 is a classic Backyard Ultra race taking place on July 18 and 19, 2026, in Kerpen-Blatzheim. In this special endurance format, it is not about speed but about the ability to complete a 6.706-kilometer loop within 60 minutes and start again exactly at the full hour. The course mainly runs over field and farm roads around Blatzheim, with start and finish at the Bolzplatz Blatzheim. The event is limited to 50 participants and promises a family-like atmosphere as well as a significant mental and physical challenge.
course_highlights: Loop course of exactly 6.706 kilometers
Course over field and farm roads around Blatzheim
Start and finish area at Bolzplatz Blatzheim
additional: The start of each new lap is exactly on the hour. Anyone who does not finish a lap in time or does not appear at the next start on time is eliminated. The remaining time within one hour after crossing the finish line can be freely used for rest, nutrition, or short breaks. The maximum number of participants is limited to 50 to ensure a family-like atmosphere. Registration is only possible online and becomes binding only after payment. Participation is at your own risk; good health is assumed. The course runs over field and farm roads, with start and finish at Bolzplatz, limited to 50 participants, and continues until the 30th lap is reached or the runner drops out.

name: 22. Wiesenlauf
description: The 22nd Wiesenlauf on July 18, 2026, in Klein Meckelsen offers runners the opportunity to compete on officially measured and DLV-approved courses over 5 and 10 kilometers. The event includes district championships over both distances as well as a regional championship over 5 kilometers, with scoring starting from the age group M/W 14. The start and finish are located at the Klein Meckelsen sports field, and the event is suitable for both competitive athletes and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 10 km loop course and 5 km route with turnaround point
Officially measured and DLV-approved running courses
Scoring as district championship (Rotenburg/W.) and regional championship (Lüneburg)
additional: Late registrations are possible until 6:00 PM on the day of the event with an additional late registration fee of €3 on top of the entry fee. Bib number distribution begins at 6:00 PM at the announcer's stand at the sports field. Changing rooms and shower facilities are available in the Schulstraße sports hall. Parking is available at the sports field grounds and at the gymnasium. The award ceremony for the top three places in each race and gender, and all participants receive a medal. Certificates are available online. The event starts at 7:00 PM and offers a summery running atmosphere. It is a great opportunity for runners of all ages to compete and participate in championships.

name: 4. Fachberg 100
description: The Fachberg 100 is a 100 km road race in Northeim, Germany, starting at 6:00 AM on July 18, 2026. The course consists of 15 laps and a short shuttle section, alternating between asphalt and field paths. Each lap involves approximately 75 meters of elevation gain, totaling 1,125 meters of elevation change. The race is a small ultramarathon event with a limited number of participants and no entry fee, requiring runners to bring their own supplies.
course_highlights: 15 laps with alternating asphalt and field paths
Total elevation gain approximately 1,125 meters
Start at 6:00 AM
additional: No entry fee; participants must bring their own supplies; small field with about 21 finishers so far; typical July weather conditions around 25°C during the day, 15°C at night, mostly sunny. The race is free, and participants need to bring their own provisions. The event is a small, family-oriented ultramarathon community with approximately 21 finishers in previous editions.

name: DJK Jakobuslauf
description: The Augsburg Jakobuslauf of the DJK Diözesanverband is a special recreational sports event held as part of the oldest Augsburg folk festival, the Jakober Kirchweih. The race is aimed at joggers and walkers and deliberately does not include official timing to embody the motto "Experience over Result." The event includes student races as well as three routes for adults, including a quarter marathon along the Lech River. Start and finish are at Jakobsplatz at the famous Fuggerei, giving the race a historic and atmospheric setting.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Jakobsplatz at the historic Fuggerei
Course along the Lech River
Quarter marathon over 10.5 kilometers for adults
additional: The race does not include official timing to prioritize fun and experience. The event is ecumenical and organized by the Catholic DJK Diözesanverband Augsburg. The Jakober Kirchweih opens the Fuggerei free of charge for visitors during the race. Courses for students, walkers, and adults; no official timing, focus on community and experience; start and finish at Jakobsplatz in the Fuggerei.

description: The Gänslauf in Herbolzheim an der Jagst is a traditional community run taking place on July 18, 2026, for the 18th time. The event offers races over 10 km, 5 km, 1400 meters for students, as well as 400-meter children's runs and is held as part of the village festival. The course leads through scenic and varied loop routes with start and finish at the Herbolzheim sports hall, passing sights such as the Herbolzheim castle ruins. Runners enjoy both paved and shaded forest paths along the Jagst River.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km races with start and finish at the Herbolzheim sports hall
Course is 60% paved and 40% gravel forest and field paths
Shaded forest sections along the Jagst River with views of the Herbolzheim castle ruins
additional: No late registration possible. Participation only by pre-registration. Baby joggers, strollers, and dogs are not allowed in any of the races. Start and finish are located at the Herbolzheim sports hall near the TSV Herbolzheim football field. The course is marked with green arrows on the ground. Medals are awarded to all participants. The event is part of the Three Rivers Cup 2026. Disciplines: 10 km, 5 km, 1400 m for students, 400 m children's runs; registration only by pre-registration until July 16, 2026; no late registration; no baby joggers, strollers, or dogs allowed; weather-dependent conditions in July.

name: HAKRO Stadtlauf
price_range: Bar in bar am Veranstaltungstag, 3€ für Nachmeldung
description: The Hakro City Run in Schrozberg is a running event for a good cause, where 5€ is donated for each participant to the Creglingen Youth Welfare. The race is open to all age groups and promotes running together of young and old. There are individual competitions by registration classes as well as a team competition for companies, clubs, families, and friends. The event emphasizes a smooth process and requests pre-registration by July 16, 2025.
course_highlights: Team competition with five runners of 2 km each
Individual competitions by registration classes
Extra recognition for children and adolescents up to 18 years
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the start with a late registration fee of 3€. Participation fee is to be paid in cash on the day of the event. Participants receive certificates for the 400m run. The race is open to all age groups and genders. The event includes runs for companies, clubs, families, and friends, including a relay race. The course runs through the festival grounds with additional activities. Donations go to the Creglingen Youth Welfare.
