description: The Heizomat Altmühlseelauf is a traditional running event held annually in July around Lake Altmühlsee in Gunzenhausen. The event includes various competitions, such as the half marathon, a relay race, the fun run, a school run, and a toddler run. The courses are officially measured and lead through the scenic surroundings of Lake Altmühlsee. The event offers both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance and enjoy a sporty day together.
course_highlights: Flat half marathon course around Lake Altmühlsee with kilometer markers
Relay race with flexible division of the half marathon distance among 2-4 runners
Running routes pass Schlungenhof, Muhr am See, Streudorfer Bridge, and Lake Center Wald
additional: Relay race with 2-4 runners, joint start with the half marathon at 6:00 PM. Baton with integrated transponder for timing. Late registrations for the toddler run until 3:45 PM on the event day are possible. Medals for all finishers, certificates and trophies for age groups and overall winners. Company relays with their own scoring. Bibs with first names upon pre-registration. Course around Lake Altmühlsee, officially measured, registration via direct debit, start at 6:00 PM, various race categories for children, adolescents, and adults.

name: Lautersteiner Panorama-Lauf
description: The Lautersteiner Panorama Run on July 18, 2026, offers runners breathtaking views over the Swabian Alps. The varied course leads through forest edge paths and open sections around Weißenstein and rewards the effort with fantastic panoramas. Organized by TV Weißenstein, the event stands for joy in sports in nature and a great atmosphere. Runners can choose between a short 4.5 km loop and the challenging 11.5 km main race.
course_highlights: Breathtaking views over the Swabian Alps
Varied paths with forest edge trails and open sections
Explore the elevation of the Alps actively
additional: Course lengths of 4.5 km and 11.5 km, varied landscape, elevation of the Alps, nature experience

name: Maintal Ultratrail / Bayerische Trail Meisterschaften 30km
description: The Maintal Ultratrail offers a delightful trail running experience with its three scenic routes in the Franconian wine region. The 30 km course with 720 meters of elevation gain leads through picturesque vineyards, nature reserves, and diverse forests along the Main River. The event is aimed at trail enthusiasts of all experience levels who appreciate nature and the shared running experience. The motto for all participants is: fun and nature experience are the priorities, not just athletic performance.
course_highlights: 30 km course with 720 meters of elevation gain through the Maintal and Franconian wine region
Diverse landscapes: limestone beech forests, Mediterranean flora, vineyards, and meadow valleys
Typical Main river meanders with scenic views
additional: Online registration deadline is June 30, 2026. A high-quality functional shirt can be ordered until May 31, 2026, for €20. Late registrations are subject to a late registration surcharge by BLV. Food and beverages are provided at the start and finish areas for runners and visitors. The course is hilly with steep climbs, and has a cut-off time at aid station 5 at 3:00 PM. The event also offers longer distances of 13 km and 64 km, with start and finish at the sports grounds of SV Veitshöchheim. On-site registration is possible, and the course includes natural trails with elevation changes, making the run challenging and varied.

name: OYLER Berglauf
description: The 27th Oyler Mountain Run will take place on July 18, 2026, as part of the Sports Promotion Week in Marklohe. Organized by the Youth Community Oyle, this race offers a sporting challenge on the Oyler Mountain. The event is part of a diverse sports program and is aimed at runners who want to experience a hilly course in a friendly club atmosphere. The exact route and further details can be found on the organizer's website.
course_highlights: Run on the Oyler Mountain
Event location: Sportplatz Oyle
Part of the Sports Promotion Week 2026
additional: The Oyler Mountain Run is embedded in the Sports Promotion Week 2026, which takes place from July 18, 2026, to July 26, 2026, at Sportplatz Oyle. The organizer is the Youth Community Oyle from 1953 e.V. There are no published details regarding prices or registration on the website, nor are there start times or wave information. The event is part of the Sports Promotion Week 2026 and takes place at Sportplatz Oyle, with no specific registration information available.

name: Sparkasse Kraichgau CityCup Bretten
location: TV Platz, Bretten, Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Sparkasse Kraichgau City Cup Bretten is a popular race that has been held annually since 2004 and attracts many runners from the region. The races take place through the beautiful old town of Bretten with its alleys and the marketplace with half-timbered houses. Various distances are offered, including school runs, 5 km and 10 km races, as well as a 4 x 2.5 km relay. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with medals for all students and special prizes for schools and relays.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Bretten
Start and finish at the TV Platz
Rounds on the TV Platz and through the old town
additional: Race bib distribution from 15:15 at the TV Platz. Medals for all students at the finish. Changing rooms and showers are available. Relay exchange zone is located opposite the start/finish at the sports field. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the competition begins with a €2.00 surcharge. Run through the old town, start and finish at the TV Platz, registration open, preparation courses as part of the running club.

name: Spendenlauf Recke
description: The Recke charity run on July 18, 2026, is a fundraising event in support of the Children's Cancer Aid Münster. Organized by Andreas Egelkamp Heating, Ventilation, Sanitary GmbH & Co. KG and the Lewe company from Recke, the run offers two distances: 5 kilometers for beginners and relaxed runners, as well as 10 kilometers for experienced runners seeking a greater challenge. The focus is on collective effort for a good cause, with the entire registration fee donated. The event combines athletic commitment with social responsibility and invites everyone to participate and support.
course_highlights: 5 kilometer course ideal for beginners and relaxed runners
10 kilometer course for experienced runners and greater challenge
Charity run in support of Children's Cancer Aid Münster
additional: The entire registration fee is donated. Organizers are Andreas Egelkamp Heating, Ventilation, Sanitary GmbH & Co. KG and the Lewe company from Recke. The event supports Children's Cancer Aid Münster, which gives hope and quality of life to affected children and families. Race distances: 5 km and 10 km, registration only online, run in support of Children's Cancer Aid Münster.

name: Zkus Noční Kuks
location: Kuks, Trutnov District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
description: Try Noční Kuks is a night running race set in the picturesque baroque environment of Kuks. It offers two routes - 10 km and 5 km - which pass by historic landmarks such as Braun's Nativity Scene and Hospital Kuks. Running in the darkness illuminated only by headlamps provides a unique experience and atmosphere that participants will remember for a long time. The 10 km route includes the pilgrimage route of the 21st-century Cross Path, while the shorter 5 km route runs along the night-time Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees.
course_highlights: 10 km route runs through the magical heart of baroque landscape with Braun's Nativity Scene and the 21st-century Cross Path
5 km route starts at the hospital and passes along the night Elbe River and the Count's Avenue with 222 trees
Night run illuminated by headlamps with an unforgettable atmosphere under the glowing facade of Hospital Kuks
additional: The registration fee includes a start number and chip. It is possible to purchase the registration as a gift voucher with a unique code. Registration is done online via myresult.cz, and a contractual relationship is established upon payment of the registration fee. The race is organized by TURN ON EVENTS s.r.o. from Hradec Králové. The race offers routes of 5 km and 10 km, the option to start with a headlamp, refreshments during and after the race, participation with dogs is allowed, registration is possible through the website, and the registration fee is payable within 14 days of registration.

name: ČEZ RunTour Olomouc
location: Smetanovy sady, Olomouc, Olomouc District, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Olomouc is a family running event offering courses for amateurs and elite runners in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy sady and is part of a nationwide series with unique routes. Organizers emphasize excellent service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and can look forward to refreshments and support from a guiding team. CEZ RunTour is not only a sporting event but also a full-day experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km including children's runs of 500 and 1000 m
Start and finish in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc
Accompanying program and charitable aspect of the race
additional: The race offers relay races 2x5 km and 4x2.5 km within the 10 km run. A guiding team helps runners achieve their target time. There are refreshment stations on the course, including at least two on the half marathon. Children receive a start package and entertainment in the children's zone. A special emergency phone line is available during the race. The event includes various routes, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, and facilities for runners. The start and finish are in Smetanovy sady, with a capacity of approximately 1700 runners.

description: Night Run Rusava is an unforgettable night race in the Hostýn Hills, offering a 12-hour run on a single loop as well as a 5 km race. The event is suitable for individuals and relay teams, and it is not mandatory to run the entire 12 hours. The race facilities include a gym for rest, a all-night buffet, and refreshment stations. The event takes place in a picturesque environment with a ski slope and forests around Rusava, providing a unique sporting experience under the starry sky.
course_highlights: Night run on a ski slope and in the forests of the Hostýn Hills
One loop 5 km long with the possibility of repeating for 12 hours
All-night refreshment stations and facilities at the local school
additional: The race facilities include a gym at the local school for rest, with the option to bring sleeping bags and mats. Throughout the night, a buffet and refreshment stations with drinks, fruit, and food are open. Parking is available at designated spots in the village. It is not necessary to run the full 12 hours; walking with poles is also allowed. Starting numbers can be supplemented with a band for 150 CZK. Terrain: forests and ski slope, registration, relay system, ecological requirements for cups, all-night catering.

name: 7 pohoří Krušné Hory
description: The Krušné hory 2026 race is a technical trail run that takes you through the beautiful Krušné hory mountains and the former mining landscape listed as UNESCO World Heritage. The route starts in Abertamy and passes through the former Eva mine, Jelení, Swiss Cottage on Plešivec, Merklín, the former Kaff settlement, Pstruží, and a ski resort to the finish line. It offers three courses of different lengths and elevation gains, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The race takes place in all weather conditions, and participants receive a commemorative medal and refreshments on the route and at the finish.
course_highlights: Natural route with the beauty of Krušné hory and UNESCO mining landscape
Main course 22 km with 1000 m elevation gain
Alternative routes 13 km and 8 km with 510 m and 220 m elevation gain
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the runner is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration stand. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The registration fee includes a professionally marked route, a start number, chip timing, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the route and at the finish. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The registration fee covers the course, medal, refreshments, facilities, and recommended gear including a windbreaker and a mobile phone with the Záchranka app. The race is organized by the local mountain rescue team.

name: Rokytnice nad Jizerou - Dvoračky
location: Dvorská bouda, Rokytnice nad Jizerou, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The route from Rokytnice nad Jizerou to Dvoračky is a popular hiking trail in the western Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the Upper Square in Rokytnice. The blue-marked trail leads around the Hutský Stream to the picturesque Hutský Waterfall and further to the mountain lodge Dvoračky, which is known for its history and traditional cheese production. The path offers beautiful natural scenery, especially in the autumn season when the surrounding beech forests display all the colors. The route is suitable for hikers, ski mountaineers, and cross-country skiers, who can enjoy the snowy landscape and refreshments at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky.
course_highlights: Blue-marked trail leading around Hutský Stream
Hutský Waterfall surrounded by beech forests with beautiful autumn colors
Historical mountain lodge Dvoračky with traditional cheese production
additional: Parking is available at the parking lot by Tesco on the Lower Square in Rokytnice. Refreshments are available at the Štumpovka restaurant at Dvoračky and at the U Vocta pub in Rokytnice. The route is also suitable for winter hiking, ski mountaineering, and cross-country skiing, with the need to respect groomed ski tracks and not enter them. The race is part of the local sports calendar, with options to participate in various distances, including an ascent race to Dvoračky. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and offers beautiful views and sporting experiences.

description: The 12th Night Port Marathon Szczecin and the 7th Night Port Half Marathon Szczecin are nocturnal street races held in Szczecin, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. The marathon course consists of two identical loops of 42.195 km each, and the half marathon is a single loop of 21.097 km, both certified by PZLA. The start is at 11:00 PM, and participants can expect original t-shirts and a special classification for individuals connected to the maritime industry. The event is organized by the Movement Health Academy, the West Pomeranian Sports Federation, and RAZ Event, with support from the city of Szczecin and port partners.
course_highlights: Marathon route consists of two identical loops through Szczecin streets with PZLA certification
Start and finish at the Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium
Markers every 1 km and nutrition points along the route and at the finish of each loop
additional: The marathon time limit is 6 hours. A new classification category 'Sea People' for individuals associated with the maritime industry. Start and finish at the Florian Krygier Municipal Stadium. The route may have minor modifications due to renovations near Trasa Zamkowa. Registration opens at 12:00 PM. The route may undergo slight changes due to construction work, and a 'Sea People' category is planned for participants connected to the maritime industry.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko
description: Garmin Ultra Race Tolkmicko is a unique trail run taking place on July 18, 2026, on the picturesque terrains of the Elbląg Upland by the Vistula Lagoon. The route passes through wild trails, varied elevations, and a quiet, natural scenery, offering runners contact with nature and the region's history. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series promoting physical activity in harmony with nature, suitable for both beginners and experienced ultramarathoners. Participants can expect professional organization, medical support, and a rich race package.
course_highlights: Wild nature of the Elbląg Upland with scenic elevations
Routes passing through the Elbląg Upland Landscape Park and four forest reserves
Views of the Vistula Lagoon and historic sites such as Old Prussian hillforts and the Imperial Stone
additional: The race package includes a waterproof bib with a chip, medical support, trail marking, nutrition points, drinks and snacks at the finish line, a commemorative medal, and a GPS tracker for the 81 km distance. Starts are scheduled in waves from 5:00 AM (81 km) to 10:30 AM (14 km), with separate races for children called Garmin Junior. An online technical briefing on Facebook will be held on July 15, 2026, at 8:00 PM. The system offers discounts when registering for more than one event in the series. The event also includes junior categories and challenge options, with routes passing through reserves and tourist trails, providing unique experiences for runners and nature enthusiasts.

name: Nocna zaDyszka 2026
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Piekarach Śląskich
description: Night Run is a 10 km race organized as part of the 7th PKO Piekarski Half Marathon, which will take place on July 18, 2026, in Piekary Śląskie. The event attracts many runners, with a participant limit of 900 for this distance. The day before, on July 17, there will also be a companion race, the Forest Eco Five (Leśna Eko Piątka), covering 5 km. Organizers invite participation and expect nearly 3,000 runners across all distances in 2026.
course_highlights: Night race over 10 km
Participant limit of 900
Companion race Leśna Eko Piątka over 5 km with a limit of 500 participants
additional: Participant limit: 1500 for the half marathon, 900 for Night Run (10 km), 500 for Forest Eco Five (5 km). Registration available online. The companion race takes place the day before the main event. The event also includes races for children, with the possibility of early online registration, and a time limit of 2 hours and 30 minutes to complete the course. The race enjoys great interest from the local community and is one of the most important sporting events in the region.

name: 2 Chojnicka Piątka
description: 1. Chojnicka Piątka is an urban race organized in Chojnice, which will take place on July 26, 2026. The event is part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich and attracts runners from various places, offering sporting competition and a good atmosphere. The race route runs through the streets of the city, providing participants with attractive views and the opportunity to test their form over a distance of 5 km.
course_highlights: Urban race in the center of Chojnice
Route length of 5 km
Organized as part of the Grand Prix Borów Tucholskich
additional: The event is scheduled for July 18, 2026, and the route runs through the streets of Chojnice, mainly along Rybacka Street. Details regarding registration have not been provided.

name: Aalener Stadtlauf
description: The Aalen City Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen and offers a varied running event with different races such as the Baby Race, School Race, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, as well as the Youth and Sparkassen Main Run. The event is characterized by a great atmosphere and sporting challenges. A new feature is the introduction of the City-Country-River Cup scoring, which combines races in different landscapes and presents a special challenge. Registration is already open, and all running enthusiasts are warmly invited to participate and enjoy the urban and natural running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Sparkassenplatz in Aalen
Various running routes for babies, school children, youth, and adults
New: City-Country-River Cup scoring with races in city, countryside, and river surroundings
additional: The event includes several races, including Baby Race, School Race, AOK Active & Healthy Run, Team Run, and Youth and Sparkassen Main Run. There is a new cup scoring over three races in 2026 (Essingen Panoramic Runs, Kocher Cup Unterkochen, Aalen City Run). Individual participation in the Team Run is possible. After the event, invoices/receipts can be issued. Various distances, 'City-Country-River Cup' race series, online registration, bib number pickup on event day, parking options in Aalen, limited changing facilities, and valuables storage.

name: Barbarossalauf 2026
location: Erlenbach am Main, Landkreis Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Barbarossalauf 2026 returns on July 19th as a city run in Erlenbach am Main. The new course starts centrally at the old fire station and runs flat and naturally along the Main River before leading through the historic old town of Erlenbach to the finish. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, from school runs to the 10 km main race, which consists of two laps. The course is ideal for beginners and ambitious runners aiming for fast times, showcasing Erlenbach at its most beautiful.
course_highlights: Flat, naturally scenic course along the Main River
Start and finish at the old fire station in the town center
Loop through Erlenbach's old town with good infrastructure
additional: Race documents will be issued on the day of the event from 1:30 PM at the old fire station. Shirts are available only while supplies last. Timing is done via bib scanning at the finish. Parking is available at the mountain swimming pool and train station. Refund of the participation fee is 80% until July 12, 2026, thereafter 50%. Transfers are possible at any time. Multiple race distances are offered, including marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and shorter runs; the event promotes running in the region; registration is possible until the day of the event.

name: Flughafenlauf Barth
description: The Barther Airport Run takes place on July 19, 2026, at the Baltic Sea Airport Stralsund-Barth and offers a diverse range of seven competitions for runners and walkers of all ages. From short distances for young runners to the half marathon distance, there is something for everyone. The event promises a morning full of activity, fun, and exciting races in a unique atmosphere directly at the airport. Walkers are also warmly welcome, and catering is provided on site.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Baltic Sea Airport Stralsund-Barth
Course lengths from 500 m to half marathon (21 km)
Refreshment point with water on the half marathon route
additional: Late registrations are possible on site with an additional fee of €2.00 for competitions from 4 km. The race number distribution begins on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m. in the terminal building. There is a ranking for places 1 to 3 in age group and overall classifications. The café and restaurant "Airpott" offers small snacks and drinks. Participants are asked to return their race number after crossing the finish line. Various running and walking distances, family-friendly, at Baltic Sea Airport Stralsund-Barth.

name: Heumadener Volkslauf 2026
location: Sportgelände Untere Hasenwedel, Stuttgart-Heumaden, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Heumaden Volkslauf has been held annually in Stuttgart-Heumaden since 2009 and offers runners three distances: 5.5 km, 10.3 km, and since 2018 also a half marathon over 21 km. The course is a long, relatively flat loop with few inclines, passing through the districts of Heumaden, Riedenberg, and Kemnat. The start and finish are located at the sports grounds Untere Hasenwedel. The event is part of the family sports festival and features a water station on the longer course.
course_highlights: Long, flat loop course with few inclines
Course through Heumaden, Riedenberg, and Kemnat
Start and finish at the sports grounds Untere Hasenwedel
additional: The 10.3 km course is run as a loop twice. There is a water station after the halfway point. The event is integrated into the family sports festival of TSV Heumaden. The event also includes an inclusion walk after the races and is part of the annual family sports festival in Stuttgart-Heumaden.

name: Internationaler Allgäu Volkslauf
description: The International Allgäu Volkslauf in Leutkirch has been held annually on Children's Festival Sunday since 1970 and has developed into a major sporting event with hundreds of runners from southern Germany and partner cities. Organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V., the Volkslauf is supported by numerous volunteers, the DRK Leutkirch, the city administration, and other partners. The race is a traditional sporting custom in Leutkirch and offers a diverse event for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Scenic routes in the Allgäu region
Various categories for children, adolescents, and adults
Family-friendly and communal atmosphere with warm support along the course
additional: The Volkslauf is organized by the Skiläuferzunft of TSG 1847 Leutkirch e.V. and takes place on Children's Festival Sunday. The event is supported by friendly clubs, the DRK Leutkirch, the Red Cross from the partner city Castiglione, the city administration, and the municipal construction yard. It is a traditional event of great regional significance. The event includes various race distances, including a Bambini run and longer distances for older children, and offers a family-friendly, sporting community experience.

name: Jakob Scheuring Lauf
description: The 24th Jakob Scheuring Run will take place on July 19, 2026, at the Murgstadion Ottenau and includes races over 1.5 km for students, 5 km, and 10 km with timing and placement. The course runs from the stadium through the picturesque Salzwiesental, mostly through forest and meadows, back to the stadium. The event is part of the sports festival of the Ottenau Sports Club and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering and an award ceremony in the festival tent.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Murgstadion Ottenau
Course through the idyllic Salzwiesental with forest and meadow terrain
Elevation difference approx. 140 m for 10 km, approx. 40 m for 5 km
additional: Race bibs can be collected at the festival entrance from 07:30 to 08:50. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a fee of 2 €. Drinks are available at the start/finish area and at the 10 km turnaround point. Certificates and prizes for the top three in each age group. Special prize of €250 for course record. Award ceremony begins around 12:00 in the festival tent. Changing rooms and showers are available at Murgstadion. Parking is sufficient at Murgstadion. Late registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start, with catering, changing facilities, and parking available.

name: neuefinanzkultur Laufevent mit Biosphärenlauf und Auinger Alblauf
description: The New Financial Culture Run event in Auingen on the Swabian Alb is an annual major running day with various race options, including the Biosphere Run and the Auingen Alb Run. In addition to the athletic competition, there is also a charity "Walking" run in support of the Clowns on Duty. The event offers timing with a transponder system, awards for the fastest runners in each age group, as well as special prizes for the largest group. For children, there is a Bambini run without timing, medals, certificates, and surprises.
course_highlights: Runs on the Swabian Alb with Biosphere Run and Auingen Alb Run
Timing with transponder system by time 2finish GbR
Bambini run without timing with medal and certificate
additional: Start and finish at the sports home Auingen with changing rooms and showers. Bib number pickup from 8:00 AM at the community center Auingen. Transponder deposit €5; own transponders not allowed. Special prize for the largest group by number (excluding walking). Disclaimer: participation at own risk. Running event as part of the race day, details about terrain or registration not provided.

name: run4trees
description: The Run4Trees is a running event in Unterhaching taking place on July 19, 2026. The course leads through the idyllic Perlacher Forest with start and finish at the festival grounds in Unterhaching. By participating, runners make a statement for climate protection, as the proceeds are donated to Plant for the Planet and the youth work of TSV Unterhaching. The run combines athletic commitment with environmental awareness and community spirit.
course_highlights: Run through the idyllic Perlacher Forest
Start and finish area at the festival grounds in Unterhaching
Event focused on climate protection and environmental conservation
additional: The proceeds of the run are equally donated to Plant for the Planet and the youth work of TSV Unterhaching. The office is closed during school holidays. The run is known for its sustainable orientation and commitment to climate protection. Awards are given for overall and youth winners, and registration is open until July 2, 2025.

name: Sommer Rheinauenlauf
description: The Summer Rheinauenlauf in Bad Bellingen is a traditional running event organized by TV Rheinweiler. The races take place through the picturesque Rheinauen and offer a varied course for runners of all ages. The event includes different distances and is aimed at both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. In addition to the sporting competition, community experience is also a focus.
course_highlights: Run through the idyllic Rheinauen
Varied route with natural experience
Suitable for all age and performance levels
additional: Multiple race categories, start and finish in the spa park, registration via the website

name: Stundenlauf VfL Dettenhausen
location: VfL Dettenhausen sports ground, Dettenhausen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The 24-hour run in Dettenhausen is a traditional running event taking place on July 18, 2026, for the 20th time. The event is held on the sports grounds of VfL Dettenhausen and offers both individual and team runners the opportunity to test their endurance. Participation is free of charge, and great emphasis is placed on community and fitness. The course is equipped with a microchip in the bib number for easy time tracking, and there are overnight accommodation options directly at the sports grounds.
course_highlights: Loop course on the sports grounds of VfL Dettenhausen
Microchip timing integrated into the bib number
Overnight accommodations with tents or motorhomes on designated areas
additional: Bib pickup on Friday evening from 18:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 8:00 on-site; teams of 5 to 12 people are possible, with only one runner on the track at a time; showers and toilets available on-site; donations are welcome, participation is free; run takes place on the sports grounds, overnight stay possible in tents/motorhomes, timing with microchip, no grilling or open fires allowed, dogs prohibited

name: Vogelsberger Südbahnlauf
price_range: Bambinilauf kostenlos, Schülerlauf 3 Euro, 5km Lauf 7 Euro, 10km Lauf 12 Euro, Halbmarathon 15 Euro
description: The Vogelsberg South Railway Run will be held for the 21st time on July 19, 2026, organized by the Unterreichenbach Running Club. The event offers runners of all ages and performance levels a varied running experience on well-marked routes that lead over the paved Vogelsberg South Railway Cycle Path as well as paved forest and field paths. The races range from a toddler run, school runs, and 5 km races to the half marathon. The team places great importance on a relaxed and sporty atmosphere, supported by refreshment stations and timing without chips.
course_highlights: Routes run on paved Vogelsberg South Railway Cycle Path and paved forest and field paths
Well-marked routes with kilometer markers and directional signs
Refreshment stations every 2.5 km with mineral water, apple spritz, and damp sponges
additional: Timing is chipless. Start and finish are at 310 meters above sea level, with the highest point of the course at 460 meters above sea level. Races start in staggered groups between 09:00 and 09:35 AM. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late registration fee of 2 euros (except for children and toddler runs). Refreshment stations are located every 2.5 km with mineral water, apple spritz, and damp sponges. The routes run on cycle paths and forest paths, with water stations, changing rooms, and showers on site, and parking is available.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Fojtovice
location: Fojtovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Živé Sokolovsko z.s. a Destinační agentura Krušnohoří z.s.
description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beauty of the Ore Mountains. Over six races in various destinations, you can choose from main races of 6 to 9 km, experience trails of 20 to 30 km, point search walks, and children's races. The series is suitable for runners, canicrossers, children, and walkers, offering a diverse range of routes in the picturesque nature of the Ore Mountains. The race in Fojtovice takes place on July 19, 2026, and features a main race, experience trail, walking, and children's races.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the picturesque landscape of the Ore Mountains
Experience trail 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 300 m to 1,600 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations of the Ore Mountains. Besides running, participants can also take part in point search walks according to the map and canicross. Children's races are divided by age and distance. The organizer is Živé Sokolovsko z.s. in cooperation with the Destination Agency Ore Mountains z.s. The races include various distances and categories, including walking and children's races, and the series takes place at several sites in the Ore Mountains region.

name: Šachty - Štěpánka
location: Vysoké nad Jizerou-Sklenařice, Vysoké nad Jizerou, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Český Ski klub Vysoké nad Jizerou
description: Šachty - Štěpánka Run is a traditional race organized by the Czech Ski Club in Vysoké nad Jizerou. The race is part of the Maratonstavu of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers runners a challenging course in the beautiful Krkonoše environment. The event attracts athletes and fans of uphill running who will enjoy the challenge and the atmosphere of a mountain race. The organizers welcome all runners who want to test their strength on this traditional route.
course_highlights: Challenging course in the Krkonoše Mountains
Uphill run with beautiful views
Part of the Maratonstavu of the Czech Cup
additional: The race is part of a series of uphill running events with a tradition dating back in history, and offers a demanding terrain suitable for experienced runners and mountain sports enthusiasts.

name: Kaszubski Festiwal Biegowy VII Kaszubski Maraton o Wschodzie Słońca
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji we Władysławowie
price_range: od 49.50 PLN do 250.00 PLN w zależności od dystansu i terminu
description: Kashubian Running Festival is a unique running event taking place on July 19, 2026, on a scenic route passing through the towns of Różewie, Swarzewo, Jastrzębia Góra, and back to Różewie. The festival offers various distances: marathon, half marathon, and races of 15 km, 10 km, and 5 km, ensuring that every runner, regardless of skill level, finds a suitable course. The marathon starts at 04:35, allowing participants to experience the extraordinary atmosphere of sunrise over Kashubia. After the races, organizers provide refreshments and a prize draw, creating a festive and social atmosphere.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque Kashubian towns and seaside areas
Marathon starts at dawn, providing a unique experience and energy on the course
Beautiful views of the seaside surroundings and the characteristic climate of Northern Pomerania
additional: The race route is available in .GPX, .KML, and .TCX (Garmin) formats for download. After the races, there is a refreshment and prize draw for participants. The event has a festival atmosphere and unites runners of various skill levels. The route is available for download, registration is open until the end of June 2026, and the event is a memorial for Franciszek Sojka.

description: Queen Bony's Five-Kilometer Run is a race covering a distance of 5 km held at the Municipal Stadium in Różan. The event is organized by the Różan Municipality and the Maków Mazowiecki Athletic Sports Club, and participants can expect professional service and timing measurement.

Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Różan
City route located in Różan

Timing is conducted using a modern UHF RFID system with instant results and SMS notifications sent to participants after the race. Venue: Municipal Stadium in Różan, online registration, distance: 5 km, participant age: from 15 years old.

name: VII Bieg Górski o Złotą Paproć
description: The 7th Mountain Run for the Golden Fern is a mountain race covering a distance of 10 km, taking place in the picturesque Tymbark. The event is an excellent opportunity to test your fitness on a challenging route with varied terrain. Organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to different levels of advancement. This event attracts runners who value challenges and contact with nature.
course_highlights: Mountain route of 10 km
Picturesque landscapes of Lesser Poland
Challenging terrain with uphill sections
additional: The organizer offers training plans from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level and expert support. There is also a runner zone on the website with tools for tracking progress and implementing training plans. The event is very popular, and participants can expect sporting competition and beautiful views. Participation is open to a wide group of runners, and the organizer provides various categories and attractions.

name: 07. Stadtholz Marathon
description: The Stadtholz Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a run at Heideteich featuring a trail of 6.14 km per lap. The event is not competitive in nature but is aimed at runners who enjoy running in nature. The marathon is held on the occasion of a leash wedding by Evi Köppe-Neeb and offers a special atmosphere at Heideteich. The course is characterized by natural trails and a peaceful environment.
course_highlights: Trail course at Heideteich
Lap of 6.14 km per round
Natural running course in Rheda-Wiedenbrück
additional: The run is explicitly not a competitive event. Organizer is Evi Köppe-Neeb. The course consists of trail laps at Heideteich, each 6.14 km long. The marathon is part of a regional event series; specific details about registration and terrain are not published.

name: Běh za Sliveneckou saní
description: The Slivenecká Sáně Run is a uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle, measuring 2.54 km with an elevation gain of 130 meters. This race is part of the series of uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for all who want to test their strength and endurance in hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.54 km
Elevation gain 130 m
Uphill race in Prague 5-Velká Chuchle
additional: The race takes place as part of the series of hilly runs, starting in three waves, with results published in categories. The event is suitable for runners of all levels who want to conquer a hilly course in a pleasant environment.

The corporate run promotes team spirit and combines exercise with socializing.
course_highlights: Course approximately 5 kilometers, run twice
Start and finish at Optima Sports Park Schwäbisch Hall
Free finish line refreshments with Erdinger Alkoholfrei, fruit, vegetables, and water

name: Wild and Run
description: The Wild & Run on July 22, 2026, transforms Oberkollbach into a running paradise and is part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw. The event offers runners a varied course through nature and invites both ambitious runners and running enthusiasts to stand at the starting line. The Wild & Run team looks forward to numerous participants and a sporty atmosphere in the idyllic surroundings.
course_highlights: Running course through nature around Oberkollbach
Part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup Pforzheim-Calw
Varied and scenic route

The event is organized by the Sportverein Oberkollbach. Running course, registration, children's runs, part of the Sparkassen Volkslaufcup

name: 402. Malá cena Monaka
description: The Small Monaka Run is a traditional running race organized by the KRB Chrudim club, held in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. The race offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on various courses and enjoy the atmosphere of the running community. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and attracts runners of all ages. Organizers emphasize quality organization and a friendly race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Traditional running race in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany
Various courses suitable for a wide range of runners
Part of the long-standing running tradition of the KRB Chrudim club
additional: The race takes place in July 2026, specific courses and registration information are not specified

name: 34. Lippesee Marathon
description: The 34th Lippesee Marathon in Paderborn-Sande is a private marathon race organized according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.1 km each, totaling 42.7 km, around Lippesee, a popular leisure area and water sports center. Participants are responsible for their own provisions, as there are no refreshment points, and they record their time manually, submitting a photo of the clock as proof via email. The race is designed for experienced runners aged 18 and over, with a participant limit of 18 people, and only takes place if at least five participants register.
course_highlights: Seven laps of 6.1 km around Lippesee, total 42.7 km
Course marked with arrows and flutter tape, GPS track and map available in advance
Course is heavily frequented in good weather, self-supply possible at the car after each lap
additional: Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, a photo of the clock on race day is required via email as proof. No showers or changing facilities are available. Participation is at your own risk, liability waiver applies. Registration by email until the day before at 6 pm with personal data. The organizer requests a voluntary donation of 5 € for a tree. Minimum age 18 years, participant limit 18 persons. Course: 7 laps of 6.1 km each, self-supply, no showers/changing rooms, participation at own risk, no liability of the organizer.

name: Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen
description: The Trompeterlauf Bad Säckingen is a traditional running event taking place on July 23, 2026, for the 20th time. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, from children (bambini) to teenagers and ambitious adults. The race connects the entire city and emphasizes the joy of running and shared experience. Whether beginner, team player, or competitive runner – everyone will find a suitable category here.
course_highlights: Varied courses for children, teenagers, and adults
Start and finish at the Town Hall Square in Bad Säckingen
Sporty ambitious Grieshaber Grand Prix with time limit
additional: Parent-child run without timing and without bib number, free participation on the event day without registration. Late registration fee on the event day is €5 per registration. Adult race shirts can be added for €15, registration deadline has passed. Runners with a finish time over 22 minutes start in the second block at 18:57. The Grieshaber Grand Prix is for the sporty ambitious with a target finish after 35 minutes. Certificates can be requested online via Datasport. Registration required; bib number distribution, award ceremonies, and certificates; various race categories and age groups; event takes place at the Town Hall Square.

name: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák
description: Tobiášův běh Kazín - Cukrák is part of the KOPEC series, which features uphill runs in Prague and the surrounding area. This traditional race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on challenging hilly courses in the picturesque environment of Kazín. The KOPEC series is known for its community atmosphere and support for runners of all categories, who are automatically included in the overall ranking. The race is suitable for everyone who enjoys running in nature and the challenges associated with hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill run in Prague and surrounding terrain
Challenging hilly courses in the natural environment of Kazín
Part of the traditional KOPEC series with scoring and league
additional: Participation in any KOPEC series race automatically qualifies runners for the overall league ranking. The series ranking is determined by the total points from up to the 10 best races. Runners must follow start rules according to categories and run with a visibly attached start number. In case of health threats, the race director may interrupt or terminate the race. The event is part of a series of hilly runs in Prague, with no specific course lengths provided. The race has a long tradition and is popular among local runners.

name: 13. Heilwald Marathon
description: The Heilwald Marathon in Bad Lippspringe is a special race held amidst the 200-hectare Heilwald, a uniquely European recreational and therapeutic forest with a calming low mountain climate. The course consists of six large laps of 7.05 km each, totaling 42.3 km, carefully measured with a surveyor’s wheel and GPS. The event is a private running event with self-supply, where times are manually recorded and a photo of the clock must be submitted as proof. Participation is at your own risk, and there is no entry fee; instead, a voluntary donation for tree planting is requested.
course_highlights: 6 laps of 7.05 km in Heilwald Bad Lippspringe
Europe-wide unique diverse Heilwald with low mountain climate
Self-supply with provisions at your own car after each lap
additional: Timing is done with a manual stopwatch, proof via photo of the clock on race day by email. No showers or changing rooms available. Participant limit 18, minimum age 18. Participation at your own risk with liability waiver. The organizer reserves the right to reject registrations without giving reasons. Course: 6 laps of 7.05 km, self-supply, no showers/changing rooms on site, participation at own risk, limited number of participants (18).

description: The 38th Heiligenhafen Midnight Run will take place on July 24, 2026, offering runners a special experience with start times late in the evening. The main course is a 10 km loop through the town of Heiligenhafen, along the promenade and around the inland lake, with plenty of support along the route. Additionally, there are other competitions such as the Inland Lake Run (approximately 5.5 km), the Midnight Double Mile (approximately 3.2 km) for youth, and the Mini Midnight Run (approximately 1 km) for children. The event is organized by TSV Heiligenhafen and is a popular tradition with electronic timing and an atmospheric program on the event day.
course_highlights: 10 km loop through Heiligenhafen with promenade and inland lake
Gentle inclines and declines, start and finish at the sports field Lütjenburger Weg
Additional routes: 5.5 km Inland Lake Run, 3.2 km Double Mile, 1 km Mini Midnight Run
additional: Electronic timing with transponder technology without rental fee, late registrations on race day until 1 hour before start for an additional charge, participant limit of 1250 runners, relay race possible, extensive supporting program with children's races, double mile, inland lake run, and Zumba events. The course is officially measured, with certificates, trophies, and cash prizes for top placements. There are individual and relay competitions, participation is open from age 16.

name: Bokeler Windmühlenlauf
description: The 20th Bokeler Windmill Run will take place on July 24, 2026, in Bokel. The event is a traditional anniversary race organized by ALG-VfL Bokel. The number of participants is limited to 300 people, and registration is via the RaceResult platform. The run offers runners a special atmosphere in the region and is a popular event for endurance and athletics enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Various race distances (5 km, 10 km, school run)
Local club atmosphere
Limited number of participants to 300 runners
additional: The starting places are limited to 300 persons. The organizational fee covers the provision costs and is non-refundable, even in case of force majeure. Registration is via RaceResult, limited starting places (300), date on 24.07.2026

name: Fun-Lauf "Durch den Wewerschen Wald"
description: The 33rd Fun Run "Through the Wewerschen Forest" in Paderborn is a community run without timing and without an entry fee, taking place on July 24, 2026. The event supports children in need through many thousands of steps and instead requests a donation. The runs take place on flat loop courses with minimal elevation gain and are suitable for everyone. Competitions for children and adolescents are also offered.
course_highlights: Flat loop course (one lap)
Minimal elevation gain (30 to 40 meters ascent)
Distance options 5 km and 7 km
additional: Run without timing and without an entry fee, instead please donate. There are competitions for children and adolescents. The destination is not publicly displayed (RUNME Premium required). Run on flat loop courses, various distances, no timing, no entry fee, donations for charitable purposes.

name: Sparkassen-Adam-Riese-Nachtlauf
description: The Sparkassen-Adam-Riese Night Run is an evening running event in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria, offering races for children, recreational runners, and experienced participants. The event takes place in summer and is part of the Bavarian running calendar. The course lengths range from short distances for schoolchildren to main races of about 9 kilometers. The special feature is the night race format, which allows runners to run under the evening sky, setting it apart from typical daytime races.
course_highlights: Various distances from 780 m to approximately 10 km
Night race atmosphere under the evening sky
Event in summer in Bad Staffelstein, Bavaria
additional: The event offers races for different age groups and performance levels, including children and recreational runs. The weather in July is usually sunny with an average of 25 °C during the day and 15 °C at night. Night race with multiple distances, part of Bayern running calendar, held in summer in Bad Staffelstein.

name: Waldlaufmeisterschaft SV Renquishausen
description: The 37th Waldlauf Championships will take place on July 24, 2026, in Renquishausen in the Black Forest. The race is part of the Silberdistel series and offers various distances for children, students, recreational runners, and the main race. The event is open to all age groups and takes place in all weather conditions. Bib numbers will be distributed from 4:00 PM, and the award ceremony will be held approximately one hour after the last finish at the sports house.
course_highlights: Course lengths: children 500 m, students 1 km and 2 km, recreational runners 5.7 km, main race 10 km
Start times from 5:30 PM for children, 5:35/5:45 PM for students, 6:00 PM for recreational runners and the main race
Changing rooms and showers available at the community center Renquishausen
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start at the race management. Bib number distribution begins at 4:00 PM in the foyer of the community center. Award ceremony and certificate presentation approximately 1 hour after the last finish at the sports house. Changing rooms and showers are available at the community center. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Start times: children 5:30 PM, students 5:35/5:45 PM, main race & recreational runners 6:00 PM; Weather in July usually around 25°C, mostly sunny.

name: WAREMA Lauf
description: The 19th WAREMA Run in Marktheidenfeld offers a diverse running experience for all age and performance levels. From short children’s and school runs to the motivating 5 km corporate run and the challenging 10 km main race, there is something for everyone. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and an exciting mood that inspires both beginners and experienced runners. Start and finish are located at the district sports facility, which serves as the central event location.
course_highlights: Children’s and school runs with short distances (630m, 1260m)
5 km corporate run as a team competition
10 km main race as a challenge for long-distance runners
additional: Start times: Children’s run at 17:00, school run at 17:15, school relay race at 17:30, corporate run at 18:00, 10 km race at 18:45. Teams consist of 4 people. The event location is the district sports facility in Marktheidenfeld. Courses include 630 m children’s run, 1260 m school run, 4x630 m school relay, 5 km corporate run, 10 km main race; registration is online, start and finish are at the district sports facility.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon 2026
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatras, in Zakopane. The route runs along the crest of the Red Peaks and Starorobociański Wierch, offering two demanding vertical ascents of approximately 1200 meters each, interwoven with challenging Tatra descents. The event is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of Podhale and Orawa, providing participants and spectators with unforgettable experiences. Organizers invite you to participate and cheer along the course.
course_highlights: Route through the crest of the Red Peaks and Starorobociański Wierch
Two demanding vertical ascents of about 1200 meters each
Challenging Tatra descents
additional: For participants in Orava 120 and Orava 80, additional transport to the start from Siwa Polana is provided (paid during registration: 45 PLN for Orava 120, 60 PLN for Orava 80). Buses depart at 17:45 and 4:00 respectively. Mandatory equipment is required, and interactive maps of the routes and elevation profiles are available for download. The event includes various distances such as Orava 120, Orava 80, Marathon, Tatra Trail, Mini Tatra Sky, and Tatra Skyline. Participants can enjoy a rich festival program, and registration details are available on the official website.

name: 10. NORDERNEY - meine Insel Lauf
price_range: 25 EUR für Erwachsene, 20 EUR für Kids
description: The NORDERNEY - my island run is a maritime race that has been held annually since 2016 on the North Sea island of Norderney. The event offers a unique running experience amidst the natural surroundings of the island and a special atmosphere. The race routes lead through the historic Kurplatz, past sights such as the Napoleon Bunker, the swan pond, and the island windmill. The race is suitable for all age groups and includes distances from the children's run to the half marathon.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kurplatz with Conversations House and Bath House
Passing the Napoleon Bunker, the oldest monument of Norderney
Run through the busy shopping streets with spectator support
additional: Official functional shirt can be ordered during registration and will be handed out with the start documents. Functional shirt costs 25 EUR for adults and 20 EUR for children. Late registrations are possible online until 22.07.2026 for a fee, as well as on-site on 24th and 25th July 2026. Timing is done with ChampionChip, rental fee for the chip varies between 3 and 5 EUR depending on the race. Preferred start number can be requested for an additional 3 EUR. Limit times: 1:15 hours for 10 km, 2:30 hours for half marathon. Island and maritime theme, sustainable functional shirt, on-site registration, results online, ferry connections for participants, test run the day before, certificates and medals for children.

name: 6. GEO-Pfad Ultramarathon
description: The GEO Path Ultramarathon is a 50 km trail run starting in Kaltenweide, Langenhagen, Germany. The course features a slight elevation change of approximately 350 meters and must be completed within 8 hours. The route passes through forest and trail sections, past the Brelinger Berg with its geological nature trail, and back along the Bissendorfer Moor. The event is registered with the German Ultramarathon Association and offers online results, certificates, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: 50 km trail with approximately 350 m elevation change
Loop course over Brelinger Berg and geological nature trail
Section along Bissendorfer Moor
additional: Participants have 8 hours to complete the course. The event offers finisher medals, online results, and certificates. Typical July weather is around 25 °C with mostly sunny days. The route includes 16 km from Kaltenweide to Brelingen, 18 km around Brelinger Berg and the geological natural monument, and the final 16 km back to Kaltenweide along Bissendorfer Moor. The event provides certificates and finisher medals.

name: FriesenCross
description: The Friesencross in Schillig is one of the most extraordinary cross-country running events in Germany and takes place on July 25, 2026. The course runs directly along the beach and offers a unique natural experience along the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wattenmeer. Runners cross soft sandy beaches, green meadows, and even the muddy seabed, perfectly combining athletic challenge with North Sea feeling. The event is accompanied by running sports presenter Heino Krüger, who guides the day with much experience. Parallel to the race, the Friesenfestival takes place, providing atmosphere, music, and culinary highlights.
course_highlights: Running course directly on the beach of Schillig
Route along the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wattenmeer
Course over sandy beach, green meadows, and muddy seabed
additional: The event is accompanied by running sports presenter Heino Krüger. Parallel to the Friesencross, the Friesenfestival takes place on the beach of Schillig, offering music, atmosphere, and culinary highlights. Races on sand, meadows, and mud; various distances (400 m to 10 km); accompanying program with Friesenfestival; registration includes a jersey; race moderation by Heino Krüger.

name: Allersberger Kirchweihlauf
location: Marktplatz Allersberg, Allersberg, Mittelfranken, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Allersberg Kirchweihlauf takes place annually on the last weekend of July in Allersberg and is part of the Raiffeisen Läufer-Cup in the BLV district of Middle Franconia-South. The event offers various races, including a Bambini run over 400 meters as well as other competitions for students and adults. The course is a very flat loop starting and ending at the Allersberg marketplace. For refreshments, water stations and catering are provided at the finish line, and the event is organized by an experienced team.
course_highlights: Very flat loop course at the Allersberg marketplace
2 water stations per lap
Catering at the finish with water, ISO drinks, apples, and bananas
additional: Race office, award ceremony, late registrations, race documents, and changing rooms are located at Westhof Gilardihaus at the marketplace 20. Showers are available at Rothseehalle TSV Allersberg, Altenfeldener Str. 16. Arrival by S-Bahn line 5 or DB station Allersberg-Rothsee, from the station with a call bus to the marketplace. Parking is approximately 50 meters from the start/finish area. Races take place on a very flat loop course in the city center. Registration online until July 22, 2026. Late registrations are possible on race day. Start and finish at the Allersberg marketplace.

name: Freundschaftslauf Hasborn
description: The Friendship Run Hasborn is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Hasborn. The event offers various distances, from short races for the youth to challenging distances such as 5 km, 11 km, and 21 km. The atmosphere is family-friendly and motivating, with lively ambiance and numerous volunteers ensuring a successful event. The run is a sporting highlight in the region and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 100 m to 21 km
Motivating atmosphere with music and refreshment stations
Family-friendly running event with a large number of participants
additional: The run takes place annually in summer, featuring a large bridge party as a motivational station including music and cheerleaders. There is catering with water, isotonic drinks, and snacks along the route. The club's running group meets regularly on Wednesdays, providing good preparation for the race. Courses for children and adults, no official times for all distances, annual event with a special community character.

name: HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf, 46. Int. Volkslauf mit HM
description: The HTV-SPARDA-Rheinuferlauf in Duisburg is a traditional community race with a flat course along the Rhine. On July 25, 2026, competitions will be held over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and the half marathon (21.1 km). The flat route makes the race attractive to runners of all performance levels. The finish line is the same for all competitions, and the event offers a pleasant atmosphere for both recreational and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Flat course along the Rhine
Competitions over 5 km, 7.5 km walking, 10 km, and half marathon
Same finish line for all competitions
additional: Start times: 7.5 km walking at 15:00, 5 km run at 16:50, 10 km run at 17:40, half marathon at 17:30. All competitions take place on a flat course. Results are published on the RUNME results page. The event takes place on July 25, 2026, and offers start times for various competitions. Results are available shortly after the race. The event is especially attractive in good weather.

name: Mulsumer Speckenlauf
location: Sportplatz Mulsum, Wurster Nordseeküste, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: kostenfrei für Mitglieder, sonst nicht explizit
description: The Mulsumer Speckenlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by TSV Mulsum. The event takes place at the Mulsum sports field in the Wurster North Sea Coast and attracts numerous runners. The course offers a sporting challenge and is accompanied by a friendly atmosphere. In addition to the main race, there is also a children's sports festival with classic disciplines, emphasizing the family-oriented character of the event.
course_highlights: 5.3 km course with sporting challenge
Start and finish at Mulsum sports field
Family-friendly children's sports festival with classic disciplines after the race
additional: Registration on-site is possible until 45 minutes before the start. A monetary prize is awarded for breaking a course record. Course length 5.3 km, 10 km; start and finish at Mulsum sports field; registration until July 23 via wattzeit; participation at own risk.

name: Rechberghäuser Sommernachtslauf
description: The 14th Rechberghäuser Summer Night Run will take place on July 25, 2026, in Rechberghausen. This event, officially registered with the German Athletics Federation, allows participants to achieve times recognized for athletics best lists. The run supports the solidarity system in sports and offers a sporting challenge in a pleasant summer atmosphere. The event includes two distances suitable for both children and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Distances: 300 m and 10 km
Official recognition by the German Athletics Federation
Summery weather with an average of 25 °C and mostly sunny days
additional: The start location is in Rechberghausen. The event takes place under typical July weather with an average of 25 °C and mostly sunny conditions. The event supports the solidarity system in sports and offers a festive night running atmosphere.

name: Reichenbacher Citylauf
location: Reichenbach an der Fils, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
price_range: 3 € pro Teilnehmer (Bambini), keine Gebühr für Staffellauf
description: The 31st Reichenbacher City Run takes place as part of the Reichenbacher Village Festival on Saturday, July 25, 2026. This year, only the Bambini race for children and the school relay races are offered. The races start and end at the Reichenbach Town Hall and provide a great opportunity for elementary school classes and the youngest runners to engage in sports and have fun together.
course_highlights: Bambini race: one lap of 650 meters
School relay race: 4 x 650 meters with at least one girl per team
Start and finish at Reichenbach Town Hall
additional: Late registrations for the Bambini race are possible up to 30 minutes before the start. No late registration is possible for the school relay races. Certificates can be collected free of charge at registration. No timing will be conducted for the Bambini race. Courses: Bambini 650 m, relay race 4 x 650 m; registration via email; no late registration; no timing

name: Sechs-Std.-Lauf am Förderturm Bönen
location: Ehemaliges Zechengelände, Bönen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Six-Hour Run at Förderturm Bönen is a unique ultramarathon event held on an officially measured loop course on the former mining site. The route is traffic-free, gently profiled, and consists of asphalt and solid gravel. The event offers comprehensive catering, including vegan options, and professional lap timing via race result. Open to participants aged 20 and above, it is aimed at experienced ultrarunners who wish to test their endurance in a friendly and well-organized atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course on former mining site, traffic-free
Lap length 1,340 meters, surface of asphalt and solid gravel
Officially measured route with gentle profiling
additional: Number pickup on the day of the event from 07:00 to 08:30. Showers and changing rooms are available at the nearby Goethesporthalle and the Förderturm Schachthalle (unattended, no liability). Catering before and during the run with a variety of foods and drinks, including vegan options. Electronic lap timing via race result with residual meter measurement. First aid provided by the DRK Ortsverein Bönen e.V. The award ceremony is around 4 p.m. Participation is open from 20 years old. Maximal 200 participants, registration on site possible with a 10 euro fee. Loop course on former mining site, vegan catering, number pickup 07:00-08:30, participation from age 20.

name: Tote Mann Berglauf / 10. Oberrieder Kinderlauf
description: The Tote Mann Berglauf in Oberried is a challenging mountain run over 11.1 km with 750 meters of elevation gain on forest paths and trails. Additionally, the 10th Oberried Children's Run takes place on a flat course at the Goldberghalle, with distances ranging from 0.4 to 1.2 km depending on age group. The race offers a special atmosphere with a varied course and refreshment stations. The start is on July 25, 2026, from 10:00 AM, with different start times for the children's runs.
course_highlights: 11.1 km mountain run with 750 meters of elevation gain on forest paths and trails
Flat children's course at the Goldberghalle with 0.4 to 1.2 km
Refreshment stations along the course
additional: Late registrations on site are possible for a fee. Children's runs are limited to a total of 100 pre-registrations and 20 late registrations. Training runs for preparation are offered by PTSV Jahn Freiburg, participation is free, registration for the 4th training run is required. Forest and woodland paths, online registration until July 22, 2026, late registration on site possible, preparation runs in Freiburg, return transport from Stollenbacher Hütte.

description: The Run for Thea is a charity race organized by the Smilovice Helping Foundation, taking place on July 25, 2026, at the Smilovice Sports Center. This race supports the treatment and rehabilitation of little Thea, who is facing serious health complications. Participants can choose from several routes of different lengths and age categories, whether they want to compete or just walk. The event is open to everyone who wants to support a good cause and experience the joy of movement in a community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Routes run on asphalt and paved paths, suitable for strollers and wheelchair users (accessible route).
Available routes: 600 m children's race (ages 0-5 and 6-10), 2 km junior race, 4 km hobby race, and 12 km main race.
Start and finish are at the Smilovice Sports Center with parking available.
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers begin at 8:00 AM. Starts are divided by categories from 9:30 to 11:11. The proceeds from the entry fees are fully dedicated to supporting the treatment and rehabilitation of Thea. There is an option to purchase a lottery ticket for the tombola. Routes are marked with colors according to length (green for 4 km, red for 12 km).

name: Běh na Lysou horu
location: restaurace Zlatník, Krásná-Nižní Mohelnice, Czech Republic
description: The Lysá hora Run is a traditional race held every last Saturday of July in Krásná - Nižní Mohelno. This 41st edition will welcome runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, who aim to conquer Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains. The race starts near the Zlatník restaurant at the intersection to Lysá hora, where registration and the award ceremony also take place. The course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority up to the summit of Lysá hora.
course_highlights: Start near the Zlatník restaurant at the intersection to Lysá hora
The entire course runs along an asphalt road on a forest road managed by the Czech Forests Authority
Finish at the summit of Lysá hora, the queen of the Beskydy Mountains
additional: The race is open to runners from the Czech Republic and Poland, takes place in the Beskydy Mountains, and is part of regional and national running competitions.

description: The Borovská Ten is a traditional running race held in the picturesque village of Havlíčkova Borová in the Vysočina region. The race offers a 10 km course with a gentle elevation gain, mainly through forest and asphalt roads, ensuring a pleasant running experience even in sunny weather thanks to the shade of trees. The start and finish are located in the center of the village, with refreshment stations on the course and at the finish. After the race, there is abundant refreshments and a ceremonial announcement of winners in various categories.
course_highlights: 10 km course with a total elevation gain of 139 m
The first third of the course runs along a forest path, the rest on asphalt roads
Refreshment stations at 5 km and at the finish, course runs through a forest with pleasant shade
additional: Registration for the main category takes place from 14:30 to 16:15, the main race starts at 17:00. Showers, changing rooms, toilets, and baggage storage are available. Throughout the race, there is abundant refreshments at the finish including drinks, grilled delicacies, draft beer, and ice cream. Timing is provided by chip timing integrated into the start number, with a timing mat only at the finish. The race is part of the local running tradition, with results available on the website and the possibility to participate in children's categories.

name: 26. Bieg Dookoła Morynia i Jeziora Morzycko
location: Miejski Ośrodek Kultury w Moryniu, Moryń, Zachodniopomorskie, Poland
description: We invite you to the 26th edition of the Race Around Moryń and Lake Morzycko, a unique event combining sporting competition with the beauty of Western Pomerania. The race route runs along a picturesque trail around Lake Morzycko, offering participants unforgettable views and an atmosphere of sporting community. It is an excellent opportunity for runners and active lifestyle enthusiasts to meet in Moryń and enjoy outdoor activity. Regardless of experience, everyone will find something for themselves here.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Morzycko
Beautiful views of Western Pomerania
Atmosphere of sporting community and active lifestyle
additional: Registrations are conducted through the platform dostartu.pl. The regulations are available in PDF format on the organizer's website. The event takes place at the Miejski Ośrodek Kultury in Moryń. Race around Lake Morzycko, registration via external link, scenic route, event date July 25, 2026

description: The Warsaw Uprising Run is an annual running event held in Warsaw, commemorating the Heroes of the Warsaw Uprising. The event attracts thousands of participants who start on distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, creating a unique, solemn atmosphere of patriotism and historical remembrance. The run is wave-started and takes place in the evening, which further emphasizes its distinctive character. Organizers also offer a virtual edition, allowing participation from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km routes are certified by PZLA
Wave start in the evening - 5 km at 20:30, 10 km at 21:20
Time limit: 60 minutes for 5 km, 90 minutes for 10 km
additional: Wave start divided into 3 waves approximately every 6 minutes for the 5 km and every 7 minutes for the 10 km. Participants in the 10 km race are ceremoniously brought to the start line at 21:15. Participant limit: 7,500 for 10 km and 5,000 for 5 km. Race bibs are collected at the Race Office at ul. Konwiktorska 6 in Warsaw from July 24-26, 2025. On race day, bib collection for participants from outside Warsaw is possible from 16:00 to 18:00. Required documents include an ID and a QR code for packet pickup. Minors must present a parental or guardian statement. The event includes both on-site and virtual options, with medals, T-shirts, and certificates, and aims to honor the memory of the Warsaw Uprising.

name: Tatra SkyMarathon
description: Tatra SkyMarathon is a prestigious mountain race held in the heart of the Tatra Mountains, in Witów in the Podhale region. The race route runs along the crest of the Red Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch, offering two demanding vertical ascents of approximately 1200 meters each, interwoven with challenging Tatra descents. The event is part of a running festival that highlights the sporting character of the Podhale and Orawa regions, providing participants and spectators with unforgettable experiences. Organizers invite you to participate and cheer along the course.
course_highlights: Route through the crest of the Red Wierchy and Starorobociański Wierch
Two demanding vertical ascents of approximately 1200 meters each
Challenging Tatra descents
additional: Additional transport to the start of Orava 120 and Orava 80 from the parking lot at Siwa Polana (paid). Orava 120 start at 19:00 on 24.07.2026, Orava 80 start at 6:00 on 25.07.2026. Mandatory and recommended equipment available on the website. The festival includes many mountain races of various lengths and characters. The event features different race categories, a festival atmosphere, registration information and accompanying attractions, as well as volunteer options.
