description: The 24th St. James Street Run is an annual sporting event organized in Lębork to honor the city's patron. The race takes place on an approved 10 km route through the city streets, properly secured by security services. The honorary start is at Pokoju Square, and the official start is on Armii Krajowej Street. The finish line is at Pokoju Square in front of the stage. Participants must be at least 16 years old and follow traffic rules.
course_highlights: Certified route of 10 km length
Route runs through the streets of Lębork
Honorary start at Pokoju Square, official start on Armii Krajowej Street, finish at Pokoju Square
additional: Personal registrations, pickup of race packs and chips take place on July 24, 2026 from 17:00 to 20:00 and on July 25, 2026 from 7:00 to 9:00 at the Race Office in the gymnasium of the Special Educational and Educational Center at Curie-Skłodowska Street. Participants under 18 from Lębork County are exempt from the start fee upon presenting a valid school ID. The first 600 finishers will receive a commemorative medal. Medicover Sport users can get a 20 PLN discount on the start fee. The route is certified, with start and finish at Pokoju Square, secured by security services, and participants are required to follow traffic rules. Race packs are to be collected on the day of the event.

name: 9 Bieg Lubliniecki
description: The 9th Lubliniec Run is an annual running event organized by Mafia Team Lubliniec, scheduled for July 25, 2026. The main distance is a 10 km run, and participants can also take part in races for children and youth. The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec. The course will be announced soon, and the event is well-regarded with numerous awards in the categories of small-scale runs and 10 km races.
course_highlights: 10 km course (details to be available soon)
Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
Races for children and youth as a supplement to the event
additional: The race office is located at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec at 74 Górnośląski Regiment of Infantry Street 1. The course will be published soon. The event has received numerous awards and prizes granted by Maratony Polskie. Cross-country, 10 km, online registration and on-site registration, age categories, and official championships.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Gdynia - summer edition is cross-country running organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with exceptional sports and landscape experiences. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time in the beautiful surroundings of Gdynia.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on scenic routes of Gdynia
Routes emphasizing the aesthetic qualities of the location
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events organized in Gliwice in 2026. The events take place on Saturdays, once a month, on a 4219.5-meter route in the municipal forest, with start and finish at the Piast stadium. The event promotes a healthy and active outdoor lifestyle, encouraging regular physical activity under the slogan "Let yourself be provoked to fight laziness!".
course_highlights: Route length of 4219.5 meters in Gliwice municipal forest
Runs through forest paths, gravel roads, and partially asphalt
Refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line after each lap
additional: The events take place in the Gliwice municipal forest, with start and finish at Piast stadium. The race office is open from 9:00 AM on race day. There is an option to participate in the e-Provocation in case of a ban on stationary events. Participants can choose from 1 to 5 laps (4.2 km to over 21 km). Time control is conducted after each lap. The route is not closed to other pedestrians. Participation of wheelchair users is not permitted. The event is held in the park, with regulations, race office, and contact via email.

name: XIII Pętla Tuszkowska Matka
description: The 13th Tuszkowo Loop Mother is a 10 km race held in Lipusz as part of the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series. The event is part of the largest running event in northern Poland, bringing together running enthusiasts from the entire region. The race route takes participants through picturesque areas of Kashubia, offering unique views and sporting challenges. We invite runners of all ages to participate and celebrate sport and outdoor activity together.
course_highlights: 10 km route in scenic Lipusz
Part of the Kaszuby Biegają 2026 series
Runs through charming Kashubian landscapes
additional: The race route can be viewed on the Endomondo profile at: https://www.endomondo.com/users/20588117/workouts/556468658. The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, which includes many runs in the Kashubia region in 2026. Forest trail, online and on-site registration, program and medal, part of the Northern Poland Running Festival.

name: 38. Frankenwaldlauf
description: The 38th Frankenwaldlauf in Oßla offers races over 18.5 km and 9 km as well as Nordic walking. Additionally, there are shorter distances for children and adolescents, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf. The course runs through the Thuringian Forest and features a beautiful natural scenery. The event is part of regional running cups and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with on-site catering and award ceremonies.
course_highlights: Course through the Thuringian Forest with beautiful views
Marked routes over 18.5 km, 9 km, and 3.5 km
Separate children and youth races, including the Oßlaer Gimpel-Lauf
additional: Race numbers and payment are to be made on-site on race day. Late registrations are possible until 8:15 a.m. There is catering with water, tea, soft drinks, fruit, as well as sausages and beverages for sale. Changing rooms and toilets are available free of charge at the cultural center at the start/finish area. Parking is sufficient, e.g., at the cemetery and start/finish area. Certificates will be sent via email after the race. The award ceremony takes place at 11:30 a.m. in the start/finish area. Card payment is not possible; the nearest ATM is in Wurzbach. Races over 3.5 km, 9 km, and 18.5 km; registration on-site; parking at the cemetery and start/finish; changing rooms at the cultural center; marked routes; catering along the route and at the finish; certificates via email; late registrations until 8:15 a.m. on race day.

name: Altmühl-Jura Halbmarathon
description: The Altmühl-Jura Half Marathon is a traditional race in the scenic region around Greding. The course runs through the diverse landscape of the Altmühl-Jura area and offers runners a challenging and visually appealing experience. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all performance levels and is organized by the town of Greding. The Greding Tourist Information serves as the contact point.
course_highlights: Landscape of the Altmühl-Jura area
Diverse and scenic course
Traditional race event in Greding
additional: Contact person is the Greding Tourist Information, reachable at 08463 904-20. The event takes place in Greding. More information and registration are available on the official websites. Terrain: roads and paved bike paths; online registration; medal for finishers included, certificates available online; race in July 2026

name: Blutenburglauf
description: The Blutenburglauf takes place on July 26, 2026, in Munich-Untermenzing and offers attractive running routes along the Würm River and around the historic Blutenburg. The event includes distances of 5 km and 10 km, which lead charmingly through nature. Timing is done electronically with transponders in the bibs, and refreshments are provided with drinks along the course and at the finish. The event is organized by the Rotary Club Munich-Blutenburg Gemeindienste e.V. and features not only the athletic competition but also an entertainment program in the start/finish area.
course_highlights: 10 km route along the Würm River and around Blutenburg
5 km route with scenic course
Drink stations between km 5 and 6 during the 10 km race
additional: Race bib pickup on July 25 from 14:00 to 18:00 and on July 26 from 7:30 until 30 minutes before the start. Net timing with electronic transponder. Changing rooms, showers, and baggage storage are limited. Paramedics are present along the course and at the finish. Awards ceremonies for the fastest runners and teams take place shortly after the competitions. Public transport connections via S2 and bus lines are available. The run is a charity event, with 100% of the entry fees donated to social projects. High-quality functional shirts for the first 150 registrations. Online registration available. Start from 10:00 AM, in any weather.

name: Hausener Volks-Waldlauf (TGS-Hausen)
location: Sportplatz TGS Hausen, Obertshausen, Hesse, Germany
price_range: Nachmeldung 5 € für Erwachsene, online Anmeldung bis 25.07.2025, Kinder frei
description: The Hausener Volks-Waldlauf organized by TGS Hausen will take place on July 26, 2026, offering races over various distances, including half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, as well as shorter youth and children’s runs. The start and finish are at the sports field of TGS Hausen in Obertshausen. The courses mostly run on well-marked, flat forest paths, with the half marathon consisting of two laps of 10 km each. Timing is done via transponder with gross time measurement, and there is a team classification over 100 km. The race is open to all age groups and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with good organization.
course_highlights: Well-marked, flat forest paths
Half marathon as two laps of 10 km
Start and finish at the sports field of TGS Hausen
additional: Late registration is possible on the day of the event until 15 minutes before the start, with an additional fee of 5 euros for adults, and free for youths and children. Spikes are prohibited on the sports field. Timing is provided by R.S.T. Volkslauf GmbH. There is a 100 km team classification, in which runners from the half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km can participate (up to 20 participants per team). Courses on forest paths, gross and net time measurement, refreshments on the course and at the finish, late registration possible until just before the start.

name: Kinderfestlauf Wangen im Allgäu
organizer: Kinderfestkommission Wangen im Allgäu e. V.
description: The Children's Festival Run in Wangen im Allgäu is part of the traditional Children's and Homeland Festival, which has been celebrated for over 180 years. The race takes place on the Sunday of the festival weekend and offers children and teenagers from Wangen and the surrounding area a sporting attraction. The festival includes numerous other events such as the colorful parade, eagle shooting, and a diverse program for the whole family. The event combines sporting ambition with festive community spirit in the historic old town of Wangen.
course_highlights: Run for children and teenagers as part of the Children's Festival
Part of the large, partly redesigned parade on Saturday
Event in the historic old town of Wangen im Allgäu
additional: The Children's Festival Run takes place on Sunday at 2:00 PM in the Allgäu Stadium. The award ceremony is held at 4:00 PM in the festival tent. The festival offers a comprehensive supporting program with a parade, theater, eagle shooting, festival tent operations, and fireworks. There are no explicit details about start waves, participant limits, or entry fees on the websites. The event is scheduled for July 2026 and includes not only the races but also attractions for children as well as a parade. Results are available online.

name: Kusterdinger Hornissenlauf - 4. Lauf des VR-Cups
description: The Kusterdinger Hornissenlauf is a scenic race with a family-friendly character and timing, held annually since 1990. The challenging course of approximately 10 kilometers runs over paved forest and bike paths and ends on the synthetic track of the Kusterdingen stadium. In addition to the main race, there are also student, youth, children's runs, a hobby run, and Nordic walking. The event is supported by the municipality of Kusterdingen and the Volksbank in the region, offering medals and certificates to all participants as well as awards for the best runners.
course_highlights: Challenging 10 kilometers on paved forest and bike paths
Finish on the synthetic track of the Kusterdingen stadium
Various race distances for all age groups and Nordic walking
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late registration fee of €3.00 per registration. The award ceremony begins at 11:00 AM in the gymnasium and festival hall. The top runners receive honorary prizes, all participants get medals and certificates. The largest pre-registered group will receive a special prize. Course on paved forest paths, no wheelchair or baby jogger approval, no dogs allowed, test run on July 17, 2026, weather around 25°C, sunny.

name: Langauer Inklusionslauf
description: The 3rd Langau Inclusion Run will take place on July 26, 2026, in cooperation with the Tri-Team Schongau as part of the 14th Schongau Triathlon. The race is open to everyone who wishes to participate alone, in pairs, or with assistance, including wheelchair users. The course is a flat loop with start and finish at Lechuferstraße near the ice stadium. Participation is free of charge, but donations to support Langau are welcome. Each registered participant will receive a running shirt and a finisher gift, and trophies will be awarded for the top places in various categories.
course_highlights: Flat loop course with start and finish at Lechuferstraße near the ice stadium
Participation alone, in pairs (pairing on race day), or with assistance possible
Accessible participation, including wheelchair users
additional: Registration on race day is possible up to 1.5 hours before the start. Parking is available at the Volksfestplatz, with additional parking for people with disabilities. Showers and toilets are available at the ice stadium, Plantsch Erlebnisbad, and Tennisheim, with accessible toilets at Plantsch and a mobile accessible toilet at the start/finish area. Award ceremony around 3:30 PM. Includes catering, medals, sport bags, and wristbands; online registration; supported by the Triathlon Team Schongau and Aktion Mensch; parking at Volksfestplatz; accessible toilets at the start/finish area.

name: Mercaden Stadtlauf Böblingen
description: The MERCADEN® Böblingen City Run is a traditional race event held annually in the city center of Böblingen. On July 27, 2026, runners of various age groups and distances will start, including the Sparkassen Run over 10.2 km, the Lotto Run over 5.1 km, as well as children and school runs. The start and finish are located at Alba Bridge/Wandelhalle, ensuring an attractive and central route through the city. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Alba Bridge/Wandelhalle
Course lengths from 500 m to 10.2 km for different age groups
Central city route with good accessibility
additional: Late registrations are possible on July 25 from 15:00 to 18:00 and on July 26 from 11:00 to 13:00 on-site at the center in front of Deichmann. The race bibs will be distributed at the same times. Award ceremonies will take place on the event day at 11:30 a.m. (Sparkassen, Lotto, Junior Run) and 1:30 p.m. (Children's races). The terrain includes urban streets. Registration is available online and on-site. The event on July 26, 2026, features children and family runs as well as supporting programs.

name: Oscheffer TSG-Lauf
description: The 17th Oscheffer TSG Run will take place on July 26, 2026, in Mainaschaff. The event offers various running competitions for different age groups and performance levels, including a school and youth run, Sparkassen run (5 km), agilimo run (10 km), children’s run, and relay race. The races are part of a traditional sports event organized by TSG Mainaschaff 1973 e.V. and appeal to both recreational and ambitious runners. Online registration is already open, and further information is available in the official announcement.
course_highlights: Varied race distances from children’s runs to 10 km
Start and finish in Mainaschaff
Traditional sports event organized by TSG Mainaschaff
additional: The event includes school and youth runs, Sparkassen run (5 km), agilimo run (10 km), children’s run, and relay race. Registration is available online via the official website. The organizer's address is Schuberstraße 4, 63814 Mainaschaff. The event features various categories such as school and youth runs, children’s runs, relay races, as well as the 5 km and 10 km runs. Online registration is possible. The courses are measured and offer the best price conditions.

name: Rainer Volkslauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: bis zum 11.05. gelten noch die günstigsten Anmeldepreise

description: The Rainer Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, July 26, 2026, in Rain and offers runners of all ages a varied and motivating running experience. The main race over 10 km starts at 9:30 a.m., followed by 5 km runs and the shorter Spatzenläufe over 1 km and 2 km. The focus is on the fun of movement and health prevention, supported by enthusiastic spectators and a diverse accompanying program as part of the SC Rains 1928 e. V. sports week. When registering by June 15, 2026, a popular Volkslauf T-shirt is included in the starter package. Additionally, one euro per participant is donated to the aid campaign "Freunde durch Helfen".
course_highlights: 10 km Hauptlauf startet um 9:30 Uhr
5 km Läufe starten gegen 11:00 Uhr
1 km und 2 km Spatzenläufe ab 11:50 Uhr, zeitversetzt
additional: Siegerehrungen ab 13:00 Uhr. Bei Anmeldung bis 15.06.2026 ist ein Volkslauf-T-Shirt im Starterpaket enthalten. Pro Teilnehmer wird 1 Euro an die Hilfsaktion „Freunde durch Helfen“ gespendet. Der Lauf findet im Rahmen der Sportwoche des SC Rains 1928 e. V. statt. Läufe am Sonntagvormittag, Anmeldung online, T-Shirt im Starterpaket, vielfältiges Rahmenprogramm, Benefizaktion zugunsten der Kinderlobby e. V.

name: Rieslinglauf und 17. Rheingauer Halbmarathon
description: The Riesling Run and the Rheingau Half Marathon are traditional running events that have taken place for over 40 years in the picturesque vineyard landscape of Oestrich-Winkel. The races lead through gentle hills and offer an idyllic panorama of the Rhine Valley. The event includes various distances, including 10 km, half marathon, 5 km fun run, and a 2000 m school run, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Course through the gentle hilly landscape of the vineyards above Mittelheim and Oestrich
Mostly asphalted route with slight inclines and approximately 90 meters of elevation on 10 km
Idyllic panorama of the Rhine Valley
additional: Maximum number of participants limited to 555 starters. Late registrations only on the day of the event until 8:00 AM on-site with a late registration fee of 5 EUR, cash only. Each participant receives a running shirt with timely registration; later registrations while supplies last. Timing is done with a transponder on the bib. Cut-off time at the finish line is 11:30 AM on race day. Prizes for age groups and special awards for the largest participating group/club as well as new personal bests. The route runs through vineyards, mainly asphalted paths with slight inclines; online registration until 24.07.2026; start at Vollradsser Allee sports field; limited to 555 participants; participation possible for children and adolescents.

name: Südries-Kesseltal Halbmarathon mit Philipp Pflieger
description: The South Riese-Kesseltal Half Marathon with Philipp Pflieger takes place on July 26, 2026, in Mönchsdeggingen. The event celebrates the 100th anniversary of TSV Mönchsdeggingen and offers runners the opportunity to participate in a traditional half marathon. The course runs through the scenic Kesseltal and promises an athletic experience with team spirit and good atmosphere, as in previous years. The event includes distances of 3 km and 21.1 km and takes place in typical July weather with pleasant temperatures.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Kesseltal
Traditional half marathon for the 100th anniversary of TSV Mönchsdeggingen
Atmospheric event with dedicated volunteers and team spirit
additional: Typical July weather with an average of 25°C and mostly sunny days. Starting point is Mönchsdeggingen. Weather in July typically ranges between 15°C and 25°C, with an average of 75mm of precipitation; starting point in Mönchsdeggingen.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event set in one of southern Germany's most beautiful landscapes, featuring gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route offers a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal with varied sections passing through historic towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites a strong final sprint. The marathon is open to adult runners aged 18 and over and is part of a diverse running program in Bottwartal.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Beilstein, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups on the last Sunday of each month in Steinheim. Weekly summer break runs during the summer holidays every Tuesday evening at 7:00 PM. Year-end run with 10 km and afterwards mulled wine & punch at the end of the year. Registration for all runs is via the partner Datasport. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible until shortly before the race. The event takes place at the Riedstadion in Steinheim an der Murr. It is an excellent opportunity to prepare for the marathon in July and to improve running technique in a motivating community.

name: virtueller St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf
description: The virtual St.-Anna-Jedermannslauf in Amerdingen is a popular race event held annually in July. Participants can choose from original routes of 10 km, 5.8 km jogging, 5.8 km walking, or 3.5 km for youth. The course runs from the St.-Anna Chapel through the forest south of Amerdingen, passing historic sites such as the Celtic rampart and the Three Stones, as well as a small lake. Times are recorded via an app and immediately uploaded to a leaderboard, making the race particularly modern and accessible. The race is increasingly popular and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups.
course_highlights: Start at the St.-Anna Chapel
Forest route south of Amerdingen with historic sights like the Celtic rampart and the Three Stones
Course with directional arrows and app support for time measurement
additional: The race is virtual and takes place in July, allowing participants to complete their runs flexibly. Multiple registrations and a second free attempt are possible. Results are recorded via an app and immediately uploaded to the leaderboard. There are various route lengths for different age groups and performance levels. Virtual race, route passing the Celtic rampart, online registration, race period from 01.07. to 27.07.2025, start times between 06:00 and 20:00, participation from age 8, donations for the preservation of the chapel.

description: The Volkswandertag in Bollensen is an event held annually on the last Sunday of July, open to hiking enthusiasts of all ages. Various family-friendly routes are offered, leading through forest paths in the beautiful Solling area. The marathon and half marathon hikes are circular routes starting and ending at the sports home of TSV Bollensen, with all routes marked and equipped with refreshment stations. The event is characterized by a cozy atmosphere with food and drinks at the finish area and a strong sense of community.
course_highlights: Forest paths through the Solling area
Circular routes with start and finish at the sports home of TSV Bollensen
Refreshment stations on the route and at the finish
additional: Participant limit of 400 participants. Refreshments on the routes (3 stations for the marathon, 2 for the half marathon) as well as coffee and cold drinks at the start, a free drink and meal voucher at the finish. Late registrations on-site until one hour before the start with a late registration fee of €5. Hiking routes of 3, 7, 12, and 42 km, registration until 29.05.2026, participant limit 400, including refreshments and drinks, special stamp on July 27, 2025, for €3.

name: Wallenstein-Halbmarathon
location: Altdorf bei Nürnberg, Nürnberger Land, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Wallenstein Half Marathon is a traditional community race around Altdorf near Nuremberg, taking place on July 26, 2026. The half marathon course runs through the picturesque Schwarzachtal with stunning views and includes roads, bike paths, and forest trails. In addition to the half marathon, there is a 12 km hobby run and a family-friendly 5 km course for runners and walkers. The event offers well-organized infrastructure with refreshment stations and an attractive start/finish area in the sports park of TV 1881 Altdorf. The city championship for the half marathon and 12 km course is also held and awarded by the mayor.
course_highlights: Half marathon course through Schwarzachtal with viewpoints
Refreshment stations at km 7, 11, 15, 18, and at the finish
Course routing over roads, bike paths, and forest trails around Altdorf
additional: Start and finish at the sports park TV 1881 Altdorf (Heumannstr. 5a). Refreshments with isotonic drinks and water at several stations. Free entry for all finishers to the outdoor pool, sponsored by the Altdorf municipal utilities. City championship and team competitions will be held. Scenic route through Schwarzachtal, team competitions, family-friendly 5 km, race day logistics and amenities at Sportpark Altdorf.

name: Běh na Kozubovou
location: Dolní Lomná, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Elektronické přihlášení do 24.7.2026 ráno, bez nároku na tričko

description: The Kozubová Run is a traditional mountain race held in Dolní Lomná, run along marked tourist trails with challenging elevation gain. The race starts at the bakery in Dolní Lomná and passes through Polana, the Pod Kykula saddle, up to the tourist hut on Kozubová. The course is approximately 5 km long with an elevation gain of around 500 meters, offering runners a challenge with steep ascents and beautiful mountain views. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and is known for its friendly atmosphere and a rich raffle for participants.
course_highlights: The entire course runs along marked tourist trails - blue and green markers
Challenging ascent with an elevation gain of about 500 meters
Start at the bakery in Dolní Lomná, finish at the tourist hut on Kozubová
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the museum located 300 meters from the start at the bakery. Pre-registered runners will receive a start number with their name and a T-shirt. After the race, there is a rich raffle with prizes from local sponsors. The start is mass for all categories at 10:00 AM. Prizes and monetary awards are announced in individual categories as well as overall for men and women. The race starts at 10:00 AM at the bakery in Dolní Lomná, registration is open until July 21, 2026, with a rich accompanying program, prizes for the top three in each category, accommodation options, and a photo gallery from previous editions.

name: XRUN - Ucieczka Św. Kingi
location: Krościenko nad Dunajcem, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: St. Kinga's Escape is a mountain trail run held in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, connecting the scenic routes of the Sądecki Beskid and Pieniny mountains. Participants can choose distances from 14 km to 40 km, with various time limits and starts on Sunday morning. The 40 km route passes through Przysłop, the Shelter at Przechyba, Wielka Przechyba, as well as through Pieniny National Park, ending with a viewpoint trail along the Dunajec River. The event is organized by the Beskid Foundation and takes place at the amphitheater in Krościenko nad Dunajcem.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1800 m elevation gain, connecting Sądecki Beskid and Pieniny
Scenic loop through the Shelter at Przechyba and Wielka Przechyba (1191 m)
Picturesque trail along the Dunajec River at the finish
additional: Race office and start/finish at the Culture and Promotion Center in Krościenko nad Dunajcem (amphitheater). Age categories for children’s races from 3 to 15 years. Time limits: 40 km - 9 hours, 26 km - 7 hours, 14 km - 5 hours. Routes are marked and available on maps on the website. Organizer: Beskid Foundation. The event includes various trail distances, with routes leading through mountain trails, with online registration available. Start and finish are located in Krościenko nad Dunajcem, and the event is part of the XRUN mountain running series.

name: 13 Nadmorski Bieg Uzdrowiskowy
description: The Coastal Health Resort Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque town of Dąbki in the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle, as well as the attractions of the Dąbki Health Resort and the Darłowo Municipality. The event includes races for children and youth, a 10 km race, and special accompanying runs such as the Health Resort Sea Mile. Organizers provide a rich program and attractive prizes, and the race route runs through charming health resort areas.
course_highlights: 10 km race route through the Dąbki Health Resort area
Health Resort Sea Mile over a distance of 1852 meters
Children's and youth races over distances from 150 m to 1100 m
additional: The event program spans two days: July 25th with the Health Resort Sea Mile race divided into women and men, and July 26th with races for children and youth, the ZaRadnych and OdWażnych race over 1100 m, and the main 10 km race. The race office is open from 16:00 to 18:00 on July 25th and from 8:30 on July 26th. The time limit to complete the Sea Mile is 20 minutes. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and the Dąbki health resort, with registrations starting from April 1, 2026.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
organizer: Zachodniopomorskie Centrum Kultury Obszarów Wiejskich i Edukacji Ekologicznej
description: Botaniczna Piątka summer edition is a 5 km race organized in the picturesque Dendrological Garden in Przelewice. It is a perfect opportunity to combine physical activity with relaxation in the midst of greenery and nature. The event is part of the Botaniczna Piątka series and is co-organized by the West Pomeranian Voivodeship. Participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of a Water Lily, and the main race is scheduled to start at 10:00 AM.
course_highlights: 5 km route in the Dendrological Garden in Przelewice
Picturesque scenery of greenery and nature
Relaxing summer running atmosphere
additional: The race takes place as part of the special summer edition of the Botaniczna Piątka series. Participants receive a commemorative medal in the shape of a Water Lily. The event is co-financed by the budget of the West Pomeranian Voivodeship and is under the honorary patronage of the Marshal of the Voivodeship. The Przelewice Gardens also offer numerous attractions and services, such as garden tours, a restaurant, conference rooms, and guest rooms. Finisher medals, an event related to culture and education, and the opportunity to participate in the summer edition in beautiful gardens.

name: V Festiwal Biegowy pod Chełmcem Bieg Babinicza
location: Szczawno-Zdrój, Wałbrzych County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Szczawnie-Zdroju
description: The 4th Chełmiec Running Festival - Babinicza Run is a running event held in the picturesque Szczawno-Zdrój, at the foot of Mount Chełmiec. Participants can choose from many distances, from 1 km to a full marathon, making the festival attractive for runners of various skill levels. The race route runs through charming areas, offering both challenges and beautiful views. The event takes place in July, when typical summer weather with temperatures around 25°C and sunny skies prevails.
course_highlights: Route at the foot of Mount Chełmiec
Various distances from 1 km to a marathon
Picturesque areas of Szczawno-Zdrój
additional: Start location: Dworzysko - at the foot of Mount Chełmiec, Aleja Spacerowa 22, 58-310 Szczawno-Zdrój. Typical weather in July is around 25°C, min. 15°C, with predominantly sunny days and average rainfall of 75 mm. The event will take place on July 26, 2026, with registration available on-site on July 25-26 in Szczawno-Zdrój. The start and finish are located near Dworzysko.

name: Holger-Nothacker-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Holger Nothacker Memorial Run is a traditional race event in support of the Schömberg Children's Clinic. The event offers three course lengths for different runner groups: a 3-kilometer route for beginners and schoolchildren, a 5.4-kilometer loop for hobby runners, and a challenging 10-kilometer circuit with 148 meters of elevation gain around Schömberg. The course takes participants around Schömberg and provides a sporting challenge in the region. The event is supported by staff from the Children's Clinic, who provide refreshments and drinks.
course_highlights: 3-kilometer route for beginners and schoolchildren
5.4-kilometer loop for hobby runners
10-kilometer circuit with 148 meters of elevation around Schömberg
additional: The event is supported by staff from the Schömberg Children's Clinic, who provide refreshing drinks and refreshments along the course. The event is open to runners of all ages and performance levels, with a special focus on community and charity.

name: Zlatý maraton Emila Zátopka
description: The Emil Zátopek Golden Marathon is part of the Zátopek Golden Week, a series of running races held in Plzeň in honor of Olympic champion Emil Zátopek. The main marathon takes place on July 27 and also features accompanying races such as a half marathon, marathon and half marathon relay races, and a 10.5 km road run. The start is in the afternoon in Štruncovy Sady and the surrounding area, with a rich program and categories for men, women, and youth. The race is known for its tradition, quality organization, and friendly atmosphere for all runners.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Plzeň, Štruncovy Sady and surroundings
Opportunity to participate in the marathon, half marathon, relays, and shorter runs
Categories for all age groups including youth
additional: The start for marathon runners with an expected time over 5 hours is at 13:00. Registration begins at 12:00, with check-in and bib number distribution in Plzeň, Pallova 19. The entry fee includes a bib number, chip usage fee, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and a T-shirt for marathoners. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. The race offers various course lengths, online registration, technical and medical support, and has a capacity of approximately 1000 participants.

name: Tempo Makers Run Plzeň v Pytli - červenec
description: Tempo Makers Osmička is a regular running race in Pilsen, held along the Úslava River. The race is open to men and women aged 16 and older and offers a friendly atmosphere for all runners who share a passion for running and spending time together. The capacity is limited to 75 participants, ensuring an intimate and relaxed event. The start and finish are at the same location with parking available nearby. After the race, the best runners are announced and a raffle draw takes place.
course_highlights: 8 km course along the Úslava River
Start and finish at the same place in Pytle, Pilsen
Friendly atmosphere with a limited capacity of 75 runners
additional: Registration and bib distribution are from 17:00 to 17:45. After the race at 19:05, the top runners are announced and at 19:15, a post-race raffle is held. Parking for participants is available near the start and finish. The course is flat, registration is possible in advance or on-site. The race takes place on July 28, 2026.

name: Altbulacher Berglauf
description: The 24th Altbulacher Mountain Run will take place on July 29, 2026, in Neubulach. It is a short mountain running race with two distances of 800 meters and 2.9 kilometers. The race offers runners the opportunity to experience the scenic beauty of the region in typical July weather with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny days. Please note that the exact organizer details should be checked before registration.
course_highlights: Two distances: 800 m and 2.9 km
Mountain run in the Neubulach region
Typical July weather with around 25°C and mostly sunny
additional: The race takes place in Neubulach. The weather in July is typically warm with about 25°C and mostly sunny. It is recommended to verify the organizer details before registration. Family-friendly event with awards and a festive atmosphere, terrain: mountain trail, registration: not specified

name: AOK Firmenlauf Sulz am Neckar
location: Albeck-Stadion, Sulz am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 19,00 Euro pro Person – erste 500 Anmeldungen (Early Bird)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 22,00 Euro pro Person – 501 bis 1.000 Anmeldungen bzw. bis zum Meldeschluss am 20. Juli 2026 (18:00 Uhr)

description: The AOK Corporate Run Sulz am Neckar is a team event taking place on July 29, 2026, at the Albeck Stadium. The 5 km course offers companies and teams the opportunity to be active together and strengthen team spirit. In addition to the run, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with DJ music, warm-up activities, and free finish line refreshments. The event is part of the BW-Running series and is open to runners aged 16 and above.
course_highlights: 5 km course at Albeck Stadium and surroundings
Group warm-up session shortly before the start
Free finish line refreshments with non-alcoholic Erdinger, fruit, vegetables, and water
additional: Starting at 5:00 PM, a DJ program will set the mood. Before the start, there will be a group warm-up in the starting area. After crossing the finish line, winners will be honored and musical entertainment will take place. Registration is via a company registration with a team captain who registers team members. Changes to registration are free until the registration deadline, after which there is a fee. Minimum age is 16 years. The course length is 5 km, registration deadline is July 20, 2026. Participation is open to those aged 16 and above. Registration can be done online. Finish line refreshments and a festive atmosphere with catering by TV Sulz.

name: Volkslauf Lauftreff Pfohren
price_range: Hauptlauf: € 12, Walking/Nordic Walking: € 5, Schülerlauf: € 3, Bambini: kostenlos

price_tiers.distance: Walking und Nordic Walking ca. 8 km

description: The 24th Volkslauf "Rund um Pfohren" will take place on Wednesday, July 29, 2026. The officially measured 10 km course mainly runs over paved agricultural paths around Pfohren. In addition to the main race, there are also youth runs, children’s runs, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Training runs will be offered starting July 7, 2026, on Tuesdays at 7:00 PM at the Pfohren sports and festival hall. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with awards for the best runners and groups.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km course
Route mainly over paved agricultural paths
Training runs from July 7, 2026, Tuesdays at 7:00 PM
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late registration fee of €2 for the main race. The award ceremony will take place after the main race in the sports and festival hall. There are wandering trophies for the daily winners, which can be kept permanently after winning three times. Course: 10 km, paved agricultural paths; registration upon receipt of payment; training runs from July 7, 2026; prizes for age groups and groups; course record prize €50.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (8) – červencový
description: Race of 5 and 10 km VAŠÍ LIGA 2026 in Prague Braník offers a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River, where personal records are often broken. This race is part of the 16th edition of regular runs held every month, allowing participants to compare their performances with other runners. The course is certified, and for the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified measuring device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Championships at 10 km
additional: Registration is from 18:00, the 10 km race starts at 19:00, the 5 km race starts at 19:05. After the race, refreshments are available at the Hamr Braník restaurant. Bag storage is possible at the organizer’s tent. After the race, a raffle with prizes such as free entry to the next race, massage vouchers, and more will be held. The course is suitable for all levels of runners from beginners to professionals. First place in categories is awarded prizes worth 103,000 CZK. The races are part of a series of running events in Prague.

name: 43. Flora-Westfalica Marathon
description: The Flora-Westfalica Marathon in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a private marathon race conducted according to the rules of the 100 Marathon Club Germany. The course consists of seven large laps of 6.10 km each, totaling 42.7 km, and is marked with arrows or flutter tape depending on the weather. The event emphasizes self-sufficiency, as runners pass by their cars after each lap. Timing is done manually with a stopwatch, and a certificate is sent via email. Participation is possible from age 18, there is no entry fee, but a voluntary donation of €5 is requested.
course_highlights: 7 large laps of 6.10 km each, total 42.7 km
Course marked with arrows or flutter tape depending on weather
Self-sufficiency possible, as runners pass by their cars after each lap
additional: Start and finish at the parking lot at the town hall, Hauptstraße 120, 33378 Rheda-Wiedenbrück. No showers or changing rooms on site, but toilets with hot water 150 meters away and two additional toilets nearby the course. Participant limit of 22 persons. Registration until 6 pm the day before via email with first name, last name, year of birth, and club. Participation at own risk, liability waiver applies. Timing for the marathon is manual with a stopwatch; for ultramarathon, external timing with photo proof. Those who stop their hydration breaks will be disqualified. Course: 7 laps of 6.10 km; Ultra: 8 laps of 6.25 km; no showers; toilet 150 meters away; participation from age 18; registration until 6 pm the day before.

name: 6. Bienwald Backyard Ultra
description: The Bienwald Backyard Ultra is a challenging ultrarunning event in Kandel, Rhineland-Palatinate. As one of the Silver Ticket Races, it offers winners the opportunity to participate in the German team at the Big Dog's World Championships 2023. The event takes place at the Bienwaldstadion and attracts ambitious ultrarunners who want to test their endurance and mental strength.
course_highlights: Venue: Bienwaldstadion in Kandel
Silver Ticket Race with qualification for the Big Dog's World Championships
Ultramarathon format with a special focus on endurance
additional: The race is known for its tactical diversity and attracts recurring participants. Registration is already closed, and all starting places are booked.

name: Esenser Volksbanklauf - 31. Stadtlauf
description: The 31st Esenser City Run, held as the 6th Esenser Volksbank Run, takes place on Friday, July 31, 2026, in Esens. The traditional race "Around St. Magnus" offers exciting competitions for runners of all ages in the city center. The event begins with the Bambini race over 670 meters, followed by school runs over 1340 meters. For adults, there are competitions over five and ten kilometers, which start simultaneously. The award ceremonies take place immediately after the races.
course_highlights: Race "Around St. Magnus" in the Esens city center
Bambini race over 670 meters
Adult races over 5 and 10 kilometers
additional: Start times: Bambini race at 18:10, school run at 18:30, adult 5 km and 10 km at 19:30. Award ceremonies follow immediately after the races. Registration is available online. Start and finish at the Esens marketplace; registration online possible; weather in July around 25°C, sunny.

name: Nordschwarzwald Trophy
description: The Nordschwarzwald Trophy is a sporting event in Schömberg that offers various competitions and running routes in the picturesque Northern Black Forest. The event is characterized by diverse courses and a warm atmosphere that appeals to both ambitious athletes and recreational runners. Organized by Eventservice Stahl, the Trophy stands for sporting challenge and community experience in a beautiful natural setting.
course_highlights: Diverse running routes in the Northern Black Forest
Natural and varied landscape
Event in the municipality of Schömberg
additional: Results and certificates are provided online. The event is organized by Eventservice Stahl, who also manages other sports events. The event takes place in July 2026 and offers a varied backdrop in the spa park and at the Himmelsglück observation tower.

name: Springe-Deister-Sommerlauf
description: The Springe-Deister Summer Run on July 31, 2026, offers a measured 5 km loop course at the foot of the Kleine Deister. The route is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), allowing results to be included in official rankings. The kilometer markings are well signposted, and the course profile is slightly hilly with an elevation difference of about 20 meters. The race starts at 5:45 PM at the South School Center (OHG) in Springe and is aimed at runners seeking an attractive and official running event in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop course with DLV measurement
Kilometer markings clearly signposted
Slightly hilly profile with approx. 20 m elevation difference
additional: Start and finish at the South School Center (OHG) in Springe. Registration opens on March 22, 2026. There are also other runs such as the 15 km Stadtwerke Springe Run and 5 km Walking/Nordic Walking. The course is officially measured and recognized for rankings. Start from 5:45 PM, part of the Laufpass series, course profile with 35 m elevation change.

name: Xaver-Höger-Gedächtnislauf
location: Waldstadion, Rothensteiner Straße 9, Bad Grönenbach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Xaver Höger Memorial Run will take place on July 31, 2026, at the Waldstadion in Bad Grönenbach. The event is organized by TV Bad Grönenbach 1894 e.V., Athletics Department, and offers runners a sporting challenge in a friendly and family atmosphere. Registration is available online via Race Result, and late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start. Nordic walkers are unfortunately not allowed to participate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Waldstadion, Rothensteiner Straße 9
Event begins at 4:00 PM
Participation for Nordic walkers not possible
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the start of each race with a late registration fee of 5 euros (excluding children). Bib numbers must be collected at least 30 minutes before the start. Start and finish at Waldstadion, participation for Nordic walkers not allowed, registration via Race Result, late registrations up to 1 hour before the start are possible.

name: XI Gorce Ultra-Trail
location: Ochotnica Dolna, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gorce Ultra-Trail is a unique mountain race held in the picturesque area of Ochotnica Dolna. Participants can choose from five diverse routes ranging from 5 to 102 km, suitable for various skill levels, from beginners to experienced ultramarathon runners. The routes pass through beautiful Gorce terrain, offering challenging ascents and spectacular views. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours, emphasizing the event's challenge and character.
course_highlights: Five routes ranging from 5 to 102 km
Routes pass through scenic Gorce terrain
20-hour time limit for the GUT 102 route
additional: Registration is conducted online via time-sport.pl. There is an option to obtain discount codes for podium finishers of previous editions, residents of the Ochotnica Dolna municipality, and seniors. Refunds, distance changes, and package transfers are regulated by the event rules. Invoices can be ordered during registration or by email contact. The time limit for the longest route is 20 hours. The event takes place in the summer season, with active registrations and details regarding regulations, logistics, and routes.

name: 16. Piesauer Glasmacherlauf
description: The 16th Piesauer Glasmacherlauf will take place on August 1, 2026, in Piesau, Thuringia. The event offers races over 2 km for children and 10 km for adults, as well as a 10 km Nordic Walking competition on forest trails. The event is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV Lauf- und Nordic Walking Cup and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with changing and shower facilities as well as on-site catering. Trophies and awards will be given to the fastest runners and in age categories.
course_highlights: 2 km children's race
10 km main race exclusively on forest trails
10 km Nordic Walking with poles, racing prohibited
additional: Changing, washing, and shower facilities are available. Food, drinks, and cake sales on site. Trophies for the fastest runners in each distance (1st-3rd place per gender) as well as awards for the top three in each age group. Team competition for the 10 km distance with scoring of the 2 fastest women or 3 fastest men from a club. Forest trails, team scoring, trophies for fastest on the course, awards, registration until July 29, 2026.

name: 18. Ottonenlauf
description: The Ottonenlauf is a scenic race in the Harz, bringing runners from three different villages to a common goal in the UNESCO World Heritage city of Quedlinburg. The race distances of 21.1 km, 42.2 km, and 69 km start respectively in Stiege, Alexisbad, and Meisdorf. The route mainly runs on forest and woodland paths through the Selketal, featuring shady forests, rural sections, and moderate inclines that require a good pace. In addition to the race, there are walking and Nordic walking options, making the event accessible to a wide range of runners. Electronic timing and medals for finishers complete the offering.
course_highlights: Trail landscape run on the Selketal-Stieg
Forest and woodland paths with shady sections
Moderate inclines with 809 m ascent and over 1,000 m descent on the long course
additional: Three starting points for different distances with a common finish in Quedlinburg. Electronic timing and medals for all finishers. Typical August weather with around 25°C and mostly sunny. Trail-style run with multiple distances, including walking options, no official course measurement, medals for all finishers, online registration, route through quiet Harz forest paths.

name: 24. Hella Marathon Nacht
description: The hella marathon night Rostock is a festive sunset run set against a picturesque backdrop on the Haedgehalbinsel in Rostock's city harbor. The event offers competitions in the marathon, half marathon, Rostock 7 km, and a student run, all starting at dusk and ending in a brightly lit finish. The course includes passages through the Warnow Tunnel and the IGA Park and is kept traffic-free. The event combines athletic challenge with North German hospitality and holiday atmosphere.
course_highlights: Marathon course runs along the Warnow and through the Warnow Tunnel
Half marathon through the IGA Park and along the Warnow to the city harbor
Rostock 7 km loop around the city harbor
additional: Start times: Student run at 17:00, Marathon at 18:00, Rostock 7 km at 19:07. Cut-off time at 23:30. Start and finish at the Haedgehalbinsel, Rostock city harbor. Pre-ordering a functional shirt is possible (28 euros, only until 21.07.2026, pickup only during the event weekend). Bib pickup on 31.07.2026 and 01.08.2026 on site. The event takes place in Rostock, with start and finish on the Haedgehalbinsel at Rostock city harbor. It is known for its festive atmosphere, medals, and professional timing. The courses run along the Warnow, through the Warnow Tunnel, and the IGA Park.

name: 5. TCW Backyard Ultra
description: The TCW Backyard Ultra in Wölfersheim is a unique running event that emphasizes camaraderie and endurance. Races start on the hour on a 6.706 km loop, which must be completed within one hour. The race continues until only one runner remains, who is declared the winner. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a motivating community that welcomes runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: 6.706 km long loop on the grounds of the tennis club and adjacent fields and farm roads
Start on the hour with a maximum of one hour per loop
Night runs with headlamps between 21:00 and 6:00
additional: The race is an officially listed Backyard Ultra race and a potential qualifier for individual and team world championships. The start is announced acoustically with whistle signals and a bell. There is no time limit for the competition; the winner is the last remaining runner who completes one more loop than all others. Personal assistance on the course is not allowed, but mutual support among participants is permitted. Trekking poles and artificial aids are prohibited. Participation is limited, early registration is required; the event is held in the Backyard Ultra format and regularly attracts over 400 applicants.

name: adidas Runners City Night
description: The adidas Runners City Night Berlin is a unique summer event that combines running and inline skating with a large party on the famous Kurfürstendamm. The event offers routes over 5 km and 10 km for runners, as well as a 10 km inline skating course that passes through the vibrant City West. Live bands, cheering zones, and enthusiastic fans create an exhilarating atmosphere, making the race an unforgettable experience. The finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church with a glowing finish gate perfectly concludes the sporting night.
course_highlights: Route through City West and Kurfürstendamm
Live bands and cheering points, especially at the adidas Cheering Zone at Adenauerplatz
Start and finish at the Kaiser Wilhelm Memorial Church
additional: Start times: 5 km run at 19:00, 10 km run at 20:00. Timing is done with a transponder on the back of the bib. The 5 km run has a turnaround point, while the 10 km run leads in a star shape with multiple passages at the adidas Cheering Zone. Eligibility from birth year 2016 (5 km) and 2014 (10 km). Personalized medal engraving available. Extras such as event shirt and bag storage can be added during registration. The route passes through Kurfürstendamm and Old West Berlin; start at sunset; includes a medal with luminous effect and optional medal engraving; online registration available.

name: Die 10 Kilometer von Dürwiß
price_range: kostenlos, Anmeldung online oder vor Ort gegen Gebühr
description: The 10 km race from Dürwiß is a traditional road race held annually on the first Saturday in August by SV Germania Dürwiß e.V. Over 500 runners from home and abroad participate, with winning times usually around 30 minutes. The flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop runs through the town center of Dürwiß and is completely closed to traffic on race day. The special feature of this cult race are the numerous spectators and the atmospheric street parties along the route, which create a unique atmosphere with music and decorations. The event is rounded off with an after-run party with DJ Steve and a variety of refreshments.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured 2 km asphalt loop in the town center of Dürwiß
Five laps for the 10 km main race, completely closed and car-free streets
Atmospheric street parties with music and decorations along the route
additional: In addition to the 10 km main race, there is also a 4,000 m open race, children's and youth races from 200 m to 1,000 m, as well as a 10 km inline skating race with different rounds depending on age group. The route is completely closed to road traffic on race day, and there is a strict parking ban along the course. The event is complemented by an after-run party with DJ Steve and extensive catering. The course returns to 10 km, inline and children's races, street festivals, after-run party, music, and sponsor prizes.

name: hella marathon nacht rostock
description: The hella marathon night Rostock is a festive sunset run along the Warnow River with maritime flair and Hanseatic hospitality. The event takes place in August in Rostock and offers competitions over the marathon, half marathon, Rostocker 7, and a student run. Start and finish are located at Rostock's city harbor, where runners start at dusk and finish in the brightly lit finish area. The course includes passages through the nearly 800-meter-long Warnow tunnel and the IGA Park, providing a unique running experience.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rostock's city harbor with maritime flair
Course passes through the nearly 800-meter-long Warnow tunnel
Run through the IGA Park with a picturesque sunset
additional: Start times: Student run 17:00, Marathon 18:00, Rostocker 7 around 19:07. Cut-off time at 23:30. Marathon participants must pass the Warnow crossing checkpoint by 20:40. Distribution of pre-ordered functional shirts only during the event weekend, no postal shipping. Bib pickup at the event center Haedgehalbinsel, Rostock's city harbor on 31.07.2026 from 16:00-19:00 and on 01.08.2026 from 12:00-18:30. Event in August, dusk start, various race distances, finisher medals, instant certificates, optional event shirt, timing with transponder.

name: Hemfurth-Edersee-Abendlauf
description: The Hemfurth-Edersee Evening Run is a traditional race held in late summer, bringing together runners of all ages in the beautiful surroundings of Edertal-Hemfurth. In pleasant temperatures and under the setting sun, the focus is on the joy of movement and community spirit. Participants can enjoy refreshments, good music, and a convivial gathering in a relaxed atmosphere at the finish line. The race is organized voluntarily by TSV 08 Hemfurth-Edersee e.V. and is a popular event for ambitious runners, recreational joggers, and families.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque nature around Lake Eder
Start in pleasant evening temperatures
Community running experience for all age groups
additional: The evening run takes place annually in late summer, usually at the beginning of August. The event is organized on a voluntary basis. At the finish line, there are refreshments, music, and a social gathering. Timing is done with special software used only once a year. There are no specific details available regarding start times, fee structures, or registration procedures on the provided pages. The event is part of the Laufcup Waldeck-Frankenberg, with certificates for all finishers, medals for children, and prizes for the top runners in the main categories. On-site registration is possible up to 30 minutes before the start.

name: Markttagelauf
description: The Markttage Run in Bredstedt is an international race for a good cause, with entry fees donated. There are various routes for children, beginners, and experienced runners that lead through the city center of Bredstedt. The event promotes community spirit and offers a sporting challenge for all age groups. Registration is done online, and the participation fees are moderate to enable as many people as possible to participate.
course_highlights: Various routes for children, beginners, and experienced runners
Run through the Bredstedt city center
International race with a social purpose
additional: Registration is only possible online until 30.07. at www.my.raceresult.com. The entry fees are donated. Note: The call for entries PDF is currently not accessible. Multiple routes for different performance levels, event in August 2026, participation fees for children are free, for adults up to 5 euros.

name: Mehrstetter Crosslauf
description: The Mehrstetter Cross Country Race takes place on August 1, 2026, in Mehrstetten on the Swabian Alb. The event offers runners the opportunity to run in a well-maintained and natural environment. The municipality of Mehrstetten is known for its beautiful landscape and friendly atmosphere, making the cross country race a special experience. The event is organized by the municipality of Mehrstetten and is a regular part of the local sports calendar.
course_highlights: Run through the natural landscape of the Swabian Alb
Well-maintained running course in Mehrstetten
Event in a friendly and welcoming community
additional: Registration is via an online form on the municipal website. The municipality of Mehrstetten is the organizer and offers well-maintained infrastructure. Contact options are available through the municipality's contact form. Event as part of the SauHeld Cup 2026, runner information and detailed course description are not available.

name: Pörndorfer Sommernachtslauf
description: The 15th Pörndorfer Summer Night Run on August 1, 2026, in Aldersbach is a running event with a family-friendly atmosphere and genuine competitive spirit. The event offers suitable challenges for all age groups and skill levels, from children’s runs to youth and main races. Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event combines athletic ambitions with communal summer feeling and attracts runners and spectators from the region.
course_highlights: Races for all age groups from children to youth and main race
Summer scenery and golden evening light
Including Nordic walking as a relaxed discipline
additional: Registration is possible until July 24, 2026, at 23:00. The venue is the sports grounds of DJK Pörndorf, Sportplatzstr., 94501 Aldersbach. The event is organized by the sports club DJK Pörndorf. Various race distances, children’s and youth runs, Nordic walking, registration until July 24, 2026.

name: Schwindegger Schlosslauf
description: The Schwindegger Castle Run is an annual sporting event in the idyllic community of Schwindegg. Participants run through scenic paths and forests with a view of Schwindegg Castle. There are various categories for all age groups, including children and teenagers. The event is also an opportunity to strengthen community bonds and support the sports club. Before and after the run, a summer festival with food, drinks, and a bar area takes place, creating a cheerful atmosphere for celebration and socializing.
course_highlights: Run through scenic paths and forests
Impressive view of Schwindegg Castle
Various categories for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: The run takes place as part of the summer festival of the Schwindegg Sports Club, which offers food and drinks before and after the race to create a convivial atmosphere. There is a bar area for runners and spectators. The event also includes a toddler run over 0.5 km at the school sports ground. Various categories, community and summer festival, scenic surroundings.

name: SWE Halbmarathon Ettlingen
description: The SWE Half Marathon Ettlingen is a challenging and varied scenic run over 21.1 km, connecting several districts of Ettlingen at different elevations. The course begins idyllically in Horbachpark and passes through forested areas with distant views of the Black Forest before descending into the Rhine Plain towards the finish at Horbachsee. Aid stations are available every 3 km, and local residents provide refreshments and a motivating atmosphere. The race takes place on August 1, 2026, and is organized by SSV Ettlingen 1847 e. V., Lauf Treff Ettlingen department.
course_highlights: 21.1 km challenging scenic run with elevation changes
Forest sections with distant views of the Black Forest and Palatinate Mountains
Finish at the picturesque Horbachsee in the former State Garden Show grounds
additional: Start and finish are at Horbachpark near the pavilion, Middelkerker Straße, 76275 Ettlingen. There are two block starts with approximately 3-minute intervals to ease the first kilometers. The maximum number of participants is limited to 800 starters. Late registrations are possible during the event weekend at Albgauhalle. All pre-registered participants receive a gift along with their race bib. The team with the most finishers will be rewarded with two bottles of champagne. Timing is via transponder in the race bib, with net time results. Terrain includes paved paths, gravel paths, and asphalt; registration deadline is July 27, 2026; maximum 800 participants; start times: 16:00 for walkers, 17:00 for runners; children and youth races introduced in 2026.

name: Krkonošská 50
location: Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonošský národní park, Czech Republic
description: Krkonošská 50 is a traditional trail run held in the picturesque environment of the Krkonoše National Park, starting in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, passing along marked trails and mountain paths. The event is limited to 300 participants and is divided into several age categories for men and women. Organizers emphasize ecology and safety, including mandatory mobile phone equipment and a ban on littering outside refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 50 km course with an elevation gain of 1784 m
Route runs along marked trails in Krkonoše National Park
Refreshment stations at 13, 18, 27, 33, 39 km and at the finish
additional: Limited to 300 participants. Start and finish at the Svatý Petr area, Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Possibility to change the route from long to short after reporting to the control at Svatý Petr - hotel Horal. Trail marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. Mobile phone is mandatory for all participants. Trail race with marked paths, online registration, limited to 300 participants, categories for men and women, possibility of route changes.

name: Běhej lesy Bílá
location: Bílá, Beskydy, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Běhej lesy Bílá is a mountain trail race held in the beautiful environment of the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy). The race offers various routes including a short and a long one, with the long route ČSOB 20 km included in the international UTMB Index. Runners can use the cable car to the top and look forward to special speed sections Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which bring additional competitive elements and rewards. The race is suitable for all mountain trail running enthusiasts who want to experience the beauty of the Beskydy and compete on well-marked trails.
course_highlights: Trails run within the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area (CHKO Beskydy) with respect to nature and a ban on entry outside marked paths
Conti Speed Section - a 200-meter speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 20 km routes
Generali Investments Finish - an extended 500m finish straight with a measured section and performance analysis
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with international points. The cable car to the top of the Bílá ski resort is available. At the finish line, there is an extended 500m straight with a measured section called Generali Investments Finish, where the fastest men and women are announced and rewarded with a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. Trail routes of various lengths, cable car ascent, speed sections, charity race, respect for the Beskydy Protected Landscape Area, GPX routes available for download.

name: Zlatá stezka
location: Stožec, Šumava, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Golden Trail is a historic and international tourist route connecting the Czech Republic with the Danube region, passing through the beautiful nature of the Šumava and Bavarian Forest. The route, 631 km long, offers a unique experience through its connection with the German Golden Trail and crossing several national parks and natural reserves. Tourists can explore historic towns, castles, lookouts, and cultural monuments along the trail, which is equipped with informational boards and rest areas. The Golden Trail is ideal for hiking and discovering the natural and historical beauty of the South Bohemian and Pilsen regions.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Šumava National Park and Bavarian Forest, the largest forested areas in Central Europe
Historic towns of Prachatice, Vimperk, and Kašperské Hory with cultural monuments and museums
Cross-border connection with the German Golden Trail with 13 border crossings
additional: The route features the Golden Trail logo, informational boards, and rest areas. There are various stages with different difficulty levels and lengths. Nearby attractions include the Volary Museum, Libín Lookout Tower, and historic sites such as Hus Castle and Vimperk Castle. The route offers different lengths and levels, including ultra challenges and sports challenges, with the possibility of pre-registration. The event is suitable for runners, cyclists, and tourists who want to explore the region actively and respectfully of nature.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - srpen
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant can enjoy a warm cinnamon pancake at the finish line. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration from 8:15 to 8:55 and a start at 9:00.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old. Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. Recommended arrival methods include cycling, walking, driving, rollerblading, or taking trolleybus no. 11 (Průmyslová zóna stop). The course length is 3.2 km with an asphalt surface, and the children's course is 800 meters. The run is open to all age groups, including children up to 12 years old. The race starts every first Saturday from 8:15 to 8:55, with the gunshot start at 9:00.

name: Běh na Kamenný stůl
location: Rataje nad Sázavou, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Kamenný stůl Run is a traditional running race held in Rataje nad Sázavou, celebrating its 10th anniversary this year. The race offers a challenging and beautiful route from the castle courtyard to the Kamenný stůl monument, with varied surfaces and hilly terrain. The event is suitable for both professional runners and amateurs, as well as families with children, for whom shorter routes are prepared. The race is part of the Běhej zámky series, which connects running races in attractive castle locations.
course_highlights: The course leads to the Kamenný stůl monument with various surfaces: cobblestones, asphalt, paved and unpaved forest paths
Hilly terrain with parts of the route passing through the forest and field roads
Start and finish directly on the castle courtyard in Rataje nad Sázavou
additional: Start numbers with chip and name, water, cookie, promotional materials, castle entrance ticket. For children, a voucher for ice cream and for adults, a sausage. The facilities include fruit, buns, and a drinking regime. Parking is available at the playground on Zámecká Street and other nearby locations. Results are announced after completing each route. Registration includes a running package, refreshments, and castle entry; races take place under normal traffic conditions.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - srpen
location: Stromovka Park, Praha 7, Prague, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is friendly and focused on the joy of running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful environment. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps and children one lap. At the finish line, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age and gender, results are measured with an age coefficient and count towards the annual Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables locker, and portable toilet cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. The race is held in Stromovka Park, starting at 9:07 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. Categories for different age groups, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, changing rooms and toilets available. The race is regularly held on the first Saturday of each month.

name: Mšecká sedmička
organizer: Městys Mšec a TJ Sokol Mšec
description: Mšecká sedmička is a traditional running race held in Mšec in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 7 km long and runs through forest and field paths, offering runners a pleasant natural terrain. The start is at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field, and the race is suitable for the general public. The event is organized by the Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec, who ensure a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Race length of 7 km
Surface of forest and field paths
Start and finish at TJ Sokol Mšec football field
additional: The organizer is Městys Mšec and TJ Sokol Mšec. The race is of a mixed type with a course through forest and field paths. The race starts at the TJ Sokol Mšec football field. The course includes forest and field paths; registration conditions are not specified.

name: Libeř - Radlík
description: Libeř - Radlík is an uphill race 2.47 km long with an elevation gain of 170 meters, which is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area. The route is not purely uphill; it includes several flat sections and one downhill, adding interest and dynamism to the race. The atmosphere is pleasant, and the entry fee is symbolic, with generous prizes for winners from the company Botanicus. The race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain near Prague.
course_highlights: Length of the route 2.47 km with an elevation gain of 170 m
The route includes flat sections and one downhill
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: Entry fee is symbolic, winners receive generous prizes from the company Botanicus. The route runs on wide, partly gravel paths, which some runners mention in comments as a disadvantage compared to forest trails. The race has a pleasant atmosphere despite slightly punk conditions. The route is not purely uphill; it includes a few flat sections and one downhill; runs on wide, partly gravel paths; part of the Hill Runs series.

name: Trail Running Cup - Krkonošská padesátka
description: The Krkonošská Fifty is a traditional trail race held in the picturesque environment of Špindlerův Mlýn in the Krkonoše Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 50 km with an elevation gain of 1784 meters, running on marked trails and mountain paths. The start is at the Svatý Petr area, and participants can use the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. The race is limited to 300 starters and announces an absolute male and female winner, as well as ten age categories for men and women.
course_highlights: 50 km course with 1784 m elevation gain
Route runs on marked trails and mountain paths in the Krkonoše Mountains
Checkpoints at 13 km, 18 km, 27 km, 33 km, 39 km, and at the finish line
additional: The race starts at the Svatý Petr area in Špindlerův Mlýn. Parking is available at the central parking lot in Špindlerův Mlýn. Mobile phones are mandatory equipment for all participants, must be functional and charged. The race strictly prohibits littering outside refreshment stations. Route changes from longer to shorter are possible after notifying the control at Svatý Petr - Hotel Horal. The route is marked with black arrows on a yellow background only at intersections and turns. The participant limit is 300 runners, the race is open to men and women, registration is online, and the race day is August 1, 2026.

name: 32. Bieg św. Dominika
description: The International St. Dominic's Run is a prestigious running event held annually since 1994 in Gdańsk, as an integral part of the St. Dominic Fair. The race attracts over 1200 participants and tens of thousands of spectators, offering a unique atmosphere in the historic city center. The course runs through picturesque streets of Gdańsk's Old Town, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration. The festival includes various races, such as the Women's 5 km Run, Men's 5 km Run, and the Polish Championships at 10 km.
