Passing through Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników, Podwale Przedmiejskie, and other streets
Support from over 25,000 spectators along the race route
additional: The race course is a 1412-meter loop in the center of Gdańsk, allowing spectators to closely follow the competition. The event is part of the rich program of the St. Dominic Fair, featuring concerts, shows, and partner stalls. The race promotes social integration, a healthy lifestyle, and sports for people with disabilities as part of the prologue 'Chase St. Dominic'. The event includes various categories such as races for women, men, elite, and VIPs, with a wide range of age groups. Participants have the opportunity to support charitable causes through registration fees, which are allocated to various social initiatives.

name: Arm Race Kamień
location: Cekow-Kolonia, Kamień County, West Pomeranian Voivodeship, Poland

The race is part of an elite group of such events in Poland and is continuously developing, providing participants with unforgettable emotions.

Routes for different skill levels: PRO 10K, PRO 5K, OPEN 10K, OPEN 5K, FUN 5K, Orange Warrior
Event for families with children, amateurs, and professionals

name: IX Rudzki Półmaraton Industrialny
organizer: RUDA Śląska i MOSiR Ruda Śląska
description: The 9th Rudzki Industrial Half Marathon will take place on August 1st at 9:00 PM in Ruda Śląska. The route, 10.5 km long, runs through the central part of the city, showcasing the industrial character of the region and post-industrial monuments such as the Chebziu station, Mikołaj Shaft, Kaufhaus housing estate, and the blast furnace of Huta Pokój. In addition to the half marathon, a companion race of approximately 10 km is organized, intended for those who do not feel capable of running the full distance. The start and finish are located at the athletics stadium on Czarnoleśna Street, where the race office and organizational facilities are also situated.
course_highlights: 10.5 km route on a loop in the central part of the city
Passing through post-industrial monuments: Chebziu station, Mikołaj Shaft, Kaufhaus estate
Passing by the only blast furnace of Huta Pokój in Silesia

There are also 10 km races and Nordic Walking, with PZLA certification for the half marathon.

name: XI Czastarska Piątka
description: The 11th Czastarska Five is an annual street race organized in the Czastary municipality, attracting runners from various regions. The event has a sports and recreational character and takes place on a 5-kilometer route passing through picturesque areas of the municipality. Sports and recreational event

name: 10. Charity-Lauf Koldingen
location: Koldingen, Pattensen, Region Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Koldingen charity run is part of the Sparkassen running pass of the Hanover region, one of the largest running series in Germany with 43 events in 2026. Runners have the opportunity to explore the Hanover region on foot and collect stamps for their running pass with each participation. The race offers a varied course in the beautiful surroundings of Pattensen and promotes amateur sports in the region. The event is open to everyone who wants to stay active and do good at the same time.

Part of a large running series with 43 events in 2026
Opportunity to collect stamps for the Sparkassen running pass
additional: Participation in the Sparkassen running pass with a digital app for stamp collection and a digital running diary. There is also a classic running pass in folded format. The running series includes a variety of running events in the Hanover region, with active participation rewarded with attractive prizes. The event offers rounds for children and adolescents, start times between 16:00 and 17:30, and usually takes place in warm weather in August.

name: 55. Volkslauf Rund um Wellen
description: The 55th Volkslauf Rund um Wellen will take place on August 2, 2026, in Beverstedt-Wellen and is one of Germany's oldest marathon races with a family-friendly character. The event offers challenging courses across four distances, including marathon, half marathon, 11 km, and 5 km, some of which are measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The route passes through varied landscapes with forest paths and different surfaces. The event is organized by TSV Wellen and relies on the support of many volunteers from the village.
course_highlights: Marathon and half marathon courses DLV-measured
11 km course with different surfaces and forest paths
Refreshment stations every five kilometers on half marathon and marathon courses
additional: Registrations on-site are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start with an additional fee of 3 euros (except for children's runs). Handwritten commemorative certificates are available for an extra 3 euros. Changing rooms and showers are available at the start and finish areas. For travelers, overnight accommodation in the sports hall is possible upon registration. Medical services are provided by the German Red Cross. Course supervision is carried out by the volunteer fire brigade Wellen and helpers from TSV Wellen. Walkers are welcome on 5 km, 11 km, and half marathon distances but without separate rankings. Multiple race distances, family-friendly, community event, in a small village community with support from the local volunteer fire brigade.

name: Hilpoltsteiner Burgfestlauf
description: The Hilpoltstein Castle Festival Run is a traditional running event held as part of the Hilpoltstein Castle Festival, taking place annually on the first Sunday in August. The event offers races for various age and performance groups, including children, students, hobby runners, and the main race. A special highlight is the castle hill sprint in the main race, where the fastest female and male runners can earn the title of Castle Hill King or Queen. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and an attractive course layout with start and finish in Market Street near the town hall.
course_highlights: Main race over 7.6 km with castle hill sprint after 500 meters
Course layout with start and finish in Market Street near the town hall
Refreshments at the finish area and shower facilities at the outdoor pool
additional: Race bibs will be issued on the day of the event from approximately 7:45 AM to 9:00 AM. Safety pins are not provided. Parking areas around Hilpoltstein are signposted; the city center is closed. Shower facilities are available at the outdoor pool, and entry to the city bath on the event day is free upon presentation of the race bib. There is a special classification for the team with the most participants. Certificates are available via email or download. Prizes are only awarded in person. The event includes distances from 0.6 km to 7.6 km. Online registration is possible. The start is at Siegertstraße 2. Participation is focused on families and children.

name: Kapellenlauf Vorra
location: DJK SC Vorra, Frensdorf, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kapellenlauf Vorra is a traditional race organized annually by DJK SC Vorra. It includes several distances, such as a half marathon, a quarter marathon over 10.55 km, as well as a hobby run and Nordic walking, which have been added since 2025. The course runs through the rural surroundings around Abtsdorf and offers both competitive sport and leisure running. The race is also the venue for the Upper Franconian Championships in the half marathon and attracts numerous participants from the region.
course_highlights: Half marathon and quarter marathon through rural surroundings
Course with two 5.5 km loops for hobby run and Nordic walking
Start and finish at the sports grounds in Abtsdorf
additional: The patron starts the races promptly at 9 a.m. There is a large number of participants in the Nordic walking category, emphasizing enjoyment and community. The route is available for download as a GPX file. Changing facilities are available at Gastwirtschaft Beck. Event includes elevation meters, team rankings, start and finish at the sports grounds in Vorra, results and photos available.

description: The Nordkirchen Half Marathon takes place on August 2, 2026, and offers a scenic route through the Nordkirchen Palace Park and the Obsen farming community. Several refreshment points along the route provide supplies for participants. The finish line is again at the stadium, where spectators cheer on the runners and create a pleasant shared experience.

Run through the extensive Nordkirchen Palace Park with castle panorama
Loop through the Obsen farming community with enthusiastic neighbors

Late registrations on-site until 8:00 AM are possible for an additional fee of 3 EUR. Bibs with chips for electronic timing are issued and collected after the race but can be kept as souvenirs. The route passes through Nordkirchen Palace Park and Obsen, with start and finish at the stadium in Nordkirchen Palace Park. Registration is available online and on race day. Results are live. Parking is available at the stadium, Nordkirchen comprehensive school, and the Sundern parking lot.

name: Olewiger Charity-Run

All entry fees are donated 100% to the Demenzzentrum e.V. for the Trier region, emphasizing the charity aspect of the event. The races take place on August 2, 2026, providing a great opportunity to be active together for a good cause.

dm Market Inclusion Run over 1000 meters

The event is supported by regional sponsors who emphasize community spirit and the promotion of the Trier region. Multiple race categories include Volkslauf, Youth Run, Children's Run, Inclusion Run, and Elite Race; registration begins in January 2026; start at Volksfreund Torbogen and Volksbank Trier Eifel Torbogen; participants receive medals, goodie bags, and drinks; parking options and shuttle information are available.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - srpen
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and self-improvement, where each participant competes primarily against themselves. The event is usually held in Smetanovy Sady near the fountain, except for the June and August races, which take place by the river on U Dětského domova street. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.

June and August races are held by the river on U Dětského domova street
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026. The race includes an asphalt track of 3.2 km and a children's race of 600 m; registration is from 9:30 to 10:00; the event is scheduled for August 2, 2026.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Moldava

description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a cross-country and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. Each race offers a main running event of 6 to 9 km, an experiential route of 20 to 30 km according to the map, a walking route of 5 to 8 km with point finding, and children's races from 200 to 1600 meters. The series is suitable for the general public who want to actively and sportingly explore the beauty of the Ore Mountains.

Children's races and walking with point finding 5 - 8 km

Children's races range from 200 to 1600 meters in length. Experiential routes are guided by a map and include point finding for walking. The races are part of a series with overall scoring and winners announced at the final race in Stříbrná; the event also features races with dogs and children's categories.

very demanding mountainous profile

name: Rozdělovský čtvrtmaratón
location: Kladno-Rozdělov, Kladno, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Rozdělov Quarter Marathon is a running race organized by the Marathon Club Kladno, held in Kladno-Rozdělov. The club focuses on endurance running and organizing running events in the region. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to test their strength on a quarter marathon course in the pleasant environment of the Central Bohemian Region. The event is part of the club's running calendar and supports the running community around Kladno.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon course in Kladno-Rozdělov
Organized by Marathon Club Kladno focusing on endurance running
Part of the regional running calendar
additional: The race takes place on a Wednesday or Thursday in the first half of August from 18:00, with a route through forest paths. The event has an intimate character and the number of participants is growing.

name: Krčský lomcovák
description: Krčský lomcovák is a traditional running race held in Krčský Forest in Prague 4. The race offers a 5 km route starting at the Great Pavilion, suitable for both men and women, with different start times. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and families with children can try various activities such as slackline, sack jumping, or disc golf. The race is organized by the magazine Krčák žije, which focuses on activities and news related to Krčský Forest and its surroundings.
course_highlights: 5 km route in Krčský Forest
Start at the Great Pavilion
Mostly forest terrain with natural features
additional: Men start at 18:30, women half an hour earlier. The start is at the Great Pavilion. The event is part of a sports and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park with accompanying activities for families with children. The race is open to all age groups, offers various running disciplines, and is part of a community sports day in Prague 4.

name: 6. Bärenkopplauf
description: The Bärenkopplauf is a challenging mountain and trail run in the Rhein-Westerwald Nature Park, covering approximately 11 km on the premium hiking trail "WällerTour Bärenkopp" with around 360 meters of ascent and 260 meters of descent. The race takes place on the first Friday in August starting at 6:00 PM with staggered block starts. The course is divided into two halves: the first half is technically demanding with trails and steep climbs, while the second half mostly runs downhill and is scenically attractive. The fastest man and woman at Bärenkoppkreuz receive a mountain prize. The event is organized by VfL Waldbreitbach and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering and timing via transponder.
course_highlights: 11 km course with +360/-260 meters of elevation on the WällerTour Bärenkopp
First half as a demanding trail and mountain run with steep ascents and technical sections
Second half as a scenic cross-country run mostly downhill
additional: Start occurs in staggered block starts between 6:00 PM and 6:30 PM with 20 participants per block. Bib numbers are assigned after registration closes based on the 10 km time provided; the fastest runners start first, late registrants in the last block. There are two refreshment stations at 3.3 km and 7 km with water. The course is permanently marked and includes steep, sometimes narrow trails with steps and wooden bridges; caution is advised in wet conditions. Bib pickup and bag drop-off take place on the schoolyard of Realschule plus. Timing is done with disposable transponders on the bibs. Finish line refreshments include water, tea, and energy drinks. Parking is available near start and finish; parking near the finish allows about 1 km of running to the start. Registration online until August 3, 2026; late registration until August 6, 2026; no shower facilities. The event includes the Bärchenlauf and other activities.

name: 8. Wisent-RUN
location: Wisentgehege Springe, Springe, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wisent-RUN is a popular race at the Wisent Enclosure in Springe, taking place for the eighth time on August 7, 2026. The event offers various running courses, including children's runs and timed competitions, set in a natural environment. With a family-friendly setting and free admission to the Wisent Enclosure from 3:00 PM, the race is a sporting highlight for all age groups. The event is organized by VfV Concordia Alvesrode e.V. and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and dedicated volunteers.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Köhlerhütte in the Wisent Enclosure Springe
Running routes through the natural Wisent Enclosure
Children's runs with timing and award ceremonies
additional: Free admission to the Wisent Enclosure from 3:00 PM. Children's race "Frischlingsrennen" without timing over 500 m for children born in 2021 and later. 1 km children's run with timing and award ceremony for children born between 2016 and 2021. Ample parking available. The event is open to everyone, with free entry for visitors. It offers an opportunity to explore the wildlife of the Wisent Enclosure while staying active.

name: Heimat- und Schützenfestlauf
description: The Zerbst Homeland and Shooting Festival Run takes place in the castle garden of Zerbst/Anhalt and offers flat, varied running routes on a 1.5 km long terrain and street circuit with start and finish in front of the town hall. The event is aimed at students, youth, and adults with distances from 1.5 km to 9 km. The family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete in different age groups and groups make the run a popular event as part of the Homeland and Shooting Festival.
course_highlights: Flat 1.5 km loop in Zerbst castle garden
Start and finish in front of the town hall
Terrain and street sections
additional: Parking lot at Gartenstraße 21 (for navigation, use Gartenstraße 26). Changing and shower facilities in the gymnasium of the elementary school "An der Stadtmauer" (about 500 meters from the town hall). Certificates for the top three finishers in each age group. Trophy for the largest participating running group (club, company, or school, excluding the organizer). No refund in case of non-participation. Participation requires race fitness. By registering, participants agree to the storage and publication of race-relevant data and images in accordance with EU GDPR. Race distances include 1.5 km, 3 km, 4.5 km, and 9 km; online registration; run in the castle garden; start times and further details on the official website.

name: Berglauf
description: The TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. warmly invites you to the mountain run in Höxter, which offers a challenging course with varied terrain. The race includes a children's mountain run of approximately 1 km and a main race of about 3.2 km with a steady ascent and an elevation difference of around 170 meters. The course starts at the sports field and leads over grass areas, asphalt paths, meadow paths, and narrow gravel and forest paths to the finish in the woods. The event is a traditional race that appeals to runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Children's mountain run approx. 1 km with 50 m elevation gain on narrow gravel/forest path
Main race approx. 3.2 km with 170 m steady ascent over asphalt and meadow paths
Start and finish at the sports field with varied surfaces
additional: The return to the sports field after the main race is via light jogging or by car. The children's mountain run starts at the sports field with about 150 m of flat grass area, followed by asphalt and forest paths. The event is organized by TuS Ovenhausen 1924 e.V. The event takes place in typical August weather with temperatures around 25°C and occasional rain. Registration is via the official website, with details available in a PDF file.

name: Gifhorner Friedhofslauf
location: Ev.-luth. Friedhof St. Nicolai, Gifhorn, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Gifhorn Cemetery Run is a special race held at the Evangelical Lutheran Cemetery St. Nicolai in Gifhorn. The event offers runners the opportunity to complete courses of 4 or 8 kilometers. After the run, there is a cozy gathering with barbecuing and drinks under the apple trees. The race traditionally takes place in the evening and combines athletic activity with a relaxed atmosphere in a historic setting.
course_highlights: Running routes of 4 and 8 kilometers on the cemetery grounds
Cozy gathering with barbecuing and drinks under apple trees
Direct connection to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival
additional: The run supports the Cemetery Mobile, a free transportation service for seniors. After the race, participants have the opportunity to go directly to the Gifhorn Old Town Festival. Race routes, registration, cemetery tours, catering, date 2026 on August 7th and 8th.

name: Sparkassen-Festungslauf
location: Königstein vor der Festung Königstein, Saxony, Germany
description: The Sparkassen Fortress Run in Königstein is a summer evening running adventure on one of Europe's most architecturally and historically valuable mountain fortresses. The main course over 9.4 kilometers is a challenging uphill run with 470 meters of elevation, with the last kilometers running on the fortress plateau offering a magnificent view of the Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe River. In addition to the main race, there is a 7.7 km course as well as a mini run and an inclusion run, each 1.2 km long, on the fortress plateau. The event has been established for over 20 years and offers a special atmosphere with an award ceremony at sunset on the fortress marketplace.
course_highlights: Challenging, hilly profile with 470 meters of elevation
Last 1.2 km on the fortress plateau of Königstein with views of Saxon Switzerland and the Elbe
Start in two waves at 18:20 and 18:30 at the Tourist Information Königstein
additional: Race bib distribution for the main race (9.4 km and 7.7 km) at the start area Tourist Information Königstein between 4 PM and 6 PM. Race bib distribution for mini run and inclusion run (each 1.2 km) at the registration stand on the fortress plateau. The inclusion run is not wheelchair accessible. The award ceremony takes place on the fortress marketplace at sunset. Registration opens on December 1, 2025, including main races, children’s races, and inclusion races, with detailed course information and participant details available on the website.

name: 1. Hannover Backyard Ultra
description: The 1st Hannover Backyard Ultra will take place on August 8, 2026, in Georgengarten in Hannover. In this unique running format, a 6.706 km lap is run every hour until only one person remains. The event offers a special challenge for endurance runners and promotes community and sporting ambition in the Hannover region.
course_highlights: Lap length of 6.706 km per hour
Start and finish in Georgengarten, Hannover Herrenhausen
Run until only one person remains
additional: The race takes place in Georgengarten Hannover, registration is via an external platform, and participation is limited to 70 runners. The event emphasizes community and experience in the ultra-running scene.

name: Volkslauf um den Mittelpunkt Deutschlands
location: Krebecker Sportplatz, Krebeck, Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: Erwachsene €8,00, Schüler bis 16 Jahre €3,00, Kinder bis 6 Jahre kostenlos
description: The Volkslauf around the center of Germany is a sporting running event on August 8, 2026, in Krebeck, suitable for young and old as well as for ambitious and recreational runners. The event offers various running and walking routes with changing elevation profiles, some of which are challenging and run on paved or asphalted paths. The races start and end at the Krebeck sports field, and all participants receive fruit and drinks during and after the competition. Medals and prizes are awarded to the top finishers, and there is an age group classification as well as on-site medical support.
course_highlights: Changing elevation profiles, some challenging
Paved or asphalted running and walking routes
Support stations on the 5.7 km and 10.4 km routes
additional: Registrations and re-registrations are possible until about 30 minutes before the respective start for a fee of 2.00 €. Showers, toilets, and changing rooms are available in the sports hall. Participation is at your own risk. Photos and video recordings will be taken on the event day and may be published. Runs on paved or asphalted paths, provision of fruit and drinks, showers, toilets, medical support, online registration possible, start and finish at Krebeck sports field.

name: Schierker Sommerlauf
description: The Schierker Summer Run is a traditional race in the Harz region, taking place on August 8, 2026, for the 24th time. The event offers varied courses ranging from 1 km to 16 km, passing through the impressive landscape around Schierke. Runners experience breathtaking views, a unique atmosphere, and great support at the finish area of the Schierker Feuersteinarena. The race is part of the new Harz Running Cup 2026 and is open to runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Run on paved forest roads with two laps in the 8 km main race
Breathtaking views of the Brocken and the Harz landscape
Start and finish at the Schierker Feuersteinarena with a great atmosphere
additional: Start and finish are at the Schierker Feuersteinarena with changing and shower facilities. The course runs over paved forest roads. There is a refreshment point at the newly built toboggan run. Registration is online with a personalized bib for pre-registrants. The use of showers is included in the entry fee. The event is part of the Harz Running Cup 2026. Courses on paved forest roads, online registration, personalized bibs, refreshments included, electronic timing, certificates and trophies for winners.

name: Brohlbachtal-Lauf mit Halbmarathon und Walking
description: The 15th Brohlbachtal Run in Gamlen offers runners and walkers a varied sporting event on a flat course. The event includes competitions over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.0975 km), as well as walking and Nordic walking distances. Children's and youth competitions are also offered. The finish line is the same for all competitions, with the exact address displayed via RUNME Premium.
course_highlights: Flat course
Competitions for running, walking, and Nordic walking
Distances from 5 km to half marathon
additional: The finish line is the same for all competitions. Children's and youth competitions are also part of the event. The exact finish line address is only visible with RUNME Premium. The event takes place at the Gamlen community hall and is known for its friendly atmosphere and diverse running options for all age groups.

name: Frontrun - Janus Queer Games 2026
organizer: Janus Queer Games / SC Janus e.V.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 17 Euro pro Person bei online Anmeldung

description: The Frontrun is an inclusive race event as part of the Janus Queer Games 2026 in Cologne, welcoming runners of all genders. It offers a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 5 km partner run. The start and finish are located on the Jahnwiesen under a large rainbow, the course is well marked and accompanied by motivating course marshals. The event emphasizes community, diversity, and fun in sports within an open and supportive environment.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Jahnwiesen under a large rainbow
5 km loop for short runs, 2 loops for the 10 km run
Alphabetically marked course with friendly course marshals
additional: Race bibs are available until 11:30 a.m., warm-up begins at 11:45 a.m. Manual timing with an accuracy of +/- 3 seconds. Free water provided during the race, after the race fruit and a cake buffet available for donation to Anyway e.V. No age group classifications, categories include female, male, and all-genders. The 5 km partner run is scored in the all-gender category. Late registrations are possible on race day if starting spots are available. The course is flat and on the Jahnwiesen, registration is available online and on the event day, including refreshments and scoring in multiple categories.

name: Güttersbacher Volkslauf 2026
description: The Güttersbach Volkslauf takes place on August 8, 2026, for the 29th time and is an established running event in the Hessian and Odenwald running calendar. The event is characterized by excellent organization, a great atmosphere, and smooth execution. The courses lead through the beautiful landscape around Mossautal and offer a challenge for runners of all performance levels. Start and finish are located in the town center at the community center, where catering for participants and spectators is also provided.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the town center at the community center
Challenging courses embedded in the beautiful landscape of the Odenwald
Refreshment stations along the route and free use of the outdoor pool for participants
additional: On the day of the event, late registration is possible until at least 30 minutes before the race begins. The first 200 pre-registered participants will receive a T-shirt, as will the first 80 registered students. The first place in each class (except walking) receives a trophy, a material prize, and a certificate. Every finisher receives an exclusive finisher medal. The use of the Güttersbach outdoor pool is free for participants. Catering for runners and spectators is well provided. Participants receive medals, T-shirts for early registration, there are limited parking spaces, and possible road closures. After the race, families have free entry to the outdoor pool.

name: Monschau-Marathon warm-up
description: The Monschau Marathon is a scenic race through the picturesque Eifel landscape, attracting runners from around the world. The course leads through historic old town areas, green meadows, forested landscapes, and challenging climbs that offer a sporting challenge. The family-friendly and warm atmosphere is characterized by dedicated volunteers and a diverse international runner community. In addition to the classic marathon, ultra distances and relay races are also offered, making the event a special running experience.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen with a slight downhill and a perfect warm-up lap
Historic old town of Monschau and nature along the Rur
Legendary Holderbachtal ascent with 160 meters of elevation
additional: Registrations are possible online and on-site until August 9, 2026, with an additional late registration fee. There are 12 refreshment points along the course. Medical services, doctors, massage team, and sports physiotherapists are available on-site. Camping is possible at the sports field Am Windrad (10 € per day/person, children free). Showers and changing rooms are available at the elementary school gym in Konzen. Pacemakers for various target times are available. Finisher medals included, functional shirts can be booked for an extra charge with online registration until July 31. Multiple race categories including marathon, ultra, relay, and walking; extensive participant services such as refreshments, medals, finisher shirts, massage offers, and after-run party; registration deadlines and personalized bib numbers.

name: Oettinger Stadtlauf
description: The Oettingen City Run takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the city festival "Summer in the City" in downtown Oettingen. The event offers races for children, teenagers, and adults with timing for the main and youth races as well as for walkers. The courses lead through the historic city center and provide a sporting challenge for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV Oettingen, Department of Running, Triathlon, and Athletics, and is a popular local race event with a family-friendly character.
course_highlights: Course through the historic city center of Oettingen
Children's race approx. 0.8 km without timing
Main race and walk approx. 7 km with timing
additional: Children's race without timing, registration possible via Oettingen holiday program, late registration on the event day with additional fee, medals and drinks for children and youth races, prizes for the top three boys and girls in the youth race, walk and main race with timing, start times staggered from 4:00 PM. The course is mostly flat, asphalt and cobblestone, start and finish at the marketplace, participation open to all physically trained individuals, city championship for residents of Oettingen.

name: Residenzfestlauf Kirchheimbolanden
location: Innenstadt von Kirchheimbolanden, Kirchheimbolanden, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Residence Festival Run Kirchheimbolanden is a traditional race through the city center of Kirchheimbolanden. The event offers runners the opportunity to start in a beautiful urban environment and be part of a popular local sports event. The course runs through the city center and offers a varied running scenery. The event is organized by LLG Wonnegau, known for its dedicated running community.
course_highlights: Run through the city center of Kirchheimbolanden
Varied urban running course
Traditional local sports event
additional: Registration for the LLG Summer Runs 2026 is now open. LLG Wonnegau also offers an annual closing celebration event for club members and non-members. The office of LLG Wonnegau is located in Monsheim. Courses in the city center, start and finish at the parking garage, free parking, showers and changing rooms in the school gymnasium.

name: Volkslauf um den Auesee
description: The 5th race of the Mühlenkreis series will take place on August 8, 2026, at ATSV Espelkamp at Auesee. The course runs on paved and partly asphalted paths around Auesee and is almost flat, with no significant elevation changes. The race is part of a popular regional running series with a total of nine events. The organizer is ATSV Espelkamp, which ensures a well-organized and pleasant running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop around Auesee
Paved and partly asphalted paths
Hardly any significant elevation changes
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie with a total of nine races in the region. The series awards ceremony will take place on November 14, 2026, in Espelkamp. The race offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering and medical services on site. Registration is via contact email, and the course includes asphalt and forest paths. The event is also part of a regional running series.

name: Měřínský kros
description: Měřínský cross-country is a traditional cross-country race set in the beautiful nature of the Vysočina region, offering a main race of 13 km across Dědkovská Mountain and a relaxed 8 km course suitable for recreational runners. For children aged 5 to 12, there is a obstacle run called Junior Kros with a giant jumping castle. The race is timed with chip timing, and after the run, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The start and finish are at the playground behind the elementary school in Měřín, where parking, a storage room, toilets, changing rooms, and showers are available.
course_highlights: Main course of 13 km mainly runs on field and forest paths and trails (about 70%), with the rest consisting of asphalt sections in the village
Route over Dědkovská Mountain with new viewpoints thanks to bark beetle damage
Small refreshment station along the route
additional: Junior Kros is a free obstacle run for children aged 5-12 with distances of 700 m and 1400 m. After the race, a giant jumping castle is available. Parking is possible at the Měřín elementary school. On-site registration closes 20 minutes before the start. The registration fee includes a sausage and a drink. The race limit is 100 runners. The race is run at your own risk, without insurance. After the race, an evening volleyball tournament with refreshments takes place. The course is mainly on field and forest paths, marked route, limit of 100 runners, free children's obstacle runs, evening volleyball tournament after the race.

name: Barvám Neutečeš Pardubice
description: Color Run You Can't Escape is a colorful run in Pardubice offering two routes - 5 km and 1.5 km. The event is not about speed but about joy, friendship, and fun, where participants pass through colorful zones, being splashed with colors. The run is suitable for all age groups and is ideal for families, friends, and individuals who want to experience a day full of colors, music, and great atmosphere. In addition to the run, there is a music program and various entertainment activities.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 colorful zones
1.5 km route with 3 colorful zones and an interactive sports zone
Colorful zones, music, and entertainment activities along the route
additional: The event takes place from 9:00 to 16:00 in Pardubice, Park Na Špici. It features a music program with Pavel Calta and others. The event is charitable, with the option to contribute by purchasing a symbolic heart. Participants can join a prize draw from partner STANLEY on Instagram. The event offers BASIC and WOW start packages, with registration available online and on-site. It is suitable for team-building and charitable activities, with rules including paid entry fee and a visible participant T-shirt.

name: Mořice Run
location: Mořice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Mořice Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque village of Mořice near Olomouc. The race is part of a series of running events focused on fitness and performance running, organized by the club in Central Moravia. Liga stovkařů is known for supporting regular running and endurance races, and Mořice Run offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy a quality race atmosphere. The club also provides support and advice to runners who want to start or improve their training.
course_highlights: 8 km course on asphalt roads around the castle in Mořice
Children's run of 1.5 km as part of the event
Friendly atmosphere and facilities for competitors in the local area
additional: The race takes place on August 8, 2026, as part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc region, start at 9:00 AM, registration and details are not specified

name: Slatinická sedmička
location: Slatinice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinická Sedmička is a charity run covering 7 km, primarily through terrain around the village of Slatinice near Olomouc. The race is dedicated to the memory of Šárka Krčková and offers runners a pleasant route with a natural character. The event is suitable for all runners who want to combine sport with supporting a good cause.
course_highlights: 7 km mainly off-road route
Surroundings of the village of Slatinice near Olomouc
Charity run in memory of Šárka Krčková
additional: The run is part of charitable activities supporting oncology care, and the event is associated with fundraising and support for local sports.

name: Vnorovská desítka
location: Vnorov, Vnorovy, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: platba přes bankovní účet, ceny nejsou explicitně uvedeny
description: Vnorovská desítka is a popular 10 km running race held annually in August in the village of Vnorovy. The race is part of the Moravian-Slovak Running Cup and attracts over 200 runners from various countries, including Czech elites and African runners. The course runs on a closed asphalt circuit with minimal elevation gain, with start and finish at the elementary school. The race atmosphere is very lively due to a large audience and numerous participants, with nearly 700 runners competing in all categories.
course_highlights: Course 4 x 2.5 km on asphalt road with minimal elevation gain
Closed circuit with traffic exclusion
Start and finish at the elementary school in Vnorovy
additional: Registration is open online until August 6th; same-day registration is not possible. The main race is timed with AMB chip technology. Women and men over 70 years run a shorter course of 2 x 2.5 km. Results of the main race will be announced at the Ajax pub area in Lidéřovice. Starting numbers for participants starting at 17:00 are entered into a raffle for running prizes. The race is 4 x 2.5 km on a closed circuit, with online registration until August 6th, start at 17:00, start and finish at the elementary school, with an atmosphere of spectators and a raffle.

name: Dačického 12
location: GASK Kutná Hora, Kutná Hora, Czech Republic
description: Dačického 12 is a traditional cross-country running race in Kutná Hora, which is already in its 18th edition. The race offers courses of 12 km and 6.7 km, as well as children's races with shorter distances. The route runs through the picturesque Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys, passing by historical landmarks such as the Church of St. Barbara and the Sedlec Cathedral. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting experience in the beautiful environment of Kutná Hora.
course_highlights: The route runs through the Vrchlice and Bylanka valleys
Passes between the Church of St. Barbara and Sedlec Cathedral
Refreshment station at the Holy Trinity
additional: Children's races are divided into categories based on year of birth with distances ranging from 300 m to 1000 m. The start is at the Jesuit College / GASK on Barborská Street. The route includes running through the streets of Pod Hrádkem, Na Podskalí, around the Šafrán guesthouse and the Great Pond. After the race, participants can order custom plaques for clubs or events. The race includes the main 12 km course, 6 km course, children's races in four categories, online registration, start and finish at GASK Kutná Hora, and the event is complemented by music and support for the charity collection Světluška.

name: niedamiRUN - Ultramaraton Sudecki
organizer: Stowarzyszenie NIEDAMIRÓW WIOSKA CUDÓW i Foxter Sport
description: NiedamiRUN is an ultramarathon in the Sudetes taking place on August 8, 2026, in Niedamirow, a picturesque village located at the border of three cultures. Participants can choose from four distances: 10K, 20K, 50K, and 100K, which lead through the Karkonosze Mountains, Lubawska Gate, and Bóbr Valley, offering challenging elevation gains and beautiful views. The routes pass through historical and natural attractions of the region, with start and finish lines in Niedamirow. This is a unique opportunity to face the Sudecki ultra in the company of wild nature and local culture.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Karkonosze Mountains, Lubawska Gate, and Bóbr Valley
Elevation gains up to 3970 meters on the 100K distance
Views of Bukówka Lake and historical crucifixes on the 10K route
additional: The participant limit for each distance is 100 people. There is an option to change the distance until August 4, 2026, with an additional fee or without a refund of the difference. The routes have nutrition points and time limits. The start and finish are located at the former WOP Guardhouse and sports field in Niedamirow. Routes are available for download to Garmin, Suunto, Polar, and other GPS devices. The courses go through the Karkonosze and Sudetes, with a time limit from 3 to 18.5 hours, various distances, attractions for children, and local delicacies at the finish line.

name: 10 Śliwicka Dyszka
description: Sliwicka Dyszka is an annual race organized by the association Running Sliwice, promoting active lifestyles and running. The event takes place in the picturesque area of Sliwice, offering participants an attractive 10 km route. The race attracts both amateurs and experienced runners, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community integration.
course_highlights: 10 km route
Picturesque terrain around Sliwice
Organized by the local association Running Sliwice
additional: The event is part of the local running calendar, and details regarding registration and the route are not specifically available on the website, but it is a popular sporting event in the region.

name: 12 eXtremalny Bieg Godzinny
description: The 12th Extreme One-Hour Run is a unique one-hour race held in Koszalin on a demanding approximately 1-kilometer loop in forest terrain with significant elevation changes and varied ground, including sandy sections. Participants compete to complete as many laps as possible within one hour, and the last lap must be started before the time expires. The race promotes sport, recreation, volunteering, and active tourism, and at the finish line, competitors receive an extremely heavy medal and a drink. The event is organized by the 'SFX' Association and Rozbiegany Koszalin.
course_highlights: Loop approximately 1 km long in challenging, hilly forest terrain
Varied ground with sandy sections
Significant elevation changes and demanding terrain
additional: Electronic chip timing; medical support from the PCK Rescue Group Koszalin; each participant receives a start number with safety pins; a drink is provided at the finish; the race starts together; participants must complete the last lap started before the one-hour limit; the race is open to individuals aged 18 and over with current medical examinations or a signed declaration. Registration opens on June 6, 2025; the event takes place on sandy terrains in Koszalin; participant limit; ability to complete 1 km within an hour.

name: Bieg Zbója
description: The Zbój Race is a mountain run held in the picturesque region of Bielsko-Biała, on routes around the Klimczok peak. The race's name refers to the legend of the bandit Klimczok, who formed a gang to help the poor and left behind traces in the form of a shelter and a cave. The course is demanding, with significant elevation gains and technical ascents that test the character and endurance of participants. This event attracts runners from all over Poland, offering not only a sporting challenge but also a unique atmosphere and beautiful mountain views.
course_highlights: Mountain route with over 1530 m of elevation gain over a 25 km distance
Legendary ascents and sections requiring great endurance
Refreshment point 'Hilton' with a rich buffet along the route
additional: The start package includes a limited-edition running band and a neck gaiter in the color assigned to the distance. There is an option to purchase an extended package with a T-shirt and a belt for the race number. Finisher medals are cast, and participants receive a recovery meal and a certificate of completion with time and place. The 'Hilton' refreshment point offers a rich buffet on the route. The race is mountain-based, with limited distances, start packages with T-shirts and belts, certificates, medals, and meals.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
location: Ogród Botaniczny UAM, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Botaniczna Piątka Poznań - summer edition is cross-country race organized in the picturesque UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań. The event is part of a series of races that since 2014 promote running and the beauty of natural routes in Greater Poland. The race attracts running enthusiasts who appreciate the aesthetics and character of cross-country trails. The alternative location is Lake Rusałka, situated just 500 meters from the Botanical Garden, providing additional scenic value.
course_highlights: Cross-country route in UAM Botanical Garden in Poznań
Picturesque natural terrain and aesthetic surroundings
Alternative location at Lake Rusałka, 500 m from the start
additional: Start packages can be collected with authorization. The organizer emphasizes the aesthetic qualities of the routes and the character of cross-country races. The partner of the autumn cycle is Trzymsie.pl. The alternative race location is Lake Rusałka, 500 meters from the UAM Botanical Garden. The 5 km route runs through park terrain, online registration is available, with a limit of 500 participants. The start and finish are at the UAM Botanical Garden. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and outdoor activity.

name: I Jura Night Dog Run
location: Klucze, Olkusz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.description: Jura Night Dog Run 10 km KOBIETA indywidualnie z pełnym pakietem
