description: I Jura Night Dog Run is a night canicross race taking place on August 8, 2026, in Klucze, Poland. The event offers two main routes: 10 km and a half marathon of 21 km, with options for individual or team participation. The event is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a intimate atmosphere and comfortable competition. The race is scheduled to start at 8:00 PM, highlighting the unique nature of a night run with a dog.
course_highlights: Night canicross race
Routes of 10 km and 21 km (half marathon)
Participant limit of 500
additional: Number of participants limited to 500. Options for individual or team (team) participation. Possibility to join teams, training plans available, event promotes activity with dogs.

name: Złota Dycha
description: The 6 Gold Ten is a street race held in the heart of Złotoryja, the oldest town in Poland. The event is scheduled for August 8, 2026, combining sporting excitement with the celebrations of the European Gold Panning Championships. The race offers two distances - 5 and 10 kilometers, and participants have the opportunity to compete on the picturesque streets of the town. The organizer is the Złotoryja City Office and the Złotoryja Cultural Center, supported by the local running community.
course_highlights: Street race through the picturesque streets of the oldest town in Poland
Two distance options: 5 and 10 kilometers
Event combined with the European Gold Panning Championships
additional: The participant limit is 300 people, divided between the 5 km and 10 km distances. Starts are scheduled for Saturday morning at 9:00 and 10:00. The race is part of the celebrations of the European Gold Panning Championships, and participants will receive special medals and trophies. The race covers 10 km and 5 km distances, in the center of Złotoryja, with the town center closed to vehicle traffic on race day. Registration is available at the Złotoryja Cultural Center, with options to purchase start packages. Training sessions are available from the moment of registration.

name: Brunnenlauf
location: Iburg-Stadion, Bad Driburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Bad Driburg Fountain Run is an annual running event organized by TV "Jahn" Bad Driburg e.V., welcoming runners of all ages. The challenging course leads over the Sachsenring, through the spa park, and through the city to the finish line at Iburg Stadium. The event emphasizes fairness and sportsmanship and offers timing with a reusable chip. Registration is exclusively online; late registrations are not possible.
course_highlights: Challenging turnaround course with inclines
Course passes over the Sachsenring, through the spa park, and the city
Finish at Iburg Stadium Bad Driburg
additional: Timing is exclusively provided by the reusable race result chip, which is worn on the foot with a chip strap. The chip deposit is €10 and will be refunded upon return. Late registrations are not possible. Participants can be disqualified for violations of fairness and decency. Registration is only online, no late entries, participation from 18 years old, children and students free of charge.

name: Diekseelauf
description: The Sparkassen Diekseelauf is a traditional fun run around the Dieksee in Bad Malente-Gremsmühlen. The event takes place on August 9, 2026, and offers runners an attractive course with modern timing using transponders. Participants can view and download their results and certificates conveniently online. The race is organized by TSV Malente and is open to runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Dieksee
Timing with transponder and bib number
Start and finish at the Diekseepromenade
additional: Timing is done using a bib number with an integrated transponder. The bib must be worn clearly visible at the front. Results and certificates are available online and can be downloaded after the race. Terrain along the Dieksee, on-site registration possible, start and finish area at the Diekseepromenade, catering at the finish area.

name: Karbener Stadtlauf
price_range: zwischen 2,00€ und 15,00€ je nach Lauf und Jahr
description: The Karben City Run is a traditional race event held annually in Karben on Günter-Reutzel-Weg. The event offers runners of various age groups and skill levels the opportunity to compete on diverse courses through the city and surrounding areas. In addition to the athletic competition, an accompanying program provides entertainment and social interaction. The race is a popular event for the whole family and promotes local sports spirit.
course_highlights: Course route through the city of Karben
Finish line at Günter-Reutzel-Weg
Varied running routes for different age groups
additional: There is an accompanying program for the event. Registration is via a separate registration page. The event is organized by the Karben Sports Club. Various race disciplines, online registration until approximately 60 minutes before the start, late registrations possible for a fee.

name: Monschau Marathon
description: The Monschau Marathon takes place from August 7 to 9, 2026, in the picturesque Eifel landscape and offers runners a challenging course with varied terrain. The event includes not only the classic marathon but also ultra distances (K56 and K70), a Genuss-Marathon, and relay races. The route passes through historic old town areas, green meadows, forest landscapes, and offers impressive views, combined with a family-friendly and warm atmosphere. The Monschau Marathon is an international running event with great diversity and a strong sense of community among participants, helpers, and sponsors.
course_highlights: Start in Konzen with slight downhill and a fast warm-up lap
Historic old town of Monschau and nature along the Rur
Legendary Holderbachtal ascent with 160 meters of elevation
additional: 12 refreshment points on the marathon route. Relay exchange points in Widdau and Kalterherberg. Medical services, doctors, massage team, and sports physiotherapists on site. Camping available at the sports field Am Windrad (10 euros per day/person, children free). Showers and changing rooms in the Grundschule Konzen sports hall. Late registrations are possible until August 9, 2026, online and on-site with a late registration fee. Pacemakers for various target times. Finisher medal included, functional shirt available for an additional charge with online registration until July 31. Guided bike tour on Saturday without start fee. Multiple race distances including marathon, ultra (K56, K70), relay, and walking; event in the Eifel with refreshment points, start and exchange zones; focus on community and nature experience.

name: Münzwaldlauf (36. Volkslauf)
description: The Münzwaldlauf is a traditional community race in Lichtenau, Baden-Württemberg, which will take place in 2026 for the 36th time. The event offers various distances from 0.25 km for children to the main race over 10 km. The courses mainly run through forest and meadow paths and are characterized by their natural setting, making the race particularly attractive for families and nature lovers. In addition to the short children's races, there are more challenging sections, such as the 5.2 km trail run. The event is an established local running event with a long history.
course_highlights: Courses over forest and meadow paths
Natural setting, not a typical city street race
Diverse distances from 0.25 km to 10 km
additional: Typical August weather with an average of 25 °C and mostly sunny days. The event takes place in Lichtenau, with courses around Lichtenau-Ulm. There are several distances, including 0.25 km, 0.5 km, 5.2 km, 7 km, and 10 km. The event is scheduled for August 9, 2026, with various distances suitable for all age groups. The terrain is natural and suitable for both amateur runners and trail enthusiasts.

name: Oberpfalzmeisterschaft Waldlauf 2026
location: Familienbrauerei Jacob, Bodenwöhr, Schwandorf, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Upper Palatinate Forest Run Championship 2026 will take place on August 9, 2026, at the Jacob Family Brewery in Bodenwöhr. The event is organized by the Upper Palatinate district and hosted by TV Burglengenfeld. The forest run offers runners an attractive course in a natural environment and is part of the Hammerseelauf. The championship is open to various age groups from youth to masters and promises exciting competitions in the Upper Palatinate region.
course_highlights: Forest run course in a natural environment
Event location at Jacob Family Brewery in Bodenwöhr
Part of the Hammerseelauf with regional championship
additional: Registration until August 2, 2026; categories for youth, active, and masters; event location is Jacob Family Brewery in Bodenwöhr.

name: Rother Kirchweihlauf
description: The Rother Kirchweihlauf is a traditional running event organized by TSG 08 Roth. The race takes place annually in Roth and offers runners a wonderful opportunity to engage in sports and experience community. Despite occasional weather-related challenges, the event is carried out with great commitment. It is open to runners of all performance levels and is a fixed part of the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional race in Roth with regional significance
Open-air event with varied course
Part of the Middle Franconian 10km Championship (if held)
additional: Certificates can be downloaded online after the race. The event is organized by TSG 08 Roth, which also offers other sports programs and courses. The race takes place on a flat, asphalted course, with various categories for all ages and performance levels. Results and photos are available.

name: Stefan-Andres-Freundschaftslauf
organizer: Lauftreff Schweich e.V. / LLG Wustweiler e.V.
description: The Stefan-Andres Friendship Run is a challenging scenic run through the vineyards of Schweich on the Moselle, held without a competitive character. The focus is on the joy of running and the shared experience. Three distances are offered: 12 km, 18 km, and 26 km, each with several elevation meters and well-marked paths. After the run, there is a social gathering with cold drinks at the House of Sports, which also offers changing and shower facilities.
course_highlights: Challenging scenic run through the Schweich vineyards
Three distances: 12 km (approx. 340 Hm), 18 km (approx. 490 Hm), 26 km (approx. 720 Hm)
Refreshment points on all routes, traditional schnapps at the last station
additional: The run is a friendship run without entry fees, conducted as a charity run for the Lifesaver App project 'Region of Lifesavers'. Start and finish are in Schweich, with the start point at Niedeprümer Hof and the finish at the House of Sports, which has changing and shower facilities. At the Schweicher Annaberg 'Lagenliebe', each participant is served a glass of wine. After the run, there is a casual gathering with cold drinks. The event usually takes place in August, with typical sunny weather around 25°C. There are refreshment stations with wine and schnapps tastings, and after the run, participants celebrate together at the House of Sports. The event supports the app 'Region of Lifesaver', which alerts first responders nearby.

name: v-office-Europalauf
location: Neustadt in Holstein, Ostholstein, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The 39th vOffice Europalauf on August 9, 2026, is an international race connecting the Baltic Sea resorts of Neustadt, Pelzerhaken, and Rettin via the half marathon route. The course offers a magnificent view over the Neustädter Bay and runs along the beach promenade back to Neustadt parallel to the beach. In addition to the half marathon, there are other races over 10 km, 5 km, 2.5 km, and a kids' run. The event is a popular sports occasion in the region and is organized by TSV Neustadt.
course_highlights: Half marathon route connects Neustadt, Pelzerhaken, and Rettin
Magnificent view over the Neustädter Bay
Course runs along the beach promenade parallel to the beach back to Neustadt
additional: Start and finish of all runs at the Seebrückenvorplatz, Neustadt-Pelzerhaken. Distribution of starting documents from 7:00 a.m. at the Kurzentrum Soziales Genesungswerk (SGW), Dünenweg 1-3, opposite the Tourist Information. Schedule with multiple start times for different distances and disciplines (half marathon, 10 km Windberglauf, 5 km promenade run, 5 km Nordic walking, 2.5 km lighthouse run, kids' run 900 m). Award ceremonies begin at 10:30 a.m. The event ends at 1:00 p.m. The event includes various race distances, including half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and children's runs. The race takes place on August 9, 2026, offering a beautiful setting and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Černovírský kros
location: Černovír u Ústí nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Černovírský kros is a traditional running race held in Černovír near Ústí nad Orlicí, offering courses in hilly terrain with a combination of paved and unpaved forest and field paths as well as asphalt. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Registration and start are at the Sokol hall in Černovír, with the main race covering a distance up to 5 km. The race atmosphere is friendly and it is popular among local and visiting runners.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain with a combination of paved and unpaved forest and field paths
Mixed surface including asphalt
Course up to 5 km suitable for children and adults
additional: Registration on site from 9:00 AM. Children's race at 10:00 AM, main race at 11:30 AM. Entry fee 100 CZK for adults, 20 CZK for children. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup. The course is up to 5 km with diverse surfaces. The race offers various distances, from 0.08 km to the main 4.85 km, and is part of a sports series supporting running activities in the region.

name: Běh na Krušnou horu
description: The Krušná Hora Run is a traditional uphill race held in the village of Hudlice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race starts at the end of Dolejší Street by the forest and leads along a wide forest gravel path to the Máminka lookout tower at the top of Krušná Hora. The course is 2.7 km long with an elevation gain of 190 meters, offering runners a challenging yet beautiful trail running experience in nature. The organizer is TOBI Sport s.r.o. and the race is part of the Czech Running Club.
course_highlights: Course length of 2.7 km
Running on a wide forest gravel path
Finish at the Máminka lookout tower at the top of Krušná Hora with a 190 m elevation gain
additional: The race start is near the village of Hudlice, 9 km from Beroun, at the forest crossroads. The race is organized by TOBI Sport s.r.o., contact person Pavel Kundrát. The course is certified and the race is part of the Czech Running Club. The race includes trail running in the forest, with registrations available on the KOPEC website. The race is suitable for runners of various levels.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Kielce - summer edition is cross-country running organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with exceptional sports and natural experiences. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: The event takes place on August 9, 2026, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle among residents of Kielce and the surrounding areas.

name: Chudy Wawrzyniec
description: Chudy Wawrzyniec is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Żywiec Beskids, offering six distances from 3 km to 100 km. The event takes place on August 8-9, 2026, starting in Rajcza and ending in Ujsoły. The routes are technically demanding, with significant elevation gains and beautiful views, and the 80 km race is the venue for the Polish Mountain Running Championships at Ultra Distance. Organizers ensure professional organization and nutrition points along the route, as well as the possibility to transfer the start package.
course_highlights: Routes with large elevation gains: 50 km (+2525 m), 80 km (+3825 m), 100 km (+5115 m)
Technically demanding mountain trails with numerous ascents and descents
Start in Rajcza, finish in Ujsoły, routes passing through Wielka Rycerzowa, Pilsko, and other peaks
additional: Time limit for distances 50/80/100 km is 16 hours. The 100 km route requires reaching the control point at Trzy Kopce within a maximum of 11h30 to continue the race. There are nutrition points (3 on 100 km, 2 on 80 km, 1 on 50 km) without disposable cups. Transfer of the start package to another participant is possible from April 1 to July 31. Registration for the event begins on December 11, 2025. The race takes place in the Żywiec Beskids, with options to participate in various distances and mountain climbing elements. The time limit for completion is 16 hours.

name: VII Charytatywny Bieg świętego Dominika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie Bieg Świętego Dominika w Ustroniu
description: The St. Dominic International Run is a prestigious running event held annually since 1994 in Gdańsk, as an integral part of the St. Dominic Fair. This unique sports event attracts both amateurs and professionals, offering races of various distances in the picturesque city center with a route around Neptune. The event promotes a healthy lifestyle and social integration, as well as providing an unforgettable atmosphere thanks to the cheering of thousands of spectators and a rich accompanying program. The event is appreciated by local authorities and sponsors, highlighting its importance and significance in the Polish running calendar.
course_highlights: Route in the center of Gdańsk around Neptune with a length of 1412 meters
Loop leading through Długi Targ, Powroźnicza, Kotwiczników streets, and others
Cheering from over 25,000 spectators along the route of each race
additional: The event includes four races under the common slogan "Chase St. Dominic," including a prologue for all fair participants, a race for disabled persons, and traditional races for women and men over 5 km and 10 km. The route is a closed loop, allowing spectators to follow the competition closely. The event is accompanied by a rich program of attractions, including partner stalls, presentations, shows, and concerts of the St. Dominic Fair. There is also a charity run over 10 km and 5 km, with entry fees donated to charitable causes, and the event is part of the GRAND PRIX USTRONIA.

name: XI Bieg Lucka

price_tiers.distance: Bieg rekreacyjny i Nordic Walking 5,2 km

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Opłata startowa za Biegi Dzieci wynosi 10 zł

description: The 11th Lucka Run is a memorial race commemorating Lucjan Chorąży, taking place on August 9, 2026, in Skawinki near Lanckorona. The event includes the main race of approximately 14 km, a recreational run and Nordic Walking on a distance of about 5.2 km, as well as races for children on shorter distances. The main route leads up to Chełm mountain, and after the race, participants can meet for refreshments. The run has a family and mountain character, and its goal is to honor Lucjan, who was passionate about mountains and running.
course_highlights: Main race route of about 14 km leads up to Chełm mountain
Recreational run and Nordic Walking on a distance of about 5.2 km
Children's races on the sports field and meadows near the race office
additional: Number bibs and additional registration for participants are collected on the day of the event from 9:00 to 11:00. The children's races start at 10:30. The participant limit is 270 for the main race, recreational run, and Nordic Walking, with 80 spots available online and 30 on the day of the event for children's races. If fewer than 5 participants are in an age category, categories may be combined. Children's race routes are marked on the sports field and meadows near the race office. After the race, a refreshment is provided for participants. Registrations can be made online, and the event includes RFID timing. The participant limit is 270. The routes run around Skawinki and Lanckorona, and the event is part of local sports traditions.

name: Stezka mužů
description: The Men's Trail is a 3 km road race that is part of the SABZO series and will take place on August 12, 2026, in Prague 4. This race is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to spend active time in a friendly atmosphere. Although the main focus is on running, the event is part of a larger sports and social program in the region. Come race and enjoy a day full of movement and fun.
course_highlights: 3 km road course
part of the SABZO series
friendly atmosphere and suitable for the general public

name: 6. Běh pro zdraví
location: Park B. Němcové, Karviná, Czech Republic
description: Run for Health is a charitable series of seven runs held in the beautiful surroundings of Božena Němcová Park in Karviná. Each run offers a 3 km route that anyone can run at their own pace. The proceeds from the entry fees are donated to help those in need, giving the event purpose and added value. Registration begins at 17:00 and the start is at 17:45 at Lodičky. Everyone is warmly invited to participate and support a good cause.
course_highlights: 3 km route in the beautiful environment of Božena Němcová Park
Surface: cycle path
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need
additional: Registration begins at 17:00, start at 17:45 at Lodičky. A series of seven runs, each 3 km long. The proceeds from the entry fees go to help those in need. Terrain: cycle path; Registration: registration from 17:00, start at 17:45; Series of seven runs from March to August 2026

name: 15 Diecezjalna Pielgrzymka Biegowa Radom...
description: The 15th Diocesan Running Pilgrimage is a unique running event organized by the Association "Biegiem Radom!". The race takes place on a route from Radom to Częstochowa and combines sporting passion with the spiritual dimension of a pilgrimage. It is not only a competition but also a community experience that attracts runners from various backgrounds. The event is scheduled for August 11-13, 2026, and is an important date in the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: The route runs from Radom to Częstochowa
The event combines running with a spiritual pilgrimage
Organized by the local Association "Biegiem Radom!"
additional: The race takes place from August 11 to 13, 2026. Registration is conducted through the platform time-sport.pl. The event has the character of a running pilgrimage, emphasizing its unique spiritual aspect. Participation is limited to 40 pilgrims over 18 years old. The registration fee includes meals, insurance, a medal, and a T-shirt, with accommodations in tents and buildings.

name: 17. VSB Dresdner Nachtlauf
price_range: early bird price (specific amount not provided)
description: The VSB Dresden Night Run offers a beautifully illuminated running course with a view of the Dresden skyline, accompanied by torches and glow sticks that create a special atmosphere. The 11.5 km route runs along the Elbe to the Blue Wonder and back via the Neustadt Elbe side, while the 6.2 km route also follows the Elbe and leads to the finish over the Albert Bridge. In addition to the sporting experience, there are children's runs and a special team classification for clubs and organizations. The event takes place at the Heinz-Steyer-Stadium and is a highlight in the regional running calendar.
course_highlights: 11.5 km route with views of the romantically illuminated Elbe castles and the Blue Wonder
6.2 km route along the Elbe with return over the Albert Bridge
Course illuminated with torches and glow sticks, view of the Dresden skyline at night
additional: Start times: 6:30 PM Bambini run (400 m), 7:00 PM children's run (1.8 km), 8:00 PM 11.5 km run, 10:15 PM 6.2 km run. Pacemakers for target times of 50, 60, and 70 minutes on the 11.5 km route. Team classification with prize money for the most participants clubs/organizations. Cut-off time: 9:40 PM (11.5 km) and 11:15 PM (6.2 km). Night run, registration open for 2026, event in Dresden, various race distances possible.

name: 24. Dammer Stadtlauf
description: The 24th Damme City Run is an evening road race through the center of Damme, organized by OSC Damme in cooperation with the city of Damme. The program includes three starts: a school run, a general race for all participants, and the main race in the evening. After a two-year pandemic-related break, the race returns with an expected participation of over 500 runners. The event is characterized by an open, local atmosphere with late registration options, filling the streets of the city center with runners.
course_highlights: Evening road race through the city center of Damme
Three starts: school run, general race, and main race
Course remains in the city center with a lively atmosphere
additional: Late registrations are possible, promoting open and local participation. The weather in August is typically sunny with temperatures between 14 and 25 °C. The event includes multiple categories, including children's races and the main race, with a course through the city and a relaxed, inviting atmosphere.

name: 24. Knesebecker Einhornlauf
description: The Knesebecker Unicorn Run is a traditional running event in the Isenhagener Land, taking place annually in August. The event offers runners of various performance levels the opportunity to compete on diverse courses. Online registration is conveniently available via the RaceResult platform, where all results and certificates can also be accessed. The race takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Wittingen and attracts numerous running enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: 10 km race course
Nordic Walking option
Event on school grounds in Knesebeck
additional: Registration is done online via RaceResult. Results and certificates are also accessible through RaceResult. The race takes place on Friday evening. Participant limit is 100 people; registration and results are available online; event is held on the school grounds in Knesebeck.

name: 35. Speller Sparkassen-Sommernachtslauf
description: The 35th Speller Sparkassen Summer Night Run is a traditional race in Spelle organized by SC Spelle-Venhaus. The event offers runners an attractive course in the beautiful surroundings of Wählehof. The race is suitable for all age and performance levels and takes place in a relaxed atmosphere. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a family-friendly character.
course_highlights: Course through the scenic surroundings of Wählehof
Well-marked routes with various distances
Varied paths with asphalt and natural sections
additional: The event takes place in the evening, making it a special summer night run. Results are available online and detailed directions are provided. The race routes are available as PDFs, including 5 km, 10 km, and walking distances. The event is part of the EL CUP series, offers numerous categories for all age groups, and is known for its flat course and friendly atmosphere. After the race, participants can enjoy the summer evening with music and refreshments.

name: 100MeilenBerlin - Der Mauerweglauf
description: The 100MeilenBerlin - The Wall Run is a historically themed ultramarathon that traces the path of the former Berlin Wall around western Berlin. The approximately 161-kilometer route mainly runs on paved paths but also includes trail sections and some rough terrain. The start and finish are located at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg. The race commemorates the victims of German division and is held annually with changing race directions.
course_highlights: Route follows the former GDR border strip around West Berlin
Changing race direction annually, in 2026 counterclockwise
26 refreshment points at intervals of 5 to 9 kilometers, including 3 exchange points with dropbag options
additional: Start and finish at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark, no parking available on site, public transportation recommended. Race number serves as a travel pass. Cut-off time for individual runners is 30 hours, for 2-person relay teams 27 hours. Shuttle buses to the start on the morning of race day. Three exchange points with dropbag options. 26 refreshment points offering mostly vegan food. Timing with transponders from race result Germany. Finish line soup and award ceremony for all finishers. The race begins at Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahnsportpark in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg, starting at 6:00 AM and finishing the next day at 12:00 PM. The race is known for its historical significance, varied course, and support from numerous refreshment stations. It is a challenging ultramarathon that tests both the physical and mental strength of participants.

name: 2. Backyard Ultra-Marathon Tharandter Wald
description: The 2nd Backyard Ultra Marathon in the Tharandter Forest is organized by SC Freital e.V. and takes place in one of Saxony's most beautiful forest regions. The course consists of a 6.7 km loop, mainly running on forest paths, with variations running clockwise and counterclockwise. The start and finish areas are located at the youth recreation farm Grillenburg. A total of 100 starting spots are available, with registration via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 6.7 km long loop mainly on forest paths
Change of running direction: first counterclockwise, at night clockwise, during the day again counterclockwise
Start and finish area at the youth recreation farm Grillenburg
additional: The first 8 laps are run counterclockwise, from 6 PM (night course) clockwise, from 6 AM (day course) again counterclockwise. There are a total of 100 starting spots. Registration is via RaceResult. Maximum 100 participants, registration through RaceResult, accommodation at the youth recreation farm Grillenburg, running principle: hourly laps until only one runner remains.

name: Charity Mega Run
description: The Charity Mega Run in Bingen am Rhein is a unique running event with a mission: to get people moving — for themselves, for others, and for a good cause. The event offers four distances from 5 km to 52 km along Germany's most beautiful running route with stunning Rhine panorama and vineyards. In addition to the run, there is a pasta party on the eve and a diverse supporting program for runners and spectators. The event takes place on August 15, 2026, at the Rhine-Nahe corner in Bingen and combines athletic ambition with social engagement.
course_highlights: Running route with Rhine panorama and vineyards
Four distances: 5 km, 10 km, 26 km, and 52 km
Six to nine refreshment stations depending on the route
additional: Number bib distribution and registration on the day of the event from 7:30 a.m. or already on August 14 at the pasta party. Six to nine refreshment stations depending on the route. Free parking nearby during school holidays. Supporting program and prizes for the top three finishers as well as trophies for the winners (women and men) of each distance. Runner bags with goodies for all participants. The event includes refreshment stations, a supporting program with music and children's activities, as well as a pasta party on August 14. Registration is possible online, with payment options on-site including PayPal and card payment. There are prizes for the best runners and sponsors.

name: Altenlotheimer Dorflauf
description: The Altenlotheimer Village Run offers a great opportunity to get active together. With routes for children and longer distances, there is something for the whole family. The event takes place on August 15, 2026, in Altenlotheim and invites runners of all ages to experience the local running community.
course_highlights: Variety of course lengths from 1 km to 21 km
Family-friendly race event with children's routes
Start in Altenlotheim with beautiful surroundings
additional: The weather in August is usually sunny with an average of 25 °C and 60 mm of precipitation. The event is open to all age groups with various course lengths. In addition to the main races, there are also children's and Bambini races, relay runs, and Nordic walking. The event is well organized and offers a wonderful opportunity for community and activity.

name: CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf
description: The CJ Schmidt Hafentagelauf takes place in Husum, a city on the North Sea in Schleswig-Holstein, as part of the Husumer Hafentage Festival. The event offers flat road races over various distances, including children's and youth races, a 5 km run, a 10 km run, and a 4 x 2.5 km relay race. Additionally, there is the Husumer Corporate Cup, where company teams with four participants each compete. The course runs through the city center and along the harbor, featuring a mix of urban streets and waterside paths, accompanied by the fresh North Sea breeze.
course_highlights: Flat road races through Husum's city center and harbor
Course along the North Sea coast with fresh sea breeze
Various distances for children, youth, and relay teams
additional: The organizer is the Husumer Sportverein seit 1875 e.V. Timing is provided by Race Result, and registration is managed by LAV Husum. Typical August weather in Husum is around 25 °C with mostly sunny days and an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The event also includes team and corporate runs as well as family races, with a festive atmosphere in the harbor area. The weather in August is usually sunny at about 25°C.

name: Detmolder Residenzlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 11,00 Euro für Erwachsene und wird per Bankeinzug nach der Anmeldung gezahlt.

description: The Detmold Residence Run is a traditional race event taking place on August 15, 2026, in Detmold. The event offers various runs for children, youth, and adults, including a toddler run, school runs, a 5 km fitness run, and the 10 km main race. Start and finish are located at the marketplace in Detmold, providing a central and lively setting. The event is supported by the Detmold municipal utilities and AÜG NETWORK as title sponsors and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and diverse competitions.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the marketplace in Detmold
Various distances from 1.5 km to 10 km
Timing with Raceresult timing system
additional: Number pickup on the day of the event from 3:30 PM at the town hall at the market in Detmold. Timing is done via the Raceresult timing system; own chips are not permitted. Free entry to the Aqualip fun pool upon presentation of the start number. Medals for all participating children and youth. Award ceremony at the marketplace: school runs from approximately 6:30 PM, 10 km run from 8:00 PM. Friedrich-Brakemeier-Wanderpokal for the school with the highest participation rate. Vouchers for schools, teams, and groups with the most pre-registrations. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and offers not only the main distances but also children's runs and special competitions. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Dülmener Wasserlauf mit 5 km Walking
location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 11th Dülmener Wasserlauf with 5 km walking will take place on August 15, 2026, in Dülmen. The event offers runners and walkers the opportunity to participate in distances of 5 km and 10 km. The race will be held at the Sportzentrum Nord and promises pleasant conditions typical of August weather with temperatures around 25 °C and mostly sunny skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified with the organizer before registration.
course_highlights: Distances: 5 km and 10 km
Location: Sportzentrum Nord, Dülmen
Typical August weather with approximately 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registration. The event features a team classification where four runners start together, as well as a special emphasis on water and environmental protection. The event is family-friendly and caters to runners of all performance levels.

name: Gederner Stadtlauf
location: Lauterbacher Straße, Gedern, Wetteraukreis, Hesse, Germany
description: The 24th Gederner City Run on August 15, 2026, offers runners of all ages a special running experience through the historic old town of Gedern. With distances of 500 m, 1,500 m, 5 km, and 10 km, there is a suitable option for children, teenagers, beginners, and ambitious runners. The longer distances lead over a varied loop course with four laps of 2.5 kilometers each, combining athletic challenge and history. The route passes through historic paths such as the Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg, and Fürstenweg, with a notable ascent to Schlossberg and through the castle garden. Start and finish are located on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing facilities are available in the Gedern sports hall.
course_highlights: Historic old town of Gedern
Four laps of 2.5 km with a varied loop course
Sections over Eisenpfad, Basaltweg, Barbarossaweg, and Fürstenweg with ascent to Schlossberg
additional: Start and finish on Lauterbacher Straße near Kirchplatz. Changing rooms in the Gedern sports hall (Franseckystraße 32A). The longer distances consist of four laps of 2.5 km each. The course includes a paved castle courtyard and castle garden. Organizer is the Top-Time timing team. Courses for children, teenagers, and adults, start/finish on Lauterbacher Straße, changing rooms in the Gedern sports hall.

name: Hambacher Volkslauf
description: The Hambach Volkslauf takes place on August 15, 2026, in Niederzier-Hambach and offers races over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, as well as a half marathon. Additionally, there are walking and Nordic walking routes over 10 km. The courses are measured by the DLV and are part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and welcomes numerous participants.
course_highlights: Measured courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Walking and Nordic walking over 10 km
Part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup
additional: Registration is now possible via the website. Course maps and the race announcement are available as PDFs. The event is part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup. Courses are measured, registration is online, and it is part of the Regio Aachen Laufcup.

name: Hüttenfelder Volksbankkerwelauf
description: The Hüttenfelder Volksbank-Kerwelauf is a traditional running event with over 30 years of history, offering runners of all performance levels an attractive opportunity to test their endurance and have fun together. Three races are offered: a half marathon (21.1 km), a 10 km run, and a 2 km school run for children. The course mostly runs through shaded forest and provides a very flat, pleasant running environment with historic ammunition bunkers as special highlights. The start and finish are located at the Hüttenfelder allotment gardens, and after the races, an award ceremony takes place at the Kerweplatz at the Bürgerhaus.
course_highlights: Super flat course mostly through the forest
Start and finish at the Hüttenfelder allotment gardens
Historic decommissioned ammunition bunkers along the course
additional: Water and isotonic drink stations in the forest and at the start/finish. No on-site registration possible. Award ceremony at 6:30 PM at the Kerweplatz at the Bürgerhaus. The 2 km school run runs over paved field paths and shaded forest edges. The course passes through forest, historic bunker facilities, water and refreshment stations, participation from age 7, on-site registration from 1:00 PM, various start times depending on age group.

name: Josef Kaderhandt-Waldlauf Plus
price_range: Waldlauf (20 km und 20 km Plus): 20€, 7,8 km Lauf: 5€
description: The 42nd Josef Kaderhandt Forest Run in Menden is a traditional running event organized by the Marathon Club Menden e.V. The course runs over paved forest paths through the scenic Sauerland and offers a sporting challenge with demanding sections. In addition to the classic 20 km forest run, runners can participate in the 20 km Plus Marathon, which can be extended to an ultramarathon of over 50 km by completing additional laps. The start is in Waldemei near the Kolping Memorial Stone, and the finish is at the Bürgerbad Leitmecke. There is also a 7.8 km fun run open to all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths in Sauerland
Challenging and scenic course
Variable ultramarathon up to 50 km through multiple laps
additional: The cut-off time for all categories is after 6 hours of running. The start is in Waldemei Menden, with the finish at Bürgerbad Leitmecke (new). Parking is centrally designated; please do not park in residential areas or on Gisbert-Kranz Straße. The course includes 3 laps for 20 km, 4 or more laps (up to 8) for the 20 km Plus and ultramarathon, as well as a 7.8 km fun run. Participants can register online; late registrations are possible on the event day in cash. The course runs over paved forest paths, starting in Waldemei and finishing at Bürgerbad Leitmecke. This event is the 42nd edition of the race.

name: Kelheimer Volksfestlauf
location: Festgelände Am Pflegerspitz, Kelheim, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kelheim Folk Festival Run is a traditional race event held annually in August at the festival grounds Am Pflegerspitz in Kelheim. It offers various distances for different age groups, including 2 km for students, 5 km for youth, and 10 km for adults. The event is a regular part of the city of Kelheim's event calendar and is organized by run & bike Kelheim e.V. Race documents are issued on the day of the event from 12:00 PM at the beer tent, and the award ceremony takes place in the beer tent after the races.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the festival grounds Am Pflegerspitz
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km depending on age group
Scoring for the Landkreis Kelheim Running Cup
additional: Race documents are issued at the beer tent from 12:00 PM until 30 minutes before the start. The award ceremony is approximately at 4:30 PM in the Volksfest beer tent. Timing is provided via Race Result. Online registration is available until August 14, 2026, with late registration on the event day thereafter. Participation is part of the Landkreis Laufcup 2026; results and registration are available online.

name: Städtedreieckslauf
description: The City Triangle Run is a traditional race through the three cities of Burglengenfeld, Teublitz, and Maxhütte-Haidhof. The 16th edition of this event will take place on August 15, 2026, attracting numerous runners for a good cause with five competitive categories. The course is flat and runs over field paths and public roads, with traffic regulations to be observed. The race offers a great opportunity to experience the region athletically and to reach the finish line together.
course_highlights: Flat running routes
Field paths and public roads
Course through three cities: Burglengenfeld, Teublitz, and Maxhütte-Haidhof
additional: The course is flat and runs over field paths and public roads. Traffic regulations must be observed. Charity event, registration from June 1, donations for non-profit organizations, joint celebration after the race at the community festival.

name: Städtelauf Plauen - Hof
description: The Städtelauf Plauen - Hof is a traditional race in the Saxon-Bavarian border region, celebrating its 35th edition in 2026. The course connects the Vogtland metropolis of Plauen with the Bavarian city of Hof and attracts runners and Nordic walkers from the region and beyond. The race is known for its sporting atmosphere and cross-border city partnership. Every year, numerous participants take part in excellent weather conditions and enjoy the scenic route.
course_highlights: Traditional race course in the Saxon-Bavarian border region
Connection between Plauen and Hof
Popular route for runners and Nordic walkers
additional: Various routes, Nordic walking possible, scenic route, joint finish in Hof

name: WoKiMen
location: Parc de Tarbes, Altenkirchen, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: WoKiMen is a family-friendly running day at Parc de Tarbes in Altenkirchen, offering various running and activity options for children, adults, teams, walkers, Nordic walkers, and even dog owners. Children can run 0.5 km or 2 km, while adults can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and 21 km. The TeamChallenge is a relay race with three 1-km segments. In addition to the runs, there is a diverse program with yoga, Zumbathlon, and an adventure course. The day ends with a relaxed Chill & Grill event featuring Nepali specialties, Italian wood-fired pizza, popcorn, coffee, and cake.
course_highlights: Family-friendly event with runs for children and adults
Various distances from 0.5 km to half marathon (21 km)
Additional program with yoga, Zumbathlon, and adventure course in the park
additional: The 5-km course is especially open to walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners with dogs. The TeamChallenge consists of three 1-km relay segments. The event takes place at Parc de Tarbes and offers a family atmosphere with a Chill & Grill conclusion. The event is open to everyone, with activities for children and adults, team relays, dog runs, and a varied supporting program. It is aimed at families, hobby runners, and community groups.

name: Reuter Run Boršov nad Vltavou
location: Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Reuter Run in Boršov nad Vltavou is a running race of 12.5 km, taking place on August 15, 2026, starting at 11:00 at Kemp Poslední štace. The race is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup and offers runners the opportunity to compete on an interesting course in the South Bohemian region. The organizer is Zdeněk Richtr, and the race is suitable for the general running public, including registered members of the cup and other runners. The surface of the course is not specified in detail, but the race is part of a series with a long-standing tradition and clear rules.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 12.5 km
Start at Kemp Poslední štace, Boršov nad Vltavou
Part of the South Bohemian Running Cup
additional: Registration for the South Bohemian Running Cup requires a membership fee of 250 CZK, which covers the entire season of the cup. Registration is possible via the website, and payment is made by bank transfer with the name and year of birth specified. When registering during the year, points from races up to 3 months retroactively are counted. The race includes trail and cross-country terrains, with start and finish at Kemp Poslední štace. On-site registration is available until 10:00. There is also a children's race of 800 meters as part of the event.

name: Běžecký mítink Bohuňovice
location: Bohuňovice u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The running meet in Bohuňovice near Olomouc is a cross-country race offering a 12.2 km course for men and a 6.1 km course for women. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and attracts runners who enjoy more challenging terrain. The meet is suitable for everyone who wants to test their strength in a natural environment with variable terrain. The event is a traditional gathering of the running community in the region.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain with variable surface
Course length of 12.2 km for men and 6.1 km for women
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of running events in the region, offers registration and rental of running equipment, and attracts runners from the wider area.

name: 7 pohoří Šumava
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails, epic views, and a unique atmosphere that will test the strength, willpower, and determination of every runner. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, 7 Mountains challenges you to conquer all routes and become a legend. The Šumava race features routes passing over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř, around glacial lakes and deep forests with elevation gains of up to 900 meters.
course_highlights: The route passes over the peaks of Špičák and Pacíř with views of the glacial lakes Černé and Čertovo
Mostly natural terrain with an elevation gain of 900 meters on the main 23.5 km track
Atmosphere and technical trails prepared by mountain rescue members
additional: The race has a time limit of 4 hours, after which the participant is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration tent. Recommended equipment includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Rescue app. The entry fee includes a professionally marked route, start number, chip timing, commemorative medal, refreshments on the route and at the finish, and access to facilities at the start and finish areas. The races include registration with chip timing, medals, refreshments, and the opportunity to participate in various routes in the beautiful Šumava environment.

name: Jablonská osmička
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: Jablonská osmička is a running race in Jablonné nad Orlicí, taking place on August 15, 2026. This fifth edition offers a main race of 8 km, children's races, and a fun beer relay for teams of four. After the race, the program continues with a Food Festival and Jabloffest featuring music and children's activities at the swimming pool area. The race is suitable for both athletes and hobby runners, and is accompanied by a rich raffle and gift bags for registered participants.
course_highlights: Road course 8 km long with slight elevation
Beer relay with 100 m sprint and consumption of beer or soft drink
Children's races divided into three age categories
additional: Registration for the main race is from 9:00 to 10:30, children's races start at 10:15, the main 8 km run begins at 11:00, and the beer relay at 12:15. T-shirts and gift bags are available only for registered participants until July 31, 2026. The race commentator is biathlete Vlastimil Vávra. After the race, there is a rich raffle and accompanying program including the Food Festival and Jabloffest. Registration is open until July 31, 2026. Start and finish are at the athletic oval. T-shirts are for registered participants, with a rich raffle and gift bags.

name: Křivinský kros
description: Křivinský cross-country is a running race held in Křivice, offering a main course of 7.5 km with an elevation gain of 275 meters and a children's course of 800 meters. The race mainly runs through forest roads and trails in hilly terrain, ensuring a challenging and interesting run. The start is gradually from 9:30 AM, first children, then juniors, and finally the main categories. The race is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix and is open to the general public with voluntary registration fee. After the race, results are announced and a short raffle for participants takes place.
course_highlights: Main course 7.5 km with 275 m elevation gain
90% of the route runs through forest roads and trails
Hilly terrain at Křivina
additional: Registrations are possible on-site before the race or in advance via email. The registration fee is voluntary. The start of all categories is approximately 150 meters from the registration site. The route is marked with red-white plastic ribbons and white arrows on trees or posts, or with white spray paint on the ground. After the race, results are announced around 11:30 AM followed by a raffle. Before the race, participants can join a group training and run through the main route. The race includes hilly terrain, forest roads, and trails, and is part of the Eastern Bohemia Grand Prix series.

name: 303 Maraton Antoniego Fili
organizer: Polska Fabryka Wodomomierzy i Ciepłomierzy FILA Sp. z o.o.
description: The 303 Antoni Fili Marathon is a marathon race held in Sztum, Mazowieckie, Poland, scheduled for August 15, 2026. Participants have access to a professionally prepared training plan tailored to various skill levels, helping them optimally prepare for the start. The event is an excellent opportunity for runners wishing to challenge themselves with a marathon distance in a picturesque setting. Organizers provide expert support and the possibility to use a platform for managing race information.
course_highlights: Marathon distance of 42.195 km
Organized in the scenic area of Sztum
Training preparations available online
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support. Organizers encourage the use of a platform to manage the race profile and marketing collaboration, which helps increase reach and professionally manage event information. The event also includes other local races, such as the Sztumski Bieg Solidarności. Details regarding registration and participation are available on the organizer's website.

name: Botaniczna Piątka edycja letnia
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - summer edition is a cross-country run organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. The organizers aim to popularize running and provide participants with exceptional sports and landscape experiences. We invite you to participate in this friendly and dynamic running event.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized since 2014 with a passion for running
additional: Registrations for the summer edition are available through the registration form. The organizers place particular emphasis on cross-country runs and the aesthetics of the routes. The partner of the autumn cycle of Botaniczna Piątka is Trzymsie.pl. Cross-country run, available through the registration form for the summer edition.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See
location: Kurpark am Kanal, Bad Bederkesa, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Volkslauf Rund um den Beerster See is a running event for participants of all ages and skill levels, taking place on the third Sunday in August in Bad Bederkesa. The course runs through a natural environment and offers a motivating challenge for both ambitious runners and hobby athletes. The event promotes community and joy of movement and is a special experience for both competitive participants and recreational runners. Start and finish are located in the spa park at the canal, and timing is done with a transponder.
course_highlights: Natural course around Beerster See
Start and finish in the spa park at the canal
Free drinks on the other side of the lake and at the finish
additional: Race documents are issued at the Amtsscheune opposite the castle. Showers are available at Moortherme upon presentation of the start number. Timing is done with a transponder, which must be returned after the race. The cut-off time for the main races is after 1:45 hours. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Course length 7.6 km, walking, Nordic walking 1.1 km, 0.5 km, 14.6 km; race documents at the Amtsscheune; in all weather; timing with transponder.

name: HuBuT - 8. Hunsbuckel-Trail
description: The HuBuT - Hunsbuckel-Trail is a challenging trail running event in the Hunsrück with three course lengths: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km), and UltraTrail (47 km). The runs take place through diverse low mountain landscapes with green meadows, deep forests, single trails, gorges, and award-winning hiking trails. A special highlight is crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge, Germany's most beautiful and highest suspension bridge. The start and finish point is the idyllic town of Laubach, offering participants an unforgettable natural experience.
course_highlights: Diverse low mountain landscape with elevation profile between river valleys and ridges
Crossing the 360 m long and 100 m high Geierlay suspension bridge
Running on pristine terrain, single trails, award-winning hiking trails, and through deep gorges
additional: Start and finish are in Laubach. There are three courses: ShortTrail (12 km), HalfTrail (27 km), and UltraTrail (47 km). The UltraTrail route includes crossing the Geierlay suspension bridge. The trail features single trails, forest paths, gorges, and historic sights such as the Balduinseck castle ruins. There is a winter edition with a 6-hour run in February. The event offers multiple distances, including UltraTrail, HalfTrail, ShortTrail, and a winter edition with a 6-hour run; it takes place in Laubach in the Hunsrück; typical weather in August is warm.

name: Ortskernlauf
description: The Roßdorf Old Town Festival is a traditional event held annually on the third weekend of August, celebrating its 42nd anniversary in 2026. It brings together the diverse community of Roßdorf and offers a lively program with live acts on three stages, a children's and family area, as well as numerous clubs and local organizations. The Old Town forms the social center where visitors from near and far celebrate together. The Old Town Run on Sunday is a sporting highlight with start and finish in the Old Town.
course_highlights: Start and finish area in the Old Town of Roßdorf
Warm-up from 11:00 AM, start of the Old Town Run at 12:00 PM on Sunday
Diverse community and festive atmosphere in the Old Town
additional: The Old Town Run takes place on Sunday with warm-up from 11:00 AM and start at 12:00 PM at the start & finish area in the Old Town Run. Children's program and children's band are from 5:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The festival offers live acts on three stages, a kids and family area, as well as numerous clubs on site. Athletic run, registration from summer 2026 on the website of the Skifreunde Roßdorf.

name: Ronneburger Stunden-Paarlauf des Laufprojekt Büdingen
location: Stadion im Jugendzentrum Ronneburg, Ronneburg, Hessen, Germany
description: The Ronneburg Hour Pair Race organized by Laufprojekt Büdingen e.V. is a unique running competition where teams of two runners take turns completing laps on the 400m synthetic track in the stadium at the youth center in Ronneburg. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, and offers three competitions over 15, 30, and 60 minutes. The laps run are added up and converted into a total distance, with the pair covering the greatest distance winning. The event is open to all gender combinations and promotes team spirit and endurance in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 400m synthetic track at the stadium in the youth center in Ronneburg
Pair exchange after each lap
Competitions over 15, 30, and 60 minutes
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site until one hour before the start of the competition. Registration can be done as an individual or as a pair; individual registrations will be grouped into pairs by the organizer. Payment is made via direct debit upon registration or in cash at the bib pickup during late registration. The event is expected to end around 3:00 PM. Course lengths are 900 m and 3.6 km, medals, certificates, supporting program, and catering are available on site.

name: Run´n Roll for Help
description: The Run'n Roll for Help is a traditional city run in Giessen that has been inspiring female runners for over 28 years. Annually, the streets of the city center transform into a sporting highlight, where alongside the athletic competition, the good cause is at the forefront. With over 1,200 participants in 2025 and a donation total of over 19,000 euros for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe, the event is a significant charity race celebration in the region. The event offers a great atmosphere and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to participate in August 2026.
course_highlights: Route through Giessen city center
Traditional city run with large number of participants
Charity run supporting Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe
additional: Registration for the run opens soon. Over 1,200 runners participated in 2025. The event raises funds for Lebenshilfe and Aidshilfe. Photos and videos of the event are available in the gallery on the website. Official hashtags for social media are #MiteinanderMehrBewegen and #RunandRollforHelp. Charity run, registration opens soon, donations for social causes, support for HIV prevention and youth work.

name: Sengbachtalsperrenlauf
location: Sengbachtalsperre, Leichlingen-Witzhelden, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

price_tiers.distance: Stadtwerke Solingen Familienlauf 1,2 km und 3,6 km

description: The Sengbach Dam Run is a traditional scenic race around the Sengbach Dam near Leichlingen-Witzhelden. The three main distances lead over well-maintained forest paths and a paved section along the dam wall, with a loop of approximately 9.8 km and about 200 meters of elevation gain per lap. The course is vehicle-free and runs within a landscape conservation area. For families, there is a separate race with shorter distances in the vicinity of the event grounds. The event offers refreshments along the route and showers in the nearby town of Kuhle.
course_highlights: Loop of approximately 9.8 km with 200 meters of elevation gain per lap
Well-maintained forest paths and a paved section along the dam wall
Vehicle-free course within a landscape conservation area
additional: Race documents will be issued on the day of the event from 7:30 AM at the registration tent. Showers are available in a school in the neighboring town of Kuhle and are signposted. Refreshments with bananas, water, ISO, and cola are available approximately every 5 km, with free tea and bananas at the finish. Certificates can be downloaded online. The course is vehicle-free with two refreshment stations on the loop. A donation campaign for the Leverkusen Children's Hospice is being conducted. The route runs on forest paths, no roads, donations for the children's hospice are possible, registration until the day of the event, late registration fee of €5 from August 11, 2026.

name: SV02 Kerwelauf - Der SV02 lässts LAUFen
description: The 8th SV02 Kerwelauf in Schönau is an entertaining running competition taking place on August 16, 2026. The event offers two distances, a 400-meter run and a 10-kilometer run, and is aimed at runners seeking a short but sporty challenge. The race is held in typical August weather with pleasant temperatures and mostly sunny conditions. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Schönau and promises an enjoyable running experience.
course_highlights: Distances: 400 m and 10 km
Location: Schönau
Typical August weather with approx. 25 °C and mostly sunny
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. The event features a measured, DLV-approved course, live timing, children's runs, and a festive atmosphere with catering in the festival tent.

name: Waldlauf / 37. Volkslauf
description: The 47th Waldlauf / 37th Volkslauf is a running event held on Sunday morning in Oberzent-Hetzbach in the Odenwald. The program for adults includes hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. The start times are staggered, with the 10 km run beginning shortly before the 5 km run, giving the event the character of several local races organized together. Additionally, there is a 750-meter race for children and adolescents, with all races ending at the same finish line.
course_highlights: Hilly courses over 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Shared finish line for all distances
Separate competitions for children and adolescents
additional: Start times are staggered, with the 10 km run starting shortly before the 5 km run. The 5 km course is also open to walkers and Nordic walkers. Typical weather in August: around 25°C, mostly sunny, average precipitation 60 mm. Hilly terrain, multiple race distances, including walking and Nordic walking options; weather-dependent conditions in August with temperatures around 25°C and approximately 60 mm of rainfall.

name: Wohldenberger Waldlauf
description: The 21st Wohldenberger Forest Run on August 16, 2026, offers runners of all performance levels varied courses through the Wohldenberger Forest. For over two decades, this event has been one of the most popular in the Hildesheim region and attracts 200 to 300 participants annually. The course runs over natural forest paths with changing surfaces and hilly sections, making the run a true cross-country experience. There are suitable distances for beginners, families, walkers, and ambitious runners, from short children's runs to the challenging half marathon.
course_highlights: Natural forest paths with changing surfaces
Hilly sections in the Wohldenberger Forest area
Diverse courses for all performance levels from 0 km to 21.1 km
additional: Six starts for all: Shorty run (free, 11:30 AM), School run (1.5 km, 11:15 AM), 4 km walking (9:10 AM), 4 km run (9:00 AM), 10 km run (9:10 AM), Half marathon (8:50 AM). Registration as an individual or group registration possible. Event at the forest sports facility of SV Rot-Weiss Wohldenberg in Holle. Four courses, registration on-site possible, cross-country run in the forest with changing surfaces.

name: Wolfsburg Staffellauf powered by VfL Wob e.V.
price_range: Startgebühren der Kinderstaffeln werden vom Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. übernommen, sonst keine Angaben
description: The Wolfsburg Relay Race, organized by VfL Wolfsburg e.V., is a special team experience that brings together runners of all ages and backgrounds. On August 16, 2026, the second edition of this relay marathon will take place, where teams from schools, clubs, and companies can experience sporting team spirit together. The course runs through the green city forest of Wolfsburg with start and finish at VW-Bad, where musical entertainment is also provided. Children's relays are supported by the Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V., making participation especially attractive.
course_highlights: Start and finish at VW-Bad
Course through the green city forest of Wolfsburg
Musical accompaniment by DJ Tomoritzland in the start-finish area
additional: Children's relays consist of 5 participants with at least one female and one male person. The entry fees for children's relays are covered by the Förderkreis Leichtathletik VfL Wolfsburg e.V. The race numbers are collected after the run and reused for future events. Race materials can be picked up on August 14, 2026, from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM at the VfL office or on the day of the event from 8:00 AM. Dogs are not allowed in VW-Bad. Medical services are on site. Participants can use the swimming pools of VW-Bad free of charge. Relay race, teams from different groups, route plans, impressions, registration via my.race|result.

name: Žebrácká pětadvacítka
description: The Beggar's 25K is a traditional August road race through the roads and forest paths of Křivoklátsko, held annually in Žebrák. It offers several distances including the main race of 25 km, a 10 km run, a 10 km walk, and a family run for children. The main race starts at 10:00 AM at the Elementary School in Žebrák, with the senior categories starting at 9:00 AM. The race is associated with the celebrations of the Vavřinecká pilgrimage and offers beautiful sporting experiences in the picturesque environment of Křivoklátsko.
course_highlights: Road and forest paths of Křivoklátsko
Two loops around the housing estate in Žebrák at the beginning of the race
Family run with attractions for children on a 1.1 km loop
additional: The family run with Točníček and Žebráček starts on race day at 9:30 AM in front of the Elementary School in Žebrák, with a length of 1.1 km, no age restrictions, with a reward for children at the finish. The main 25 km race starts at 10:00 AM, with senior categories starting at 9:00 AM. After the start of the main race, a non-competitive 10 km run and a 10 km walk with poles (Nordic walking) are also launched. Online registration with the option to order a T-shirt ends on July 20, 2025. On-site registration is available on race day from 7:30 to 9:15 AM at the Cultural Club. The race is suitable for all age groups, including children and families, with participation possible in any weather, with dogs, and barrier-free access.

name: MFB MarathOn LABE
description: MarathOn LABE is a traditional international running festival held in Kolín and Poděbrady, offering a marathon, half marathon, 10 km race, and other running disciplines. The marathon course is a loop and runs on forest, paved, and asphalt roads with ČAS certification. The event is suitable for runners of all levels and features a rich program including children's races and entertainment for families. The organizer is the Kolínská 14 association, which has been promoting an active and healthy lifestyle in the region since 2011.
course_highlights: Marathon course is a loop with ČAS certification
Terrain: forest roads, paved roads, asphalt
Marathon start at Kmoch's Island in Kolín
additional: The marathon starts at 8:00 AM on Kmoch's Island in Kolín, the half marathon and 10 km races start at 9:00 AM (half marathon from Poděbrady, 10 km from Kolín). There is an option to camp overnight for free in a tent at the amphitheater. Bus transportation from Kolín to the half marathon start in Poděbrady is arranged with reservation. Registration and bib pickup are on Saturday and Sunday morning. Parking and changing rooms are available in Kolín. The event takes place on August 16, 2026, offering various race categories, a festival atmosphere, and online registration.

name: Tyršův běh na Sokol
location: Malá Skála, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Tyršův běh na Sokol is a traditional forest run in Malá Skála, offering a challenging course of 2 km with an elevation gain of 300 meters. The run is intended for outdoor running enthusiasts who do not mind hills and technical terrain full of roots, holes, and stones. Races start at one-minute intervals, and the event has a long-standing tradition, with the 36th edition held in 2021. All interested in this type of run are warmly welcome.
course_highlights: Forest course with technical terrain full of roots, holes, and stones
Length of 2 km with an elevation gain of 300 m
Start at one-minute intervals
additional: The course includes forest and gravel paths, stairs, and only the first 100 meters are asphalt. Registration and further information are available on the event's website or Facebook page.

name: Marceliński Bieg Letni 2026
description: Marceliński Summer Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Route available on Garmin Connect
additional: Authorization form for collecting the start package. The race route is available on Garmin Connect. The event focuses on trail running, and details about registration are not provided on the website but can be found on the event's Facebook page.

name: XXI Bieg Lesoków
description: The 21st Lesoków Run is an annual race organized in Szemud, part of the Kaszuby Biegają series. The event offers two routes of 5 km and 10 km, which lead through picturesque areas of Kashubia, encouraging active outdoor recreation. The event attracts runners of various age groups and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and local running culture.
course_highlights: Routes lead through charming areas of Kashubia
Available distances: 5 km and 10 km
The race takes place in the scenic surroundings of Szemud
additional: The event will take place on August 16, 2026, with online registration available from December 2025. The run is part of the regional Kaszuby Biegają series, promoting physical activity in Kashubia.

name: BWM Sommerlochlauf
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a popular running event in one of the most beautiful landscapes of southern Germany. The course leads through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and offers an exhilarating atmosphere at the roadside. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, everyone will find their personal highlight here. The dedicated organizing team ensures an unforgettable running experience with a lot of heart and precision.
course_highlights: Run through picturesque vineyards and historic old towns
Flat finish on Ludwigsburger Straße in Steinheim
Various distances from 5 km to ultra marathon
additional: Monthly training runs with different pace groups and guides for preparation. Summer runs every Tuesday evening during the summer holidays, 10 km long run, free of charge and no registration required. Year-end run as a traditional event with a 10 km race and afterwards punch & mulled wine. The 5 km run starts at Rosenplatz in Großbottwar with a historic course and flat finish. Time limit for the 5 km run: 2 hours. No specific details about terrain, registration, or further notes available.

name: Žvahov - Ivův běh
location: Děvín, Praha 5, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Žvahov - Ivův běh is a cross-country race 3.7 km long, held in the Děvín area in Prague 5. The race is part of the SABZO series and offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in a natural environment with gentle hills and interesting views. This race is suitable for everyone who enjoys short but more challenging terrain courses. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in the beautiful Děvín Hills.
course_highlights: Cross-country course 3.7 km long
Natural environment of the Děvín Hills
Part of the SABZO series
additional: The race starts on the road below the TJ Zlíchov football pitch; the race is also suitable for beginners and families with children.

name: Nettetal-Lauf
distance_verbose: 50 Meilen, Marathon, Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter
description: The Nettetal Run is a traditional road race held annually in mid-August in Ochtendung, Germany. The event offers a wide range of distances from 3 km to 10 km for 2026, with longer distances possible in other years. The course is officially measured, allowing for recognition of results in the German best lists. The race is supported by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and is listed in the running.de calendar.
course_highlights: Officially measured course
Road race in Ochtendung, Germany
Various distances from 3 km, 5 km to 10 km
additional: Typical weather in August: around 25 °C during the day, 14 °C at night, mostly sunny with an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The start location is Ochtendung. The race is part of the German athletics calendar, with an official, measured course suitable for competitions.

The festival includes running races such as the Lipno Half Marathon, 10 km COOP RUN, and a family run, as well as cycling races including 60 km and 20 km gravel and MTB routes. The event is complemented by children's races and evening runs along the scenic cycle path Čertovy proudy. Participants can enjoy the beautiful nature of Šumava and a rich accompanying program with cultural activities.

Cycling races on the peaceful side of Lipno with 60 km and 20 km routes
Children's off-road cycling races on a cyclocross track in six categories

The race kit can be picked up in advance from August 17 at the festival's Active point. The race office opens on race day at 7:30. The races include cycling routes, running tracks, cultural program, sports activities, and registration probably on the website. Joint start for men and women
Children's race with loop length determined before the start

name: Šárecká 5

description: Šárecká 5 is a cross-country race of 5.3 km held in the picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6. This varied race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy running in one of the most beautiful parts of Prague with more challenging terrain. Organized by SABZO Prague under the leadership of Michal Procházka, it is part of the running activities of the Czech Athletic Federation. The race is suitable for all who enjoy trail running and natural scenery.
course_highlights: Distance of 5.3 km on varied terrain
Cross-country/trail race character
Picturesque natural area of Divoká Šárka in Prague 6

It is held in the beautiful environment of the Divoká Šárka nature reserve, registration is possible online, and the course is suitable for runners of all levels.

On August 21, 2026, runners of all ages and skill levels can participate in various race distances, including a children's run, a 5 km fun run, a 10 km main race, and a team relay. The course runs along the picturesque Elbe promenade and offers a special atmosphere with an after-run party in Tangermünde. The race is a community sporting event that emphasizes fun, movement, and team spirit.

Loop course approximately 1 km in length with 5 or 10 laps for the main races
Children's run about 500 m long, possible with parental accompaniment

All participants receive a certificate, which is available online. The team relay is awarded a trophy. Bib numbers must be worn visibly on the chest. Catering before, during, and after the race is provided. The event takes place at Bleichenberg on the Elbe riverbank, including various distances, children's and youth runs, and an after-run party. It is integrated into the regional race calendar and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

A broom bicycle accompanies the races, with the finish at 19:15 for the 5 km and 21:00 for the 10 km. Event at Ahnepark in Vellmar
Officially measured courses for rankings

It is a local club race without major branding or destination elements. Distances: 200 m, 17.3 km; registration and results via my.raceresult.com; listed in the laufen.de race calendar.

name: Abendstraßenlauf
location: Dorfzentrum, Herxheim, Südliche Weinstraße, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The evening street run in Herxheim is a traditional race event that has been held annually since 1987. In 2026, the race will be organized with a new concept and a new course in the village center, starting and finishing at the festival grounds behind the festival hall. Races are offered for the whole family, including Bambini, school children, beginners, and main races over 10 km. The main race consists of two laps, and the beginner's race has been extended to 5 km. The event combines athletic challenge with a family-friendly program.

Beginner's race extended to 5 km
Start and finish at the festival grounds behind the festival hall
