Age group rankings with certificates and prizes. The top three male/female finishers of the 10 km race of the day will receive gift vouchers. Organizer is TV Herxheim 1892 e.V., Athletics Department. New race course, family and children races, online registration, event in the village center.

name: Buntekuhlauf
description: The Buntekuhlauf in Lübeck-Buntekuh is a traditional race taking place on August 21, 2026, for the 18th time. The event offers various competitions for all age groups and skill levels, from short runs on the sports field to longer distances on sidewalks. The races are held on traffic-free sidewalks and sports grounds, creating a safe and pleasant atmosphere for all participants. SC Buntekuh e.V. organizes the race with the goal of enabling movement with fun for everyone.
course_highlights: Courses on the sports ground (750 m and 1.5 km)
Longer distances (5 km, 10 km, 15 km) on sidewalks, no road closures
Multiple laps of the 5 km course for 10 km (2 laps) and 15 km (3 laps)

Late registrations are possible until August 16, 2026, at 8:00 PM, and possibly on the event day, but not guaranteed. There are no personalized bib numbers, but certificates will be issued with the usual information. Changes to registration are free until a certain point; thereafter, a fee of 10 euros applies. Multiple race categories including Fun Run, walking, and longer distances; online registration available; start and finish at Koggenweg in Lübeck-Buntekuh.

name: Bürener Volkslauf - Hochstift-Cup
description: The Bürener Volkslauf is a traditional running event in Büren, taking place on August 21, 2026. The races include various distances, such as Bambini, children, students, and corporate runs, which lead through the scenic Aftetal on asphalted courses with slight elevation differences. Certificates are provided for all participants, and the top runners are awarded trophies. The event is part of the Hochstift-Cup and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.

Continuously asphalted course with slight elevation differences
800 m students' and children's races on a 400 m circular track
additional: Certificates for all participants. Trophies for places 1-3 (m/f) in the overall standings. The city of Büren's perpetual trophy for first place in the team classification. Special prize for the team with the most participants (only for corporate runners). Certificates can be printed via the race software 'race result' after the event. Bib numbers and transponders will be issued. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking and travel information will be provided. The courses are challenging with slight elevation differences. Registration deadline is on the day of the event, and registration is via MY RACERESULT.

description: The Lemgo Hanselauf is a traditional running competition held annually on the last or second to last Friday in August in Lemgo. The event offers courses of 3.3 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km on the city’s ramparts. Children and toddlers can also participate in shorter distances, making the Hanselauf a family-friendly event. With around 1,000 participants, the Hanselauf is a sporting highlight in the region that combines fun and community.

Children's and toddler races over 1.5 km and 400 m

Race on the ramparts, children's and toddler races, registration at Engelbert-Kämpfer-Gymnasium, late registration possible on the event day.

The race is a sporting challenge in Schleswig and is organized by the Laufverein Spiridon Schleswig.

Mostly firm sandy ground
Start and finish at Polierteich

name: Volkslauf Um die Taakener Ähren
description: The community run "Around the Taakener Ears" is a family-friendly and popular running event in Taaken, taking place on August 21, 2026. The event offers various competitions for all age groups, from toddler runs to school and jogger races, as well as the main 10 km race and a relay race. The course runs through the town of Taaken and the idyllic Ears fields, with fun and community spirit at the forefront. All participants receive baked goods at the finish line, and the winners are awarded traditional victory loaves. The village provides catering and beverage stands to create a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course through Taaken and idyllic Ears fields
Start and finish on the green area behind the sports hall
Relay race with a unique baton over 10 km in teams of 2 to 4 runners

Parking is available behind the sports hall. Catering with water, fruit, and baked goods is provided, along with snack and beverage stands. All runners of the main, relay, and jogger races can participate in a raffle held after the award ceremony of the main race. Various running disciplines, team relay, children and youth races, on-site catering.

description: Morava Run - Against the current is a relay running race across Moravia along the Morava River. It takes place in teams of 7 to 12 members. The approximately 280 km route is divided into 30 segments of about 9 km each, which teams divide according to their strength and strategy. The race starts in the south of Moravia in the CHKO Soutok and runs against the river's flow through Slovácko, Haná, CHKO Litovelské Pomoraví, up to the source of the Morava River at Králický Sněžník. The event is aimed at amateur runners and emphasizes team cooperation and teambuilding, with no set pace limit.
course_highlights: The route runs against the flow of the Morava River from Břeclav to Dolní Morava
A total of 30 segments, each about 9 km long
Passes through CHKO Soutok, Slovácko, Haná, CHKO Litovelské Pomoraví, and Jeseníky
additional: The race starts in Břeclav at Pohansko Castle, and the finish is at the Dolní Morava camp, where camping is available until the next day. The race begins in waves, with no pace limit. Each team plans logistics and schedules their effort over 30 segments. The organizer provides an emergency line for unforeseen events and a WhatsApp group for team leaders. The race is designed for teams of 7-12 members, including logistics, support along the route, and camping facilities. It is intended for athletes and teambuilding groups, focusing on experiences and cooperation in nature.

description: The Rammelsberger Steigerlauf is a challenging mountain run in the Northern Harz, taking place at the World Heritage Site Rammelsberg in Goslar. The event offers various courses with inclines of up to 30%, passing through historic mining scenery and diverse forest and mountain passages. Participants can look forward to professional timing and a unique running experience with an alpine character. The courses range from a short race for children to a marathon and trail with up to 1110 meters of elevation gain. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and trail runners who want to challenge their endurance and footing.
course_highlights: Inclines up to 30% on challenging sections
Start and finish at the World Heritage Site Rammelsberg with historic mining scenery
Trail sections with alpine character and up to 620 meters of elevation gain (BergmannTRAIL)
additional: Late registrations are possible on August 21st from 3-6 PM and on August 22nd from 8:00 AM on site with a late registration fee of €3 until 30 minutes before the start. All participants receive a yellow wristband for free access to the mining site (no guided tours). The BergmannTRAIL starts 200 meters underground, requiring a helmet, at 250 meters of tunnel. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Dogs are not permitted on the premises. Courses with up to 1630 meters of elevation, challenging sections with up to 30% incline, mining scenery, late registrations possible on site.

name: Osnabrücker 6-Stunden-Lauf
organizer: Norbert Dulle, Heinz Hagen, Maik Mittmann, Holger Schulze, Florian Siebelmann, Frank Wilke
price_range: 49 Euro für Einzelstartende, 145 Euro für Staffeln
description: The Osnabrück 6-Hour Run takes place on August 22, 2026, at Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück and celebrates its 10th edition. The race is a charity run in support of the HelpAge campaign "Every Grandma Counts" and is open to all runners who wish to cover as many kilometers as possible within six hours. Whether ambitious runners, marathon training, or simply running, walking, or hiking together in the beautiful landscape around the lake — everyone is warmly welcome. The event offers individual and relay participation and emphasizes community and the good cause.
course_highlights: Loop course around Rubbenbruchsee in Osnabrück
Running, walking, or hiking in beautiful nature
6-hour distance with free choice of kilometers
additional: Briefing at 09:45 AM with mandatory attendance for all runners. Relay team members: at least 3, maximum 6 persons. Legendary "Every Grandma Counts" running shirt can be ordered for 25 euros upon registration (sizes S/M/L, other sizes on request). No refunds for non-participation. The event supports the aid organization HelpAge Germany e.V. Runners will compete on a 3,130-meter paved loop around Rubbenbruchsee; inclusive race; catering and race materials on site; charity run in support of HelpAge Germany.

name: Sieber Berg- und Panoramalauf
location: Sieber, Herzberg am Harz, Niedersachsen, Germany
price_range: 44,00 € für das Original, 34,00 € für die Panorama-Runde, 19,00 € für das Natur-Erlebnis, Kinder 6,00 €; Frühbucherpreise bis 31.03.2026 ab 38,00 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Altersklasse: ab 16 Jahren Das Original , 27,5 km 44,00 €

description: The Sieber Mountain and Panorama Run returns on August 22, 2026, after a 14-year hiatus, offering three challenging courses in the Harz with up to 900 meters of elevation gain. The event is handcrafted, warm, and challenges runners of all performance levels. From the family-friendly 4.5 km nature experience trail, the 12.5 km panorama round, to the main distance of 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation gain, there is something for everyone. The runs pass through impressive nature with panoramic views and provide an authentic Harz feeling. In addition to the sporting experience, there is a pasta buffet and a village festival as a conclusion.
course_highlights: Nature Experience: 4.5 km with 130 meters of elevation, family-friendly and ideal for beginners
Panorama Round: 12.5 km with 500 meters of elevation on the Großer Knollen with impressive views
The Original: 27.5 km with 900 meters of elevation over Großer Knollen and Hanskühnenburg, challenging and legendary
additional: Race number pickup on August 21, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00 and on August 22, 2026, from 07:00 at the Haus des Gastes, Sieber. Pasta buffet on Friday evening (bookable separately, €7.00). Participation in 'The Original' and 'Panorama Round' is also possible outside of age categories with written consent from guardians. Children's run for ages 6-12 on August 22, 2026, at 11:00. Award ceremony and village festival afterwards on the Große Wiesen. Three courses: Nature Experience (4.5 km), Panorama Round (12.5 km), The Original (27.5 km); up to 900 meters of elevation; family-friendly; pre-sale with pasta buffet; joint carbo-loading; participation outside age categories possible with guardians.

name: THE HUMBLE CLUB Backyard Run IV
description: The Humble Club Backyard Run IV on August 22, 2026, on the Oker Island in Braunschweig is a unique running experience that combines athletic challenge with social engagement. The race supports the project "Boxing Against Parkinson" and stands for movement, community, and social responsibility. The event begins at 10:00 AM, with entry from 8:30 AM, and offers participants basic provisions of still water and fresh fruit as well as an exclusive finisher medal. Participants are asked to bring their own supplies to ensure optimal nourishment.
course_highlights: Event on the Oker Island in Braunschweig
Backyard Ultra format with laps running
Support for the project "Boxing Against Parkinson"
additional: Arrival from 8:30 AM possible. Basic provisions with still water and fresh fruit included. Exclusive finisher medal for all participants. Bring your own supplies. Event within the Backyard Ultra format, start at 10:00 AM, provisions on site, donations for 'Boxing Against Parkinson', community spirit in ultramarathon format.

name: Arnstädter Bach-Ultra
description: The Arnstädter Bach-Ultra is an ultramarathon over 60 kilometers that takes place on August 22, 2026, in Arnstadt. It was established in response to runners' desire to complete the 60 km relay race as an independent ultramarathon. The event is organized by SG Motor Arnstadt in collaboration with the Arnstadt city administration and offers a challenging course through the region. The race is an interesting experiment that hopefully will attract a large audience and is part of a diverse running tradition in Arnstadt.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon distance of 60 km
Course runs around Arnstadt
Event developed as an independent ultramarathon from the relay race
additional: Electronic timing is managed by Sportident. Registration is via the platform www.timing.sportident.com. The race is part of a diverse running calendar in Arnstadt with several events throughout the year. Ultramarathon, 60 km, challenging course, in the Arnstadt region

name: Barumer Stick and Stone Run
location: Barumer Waldstadion, Barum, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Das Startgeld beträgt 25 € und beinhaltet eine Medaille und die Teilnehmerverpflegung im Zielbereich

description: The Barumer Stick and Stone Run is a challenging obstacle race taking place on August 22, 2026, at the Barumer Waldstadion and the surrounding wooded, hilly landscape of the Lüneburger Heide. The course runs over sandy, muddy, and partly overgrown paths with water obstacles such as ditches and a village pond. The event offers runners a varied challenge in a natural environment and is suitable for individual participants as well as groups. Participants receive a medal and refreshments at the finish area.
course_highlights: Wooded and hilly landscape on the edge of the Lüneburger Heide
Sandy, muddy, and overgrown paths with water obstacles
Course with 4 km loops, which can be run 1 to 3 times depending on the distance
additional: Individual start times between 2 PM and 4 PM, communicated to participants via email by August 21, 2026. Start and finish are at the Barumer Waldstadion. There is a group discount offer for groups of 10 or more runners, where every 5th runner runs for free. Race documents will be issued 30 minutes before the start at the race office. There is a washing station on site and drinks and snacks in the finish area for refreshment. The race takes place at the Barumer Waldstadion and is suitable for all performance levels. There are also training plans and a family-friendly atmosphere that emphasizes fun in obstacle racing.

name: Exter FlexRun! 2026
location: Sparkassen Sportpark Exter, Vlotho, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Exter FlexRun on August 22, 2026, at Sparkassen Sportpark Exter offers a flexible running concept for all performance levels. Participants can choose their distance freely and run up to four laps of 10.5 km each, which adds up to the full marathon distance. Additionally, there are relay races, walking and Nordic walking routes, as well as a children's run. The event takes place in a scenic environment and provides a great atmosphere with catering and entertainment on site.
course_highlights: Loop courses on paved paths and mostly asphalted roads in and around Vlotho Exter
Refreshment stations after 4.0 km, 8.5 km, and at Sportpark Exter
Showers, changing rooms, and extensive catering facilities at Sportpark Exter
additional: Start and finish of all competitions are at Sportpark Exter. Flexible distance choice with up to 4 laps (each 10.5 km). Relay 4 x 10.5 km for teams. Walking/Nordic Walking 10.5 km and 21 km. Children's run 1.6 km from age 6. Team and corporate awards with recognition. Routes are signposted and secured with checkpoints. Registration is via Race Result; the event offers showers, changing rooms, catering, and is suitable for families.

name: Heideköniginnenpokal
description: The Heide Queen's Cup (HeiPo) in Amelinghausen is a traditional community run that will take place for the 31st time in 2026 as part of the Heideblütenfest week. The challenging courses lead through scenic passages, including along Lake Lopau. The race attracts many participants and is a staple of regional running events.
course_highlights: Scenic passages
Course along Lake Lopau
Part of the Heideblütenfest week in Amelinghausen
additional: The Amelinghausen Running Group meets regularly on Mondays and Wednesdays to run together. There is also a beginner's course that gradually introduces newcomers to running. The event is part of a lively running community with participation in many community and marathon runs across Germany. The race takes place in August, typically with summer weather around 25°C, with possible rain. There are also children's runs and other community races during the festival week.

name: Jahn-Gedenklauf
description: The Jahn Memorial Run in Lanz is a traditional race organized by SV Jahn Lanz e.V. The event takes place at the Friedrich-Ludwig-Jahn-Stadium and offers various distances, which are also counted towards the Prignitz Cup. The start time is at 10 a.m., and the race is open to runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is supported by the Kreissportbund Prignitz e.V. and is a fixed date in the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Short distance: 6.6 km
Long distance: 12.5 km
Outside the Prignitz Cup: 3 km
additional: Tracks are not accessible with spikes, registration possible on-site, start at the stadium

name: Jan Schüpp Bürgerlauf Wittmund
location: Stadion an der Breslauer Straße, Wittmund, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Jan Schüpp Wittmunder Bürgerlauf is a running event organized by MTV Wittmund, starting at the stadium on Breslauer Straße in Wittmund. The course leads through the city center, past the marketplace and castle square, offering a challenging and varied running route. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, which are offered free of charge. The event is well organized with support from police, fire brigade, and the German Red Cross (DRK), and is very popular among runners and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the stadium on Breslauer Straße
Course runs through the city center past the marketplace and castle square
Challenging route with varied course layout
additional: Parking is available at the stadium and on the Schützenplatz on Auricher Straße. The event is medically supported by police, fire brigade, and DRK. There are children’s and youth races free of charge, as well as main races with an entry fee. The event is accompanied by a moderator and supported by local sports clubs. The run includes distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 1200 meters, with a supporting program, on-site registration, and parking options at the stadium and Schützenplatz. The event is very popular among participants and offers a festive atmosphere.

name: Michelsmarktlauf
description: The Michelsmarktlauf is a traditional running event in Reichelsheim that takes place annually in August. On August 22, 2026, the 30th edition of the Michelsmarktlauf will be held, featuring a main race over 10 km, a school run over 1.4 km, and a toddler run over 400 meters. The event is organized by the athletics department of KSV Reichelsheim and offers runners of all ages a sporting challenge in a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km
School run over 1.4 km
Toddler run over 400 meters
additional: The event offers a variety of distances and is very popular among families, school groups, and running enthusiasts from the region. Online registration is possible.

name: middenmang-Loop 2. Emder Vielfaltslauf
description: The middenmang run is an inclusive diversity run in Emden, taking place for the third time on August 22, 2026. The race is open to all age groups and people with and without disabilities to experience the joy of running together. Various competitions and courses, from the Kinner-Loop for children to the 10-km middenmang-Loop for experienced runners, offer something for everyone. The run is part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series and promotes community, activity, and inclusion.
course_highlights: Diverse courses for children, adolescents, and adults with and without disabilities
Inclusion run focused on running together and overcoming barriers
Part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series with 5 km and 10 km courses
additional: The middenmang run includes various competitions and courses for all ages and abilities. The event emphasizes inclusion and community. The 5 km and 10 km runs are part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series. Registration is available online via the website. Contact person is Inga Weerts. Inclusion run with different courses for all age groups and abilities, part of the Ostfriesische Sieben running series.

name: Münsterland-Sternlauf - Benefizlauf
location: Universitätsklinikum Münster, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Münsterland Star Run is a charity run in support of the Children's Cancer Aid Münster e.V. at the University Hospital Münster. Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to the common goal at Leonardo-Campus in Münster. The run is designed as a stage race, where participants can set their own pace and run one or more stages. 100% of the proceeds are donated to the association for the promotion of children with cancer Münster e.V. to support the treatment and care of affected children.
course_highlights: Five routes lead in a star shape from different towns in the Münsterland region to Münster
Mostly business, walking, and bike paths as well as traffic-calmed streets
Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles, refreshments at stage points
additional: The run is not a competition; participants determine their own pace. One or more stages can be run, and start and finish are possible at each stage point. Participants are responsible for their own return transport. For the first time, cashless donations are possible. Donation receipts are issued from 200 euros. Accompaniment by stage leaders and DRK ambulance vehicles. Refreshments are offered at stage points in cooperation with the Kolpingsfamilien. The run takes place in Münster and promotes social cohesion through sporting engagement.

name: Ring of Feier - 2.Hermeskeiler City Lauf
organizer: Kulturbeirat der Stadt Hermeskeil, Hermeskeiler Turnverein
description: The Ring of Feier - 2nd Hermeskeil City Run takes place on August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. It is a short race with distances of 150 meters and 5 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant running atmosphere with typical August weather, temperatures around 25°C, and mostly sunny days. Participants should check the organizer details before registering.
course_highlights: Short distances: 150 m and 5 km
City run in Hermeskeil
Typical summer weather with mostly sunny days
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, August 22, 2026, in Hermeskeil. Weather conditions in August are typically 25°C with lows around 14°C and an average of 60 mm of precipitation. The event is designed as a short city run. Besides the races, the event also offers music, catering, and team competitions, making it a convivial city festival.

name: Brdský půlmaraton
location: Kytín, Kladno District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Brdský Half Marathon is a traditional trail running race held in the picturesque environment of Kytín in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers two routes - a more challenging 21 km with an elevation gain of 430 meters and a shorter 9 km with an elevation gain of 158 meters, both with refreshment stations. On the longer course, absolute winners and categories by age and gender are announced, while the shorter course recognizes the overall fastest men and women. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for nature lovers with beautiful views and diverse terrain.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 430 m elevation gain
9 km course with 158 m elevation gain
Refreshment stations on the course with water and isotonic drinks
additional: On the 21 km course, refreshment stations are located at 3.7 km, 9 km, and 17 km with water and isotonic drinks. On the 9 km course, refreshments are available at 3.7 km and at the finish line, including water, isotonic drinks, and light snacks. Children's courses are free of charge. Categories by age and gender are announced for the 21 km course, and overall winners are recognized for the 9 km course. The race offers routes of 21 km and 9 km, suitable for trail runners and families with children, with registration available through the official website.

name: Hrabovský 1/2 a 1/4 maraton
description: The Hrabovský 1/2 and 1/4 Marathon is a traditional running race held in Ostrava-Hrabová, offering a half marathon and quarter marathon course. The race is part of the Hrabovský Cup and the Moravian-Silesian Running Cup, with participants receiving medals and having access to refreshments, changing rooms, and an accompanying program. The start and registration take place at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field. The course runs through an urban environment with a pleasant atmosphere and is suitable for a wide range of runners.
course_highlights: Half marathon course 21.1 km
Quarter marathon course 10.5 km
Start and finish at TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field
additional: The starting number is refundable and contains a chip. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, along with changing rooms and toilets. An accompanying program is part of the event. Registration is possible online with payment by bank transfer within 5 days of registration. The registration and check-in location is at the TJ Sokol Hrabová sports field, Paskovská 209, Ostrava. The event includes not only runs but also children's races, Nordic Walking, a raffle, and other fun activities. The event will take place on August 22, 2026.

name: Jesenický maraton
description: The Jesenický Marathon is a legendary and challenging mountain marathon in the Czech Republic, held in the Jeseníky Mountains since 2009. The race offers the same course for both the marathon and half-marathon each year, which varies due to changing weather and mountain terrain. Runners traverse the ridges of forested mountains, passing springs, rainforests, stone seas, and peat bogs, creating a unique atmosphere and challenge. The Jesenický Marathon is intended for experienced endurance athletes who want to conquer the highest mountains of Moravia and Silesia.
course_highlights: Ridge of forested mountains with rounded crests
Springs of fresh water and deep valleys
Ancient rainforests, mountain tundra, and stone seas
additional: The race limit is 700 runners. The time limit for completing the marathon is 6 hours and 30 minutes. Refreshments are provided at several stations with water, isotonic drinks, fruit, and energy foods. At the finish line, there is an option to purchase hot meals and drinks. Runners with valid registration by June 30, 2026, will receive a T-shirt unless they choose otherwise. The organizer may cancel the race in case of adverse weather conditions without compensation. The course is mountain terrain with refreshments at two stations, free parking, free bus transportation from the start, a time limit, and an age limit of 18+.

name: Panevropský půlmaraton
description: The Pan-European Half Marathon is an international running race from Stadlern in Bavaria to Poběžovice. The course passes through scenic nature of the Bavarian-Czech border region, including the former 'Iron Curtain' and the low saddle of the Bohemian Forest near the source of the Radbuza River. The race is accompanied by a rich cultural program at the start and finish, with activities for children. The start is traditionally at 10:00 AM and the finish is at the Míru Square in Poběžovice. Organizers warmly invite athletes and spectators to support the runners.
course_highlights: International course from Germany to Czechia
Passes through the former Iron Curtain at the Schwarzava border crossing
Hilly profile with two ascents into the low saddles of the Bohemian Forest
additional: Refreshment stations on the course at 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18 km with water and isotonic drinks. After the race, hot food, drinks, fruit, muesli, and chocolate. Registration on race day possible on-site at the start (Stadlern) for 600 CZK in cash. Bus transportation to the start and back after the race. Winners announced and awards presented immediately after the race. Each participant receives a commemorative medal and a race-themed T-shirt. Buses depart from Poběžovice and Domažlice. The race takes place in August 2026. The course is mostly asphalt with varied terrain. Part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Svatý Hostýn
location: Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Svatý Hostýn Run is a mountain race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem in the Zlín Region. This event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging race of 5 km with an elevation gain of 422 meters, most of the route being on asphalt. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and the general public, attracting running enthusiasts from across the country. The event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful surroundings of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Length of the route 5 km with an elevation gain of 422 m
Mostly on asphalt with a challenging ascent
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: Registration is also possible on-site, the race uses chip timing, and it takes place in August 2026.

name: Běh k Božímu hrobu
location: Svatý Hostýn, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run to the Holy Tomb is a traditional running event held at Svatý Hostýn in the Zlín Region, which is part of broader pilgrimage and sporting activities at the site. This event offers a uphill run with the finish at the Holy Tomb, and is an important part of the regional sports calendar. Prepare for the atmosphere of a pilgrimage site and enjoy a sporting experience in the beautiful environment of Svatý Hostýn.
course_highlights: Uphill run at Svatý Hostýn
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
Pilgrimage and sporting atmosphere with participation options during pilgrimages
additional: The event includes a run to Svatý Hostýn and the Holy Tomb, part of pilgrimage activities, registration and results available on the website.

name: Běh na Čupek
description: The Čupek Run is a newly introduced running race in Metylovice, which has already attracted two hundred runners. The course is beautiful and challenging, providing an interesting experience for participants. The race is part of the calendar of the Slezan Frýdek-Místek Physical Education Union, and its future in the schedule is being watched with anticipation.
course_highlights: Challenging course in Metylovice
Beautiful running environment
Race has already attracted two hundred runners
additional: Entry fee is 50 CZK for youth and 150 CZK for adults; the race takes place on a football field in Metylovice; facilities include changing rooms, showers, toilets, stadium amenities, a restaurant, and parking.

name: Vavřinecký běh Moravským krasem
location: Vavřinec, Moravský kras, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Vavřinec Run through Moravian Karst is a sporting event held in the village of Vavřinec in the South Moravian Region, which is part of the District Running League. The event takes place on August 22, 2026, and offers various running categories suitable for the general public. This event is an ideal opportunity for running enthusiasts who want to explore the beauty of Moravian Karst and enjoy a sporting experience in nature.
course_highlights: Held in the picturesque environment of Moravian Karst
Part of the District Running League
Various age categories and race lengths
additional: The race is suitable for all age groups, with participation available for a symbolic fee of 200 CZK for adults and 50 CZK for children. The event promotes an active lifestyle and the discovery of the natural beauty of the region.

name: IV Festiwal Pustelnika
organizer: Stowarzyszenie na rzecz rozwoju Wysowej-Zdroju „Przekrocz Granice”
description: The IV Hermit Festival is an annual sports and recreational event organized in the picturesque Wysowa-Zdrój by the Cross Borders Association. The festival combines sport, culture, and nature, offering participants the opportunity to take part in runs, marathons, as well as MTB and E-BIKE competitions. It is a unique chance to explore the charms of the Low Beskids, spend active time, and connect with the local community.
course_highlights: Running and cycling routes in the Low Beskids
Picturesque landscapes and natural surroundings of Wysowa-Zdrój
Combination of sport, culture, and regional history
additional: Participation in running and MTB/E-BIKE competitions is available. Contact with the organizer is available by phone from Monday to Saturday between 8:00 AM and 10:00 PM at +48 600 091 196. The events take place on mountain trails, with online registration, various distances for different skill levels, and options to participate in marathons, half-marathons, and shorter runs.

name: Gladbecker Sparkassenlauf
description: The Gladbeck Sparkassenlauf is a traditional running event welcoming runners of all ages. The event offers various distances from a mini marathon to a half marathon as well as a team relay. All courses are certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for best lists. Participants receive finisher medals and personalized bibs with their names, making the running experience special. There is also a district championship ranking and extensive award ceremonies.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses: 1.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Personalized bibs with first names for all participants
Live timing and net times for all races
additional: Finisher medals for all participants, personalized bibs with first names, live timing with net times, changing and shower facilities at the stadium, valuables can be handed in at storage stations, trophies and certificates for winners and age groups, team and club rankings, district championships with certificates and badges, no scoring for Bambinis and walking disciplines. Courses at Gladbeck stadium, online registration, late registration until 1 hour before start, medical support by the German Red Cross, various distances and categories

name: Rotherbaum 10K Hamburg - K Rotherbaum
description: The 10K Rotherbaum is an officially measured 10-kilometer race in Hamburg conducted according to international competition standards. The course is a loop, registered with the German Athletics Association and AIMS, ensuring that finish times are eligible for record lists. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers a cup ranking across all 10K Hamburg races with attractive prizes. Registration is exclusively online, and participants are advised to use public transportation for their arrival.
course_highlights: Officially measured 10 km loop course
Start and finish near the Hallerstraße subway station
Record-eligible finish times according to IWB and AIMS
additional: Clothing deposit for personal belongings available on event day. The cup ranking includes all 10K Hamburg events with points awarded to the 30 fastest men and women. Official registration confirmation will be sent via email after the registration deadline. Public transportation, especially to the Hallerstraße subway station, is recommended for travel. The race is part of the Hamburg 10K series, which includes various running events in Hamburg. Registration is possible online, and different categories are offered.

name: Der Alstertallauf
price_range: Halbmarathon: 40,00 € (Nachmeldungen 45,00 €), 10 km: 30,00 € (35,00 €), 4 km: 20,00 € (25,00 €), Kinder- und Schnupperläufe ab 10,00 €
description: The Alstertallauf is a family-friendly race on the upper Alster hiking trail, considered the most beautiful running route in Hamburg. It is aimed at both young and old running enthusiasts as well as recreational athletes and offers various distances. The event takes place near the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium in Hamburg and is known for its friendly atmosphere. In 2022, over 200 runners participated, with race distances ranging from 410 meters to 10 kilometers.
course_highlights: Run on the upper Alster hiking trail, regarded as Hamburg's most beautiful running route
Family-friendly race for all ages and performance levels
Various distances: 410 m, 1,500 m, 4 km, and 10 km
additional: Start location is the Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, Wellingsbütteler Landstraße 43, 22337 Hamburg, marked from U-Klein Borstel. The event includes multiple distances for different age groups and performance levels. Results and impressions from previous years are available online. The event is organized by Hamburger Turnerbund von 1862 e.V. Registration via www.davengo.com, start/finish at Albert-Schweitzer-Gymnasium, no parking available, public transportation recommended, changing rooms and showers on site.

name: Eschweiler Citylauf 2026
description: The Eschweiler City Run takes place on August 23, 2026, for the third time and is organized by the Marathon Club Eschweiler, which has been hosting a popular race in Eschweiler for the 40th time. The start and finish are located in Eschweiler city center on Marienstraße and Grabenstraße. The event offers school runs as well as two distances for adults: 5 kilometers and 10 kilometers, with the 10-kilometer race also counting as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. The City Run is part of the newly established Regio Aachen Running Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the city center.
course_highlights: Start and finish in Eschweiler city center (Marienstraße and Grabenstraße)
Distances: 5 km and 10 km with RAC scoring
Part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup
additional: Start and finish are on Marienstraße in Eschweiler city center. There are school runs and two distances for adults. The race is part of the Regio Aachen Running Cup. The 10 km course is also counted as the LVN-Nordrhein Championships. Various activities, children's program, on-site and online registration, different race distances.

name: Gettorfer Staffelmarathon
description: The Gettorf Relay Marathon is a team marathon taking place on August 23, 2026, at Sportpark Gettorf. The course consists of a roughly 4.2 km loop, which is run ten times. Teams consist of 5 to 10 people who pass the chip-timed baton in the exchange zone. Alternatively, the duo marathon can be completed by two people who share the ten laps freely. Timing is done electronically via transponders and shoe chips, and intermediate times are recorded for each runner.
course_highlights: Loop course of approximately 4.2 km at Sportpark Gettorf
Ten laps per team or duo
Electronic timing with baton transponder and shoe chip
additional: The deadline for both competitions is 4:45 PM. Each person may run a maximum of two laps. Team re-registration (change of team members) is possible online until the registration deadline. Bib numbers are mandatory and provided by the organizer. Online registration is available, with early bird discounts, supported by local partners such as AOK NordWest, Zippel’s Läuferwelt, Förde Sparkasse, EGE.

name: FlorSTADT Halbmarathon 2026
description: The FlorSTADT Half Marathon is a popular race in Florstadt, Hesse, taking place on August 23, 2026, for the 11th time. The event offers not only the half marathon but also additional runs over 10 km, 5 km, 1.8 km, and 300 m, allowing the whole family to participate. The course runs through the beautiful forest and is secured, with plenty of water stations and medical support. The race is part of the Main-Kinzig Challenge and is an excellent preparation for the Frankfurt Marathon. Food and drinks are provided, and a personal certificate is available for download.
course_highlights: Hesse's most beautiful forest half marathon
Plenty of water stations along the course
Secured course with medical support
additional: Moderation by Runningvoices, free download of photos, organic fruit at the finish, warm-up with Smarttraining Ortenberg, playground right at the start/finish area, event for the whole family, personal certificate for download, support by the Gadde crew. The event is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge, offers electronic timing, medical support, and photo service. The weather in August is typically warm around 25°C.

name: Bielebohlauf
description: The Bielebohlauf Oppach is a running event in the Lusatian Mountains offering various distances from 400 meters to 20 kilometers. The runs take place on forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads around Bieleboh. The longer routes are challenging and include steep inclines. There are special Bambini and children's runs for kids. The Oppach stadium provides catering and entertainment, and finishers receive certificates and clips online.
course_highlights: Routes through the landscape of the Lusatian Mountains around Bieleboh
Forest, meadow, and field paths as well as small roads
Challenging longer routes with steep inclines
additional: Registration on site possible with a 5€ late registration fee. Dogs are allowed on the walking route; leash and muzzle are mandatory in the stadium. Trophies and gifts for course winners from 4.9 km and age group winners. Age-appropriate gifts for winners of the 1.5 km route. Results, finisher clips, and certificates are available online immediately after the race. Food, drinks, and entertainment are provided in the stadium. Routes with inclines, dogs allowed on walking route, food and drinks available.

name: Breitunger Pleßlauf

The event is organized by SV Lauftreff Breitungen e.V. and starts and ends at the sports hall on Riegelsweg. The races feature varied routes suitable for both children and experienced runners. In addition to the sporting challenge, there is timing with a disposable chip, trophies and material prizes for the fastest participants, as well as finisher medals for the main distances.

Nordic Walking over 10.7 km
Start and finish at the sports hall on Riegelsweg in Breitungen

Timing is done with a disposable chip from GO timing. Race documents can be picked up on August 22, 2026, from 12:00 to 15:30 and on the event day from 07:00 at the sports hall. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the sports hall. Trophies are awarded to the three fastest finishers in the main distances, along with material and monetary prizes for the winners. All finishers of the main distances receive a medal with laser engraving. Course profiles, mountain running, online registration, results, photos, videos, dates in 2024-2026.

name: ews Volks- und Spendenlauf
description: The 14th ews Volks- und Spendenlauf takes place across Bad Segeberg, passing scenic locations such as Kalkberg and Lake Segeberg. Since 2011, the race has been a fixed part of the city's sports program, combining athletic performance with the enjoyment of shared activity and charitable engagement. The event annually supports selected projects, with donations in 2026 distributed among three projects. The race is a community event that unites movement and social commitment.
course_highlights: Across Bad Segeberg
Past Kalkberg
Along Lake Segeberg
additional: Team registrations are only possible via a paper form, which must be sent by email to info@volkslauf-bad-segeberg.de by October 2, 2023. Bib number distribution will take place on August 23, 2026, at the registration office. Registration is done online with a consent to liability waiver and data protection. The focus is on fun in movement and charitable engagement. Run across Bad Segeberg, including walking and Nordic walking, donations for local projects, registration until June 2026, team and individual starts possible.

name: RAG Hartfüssler Trail
location: Förderschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The Hartfüssler Trail on August 23, 2026, in Saarbrücken offers challenging trail running routes through diverse natural and cultural landscapes. The 58 km ultratrail course leads over abandoned forest paths, historic mining facilities, and the wild-romantic Netzbachtal with geological features. The highlight is the ascent to the Halde Grühlingstraße with a literary granite staircase path and an impressive view over the entire trail. Start and finish are located on the schoolyard of the Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken, embedded in a listed mining ensemble.
course_highlights: Abandoned forest paths and crossing under the highway at the Saarbahn tracks
Wild-romantic Netzbachtal with geological features (Holzer conglomerate)
Ascent to Halde Grühlingstraße with granite steps and panoramic view
additional: Start and finish are on the schoolyard of the Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken in the Grubensiedlung Von der Heydt, accessible by Saarbahn (stop Heinrichshaus) or car. There are cutoff times at aid stations (Göttelborn km 30.8 at 12:30 PM, Halde Grühlingstraße km 53.1 at 5:00 PM) with a time limit of 10 hours. Aid stations, medical support, timing, and personalized bibs are included. Dogs are not allowed, poles are permitted. Fair cancellation policies and CO2 compensation for travel are offered. Trail races of 30 km and 58 km, scenic forest and historic mining sites, cutoff time 10 hours, start/finish at Fördersschule soziale Entwicklung Saarbrücken.

name: TuS Hiltrup Halbmarathon
location: Stadion am Osttor, Münster, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TuS Hiltrup Half Marathon is an established running event in Münster with start and finish at the Stadion am Osttor. The course runs in a loop within the stadium, along the canal promenade, and through the Hiltrup residential area, offering a varied and attractive running environment. In addition to the classic half marathon, there is also a relay race, which is particularly interesting for teams. The event is open to runners born in 2008 (individual start) and 2010 (relay) and offers a family-friendly atmosphere within a large sports club.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Stadion am Osttor
Run along the canal promenade with views of the canal
Course through the Hiltrup residential area with varied terrain
additional: Individual entries for the half marathon are fully booked, only relay spots are still available. The cut-off time is 12:00 PM, after 3 hours of competition. The course is barrier-free, and detailed information about the route and traffic regulations on race day is available for residents. The course is measured, start at Stadion am Osttor, individual and relay races, registration online, start times at 9:00 and 9:05 AM, cut-off after 3 hours.

Each successful participation is rewarded with a stamp, and avid runners can earn attractive prizes in gold, silver, or bronze. Participation is directly at the individual races, which take place at many beautiful locations with different activity options. Additionally, there is a Running Pass app with an event calendar and a digital running journal.

Collect stamps at a total of 43 running events in 2026
Exclusive prizes for avid runners in gold, silver, and bronze
additional: The Running Pass is available both in a traditional fold-out format and digitally via the Running Pass app. The app offers an event calendar as well as a digital running journal. Participation is directly at the individual races, which are spread throughout the year. Participation within the Running Pass series involves collecting stamps, available both digitally and in print, and is part of the largest running series in Germany.

name: H Lauf 2026
description: The 10-hour run in Hanau is a charity event held on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School. The event starts at 9:00 AM and runs until 7:00 PM, with participants running for a good cause. The run offers a special opportunity to experience endurance and community while supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Run on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School Hanau
Endurance run lasting 10 hours from 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM
Event for a good cause
additional: The run takes place on the grounds of the Paul-Gerhardt School Hanau. There is a program and a flyer available for download as a PDF. The event is a social initiative where donations are collected. The run is held on the school grounds with a duration of 10 hours, ideal for those who want to challenge their endurance.

name: Die Generalprobe
description: The General Rehearsal is an urban road race in Berlin, serving as the perfect preparation for the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON. On August 23, 2026, runners can test their form on a super-flat loop course through the Berlin districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf. The event offers a quarter marathon, a half marathon, as well as races for children and youth. The event is characterized by a lively atmosphere and a personal medal for all finishers.
course_highlights: Super-flat loop course through the Berlin neighborhoods of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf
Two race distances: quarter marathon (10.5 km) and half marathon (21 km)
Course passes through typical Berlin residential districts with urban flair
additional: Timing is done with MIKA TAG transponder, attached to the back of the bib, which does not need to be returned. The Kids & Youth races start at 08:15 AM with distances from 200 m to 800 m; late registrations are possible on the event day. The start and finish for the main races are at Schlossstraße, Berlin-Steglitz. The participation limit is 4,000 runners. The course runs through the districts of Steglitz, Wilmersdorf, and Zehlendorf; medals for all finishers; results and certificate downloads; age group winners receive a free start for the following year.

name: Slopenská desítka
location: Slopné, Luhačovice, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic

description: Slopenská desítka is a traditional cross-country running race held in the picturesque village of Slopné near Luhačovice. The race offers a challenging course with a varied profile, including asphalt roads, steep climbs, and descents through forest terrain. The start is located under the church and the finish line is at the sports field, where spectators cheer enthusiastically. The event is suitable for the general public, including junior categories and family relays. The race is part of the year-round competitions Běhy Zlín and the Czech Cup in uphill running KRAKONOŠ.
course_highlights: Start on an asphalt road under the church with ample space for runners
Long ascent of 1500 m on asphalt and steep climb through the forest up to 2.5 km
Last three kilometers are downhill only, with a flat finish at the sports field
additional: The family relay consists of three members running in three sections, with members being relatives and a minimum age difference of 18 years between two members. Registration closes 5 minutes before the start of the category. The overall winner receives a monetary reward for each second under the set time. The main race starts approximately 100 m from the sports field on an asphalt road under the church. The race is part of the local sports calendar, offering family relays and prizes in various categories.

name: Běžím Krušnohořím Stříbrná

description: Running in the Ore Mountains is a running and canicross series that takes you through the beautiful Ore Mountains. The series includes 6 races in various destinations, including Stříbrná, where the main race is held over 6 to 9 km and an experiential route of 20 to 30 km. In addition to the main races, there are also children's races and walking routes with point finding according to a map. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, canicrossers, children, and walkers, and offers a beautiful natural environment of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Main race 6 - 9 km in the nature of the Ore Mountains
Experiential route 20 - 30 km according to the map
Children's races from 200 m to 1,100 m
additional: The series includes 6 races in different locations of the Ore Mountains. description: Run for Střížák is a traditional race held on Střížovický Hill in Ústí nad Labem, now in its 16th edition. The course consists of a loop run three times, with one significant ascent and descent, otherwise it is gently undulating. The race also includes shorter children's and pupils' runs, allowing broad public participation. The race has an interesting story because the course passes through an area that was previously threatened by planned construction, which was canceled due to residents' opposition.
course_highlights: Loop run three times
One noticeable ascent (220 m, elevation gain 25 m)
Gently undulating terrain with one descent of about 20 m over a 400 m segment
additional: Shorter children's (700 m) and pupils' (2.7 km) runs are available. The course passes through an area that was previously threatened by planned construction of a cooled hall for year-round downhill skiing, which was canceled due to residents' opposition. The race includes a raffle, refreshments, and is part of the local cross-country cup, with participation options for children and youth.

name: 7. PKO Tarnogórski Półmaraton oraz Tarnogórska Srebrna Dyszka

Participants will have access to nutrition and refreshment points, and the time limit to complete the half marathon has been extended to 3 hours, allowing everyone to cross the finish line with a smile and earn a medal. The Silver Ten is approximately 10.5 km long, complementing the event's running offer.

Nutrition and refreshment points along the half marathon and Silver Ten routes
Partially closed traffic on the route

name: IV BIEG PEŁNEJ MISKI
description: The Full Bowl Run is a charity running event organized in Szubin, aimed at supporting animal shelters through the "Full Bowl" campaign. The race has been held annually since 2023, with the next edition scheduled for August 23, 2026. The event combines athletic competition with the idea of helping homeless animals, engaging the local community and running enthusiasts. Organizers encourage participation and joint action for animals.

Virtual race with the option to participate anywhere

The route most likely passes through rural and natural areas, providing attractive conditions for running.

Natural environment in Prague 9

Registration until July 30, 2026, finisher shirts for an extra fee, team rankings, results available at Race Result.

name: 4. S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz"
description: The 4th S-RUN Sparkassenlauf "Rund um das Dünkreuz" is a nature-oriented community run in Eichsfeld that appeals to runners of all ages and fitness levels. The varied courses lead through breathtaking natural landscapes around the Dünkreuz and offer exciting challenges for both experienced runners and beginners. In addition to the sporting competition, the sense of community is at the forefront, supported by an attractive accompanying program at the sports field. The run is part of the Eichsfeldcup and is organized by SG Birkungen 07.
course_highlights: Nature-oriented courses around the Dünkreuz
Diverse competitions for young and old (400 m to 10 km)
Part of the renowned Eichsfeldcup
additional: There are 4 courses with 5 competitions: Bambini-Run (400 m), Youngster-Run (1.5 km), 6-K-Run (6 km run/nordic walking), and 10-K-Run (10 km run). The event promotes community spirit and offers an accompanying program at the sports field. Results from previous years are available at my.raceresult.com. Forest paths, fields, elevation gain, Nordic walking, course signage, medical services, transponder timing, community program.

name: Kácovský běh
location: Náměstí kněžny Toskánské, Kácov, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kácov Run is a traditional running race held on the last Saturday of August in the picturesque Posázaví region. It offers three main routes - Nineteen, Ten, and Loop - with varied terrain and elevation gain, challenging both experienced runners and beginners. The start and finish are located in the center of Kácov, with refreshment stations on the longer routes. The race is timed with chip timing and accompanied by a rich program including children's races and a raffle.
course_highlights: Nineteen: 18.8 km with an elevation gain of 380 m, mixed surfaces including forest paths and asphalt
Ten: 10.4 km with an elevation gain of 160 m, similarly varied terrain as Nineteen
Loop: 2.9 km with an elevation gain of 20 m, suitable for children and beginners
additional: The race is timed with chip timing with instructions for proper chip placement. Refreshment stations are available on the Nineteen and Ten routes both on the course and at the finish. For permanent residents of Kácov, a bonus competition for the fastest local runner is prepared. Children's races have voluntary entry fees and are divided by age. The race includes various categories, with surfaces combining road and trail. Registration is possible online and on-site, and the event is supported by local tourism.

name: Cross Parkmaraton
location: Krásná Lípa, Česká Švýcarsko, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross Parkmarathon in Krásná Lípa is a traditional race set in the picturesque environment of the Czech Switzerland National Park. It takes place on hilly terrain mainly along forest paths with beautiful views of the Lusatian Mountains. The event offers various disciplines including marathon, half marathon, shorter runs, Nordic walking, canicross, and relay races. The event is suitable for the general public and running enthusiasts of all ages. In 2019, it received the Czech-Saxon Switzerland Regional Product certificate as a certified experience.
course_highlights: Hilly terrain mainly along forest paths
Picturesque landscape of the Czech Switzerland National Park
Views of the Lusatian Mountains
additional: Start times: Canicross and marathon at 8:00 AM, other races at 10:00 AM. Relays are teams of 4 members, each runner runs approximately 5 km. Each team arranges transportation for relay handovers themselves. Categories are announced based on age and gender. The time limit for completing the marathon is until 3:00 PM. Participants who do not finish within the marathon limit can switch to the half marathon. The registration fee includes a start number. The race is part of the Czech Switzerland Day, attracting regional and international runners, with refreshment stations along the route and support from local sponsors and artisans.

description: The Chomutov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in the picturesque city of Chomutov in the Ústí Region. The race offers a fast and attractive route through the historic city center, around the unique Kamencové Lake, and through beautiful natural areas such as Bezručovo Valley. The event also includes children's categories and relays, making it suitable for a wide range of runners. Participants in the main race can look forward to refreshments on the course and at the finish line, as well as a finisher medal.
course_highlights: Historic city center with the Town Tower and diverse architecture
World-unique Kamencové Lake and extensive recreational area
Romantic Bezručovo Valley with the Chomutovka River
additional: Registration for adults and the Kamencové Circuit is conducted online from 8:00 to 10:30 AM, children up to 15 years old can register on-site from 11:00 AM to 1:30 PM. The registration fee includes refreshments on the course and at the finish line (fruit, water, isotonic drink) and a finisher medal. When registering online and paying in advance, participants receive free headbands and have the option to purchase T-shirts with headbands. The children's race starts at 2:00 PM. The organizer reserves the right to change the schedule of individual runs. The terrain is a trail course, with online and on-site registration, refreshments at the finish and on the course, medals, T-shirts, and headbands available free of charge with registration.

name: Běhej lesy Jizerská
location: Bedřichov, Jizerské hory, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Forests Jizerská is a trail race held on August 29, 2026, in the picturesque environment of the Jizerské Mountains in Bedřichov. It offers various routes including short, long, and ultramarathon distances, which pass through beautiful natural locations such as Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora. The race is part of the Run Forests series and is included in the UTMB Index Races, ensuring international point scoring. For competitors, there are also the Conti Speed Section and Generali Investments Finish, which bring additional competitive elements and rewards.
course_highlights: Routes pass through Hřebínek, Smědava, Jizerka, and Olivetská hora
Conti Speed Section - a 150-meter speed segment on the Nova 11 km and ČSOB 23 km routes
Generali Investments Finish - a 500m straight finish with measured segment and rewards for the fastest men and women
additional: The race is part of the UTMB Index Races with international point scoring. The Conti Speed Section is a speed segment with a prize worth 5000 CZK. The Generali Investments Finish is a 500m measured straight finish with special jerseys for winners. There is an option for online and on-site registration and change of entry fee. The race includes a charitable component, offers fast and scenic routes in the Jizerské Mountains, and starts at the ski stadium in Bedřichov.

name: Mizuno Neon Run Praha
description: Mizuno Neon Run Prague is a night running event full of glowing neon lights and colorful zones, offering a unique experience rather than a speed competition. The run takes place in Bohnice, and participants receive a starter pack with a neon light baton and a beautiful Unicorn medal at the finish line. The event is under the auspices of the mayor of Prague 6 and the proceeds from registrations are donated to non-profit organizations. After the race, there is an after-party with DJ René, which enhances the overall atmosphere of the evening.
course_highlights: Night run with neon lights and colorful zones
Start and finish in Prague 8 - Bohnice
Bright neon experience with a neon light baton in the starter pack
additional: The race is divided into waves for 5 km run and walk, including a charity 2 km Fénix Run. After the race, there is an after-party NEON NIGHT RUN with DJ René. Option to purchase the SUPER package for 300 CZK until 20.08.2026. The starter pack includes a neon light baton. Registration and check-in are from 17:00 to 20:00, with baggage storage open until 21:45. Neon batons, medals, evening festive atmosphere, online and on-site registration, support for charity projects FénixRun.

name: Proběhni si Zoo Ústí nad Labem
location: Zoo Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Run through Ústí nad Labem Zoo is a running event held in the premises of the zoo in Ústí nad Labem. The run offers a unique opportunity to combine sports activity with a visit to the zoo and observing animals in their natural environment. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes active leisure time in nature. We look forward to your participation and shared experiences in the beautiful zoo environment.
course_highlights: Run in the zoo premises with a view of the animals
The route passes through diverse terrain of the zoo with natural scenery
Opportunity to combine athletic performance with a family visit to the zoo
additional: The zoo is open 365 days a year, admission is charged according to standard zoo rates. Discounts are available for visitors with disabilities. The event is part of the zoo's event calendar, which may be updated throughout the year. The event is primarily aimed at supporting animal protection and conservation, with an emphasis on ecological education and community engagement.

description: UKIEL Sunset Run Olsztyn 2026 is an evening street run scheduled for August 29, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km or 10 km distance, running through the center of Olsztyn with scenic views of the Old Town and CRS Ukiel beach. The route is certified by PZLA, and the finish line is located on the beach, where a finisher zone with musical and lighting effects awaits. It is an excellent opportunity to combine athletic competition with the atmosphere of a city event.
course_highlights: The 10 km route passes through the Grunwaldzka district, downtown, and the Old Town area with views of the Town Hall and High Gate
Start and finish at CRS Ukiel beach with musical and lighting effects
The route is certified by PZLA with markers every 1 km and two refreshment zones
additional: Race kits can be collected on August 28, 2026 (16:00 - 20:00) and August 29, 2026 (9:00 - 15:00) at the race office at CRS Ukiel. It is possible for an authorized person to pick up the kit with an ID. No registration on race day. The 5 km race starts at 18:00, and the 10 km race at 19:00. There is a one-hour break between starts for rest and recovery in the athlete zone. A 10% discount is available when registering for both races in one order. The routes close at 18:45 (5 km) and 20:15 (10 km). The event includes evening runs of 5 km and 10 km, with early registration and discounts available until the end of April 2026, as well as children's races. The routes are designed with participant safety and comfort in mind.

location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Kurierów Sądeckich Run is a historic mountain race held in the Sądecki Beskid Mountains, on the route from Rytro to the PTTK shelter on Przehyba. The route is marked and leads through various surfaces: 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, and 80% forest trails, offering participants contact with nature and challenging terrain. The race commemorates couriers from World War II, and the course record is just under an hour. The organizer provides timing measurement, medical security, a commemorative medal, and a hot meal after the race.
course_highlights: Marked route, 15% asphalt, 5% gravel roads, 80% forest trails
Start at the PKP railway station in Rytro, finish at the PTTK shelter on Przehyba
Historical character of the route related to AK couriers from World War II
additional: Race office open on 30.08.2025 from 08:00 to 09:45. Participants receive a clothing bag for storage, which will be transported to the finish. After the race, vouchers for a hot meal and tea are available. Electronic timing measurement and manual recording. Medical security during the race. A special prize of 500 PLN for breaking Andrzej Długosz's course record (00:57:58). The race includes asphalt, gravel, and forest sections, with electronic timing, medals, start number, and drinks for participants. Registration is available online, and the event is part of the local sports tradition.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa

description: Gliwice Park Run Provocation is a series of 12 running and Nordic Walking events organized in Gliwice in 2026, held once a month on Saturdays in the Park behind Piast Stadium. The route is 4219.5 meters long and mainly runs through forest paths, gravel roads, and partially asphalt, with a refreshment point at the start/finish line. The event aims to promote healthy and active outdoor recreation under the slogan "Let yourself be provoked to fight laziness!".
course_highlights: Route length of 4219.5 meters through forest paths, gravel roads, and asphalt
Refreshment point with drinks at the start/finish line available after each lap
The race takes place in the municipal forest in Gliwice, near Piast Stadium
additional: The events are held on Saturdays once a month in 2026. The race starts at 10:00 AM, Nordic Walking at 10:03 AM. The route is not closed to pedestrian traffic. The race office is open from 9:00 AM at the clearing near Piast Stadium. Online registration is available year-round, and registration can also be done at the race office on the event day. Participation of wheelchair users is not permitted due to terrain conditions. Start and race office are located at the clearing behind Piast Stadium, with regulations and archival photos available on the website.

description: Kunicki Reggae Run is a nationwide sporting event held by the picturesque Kunickie Lake in Kunice. Participants can choose from three certified running routes: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The start and finish are located in front of GOKiS in Kunice at 11 Słoneczna Street. The event combines athletic competition with a friendly atmosphere and reggae music, attracting an increasing number of participants from all over Poland.
course_highlights: Running routes by the scenic Kunickie Lake
Certificates from the Polish Athletics Association for all distances
Start and finish in front of GOKiS in Kunice, 11 Słoneczna Street
additional: Start package for each participant, commemorative medal for completing the distance, material prizes for category winners, time measurement provided by DataSport, post-race recovery meal. The event accompanies the Reggae Festival by the Lake, and participants can expect organizer support and musical attractions.

name: Mały Wielki Bieg
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji Gminy Pruszcz Gdański
description: Mały Wielki Bieg is the largest race in the Pruszcz Gdański municipality, returning to Straszyn after a one-year break. The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Center of the Pruszcz Gdański Municipality, which promotes sports and recreation among residents. The event takes place on August 29, 2026, and is an important sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through the picturesque Radunia Valley and green surroundings
Distances from 5 km to 36 km, including races for children and adults
Attractions and fitness challenges for participants
additional: trail runs, online registration via electronic sign-ups, participant limit of 550, terrain: Pruszcz Gdański municipality

name: NorDan RUN
price_range: 75 zł - 155 zł depending on distance and registration date
description: NorDan RUN is a race held in the picturesque town of Wolsztyn, with routes leading through city park paths along Lake Wolsztyn. Participants can choose from several distances, from shorter runs for children to challenging routes of 48 km with control and nutrition points. The start and finish are located at the "Fala Park" facility, ensuring comfortable organization and beautiful views. The race is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors in nature.
course_highlights: Routes run through city park paths in Wolsztyn
View of Lake Wolsztyn and the UMKS ZRYW kayak marina
Control and nutrition points on routes of 10 km, 24 km, and 48 km
additional: Start and finish at the "Fala Park" facility, ul. Poznańska 1, 64-200 Wolsztyn. Routes have control and nutrition points with time limits on longer distances (24 km and 48 km). No time limit at the control point on the 10 km distance. Children's runs have shorter distances from 300 m to 900 m with start times from 13:00 to 14:30. The event takes place in Wolsztyn, with online registration available, an annual edition, and various distance options.

name: Tatraman
location: Łapsze Niżne, Nowy Targ County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Tatraman is a challenging triathlon race on the half Ironman distance, held in the picturesque terrains of Polish and Slovak Spisz and the Tatra Mountains. The course starts from Niedzica at Lake Czorsztyn, passing through mountainous areas, all the way to the summit of Kasprowy Wierch. The event is mainly aimed at experienced athletes, but amateurs can also test their skills on this extreme route. Tatraman combines athletic competition with beautiful views and Highlander hospitality.
course_highlights: Swim 2 km in Lake Czorsztyn with mandatory neoprene wetsuits
Ride 90 km on mountainous roads of Polish and Slovak Spisz with an elevation gain of about 1400 m
Run 21.1 km with finish at Kasprowy Wierch, passing through mountain trails
additional: The race office is located at the 'Polana Sosny' Camping in Niedzica and is open on August 28, 2026 from 16:00 to 21:00. The race starts at the Water Marina in Niedzica-Zamek, and the finish line is at Kasprowy Wierch. The event is held in a non-drafting format, with road and triathlon bikes allowed. The time limit for swimming is 60 minutes, and for cycling until 14:00. Transportation for athletes and accompanying persons is provided, along with recovery meals and an afterparty. Triathlon, mountain route, half Ironman distance, from Niedzica to Kasprowy Wierch.

name: VIII Dycha nad Wisłą
description: The 8th Wisła Ten-Kilometer Run is an annual street race held in Tczew, part of the 9th Kociewie Running Grand Prix. The event attracts runners from various regions, offering a scenic route along the Vistula River. The event has a sports and recreational character, promoting physical activity and community integration.
course_highlights: The race route runs through scenic streets of Tczew along the Vistula River
Flat course profile conducive to fast times
Organized as part of the Kociewie Running Grand Prix
additional: Registration is open, limited to 300 participants, start packages with T-shirts, attractions and prizes, area by the Vistula River, various registration options
