description: The 16th Baltic Sea Coast Marathon is an annual running event held in the picturesque towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. Participants can choose between the marathon and half-marathon distances, which run along the coast, offering stunning views and a unique atmosphere. The event attracts runners of various age groups, including the K60+ and M65+ categories. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring a intimate and friendly environment.
course_highlights: The route runs along the Baltic Sea coast
Scenic views of the sea and seaside towns Jastarnia and Władysławowo
Available distances: marathon (42 km) and half-marathon (21 km)
additional: The participant limit is 250 people. The K60+ and M65+ age categories have reduced entry fees. Registration is open from March 16 to August 26, 2026. The fee on the event day is higher. Start and finish in the seaside towns of Jastarnia and Władysławowo. The participant limit is 250 people, registration is open from March 16, 2026, with information on dates and fees.

name: 22. Eilenriederennen Hannover
location: Eilenriede Park, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Eilenriederennen Hannover is an established summer running event that takes place through the green lung of the state capital Lower Saxony. The popular race is offered in three different distances: 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The course is officially measured, mostly asphalted, and nearly flat, allowing for fast times. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere with musical entertainment in the beer garden and is part of the Sparkassen-Laufpass series of the Hanover region.
course_highlights: 100% asphalted course except for a small U-turn on unpaved paths at the 5 km distance
Loop course to the forest station and back to the zoo and Lister Tower
Course is flat and officially measured except for crossing the Messe Schnellweg
additional: Number bib distribution on the day before (29.08.2026) from 15:00 to 17:00 at the Lister Tower beer garden is recommended to avoid delays. Late registrations are possible online until 29.08.2026 14:30 and on-site without surcharge, provided the race is not fully booked. Refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, and 10 with water, isotonic drinks, and energy gels; at the finish line with watermelons and drinks. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the start number. The event location is the district center Lister Tower, Walderseestr. 100, Hannover. Recommended travel by bicycle or public transport (city train lines 3, 7, 9, stop Lortzingstraße). The course is officially measured, with refreshment points at km 3, 5, 7, 10, and at the finish; registration online or on-site; bib distribution at the Lister Tower beer garden; the event takes place in summer.

name: 23. Windmühlenberglauf
location: Bezirkssportanlage am Windmühlenberg, Fallersleben, Wolfsburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 23rd Windmühlenberglauf will take place on August 30, 2026, in Fallersleben (Wolfsburg) at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg. The event is organized by VfB Fallersleben and offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to participate in a traditional race. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Windmühlenberg and promises a varied running experience. Registration is open until August 25, 2026.
course_highlights: Run at the district sports facility on Windmühlenberg
Scenic course in Fallersleben
Traditional race with different age and performance categories
additional: Registration deadline is August 25, 2026; the event offers various race distances and promotes community and sporting exchange.

name: 30. Lauf um den Arendsee
description: The 30th Run around Lake Arendsee (LUDA) takes place on August 30, 2026, at the Arendsee Beach. The event is a jubilee edition and offers runners from the region and beyond a sporting backdrop in nature. In addition to the run, there is a small party on the eve to celebrate sports and community together. The organization by Kersten Friedrich Events guarantees a professional execution with regional connection.
course_highlights: Event location at Arendsee Beach
Run through the natural landscape of the Altmark region
Jubilee event with a party on the eve
additional: Registration for the run opens on December 1, 2025. The event is part of a day with four events on August 30, 2026, in Arendsee. There is a small party on August 29, 2026, at Arendsee Beach. Event photos will be provided. The organizing team donates €1 per participant to Special Olympics Saxony-Anhalt e.V. Registration has been open since December 1, 2025; the event includes multiple competitions and a party the day before; suitable also for marathon preparation.

name: 45. Königseer Stadtwaldlauf
location: Oberhain bei Königsee, Landkreis Saalfeld-Rudolstadt, Thüringen, Germany
description: The Königseer Stadtwaldlauf is a traditional running event in Oberhain near Königsee, held annually. The event offers runners of various performance levels an attractive course through the city forest with diverse terrain. The family-friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings make the race a special experience for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque city forest of Königsee
Varied terrain with forest paths and nature trails
Family-friendly event with different distances
additional: Competitions for children, adolescents, active runners, and masters; registration until August 28, 2026; typical August weather around 25°C, please check details with the organizer before registering.

name: 6-Stunden-Sparkassenlauf
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal-Fleestedt, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course mainly runs on paved surfaces and partly on grass, and is well visible from the start/finish area, creating excitement for spectators. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with the marathon (42.2 km) receiving its own classification. The race is open to runners born from 2008 onwards, and the relay race is also available for youth born from 2014. For younger participants, there is a 5,000-meter run and the opportunity to earn the DLV running badge.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop at Seevetal Sports Center
Course mainly paved, partly grass
Start/finish area well visible for spectators
additional: Marathon distance requires 35 laps. Team classification sums all kilometers, relay classification involves exchanges. Participation is open from 2008 birth year, relay from 2014. Youth 5,000m run for birth years 2009-2014. Children born between 2015-2020 can earn the DLV running badge. The event starts at 10:00 AM, with a duration of six hours, during which participants aim to complete as many laps as possible. Breaks are allowed, and the event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories and children's activities.

name: Blankeneser Heldenlauf
description: The Blankeneser Heroes Run on August 30, 2026 offers five varied courses with different distances and profiles, appealing to both beginners and experienced runners. The races lead through the picturesque Blankeneser Staircase District, along the Elbe River, and through diverse parks and residential areas. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the unique combination of urban and natural running enjoyment. Participants can expect a finisher medal and a lively award ceremony at the finish line.
course_highlights: Courses run along the scenic Elbe waterfront and through the Blankeneser Staircase District
Varied profiles from flat to challenging with climbs such as the Polterberg
Finish at the Blankeneser Weekly Market Square with a finisher medal
additional: Start is at Strandweg / corner Mühlenberg, about a 15-minute walk from the event site. Bag drop-off from 8 a.m. at the event location. Official registration deadline is August 19, 2026, with online late registration and increased entry fee available until August 29, 2026. Finisher medals are included in the registration fee. Results and certificates will be provided online. Photos can be purchased after the event through a photography partner. Various course profiles and distances, including medal distribution and award ceremony; registration, late registration, and travel by public transport are possible.

name: Grafschaftslauf
location: Gut Rietberg, Rietberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Grafschaft Run connects the historic towns of Rietberg, Verl, and Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock and offers runners a varied course rich in history and atmosphere. The race starts at Gut Rietberg, passing historic buildings and through the city center, continuing along the Ems River to the Gartenschau grounds. The route leads through atmospheric locations with multiple exchange points for relay runners and ends in the Holter Forest at the Hunting Lodge to Holte, which provides an impressive backdrop for the finish line. The race is characterized by diverse scenic paths, enthusiastic spectators, and a special connection between sport and regional history.
course_highlights: Start at Gut Rietberg with historic castle ambiance
Atmospheric spots in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz with relay exchanges
Finish through the peaceful Holter Forest to the Hunting Lodge to Holte
additional: The relay race is organized as a 3-person team over 28.5 km with two exchange points in Westerwiehe and Kaunitz. The course passes through historic town centers, along the Ems River, through the Gartenschau park, and ends at the castle in Schloß Holte-Stukenbrock. There is also a 10 km run and walking options. The event emphasizes a lively atmosphere with multiple spectator points and musical accompaniment. Races include: 28 km individual run, relay race, 10 km run, walking; registration opens on 01.01.2026; motto: Experience history actively.

name: Altra Sunset Wattenmeer
price_range: 1.100,00 Euro bis 1.500,00 Euro für Teams, je nach Anmeldedatum
description: The Altra Sunset Wadden Sea is a unique team relay race taking place on August 29 and 30, 2026. The course covers approximately 250 kilometers through the stunning natural landscape along the Elbe River and the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park. The race starts in Hamburg at St. Pauli Hafenstraße and finishes in St. Peter-Ording in the Bad district. Teams consist of 5 or 10 runners, each taking on multiple segments, making the race a special community experience.
course_highlights: Approximately 250 kilometers through the UNESCO World Natural Heritage Site Wadden Sea National Park
Start in Hamburg, finish in St. Peter-Ording, Bad district
Natural experience along the Elbe with breathtaking landscapes
additional: The start times of the teams will be assigned after registration closes based on the reported average pace. The digital map material will be provided to the teams a few weeks before the event. Team vehicles must be organized independently (10-person teams require 2 vans, 5-person teams 1 van). Participants born from 2010 onwards are eligible, for ultra teams from 2008. There are team categories by gender and mixed teams. Registration is managed by a team captain who oversees team members. The race includes 30 stages, night and day runs, navigation with map material, starting in Hamburg and ending in St. Peter-Ording. Participation is open to teams from multiple countries, with variable weather and sporting challenge.

name: Binger Stadtlauf
organizer: Stadt Bingen am Rhein, Leichtathletik-Club Bingen
price_range: Schüler 5,00 Euro, Erwachsene 13,00 Euro, Staffeln 22,00 Euro, Binger Starter kostenfrei

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Meldegebühr Staffeln nicht aus der Stadt Bingen

description: The Bingen City Run is a traditional running event in Bingen am Rhein that appeals to runners of all ages. Offered are competitions over 10 km and 5 km, which are measured courses certified by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The event takes place as part of the Bingen Winzerfest and attracts many spectators who enthusiastically watch the races and relays. In addition to the main races, there are also school and relay races, ensuring a diverse field of participants.
course_highlights: DLV-certified courses over 10,000 m and 5,000 m
Start and finish in Gerbhausstraße
Relay races with 5 x approx. 700 m laps
additional: Relay races are open to clubs, schools, and groups with 3 men / 2 women or 3 women / 2 men. All finishers receive medals, and the overall winners receive the Bingen city coin. The fastest relay team wins a traveling trophy. Changing rooms are available at the Kulturzentrum am Freidhof. The time limit for the main races is 75 minutes. Online registration is open until August 27, 2025; registration on the day is possible for a fee. Start and finish are in Gerbhausstraße, beginning at 11:00 AM. The courses vary in length and difficulty.

name: Bottroper Ultralauf Festival (BUF)
description: The Bottrop Ultra Running Festival 2026 takes place on August 30 and 31 at Batenbrockpark in Bottrop and offers an unforgettable running experience for ultra runners. In addition to the proven 6- and 24-hour runs, the Hilltop Backyard is also a special highlight. The festival is characterized by a great community, exciting challenges, and a unique festival atmosphere, which is shaped by hourly restarts and parallel competitions.
course_highlights: 6- and 24-hour runs at Batenbrockpark
Hilltop Backyard as a special highlight
Hourly restarts and parallel competitions
additional: The festival features hourly restarts, a parallel competition, and a simultaneous hiking event, creating a special festival atmosphere. Running event with 6h, 24h, relay, and backyard events; at Batenbrockpark; online registration; event in August 2026

name: Burgwald Märchen Marathon
description: The Burgwald Fairy Tale Marathon in Rauschenberg is a diverse running event with courses for ultra marathon, marathon, half marathon, three-quarter marathon, fun runs, and costume runs. The event offers a well-organized race route with refreshments, timing, and medals for all finishers. The bib number distribution takes place the day before, and the races start from 8:00 a.m. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to enjoy the race in a fairy-tale environment.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from 5 km to ultra marathon (52 km)
Start and finish near the sports hall and outdoor pool in Rauschenberg
Cut-off time for all races is 4:00 p.m.
additional: Maximum 1111 starting places for all races. Bib number distribution on August 29, 2026, from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. at the sports hall Rauschenberg. Late registrations are possible on August 29 from 5:00 p.m. to 7:00 p.m. and on August 30 until one hour before the respective start, with late registration fees (€3 for ultra, marathon, half marathon; €2 for other races). All finishers who reach the finish line by 4:00 p.m. will receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online or collected at the finish area. Start and finish are located near the sports hall and outdoor pool in Rauschenberg. The course mostly runs through the forest, partly on paved paths; refreshments every 5±2 km; dogs allowed.

name: CrossFunRun
description: The CrossFunRun on August 30, 2026, in Ahrensburg offers varied courses for all age groups and performance levels. The races take place in Wulfsdorfer Park with start and finish at Heidkoppelhof. The event is family-friendly with special Kids Cross-Run courses and relay competitions. All participants receive medals, certificates, and prizes. The event is organized by WEcycle e.V., which ensures a great atmosphere and exciting cross-country running experiences.
course_highlights: Course lengths from 500 m to 5 km, depending on age group
Start and finish at Heidkoppelhof, Wulfsdorfer Weg
Family-friendly Cross-Run courses and relay competitions
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site from 10:00 AM for an additional fee of 5 euros. The event offers awards in the form of medals, certificates, and prizes. There are relay Cross-Run competitions with 3 or 4 team members. Directions are via Bornkampsweg and Wulfsdorfer Weg in 22926 Ahrensburg. On-site registration is possible, various categories, family-friendly, activities for cyclists and runners, start and finish at Heidkoppelhof Ahrensburg.

name: DO IT FAST
description: DO IT FAST in Dortmund offers runners the opportunity to set their personal best on a fully measured 2.5 km loop course. Depending on the distance, the course will be run 2 or 4 times and is eligible for record listings. In addition to the athletic competition, participants will receive a finisher medal, refreshments, and an award ceremony for the top runners. A photo banner at the finish area invites memorable photos, and the results can be accessed digitally via QR code.
course_highlights: DLV-measured 2.5 km loop course
10 km run: 4 laps, 5 km run: 2 laps
Photo banner in front of the blast furnace as a photo spot
additional: Race office opens at 07:30 AM. Award ceremony for men and women, each for places 1-3, after crossing the finish line on the event area. Finishers receive a medal and refreshments. Results and certificates can be accessed via QR code on the bib number. Late registration fee of €5 applies after registration deadline. Races on a measured 2.5 km loop course, registration until 16.08.2026, including shirt options, timing, award ceremony, photos.

name: Ehriker Stadtmauerlauf mit 2. Ehriker Burg Ramstein Lauf
description: The 6th Ehriker Stadtmauerlauf will take place on August 30, 2026, in Ehrang and offers runners a varied program with different distances. New to the program is the 10 km Burg-Ramstein-Lauf, a shaded scenic run that is part of the 4REGIO-CUP. The 5 km course runs through the old village with a lively city run atmosphere over four laps. For children, there are exciting youth runs and toddler runs in the running tunnel between fairground stalls. The event is DLV-measured and promises an athletic experience for all age groups.
course_highlights: 10km shaded scenic run, DLV-measured
5km city run on 4 laps through the old village, DLV-measured
Youth runs and toddler runs in the running tunnel between fairground stalls
additional: Start at all runs in front of the stage at Kyllkreisel. Finish for all runs except the 10km run at Peter-Roth-Platz, with the 10km finish just before the end of Ramsteiner Weg in Ehrik (Ehrang). New in the program: 10km Burg-Ramstein-Lauf as part of the 4REGIO-CUP. Children's runs with thunderous applause and toddlers in the running tunnel between fairground stalls. The event also includes family and youth runs as well as DLV-measured courses. Registration is via laufen.de, and the event is part of the 4REGIO-CUP, a regional running series.

name: Felsburglauf
description: The Felsburglauf is a traditional race competition that has been held annually since 2013 on the last Sunday of August at the stadium below the Felsburg in Felsberg. The event offers courses over 400 meters, 1,000 meters, 5,000 meters, and 10,000 meters and attracts runners of all ages from the region. The family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful setting make the race a popular event in the Schwalm-Eder-Kreis. As a licensed course for the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup, participants can also earn points for the overall standings.
course_highlights: Courses over 400 m, 1,000 m, 5,000 m, and 10,000 m
Start and finish at the stadium below the historic Felsburg
Family-friendly atmosphere with good weather and beautiful scenery
additional: The race is part of the KSK-Schwalm-Eder-Cup. The youngest participants are often born in 2020 or later, and the oldest runner was born in 1937. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht 1863 Felsberg and partner TSV Jahn Gensungen. Courses: 400 m, 1 km, 5 km, 10 km; Terrain: stadium and Felsburg surroundings; registration not explicitly mentioned.

name: Koberstädter Waldmarathon
description: The Koberstädter Forest Marathon has been held annually since 1979 on the last Sunday in August in Egelsbach and is organized by the Athletics Department of SG Egelsbach. The event offers races over distances of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon (21.1 km) in a scenic, gently hilly forest landscape. In addition to competitions for ambitious runners, there is also a Bambini race for children in the stadium. The family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the race a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the natural idyll of Koberstadt with gently hilly forest terrain
Refreshment stations approximately every 5 km along the route
Start and finish in the stadium with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The Bambini race starts at 9:00 AM in the stadium and is for children up to nine years old, covering one stadium lap (400 m). Children receive a medal, certificate, and a gift. Along the route, there are refreshment stations with drinks and fruit approximately every 5 km. The event is part of the Hessian State Championships. A lead bicycle accompanies the fastest runner. Due to increased safety regulations, no marathon is offered. Registration for the Hessian Half Marathon Championships is separate. Courses are available for children, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon; registration is open until August 22; bib number pickup begins on August 31 from 7:30 AM; participation in the Hessian Championships is possible.

name: Kölner Halbmarathon- Die Generalprobe
location: Sportpark Müngersdorf, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 27th Cologne Half Marathon on August 30, 2026, offers runners the opportunity to choose from four distances: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km. All start together at 10:00 AM at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf. The course takes participants through Cologne and is designed as a dress rehearsal for upcoming races. Refreshments such as water, bananas, muesli bars, and non-alcoholic drinks are provided along the route and at the finish line. The event is organized by the Athletics Team of the German Sports University Cologne e.V. and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the NetCologne Stadium in Sportpark Müngersdorf
Four distance options: 7 km, 14 km, 21 km, and 28 km
Course and finish line refreshments with water, bananas, and Maxi Nutrition bars
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site at the race bib distribution until August 30, 2026, provided there are still spots available. Participation with baby joggers, dogs, walkers, and music devices is not permitted for safety reasons. Preferred race numbers can be selected for a fee of €3. Changes to registration are only possible at the bib distribution and cost €15. The course, start/finish in Cologne, on-site registration, refreshments, race bibs, parking, showers, and changing facilities are available.

name: Lahnparklauf
price_range: 14,00 € für 21,1 km und 30 km, 9,00 € für 5 km und 10 km
description: The Lahnparklauf takes place on August 30, 2026, in the heart of Hesse and is an established running event that appeals to runners of all performance levels. The proven course concept, the so-called LOOP, will be maintained again this year. The organizing team of team-naunheim SPORT e.V. looks forward to welcoming many participants and offers training in various sports in addition to the run.
course_highlights: Proven LOOP course layout
Running event in the heart of Hesse
Suitable for runners of all performance levels
additional: Registration is expected to open in early June 2026. In addition to the run, training offers in running, trail running, triathlon, fitness, dancing, Zumba, and yoga are available. Course map and elevation profile online, registration online, parking at REWE parking lot, no bag storage provided by the organizer, medical services by Malteser Hilfsdienst e.V.

name: Panoramalauf
description: The Münstertäler Panorama Run is a varied scenic race over 10 km featuring a trail section and 229 meters of elevation gain. Additionally, there are children's races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km. The event takes place in the picturesque Münstertal Staufen region and offers runners an attractive route through nature. Pre-registration is via RaceResult.
course_highlights: 10 km scenic race with trail section
229 meters of elevation gain
Children's races over 1.0 km and 2.0 km
additional: Pre-registration is via RaceResult. The event is organized by the Zweckverband Schwarzwaldsüden. Pre-registration through RaceResult; the event includes a 10 km race with trail sections, as well as other distances, including fun runs and trail runs.

name: Rund um Ennepetal

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 7 € je Etappe bei Voranmeldung bis zum 23.08.2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 30 € für alle Strecken bei Voranmeldung bis zum 23.08.2026

description: Around Ennepetal is an annual recreational sports event held on the last Sunday of August, combining running, hiking, and walking along the 60 km long Ennepetal circular trail in five stages. The route passes through diverse nature with stunning views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs, and historic sites. The event is suitable for all performance levels and offers guided groups for runners and walkers as well as independent hikers. The stages are scenic and feature cultural highlights as well as challenging sections. After the race, participants can access their results and certificates online.
course_highlights: 60 km in 5 stages with varied ascents and descents through forests, floodplains, and horse meadows
Beautiful views of the Bergisches Land, reservoirs, and historic half-timbered villages like Beyenburg
Guided groups for runners and walkers, independent hikers with GPX data, refreshment points at the end of stages
additional: Late registration on the day of the event is possible for a fee until 30 minutes before the start. The start and finish point is the sports facility of Rot-Weiß Rüggeberg e.V. Organized bus transfers to the start points of stages 2 to 5 and back are provided. The cut-off time is 8:30 PM. Runners and walkers are accompanied in groups with local guides, and hikers receive GPX data for self-guided tours. Results and certificates are available online. The event includes multiple stages with a challenging route, including bus transfers between start points and refreshment stations at transfer points. Participation is open to all, with various disciplines and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Straßenlauf TV Rheinau 1893
description: The 38th Mannheimer Straßenlauf organized by TV Rheinau 1893 is an officially approved 10 km road race by the German Athletics Association (DLV), held under the supervision of the Baden Athletics Association (BLV). The race is part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup 2025 and features a measured course according to DLV guidelines. The event takes place on August 31, 2025, at 9:30 AM in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse and is open to runners of all ages, with categories from U18 to seniors. Changing rooms and showers are available at the club premises, and there are cash prizes as well as course record bonuses for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: 10 km measured road race course according to DLV guidelines
Part of the engelhorn sports Brooks Laufcup 2025
Start and finish in front of the TV Rheinau clubhouse with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start. Payment is made via SEPA direct debit in the week after the race. Certificates are printed via br-timing. Cash prizes (vouchers) are awarded to the top three in each category. Course record bonuses for men and women are offered. The award ceremony takes place around 11:00 AM at the TV sports field/halle. Access by tram line 1, stop Waldseestraße. The course is well signposted and located in Rheinau, Mannheim. Registration is online, with bib number pickup at TV Rheinau. Changing rooms and showers are available at the club premises. The route is easily accessible by bus line 1, stop Waldseestraße.

name: Stundenlauf des TuS Fleestedt
location: Sportzentrum Seevetal, Seevetal, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The 6-Hour Sparkassen Run in Fleestedt takes place on August 30, 2026, on a 1,200-meter loop course at the Seevetal Sports Center. The course mainly consists of paved surfaces and partly grass, and is well visible from the start/finish area, creating excitement for spectators. In addition to the individual competition, there are team and relay events, with the marathon distance (42.2 km) receiving its own ranking. The race is open to participants born from 2008 onwards, with special offers for youth and children.
course_highlights: 1,200 m loop course with predominantly paved surfaces and grass sections
Course mostly visible from the start/finish area
Marathon distance with 35 laps and its own ranking
additional: Participation possible from birth year 2008; relay competition also for youth born from 2014; 5,000m run for youth born from 2009 to 2014; DLV running badge for children born from 2015 to 2020 during the event; team scoring combines all kilometers. Event held on a 1,200 m loop course at the Seevetal Sports Center, various competitions, registration possible.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event set in one of the most beautiful landscapes of southern Germany, featuring gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and an exciting atmosphere along the course. The route offers a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal with varied sections passing through historic towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar. The flat finish at Riedstadion Steinheim invites a thrilling final sprint. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, everyone can find their personal running experience here.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Beilstein, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at Riedstadion Steinheim with a chance for a final sprint
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups for preparation, summer break runs during the summer holidays, year-end run with 10 km and mulled wine. The start and finish area is the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim an der Murr. Registration is via the partner Datasport. Late registrations are possible at short notice. The training run serves marathon preparation and takes place on August 30, 2026. There is also a previous training event on June 28, 2026, to test the course.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The 40th People's Hike Day of TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. is a traditional hiking event in Tiftlingerode, taking place on August 30, 2026. The event is aimed at hiking enthusiasts and offers a wonderful opportunity to enjoy nature and the surroundings. It is a social and athletic activity suitable for all age groups. The event is organized by TSV "DE" Immingerode e.V. and is part of the competition calendar of the German Athletics Association.
course_highlights: Hiking on the sports field TSV Immingerode
Participation in the People's Hike Day in Duderstadt
Nature experience in the Eichsfeld region
additional: Hiking event, Location: Sports field TSV Immingerode, Duderstadt, Registration and contact via the club

name: Wandertag
location: Neuhaus im Solling, Holzminden, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Neuhäuser Wandertag is an annual hiking event in the Solling-Vogler region around Neuhaus im Solling. Participants can choose from four different routes ranging from 4.7 to 18 km, passing through diverse landscapes with dense forests, green meadows, and beautiful viewpoints. The start and finish point is the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6, where hikers begin between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and small snacks are offered at control points for a small fee. In the afternoon, an award ceremony takes place, honoring among others the largest participating groups and the oldest hiking friends.
course_highlights: Diverse landscapes with densely wooded areas and lush green meadows
Great viewpoints with magnificent views over the Weser Uplands
Four marked routes between 4.7 and 18 km
additional: Start and finish are at the Haus des Gastes in Neuhaus, Lindenstraße 6. Participants start between 8 and 10 a.m. Drinks and small snacks are available at control points for a small fee. An award ceremony takes place in the afternoon, honoring the largest groups and the oldest hiking friends. Refreshments include hearty dishes and sweet cake varieties. Musical entertainment and a variety of info and sales booths round out the event. Routes between 5 and 20 km, catering at control points, musical accompaniment, sales booths, and an award ceremony in the afternoon.

name: Öko-Run
description: The Eco-Run in Wächtersbach is part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge and takes place on August 30, 2026. The course is continuously paved and runs traffic-free along meadows and fields by the Kinzig River. Offered are runs over 5 km, 10 km, as well as a 1,000 m school run in various age groups. Each finisher receives a running shirt, and the event is embedded in a race series with scoring runs and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Continuously paved course without road traffic
Run along meadows and fields by the Kinzig River
Start and finish at the Bioenergie Family Bath Wächtersbach
additional: Start times: 5 km run at 09:00, 10 km main race at 09:40, 1,000 m school run at 10:40. Registration and payment are on-site until half an hour before the respective race. No separate registration for the challenge is required. The event is part of a series with 8 races, with at least 5 participations needed for scoring. Each finisher receives a running shirt. The event takes place in August with typical summer weather around 25°C, registration on-site at the start, part of the Main-Kinzig-Challenge.

name: Běh teplickými skalami
location: Teplicích nad Metují, Náchod District, Hradec Králové Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Základní 200 Kč, zvýšené 300 Kč, dodatečné 400 Kč (La Sportiva Cross); 100 Kč, 150 Kč, 200 Kč (Bufo Cross)
description: The Teplice Rocks Run is a public trail race held annually on the last Sunday of August in Teplice nad Metují. The race has been a tradition since 1994 and is part of the sports program of the International Mountaineering Film Festival. The 9 km course runs along the Metuje River to the rock city, includes sandy sections and stairs, and returns along the same route. Since 2011, a children's race by age categories has also been part of the event. The start and finish are at the TJ Slavoj football field.
course_highlights: 9 km course along the Metuje River and Teplice rock city
Sandy sections and stairs on the sightseeing circuit
Start and finish at the TJ Slavoj football field
additional: Online registration until August 26, 2026, at the basic entry fee; from August 27 to 29, 2026, at an increased fee; additional registration on race day at double the entry fee. The children's race starts by age categories on circuits. The race office is located at the start and finish area at the football field. The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series. The 9 km trail is a terrain course with sandy sections and stairs, for various age categories, with online registration. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj football field and is part of the Primátor Cup 2026 series.

name: Běh zámeckou zahradou
location: Zámecký park, Lysá nad Labem, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The castle garden run is a traditional running race held in the castle park in Lysá nad Labem. This 62nd edition takes place on August 30, 2025, and is intended for a wide range of participants from preschoolers to seniors. The race offers a pleasant environment of the historic park and promotes sports activity for all age groups. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem, which has long supported sports for everyone.
course_highlights: Lysá nad Labem castle park
Course suitable for all age groups
Pleasant environment of the historic garden
additional: The race is part of a long-standing Sokol tradition and is open to the general public, including children and seniors. The organizer is T. J. Sokol Lysá nad Labem. Information about the race is available on the Sokol website in the events section. The race takes place in the castle park, is part of a long tradition, and offers various categories for all age groups.

name: Běh Bezděkovem
location: Bezděkov pod Třemšínem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděkov Cross Country Race is a traditional trail running event approximately 9 km long, held in the picturesque surroundings of Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course mainly follows forest paths through varied terrain with gentle elevation changes, offering a combination of asphalt and rocky sections. The race starts at the hunting lodge and includes a challenging uphill section with up to 7% incline, testing runners' performance. After this demanding segment, there is a final downhill and flat finish, allowing runners to showcase their pace. The event also features children's races, making it attractive to a wide audience.
course_highlights: 90% forest trail in varied terrain, 10% asphalt
Loop run clockwise with gentle descents and ascents
360-meter uphill section with up to 7% incline as a performance test
additional: Children's races are part of the event. Start and finish at the hunting lodge in Bezděkov under Třemšín. The course is mainly through forest paths with varied terrain. Results are available in PDF format from the organizers. The race length is approximately 9 km, with options for children's races, registration in advance or on-site, and the event takes place in the Brdy nature area with various categories and distances.

name: Kolínská desítka
location: Sportovní stadion Mirka Tučka, Kolín, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: Kolínská desítka is a turnaround race over 10 km, running on asphalt and a modified forest trail around the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Kolín and offers runners a pleasant combination of an asphalt surface and natural environment. This race is suitable for all runners looking for a fast and scenic run in nature. Come enjoy the race atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in the beautiful surroundings of Kolín.
course_highlights: A 10 km course with a turnaround character
Surface combining asphalt and modified forest trails
Start and finish at the Mirka Tučka sports stadium in Kolín
additional: The course is slightly hilly with an edge around Veltruby, registration is conducted online, the race is suitable for the general running public

name: Rakovnická 15
description: Rakovnická Patnáctka is a road race of 15 km, which alternates annually between starting in Rakovník and Křivoklát. The race is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup and offers runners the opportunity to compete on an attractive course in the beautiful environment of the Central Bohemian Region. This race is suitable for all runners seeking a quality road run with tradition and the atmosphere of a regional running cup.
course_highlights: Road course 15 km long
Start alternates annually between Rakovník and Křivoklát
Part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Running Cup
additional: The race takes place in 2026, with the start planned for August 30 in Křivoklát. The course includes ascents and descents and is part of the regional running cup.

name: Sázava - Lázek
location: Sázava u Lanškrouna, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Sázava-Lázek is a hill running race with a length of 7.9 km and an elevation gain of 375 meters. The course starts on asphalt and continues through field and forest paths, with the steepest climb at the end. This race offers a challenging and varied terrain for runners seeking a challenge in the natural environment of the Pardubice region.
course_highlights: Length of the course 7.9 km with an elevation gain of 375 m
The route goes on asphalt, field, and forest paths
The steepest climb is in the final part of the race
additional: Registration is possible on-site until 9:00 AM, the race starts at 9:30 AM, the race is intended for runners of all levels, the course offers technical challenges and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Běh okolo Hříšné Milady
location: okolí České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hříšná Milady Run is a cross-country race around Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region, offering two courses of 12 km and 6 km. The route mainly follows forest roads and hiking trails that are open to regular traffic. The race is part of the District Running League and is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking natural and technically interesting terrain. Cross-country/trail race character
Surroundings of Česká Lípa in the Liberec Region

The run promotes physical activity as part of rehabilitation and support for the ill, as well as social integration.

Route marked every 1 km with signs

name: Jurajskie Mistrzostwa NA SKRAJU PRZEŁAJU
description: Jurassic Championships ON THE EDGE OF CROSS-COUNTRY are demanding cross-country races held in the picturesque Przewodziszowice near Żarki, in the Jura Krakowsko-Częstochowska region. The routes lead through Jurassic hills, limestone outcrops, dense forests, winding paths, rocky ascents, and open spaces with a view of the Jurassic Landscape Park. The event offers various distances, from short races for beginners and Nordic walkers to the challenging Trentaraton for experienced runners. It is an excellent opportunity for sporting competition and enjoying the beauty of nature.
course_highlights: Jurassic hills and limestone outcrops
Winding paths and rocky ascents
Panorama of the Jurassic Landscape Park

Participants can choose between the half marathon distance (21.0975 km) or a 10 km run, which takes place on a single loop through the city streets. The start and finish are located at Jasne Błonia Square named after John Paul II. The route is certified by PZLA and is marked every kilometer, with electronic timing using chips embedded in the race bibs. Organizers offer wave starts and high-quality technical shirts from the Ventus brand in extended packages.

Route certified by PZLA, marked every 1 km

name: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznan
location: Jezioro Kierskie, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: IRONMAN 70.3 Poznań is a prestigious triathlon held at the historic Lake Kierskie, the site of Poland's first triathlon event in 1984. Participants can enjoy calm and warm waters for swimming, a fast and flat cycling route through picturesque villages and the western part of Poznań, and a run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań — a modern symbol of the city. This unique event combines athletic competition with local culture and modern infrastructure.
course_highlights: Swimming in the calm and warm Lake Kierskie, site of Poland's first triathlon
Flat and fast cycling route through villages and the western part of Poznań
Run leading towards the city center with a finish at the International Fairgrounds Poznań
additional: Start in a rolling start format. The start and finish locations are Lake Kierskie and the International Fairgrounds Poznań. The time limit to complete the 21.0975 km distance is 3 hours and 30 minutes, and the race is open to both experienced runners and amateurs.

Annual event with a community character

course_highlights: 6.6 km course through Milíčov Forest
Mixed terrain including forest paths and asphalt sections
Organized by SABZO Prague

name: 23. Lehrter CityLauf
description: The 23rd Lehrter CityLauf will take place on September 4, 2026, and is a traditional running event in the city center of Lehrte. The races include distances of 2, 4, and 10 kilometers, including children's and school runs as well as an inclusion run over 2 kilometers. A lively atmosphere is ensured by musical accompaniment and a varied supporting program involving the LSV departments.

Races over 2, 4, and 10 kilometers
Inclusion run as part of the 2-kilometer race

name: 6. Fränkischer Backyard Ultra
description: The Franconian Backyard Ultra is a unique ultra race in the "Backyard Ultra" format with a 6.7 km loop and approximately 90 meters of elevation gain. Each full hour, a new lap begins, and the last runner to complete a lap within the 60-minute time limit wins. The race takes place in Heuchling and is characterized by its open-ended finish, continuing until only one runner remains. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with comprehensive catering and a special focus on endurance and community.
course_highlights: Loop course of 6.7 km with approximately 90 meters of elevation gain
Hourly start of each new lap with a 60-minute time limit
Start and finish at Sportverein Heuchling SK Heuchling 1920 e.V.
additional: Each completed lap up to the 15th lap requires a donation of €1 to the homeless aid, payable upon registration cancellation. Catering for runners is included in the entry fee, and reusable cups are recommended. The FamilyTrail is a separate race for families with a 2.3 km route, starting every 30 minutes, with teams of 2 to 5 people and a minimum age of 5 years for children. The FamilyTrail begins on Saturday at 10:00 AM with a briefing at 9:45 AM. Tents and pavilions can be set up from 10:00 AM. The route primarily runs over paved paths and gravel trails through the Sauerland mountains and is characterized by a challenging topography. Running event with children's races, main races, challenging course with elevation meters, online registration available.

name: IHK-Ausbildungslauf move-on

The course leads from Belmontplatz through streets, fields, and forest paths with approximately 100 meters of elevation gain, offering a varied landscape. Charity tattoo event and DKMS registration on site. Participation is possible through membership, with donations for children's hospices, DKMS, and families in need. The run includes various distances, including a kids' run and inline skating.

name: Werler Kurpark Crosslauf - Hindernislauf für Groß und Klein
location: Werl Kurpark, Werl, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Werler Kurpark Crosslauf is an obstacle race for young and old, taking place in the picturesque Kurpark of Werl. The event offers runs for various age groups and skill levels, from short distances for children to challenging 6.4 km for endurance runners. New in 2026 is the relay cross, which promotes team spirit and fun. The varied course includes numerous exciting obstacles, making the race a special experience.
course_highlights: Varying obstacles such as Climb the Wall, Water Lagoon, and Mountain Climber
Course lengths from 480 meters to 6.4 kilometers
New in 2026: Project S as an additional obstacle
additional: Registration on-site until 60 minutes before the respective start is possible (except for relay). Bib numbers with electronic timing via Racersult. There is an exclusive Kurparkcross shirt, which can only be pre-ordered until June 30, 2026. Spikes, barefoot running, and costumes are not allowed for safety reasons. Accompaniment on the course is only permitted during the U6 Bambini run. Obstacles, courses for children and adults, family-friendly, team spirit, fun.

name: Wiehler AggerEnergie- und Sparkasse Gummersbach Sommerlauf
location: Wiehltalstadion, Wiehl, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Wiehler AggerEnergie and Sparkasse Gummersbach Summer Run is a varied running event for all age groups and performance levels. The courses start from the Wiehltalstadion and pass through the redesigned park areas in the center of Wiehl, offering a scenic backdrop. Whether as an individual runner or in a team, the summer run invites participants to be active, experience community, and have fun. The motto "Wi(ehle)r are sporty!" emphasizes the vibrant sports culture in Wiehl.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiehltalstadion
Run through redesigned park areas in the city center
Scenic and varied course
additional: The race takes place on Saturday, September 5, 2026. The event is open to individual runners and teams. Contact person is Nicole Woberschal (Tel. 02262 99-206). Race courses start from Wiehltalstadion, scenic backdrop, registration possible

name: Wildman Harz
description: The WILDMAN Harz is a challenging trail running event around the mountain town of Wildemann in the Harz. The course features steep climbs, technical downhills, through spruce forests and alpine meadows, offering an authentic trail running experience in the Upper Harz. With distances ranging from 1.5 km to 55 km, there is a suitable challenge for every trail runner. The event is accompanied by a lively supporting program with a pasta party and a grill party, making the weekend a special experience.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and technical downhills
Spruce forests and alpine meadows
Single trails over roots and stones around Wildemann
additional: Registration is possible online until 30 minutes before the respective start with an additional fee of 10 EUR. Age restrictions per course are defined. Supporting program includes a pasta party on Friday and a grill party on Saturday. There are scoring categories, mandatory equipment, and refreshment points. Registration is via the partner myRacePartner.com. Courses with up to 2,100 meters of elevation, refreshment points, timing, environmental and fairness rules, supporting program including pasta and grill party, registration required.

name: Volksbank Mitte Kurstadtlauf
description: The VR-Bank Mitte Kurstadtlauf in Heilbad Heiligenstadt is a traditional race taking place on September 5, 2026, for the 27th time. The course covers 19 kilometers over the Dün and starts and ends at the Vitalpark. A tree is planted for each participant to reforest local forests, making the race environmentally particularly significant. The event offers a warm atmosphere and invites runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: 19 km run over the Dün
Start and finish at the Vitalpark (Leineaue 1)
Scenic route with forest sections
additional: Race number pickup from 8:30 a.m. in front of the Vitalpark. Late registrations are possible with a late registration fee of €3. The start and finish are at the Vitalpark, the race runs over the Dün, and there is a tree planting activity for participants.

name: 55. Brockenlauf
description: The Brocken Run is Germany's oldest mountain race and has been held annually since 1927 in Ilsenburg in the Harz. The main course over 26.2 km features 890 meters of elevation gain to the highest mountain in northern Germany, the Brocken, and offers a challenging experience with variable high-altitude mountain climate at the summit. The route passes through picturesque nature, historic sites, and offers impressive views. In addition to the main race, there are shorter courses that also provide a natural experience. The event is open to all runners, regardless of club membership.
course_highlights: 26.2 km with 890 meters of elevation gain to the Brocken
Variable high-altitude mountain climate at the summit with temperatures from -15 °C to 15 °C
Start in the medieval town of Ilsenburg, run along the Ilse and through the Harz Forest
additional: Timing at multiple points along the 26.2 km route via SPORTident Timing. The course is challenging with steep sections up to 12.5% incline and concrete slabs at the summit. The event is open to runners and hikers. The organizer reserves the right to change the course if conditions on the Brocken become unreasonable. Registrations are already possible, with various course lengths including ultra and running events, as well as a book flea market and exclusive running shirts.

name: Borkumer Meilenlauf und Nordic Walking
location: Borkum, Nordseeinsel Borkum, Lower Saxony, Germany

description: The 20th Borkum Mile Run with Nordic Walking will take place on September 5, 2026, on the North Sea island of Borkum. The varied courses lead through the charming beach and dune landscape and offer the right challenge for every running enthusiast, from the junior pirate run to the quarter marathon. The high-sea climate and fresh sea air make the event a special experience, complemented by a comprehensive supporting program for participants and accompanying persons.
course_highlights: Courses through beach and dune landscape of Borkum island
High-sea climate and fresh sea air
Diverse routes from pirate run to quarter marathon
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event on-site until 45 minutes before the competition begins for an additional fee of 5.00 EUR, but without entitlement to the full service package and T-shirt. Catering on the course and at the finish line, changing rooms, bag storage, showers, and 90 minutes of free access to the Erlebnisdeck of Gezeitenland are included. Additionally, discounted ferry prices are available during the event weekend. Routes on promenade and beach, no age classes for Nordic Walking, refreshment stations on longer routes.

description: The Brokser Volkslauf takes place on September 5, 2026, in Bruchhausen-Vilsen and offers running and walking disciplines for all age groups. The event includes courses from 400 meters to 20 kilometers as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. Held in all weather conditions, participants can look forward to a colorful supporting program with a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. The races start at the school and sports center, and children's and youth races are awarded medals.
course_highlights: Courses from 400 m (children's run) to 20 km (Volkslauf)
Start and finish at the school and sports center Bruchhausen-Vilsen
The 20 km route consists of two laps of the 10 km course
additional: Start and finish are at the school and sports center Bruchhausen-Vilsen. Bib number distribution begins at 13:00. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event. Award ceremonies are held in stages after each race. Medals are awarded for children's and youth races. The supporting program includes a bouncy castle, drinks, cake, and bratwurst. Running, walking, held annually, in all weather conditions.

name: Ederauenlauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.4 km
description: The Ederauenlauf in Bergheim is a popular running event with a variety of course lengths suitable for runners of all ages and performance levels. The course runs through the picturesque Ederauen and offers ideal conditions with a measured, record-eligible route. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, numerous helpers, and a good mood. In addition to the athletic competition, the focus is also on the shared experience and supporting social projects.
course_highlights: Measured, record-eligible route through the Ederauen
Courses from 400m for children to half marathon (21.1 km)
Start and finish at the central sports facility of TV08 Bergheim
additional: The event offers various distances from 400m for children to a half marathon of 21.1 km. The course is dry, windless, and ideal for running weather. There is a family-friendly atmosphere with many helpers and spectators. The event supports social projects such as the Children's Cancer Aid Marburg. The central sports facility of TV08 Bergheim serves as the start and finish point. Courses are measured and well marked, including Nordic walking; donations for children's cancer aid; event scheduled for September 2026.

name: Fehmarn Marathon
description: The Fehmarn Marathon takes place annually on the island of Fehmarn and offers runners a varied course through the eastern part of the island. The main races lead over roads, dike paths, and uneven field paths, providing a diverse running experience. The event begins on September 5, 2026, at 9:30 AM at the sports field at the island school in Fehmarn. In addition to the marathon, there are other races with award ceremonies, and all participants receive an official marathon shirt. Timing is done with a foot chip attached to the running shoe, and the event takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Loop courses over roads, dike, and uneven field paths
Course through the eastern part of Fehmarn
Start and finish at the sports field at the island school
additional: Number bib distribution on the day before from 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM and on the event day from 8:00 AM. Award ceremonies are held sequentially after the races. Timing is done with a foot chip to be returned after the race; a fee of €15 is charged for loss. The event ends around 3:15 PM with the arrival of the final support cyclist. Parking recommendations with walking distance to the start area are available. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before each race. The shirts tend to run small; larger sizes are recommended. The event takes place in all weather conditions, online registration is possible, including race shirts and various categories.

name: Gremsdorfer Kerwalauf 2026
description: The Gremsdorf Carrot Run is a traditional race event in Gremsdorf offering various distances for all age groups. The event includes children, youth, hobby, and main races as well as walking competitions. The courses lead through the scenic surroundings of Gremsdorf, providing an engaging experience for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. The race takes place annually as part of the Kerwa festival and is a popular event for the whole family.
course_highlights: Variety of courses for children, youth, hobby, and main race
Run through the picturesque landscape around Gremsdorf
Integrated into the traditional Kerwa festival
additional: The event offers different races for all age groups, including children, youth, hobby, and main races as well as walking. Registration is possible until the day of the event, with tiered prices depending on the registration time. The scenic course routes are available as a PDF on the website. The event is embedded in the traditional Kerwa festival in Gremsdorf. It features a variety of categories, including children's races, Nordic walking, and hobby runs. The event takes place during the Kerwa week and is characterized by a lively atmosphere, medical services, showers at the sports clubhouse, and a family-friendly environment.

name: SOKOLOVSKÁ 12/24 RUN
location: Koupaliště Michal, Sokolov, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
price_range: plné startovné, sleva do 15.6.2026 (-50%), do 31.7.2026 (-20%), na místě +200 Kč
description: Sokolovská 12/24 RUN is an endurance running race lasting 6, 12, or 24 hours, intended for individuals, pairs, and teams of four. The race takes place on an easy undulating loop around the Michal Natural Swimming Pool in Sokolov. The start is on Saturday, September 5, 2026, at 11:15 AM, and the race offers accommodation in a campsite with full facilities. The event is suitable for a wide range of sports enthusiasts and offers various age and team categories with the possibility of relay exchanges at the relay area near the buffet.
course_highlights: Easy undulating loop around Michal Natural Swimming Pool
Participation in categories for individuals, pairs, and teams of four
Facilities with a buffet and relay exchange options
additional: Registration takes place on September 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on September 5, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM. Results are announced on Sunday, September 6, 2026, at 9:00 AM for the 6H and 12H categories, and at 12:30 PM for the 24H category. The registration fee includes accommodation in the campsite (own tents, caravans, shelters) and participation porcelain or medals. There are toilets, showers, electrical power, and catering options available in the campsite. The race is part of a larger multisport weekend that also includes MTB races and kick scooter events. Registration occurs on September 4, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM and on September 5, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM.

name: Běh kolem Světa
description: The Run Around the World is a traditional running event held in Třeboň, which takes place around the Svět Pond. Since its inception in 2012, the race has gained loyal supporters and offers an attractive route of 11.7 km, following the Educational Trail around the World. The event is regularly held in September and is popular for its natural scenery and diverse surface, including dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners and offers the possibility to purchase an entry fee in the form of a Christmas voucher.
course_highlights: The route runs around Svět Pond with beautiful nature
The length of the course is 11.7 km, suitable for recreational and competitive runners
Surface includes dirt, mud, sand, grass, wooden bridges, and sections of asphalt
additional: The course is 11.7 km long, held in September, electronic chip timing, possibility to purchase a voucher for the entry fee

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - září
location: Průmyslová zóna Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín in Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race also features a children's course of 800 meters. Each participant receives a warm cinnamon pancake as a reward for their performance at the finish line. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration before the start and timing for all runners.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
Children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women from 13 to 127 years old and children up to 12 years old, with age categories valid throughout the calendar year. The top three places in the men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. Recommended access to the start is by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly registration is on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55, with the start at 9:00. The 800-meter children's course is part of the event. Location: Příluky Industrial Zone, Zlín, start in front of Madal Bal.

description: Kosiřské žiganec is a traditional running race held in Drahanovice on Velký Kosíř, which is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region. The race offers courses of 10 km and 5 km running through fields and forest paths with mild to moderate elevation gain. There are shorter runs for children of 400 and 1500 meters. The event is open to the general public and, besides the sporting experience, offers refreshments and entertainment after the race. The start and registration take place at the football field, with results announcement and prizes for the best runners in individual categories.
course_highlights: The 10 km route runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 180 meters
The 5 km route also runs through fields and forest paths with an elevation gain of 50 meters
Children's races of 400 and 1500 meters with the route specified on site
additional: Registration for the main race is only possible via www.liga100.cz, children's categories register on site. The capacity for the 10 km race is limited to 150 participants. The race is accompanied by medical services and each participant runs at their own risk. Refreshments and entertainment are provided after the race. Special prizes are awarded for the best runners in categories as well as for the fastest medical personnel and local residents. Registration takes place on site, races are open to all age groups, race day includes registration, start times, and winners announcement.

description: Vorkloster Run is a stage race held in the picturesque environment of the foothills of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands and in the atmosphere of the medieval Porta Coeli Monastery. The race offers three stages of varying length and profile, from a fast flat stage to more challenging hilly sections. It is organized by the experienced team DálRunDál in cooperation with the Porta Coeli Monastery Brewery, which contributes to an authentic experience. The routes are carefully marked and mostly run off-road, with beautiful views of the surrounding landscape and historical monuments.
course_highlights: 1st stage: 5 km, a fast flat course on quality asphalt and cycle paths along the Svratka River with views of Květnice Hill
2nd stage: 11.4 km, a hilly course on paved forest and field roads with panoramic views of the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands foothills
3rd stage: 14.7 km, a moderately demanding course with one hill and a flat finish, passing under unique railway viaducts
additional: The start of the 1st stage is at 10:00 on Saturday. The route is mainly run off-road, on cycle paths and quality asphalt. Bus transportation is available approximately 10 minutes before the start from the parking lot near the start. Accommodation is possible at the Porta Coeli Monastery premises in Předklášteří near Tišnov. The routes are carefully marked with arrows and flags. Starting numbers must not be torn on the bridge over the Svratka River, where the intermediate time is measured. The race includes multiple stages of different lengths and terrains, including team relay options. The event takes place in the beautiful environment of the historic monastery and surrounding nature, with various start times and routes.

name: Podhostýnská 10
location: Zámecký park, Bystřice pod Hostýnem, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: Podhostýnská 10k is a running race held in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, offering courses of 10 and 5 kilometers, including children's races. The event takes place in the castle park and is part of the Zlín Running Series. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all ages who want to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful environment. Organizers emphasize tradition and high-quality organization of the race.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the castle park area in Bystřice pod Hostýnem
Two main routes: 10 km and 5 km
Includes children's races
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the castle in the stables area. The race is part of the year-round Zlín Running Series, which includes 13 races from 5 km to half marathon. Organizers emphasize ecology and environmental friendliness. The races are held in the castle park in Bystřice pod Hostýnem, registration is possible online and on-site, the race course is mainly on roads and park paths, and the event also includes children's races and medals for participants.

name: Běh Plzeňské teplárenské kolem Boleveckých rybníků
description: The Plzeňská teplárenská Run around Bolevecké Ponds is a traditional running event organized by Pro Sport Activities agency, offering routes for children and adults in the picturesque surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds in Plzeň. The race is part of the Youth Running Cup of the Plzeň Region and is suitable for the general public, including the youngest runners. The registration fee is free, and the first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments. In addition to the races, there is an accompanying program for children and an autograph session with athletes.
course_highlights: Routes from 300 m for the youngest children up to 5.5 km with hills for adults
Scenic surroundings of Bolevecké Ponds with flat and hilly sections
Time measurement using chips and results service by APACHI s.r.o.
additional: The registration fee is free for all participants. The first 300 registered participants will receive a voucher for refreshments (a sausage with bread and mustard, 0.33 l beer or non-alcoholic drink). Chip rental, bibs, and pins are available, along with an original finisher medal. The accompanying program includes face painting, a bouncy castle, and an autograph session with athletes. Parking is available in the parking lots around Bolevecké Ponds; entry by car to the start and finish area is not permitted without permission. Routes range from 300 m to 5.5 km, registration is through APACHI company, race office is located at Ostende near Velký Rybník, parking is available around Bolevecké Ponds, and the program includes face painting and a bouncy castle.

name: Birell Večerní Běh na 10 km Praha
description: Birell Evening Run in Prague 10 km is a traditional night run that offers a unique atmosphere of illuminated Prague streets. The race starts at dusk and allows runners to experience the city's beauty in an unconventional light. You can participate as an individual or in a team and enjoy the magical night atmosphere under the starry sky. This race is part of the RunCzech running series and attracts thousands of runners every year.
course_highlights: Night run through illuminated Prague streets
Start at dusk with a magical atmosphere
10 km course in the center of Prague
additional: The race is open to individuals and team runs (women, men, mixed teams). A mobile app from RunCzech provides all information about the race, accompanying program, and virtual package. The 2026 edition will be the 29th race with up to 8,500 participants. The race takes place on September 5, 2026, starting at 19:30, with a length of 10 km, team running options, refreshments along the route, medical support, online results, and diplomas.

name: adidas Běh pro ženy 5 km Praha
description: Come run at the adidas Women’s Run 5 km in Prague, the largest race created specifically for women. The 5 km course is suitable even for runners without prior training, with a time limit of 50 minutes. Enjoy the unique atmosphere and support of thousands of women at this exclusive race without men on the track. Register with your friends and experience the joy of running and solidarity together.
course_highlights: 5 km course in the center of Prague
50-minute limit suitable for beginners
Exclusive race only for women
additional: The race is exclusively for women; men are not on the track. The start number can be picked up at the pre-race EXPO, with the option to authorize another person to collect it. A mobile app, RunCzech, provides information about the race and accompanying program. The race is suitable for beginners, with team participation options, registration via the website, and a virtual version of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - září
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and skill levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, each participant is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for everyone, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1 mile + 70 m)
Beautiful surroundings of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended), a mobile valuables storage, and portable toilet cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, time is measured for each runner, and results are published online. The race is on a road course, 3.2 km, run without bib numbers, voluntary registration, start at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, refreshments at the finish line, categories for adults and children, open to all age groups.

name: Barokomaraton
description: Barokomaraton is the 19th edition of a cross country run held in the picturesque environment of the town of Plasy and the valley of the Střela River. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and those who run for fun and want to enjoy the beautiful autumn nature. Participants can expect courses passing through forest and field paths with regular refreshment stations. The organizers also prepare a cultural program, entertainment for children, and refreshments, making the Barokomaraton a pleasant day full of sport and relaxation for the whole family.
course_highlights: Forest and field paths in the Střela River valley
Regular refreshment stations with water, isotonic drinks, and fruit
Start and finish at the Velká Louka area in Plasy
additional: Registration of competitors takes place at the Velká Louka area in Plasy on September 4th from 18:00 to 20:30 (ultra until 23:30) and on September 5th from 7:30 to 9:20. The time limit is 6 hours for the marathon and 16 hours for the ultra 100 km. Dogs are not allowed to run (canicross). It is recommended to use your own foldable cup at refreshment stations; a limited number of cups are available for purchase on site. There is an option for team relay for groups of three runners on the 10 km, half marathon, and marathon courses. The races include various distances, including ultra 100 km, and are suitable for runners of all levels. The event also offers cultural and accompanying activities, including an expo and entertainment for children.

name: Strážný nahoru a dolů
location: Dolní Dobrouč, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: Strážný nahoru a dolů is part of the ISCAREX Cup, a traditional series of running races in the Pardubice Region. The race offers a challenging uphill and downhill run in the picturesque environment of Dolní Dobrouč. Organizers ensure a quality sporting atmosphere and facilities for all participants. The event is suitable for experienced runners and hobby athletes who want to try running in hilly terrain.
course_highlights: Uphill and downhill run in the terrain of Dolní Dobrouč
Technically interesting profile with elevation gain
Picturesque natural environment of the Pardubice Region
additional: The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup 2025 series, registration from 8:00, start at 10:00, the race takes place in nature on hilly terrain, finish station at the top of Strážný.

name: Lupenická dvanáctka
description: Lupenická Twelve is a traditional running race in Lupenice, held for the 33rd time. The race offers a 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 meters, entirely on asphalt and well marked. The start is at the Lupenice sports complex, and the race is part of the Great Prize of Eastern Bohemia. Each participant runs at their own risk, and those under 18 must provide parental consent.
course_highlights: 12 km course with an elevation gain of 98 m
100% asphalt surface
Marked route in the Lupenice sports complex
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 8:00 to 10:00 at a price of 250 CZK. The registration fee includes a start number, refreshments along the course and at the finish, and facilities at the start and finish area. The registration fee is non-refundable in case of absence. On-site registration is also possible, with the start at 10:30. The event is open to the general public, including families with children.

name: Jenštejnská pětka
location: Jenštejn, Jenštejn, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Jenštejnská pětka is an annual 5 km running race held in the village of Jenštejn since 2014. In addition to the main race, other running categories are organized, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is a traditional sports gathering in the Central Bohemian Region and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in the picturesque environment of Jenštejn.
course_highlights: Race over 5 km in the village of Jenštejn
Various running categories for all age groups
Traditional annual event since 2014
additional: The race takes place on September 5, 2026, and is part of the local sports calendar, offering different categories and being popular among locals and visitors.

name: Zbraslavská Závist
location: Nádraží v Praze-Zbraslavi, Praha-Zbraslav, Praha, Czech Republic
description: Zbraslavská Závist is a trail uphill run that starts in Prague-Zbraslav near the former mini zoo and leads to the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist. The course is 3.5 km long with an elevation gain of 190 meters, offering a challenging and interesting running experience. The race is suitable for athletes who are prepared for a brisk start and a demanding ascent. Organized by the KOPEC association, under the auspices of the Czech Athletic Federation, it is part of the traditional running calendar in Prague.
course_highlights: Trail uphill run with an elevation gain of 190 meters
Start near the former mini zoo in Prague-Zbraslav
Finish at the former Celtic hillfort at the top of Závist
additional: The race is recommended for athletes in good condition who can handle the demanding climb. The course begins flat, then starts ascending up to the lookout tower. The organizer is KOPEC, z.s., Petr Schovánek. The course length is 3.5 km with an elevation gain of 190 m, starting at the station in Prague-Zbraslav. The race offers beautiful views from the top of Hradiště Závist. Registration is possible online or on-site. The race is open to all age categories.

name: 60. Festiwal Chodu
location: Portowy region Gdańska, Gdańsk, Pomorskie, Poland
description: The 60th Race Walking Festival is a prestigious international sporting event organized in the port region of Gdańsk, scheduled for September 5, 2026. The event gathers competitors across various age categories and skill levels, offering race walking competitions over distances of 10 km (women and men, including Open, U20, U18 categories), 5 km, and 3 km for younger participants, as well as the Polish Masters Championships over 5 km. The festival also features the Polish U23 Championships over 10 km and accompanying events such as the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders - Energa Cup. The organizer, the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, promotes physical activity among people with disabilities by organizing wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions.
course_highlights: Race walking over distances of 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km tailored to different age categories
Polish Masters Championships 5 km and Polish U23 Championships 10 km
Accompanying events including the Prologue "Walking with the Postman" and the Memorial Run for the Polish Post Defenders
additional: The festival promotes activity among people with disabilities through wheelchair races and FrameRunning competitions. The organizer is the LECHIA Gdańsk Athletics Club, and the event is supported by the Ministry of Sport and Tourism. The competitions include various distances such as 10 km, 5 km, and 3 km, with online registration available.
