The event encourages sports activity among different age groups and people with disabilities, with support from the Ministry of Sport and Tourism.

name: Chojnik Karkonoski Festiwal Biegowy
location: Sobieszów, Jelenia Góra, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: 300 zł – w płacone 1 sierpnia – 5 września 2026 r.

description: The Chojnik Karkonoski Running Festival is a mountain running event held in Sobieszów, in the heart of the Karkonosze Mountains. The festival offers a variety of distances, from a family educational run to a demanding ultramarathon of 102 km with over 5000 meters of elevation gain. The routes lead through scenic, rocky trails of the Karkonoski National Park, offering unique views and challenges for runners of different skill levels. The event has an integrative character and promotes running as a team sport, as well as environmental education.
course_highlights: Routes lead through Karkonoski National Park with rocky descents and steep ascents
Ultramarathon 102 km with over 5110 m elevation gain and a time limit of 20 hours
Start and finish at Chojnik Castle in Sobieszów, scenic mountain views
additional: Races start from 2:00 AM (Ultra Chojnik) to 10:30 AM (Educational Run). The participant limit for Ultra Chojnik is 100 people, and for Chojnik Marathon 325 people. Mandatory equipment for the ultra includes, among others, a headlamp, a roaming phone, an NRC foil, and a trail map. There are refreshment points and drop bags along the route. The Educational Run features educational stops and questions about nature. Mountain terrain, participant limit 325, mandatory equipment required, refreshment points on the route, time limit 9 hours.

name: Olkuski Bieg Uliczny
location: Stadion przy ul. 29 Listopada 12c, Olkusz, Poland
description: Olkuski Street Run VII Silver Ten Thousand is an annual running event organized by the Olkusz Running Association, the Olkusz City and Municipality Office, and the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Olkusz. The main race over a distance of 10 km takes place on two laps of 5 km each, with chip timing and kilometer markers. The route runs through streets with asphalt and partially cobblestone surfaces, with the start and finish located at the Market Square in Olkusz. The event promotes an active lifestyle and running as a form of recreation for all age groups.
course_highlights: The 10 km route consists of two 5 km laps
Asphalt and partially cobblestone surfaces
Kilometer markers every 1 km and intermediate timing at 5 km
additional: The time limit to complete the run is 90 minutes. There is a refreshment point around the 6 km mark. The participant limit is 300 people. Verification and collection of start packages will take place on September 6 and 7. Chip timing is mandatory and attached to footwear. Participants under 18 must have written parental consent. The participant limit is 300, the time to complete the route is 90 minutes, online registration is available, the registration fee is non-refundable, and it is possible to transfer the fee until August 26, 2024.

name: Półmaraton Praski
description: Praga Half Marathon is an annual running event held in Warsaw, attracting both amateurs and experienced runners. The half marathon route runs through the picturesque and historic parts of Praga, offering participants unique views and atmosphere. The event is held at night, which adds a special climate and appeal. Organizers provide professional service, electronic timing, and start packages with an official T-shirt.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic district of Praga in Warsaw
The race takes place in the evening, giving the event a nocturnal character
Scenic views and a unique atmosphere of the night half marathon
additional: Official race T-shirt for participants. Electronic timing. The event is held at night, starting at 20:00. Start packages with number and chip are available. The route is certified and secured. There is also an option to participate in a 5 km run - Praska 5k Run. The event includes results and details about the route and regulations. The races are accessible to a wide range of participants, and the event is increasingly popular among runners from Warsaw and the surrounding areas.

name: XLVI Usedom Marathon
description: The 46th International Usedom Marathon is a unique running event that takes place across two countries along Europe's longest seaside promenade. The 42 km route connects Polish Świnoujście with German Wolgast, passing through historic resorts and scenic forested areas. Runners can enjoy a variety of surfaces and beautiful views of the Baltic Sea, as well as the exceptional atmosphere of the Usedom island.
course_highlights: The route runs along Europe's longest seaside promenade
Passes through historic resorts Ahlbeck, Heringsdorf, and Bansin
Diverse surfaces: asphalt, cobblestone, and forest trails
additional: Transport to the marathon start is organized by buses from the organizer with a stop near the race office at 7:15 AM. There are options to board at various points on Usedom island. Baggage transport to the stadium in Wolgast is provided. Time limit: participants must pass Kölpinsee (km 21.8) within 2:30 hours and Zinnowitz (km 30) within 3:30 hours; otherwise, they will be withdrawn from the course. After exceeding time limits, there is no route security or refreshment points. Start in Świnoujście, finish in Wolgast, bus transfer available. Registration is open until August 30, 2026. The route includes urban, forest, and seaside sections.

name: 10. Parchener Fiener-Cross
description: The Parchener Fiener-Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Jerichower Land, taking place as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP race series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event attracts numerous runners of all ages each year and offers additional competitions with the Heidel-Team-Cup and family classification. The race is held at the Klapperhalle in Parkstraße in Parchen and is known for its varied cross-country course. The event promotes running in the region and combines athletic competition with a community experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in Jerichower Land
Start and finish at the Klapperhalle in Parchen
Part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP with Heidel-Team-Cup and family classification
additional: The event takes place near the Klapperhalle in Parchen, with refreshment points and a family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is done online, and results are published after the race.

name: 15. Brunsberglauf
location: Buchholz in der Nordheide, Lower Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld für die 5 km-, 11,7 km- und 21,1 km-Strecke

description: The 15th Brunsberg Run on September 6, 2026, in Buchholz/Holm-Seppensen offers runners a varied program with main races over 11.7 km, a half marathon, and a 5 km family run. The routes lead through forest and blooming heathland with highlights such as the Höllenschlucht, the Brunsberg, the Mühlenteich, and the Zwergentunnel. Additionally, there are four children's races for different age groups. The entire family can enjoy an attractive supporting program at the finish area. The Brunsberg Run is themed "Running and Doing Good" and supports charitable organizations in the region.
course_highlights: Routes through forest and blooming heathland
Highlights: Höllenschlucht, Brunsberg, Mühlenteich, Zwergentunnel
Mountain climb on the Brunsberg and team competitions
additional: The transponder for time measurement is rented free of charge and must be worn on the ankle (40 EUR fee in case of loss). Water stations are available on the long routes, and free drinks and snacks are provided at the finish. There are team competitions for 5 km and 11.7 km runs with at least four runners. Award ceremonies take place immediately after the races. Dogs are not allowed on the routes. Changing rooms, showers, and sports bag storage are available in the sports hall. Routes through forest and heathland, children's races, supporting program at the finish, donations for charitable purposes.

name: 16. Wardenburger Sommerlauf
description: The Wardenburger Summer Run is a traditional race in Wardenburg that appeals to runners of all ages. It offers various distances from 5 km up to the 10-mile run, with some starting together and splitting at Tillysee. The event emphasizes fair and well-organized execution with chip timing and provides runners with a varied course through the region. There are special runs for children without timing, and Nordic walking is also part of the program. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and support from an engaged organizing team.
course_highlights: Joint start of the 10 km and 10 miles until the split at Tillysee
Varied courses from 5 kilometers through the Wardenburg region
Timing with integrated chip in the bib
additional: On the day of the event, no late registrations are possible. Bibs with integrated chip must be returned at the finish area. Running with a dog is not allowed; baby joggers are permitted, and participants with baby joggers should line up at the back. There is a Bambini run without bib or timing. Toilets and changing facilities are available. No timing for runners exceeding the time limit of 16:00. Multiple distances are offered; some runs do not have timing. Participation is only with a bib; no late registrations on the event day. Organized via Laufmanager.

name: 23. Schoninger Volkslauf
description: The Schoningen Volkslauf is a traditional running event in the Solling, organized annually by SC Schoningen 04. The event offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to run on diverse courses through the beautiful landscape around Schoningen. The race is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a strong community that promotes sport and camaraderie. Every year, numerous runners participate to compete and enjoy a great running event together.
course_highlights: Running routes through the diverse landscape of the Solling
Course lengths from 6 km to 11 km (historically documented)
Family-friendly atmosphere with the strong community of SC Schoningen 04
additional: The race traditionally takes place in September. The event is organized by SC Schoningen 04, which also offers a wide sports program. There is no current online registration or price information available on the website. The start time of the event is usually at 10:00 AM. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and family runs, making it a staple in the regional race calendar. Registration and detailed course information are available on the official website.

name: 31. Fulda-Marathon

price_tiers.distance: Halbmarathon (Einzel und Team), 5 km, 11 km, Mini-Marathon

description: The Fulda Marathon is a special running experience right in the heart of Fulda, Hesse. The course passes the cathedral, through the baroque old town, and along the Fulda floodplains, with the finish line in the stadium. The race is organized voluntarily by the Fulda Athletics Community e.V. and offers a well-planned route as well as professional organization. In addition to the half marathon, there are other competitions such as 5 km, 11 km runs, and a mini marathon for various age groups.
course_highlights: Course passes the cathedral and through the baroque old town
Run through the natural landscapes of the Fulda floodplains
Finish line in the stadium of the city of Fulda
additional: Start times for the other runs: 10 km approx. 09:40 AM, 5 km approx. 10:00 AM, Mini-Marathon 2:00 PM (elementary school) and 3:00 PM (secondary level 1). The routes are clearly prepared for all competitions and can be downloaded. The event is organized voluntarily with comprehensive support along the route, medical care, and catering. There are T-shirts for the Fulda Marathon and a health check. Various competitions including half marathon, 11 km, 5 km, team and mini marathon; registration opens from February 1, 2026; please note participation conditions and cancellation fees; numerous refreshment and supply points, accompanying program, and medical support.

name: 37. CURREX Alsterlauf
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf is a traditional road race in Hamburg that takes place on a flat, traffic-free loop around the Binnenalster and Außenalster lakes. The event offers a unique start and finish atmosphere in Hamburg city center and is one of the largest 10-kilometer road races in Europe. In addition to the main 10 km race, there are also competitions over 5 km, a student race, and the R5K Tour for young runners. The courses are officially measured and well-suited for fast times.
course_highlights: Flat, traffic-free loop course around Binnenalster and Außenalster
Start and finish at Ballindamm in Hamburg city center
Officially measured courses according to World Athletics-/AIMS guidelines
additional: Start and finish of all competitions at Ballindamm. The courses are flat, paved, and traffic-free. Each kilometer is marked with signs. There is a high-quality functional shirt that can be ordered online until August 25, 2026, and will be handed out during the event weekend. The Hamburg 10 km road championships are held as part of the Alsterlauf. Event in Hamburg with around 5,400 participants annually, supported by the new title partner CURREX, including charity and hotel partnerships, results, photos, and health checks.

name: 38. Volkslauf des TSV Breuna
location: Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna, Breuna, Waldeck-Frankenberg, Hesse, Germany
description: The 38th Breunaer Malsburglauf will take place on September 6, 2026, and is a traditional running event at the Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna. The race offers an attractive course in the beautiful nature around Breuna and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is part of the Nordhessencup. Registration is via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna as a scenic backdrop
Various routes for different age and performance levels
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Training times for TSV Breuna Athletics: Tuesday 6:30 PM, Thursday 7:00 PM, children's training Tuesday 5:00 PM. Meeting point is always at the sports field. All details about the event are available in the linked PDF announcements. Race details are available in PDF announcements; registration is via raceresult.com.

name: 6. Tuchmacher Stadtlauf
description: The Tuchmacher City Run in Bramsche is a popular race with multiple courses that attracts numerous participants each year. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a varied route through the city center. The 10 km main race draws high-performance athletes, while the student race with large participation creates a lively atmosphere. The Bramscher Rumläufer organize the race with great commitment and support from local schools and sponsors.
course_highlights: Run through the Bramsche city center with full street scenery
Replacement bridge over the Talbachgraben for a springy running experience
Three distances: 2.1 km student race, 5 km and 10 km main races
additional: The student race regularly records high participant numbers, supported by the engagement of Bramsche schools. The event is supported by a large team of volunteers and sponsors. The Bramscher Rumläufer offer regular running training and a motivating running community in the region. Race held as part of the Sparkassen Cup, including the student race, with a communal atmosphere, no late registration possible.

name: 8. Flensburg liebt dich Marathon
description: The Flensburg loves you Marathon offers a diverse running experience with courses through the modern and historic city center of Flensburg, along Marina Sonwik, and at the harbor. The marathon consists of four laps of 10.55 km each, with maritime flair, and finishes at Südermarkt. Additionally, there is a half marathon over two laps on the same course, as well as other runs such as relay marathon, 10 km, and 5 km races. The event sends a positive message for community and quality of life in the region and warmly invites runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Four laps of 10.55 km through the city center, Marina Sonwik, and harbor
Flat streets along the fjord with maritime flair
Finish at Südermarkt in Flensburg
additional: For registrations from 24.08.2026 onwards, bib numbers are not personalized, no medal engraving and no shirts are offered. The distribution of race materials is upon presentation of the digital registration confirmation or an ID document. There is a participation limit of 1000 runners for the marathon and 2000 for the half marathon. The award ceremony takes place at Flensburg Galerie. Participation with electronic playback devices, walking sticks, baby joggers, strollers, and animals is not permitted for safety reasons. Online registration only, pick-up of race materials at Flensburg Galerie, various race distances including relay marathon, children's runs, and trial training sessions.

name: DresdenHALF
location: Dresden city center, Dresden, Saxony, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Die Teilnahme am DresdenHALF KidsRUN kostet 10 Euro.

description: The DresdenHALF is an exhilarating half marathon that will take runners through the heart of Dresden for the first time on September 6, 2026. The 21.1-kilometer course runs along the Elbe River and past the city's most beautiful sights, with each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden's partner cities. The event offers runners a unique running experience with a historic backdrop and international flair. In addition to the half marathon, there are also races for children and hobby runners, making the weekend a special running event.
course_highlights: 21.1 km through the heart of Dresden along the Elbe
Each mile symbolically dedicated to one of Dresden's 13 partner cities
Start at the World Trade Center Dresden, finish at the Saxon State Parliament
additional: Start and finish of the DresdenHALF are at the World Trade Center Dresden and the Saxon State Parliament. The course is officially measured and eligible for rankings. Participation is possible from age 16, with a time limit of 3 hours. Race materials will be distributed on September 4 and 5, 2026, at the World Trade Center Dresden. Each participant receives exclusive arm sleeves and a finisher medal. For the EWG Dresden5K, there is an exclusive pom-pom hat. Transfer of starting places is possible for a fee. All participants in the KidsRUN will receive a finisher medal and a certificate. The course is officially measured, participation is from age 16, with a 3-hour time limit, merchandise and transfer of starting places are possible, including children's races and pre-event activities on September 5.

name: Bahndammlauf
description: The Buchholzer Railway Embankment Run is a varied running event that combines nature and enjoyment. The course leads from the stadium over the railway embankment through the districts of Wahl and Wallau to the Franziskuskreuz, with a challenging uphill section to Mückensee, the highest point of the route. Afterwards, it mostly goes downhill or flat towards Asbach-Walgenbach with several refreshment stations. The event takes place at the sports field of SV Buchholz 05 and offers, in addition to the run, an extensive cake buffet as well as hearty food from the Grillhexen. Participation supports the Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V.
course_highlights: Running course with slight incline through Wahl and Wallau
800 m uphill section to the highest point at Mückensee
Several refreshment stations along the route
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 45 minutes before the start for a late registration fee of €5. The documents can be collected from 07:30 at the start and finish area. The event supports the Förderkreis für krebskranke Kinder und Jugendliche Bonn e.V. There is an award ceremony immediately after each race with trophies and certificates for the top three finishers. Free parking is available at the nearby REWE parking lot. Participation conditions, route profiles, childcare, registration via RaceResult, results and certificates are available online, with donations going to children with cancer.

name: Breunaer Volkslauf mit 21,1km Malsburglauf
description: The 38th Breunaer Malsburglauf will take place on September 6, 2026, and is an established running event in Breuna. The race runs through the Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna and offers an attractive course for runners. The event is organized by TSV Breuna e.V. and is aimed at runners of various age and performance levels. Registration is available via the RaceResult platform.
course_highlights: Run through the Lauf- und Wanderpark Breuna
Attractive course with scenic surroundings
Traditional event with a long-standing history
additional: The training times for TSV Breuna athletics are Tuesdays at 6:30 PM and Thursdays at 7:00 PM, with children's training on Tuesdays at 5:00 PM. The meeting point is always at the sports field. All details about the race are available in linked PDF announcements. The event offers water stations, on-site catering, showers, and changing facilities. Certificates, trophies, and prizes are awarded for various competitions, including team rankings in the half marathon. Children receive participation certificates, and there is local catering with coffee, cake, and barbecue options after the race.

name: Canyon Run Mühlheim
description: The Canyon Run in Mühlheim am Main is Hesse's most beautiful forest run through the Mühlheim quarries and takes place on September 6, 2026. The event offers flat, officially measured courses with attractive prize money and material prizes as well as a unique atmosphere with live music at the finish area. There are various distances for runners of all ages, from a 400m mini-run to the half marathon, accompanied by excellent catering along the route. Additionally, the run supports social projects in the region, making the Canyon Run a special community experience.
course_highlights: Flat, officially measured courses through the Mühlheim quarries and the Mühlheim forest
Half marathon with 80 meters of elevation, 10km with 50 meters of elevation, 5km with 20 meters of elevation
Start and finish at the sports grounds in Dietesheim with live music and excellent catering
additional: Net time measurement via transponder by RST Volkslauf GmbH. Prize money and material prizes for the fastest male and female runners. Team rankings for companies, clubs, and schools. Professional photos at the finish area. Charity run with donations to local social institutions. Runs for families, kids, teams; including catering, prize money, photos, community activities.

name: Crow Mountain Survival
description: The Crow Mountain Survival Obstacle Race in Bremen is an exciting adventure that takes place on September 6, 2026, entering its 9th edition. The course lengths range from 1.2 km for children to 15 km for experienced runners, featuring challenging obstacles and spectacular water passages, including a floating crossing of Lake Werder. The event offers challenges for beginners, seasoned OCR veterans, as well as inclusive runs for people with disabilities. The varied course leads through forests, meadows, and different terrains, demanding endurance, strength, and agility. There are special runs without timing for children and newcomers to facilitate entry.
course_highlights: Spectacular water crossing through Lake Werder
Varied course through forests, meadows, and different terrains
Challenging obstacles including climbing, balancing, crawling, and hanging
additional: Wave start with 10 people every 60 seconds for 5 km, 10 km, and 15 km runs; division by pace upon registration; youth run and inclusion run without timing; medals and certificates for all participants; start times vary depending on the distance, e.g., youth run at 09:30, taster run at 12:00; children under 12 require prior approval to participate on certain courses. Course lengths from 5 km to 15 km, including water passages, natural routes through forests and meadows, challenging obstacles, including youth run, taster run, and inclusion run.

name: Gölitztallauf
description: The Gölitztallauf is an annual race held in Marktgölitz, celebrating its 44th edition on September 6, 2026. The race is divided into four different courses, including a children's course over 1 km. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and offers awards in various age categories. The award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to minimize waiting times for participants.
course_highlights: Four different courses, including a 1 km children's course
Start and finish at the Freibad Marktgölitz
Run through the Gölitztal with scenic surroundings
additional: The award ceremonies take place shortly after the races to minimize waiting times. Robust bib numbers are used. The organization has been adjusted to make the distribution of bib numbers and payment more efficient. The event is part of the Sparkassen-Cup and the TLV-Cup. It is also part of the TLV-Laufercup, with detailed course information and online registration available. The event takes place in warm weather, with on-site catering and award ceremonies.

name: Hochgratlauf
description: The Hochgrat Run is a traditional mountain race on the highest peak of the Allgäu Nagelfluh Chain. The course covers 12.8 kilometers with a vertical gain of 714 meters and a summit height of 1,834 meters. In addition to the main race, there is a youth mountain run for participants born between 2010 and 2015 on a shortened course. The race takes place annually and attracts runners and spectators from near and far, who enjoy the challenge and the scenic beauty of the Allgäu Alps.
course_highlights: 12.8 kilometer course with 714 meters of elevation gain
Finish on the summit of Hochgrat (1,834 meters)
Run through the Allgäu Alps with impressive views
additional: Youth mountain run on a shortened course from Staufner Haus to the mountain station (550 meters long, 74 meters elevation difference) on gravel/stone paths. Good mountain gear and grippy running shoes recommended. Registration on race day from 08:30 to 10:00 with a late registration fee. The first 140 registrants receive a 2-hour Aquaria voucher. Clubs with at least four participants receive an additional gift. Terrain includes mountain trails in the Allgäu Alps; on-site registration possible with late fee; participation conditions apply.

name: Internationaler Altenaulauf
description: The International Altenaulauf in Borchen is a traditional race event organized by SC Borchen 1926/32, Athletics Department. The race takes place annually and is part of the Hochstift Cup. In addition to the sporting competition, social engagement is demonstrated by offering coffee and cake free of charge and collecting donations for the Lichtblicke e.V. charity. The event provides an attractive platform for runners of various age groups and performance levels.
course_highlights: Part of the Hochstift Cup
Various courses for different age groups
Traditional race with social engagement
additional: Coffee and cake are offered free of charge at the cake stand. Donations for Lichtblicke e.V. are collected. Runners can register for courses online; the event also includes social activities such as coffee and cake as well as donations for 'Lichtblicke e.V.'

name: Kasseler Frauenlauf 2026
description: The Kassel Women's Run is a charitable race for women in Kassel-Wehlheiden, traditionally held on the first weekend of September at the Buchenau sports field. The event emphasizes movement without performance pressure: there are no timing, rankings, or pressure to achieve personal bests. Participants can run, jog, walk, or stroll, with offerings for short children's races as well as 5 km and 10 km walk-run distances on flat courses. The day supports women in need and promotes a relaxed community atmosphere with warm-up programs, music, food, a raffle, childcare, applause, and participation certificates.
course_highlights: Flat course on 5 km and 10 km
Children's races of 400 m and 800 m
Finish at the Hessenkampfbahn on Auedamm
additional: No timing or rankings, participation as running, jogging, walking, or strolling possible. Community atmosphere with warm-up, music, food, raffle, childcare, and participation certificates. The event takes place at the Buchenau sports field in Kassel-Wehlheiden and emphasizes a relaxed, inclusive participation for women and children of all ages.

name: Lauf mal wieder mit in Schmidt
description: TuS Schmidt cordially invites you to the 13th Run once again in Schmidt on Sunday, September 7, 2025. The race features a challenging new half marathon with a distance of 22 km and 480 meters of elevation through the beautiful Eifel landscape. The event is open to runners of all ages and is part of the Eifel Cup as well as the Regio-Aachen Cup 2025. In addition to the half marathon, there are also races over 4 km and 10.8 km, with awards for the fastest female and male runners of TuS Schmidt in each category.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 22 km length
480 meters of elevation in the Eifel
Races over 4 km, 10.8 km, and half marathon
additional: Cut-off time for the half marathon is 2:00 PM (3 hours after start). The races are scoring events for the Eifel Cup 2025 and the Regio-Aachen Cup 2025. The event awards the fastest female and male runners of TuS Schmidt in the distances of 4 km, 10.8 km, and half marathon. The race takes place annually in September, starting at 11:00 AM and with a cut-off time at 2:00 PM; the event is also suitable for families and children, with special children's races and medals for all children.

name: Lautrer Lebenslauf
organizer: Mama / Papa hat Krebs Kaiserslautern e.V.
description: The Lautrer Lifeline is a charity run in Kaiserslautern that demonstrates solidarity with people with cancer and their families. The event offers runs over 1 km for children as well as 5 km and 10 km forest courses for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. All proceeds support the 'Mama/Papa has Cancer' Kaiserslautern e.V. support association and enable free assistance services for children of parents or siblings with cancer. In 2026, a technical timing system with trackers will be used for the first time to make the event even more professional.
course_highlights: Children's run over 1 km
5 km and 10 km forest courses for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers
Start and finish at the South School Center in Kaiserslautern city forest
additional: Race numbers are issued after registration, pickup on site. Certificates are issued on site or sent via email. Results list will be published online on the Tuesday after the run. In 2026, technical timing with start numbers equipped with 2 trackers will be used for the first time. Runs are also suitable for walkers and Nordic walkers. The proceeds benefit the aid project 'Mama/Papa has Cancer'. Participation is at your own risk, no prizes for winners, certificates available online, online registration until August 27, 2026, start at the South School Center.

name: Lembecker Galgenberglauf
description: The Lembecker Galgenberglauf is a traditional race with over 40 years of history, taking place in the Hohe Mark Nature Park. The courses run through gently hilly forested areas and offer runners a special natural experience. Various distances are offered, from a 400 m toddler run to the main 10 km race, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is family-friendly and suitable for all age groups.
course_highlights: Courses run through gently hilly forested areas in the Hohe Mark Nature Park
Race routes exclusively on forest paths, some gravelled
Light inclines on the course
additional: Start times staggered by distance and age group from 09:30 to 10:40 AM. Refreshments with tea and water available at the start and finish areas, breakfast is offered. No showers or changing facilities available. Late registration fee for personal registration on the event day is €3.00. Race on forest paths with slight inclines, registration online or on the event day, no showers or changing rooms, refreshments with tea, water, and breakfast.

name: New Balance KÖ MEILE 2026
price_range: kostenlos bis 28 Euro, je nach Kategorie und Meldedatum
description: The New Balance Kö Meile is a unique running event on Düsseldorf's Königsallee, taking place on September 6, 2026. It offers runners of all performance levels a running party with great atmosphere, music, confetti, and a special ambiance right in the city center. The event includes various races over 5 km, the mile (1.609 meters), as well as children's and youth races. The course is officially measured, asphalted, and certified by World Athletics, making it eligible for best lists. Whether aiming for a personal best or participating in your first race, the focus is on the shared running experience.
course_highlights: Officially measured, asphalted loop course on Königsallee
Official World Ranking Competition with World Athletics certification
Atmosphere with DJ Truck, Cheering Zone, medal, and donuts
additional: The 5 km races are divided by target times to avoid overtaking. There is a limited edition event functional shirt available for order only with registration. The elite mile for women and men, as well as the REHACARE Inclusion ½ mile, are invitation races. Late registrations are possible until the day of the event with a late registration surcharge, but only up to the maximum number of participants. Officially measured, certified loop course, various race categories, personalized bibs available until August 30, 2026, event shirts for purchase, race packets can be picked up on September 4 and 5, 2026, shipping options available upon registration.

name: R5K - 5K Alsterlauf Hamburg 2026
description: The CURREX Alsterlauf Hamburg is a traditional race event with officially measured, flat, and asphalted loop courses along the Outer Alster and on the Ballindamm. The event offers various distances, including 10 km, 5 km, and youth runs, and is aimed at runners of all ages. The races are traffic-free and safely accompanied by police and marshals. As part of the Alsterlauf, the Hamburg Championships over 10 km road race are also held.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted loop courses along the Outer Alster and on the Ballindamm
Officially measured routes according to World Athletics-/AIMS guidelines
Traffic-free course with kilometer markings and safe escort
additional: Start and finish of all competitions are at Ballindamm. Cut-off time for the 5 km race is 12:15 PM. Eligibility to participate is based on birth year with a minimum performance of 22:00 minutes for R5K. Functional T-shirt can be ordered online until August 25, 2026, and will only be handed out during the event weekend, no postal shipping. The event is suitable for runners of all levels, with fixed start times and official timing. It offers a great opportunity to experience Hamburg actively and enjoy the Alster up close.

name: SaarschleifenLand-Lauf
description: The SaarschleifenLand Run in Merzig offers a diverse running program for all age groups with distances from 250 meters up to the half marathon. The main race is particularly exciting, allowing participants during the race to decide whether they want to run 15 km or the half marathon (21.1 km). The course runs along the picturesque Saarleinpfad with beautiful panoramic views and incorporates the city championship in the half marathon. The event is family-friendly with children and youth runs and offers showers as well as clothing storage in the Merzig City Hall.
course_highlights: Run along the Saarleinpfad with river views
Decision between 15 km and half marathon during the race
Panorama at Gangolfer Biotop and Leinpfad
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Start and finish are at Merzig City Hall with parking directly at the venue. Showers are available at Blättelbornstadion approximately 500 meters away. Clothing storage is available in the City Hall. The city championship in the half marathon is determined based on postal code. Various race distances, including youth, children, and main runs, registration on-site possible, finisher medals for all participants.

name: Schapener Volkslauf
description: The Schapener Volkslauf offers runners and walkers various course lengths in a natural setting around the village of Schapen and the Riddagshäuser ponds. The courses lead through idyllic forest and pond areas as well as historic sites such as the Schapen train station. The 1.2 km route is particularly family-friendly, mainly intended for children and adolescents as well as their accompanying persons. The event features a joint warm-up, children's care, and massages for a donation, and warmly invites all running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course around the Riddagshäuser ponds and through the Buchhorst
6.1 km course past Schäfer’s Ruh and the historic Schapen train station
1.2 km course for children and adolescents, to be completed once or twice
additional: Start times vary depending on the course from 9:15 AM to 10:20 AM. There is a joint warm-up, children's care, and massages for a donation. The event is organized by the Turn- und Sportverein 1921 Schapen e.V. The event takes place in September 2026, including various running and walking distances, as well as accompanying activities such as warm-up, children's care, and massages.

name: Sparkassen-Stadtlauf
description: The 20th Sparkassen City Run in Wachtendonk will take place on September 6, 2026, transforming the community into a lively running arena. The event is open to all age and performance groups, from ambitious runners and hobby joggers to families. Starting at 2:00 PM, competitions will begin at Friedensplatz, accompanied by an exhilarating atmosphere, a colorful supporting program, and dedicated volunteers. The run offers athletic achievements and personal success moments in a communal atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied competitions for all age and performance groups
Start and finish at Friedensplatz in Wachtendonk
Exciting atmosphere along the route and colorful supporting program
additional: Registration is conveniently available via the registration button on the website. The event will be organized and managed for the first time by the municipality of Wachtendonk. There is a colorful supporting program and dedicated volunteers creating a special atmosphere. Races for all age and performance groups, online registration, supporting program, at Friedensplatz

name: Stadtallendorfer Stadtlauf
description: The Stadtallendorf City Run takes place as part of the Heimat- und Soldatenfest in Stadtallendorf and is organized by TSV Stadtallendorf in cooperation with the Bundeswehr. The race course is a loop through Heinz-Lang-Park and the adjacent stadium. Competitions are offered for various performance levels, including a fun run over 5 kilometers and a main race over 10 kilometers. Following these are competitions for youth and children. The race attracts numerous athletes and offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and festive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Loop course through Heinz-Lang-Park
Course passes through the adjacent stadium
Competitions for all performance levels from children to seniors
additional: The race is part of the Stadtallendorf Heimat- und Soldatenfest. There are separate competitions for fun runners (5 km), main race (10 km), youth, and children. The event is organized in cooperation with the Bundeswehr. Participants start in new race shirts donated by the company KHS. Course length: 5 km and 10 km; start location in Stadtallendorf; weather in September averages 19°C, cloudy.

name: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum
price_range: 25 Euro für Finisher-Shirt, weitere Gebühren variieren

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum bei Meldung bis 30.06.2026 - 45 €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Stadtwerke Halbmarathon Bochum bei Meldung bis 26.08.2026 - 55 €

description: The Stadtwerke Half Marathon Bochum 2026 is a traditional race that runs through the city center of Bochum. The course includes an introductory lap and three large laps with approximately 150 meters of elevation gain, making the race varied and challenging. In addition to the half marathon, there are relay races, a 10 km run, a 5 km run, a student race, and a children's race. The event also offers a comprehensive supporting program and a training run starting from May 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course with approx. 150 meters of positive elevation gain
10 km run with approx. 50 meters of positive elevation gain in 2 laps
Measured courses according to DLV standards
additional: Online registration opens on February 1, 2026. Late registrations on September 5, 2026 (4-7 PM) and on the event day until 60 minutes before the start are possible for a fee, subject to availability. Finisher shirts can be pre-ordered for 25 euros and are available on the event day. Cancellations and refunds are not possible, but transfers are allowed for a fee. The training run starts on May 12, 2026. Registration opens on February 1, 2026, and closes on August 26, 2026; options for shirt, transfer, and changes; no refunds; event held in Bochum city center.

name: Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 6,00 € für Kinder & Jugendliche bis einschl. Jahrgang 2008

description: The Stadtwerkelauf Pinneberg is a traditional race event taking place on September 6, 2026, in Pinneberg. The event offers various running distances for children, adolescents, and adults, including a 1 km taster run for kindergarten children, a 2.5 km beginner run and team race, as well as 5 km and 10 km courses for older participants. The races lead over green loops through the Pinneberger Fahlt and around the Drosteipark, with start and finish centrally located on Am Drosteipark street. The event is family-friendly and allows spectators to continuously watch and cheer on the children during the taster run.
course_highlights: Green loop through the Pinneberger Fahlt and around the Drosteipark
Taster run for children with 2 laps around the Drosteipark
Start and finish centrally on Am Drosteipark street
additional: Race bibs (start numbers including transponder) will be issued on September 4, 2026, from 09:00 to 19:00 and on September 5, 2026, from 09:00 to 16:00 at the VfL-Sportzentrum Fahltskam. Late registrations are possible online until one hour before the start for an additional fee of €5.00. The team classification is based on the combined times of 3 runners; mixed teams are allowed. Registration is possible online, with bib pickup on September 4 and 5 at the VfL-Sportzentrum. Late registrations incur a fee. The start and finish area is located at the Drosteiwiese.

name: Staffellauf der MBB-SG Augsburg
description: The 41st Augsburg Relay Race of MBB SG Augsburg will take place on September 6, 2026, in Siebentischwald in Augsburg. The event offers a relay marathon with three runners, each running one lap of 7,032.5 meters, as well as an individual start over the half marathon distance of 21.1 kilometers. The course is paved, flat, fast, and mostly runs through the forest, creating ideal conditions for runners of all performance levels. Additionally, there is a hobby run over one lap of about 7 kilometers, which is especially suitable for beginners. The route is well marked and designed as a turnaround course.
course_highlights: Asphalted, flat, and fast course
Mostly in the forest with a pleasant natural scenery
Turnaround course with clear markings
additional: The course is designed as a turnaround course. The relay consists of three runners, each running one lap of 7,032.5 meters. Individual runners cover the full half marathon distance of 21.1 km. The hobby run is a single lap of approximately 7 km, ideal for beginners or fast lap runners. Payment is generally made via direct debit. Venue: Parking lot at Sportanlage Süd, Siebenbrunner Straße 21, 86161 Augsburg; including relay, individual, and children’s runs, in typical September weather.

name: Wallmeroder Bahnhofslauf/ 34. Nat. Straßenlauf
description: The Wallmeroder Bahnhofslauf is a traditional road race in Wallmerod, Germany, taking place in 2026 for the 34th time. The event, organized by the local sports club TuS Wallmerod, includes two distances: a short run of 400 meters and a half marathon of 21.1 kilometers. The race starts early in the morning and is firmly established in the German road running calendar. The course is thematically inspired by the town's train station and primarily targets local runners and club athletes.
course_highlights: Road race with train station theme
Distances: 400 m and 21.1 km (half marathon)
Traditional event with over 30 years of history
additional: Results from previous years are available online, with an archive dating back to the early 2000s. Participants receive certificates and can access individual result queries. The weather in September is typically mild, around 19°C during the day and 10°C at night, usually cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place in typical September weather in Wallmerod. Participants receive certificates and result queries, with a focus on local runners.

name: Wardenburger Sommerlauf
location: IGS am Everkamp, Wardenburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wardenburger Summer Run is a traditional race organized by runners for runners, taking place at the IGS on Everkamp in Wardenburg. Various distances are offered starting from 5 kilometers, including a 5 km open race, a 10 km public run, and a 10-mile run. The races are characterized by a varied course, with the division of the 10 km and 10-mile races at Tillysee serving as an important orientation point. The event emphasizes fair and well-organized conduct with chip timing and also offers special runs for children.
course_highlights: Joint start of the 10 km and 10 miles until the division at Tillysee
Varied routes from 5 km with Komoot link for precise course navigation
Division of 10 km runners to the right and 10 miles runners to the left at Tillyhügel
additional: On the day of the event, no late or additional registrations are possible. Bib numbers are equipped with integrated chips for timing and must be visibly worn. Runners with baby joggers are asked to line up at the end of the start. Running with dogs is not permitted. There is a Bambini run without bib number and timing. Returning the bib at the finish area is mandatory; failure to do so will incur a fee of €5. The time limit for runners is 4:00 PM. Toilets are available on site. The event takes place on September 5, 2026, at the IGS on Everkamp in Wardenburg. Various race categories are offered, with chip timing via bib numbers, no registration on the day of the event, and facilities such as toilets, changing rooms, and showers.

name: Dörverden läuft 2026
description: The race in Dörverden is a versatile running event suitable for all age and performance levels. The measured courses range from 1.8 km for walking, running, and strolling to the main race over 10 km, which consists of two laps of 5 km each. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and promotes community sports in the Lower Saxony region. The races start in staggered intervals from 10:00 AM, allowing each participant to find their suitable competition.
course_highlights: Measured courses from 1.8 km to 10 km
Main race over 10 km in two laps of 5 km each
Separate competitions for walking, running, and strolling
additional: Four competitions with start times between 10:00 and 11:25 AM. All courses are measured. The event is open to everyone, from walking and strolling to experienced runners. The organizer is TSV Dörverden von 1908 e.V. The event begins in the morning at 10:00 AM, the courses are measured, and registration is available online via the organizer's website. It attracts approximately 300 to 500 participants and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Fränkische Schweiz-Marathon
description: The Franconian Switzerland Marathon takes place on September 6, 2026, in the picturesque landscape of Franconian Switzerland. The route runs from Neideck to Walberla, passing through idyllic villages, castles, and rocks. The car-free federal highway provides optimal running conditions. Tens of thousands of spectators and a diverse accompanying program give the event a folk festival character. The anniversary edition warmly invites runners of all performance levels to participate.
course_highlights: Route through the wild-romantic landscape of Franconian Switzerland
Course from Neideck to Walberla with picturesque villages, castles, and rocks
Car-free federal highway for optimal running conditions
additional: Helmets are mandatory for handbikers and Run & Bike participants. The route is car-free and offers optimal conditions. There is a colorful accompanying program and numerous spectators along the route. Participation conditions of the German Athletics Association (DLV) apply. The event also includes award ceremonies, partner runs, accommodations, and course records. Additionally, rail and road traffic closures will be implemented to ensure smooth proceedings.

name: Geithainer Herbstlauf
description: The Geithainer Autumn Run is a family-friendly autumn race held at the Geithain Stadium in Geithain, Germany. The event offers various distances for all age groups, including a 300 m kids' run, a 2.5 km chestnut run for children, as well as a 7 km pleasure run, 7 km walk, and a 17 km scenic run for older participants and walkers. Start and finish are located in the stadium, and the routes are GPS-measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. In addition to the races, there is a children's program, bouncy castle, certificates, medals, and small prizes, with every fifth finisher from 7 km onwards rewarded with a bottle of sparkling wine.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Geithain Stadium
GPS-measured routes ranging from 0.3 km to 17 km
Family-friendly program with children's runs and walking routes
additional: Every fifth finisher in the 7 km or longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine. The event is organized by Impact Geithain e. V. with support from FSV Alemannia Geithain e. V. The children's program and bouncy castle are part of the event. The event includes children's runs, childcare, certificates, finisher medals, small prizes for children, and a special bonus: every fifth finisher in the longer races receives a bottle of sparkling wine.

name: Glomb City Marathon Bremerhaven
description: The GLOMB City Marathon Bremerhaven is an annual marathon held in Bremerhaven, taking place since 2005. The event includes not only the marathon but also a half marathon and a 10 km run. The course is a flat loop starting and finishing in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche, passing through the city center and the Havenwelten. Runners experience an attractive route with many sights and a unique backdrop along the water and harbor facilities. The organizer is the event agency Execute Sports Events, which ensures professional organization.
course_highlights: Flat loop course through the city center and Havenwelten of Bremerhaven
Start and finish in front of the Bürgermeister-Smidt-Gedächtniskirche
Course runs along the water, harbor basin, Klimahaus, and U-boat Wilhelm Bauer
additional: Timing is fully electronic with a transponder integrated into the bib number, which can be disposed of after the race. There are group registrations with a 10% team discount for 10 or more participants (registration via info@execute-sports.de). Event shirts can be ordered and will be handed out at the bib pickup. The course is known as the Haven City Run and offers spectators short distances and good visibility of the runners. The event also features a sports and business fair as well as corporate and government runs. The weather in September is usually mild around 19°C, mostly cloudy. The course is known for its flatness, making it ideal for fast times.

name: Běh s Klokanem
description: The Kangaroo Run is a traditional cross-country race in Olomouc-Hejčín, held annually at the end of September. The race is designed for children, youth, and adult athletes, and is part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix. Men run 9 km, women 7 km, and shorter distances are available for children according to age categories. The event is not only sporting but also social, with accompanying activities for children and parents, including games, scooter rides, puzzles, and a raffle. Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn by the Mill Stream.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in terrain by the Mill Stream in Olomouc-Hejčín
Men run 9 km, women 7 km, children have courses from 60 m to 1.5 km depending on age
Part of the Olomouc Region Children's and Youth Running Cup and the Olomouc Region Endurance Runners Grand Prix
additional: Registration takes place at the U Travise Inn. The accompanying program includes scooter rides, sack jumping, puzzles, horse riding, a photo booth with a kangaroo, an educational trail about kangaroos, a performance by the band 3+1, and a raffle with valuable prizes. All children at the finish line receive sweets. Cross-country terrain, registration at the U Travise Inn, family event.

name: Ostrava City Marathon
location: Masarykovo náměstí, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 600-1500 Kč podle druhu závodu a data registrace
description: The Ostrava City Marathon is the oldest marathon in the Czech Republic and a summer running festival full of fun for all runners. It takes place on September 6, 2026, in the center of Ostrava at Masaryk Square and offers courses for various performance levels including a mini-marathon, 10 km, half marathon, and marathon. The event is suitable for both competitive runners and hobbyists, and includes a charitable MiniMarathon. In addition to the races, a rich accompanying program is prepared to enliven the city center with sport and culture.
course_highlights: The course passes through historic, industrial, and green parts of Ostrava
Refreshment stations are located approximately every 5 km with water, isotonic drinks, and food
Start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on Saturday, September 5, 2026, from 14:00 to 19:00 and on Sunday, September 6, 2026, from 6:30 to 8:00 at the Ostrava University City Campus. The race time is measured with chip technology embedded in the non-refundable race bibs. Mobile toilets and baggage storage are available at Masaryk Square. Showers and changing rooms are available in the City Campus building. Refreshments are available approximately every 5 km and at the finish line. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square in the center of Ostrava. Men over 70 and women over 60 can register for free for the marathon after obtaining a registration code via email at info@ostravacitymarathon.cz. On-site registration is also possible. The event offers refreshments, showers, medals, and other equipment for participants.

name: Podčerchovský kros
location: Chodov u Domažlic, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Podčerchovský cross country is a demanding cross-country run held on Babí Hora near Chodov, which takes place on forest paths with several challenging ascents. The longest loop measures 2.5 km and is suitable for runners using spikes. The race is open to all age categories and offers various distances from children's categories to the main men's race. Results are announced shortly after the race, and winners receive medals, material prizes, and in the main category, monetary rewards.
course_highlights: The course runs on forest paths
The longest loop is 2.5 km with several demanding ascents
Option to use spikes
additional: Results for all categories are announced at 12:30. Categories have different distances: 1100 m (2x550 m), 4000 m (2x2000 m), 5000 m (2x2500 m), 7500 m (3x2500 m). Monetary rewards are paid in the main men's category and overall women's ranking according to the organizer's possibilities. The race offers pre-registration and on-site registration options, with over 100 runners participating, including children and youth, and is part of the Běžec Chodska series.

name: Běh na Lahti
description: We invite you to the 47th edition of the traditional running race Lahti Run, which takes place on September 6, 2026, in Děčín. The race offers two courses - the main route nearly 10 km long with an elevation gain of 230 meters, leading over the Kvádberk lookout to the village of Ludvíkovice, and a shortened route of just under 5 km with an elevation gain of 130 meters. The trail runs through the terrain in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River, ensuring beautiful views and a challenging run. Registration and check-in are on-site at the start from 8:00 to 9:45 AM, with the race starting at 9:00.
course_highlights: Terrain trail in the Děčín forests above the sandstone canyon of the Elbe River
Main course 9.8 km with a 230 m elevation gain, start at Kvádberk lookout
Shortened course 4.9 km with a 130 m elevation gain, turnaround at the cemetery in Ludvíkovice
additional: Registration and check-in on-site at the start (Kvádberk lookout) from 8:00 to 9:45. Children's races range from 100 to 1000 meters depending on the category. The main course is a loop with a turnaround after 5 km, the shortened course has a turnaround after 2.5 km. Online registration is available as well as on-site. Course maps and GPX files are available on the race website. The race takes place above the sandstone canyon and offers various distances suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - září
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, and winners are announced in each category.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Scenic environment near the fountain in the park, except for June and August races near the river
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places are announced in each category. The race is part of an annual trophy competition with results adjusted according to age coefficient and points accumulated for participation in multiple races. The race is held on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady, registration is voluntary and takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The event focuses on the joy of movement and supporting the sporting spirit.

name: Rychnov pomáhá během
location: Rychnov nad Kněžnou, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Rychnov helps during the charity running race organized in Rychnov nad Kněžnou, which offers routes for children and adults in various age categories. The race takes place at the beginning of September and is known for its friendly atmosphere, accompanying program, and support for those in need. Each participant receives a start package and a medal, and the top runners in each category receive valuable prizes. The event also features an autograph session and a fun quiz for prizes, contributing to family comfort and community spirit.
course_highlights: Routes for children from 400 m to 10 km for adults
Start and finish at Poláčkovo Square in Rychnov nad Kněžnou
Option to watch children during the race
additional: The accompanying program includes free taping and physiotherapy for runners, Spartan obstacles for children, a bouncy castle, creative workshops, face painting, InBody body diagnostics, and a photo booth. Refreshments offer sweet and savory snacks, lemonade, coffee, beer, and grilled specialties. There is a storage, changing rooms, and toilets available. The event supports charitable causes, includes online and on-site registration, and is complemented by photo galleries and support for female athletes.

name: Běh mezi mosty
description: Run between the bridges is a charitable sporting event organized by Domácí hospic Athelas and the Friends of the Stone Bridge Písek Association. This run, which revives the tradition of the original race, is intended for everyone who wants to support seriously ill patients and their families. Participants can run, walk, or make a symbolic contribution, with the entry fee being a donation that helps ensure home care for those who can no longer run. The event takes place in Písek and offers various routes including children's runs and family walks.
course_highlights: Routes lead on concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, bridges, and forest terrain
The profile of the tracks is mostly flat with a hilly elevation of 144 m
The race takes place around the Stone Bridge in Písek with safety measures and volunteer support
additional: Registration is possible electronically and on-site on the race day at the Stone Bridge. Starting numbers and chips are issued from 11:00. The program begins at 12:00, warm-up for children at 13:00. Children's runs start at 13:15, main runs from 14:00 to 15:30. Routes are marked with white arrows, there is a pacer and volunteers on the track. Parking, facilities, and refreshments are provided. After the race, results are announced and a raffle takes place. Terrain includes concrete, asphalt, cobblestones, bridges, and forest; T-shirts are available for purchase on-site; various age categories and distances are available.

name: Jihlavský půlmaraton

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 500 Kč na osobu při elektronickém přihlášení a bezhotovostní platbě

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč při osobním přihlášení na místě závodu

description: Jihlava Half Marathon is a traditional running race over 21.0975 km, held on two loops in the center of Jihlava. The race is open to individuals, pairs, and groups of four, offering an officially measured course with kilometer markers. The event also includes a Family Run and children's races, supporting a charitable project for Filípek. The event takes place at the Český mlýn complex and offers quality facilities, chip timing, and refreshments for runners.
course_highlights: Officially measured course of 21.0975 km on two loops
Course marked every kilometer
Start and finish at the Sport and Relaxation Center Český mlýn in Jihlava
additional: Start number includes a chip for timing measurement, which is not returned. The time limit for the half marathon is 3 hours; the course will be closed at 15:00. You can order a T-shirt during online registration for 250 CZK, on-site for 300 CZK until supplies last. The race also features relay teams of two and four, a Family Run (1.1 km), and children's races. Race registration opens on race day from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Český mlýn complex. The race takes place on two loops, starting in the center of Jihlava, with online or on-site registration available. The time limit is 3 hours. The race day is September 6, 2026.

name: Běžíme pro náhradní rodiny
description: Running for Foster Families is an event organized by CPNRP, o.p.s., which supports children growing up in foster care and their foster parents. The event aims to raise awareness about the needs of these children and promote a stable and loving environment for their development. The run is an opportunity for the general public to express support and solidarity with foster families. The organization has long-term involvement in professional counseling, education, and support for foster and adoptive families.
course_highlights: Various route lengths including 4 km, 8 km, 1 km for strollers and walkers
Support for foster families and children in care through proceeds
Family activities, face painting, and accompanying program
additional: The event takes place on September 6, 2026, and is part of a broader charitable project to support children's care, with online registration and accompanying activities.

name: Horský čtvrtmaraton Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch
location: Jablonné nad Orlicí, areál koupaliště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Jablonné nad Orlicí - Suchý vrch Mountain Quarter Marathon is a mountain race taking place on September 6, 2026, in Jablonné nad Orlicí. The course runs through mountain terrain to Suchý vrch and is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and the Krkonošský Cup in uphill running. The race offers approximately 10 km with an elevation gain of around 580 meters, with the course demanding endurance and running technique in mountain terrain. Registrations are possible on-site, and the race is intended for runners seeking a challenge in nature.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain environment at Suchý vrch
Elevation gain of approximately 580 meters over about 10 km
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race starts at the swimming pool area in Jablonné nad Orlicí, the course runs through mixed terrain, registration is possible on-site, the start is at 10:30 AM, registration deadline is before the race begins.

name: 14 Tyski Półmaraton
location: Stadion Lekkoatletyczny w Tychach, Tychy, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 14th Tyski Half Marathon is a race over the half marathon distance (21.0975 km) certified by PZLA, taking place on the streets of Tychy and around Lake Paprocańskie. The start, finish, and race village are located at the Athletics Stadium in Tychy. The event promotes an active lifestyle and a sporting atmosphere of the city, offering numerous accompanying attractions such as children's races, massages, and sports demonstrations. The course was modified in 2022 to reduce the number of inclines, making it more participant-friendly. The race is held under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Tychy and has been increasingly popular since 2012.
course_highlights: Street course around Lake Paprocańskie (asphalt, cobblestone, paved path)
Signage every 1 km with vertical markers
Finish at the Athletics Stadium in Tychy
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 3 hours. Electronic timing with a chip in the start number, net classification. Water stations are located along the route. The race office and packet pickup are on September 4-5, 2026 at Gemini Park Tychy and on race day from 6:30 to 8:30 at the stadium. The race packet includes a chip bib, technical T-shirt (if paid before August 2), medal, warm meal after the race, drinks, medical support, and route security. Children's races take place before and after the main race. The event will be held in an urban area, with race offices at Gemini Park Tychy and the Athletics Stadium. The program also includes races for the youngest participants.

name: 26 Eco Półmaraton Wałbrzych
description: The 26th edition of the Toyota Eco Wałbrzych Half Marathon is one of the most important running events in the region and in the country, attracting runners from all over Poland. Following last year's organizational success and record attendance, the event once again confirms its strong position on Poland's sports map. The half marathon route has been highly rated by participants, and the unique atmosphere created by Wałbrzych supporters adds a distinctive character to the event. We warmly invite both participants and spectators.
course_highlights: New, well-rated half marathon route
Unique atmosphere thanks to Wałbrzych supporters
An event with an established position on Poland's sports map
additional: On August 24, 2025, there will be traffic disruptions and special transportation for participants and spectators. Racebook – a practical guide with essential information before the start – is available. In addition to the half marathon, accompanying races and events for juniors are organized. Registration opens on January 27, 2026; the event includes the half marathon, 10 km races, and children's races; participants can choose from various start packages and enjoy attractions at the Old Mine.

name: 44 Międzynarodowy Otwarty Bieg Przełajowy o Puchar Leśny pamięci Tomasza Hopfera
description: We invite you to the 44th International Open Cross Country Race for the Leśny Cup in memory of Tomasz Hopfer, which will take place on September 6, 2026, in Obliwice. The main race course is 6.4 km long and consists of two loops of 3.2 km each, with the start and finish at the same location. The event has a unique sporting atmosphere, combining competition with recreation for entire families in a natural setting. The race commemorates Tomasz Hopfer, a legend of Polish sports journalism and an athlete, and also promotes a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.
course_highlights: Main race course: two loops of 3.2 km
Start and finish at the same point
Eco-forest surroundings of the course in Obliwice
additional: Program for September 6, 2026: from 11:00 am ceremonial opening, children's and youth races over 600 m and 1.609 km, at 1:20 pm the main 6.4 km race starts, at 2:00 pm the race of village heads and VIPs, at 5:00 pm the International Mile in memory of Piotr Gładki, and at 5:30 pm the Ecological Feast. Approximately 300 competitors will participate in the main race. The top finishers qualify for the International Mile. Forest terrain, online registration, accompanying events, sports memorial.

name: 64 Bieg Westerplatte
description: The 64th Westerplatte Run is the oldest continuously organized street race in Poland, covering a distance of 10 kilometers, held in Gdańsk. The race starts at a historic site where World War II began, giving the event a unique character and an atmosphere of reflection on sacrifice and peace. The route is certified and marked every kilometer, and the finish line is at the Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk, which adds an extra attraction for participants. The event attracts up to 5,000 runners and is both a sporting challenge and a tribute to the Coast Defenders of 1939.
course_highlights: Certified route marked every 1 km
Opportunity to run through the Tunnel under the Dead Vistula, closed to pedestrian traffic on regular days
Finish at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk - a modern football facility
additional: Number pickup at Polsat Plus Arena Gdańsk on September 6-7, 2026. Water refreshment point approximately at 6 km on the route. Participant limit is 5000 people. Free buses transport competitors to the start on race day. Deposit for belongings with a start number sticker. No showers available. Award ceremony around 11:45 at the finish line. Cash prizes and trophies for winners in the OPEN classification and age categories. Registration from March 2, 2026, to August 20, 2026, with a limit of 4900 participants, and the option to purchase official T-shirts at the Expo. The event includes package pickup, expo, transportation, start, and awards at Westerplatte.

name: Bieg KoBBiet
location: Stadion Miejski, Bielsko-Biała, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The KoBBiet Run is an annual race organized in Bielsko-Biała, which will take place in 2026 on September 6th at the Municipal Stadium. The event is dedicated to the memory of Ewa Szymanek-Płaska, head of the Department of Education and Sports at the City Hall in Bielsko-Biała. This year's edition of the run supports children on the autism spectrum, and registration will open on April 10, 2026, at 10:00 AM. The race is under the honorary patronage of the President of Bielsko-Biała, Jarosław Klimaszewski.
course_highlights: The route runs through the streets of the center of Bielsko-Biała
Start at the Municipal Stadium, finish at the Polish Army Square
5 km distance with attractions at the finish line
additional: The event supports children on the autism spectrum, registration is available at datasport.pl, the race is dedicated to women, commemorative medals and attractions await at the finish line.

name: Szybka Piątka Sokoła
description: Szybka Piątka Sokoła is a 5 km race held in Bukownica, Mazowieckie. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form on an easy, asphalt course. Organizers encourage preparation with the help of training plans tailored to individual levels, offering expert support. The event is friendly and motivating, ideal for those looking to improve their fitness and enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course length of 5 km
Easy, asphalt surface
Picturesque surroundings of Bukownica
additional: Training plans available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level with instructions and expert support. Training preparations are available for participants, and the event promotes activity and a healthy lifestyle within the local community.

The event is open to amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs, and participants can expect education on proper forest behavior.

Ability to complete the course up to 4 times

The event includes training preparations and information on training plans, making it attractive for runners at various levels of experience.

description: The XVIII Rooster Run is a 10 km race organized in Oława, scheduled for September 6, 2026. The event is organized by the Oława Running Group in cooperation with local institutions, and participants can expect professional timing services. The race office will be open both the day before the race and on the race day, facilitating the collection of race packs. The race is open and friendly to runners of all levels of experience.

Professional electronic timing measurement
Support from local institutions and partners, including the Municipal Pools "Termy Jakuba"

The race office is located the day before the race, online registration is available, and the participant limit is 891.

The route starts at the station and passes through Srbecká Lávka, Bubovické Waterfalls, and the Kačák Valley along the Berounka River to the finish line. The race offers beautiful natural scenery, a friendly atmosphere, and the possibility of refreshments and baggage storage on site. Each participant receives a bib number, and the top three in each category earn diplomas.
course_highlights: The route follows the Educational Trail Heart of the Czech Karst marked in red and white
Overcoming ascent through Bubovické Waterfalls and Doutnáč Hill
Running through the Kačák Valley along the stream and the Berounka River

The top three in each category will receive diplomas. The race is part of a series of 12 trail races held around the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, with various distances and elevation gains. The start is mostly accessible by train, races feature water stations and category evaluations. The race takes place on September 7, 2026, in Srbko.

name: S kopečka do kopečka

The race is part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region and is suitable for both recreational runners and competitors with ambitions. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for everyone who wants to experience running in a beautiful environment with the challenge of hilly terrain.

Part of the Great Prize of the Runners of the Olomouc Region
Traditional endurance run with a long history

name: Novostrašecký běh - Memoriál Vildy Šubrta

The main category start is scheduled for 6:00 PM, and the race is suitable for the general public, with adults paying an entry fee of 100 CZK, while children participate for free. Online registration is available even on the day of the race, ensuring convenient access to participation.

The event is suitable for the general public and combines sports activity with the popularization of geophysics and natural sciences.

Natural terrain suitable for recreational and competitive runners

Surface: cycle path suitable for running
Charitable run with proceeds supporting those in need

Children's race with loop length determined before the start

description: The SportScheck Run Cologne is an atmospheric night run that offers runners the opportunity to experience Cologne at night. The event is part of Germany's largest and most traditional city running series and provides an unforgettable atmosphere with finish line refreshments and a finisher medal.

Passing the historic Town Hall from 1330
Breathtaking view of the illuminated Cologne Cathedral

Training plans for preparation are offered. The course runs between Hohenzollern Bridge and Deutzer Bridge, starting on the Rhine Boulevard, night run, including children’s and family runs.

Shared start and finish area for all races
