The event is part of the Solvay Cup and attracts both club runners and local families. The atmosphere is small, family-oriented, and well organized by the Kreisvolkshochschule Aschersleben.
course_highlights: 2.3 km loop through the historic city wall area of Aschersleben
Various surfaces provide variety even on the shortest distance
Longer distances consist of multiple laps of the 2.3 km course
additional: Start and finish at Augustapromenade next to Kreisvolkshochschule and Kreismusikschule. The event takes place on Friday evening and is family-friendly. Approximately 260 participants, including club runners with Solvay Cup scoring. Sprint decision in the women's category over 9.2 km. The event offers various race distances, is part of the Solvay Cup, and attracts both club runners, families, and running enthusiasts. The course runs along the historic city wall and is known for its varied surfaces.

name: monte mare-Firmenlauf
description: The monte mare Corporate Run in Andernach is an attractive corporate race taking place on September 11, 2026. The course is a loop through the scenic Rhine gardens of Andernach and offers runners and walkers born in 2010 or earlier the opportunity to compete athletically. In addition to the main race, there is a youth run for the age groups U14 and U16. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and professional timing with disposable transponders.
course_highlights: Loop through the Andernach Rhine gardens
Total distance of the corporate run approx. 5.6 km (three laps plus finish straight)
Youth run approx. 2.0 km with finish at the Rheintor
additional: Start times: 4:30 PM Rasselstein Youth Run, 5:00 PM Raser Run, 5:40 PM Hobby Run, 6:30 PM Gourmet Run. Timing is done with disposable transponders in the bib (gross time measurement). Tent and catering bookings are possible, including equipment such as beer benches, tables, power connection, and refrigerator. Orders for food and drinks can be made by email until August 17, 2026. The race is a charity event, with part of the start fees donated to charitable causes, and offers the possibility to register online. There are also offers for tents and catering as well as training information.

name: Prajzské kilo
description: Prague Kilo is an ultratrail race in the Hlučínsko landscape that commemorates the historical borders and stories of the region divided in 1742. The race offers three routes of 30, 50, and 100 km with different time limits and elevation gains. You run through terrain full of old roads, chapels, and field tracks that bear traces of history and the identity of local residents. The race is scored within the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup and also offers points for the UTMB index and ITRA. It features a unique medal, a T-shirt, refreshments on the route and at the finish line, and child supervision for shorter distances.
course_highlights: Routes of 30, 50, and 100 km with elevation gains of 270, 350, and 600 m
Running through the Hlučínsko landscape with historical monuments and chapels
7 refreshment stations on the 100 km route, GPS live tracking, and online monitoring
additional: The registration fee includes a unique metal finisher's medal, a commemorative magnet, a cotton T-shirt with the logo, a hot meal at the finish line (meat/vegetarian), refreshments on the route, GPS live tracking (100 km), child supervision for 30/50 km (registration required), online monitoring at control points (30/50 km), timing and scoring within the Czech-Slovak Ultratrail Cup with points for the UTMB index and ITRA. We are waiting for your time to set course records; race routes of 30 km, 50 km, 100 km; time limits of 6-24 hours; child supervision for 30/50 km; GPS live tracking; scoring for UTMB and ITRA points.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026
location: Radkowskie Lake, Radków, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: 50 mil, Ultramaraton, Maraton, 24 km, Półmaraton, 10 km
description: Garmin Ultra Race Radków 2026 is a mountain trail run taking place in the picturesque surroundings of the Table Mountains, near Radkowskie Lake. The routes lead through rocky labyrinths, technical trails, and beautiful rock formations such as Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały. The event attracts both beginners and experienced ultramarathon runners, offering various distances and a unique atmosphere close to nature. Radków is an ideal place for a sporting adventure and relaxation amidst nature.
course_highlights: Spectacular trails of the Table Mountains with rock formations
Routes leading around Szczeliniec Wielki and Błędne Skały
Proximity to Radkowskie Lake as a place for recovery
additional: Ceremonies for awards are held after the completion of each distance. Starting packs are distributed at designated times before the start and during the event. Starts are staggered, with the longest distance beginning at 05:00, and shorter distances starting in subsequent hours. There are also Garmin Junior races for children in various age categories. Participants can enjoy the EXPO and have the option to track results online and download completion certificates. Trail running, multiple distances, registration details, scenic mountain terrain, event dates September 11-13, 2026.

name: 10-Teiche-Marathon
description: The 10-Teiche-Marathon in Hahnenklee is a scenic marathon held as part of the HarzerWanderWochen in September. The course runs through the Upper Harz and offers runners the opportunity to experience nature and the numerous ponds of the region. The event is part of a ten-day hiking program with various activities and live music. The marathon is a special challenge for runners who appreciate the combination of athletic performance and natural enjoyment.
course_highlights: Run through the Upper Harz with views of ten ponds
Part of the HarzerWanderWochen with a diverse hiking program
Start at 10:00 AM on September 12, 2026
additional: The marathon is embedded in a ten-day hiking program with guided hikes, evening events with live music, and other activities. There is a limited edition marathon T-shirt as a special souvenir. Trail and landscape running, various categories, physically demanding, within the framework of the HarzerWanderWochen.

name: 21. Citylauf
description: The GVG City Run Bedburg is a traditional race event taking place on September 13, 2026, in the traffic-free city center of Bedburg. The event offers various distances for all age groups, from the toddler run to school runs and the 10 km main race. The races start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall, with routes passing through the city center. The city run is ideal for runners of all performance levels and promotes community activity.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall
Traffic-free city center routes with turnaround points and laps
10 km main race with five complete laps through the city center
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until one hour before the respective start with an additional fee of 3.00 euros (the toddler run is free of charge and does not require registration). Headphones, MP3 players, baby joggers, and dogs are not allowed for safety reasons. The courses are measured and certified by the DLV. There is a 12-week running course as preparation for beginners. The event takes place on September 12, 2026, and includes children's runs alongside the main races. Registration is online, and the event is very popular within the local community.

name: 3. Wunstorfer Citylauf
description: The Wunstorf City Run is a running event in the city center of Wunstorf, organized by TuS Wunstorf. The race starts and ends in front of the city church, which serves as the event center. There are various distances, from a 400-meter children's run to multiple children's and youth races, up to the 10-kilometer main race. The course consists of a 1,400-meter loop through the city center, which is run multiple times or modified depending on age group and distance. The City Run thus offers suitable competitions for runners of all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: 1,400-meter loop through the city center
Start and finish in front of the city church
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km
additional: The race takes place on September 12, 2026, in Wunstorf. Typical September weather values are around 19 °C during the day and 10 °C at night, with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event is suitable for all age groups, with special races for children and youth. The event includes various race distances, including 400 m, 900 m, 1,600 m, 4,400 m, and 10,000 m. The course runs through the city center, with start and finish in front of the city church. The race promotes health and community spirit in Wunstorf.

name: Volvo Tierparklauf
description: The Volvo Animal Park Run takes place on September 12 and 13, 2026, at Berlin Zoo and is especially family-friendly and suitable for beginner runners. The course runs through the zoo, past various animals such as monkeys and flamingos, and offers a unique atmosphere with free entry for participants and accompanying persons. The event is part of the popular Berlin läuft! series and is characterized by a lively atmosphere and a comprehensive starter package.
course_highlights: Course through Berlin Zoo with views of monkeys, flamingos, and other animals
Free entry to the zoo for participants and accompanying persons
Running festival for the whole family on the event grounds
additional: Timing is done with a transponder on the shoe. Participants receive a comprehensive starter package with refreshment points, toilets, an online certificate, and free entry to the zoo. Groups of 15 or more people receive a 10% discount and can collect their race materials together. Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start. Additional services such as event shirts, medal engraving, and HD finish line videos can be booked. Free entry, run through Berlin Zoo, family-friendly, course past animals.

name: Dabendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Dabendorf Autumn Run is a traditional race organized by MSV Zossen 07 e.V. It takes place on September 12, 2026, in Dabendorf and offers routes for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers from 1.3 km to 15 km. The race is part of the Brandenburg Cup and the Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming and is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners. The event begins at 2:00 PM at the Sportforum Dabendorf, with the registration office opening at 12:00 PM. All participants are welcome to choose the suitable distance for themselves.
course_highlights: Distances from 1.3 km to 15 km
Scoring race in the Brandenburg Cup and Energie-Cup Teltow-Fläming
Start and finish at the Sportforum Dabendorf
additional: The registration office opens at 12:00 PM. Participation is possible for runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers. Only those wishing to collect cup points must adhere to the route specifications. The event also includes walker categories, a new starting point at the Sportforum Dabendorf, and independent timing. Registration is done online via Raceresult.

name: Dagersheimer Waldlauf
location: Waldstadion Dagersheim, Dagersheim, Böblingen, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Dagersheimer Forest Run is a traditional forest race held in the afternoon at the Waldstadion Dagersheim. The event offers races for various age groups, including a Bambini Run, school runs, a fun run, and a 10 km race that takes two laps through the Dagersheimer Forest. Number pickup begins at 1:00 PM, and late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before each race with a late registration fee. The race is characterized by its natural trail in the forest and provides an attractive running opportunity for all age groups in September.
course_highlights: 10 km race over two laps through the Dagersheimer Forest
Start and finish at Waldstadion Dagersheim
Various age groups with Bambini and school runs
additional: Number pickup from 1:00 PM at Waldstadion. Late registrations on-site until 30 minutes before each race, with a 3 € late registration fee. The 10 km race starts at 3:00 PM, the Bambini Run at 2:00 PM, and the fun run and junior run at 2:50 PM. Forest run, late registrations until 30 minutes before race, start at Waldstadion Dagersheim, distances: 300 m and 10 km.

name: Fichtl-Fun-Run
description: The Fichtl Fun Run is an annual running event in Fichtenberg that particularly appeals to children aged 6 to 11 years. Training for the run includes playful elements, running games, obstacle courses, and athletic exercises, which take place both outdoors and in the community hall. The event promotes community and fun in sports within a family-friendly atmosphere. The run is organized by the Sportkameradschaft Fichtenberg e.V., a traditional club with a diverse sports program.
course_highlights: Playful running games and obstacle courses
Athletic and circuit training for preparation
Event in Fichtenberg focused on children and community
additional: Training for the Fichtl Fun Run takes place on Thursdays from 4:15 PM to 5:30 PM in the community hall. The target group is children aged 6 to 11 years. The event emphasizes fun and community. Registration is likely required; the event also includes training sessions for children in September, featuring obstacle courses and running games.

name: Freiberger Herbstlauf
location: Platz der Einheit, Freiberg, Saxony, Germany
description: The Freiberg Autumn Run is a traditional race through the city forest of Freiberg, starting on September 12, 2026, at 10:00 AM at the Platz der Einheit. The diverse program offers runs for the whole family, including Bambini and children's races, Nordic walking, various distances from 2 km to the half marathon, as well as a corporate relay and the Einfach?Mensch!Lauf. The varied routes lead through the surrounding forests and include some inclines, making the race particularly attractive.
course_highlights: Course route through the Freiberg city forest
Start and finish at the sports facility Platz der Einheit
Varied routes with some inclines
additional: Offer for the whole family with Bambini and children's races, Nordic walking, corporate relay, and unicycle race. Various distances from 400 m to half marathon. Start and finish at the sports facility Platz der Einheit. Multiple competitions including half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, children's races, Nordic walking, unicycle race, and team competitions; the event location is the city forest and the Platz der Einheit.

name: Freisinger Volksfestlauf 2026
description: The Freising Volksfestlauf 2026 is organized by LC Freising e.V. and will take place on September 12, 2026, in Freising. The exact route has not yet been finalized, either through the city center or directly at the Volksfestplatz. The race is a popular event that combines tradition and sporting challenge. Further information will be announced in due course.
course_highlights: Route either through the city center or at the Volksfestplatz
Traditional running event in Freising
Organized by LC Freising e.V.
additional: The exact route will be announced later. Participants can send their opinions on the route to mail@lc-freising.de. Further details will follow.

name: Gassenlauf 2026
description: The alley run in Großrückerswalde is a sporting highlight in the Ore Mountains and will take place for the 17th time in 2026. The event offers various race distances, including the main race over 10.4 km and the alley run light over 6 km, as well as Nordic walking and walking. The course leads from the sports field in Großrückerswalde to the wind turbines above the Old Court and features a festive atmosphere with refreshments, a finish line video, and an outdoor award ceremony. The alley run is part of the West Saxony Running Cup and a meeting point for sport, community, and joie de vivre.
course_highlights: Main race 10.4 km with finish at the wind turbines above the Old Court
Alley run light 6.0 km as a shorter variant
Electronic timing with net time results by Bear-Service
additional: Race bib distribution on September 3, 2026 from 5 PM to 8 PM and on September 4, 2026 from 2 PM until one hour before the start at the athletes' clubhouse in Großrückerswalde. T-shirts can be reserved online until August 23, 2026 (additional 8 €). Refreshments on the course and at the finish. Shuttle service from the finish to the start. Changing rooms and showers available. Participant limit of 500 starters for all disciplines combined. Online registration from September 1, 2025, race bib distribution on race day, T-shirt reservation, refreshments on course and at the finish, shuttle service, showers at the athletes' clubhouse in Großrückerswalde.

name: Gaisenheimer Rhein-Wein-Lauf
description: The Rhine Wine Run in Geisenheim is a traditional race event that appeals to runners of all ages. The event offers various distances from children's races to the main race over 10.38 km, which takes place through the picturesque Rheingau region. The races are characterized by a varied course with small and large loops, inspiring both hobby and ambitious runners. The event emphasizes a family-friendly atmosphere with separate age group classifications and attractive prizes such as medals for children and bottles of wine for age group winners.
course_highlights: Children's and school races on small loops of 1,060 meters
Main race over 10.38 km with three large loops of 3,460 meters each
Course through the scenic Rheingau region
additional: Registrations are possible until one hour before the start of each race. There are separate age group classifications in all races. Children and adolescents up to 14 years receive medals for the top three places in each age group, adult age group winners receive a bottle of wine. The event takes place at the Rheingau Stadium and surrounding area. Races for children, adolescents, and adults; registration until 26.09.2025; late registrations accepted until 1 hour before start; weather in September typically around 19°C with 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Horpizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn
description: The Hospizlauf Wagrien-Fehmarn is an 85 km trail run that starts in Oldenburg in Holstein and takes place in September. The race is a small ultra event with a participant limit of 100 runners and a time limit of 13 hours. The course mainly runs on bike paths and field paths, with about 60% asphalt, 30% firm sandy paths, and the rest consisting of single trails and approximately 800 meters of sandy beach. Runners pass the Fehmarnsund Bridge and are supported at aid stations on piers. With each registration, the Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V. support association is also supported, which is working towards establishing a hospice in Oldenburg.
course_highlights: 85 km trail with approximately 60% asphalt and 30% firm sandy paths
Passage under the Fehmarnsund Bridge
Aid stations on piers near the coast
additional: The race is limited to 100 participants and has a time limit of 13 hours. The course includes about 800 meters of sandy beach. Each registration supports the Hospiz Wagrien-Fehmarn e.V. support association. The race takes place in September. It offers a unique combination of natural experience and sporting challenge.

name: KlosterLauf Wiedenbrück
location: Kloster Wiedenbrück, Rheda-Wiedenbrück, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The KlosterLauf in Rheda-Wiedenbrück is a special running event taking place on September 12, 2026, for the fourth time. Start and finish are at the Wiedenbrück Monastery, and the runs lead over two scenic loop courses through the town. The event is aimed at both ambitious runners and everyone who wants to enjoy the sporting community and running fun. Community and joy in running are at the center of this sporting highlight.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Wiedenbrück Monastery
Two scenic loop courses through Wiedenbrück
Distances of 5 km and 10 km
additional: The registration fee includes awards, award ceremony, timing, results, certificates, start documents, parking, catering, clothing depot, toilets, changing facilities, and medical services. After the run, there is an after-run party until 10 PM in the monastery garden. Scenic loop courses, on-site registration possible, after-run party in the monastery garden, start and finish at Wiedenbrück Monastery.

name: Lauf durch die Osterdörfer
description: The run through the Easter villages is a road race held at the Sportzentrum Arlewatt in Schleswig-Holstein. The event typically takes place in September and offers participants the choice between 1.5 km and 10 km distances. The race is part of the Waterkant-Cup series and is organized by the local club SZ Arlewatt with its running and athletics department. It is a recurring local running event with online registration and published results.
course_highlights: Road race through the Easter villages
Start and finish at Sportzentrum Arlewatt
Part of the Waterkant-Cup series
additional: Typical September weather conditions: approx. 19°C max, 10°C min, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Race in September, online registration available, results and photos from previous years available

name: Lauf in den Herbst
description: The Putzbrunn Autumn Run is a race approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV), organized by the gymnastics department of the sports club. It offers running opportunities for all age groups and performance levels with distances from 1.5 km to 10.7 km. A special feature is the inclusive nature of the race, allowing participation by people with different abilities. The event emphasizes community and the joy of running alongside athletic competition.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, and 10.7 km
Inclusive race with participants from the Lebenshilfe and Frame Runner
Classification by age groups and group awards
additional: Race bibs can be picked up from 12:00 PM at the triple gymnasium in Putzbrunn. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective race. Certificates are handed out on-site and will be available as PDFs the following day. There are special prizes for the fastest runners and the oldest participants. Catering and changing facilities are available on-site. Courses for different age groups, registration via email, no pre-registration required.

name: Lauf mit - Isingen 2026
description: Run with! Isingen 2026 is a cross-country event in the beautiful landscape around Isingen on the Swabian Alb. The event offers various disciplines, including the Crosslauf-Strong with 8.1 km and 200 meters of elevation, the Crosslauf-Light with 4.8 km and 100 meters of elevation, as well as the Molkekär-Kälble-Kidsrun for children. The routes are well signposted and lead through scenic nature. All participants receive timing with an integrated transponder, refreshment stations, and certificates; additionally, all kids runners receive a medal. The event also promotes team spirit with a group classification called "euroTECH Team Battle."
course_highlights: Well signposted routes around the beautiful Isingen
Crosslauf-Strong: 8.1 km with 200 meters of elevation
Crosslauf-Light: 4.8 km with 100 meters of elevation
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event: Kidsrun until 1:00 PM, Crosslauf-Light and Strong until 2:30 PM. There is a group classification "euroTECH Team Battle" for groups of four, whose total time is included in the team ranking. Refreshment stations are located at the start/finish and along all disciplines. Timing is done with a transponder system integrated into the bib number. Trail and cross-country running, charity run for children with cancer, routes on the Swabian Alb, supply points along the course.

name: Neubrandenburger Staffelmarathon (LC/NLC)
description: The Neubrandenburg Relay Marathon is a traditional relay race taking place on September 12, 2026, in Neubrandenburg. The event is organized by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg e.V. and offers runners the opportunity to complete the marathon distance together in teams. The start is at 9:30 AM, and the event runs until approximately 2:30 PM. The club's running group organizes the event and looks forward to many participants.
course_highlights: Relay marathon in Neubrandenburg
Organized by SV Turbine Neubrandenburg
Various categories for all age groups
additional: The race starts at 9:30 AM on September 12, 2026; details on terrain and registration are available on the website.

name: Nordhorner Meile

The varied course over 5 km and 10 km runs along the connecting canal and through the Nordhorn city center, with the finish at the Old Church at the market square. In addition to ambitious elite runners and hobby athletes, over 1500 students from the region also participate. The event is characterized by a lively atmosphere with more than 3000 spectators cheering on the runners along the route.
course_highlights: Varied course over 5 km and 10 km
Course along the connecting canal and through Nordhorn city center
Finish at the Old Church at the market square
additional: Online registration is only possible via the website. The event also includes student runs and is part of the new Grafschafter Run Series. Over 3000 spectators create a special atmosphere along the route. The event takes place on September 12, 2026, and offers a lively atmosphere in the Nordhorn city center. The event is open to runners of all performance levels, from hobby runners to competitive athletes.

name: Rudelsburglauf
description: The Rudelsburg Run is a traditional race event along the Rudelsburg near Bad Kösen, organized by LG Rudelsburg 1995 Bad Kösen e.V. The race takes place annually and offers runners of all performance levels the opportunity to experience the beautiful native region together. The event is a highlight in the club's calendar and combines sporting challenge with nature experience. Information about the race announcement and registration will be published in a timely manner before the event.
course_highlights: Various distances along the historic Rudelsburg
Scenic routes in the Bad Kösen region
Tradition and community run with a family-like character

description: The Run of Hope is an annual charity event in Kronach that brings together runners of all ages to fight cancer together. The run combines athletic effort with social engagement and invites everyone to make a difference with every step.
course_highlights: Run on the LGS grounds in Kronach
Nordic Walking route over 4 km
Hobby run over 4 km with age categories for youth and adults

Personal discount codes are available for club members. The event is organized by Gemeinsam gegen Krebs e.V. name: Schledehausener Berglauf
location: Sporthalle Schledehausen, Schledehausen, Bissendorf, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Schledehausen Mountain Run is a 10-hour mountain running event in Schledehausen, a part of Bissendorf, Germany. The race starts and ends at the Schledehausen sports hall. The goal is to climb and descend a short hill as many times as possible to accumulate the most elevation meters within the time limit. The course is 700 meters long and features an elevation gain of 32 meters with an average incline of 10%. There are individual, relay, and team categories. The run is organized by Omas on Tour as a charity event in support of HelpAge Germany e. V.
course_highlights: 700-meter long out-and-back course
32 meters elevation difference with 10% incline
Start and finish at the Schledehausen sports hall
additional: The race lasts 10 hours, during which participants can run up and down the hill as often as they like. There is a refreshment station where participants can take breaks or stop. The German Ultramarathon Association recognizes achievements from 45 km. Run on a 700-meter turnaround course, 32 meters of elevation gain, 10% incline. Registration opens on 16.01.2026. Participant limit is 150. Support for 'Jede Oma zählt'.

name: Schwarzenbacher Ausdauertag 2026
location: Sportzentrum Turnerheim, Schwarzenbach an der Saale, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Schwarzenbacher Endurance Day on September 12, 2026, offers a diverse program with running and walking competitions for all age groups. From the Bambini run, school run, fun run, 10 km run to the half marathon, there is something for every performance level. The start and finish are located at the sports center Turnerheim in Schwarzenbach an der Saale. Refreshment stations with water and bananas are provided along the course and in the finish area. Participants can enjoy a sports buffet with fruit, water, and cake at the finish. Timing is done using a disposable chip in the bib number, except for the fun run and Bambini run.

Start and finish at the sports center Turnerheim
Refreshment stations with water and bananas along the course and at the finish

There is a sports buffet with fruit, water, and cake at the finish. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, and late registrations are possible on-site. The event takes place in the Oberfranken region and offers a mix of running and walking routes as well as a family-friendly program.

name: Spiegelsbergelauf

description: The Spiegelsbergelauf on September 12, 2026, in Halberstadt offers varied running routes for all performance levels. The 14 km course takes you over the Gläserner Mönch and presents a real challenge with elevation meters and profile. The 8 km loop around the Jagdschlösschen combines speed and nature, while the 4 km route through the Spiegelsberge invites a relaxed race entry. There is also a 400-meter taster run for the youngest participants. The event is organized by SwimBikeRun Halberstadt e.V. and takes place at the Friedensstadion sports facility.
course_highlights: 14 km run with 277 meters of elevation over the Gläserner Mönch
8 km run with 117 meters of elevation around the Jagdschlösschen
4 km run through the Spiegelsberge
