Secured route, bib pickup on the day before and the day of the event, social runs before the event, detailed route descriptions, and age groups.

name: SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL
description: The SÜDTHÜRINGENTRAIL is a friendly trail run in the beautiful surroundings of Suhl, celebrating its anniversary edition on September 12, 2026. The course leads through partly winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest, past clear streams, dark valleys, and shimmering mountain ridges. The event offers an unforgettable nature experience with spectacular views and is part of the SÜHLER BÜCHSEN CUP. All finishers of the longer distances receive ITRA-/UTMB® qualification points.
course_highlights: Partly winding paths away from the main artery of the Thuringian Forest
Passage along clear streams, through dark valleys, and over shimmering mountain ridges
Spectacular views and natural experience in the Suhl area
additional: Pasta party on the evening before, starter bag, course and finish line refreshments, tracking for position determination, medical emergency services provided by mountain rescue, finisher shirt, finisher medal, finisher surprise gift, finisher certificate (online printout), winner trophies for the top three women and men in each trail category, age group classifications, ITRA-/UTMB® qualification points for Riesentrail and Heldentrail, free parking and showers, maximum number of starters per distance (Wichteltrail 344, Riesentrail 177, Heldentrail 199), no on-site late registration possible, Wichteltrail start at 10:30 AM by the patron André Knapp, Mayor of Suhl, breakfast from 4:00 AM at the start and finish area optional, award ceremonies from 3:00 PM. The event offers cultural and scenic highlights, including course profiles, GPX downloads, and detailed information about the individual trails.

name: ULTRAMARATHON DM im 100km-Straßenlauf
description: The 38th German Championship in Ultramarathon over 100 km will take place on September 12, 2026, at the Wartenberg Stadium in Berlin-Wartenberg. This road race is a challenging long-distance event that requires endurance and mental strength. The event is aimed at experienced ultrarunners and offers an official championship atmosphere under the patronage of the German Athletics Association. Participants can look forward to professional organization and a sporting challenge.
course_highlights: 100 km road race on a flat, fast course
Start and finish at Wartenberg Stadium
Official German Ultramarathon Championship
additional: The race takes place on the road, with start and finish at Wartenberg Stadium. Registration deadline is September 5, 2026. Categories include Youth, Active, and Masters. The weather in September is expected to be around 19°C, with approximately 45 mm of precipitation.

name: Unstrutlauf
description: The Unstrutlauf is a versatile running event in Dingelstädt that offers courses suitable for all performance levels, from 2 km to the half marathon (21.1 km). The varied routes run along the Unstrut River and feature scenic highlights with paved bike paths and short inclines. Refreshments such as drinks, fruit, and bratwurst are provided. All proceeds are donated to charitable projects in the region, giving the race a special social character.
course_highlights: Varied landscapes along the Unstrut River
Half marathon with two turnaround points and minimal elevation change
Relay race with four sections and segments on the Unstrut bike path
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each race for a fee of 3.00 €. Timing is done with the BIP chip system. Each participant receives a medal worth 5.00 € and a certificate at the award ceremony. Catering with water, fruit, and bratwurst is included. Toilets, showers, and changing rooms are available at the start area. Relay participants must organize their transfer to the exchange points themselves. Various race distances from 2 km to 21 km, refreshments with drinks, fruit, and bratwurst, parking facilities at the shooting range and behind the outdoor pool, electronic timing with BIP chip system.

name: VL Rund um Weitersburg und 19. Weitersburg Halbmarathon
description: The VL Rund um Weitersburg and the 19th Weitersburg Half Marathon are local running events in Weitersburg, organized by the running team of SV Weitersburg. The event offers both a traditional fun run and the full half marathon distance of 21.1 kilometers. The club promotes a family-friendly village club atmosphere with regular training, summer barbecues, and other running events throughout the year. Beginners and re-entrants are warmly welcome, with the motto "Just keep running!".
course_highlights: Fun run and half marathon with a distance of 21.1 km
Event in the municipality of Weitersburg with a village club atmosphere
Regular training on the Weitersburg sports field
additional: The running team of SV Weitersburg offers training twice a week at the sports field. The event takes place in typical September weather with about 19°C and mostly cloudy skies. There is a village club atmosphere with summer barbecues, a Fun Run in September, and a season finale in November. Running event with distances from 200 m to 21 km, including half marathon; local club organization, regular training, village club atmosphere.

name: Okolo Kolovrat
description: The Okolo Kolovrat Run is a traditional race that takes you through the beautiful surroundings of Kolovrat, including neighboring villages of Uhříněves, Lipany, and part of Říčany. It offers routes of 11 km and 21 km, with the shorter course also available as a two-person relay. The courses mainly run along field, meadow, and forest paths lined with trees, ensuring wonderful running experiences in nature. The race is suitable for all runners who want to improve their time or set a personal course record.
course_highlights: Routes run along the walking circuits around Kolovrat with a short passage into neighboring villages
Mostly field, meadow, and forest paths and trails lined with trees
On the main route, the course crosses the border of Prague into Říčany at the 50th parallel
additional: Option to run the shorter course as a two-person relay. The race takes place in all weather conditions. Detailed regulations are available in the attached PDF and on the race website https://ok.nasekolovraty.cz. Trail running, distances 11 km and 21 km, relay options, beautiful natural scenery, event scheduled for September 2026, supporting the local community and refreshments at the start and finish area.

name: Přeloučská desítka
description: Přeloučská desítka is a running race held in Přelouč, offering courses of 10 km, 5 km, and a children's race of 1 km. The race takes place on asphalt roads, cobblestones, and paths with minimal elevation gain. The start and finish are at Masaryk Square. The event is suitable for all age groups and promotes running as a social phenomenon. After the race, refreshments are provided, and results are sent via SMS.
course_highlights: Course without significant elevation gain
Surface: 60% asphalt, 40% cobblestones and paths
Start and finish at Masaryk Square in Přelouč
additional: Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line. SMS with the finishing time after the race. On-site registration will not be available. Option to purchase a functional Přeloučská 10 T-shirt for 490 CZK. Prizes for the top three men and women in the form of trophies and material prizes. Races of 5 km, 10 km, children's race of 1 km, registration only online, start and finish at Masaryk Square in Přelouč. The event supports patients with butterfly wing disease (DEBRA ČR).

name: ČEZ RunTour Brno
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
price_range: 500 Kč - 200 Kč (dle tratě a data registrace)
description: The CEZ RunTour Brno is a family running race held near Brno Dam, offering courses for all age groups from children to experienced runners. Participants can choose from distances of 500 m, 1 km, 3 km, 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon (21.1 km). The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality facilities, and accompanying program for the whole family. Each participant receives a start package and contributes to charity. CEZ RunTour is an ideal opportunity for hobby runners and elite athletes who want to experience the joy of running in the beautiful surroundings of Brno Dam.
course_highlights: Courses run around Brno Dam with unique views
Children's runs of 500 m and 1000 m with a kids' corner and supervision
Refreshment stations on the half marathon and longer distances
additional: The race includes a start package, guiding and medical teams, a special rescue service hotline during the race, refreshments at the finish and on the course, an official gymsack with gifts from partners, a kids' corner with supervision, and an accompanying program for the whole family including warm-ups and entertainment in the kids' zone. More courses, charitable contributions, medal engraving options, online and on-site registration, facilities near Brno Dam.

name: Běh na Boží horu
location: Ivančice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Boží Hora Run is a traditional race in Ivančice, presenting a challenge in the form of running up 109 steps to Boží Hora. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, ensuring a smooth race flow. The event is part of a rich program of activities organized by the Ivančice Leisure Center, which has a long-standing tradition and support from the town. The race is suitable for the general public and offers a unique sporting experience in an attractive environment.
course_highlights: Run up 109 Ivančice steps
Individual starts at one-minute intervals
Traditional event with a long history in Ivančice
additional: Participants start individually at 1-minute intervals. Regulations for download are available in the event section on the website. The race is open to all age groups, with options to download regulations and register online. The event takes place regularly and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Běh Kovohutěmi
location: TJ Kovohutě stadion, Lhota u Příbramě, Příbram District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: 50,- předem, 100,- na místě, děti a nad 60 let zdarma
description: Kovohutě Run is a traditional running race held in Lhota near Příbram, which has been taking place since 1967. This race offers a main course of 12 km as well as races for children and youth. The event is held at the TJ Kovohutě stadium and is popular among runners of all ages. It attracts many participants each year and is part of the Brdský Running Cup.
course_highlights: Main race of 12 km
Races for children and youth
Start and finish at TJ Kovohutě stadium in Lhota near Příbram
additional: The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup. Registration and provisional start lists are available for the main race, children and youth races, and also for the mile race. The races include the main 12 km course, children's and youth races, various age categories, and are held on hilly roads with asphalt and grass surfaces.

name: Strojařská desítka
description: The Strojařská desítka is a traditional road running race in Zlín, held for the 42nd time. The race offers 10 and 5 kilometer routes with an elevation gain of 153 meters on a certified turnaround course passing through Zlín's Maják, U Boudy crossroads, Salaš, and back. The start is always at 10 a.m. at the Road Maintenance Department headquarters on K Majáku street. The race is suitable for the general public and runners of all categories who want to compete in the beautiful environment of Zlín.
course_highlights: Turnaround road course 10 km long with an elevation gain of 153 meters
Certified route between Zlín's Maják, U Boudy crossroads, and Salaš
Start and finish at the Road Maintenance Department on K Majáku street
additional: The race is part of the Zlín Running Series. Junior and children categories have specific registration and scoring rules. Results and photo galleries are regularly published online. Starting numbers and other organizational information are available on the official website. The race runs on forest, asphalt, and hilly roads, with registration available in advance or on-site, and results accessible online.

name: Běh přátelství Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen
location: Klenčí pod Čerchovem, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Friendship Run Klenčí pod Čerchovem - Waldmünchen is part of the Running Series Chodsko Runner, which offers a diverse range of races in the Chodsko area. This race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Klenčí pod Čerchovem and attracts runners of all ages. The course is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners, with the race atmosphere fostering friendly gatherings of the running community. The Chodsko Runner series is known for its tradition and quality organization, ensuring a pleasant experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Run in the picturesque environment of Klenčí pod Čerchovem
Trail course suitable for nature enthusiasts
Part of the Chodsko Runner series with a tradition
additional: The race takes place in September 2026, the course is approximately 15.5 km long, and is suitable for runners of all levels. The event is associated with the celebration of friendship and sports competition.

name: Bezdězský půlmaraton
location: Doksy, Liberec District, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Bezděz Half Marathon is a running race held in the picturesque environment of the Mácha region around Bezděz Castle. It offers two routes approximately 13.6 km and 21.2 km long with an elevation gain of 200 to 300 meters, passing through forest paths, trails, and short sections on asphalt. The race is suitable for the general public and is complemented by children's races. There is catering, baggage storage, toilets, and results announcement with a raffle in the area. The capacity is limited to 500 participants, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: Routes pass through extensive forests of the Mácha region and around Bezděz Castle
Surface of the routes includes paved and unpaved roads, trails, and short asphalt sections
Two refreshment stations on the 21 km route, one on the 13 km route
additional: Registration and check-in on site is possible from 8:30 to 10:30, the race capacity is limited to 500 runners. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for participants. Children's races start at 10:00, main races on 13 km and 21 km begin at 11:00. The route is marked with flags, signs, and chalk, with each kilometer approximately indicated. Registration is possible through the official website. The race takes place in September 2026. The course includes natural terrains and forest paths.

name: 7 pohoří Krkonoše
description: Trail Run Series 7 Mountains is the largest event of its kind in the Czech Republic, taking you through seven of the most beautiful and challenging mountain ranges. The races offer technical trails with epic views and an atmosphere you won't experience anywhere else. Whether you are an experienced mountain runner or a beginner, the 7 Mountains will test your strength, willpower, and determination. Conquer all the mountains and become a legend of trail running.
course_highlights: Technical trails with elevation gain around 900 - 1230 meters on main routes
Epic views of significant peaks and landscapes such as Ještěd, Bezděz, Kozákov, Trosky, Zvičina, Velká Deštná
Routes lead through mountain paths, ancient trails, and the natural scenery of national parks
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 4 hours, after which the participant is marked as DNF. Each participant receives a commemorative finisher medal and has access to refreshments on the route and at the finish line. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the Rescue app. Storage for small items is available at the registration booth. The event takes place in all weather conditions and participation is at your own risk. The course includes mountain trails, technical sections, and scenic viewpoints. Registration includes a map of the course, chip timing, a medal, and refreshments.

name: Běh k Mohyle Hanče a Vrbaty
location: Bílý most přes Labe, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 150 Kč pro přihlášené předem online do 12.9.2025

description: The Hanče and Vrba Memorial Run is a traditional mountain race held in the Krkonoše Mountains, starting at the White Bridge over the Elbe in Špindlerův Mlýn and ending at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial. The 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 meters mainly runs on asphalt and terrain, offering beautiful views and unforgettable experiences. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and is suitable for a wide range of runners in various age categories. After the race, there is an opportunity for refreshments and a raffle, as well as the use of public transportation back from the finish line.
course_highlights: 9 km route with an elevation gain of 696 m
65% asphalt, 35% terrain
Start at 715 m above sea level, finish at 1411 m above sea level
additional: Maximum number of participants is 100. Registration takes place on race day from 9:30 to 10:30 in Špindlerův Mlýn. There are two refreshment stations along the route with water and isotonic drinks. After the race, there is a raffle and the possibility of refreshments at Vrbatova Bouda. No changing rooms or showers are provided. There is an option to transport light personal belongings from the start to the finish. Trail race with an elevation gain of 696 m, start at the White Bridge over the Elbe, finish at the Hanče and Vrba Memorial, online and on-site registration, part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

name: Dětmarovická 10

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 350,- Kč (registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 700,- Kč (cena je za oba dva běžce v případě registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200,- Kč (registrace předem, uhrazené do 3 dnů od registrace)

description: Dětmarovická 10 is a traditional running race held in the village of Dětmarovice, offering a main race of 10 km, a relay of 2 x 5 km, and children's runs called Cipísek's Run. The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest trails, combining brisk sections with gentle challenges and allowing participants to enjoy the picturesque corners of the village. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and enthusiastic amateurs, with the joy of running and a sporting atmosphere being more important than performance. Short courses with a cheerful atmosphere and illustrations of Cipísek are prepared for children. Registration is conducted online with the possibility to register on-site, and runners receive a start number with a chip for timing and gift items from partners.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on asphalt roads and forest gravel and dirt trails in the municipality of Dětmarovice
A combination of brisk sections and gentle challenges suitable for both experienced and amateur runners
Picturesque corners of Dětmarovice with a unique atmosphere
additional: Start and finish of the race are at the Dětmarovice Sports Hall. Participants will receive a start number with a chip for timing. Refreshment stations are located at the 6 km mark and at the finish line. Medical services are available at the finish. For the 2 x 5 km relay, transportation of runners between segments is provided. Children's runs are divided by age into 100 m, 200 m, and 400 m distances. On-site registration is possible but without guarantee of the same benefits as online registration. The race includes electronic registration, chip timing, medical security, refreshments, and a raffle. The course includes asphalt, forest, and gravel paths and is suitable for all levels of runners.

name: 10. PKO Bieg Charytatywny
description: The 10th PKO Charity Run is a nationwide initiative that combines sporting excitement with tangible support for an important social cause – mental health of children and youth. The event will take place on September 12, 2026, across Poland, encouraging participants to run together and act for the community. Every lap, kilometer, and minute on the route matters, emphasizing the idea of community and help. This anniversary edition invites runners to actively participate and support.
course_highlights: Multiple locations in Poland, including Gdańsk, Ruda Śląska, Łomża, Krosno, and Stalowa Wola
Virtual run option with an app
Relays and runs for children and adults for charitable purposes
additional: The event takes place across Poland, combining sports activity with a charitable goal for the mental health of children and youth. The PKO Charity Run is an initiative where not only the result matters but primarily collective action and social support. The event supports children's and youth's mental health, includes relay races and fundraising for therapies, and features participation in many Polish cities as well as virtual participation.

name: Bieg 7 Dolin
location: Piwniczna-Zdrój, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 7 Valleys Run is a mountain ultramarathon covering a distance of 100 km, taking place in the picturesque Beskid Sądecki, with start and finish in Piwniczna-Zdrój. The route runs through challenging mountain trails with significant elevation gain, offering participants exceptional views and contact with nature. The event is part of the Running Festival, which combines sports competition with regional promotion and active lifestyle. The time limit to complete the course is 19 hours, and there are food and drop-off points along the route. This is a challenge for experienced mountain runners who want to face difficult but beautiful terrain.
course_highlights: Elevation +3740 m / -3740 m over 100 km
6 food points and 3 drop-off points along the route
The route runs through Beskid Sądecki trails with views of mountains and the Poprad valley
additional: The time limit to finish the race is 19 hours (until 9:00 PM). Intermediate cut-off times at checkpoints are: Rytro (36 km) - 7 hours (by 9:00 AM), Krynica (62 km) - 12 hours (by 2:00 PM), Wierchomla (89 km) - 17 hours (by 7:00 PM). Recommended technical equipment includes, among others, a reusable cup or bottle, a backpack or running belt, NRC foil, a headlamp, reflective elements, health insurance, a whistle, hand sanitizer, and an active phone with ICE number recorded on the back of the bib. The event features various distances, including 100 km, 42 km, 61 km, 23 km, and 11 km, with accompanying attractions such as festivals and expo. The race will take place in early September 2026.

name: 5 Aktywna Piątka
price_range: 100 zł w dniu zawodów, wcześniejsza rejestracja
description: The 5th edition of the "Active Five" race will take place on September 12, 2026, in Frydek, Miedźna Municipality. It is a fast street race on a course certified by the Polish Athletic Association (PZLA) with a length of exactly 5 km, starting at 11:00 AM. As part of the event, the Silesian Voivodeship Championships in the 5 km run will be held, with a participant limit of 600 people. Additionally, there is a Family Run for children and youth up to 15 years old on three distances.
course_highlights: Fast, PZLA-certified 5 km course
Asphalt route marked every 1 km
Watering points and water curtains along the route
additional: The main race participant limit is 600 people. In the OPEN classification, the top 5 women and men are awarded. The race starts at Modowa Street 189C. The accompanying Family Run is intended for children and youth up to 15 years old, with three distances: 800 m for ages 10-15 and shorter distances for younger age groups. Only registered main participants of the family run receive a commemorative medal. The limit of paid participants is 400. No participation with a dog, wheelchair, or stroller is allowed.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: Grand Prix Truchtacza in Mysłowice is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as the integration of runners from different regions. The event is open to everyone, regardless of skill level and age, and participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross. The races take place on forest and urban routes, creating a friendly atmosphere of sporting competition and community. The Grand Prix is a tradition and passion that has united runners for many years.
course_highlights: Forest routes over Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Participants from many cities and sports clubs of Silesian Voivodeship and Lesser Poland
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix events is free of charge. The events are open to both runners and participants in Nordic walking and canicross. Athletes from different cities and sports clubs take part, with women accounting for over 27%. The event includes various distances and seasonal competitions, promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity within the local community.

name: 17. Parklauf Tangerhütte
description: The 17th Park Run Tangerhütte takes place in the idyllic town park of Tangerhütte and is part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP running series in northern Saxony-Anhalt. The event offers various courses for all age groups, including 1.1 km for children, 2.9 km for youth, as well as 5.4 km and 10.3 km for adults. The running routes lead around the Spiegelsee and past sights such as the New Castle and the Mausoleum. In the finish area, SV Germania Tangerhütte provides refreshments such as grilled foods, drinks, fruit, as well as coffee and cake to cater to participants.
course_highlights: Loop course in Tangerhütte town park with idyllic Spiegelsee
Youth course passes by the New Castle and Mausoleum
Adult routes with 2 or 4 laps through the autumnal town park
additional: Start and finish are in front of the old sports hall at Jahn sports field. Refreshments at the finish area include grilled foods, refreshing drinks, fruit, as well as coffee and cake. Course lengths range from 300 m to 10.3 km, registration online, race as part of the ELBE-OHRE-CUP series.

name: 21. swb-Marathon Bremen
description: The 21st swb Bremen Marathon takes place on September 13, 2026, offering runners a diverse running experience through Bremen. The start and finish are located at Bremen's Market Square, and the course passes notable sights such as Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park, University, Bürgerpark, Überseestadt, Schlachte, and concludes with a run through the Weserstadion. In addition to the marathon, there is also an AOK half marathon, a HIRSCH 10 km run, and an AOK children's run. The event is suitable for beginners and experienced runners and promises an unforgettable day of sport with a great atmosphere and spectator support.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Bremen's Market Square
Course passes Werdersee, Weserwehr, Rhododendron Park, and University
Run through the Weserstadion before the finish line
additional: Start and finish area at Bremen's Market Square. Option to book additional services such as finisher shirts, HD videos of the finish, and participation in the pasta party. Various distances available for beginners and experienced runners. Special highlight includes running through the Weserstadion. Event features strong spectator support and a lively atmosphere. Registration is possible online, with start times from 11:30 AM. The course runs through Bremen with highlights like Werdersee and Weserstadion, including additional offers such as pasta parties and finisher shirts.

name: 43. Internationalen Airport Race
price_range: various, e.g., 28 Euro for shirts, 15 Euro for cotton shirts, 12-40 Euro for race entries
description: The 43rd International Airport Race in Hamburg will take place on September 13, 2026, and offers a varied running experience around Hamburg Airport. The starting shot for the 10-mile course traditionally begins at 11:00 AM at the LSV sports facility on Borsteler Chaussee. In addition to the main race over 10 miles, there are also competitions over 5 km and the Mini Airport Race. The unique airport setting provides ever-changing impressions and a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied course around Hamburg Airport
Start and finish at the LSV sports facility on Borsteler Chaussee
Unique airport backdrop with constantly new impressions
additional: In addition to the main race over 10 miles, there is also a 5 km run and a Mini Airport Race over approximately 1.4 km. The event is very popular with nearly 4,000 registered participants. The race is part of the Hamburg Running Cup. Registration is via the official registration website. Courses on streets, footpaths, and hiking trails; online registration; race shirts and medals; catering and showers on race day.

name: 6. DeisterCrossing Springe
description: The DeisterCrossing is a close-to-nature extreme experience in the wooded Deister Mountains near Springe. The event offers running and marching routes over 10 km, 21.1 km (half marathon), and 42.2 km (marathon) with challenging ascents, including the Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row. Participants enjoy a well-marked course with refreshment stations, seating options, and sandwiches for marchers. The event is characterized by consideration and fun in nature, with an award ceremony for the fastest runners and a finisher gift as a memento.
course_highlights: Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row
Marathon march with additional ascent to Bielstein and Deisterkamm
Refreshment stations with seating options and sandwiches
additional: Race number pickup from 7:15 AM at IGS Springe. Timing with rental chip, return in exchange for wheat beer glass as finisher gift. Showers and changing rooms in the sports hall of IGS Springe. Parking available at IGS, netto, BZE. Arrival by S5 to Springe station, 10-minute walk to the school center North. Award ceremony for 10 km and half marathon at 12:00 PM, marathon at 2:30 PM. Patches for sewing onto for marchers. Trail event with challenging topography, refreshment at aid stations, options for runners and walkers.

name: Bedburger Citylauf 2026
description: The GVG City Run Bedburg takes place on September 13, 2026, in the city center of Bedburg. The races lead through the traffic-free city center with start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall. Various distances are offered from a 300-meter Bambini run to the 10 km main race as well as relay competitions. The run is suitable for all age groups and offers a great opportunity to experience Bedburg in motion.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the marketplace in front of the town hall
Routes lead through the traffic-free city center of Bedburg
10 km main race with five laps through the city center
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until one hour before the respective start with a late registration fee of 3.00 euros (except for the Bambini run, which is free of charge). Headphones, MP3 players, baby joggers, and dogs are not allowed for safety reasons. Multiple race distances, online and on-site registration until one hour before the start, no dogs or headphones on the course.

name: Bitburger Stadtlauf
description: The Bitburger City Run takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bitburg and offers an inclusive running event where amateur athletes, disabled persons, and competitive athletes can compete together. The event was created out of the desire for a beautiful running event in Bitburg and promotes sporting competition in a friendly atmosphere. The start and finish are at St. Martin School on Kölner Straße 14. The event is part of the CITY SPORT Trier event calendar and warmly invites all running enthusiasts to participate.
course_highlights: Inclusive running event for all performance levels
Start and finish at St. Martin School, Kölner Straße 14
Joint competition of amateur athletes, disabled persons, and competitive athletes
additional: Course in Bitburg, bib number distribution at St. Martin School, results on chiplauf.de, late registrations on the event day for a fee, including group and team classifications

name: Brachter Depotlauf
location: Brachter Depot, 41379 Brüggen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brachter Depot Run is a guided scenic run through the beautiful Brachter Depot, taking place in different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km. Various distances are offered, including half marathon, 14 km, 5 km beginner run, children's run (max. 2 km), and walking. The event emphasizes nature experience and social engagement, as participation in the children's run is free and a starting donation is collected on the event day. The races are organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht and feature a varied course in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Guided scenic run through the Brachter Depot
Different pace groups from 5:00 to 7:00 min/km
Various distances: half marathon, 14 km, 5 km, children's run
additional: Participation in the children's run is free. For all other runs, a starting donation of €10.00 is required, payable in cash only on the event day at the registration desk. The event is organized by TSF Bracht and Depotrunners Bracht. There is inclusive catering for participants. The races are held in different pace groups to accommodate all running speeds. Scenic run, various courses, inclusive catering, online registration.

name: Braker hkk Lauf
description: The 19th Braker hkk Run will take place on September 13, 2026, in Brake (Unterweser). It is a short race with distances of 850 meters and 10 kilometers. The race offers a pleasant running opportunity with typical September weather, featuring mild temperatures and mostly cloudy skies. Please note that the exact event details should be verified directly with the organizer.
course_highlights: Distances: 850 m and 10 km
Typical September weather with around 19°C and 45 mm of precipitation
Start location in Brake (Unterweser)
additional: The race includes two distances: 850 meters and 10 kilometers. September weather is typically mild and cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event usually takes place at comfortable temperatures around 19°C. Participants should check the current details with the organizer before registering.

name: Brückenlauf Halbmarathon Köln des ASV Köln
description: The Bridge Run Half Marathon Cologne organized by ASV Cologne is a traditional race covering 21.1 kilometers, running right through Cologne along the Rhine and over six of the city's most beautiful bridges. The course offers spectacular views of the cathedral and the city, accompanied by an exciting atmosphere and music along the route. In addition to the half marathon, there are shorter distances for beginners and children, including the Kölsche Runde (11.11 km) and the Bambini Run (500 m). The race combines athletic challenge with Rhineland joie de vivre and is suitable for both ambitious and recreational runners.
course_highlights: 21.1 km along the Rhine with views of the Cologne Cathedral
Crossing six Cologne bridges, including Hohenzollern Bridge and Rodenkirchen Bridge
Start and finish at the Chocolate Museum square with a lively atmosphere
additional: The Bridge Run is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for the best list. The LVN Southeast Regional Championships take place during the half marathon. Registration is available online, with on-site late registration possible on the event day. The Kölsche Runde is ideal for beginners and hobby runners, while the Bambini Run is for children aged 3-6 years. Both start and finish at the Chocolate Museum square. The event features music, announcers, and a lively atmosphere along the route. The race begins in Rheinauhafen and is part of the LVN Southeast Region Championships. Registration is possible online, including a T-shirt for members. Participation fees vary depending on the category.

name: DeisterCrossing Springe
description: The DeisterCrossing is a nature-oriented endurance event that combines running and marching in the outstanding natural scenery of the wooded Deister mountain range. The event offers courses over 10 km, 21.1 km, and 42.2 km for runners and marchers. The challenging routes include, among others, the Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row and provide a unique natural and mountain experience near Hanover. The event is relaxed, with consideration among participants, and offers, in addition to the sporting challenge, refreshment points, finisher gifts, and an awards ceremony.
course_highlights: Deister Hölle with 200 meters of elevation gain in a row after 5 km
Marathon marchers additionally cover 50 meters of elevation to Bielstein
Nature and mountain run in the wooded Deister mountain range near Hanover
additional: Number pickup from 7:15 a.m. at IGS Springe. Timing chip is issued and exchanged at the finish for a wheat beer glass with DC logo. Showers and changing rooms are available in the sports hall of IGS Springe. Parking is available at IGS, Netto, and BZE. Arrival by S5 to Springe station, a 10-minute walk to the school center north. Refreshment points with seating and sandwiches, finish buffet. Awards ceremony for the top three women and men in the running competitions at 12:00 p.m. (10 km and half marathon) and 2:30 p.m. (marathon). Marchers receive patches to sew on. Routes in forested areas, refreshment points, patches for marchers, online certificates, award ceremonies, parking, showers & changing rooms in the sports hall, travel by train.

name: Dübener Heidelauf
location: Obermühle, Bad Düben, Landkreis Nordsachsen, Sachsen, Germany
description: The Dübener Heidelauf is a traditional forest run held at the picturesque Obermühle in Bad Düben, a spa town in North Saxony. Organized by SV Bad Düben, the event offers courses for children, teenagers, and adults. With distances ranging from 500 meters to the half marathon (21.1 km), the race appeals to both young runners and experienced long-distance athletes. The run is part of the regional athletics structure for North Saxony and Leipzig and is characterized by its family-friendly, club-oriented nature.
course_highlights: Forest run through the Dübener Heide
Course lengths from 500 m to 21.1 km (half marathon)
Event location at Obermühle in Bad Düben
additional: The race takes place in typical September weather with an average temperature of 19 °C (lowest 10 °C) and mostly cloudy skies. The event includes age groups from under 8 years to adults and is not a commercial large-scale event but a regional club race. Cross-country/forest terrain, races for various age groups, regional club event.

name: ebm-papst Marathon
price_range: 12€ für Erwachsene, 8€ für Kinder (Laufshirts, bei Anmeldung mitbestellt)
description: The ebm-papst Marathon in Niedernhall is a traditional running event taking place on September 12 and 13, 2026, for the 29th time. The event offers various disciplines such as marathon, half marathon, duo marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, handbike, and inline skating, as well as children's races and Nordic walking. The course runs through the scenic region and provides an exciting experience for runners of all performance levels. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a diverse supporting program with shows, children's care, and a pasta party. Every finisher receives a medal and can download a free finish-line photo.
course_highlights: Variety of disciplines: marathon, half marathon, duo and relay marathon, 10 km, handbike, inline skating
Scenic course through and around Niedernhall
Supporting program with shows, children's care, and a runner's service
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 12 and 13, 2026, until one hour before the start on-site. There is a pasta party with a fee of 8 € (cash only). Sustainable running shirts can be ordered for 12 € (children 8 €) additionally. Every finisher receives a medal and a free finish-line photo for download. Free clothing storage, showers, and massages are available on-site. Children's care from age 3 is available from 07:30 to 14:30. Runner's service with a church service on Sunday at 08:00. Relay exchange on Facebook to find running partners for the duo marathon. Various race distances, family event, children's races, inline skaters, handbikers, supporting program, sustainable running shirts.

name: Eicklinger Volks- und Familielauf
description: The 1st Eicklingen Folk and Family Run is aimed at active families who want to spend a lovely day running together. The focus is on fun and the joy of running, without competitive pressure. The event offers a friendly atmosphere for all age groups and promotes movement within the community.
course_highlights: Running routes over 3 km and 6 km
Family-friendly event
Start location in Eicklingen
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19 °C, low of 10 °C, an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event is ideal for families who want to run together and offers a relaxed, communal atmosphere. The weather in September can affect the running enjoyment but is generally pleasant.

name: Erzhäuser Heegbachlauf
description: The Erzhausen Heegbachlauf is a traditional running event organized by the Kaltduscher in Erzhausen for nearly 30 years. The goal is to offer an affordable yet high-quality running experience for all age and performance levels. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, careful organization, and a cult clothing item as a keepsake. Despite modern timing and logistics, the original spirit and special community remain intact.
course_highlights: Courses from 0.5 km to 6.4 km
Family-friendly atmosphere and cult clothing item
Charity run and community activities
additional: The event offers a cult clothing item (KKK) as a finisher keepsake, which is redesigned annually. The organization is modeled after major city marathons but keeps the entry fees low. The event is supported by long-standing sponsors, enabling high-level execution. Cult clothing item, medals, modern logistics, online registration

name: Freundschaftslauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 15 km, 10 km, 10 km, 5 km, 5 km
description: The Friendship Run of the Bisttal-Runners Wadgassen is a running event that offers beautiful loop courses through the Wadgasser Forest. The route is suitable for both runners and walkers and passes through partly well-known, partly less frequented single trails. The event is aimed at recreational athletes from the region and provides a pleasant atmosphere for all performance levels.
course_highlights: Loop courses through the Wadgasser Forest
Suitable for runners and walkers
Partly well-known, partly less frequented single trails
additional: The Bisttal-Runners running group meets every Sunday at 10:30 AM at the Wadgassen Newspaper Museum. Participation is free and not tied to club membership. There are no fixed performance goals; everyone runs at their own pace, and the distance is chosen individually. Runs on loop courses through the forest, with distances of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, internal club events.

name: Garbenteicher Volkslauf
description: The Garbenteicher Volkslauf, organized by the Sports Club 1928 Garbenteich e.V., is a traditional race in Pohlheim, known as a good preparatory course for the Frankfurt Marathon. The route has been safety-optimized so that no federal roads or railway tracks need to be crossed. There are a total of seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea, and after the race, participants can enjoy excellent catering. The bib number distribution takes place on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before at the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich.
course_highlights: Safe route without crossing federal roads or railway tracks
Seven refreshment stations with water, cola, and tea
Routes of moderate difficulty with moderate elevation gain
additional: Bib numbers and transponders can be collected on the day of the event from 08:00 or the day before between 16:00 and 17:00. Late registrations are possible on the event day until race start for an additional fee of 5 EUR. Changes to other distances are free of charge up to two days before the race. The route is marked and checked multiple times before the start. The race takes place on September 13, 2026, starting behind the Sports and Culture Hall Garbenteich. There is no club affiliation requirement, and the event is ideal for marathon preparation.

name: Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf
description: The Hahnenfalzhüttenberglauf is a challenging mountain run that starts from Sägwasenplatz in Bad Herrenalb and leads to the Hahnenfalzhütte. The course covers 6 kilometers with an elevation gain of 519 meters, including steep ramps and gravel paths. The race is a traditional event organized by the Skizunft Bad Herrenalb and offers runners a demanding and scenic route in the heights above the Albursprung. The event combines athletic challenge with a convivial hut festival at the Hahnenfalzhütte.
course_highlights: 6 km course with 519 meters of elevation
Steep ramps and up to 21% incline
Path through the Felsenmeer and over gravel paths
additional: The race is traditionally held in conjunction with the Hahnenfalzhüttenfest. The course is partly wet and challenging, with ramps up to 21% incline. The Hahnenfalzhütte is located at 876 meters above sea level and is the finish line of the race. Participants range from young to old, with a broad age group from 14 to 78 years. The race is known for its elevation gain and steep inclines, with a festive event at the Hahnenfalzhütte including refreshments.

name: Hattinger Hüttenlauf
description: The Hattinger Hüttenlauf is a traditional race in HenrichsPark in Hattingen, offering various running and walking routes for all age groups. The course runs along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt beside the park ponds, starting and finishing under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte. In addition to the competitive race, there are classifications for children, youth, the fun run, and the 10 km Sparkassenlauf, as well as awards for the largest groups and the fastest Hattingen runners. The event is family-friendly and provides all participants with certificates for printing online.
course_highlights: Course in HenrichsPark along footpaths with cobblestones, gravel, and asphalt
Start and finish under Blast Furnace 3 at the LWL Museum Henrichshütte
Race along the park ponds
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before each start. All children in the Bambini race receive a medal. Certificates can be printed online by all participants. There are classifications in age groups and awards for the largest groups (schools, clubs) as well as for the fastest Hattingen runners. Various race distances, online registration, supporters from sports and business sectors.

name: Holzlandlauf
description: The Holzlandlauf is a traditional race in the Holzland near Hermsdorf, held annually on the second Saturday in September. Starting in 2026, the race will be part of the International Trail Running Association (ITRA), which grants the courses international recognition and makes the athletes' performances visible worldwide. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 11 km, and a half marathon, passing through the beautiful nature of the Holzland. The race is suitable for both ambitious trail runners and hobby runners and provides a special atmosphere in the region.
course_highlights: Trail runs through the Holzland with international ITRA recognition
Courses along the Birkenlinie to Bad Klosterlausnitz
Various distances: 5 km, 11 km, and half marathon
additional: Registration is via Laufservice Jena with SEPA direct debit. On race day, late registrations are accepted until 9:30 AM. Start times are staggered, with the first start at 8:30 AM at Werner-Seelenbinder-Sporthalle in Hermsdorf. In 2025, the routes were relocated due to timber harvesting, resulting in longer distances. Available distances include 800 m, 1.6 km, 11 km, half marathon, walking/nordic walking; refreshment stations; medals and certificates; no participation with dogs except assistance dogs; no political or discriminatory advertising.

name: Kiel Lauf
description: The Kiel.Lauf is a traditional running event in Kiel featuring various competitions for all age groups. The main discipline is the half marathon over 21.1 kilometers, which runs through the Kieler Westen and attracts both recreational runners and elite athletes. The popular race over 10.2 kilometers is the most participated event and offers a loop through Kiel city center with great atmosphere. Additionally, there are shorter runs for students and children, making the event family-friendly.
course_highlights: Half marathon runs through Kieler Westen
Popular race through Kiel city center
Various distances from about 0.7 km to 21.1 km
additional: The half marathon starts at 10:50 AM, the popular race at 9:45 AM. Due to construction work, there may be short-term route changes, which will be announced in advance. The event is very well attended with over 10,000 runners. There are various races for students and children, making the event family-friendly. The event includes street closures, participant information, and offers functional running shirts for most categories.

description: The Kristall-Lauf Weißwasser is a versatile popular race that appeals to runners and walkers of all ages. The course runs through mixed terrain including asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, and forest trails with roots. The race is part of several regional rankings such as the Dresden District Ranking, the Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, and the Niederlausitz Cup, and also offers an official walking classification by the German Athletics Association. A special feature is the traditional team race, which promotes community and team spirit.
course_highlights: Mixed terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots
Part of regional rankings: Dresden District Ranking, Sachsenenergie Runner Cup, Niederlausitz Cup
Official walking classification by the German Athletics Association
additional: Registrations on race day are possible on-site with an additional fee of €6 (2025) or €4 (2024). The race includes individual and team classifications. The routes are marked and binding on race day. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors. Terrain: asphalt, concrete, sandy paths, forest trail with roots; team race with at least three runners; start at Bruno-Bürgel-Oberschule; registration on-site or online.

name: LAUF FÜR MEHR ZEIT
location: Opernplatz, Frankfurt am Main, Hesse, Germany
description: The charity run RUN FOR MORE TIME is a well-established sporting and social event in Frankfurt am Main. Recreational runners, top athletes, and celebrities compete together on a circular course through downtown Frankfurt. Besides the athletic competition, fundraising and the joy of collective engagement are the main focus. The run offers five different distances for all age groups, from the toddler run to the 10-kilometer race, with start and finish at Opernplatz.
course_highlights: Circular course through downtown Frankfurt
5-kilometer large loop, 10-kilometer run with two laps
Refreshments with water on the course provided by the Frankfurt Running Shop
additional: Start numbers with electronic timing. Number pickup at Opernplatz on 12.09.2026 from 13:00 to 16:00 and on race day at various times depending on the race. The races take place sequentially with separate timing, starting gun, and finish line. Recommended arrival via U-Bahn station Alte Oper or parking garage Alte Oper; parking options are limited. Various race distances, registration until 01.09.2026, refreshments on the course, no showers, late registration possible.

name: Maiwaldlauf
description: The Maiwaldlauf in Rheinau-Freistett is a traditional community run organized by SV Freistett. The event offers runners and walkers an attractive course through nature around the Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion. The race is part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie and is aimed at recreational athletes of all ages. The family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized procedures make the Maiwaldlauf a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Courses through the Maiwald and surrounding nature
Start and finish at Friedrich-Stephan-Stadion
Part of the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie
additional: The Maiwaldlauf includes various distances, including 10 km run and 5 km run as well as walking. Detailed course maps and information about the individual routes are available on the website. The event is embedded in the Ortenauer Volkslaufserie. Organization is carried out by the recreational sports department of SV Freistett with contacts such as Alexander Dahlke and Regina Huber. The event takes place in September, with average temperatures around 19°C, and offers not only running competitions but also Nordic walking and hiking.

name: Miltenberger Landkreis Lauftag
location: Schul- und Sportzentrum, Elsenfeld, Miltenberg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Miltenberg County Running Day on September 13, 2026, offers a variety of running competitions for different age and performance groups. The courses lead through the Elsenfelder State Forest and along the old Spessart steam railway track, with scenic and mostly flat sections. All participants receive T-shirts, and the top runners are awarded with prizes. The event is ideal for runners seeking a well-organized and nature-oriented running event.
course_highlights: Half marathon with 2/3 paved road and 1/3 forest floor
Scenic course through the Elsenfelder State Forest and along the Spessart steam railway track
Loop courses with minimal elevation change and pleasant running character
additional: Catering on the course and at the finish line with drinks from Rhön-Sprudel; award ceremony before the Untermainhalle; all participants receive a T-shirt upon bib submission; special prizes for new course records. Registration available from May 1, 2026; diverse running offerings; start at the school and sports center in Elsenfeld.

name: Nibelungenlauf
description: The Nibelungenlauf in Worms is a traditional running event held annually on the second Sunday in September. The event offers a diverse program with races over various distances, embedded in a cultural framework along the Rhine promenade near the Hagendenkmal and Kriemhilds Rosengarten. Since 2004, over 44,000 participants from many nations have taken part, highlighting the popularity and international character of the event. The race is suitable for beginners and professionals alike and creates a special running experience in the Nibelungen city with its atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the newly designed Rhine promenade near the Hagendenkmal and Kriemhilds Rosengarten
Three turnaround routes with clear route markings: Half Marathon (blue), 10 km (red), and 5 km (green)
Run through the historic Nibelungen city of Worms with enthusiastic spectators and cultural program
additional: The event begins on Saturday with various activities and ends on Sunday with the races and award ceremony at the Hagendenkmal. There is a team classification, and participants under 18 years old require a parental consent form. Event shirts and hoodies can be ordered during registration. The event often fills up before the registration deadline. Registration is possible online, with deadlines on September 6, 2026, and options for team registrations and event shirts. The start and finish area is the Nibelungenlauf Arena on the Rhine.

name: Othaler Gutshof Lauf
distance_verbose: Halbmarathon, 10 km, 5 km, 2 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: The Othaler Gutshoflauf is a young but popular running event with start and finish at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal. The event offers various distances from 0.5 km up to the half marathon of 21.1 km, which is run as the Intersport Liebig Half Marathon through several towns. The race allows participants to explore the eastern foothills of the Harz on diverse routes. Approximately 350 runners participate annually, highlighting the growing popularity of the event.
course_highlights: Half marathon route through Sotterhausen, Holdenstedt, Klosterrode, and Beyernaumburg
Start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal
Various distances from 0.5 km to 21.1 km
additional: Start times: 09:00 AM for the half marathon, 09:45 AM for 10 km run/walking, 10:00 AM for 5 km run/walking, 10:05 AM for 0.5 km run, 10:15 AM for 1 km run, 10:30 AM for 2 km run. Routes for children, hobby runners, and competitive runners; start and finish area at the youth and school farm at Gutshof Othal; supported by sponsors such as Intersport Liebig and Autohaus Liebe.

name: Rathaus Center Dessauer CityRUN
description: The 26th Dessau Rathaus-Center CityRUN is a traditional race in the city center of Dessau, attracting runners from the region and beyond for many years. The course runs on a loop through central streets of the city with start and finish on Zerbster Straße near the Rathaus-Center. The race offers a sporting challenge in an urban environment and is part of a diverse sports program organized by the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing major sporting events in the region for decades.
course_highlights: Loop course through the city center of Dessau

Course route via Steinstraße, Askanische Straße, and Kavalierstraße
additional: Volksbank children's run for children up to 9 years old over 1,000 meters, free for all children and students of Dessau. The organizer is the club Anhalt Sport e.V., which has been organizing numerous major sports events in the region for over 20 years. Various distances, including children's runs, corporate run, registration on-site possible, finisher medals.

name: Run for life
location: Vorplatz des Bayerischen Nationalmuseums, München, Bayern, Germany
description: The Run for Life is a charity run established in 2001 in support of the Munich AIDS Help e.V. On September 13, 2026, the 26th edition of this popular race approved by the DLV will take place. The run starts at 2:00 PM at the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum in Munich and leads along a well-known route through the English Garden. The event is under the patronage of Munich's Lord Mayor Dominik Krause and combines athletic commitment with social engagement.
course_highlights: Start at the forecourt of the Bavarian National Museum / Prinzregentenstraße
Run through the English Garden
Famous and proven race route
additional: Registration for Run for Life 2026 opens from June 15. Participation is not allowed for individuals spreading the technology of L. Ron Hubbard. The event relies on volunteers who assist as course marshals, during setup and takedown, or in children's care. Payments can also be made on the day of the event if the participant limit has not been reached. Charity run, registration from mid-June, start at 2:00 PM, run through the English Garden.

name: runroll City
description: The event runroll City takes place on September 13, 2026, in Bielefeld and offers a fast-paced sports experience on a 7.2-kilometer flat course right in the city. The course is ideal for quick times and suitable for both intensive running training and a fast competition. Participants can enjoy movement in an urban environment and become part of a dynamic event.
course_highlights: 7.2 kilometer long course
flat course for fast times
urban race in the heart of Bielefeld
additional: The event is known for its inclusive atmosphere and the opportunity to run or skate. It is aimed at everyone who enjoys movement in the city and offers an attractive route in downtown Bielefeld.

name: Seewooglauf
description: The Seewooglauf in Ramstein-Miesenbach is organized by FV Olympia Ramstein and offers races over 10 km and 5 km as well as a 5 km walking competition. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and is open to runners and walkers of all performance levels. The course runs through the scenic surroundings around Ramstein and provides a sporting challenge in a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: 10 km and 5 km race courses
5 km walking route
Event location Reichswaldsporthalle in Ramstein-Miesenbach
additional: Starting fees from €7, registration until 30 minutes before the start, results online, small surprises for children's races

name: Sindiso-Spendenlauf
location: Hof von Walter Jahn, Zeitlarn, Bavaria, Germany
price_range: 20 Euro für Laufshirt, Spenden ab 20 Euro für Teilnahme
description: The Sindiso Charity Run on September 13, 2026, in Zeitlarn is a community event that combines running, celebration, and fundraising. The event takes place at Walter Jahn's farm and offers races for children and adults as well as a lively festival with many attractions for kids. Besides the sporting experience, supporting the educational project in Rabuor/Kenya is the main focus. Food and drinks are provided, and there are various entertainment options such as a children's train, face painting, and vehicle exhibitions.
course_highlights: 10 km run consisting of 2 laps of 5 km each
Attractions for children such as children's train and face painting
Vehicle exhibition by Wasserwacht Neutraubling, Voluntary Fire Brigade Laub, and BRK Barbing/Neutraubling
additional: The Sindiso running shirt can be purchased on race day for 20 euros after ordering via online registration. There are races for different age groups and disciplines, including 400 m toddler farm run, 1.5 km children's run, 5 km run, 10 km run, and 5 km Nordic walking. The event begins with a large party from 11:00 am and offers a variety of food and a colorful program. 10 km run (2 x 5 km), family activities, children's program, vehicle exhibition, and donations for the educational project in Kenya.

name: Stiftungslauf Salzgitter
description: The Foundation Run at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event taking place on September 13, 2026. The event offers various race competitions, including two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. The start is at 10:30 AM at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt. The Salzgitter Foundation invites all running enthusiasts to join in and enjoy the fun of movement together.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the DLRG building at Salzgittersee
Various race competitions: main runs, relay race, short run, walking
Run along Salzgittersee in Lebenstedt
additional: The event includes two main runs, a relay race, a short run, and walking. For questions, the organizer can be reached by phone at 0172/5416779. Event at Salzgittersee with main runs, relay race, short run, and walking.

name: TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. - Wuzzelauf Altenhain
description: The Wuzzelauf Altenhain is a charity run held annually since 2008, organized by TSG Altenhain 1900 e.V. It continues a local tradition where residents of the Main Taunus district refer to each other with nicknames, especially "Wuzze" for Altenhainer. The run combines athletic commitment with regional history and community spirit. The event takes place on September 13, 2026, and invites runners of all ages to participate in this special event.
course_highlights: Traditional connection to regional nickname culture
Run through the community of Altenhain in the Main Taunus district
Event as a charity run with local relevance
additional: The event takes place annually on the second Sunday in September. The proceeds benefit various charitable causes, including support for people with disabilities in the Rhein-Main area. Registration and further details are available on the official website.

name: Volksbank-Münster-Marathon
description: The Volksbank-Münster-Marathon is a major running event organized by runners for runners, mostly on a voluntary basis and with great passion. With around 12,000 participants, over 300 artists and bands along the route, and more than 100,000 spectators, the autumn marathon offers a unique atmosphere. The course is almost flat and runs through the bike- and run-friendly city of Münster. At the finish area on the Prinzipalmarkt, a red carpet is rolled out, making the finish line a special experience.
course_highlights: Course almost flat
Over 300 artists and bands along the route
Finish on a red carpet at Prinzipalmarkt
additional: The marathon is part of a large event with several competitions such as Atruvia Relay Marathon, Wecker-28 (28 km), Stadtwerke Kids Marathon, Westfalen AG Charity Run (10 km), and H+B technics Health Run (6 km). There is a combined ranking with the Enschede Marathon. The marathon office is staffed on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays from 9:00 am to 3:00 pm. A marathon guide with general information and FAQs is available. The marathon attracts about 12,000 runners, offers qualification opportunities for other races, and is supported by numerous sponsors. There are also accompanying events such as lectures and health seminars.

name: Waldlauf des TuS Calle-Wallen - Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup
description: The 46th Forest Run of TuS Calle-Wallen is part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup and takes place on September 13, 2026, in Meschede. The event offers races over 1 km and 10 km and is aimed at runners of all ages. The race leads through the forested areas around Meschede and promises a varied course in a natural setting. The typical weather in September is mild and mostly cloudy, ideal for running events.
course_highlights: Run through the forested areas around Meschede
Course lengths of 1 km and 10 km
Natural and varied running route
additional: The typical weather in September is around 19°C with lows of about 10°C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. The event takes place in Meschede, with typical weather around 19°C and overcast skies. It is a good opportunity for the whole family to participate in a traditional race.
