Participants benefit from a luggage depot at the finish area and a friendly atmosphere on the Eastern Alb.
course_highlights: Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail: 32 km trail running with 1100 meters of elevation, starting underground in the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine
VR Bank-BraunenBerg-Run: 14.6 km technically easy mountain run with 446 meters of elevation
Luggage depot at the finish area Oberalfingen and catering during the runs
additional: Start of the Rolladen Kaiser-BraunenBerg-Trail underground in the Tiefen Stollen visitor mine with special bus transfer from Oberalfingen at 9:45 AM. Personalized start numbers with chip for timing, GPX data available for download, finish area catering, medals for all finishers. Luggage depot (drop bag) available at the finish area Oberalfingen, liability for valuables is not assumed. Disqualification for exceeding the time limit on longer distances. Award ceremony at 3:30 PM at the Getränke Keller Oberalfingen finish area. Multiple race categories including trail, main run, and children's runs; routes pass landmarks such as the Braunenberg, mining trail, TV tower, and Naturfreundehaus; registration and more info on the official website.

name: Crosslauf Rund um den Wasserturm
description: The cross-country race around the water tower in Oberschöna is a varied run offering distances from 1 km to 10 km. Children and students can participate in special races, and Nordic walkers are also warmly welcomed. The course runs around the distinctive water tower and provides a sporting challenge in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country run around the water tower
Distances of 1 km, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Separate races for children and students
additional: Nordic walkers are also welcome. Typical weather in September: about 19°C, mostly cloudy with approximately 45 mm of precipitation. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various competitions and routes for all age groups.

name: Duinger Berglauf
description: The Duinger Mountain Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Duingen, Lower Saxony, and offers races for children and adults. The event starts and ends at the OBS sports hall and includes short children's races as well as more challenging 5 km and 10 km mountain runs with approximately 110 meters of elevation gain. Organized by the Duinger Sports Club e.V., the race has been an accessible local mountain running event for 19 years. After the race, all participants receive free access to the indoor pool and sauna, with changing rooms, showers, and on-site catering.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses with approx. 110 m elevation gain
Route mainly on paved field and forest paths
Children's races near the school grounds, adult races from the sports hall
additional: Late registration is possible up to one hour before the start. Free access to the indoor pool and sauna after the race. Changing rooms, showers, food, and drinks available on-site. No club membership required. Various distances, including children's and adult categories; registration possible until shortly before the race; post-race amenities include indoor pool and sauna.

name: Edeka Ladage-Lauf Wennigsen

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 3 € Teilnehmer:innen: Kindergarten­kinder laufen eine etwa 600 m und Grundschüler:innen eine 900 m lange Strecke.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2014 und jünger (U12) | Jahrgänge 2010 bis 2013 (U16)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgeld: 8 € || Jahrgänge 2007 und jünger: 4 € Teilnehmer:innen: Jahrgänge 2015 und älter

description: The EDEKA Ladage Run in Wennigsen offers a diverse program for all age groups with distances ranging from about 600 meters for kindergarten children to 10 kilometers for adults. The races take place on a varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule, which passes through residential areas and field paths and promises a special atmosphere at the start and finish. In addition to the sporting competition, the social aspect is also in the foreground, as the proceeds from the main race are donated to the craft community of the Wennigser Wasserräder e.V. The event is a popular community run with a family atmosphere and a long tradition in the region.
course_highlights: Varied loop course on the grounds of the Sophie-Scholl-Gesamtschule
Course passes through residential areas, field paths, and along Argestorfer Straße
Start and finish in close proximity to the event area with a special atmosphere
additional: Registrations are possible until one hour before the respective start with additional fees. Kindergarten and elementary school children runs start at 5:00 PM, with award ceremonies shortly after the races. The 5 km run consists of two laps of the 2.5 km loop course, and the 10 km run consists of four laps. Participation in the main race includes automatic entry into the prize draw. The proceeds from the main race are donated. Various distances, children and adult categories, donations to local clubs.

name: Fichtelgebirgstrailrun
description: The Fichtelgebirgstrailrun is a challenging trail running competition that takes place on partly unpaved paths and trails in the natural surroundings of the Fichtel Mountains. It requires participants to have good endurance and coordination as well as respect and self-responsibility towards themselves, fellow runners, and the environment. The course runs through the unique and sensitive nature of the Fichtel Mountains and offers runners an intense natural experience. The event places great emphasis on safety, fairness, and environmental protection.
course_highlights: Trail running on unpaved paths and trails in the open nature
Challenging course with high physical and coordinative demands
Natural experience in the sensitive Fichtel Mountains
additional: Participation is only for healthy and well-trained runners. A strict regulation applies with disqualification for leaving the course, unsportsmanlike conduct, or doping. Participants should stop in case of danger to their own health and provide first aid until medical services arrive. Trail run in the Fichtel Mountains, online registration, no shower facilities, details on the website.

name: Fit in Lautern Lauf 1. Lauf zu Gunsten des Fördervereins Waschmühle e.V.
description: The Fit in Lautern Run is a charity run in support of the Förderverein Waschmühle e.V. in Kaiserslautern. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and offers a sporting opportunity to strengthen the community while supporting a good cause. The run takes place around the Waschmühle outdoor pool, a well-known location in Kaiserslautern. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and promotes health and social engagement.
course_highlights: Run around the Waschmühle outdoor pool
Event in Kaiserslautern with a social purpose
First run in support of the Förderverein Waschmühle e.V.
additional: The event takes place near the Waschmühle outdoor pool. Further details on routes and registration are not currently available.

name: Freimarktslauf
description: The Garrel Freimarktslauf is the largest community run in the region and offers a diverse running experience with its flat loop courses for young and old, beginners and professionals. The event includes distances from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for main races, which take place on a 2.5 km flat loop through Garrel. In addition to the athletic competition, community and fun are the main focus, supported by the RunClub Garrel, which specifically promotes beginners. Over 1,300 participants make the race a popular event with unforgettable moments.
course_highlights: Flat 2.5 km loop course through Garrel
All main races on the same loop with 1, 2, or 4 laps
Varied distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: The race offers a combined scoring for 5 km and 10 km runs. There are special races for children and adolescents, including a children's run, a taster run, and a school children’s run. The RunClub Garrel supports beginners and re-entrants with joint training sessions. The event is a large community celebration with over 1,300 participants and numerous photos and results available online. The race includes various distances and is open to runners of all ages. Registration is online, and the event is part of regional festivities.

name: Insellauf Rund um Amrum
location: Norddorf auf Amrum, Nordfriesland, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Island Run around Amrum is a popular running event for everyone, taking place annually in late summer on the North Sea island of Amrum in Norddorf. The event offers a sporting challenge amidst the unique nature of the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Participants can enjoy the varied landscape with dunes, Kniepsand (a type of sandy beach), and sea views. The race is an attractive opportunity for both locals and vacationers to combine activity and nature experience.
course_highlights: Run through the diverse landscape with Kniepsand and dunes
Course within the Wadden Sea National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site
Start and finish in Norddorf on Amrum
additional: The island run takes place annually in late summer. The event is part of the extensive sports program on Amrum. The venue is the AOK-Nordseeklinik Strunwai 23 in Norddorf on Amrum. The event occurs within the Wadden Sea National Park area and emphasizes nature experience and beach activities. Registration is possible on-site or via email, with catering and support from local partners.

name: Int. Bodensee-Marathon
location: Kressbronn am Bodensee, Bodenseekreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The International Lake Constance Marathon in Kressbronn am Bodensee is a traditional running event with over 50 years of history. The course takes place on a circular route through the town center, along the Argen river, and by the Lake Constance shoreline, with marathon runners completing two half-marathon laps. The event offers an attractive combination of sporting challenge and scenic beauty in a natural environment. Finishers receive wooden medals, and a high-quality finisher shirt can be optionally ordered. Alongside the race, a popular street festival with music, culinary offerings, and a flea market takes place.
course_highlights: Circular course through Kressbronn starting on the main street
Loop of approximately 12 km along the Argen on shaded nature trails
Marathon consists of two half-marathon laps with finish line in front of the festival hall
additional: Finishers receive wooden medals. The high-quality finisher shirt (Puma, dark blue) can be ordered for €30 during registration, with pickup on site or at the equipment partner. Shuttle service from the beach park parking lot to the festival hall is offered. Late registrations are possible on race day (8:30-11:00 am, Kids Run until 10:00 am) with a €5 late registration fee, except for Kids Run and fully booked half-marathon. The Kressbronn street festival with live music, culinary offerings, and flea market takes place on the event day in the town center. The event provides a pleasant running atmosphere, support from numerous sponsors, a shuttle bus option, and the opportunity to donate to the Kressbronn swimming pool.

name: Int. Pronsfelder Volks- und Straßenlauf
description: The 38th International Pronsfelder Folk and Street Run offers a diverse running experience in the heart of the Eifel for all age groups and performance levels. From Bambini and children's races to the general run and half marathon, there is something for everyone. The event is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, attractive prizes, and excellent catering at the finish area. The start and finish are located at the Mais-Glandien car dealership in Pronsfeld, and the run is a sporting highlight with tradition and community spirit.
course_highlights: Diverse routes from 200 m to half marathon (21 km)
Start and finish at Mais-Glandien car dealership, Lünebacher Str. 1 - 3, 54597 Pronsfeld
Participation in the 4-Regio-Cup in the 10 km main race
additional: Medals and gifts for Bambini and children/youth. Prizes, bouquets, and vouchers in the main race. Each Nordic walking participant receives a gift. Catering and drinks at the finish area. Event with a family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. The event takes place on September 19, 2026. Online registration available. Various distances including walking and half marathon. Catering and atmosphere at the finish area.

name: Kapuziner-Kessellauf
description: The Kapuziner Kessellauf is a traditional race through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest, starting at the Weiher Sports Center. Since its revival in 2002, it has been a fixed part of the Upper Franconian race calendar. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a varied supporting program with music, coffee and cake, a finish buffet, and a large raffle. The event is especially family-friendly with the children's and school runs, which award medals to all participants. The event also promotes community spirit through team rankings and awards for the most participating teams.
course_highlights: Run through the Kessel and the Kulmbach Forest
Start at the Weiher Sports Center
Family-friendly children's and school runs with medals
additional: Late registrations are possible until 19.09.2026 at 9:00 PM for a fee of 5 euros. Team rankings are only for the main race, separated by men and women. The most participating team will be awarded a material prize. For Nordic walking, timing is provided without finish placement. The supporting program includes music, coffee & cake, a finish buffet, children's care, finisher medals for the school and children runs, and a large raffle. The course runs through forest and woodland paths. Children's and school runs, supporting program with music, coffee & cake, raffle, bib number distribution on 19.09.2026, participant limit of 500 people.

name: Klausdorfer Kranichlauf
description: The Klausdorf Crane Run invites runners of all ages to various routes in the beautiful surroundings of Klausdorf. Timing is done with a chip issued with the start number. Each participant receives a certificate and a medal, and the top three finishers of each route are specially honored. Refreshments are provided on the course and at the finish line, and changing rooms and toilets are available at the Vorpommernhus. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Running routes through Klausdorf, Hohendorf, Wendisch-Langendorf, Zarrenzin, Barhöft, and Prohn with views
Start and finish at the Vorpommernhus near the beach
Refreshments on the course and at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible on September 18, 2026, from 18:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 07:00 to 09:30 at the Vorpommernhus. The award ceremony for the Landknirpselauf takes place immediately after crossing the finish line. Parking is sufficiently available around the Vorpommernhus. Registration is possible via email or online. Participation is at your own risk. Medals and certificates are provided to all participants. Refreshments are available at the finish and on the course. Parking is available.

name: Mühlenlauf in Laar
location: Laar, Grafschaft Bentheim, Lower Saxony, Germany
organizer: Verein zur Erhaltung der Windmühle Laar/Vechte e.V.
description: The Mill Run in Laar has been organized by SV Grenzland Laarwald since 1986 and takes place annually on the third weekend of September. Runners of all ages can choose between 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances. The start and finish are located at the historic windmill, which, together with the Mill Society, creates a cozy atmosphere. Food and drinks are available to ensure the well-being of participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic windmill in Laar
Distances: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Run through the scenic surroundings of Laar
additional: The Mill Run is organized in cooperation with the sports club. The windmill and the homeland house can be rented for celebrations. Drinks and snack offers are available on site for runners and spectators. The event takes place in September, with provisions for drinks and snacks. Pre-registrations are possible, and late registrations can be made on site. The event is held in all weather conditions.

name: Nassauer Hospiz-Charity-Run 2026
description: The Nassauer Hospice Charity Run 2026 in Seelbach is a diverse running event taking place on September 19, 2026, offering distances from 250 meters for children up to 10 kilometers for experienced runners. The event combines athletic challenge with social commitment by supporting the important work of the hospice in Nassau. Participants enjoy the magnificent nature of the Taunus and experience a family-friendly event centered around communal helping.
course_highlights: Diverse distances from 250 m to 10 km
Run through the magnificent nature of the Taunus
Family-friendly event focused on solidarity and support
additional: The run serves as a charity event to support the inpatient Rhein-Lahn Hospice. Great emphasis is placed on community engagement and donations for the hospice. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, with a natural setting in the Taunus, including distances for children and adults.

name: Neusser Integrationslauf
description: The Neuss Integration Run, organized by DJK RHEINKRAFT Neuss 1914 e.V., will take place on September 19, 2026, at the Ludwig-Wolker-Sports Facility in Neuss. The run stands for active integration, where people of all origins, skin colors, religions, and with disabilities can run or walk together. The focus is on the community experience and a symbol for integration, not on competition. The colorful supporting program with music, children's activities, and culinary offerings makes the day a festival for participants and visitors.
course_highlights: Open course for running and walking without time pressure
Diverse participants of all ages and backgrounds
Colorful supporting program with bouncy castle, bull riding, and music
additional: The run is open to all age groups, origins, skin colors, religions, and disabilities. There are no rankings; fun and community are the priorities. The supporting program offers a variety of activities for participants and visitors, including a bouncy castle, bull riding, children's program, music, and culinary specialties. The event takes place at the Ludwig-Wolker Sports Facility and is part of the SportWeek for All 2026, with inclusive sports offerings and trial activities.

name: Röderhof-Benefiz-Lauf
description: The Röderhof Benefit Run takes place on September 19, 2026, in Diekholzen and offers various running and walking routes for all age groups and fitness levels. The event is a traditional charity event, emphasizing the fun of running and the collective commitment to a good cause. The distances range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers, including special wheelchair races. Start times are staggered to ensure smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Varied distances from 500 m to 10 km
Includes wheelchair races and walking routes
Run through the scenic surroundings of Diekholzen
additional: Registration deadline online is September 15 at 21:00. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the start, with an additional fee of 2 euros. Payment can be made via direct debit. The event features multiple start times for different routes and categories, including special wheelchair races and walking routes. Various running disciplines, wheelchair races, walking, and donation options via PayPal.

name: Seelauf TSV-Obernzenn
description: The Seelauf of TSV Obernzenn is a traditional running event with various distances for children, adolescents, and adults. The course includes a toddler run, school runs, a middle-distance race, and a long-distance race of approximately 10.7 km. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with guest gifts for participants and attractive prizes for the top runners. Registration is exclusively online via my.raceresult.com starting May 1, 2026. Start times are staggered to ensure smooth proceedings.
course_highlights: Long-distance race approx. 10.7 km with elevation profile
Middle-distance and long-distance races for youth and adults
Children's runs of about 400 m for toddlers and school children
additional: Late registrations are possible up to one hour before the start for a fee of €3. Distribution of race bibs begins at 9:15 AM at the sports clubhouse. All toddlers and school children receive a T-shirt as a guest gift, and the first 60 participants of the middle- and long-distance races receive a functional shirt. Participants in the toddler run receive a gold medal and certificate, while school run participants receive trophies, medals, and certificates. Results lists and certificates are available online. The event also includes a children's run of about 400 m and longer distances of approximately 10.7 km. The event takes place at the sports field of TSV Obernzenn and is part of the club activities.

name: Sparkassen-Altstadtlauf
description: The Sparkassen Old Town Run in Ottweiler is a traditional race that combines inclusion, emotion, and athletic excellence. The event takes place annually and offers runners of all ages and performance levels the opportunity to run through the historic old town of Ottweiler. The event promotes community and sporting ambition in a lively atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the historic old town of Ottweiler
Inclusive event focused on community
Athletic excellence in an emotional atmosphere
additional: The event promotes community spirit and sporting activity in a historic setting.

name: Volkslauf Rund um den Disibodenberg
location: Disibodenberg, Odernheim am Glan, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Disibodenberg Run is a traditional community race around the Disibodenberg in Odernheim, taking place for the 38th time in 2026. The scenic course connects flat sections along the Glan river with a challenging ascent on the Eselspfad trail, shaping the character of the race. Offered are 5 km and 10 km runs, walking on the 5 km route, as well as children's and youth races starting from 200 meters. The event is sport-oriented and family-friendly, with special prizes for records, families, teams, and Walk-&-Talk groups. The award ceremony and social gathering are held in the gymnasium with coffee, cake, and grilled food.
course_highlights: Scenic course along the Glan river
Challenging ascent on the Eselspfad trail
Combination of flat sections and trail passages
additional: Preparation runs for children are held on three Tuesdays in September from 6:30 PM at the gymnasium. The entry fee is paid when collecting race materials. Special prizes are awarded for new course records, the most enthusiastic family, the largest team, and the happiest Walk-&-Talk group. The award ceremony takes place in the gymnasium, where coffee, homemade cake, and grilled food are available at reasonable prices. The event features varied terrain, parking facilities, changing rooms, and showers on site, making it a popular community event in September.

name: Wehringer Wertachlauf mit schwäbischen Meisterschaften
description: The Wehringer Wertachlauf is a local running event in Wehringen, Germany, organized by the Wehringen Running Community. The program includes a short 350-meter race and a 10 km race, classified as a short run. The course runs around the village of Wehringen and offers a family-friendly atmosphere. This edition also includes the Swabian Championships.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Aue 6 near the musicians' house in Wehringen
Two distances: 350 m and 10 km
Course around the village of Wehringen, no point-to-point course
additional: The event takes place on September 19, 2026. The weather in September is typically around 19°C with a minimum of 10°C and mostly cloudy. The event is short and simple, focusing on the local character. Distances: 350 m, 10 km; including Swabian Championships; location in Wehringen

name: Welterbelauf Zollverein 2026
location: Zollverein, Essen-Stoppenberg, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Zollverein World Heritage Run takes place on September 19, 2026, on the grounds of the Zollverein Coal Mine Industrial Complex in Essen-Stoppenberg. The race routes lead over the Ring Promenade and past notable industrial monuments such as the Doppelbock headframe, the SANAA building, and the Zollverein slag heap. Various competitions are available for all age and performance levels, including a 10 km run, relays, walking events, and Special Olympics categories. The 10 km course is officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for rankings. The run combines athletic challenge with the unique atmosphere of UNESCO World Heritage.
course_highlights: Route over the Ring Promenade and past the Doppelbock headframe
Passage by the SANAA building and the Zollverein slag heap
10 km course officially measured by DLV and eligible for rankings
additional: The event offers eight different competitions, including the 10 km Zollverein Run, 3 x 3.3 km Pütt relay, 5.4 km Kumpel Run and Steiger Walk, 2.7 km Coal Mine Run, 1.2 km Schülerlauf (student race), 600 m Helen Keller Run, and 300 m Bambini Run. Parking on the grounds is free for participants and visitors. The event is easily accessible by public transport and car. International competition rules of the DLV and IAAF apply. Registration begins on May 15, 2026; the event includes team relays (Pütt Run) and offers certificates and results online.

name: Wilstermarsch Lauf
description: The Wilstermarsch Run is a traditional running event in Wilster, taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 34th time. The event offers various race distances for children and adults, including 400 meters, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, passing through the scenic Wilstermarsch. In addition to the athletic competition, a lively supporting program with games, bouncy castles, a DJ, a barbecue stand, and refreshments provides entertainment and a feel-good atmosphere for participants and spectators. The run is part of the Steinburg Cup and attracts several hundred runners each year, supported by numerous volunteers.
course_highlights: Runs through the scenic Wilstermarsch
Stadium rounds for children with loud support from spectators
5 km loop course through Nortorf and Wilster with varied terrain
additional: The Wilstermarsch Run includes multiple races for different age groups and distances, including children’s runs from 400 meters, 2 km children’s race, 5 km, and 10 km runs, as well as 5 km walking. There is an extensive supporting program with bouncy castles, a DJ, barbecue stand, refreshments, and photo wall. The event is supported by approximately 40 volunteers and is part of the Steinburg Cup. Prizes and vouchers are raffled among participants, and milestone gifts are given to the 33rd finishers. Registrations are planned for spring 2026. The event is family-friendly, offering entertainment for all involved.

name: Wutzseelauf
description: The Wutzseelauf in Lindow (Mark) is a family-friendly road race taking place on September 19, 2026, for the 21st time. The varied courses lead around Lake Wutzsee through the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park and offer running opportunities for all age groups from babies to experienced runners. The event is characterized by a warm atmosphere, professional timing with transponders, and a colorful supporting program. Participants can look forward to distances from 600 meters to 22 kilometers, including Nordic walking. After the races, award ceremonies are held, and each finisher receives a certificate available for download or print on-site.
course_highlights: Running courses around Lake Wutzsee in the Stechlin-Ruppiner Land Nature Park
Distances from 600 m to 22 km for all age groups
Varied routes with forest and lake passages
additional: Timing is done using transponders integrated into the start numbers via myRacePartner. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event online until 10 minutes before the respective start, except for the Bambini runs, which have no late registration fee. Award ceremonies take place shortly after the races. Each finisher can download their certificate online or have it printed on-site. Course profiles for children, adolescents, and adults, online registration, start numbers with transponder, various distances, routes through forest and around Lake Wutzsee.

name: Běh pro hospic Červený Kostelec
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Děti: jednotné startovné 100 Kč (online i na místě)

description: Run for Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children's courses along forest paths and courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain predominantly asphalt with some forest and field roads. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services of the Červený Kostelec Regional Charity. Participants can enjoy a pleasant landscape around the local ponds with views of the surrounding mountains.
course_highlights: Children's courses run along forest paths
Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery around the ponds in Červený Kostelec with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina
additional: Online registration is possible until September 19, 2026, at 6:00 AM, with on-site registration available for a higher entry fee. The first 300 registered participants will receive a small gift. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská street, about a 10-minute walk from the race location. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series with fair-play rules and no accompaniment (dog, bike, scooter, etc.). All proceeds are dedicated to supporting Hospice Anežky České.

name: Zátopkova 10
location: Lomená alej, Stará Boleslav, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 600 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 1200 Kč od 1. 1. 2026 až do závodu (v případě volné kapacity)

description: Zátopkova 10 is a traditional running race held in Lomená alley in Staré Boleslav, which takes place on two five-kilometer loops through forest paths. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup 2026 series and offers a main race of 10 km, a two-person relay, and children's races over 500 and 1000 meters. The course is mostly flat, and the start is interval-based, with a continuous refreshment station. Runners receive a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, and additional services including refreshments and race photos.
course_highlights: Two loops of 5 km through forest paths
Course runs almost flat
Continuous refreshment station with isotonic drinks, water, and fruit
additional: Start is interval-based. The capacity of the main race is 500 runners, children's races 100 runners. Included in the registration fee are a bib with a timing chip, a commemorative medal, SMS results, an electronic certificate, photos from the course or finish line, and refreshments on the course and at the finish. Parking is available near the start and finish. Trail terrain, forest paths, registration online and on-site, race categories include main race, relay, and children’s races.

name: Li.T.R. – Lipno.trail.run.
location: Lipno nad Vltavou, South Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Registruji dítě na dětský závod 250 Kč

description: Li.t.r. is a weekend trail festival featuring a main race of 108 km with over 2000 meters of elevation change around Lipno. The run offers a unique opportunity to explore the unknown landscape of Lipno, its history, and stories during a challenging ultratrail. The race is open to both solo runners and teams, and is complemented by an accompanying program from Friday to Sunday. The atmosphere is community-oriented and friendly, organized by runners for runners with respect for nature and local culture.
course_highlights: 108 km long trail with over 2000 meters of elevation gain
The route runs along narrow forest trails around the largest water surface in the Czech Republic - Lipno
The route is divided into 8 sections (8 - 14 km), all transfer points are easily accessible by car
additional: Start and finish of the race are in front of the Stodola restaurant in Lipno nad Vltavou. There are changing rooms, showers, and parking available at the start. The route is divided into 8 sections with transfer points accessible by car. Included in the registration fee is a dropbag for solo runners, refreshments at transfer points (water, isotonic drinks, fruit), timing and results service. The accompanying program runs from Friday to Sunday, including lectures, music, and group activities. The registration fee is non-refundable but transferable. Participants must be at least 18 years old, or 15+ with parental consent. Children under 6 years old only with accompaniment. A multi-segment trail race with an accompanying program, accommodation options, involvement of local gastronomy and history.

name: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem
location: Ústí nad Labem, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Running Festival Ústí nad Labem 2026 is a traditional running race with a fast and flat course that runs along the Elbe River and past the local chemical plant. This half marathon is known as the "Ferrari among races" due to its speed and frequently broken records. During the race, runners will enjoy beautiful views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle. The festival offers various running disciplines including the half marathon, relay half marathon, 10 km run, and family runs.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course along the Elbe River
Passage through the local chemical plant
Views of the České středohoří mountains and Střekov Castle
additional: Possibility to authorize another person to pick up the start number. Start times for different races during the day: half marathon at 09:00, other runs at 11:00, 14:30, and 14:45. The 16th edition, approximately 3500 runners participated. The race is part of running series and offers the RunCzech mobile app for participants. The event takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes various races, an expo with official merchandise, and registration options. The course passes through city landmarks and industrial areas, suitable for all age groups.

name: Mladé Běchovice
description: Young Běchovice is a traditional running race intended for children from 1 to 18 years old, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The race offers courses of various lengths from 50 to 1300 meters to accommodate a wide age range of participants. Approximately 800 children participate each year, making it a significant sporting event for young runners. In 2026, the 61st edition of this popular race will take place.
course_highlights: Courses from 50 to 1300 meters suitable for children from 1 to 18 years old
The race takes place on a grass field
Approximately 800 participants annually
additional: The race is suitable for children, held on a grass field in Prague-Běchovice. The organizer is the association Mladé Běchovice, z.s. Contact is also possible by phone at +420 606481222. The race is intended for children and youth, taking place in September 2026, with approximately 800 participants. The event focuses on promoting sports and a healthy lifestyle among youth.

name: Běh Moravským krasem
location: Sloup v Moravském krasu, Blansko, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Moravian Karst Run is part of the Blansko District Running League, which has a tradition since 1976. This race offers runners from the Blansko area and surroundings the opportunity to test their strength in the beautiful natural environment of the Moravian Karst. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of an annual competition that promotes running sports in the region. The organizers strive to ensure quality service and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic terrain of the Moravian Karst
The race is part of the traditional Blansko District Running League
Natural scenery and quality running facilities
additional: The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Sloup in the Moravian Karst, and is part of a regional running league with multiple events throughout the year.

name: Litovelská nealkoholická čtrnáctka
description: The Litovel Non-Alcoholic Fourteen is a traditional running race organized by TJ Liga stovkařů Olomouc, held in the picturesque town of Litovel in the Olomouc Region. The race is part of a running series and offers an opportunity for both fitness and competitive runners. Liga stovkařů is known for its long-standing tradition and support of the running community in Central Moravia. The race is suitable for the general public, and its friendly atmosphere is emphasized by its name, which refers to the non-alcoholic nature of the event.
course_highlights: The route passes through scenic surroundings of Litovel and its vicinity
Mostly asphalt and paved surface suitable for fast running
Part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: The race is part of a series of local running events in Olomouc and the surrounding area, with offerings for organizers and other races in the region.

name: Podzimní běh Heřmanův Městec
location: Zámecký park, Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The autumn run in Heřmanův Městec is a traditional race held in the beautiful castle park. It offers two main routes of 5 km and 10 km (two laps) as well as children's races at the start and finish area. The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league and attracts runners of all ages who enjoy a pleasant autumn atmosphere and quality facilities.
course_highlights: The route runs through the castle park of Heřmanův Městec
Two race options: 5 km and 10 km (two laps)
Children's races at the start and finish area
additional: The race is part of the Vládce Mrdic sports league, which includes a series of races and public measured training sessions throughout the year. The race takes place on September 19, 2026. Registration is available on the official website. The course profiles are not specified exactly but run through the natural surroundings of Heřmanův Městec.

name: Hořovický cvoček
price_range: 150 CZK v předprodeji, 200 CZK na místě
description: The Hořovice Nail is a traditional running race held in Hořovice, offering a course approximately 12 km long. The race runs through forest paths and asphalt and starts from Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec. The main race begins at 10:00 AM and is intended for adult runners without children's categories. The registration fee is 150 CZK in advance and 200 CZK on the spot. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup and has a long history with available results and statistics.
course_highlights: Course approximately 12 km long, a mix of forest paths and asphalt
Start in Hořovice, Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec
Traditional race with history and results since 2014
additional: The race does not have children's categories. The start and finish are on Valdecká Street near the water tower towards Hvozdec. Results are available in the system and in PDF format. The race is part of the Brdský Running Cup with other runs in the season. The race includes various terrains, offers pre-registration and on-site registration options, and is part of the series of races in the Brdský Running Cup.

name: Kačina Run
description: Kačina Run is a running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Kačina Castle and its extensive castle park, which is part of the series RUN CASTLES OF CENTRAL BOHEMIA. The race offers routes for children up to 800 meters and for adults 5 and 10 km long, mainly along gravel and forest paths. The event is suitable for all lovers of movement and nature and offers a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments on the track and at the finish. The start and facilities are located at the back of Kačina Castle, where registration and results announcement also take place.
course_highlights: Routes lead around Kačina Castle and through the extensive castle park
70% gravel path, 30% forest path
Refreshments on the track and at the finish (bananas, orange, apple, water)
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 for children's races and at 12:30 for adult races in the back part of Kačina Castle grounds. Children immediately receive a participation medal after finishing. Parents can run with children in categories 2-3 and 4-5 years old. The race takes place in any weather; safety and fair play rules must be observed. A one-time start number with clips, which must be attached to the chest. Parking is available according to the parking map, with a warning not to park on the road shoulders. Course maps and videos are available on the website; the race takes place in the castle park of Kačina.

name: Leskros Mácháč
location: Doksy, Máchovo jezero, CHKO Kokořínsko, Czech Republic
description: Leskros Mácháč is a new event of the season with beautiful routes ideal for running and canicross in the Kokořínsko Protected Landscape Area, near Lake Máchovo. The routes lead over soft sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles, ensuring a pleasant running experience in a natural environment. The race offers various distances from children's races up to 21 km, including categories for running, canicross, walking/running, and dogtrek. The race facilities include refreshment stations for people and dogs, massages, taping, and canine physiotherapy advice, contributing to the comfort of all participants.
course_highlights: Soft routes with sandy terrain sprinkled with pine needles
Location in Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo
Refreshment stations for people and dogs at the finish and along the route
additional: Registration from 8:00, baggage storage, changing rooms, Leskros kindergarten for children (10:30 - 14:00), massages and taping for competitors, canine physiotherapy advice, rental of canicross equipment by arrangement, parking and toilets near the start. The race includes charitable activities, children's races, equipment rental options, refreshments, and an accompanying program in the natural environment of Kokořínsko PLA near Lake Máchovo.

name: Štramberský Jasoň
location: Frýdlant nad Ostravicí, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Spolek Bezva běh pro bezva lidi z. s.

description: Štramberský Jasoň is a traditional hiking and running event held on September 19, 2026, in Frýdlant nad Ostravicí and the surrounding area. It offers 22 routes of various lengths from 6 km to 67 km, including competitive and tourist variants. Participants can choose routes through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other scenic locations in the Moravian-Silesian Region. At the finish in Štramberk, all registered participants receive an original medal and can order a T-shirt with a print. The event is suitable for the general public, including families with children, and offers routes adapted for strollers and seniors.
course_highlights: 22 routes from 6 km to 67 km including competitive and tourist variants
Routes pass through Lysá hora, Palkovické hůrky, Velký Javorník, and other natural attractions
Finish in Štramberk with an original medal for all participants
additional: Registration is only possible online. During registration, you can order a cotton T-shirt with a print for 390 CZK (children's 350 CZK). Re-registration to another participant is possible until September 11, 2026, at 20:00 via email redakce@bezvabeh.cz or on-site. The finish in Štramberk will close at 21:00. The event offers various route lengths, online registration, medals for participants, optional T-shirts, and detailed route maps available for download.

name: Havlíčkova pětka
location: Havlíčkův Brod, Vysočina Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 200 Kč: zvýhodněné startovné při on-line registraci a zaplacení na účet do 31. května 2026

description: Havlíčkova pětka is a running race approximately 5.2 km long, primarily along cycle paths and sidewalks along the Sázava River in Havlíčkův Brod. This race is suitable for those who do not have a relay team or consider a half marathon too demanding. The start is from Havlíčkovo náměstí, and part of the registration fee is dedicated to supporting sports equipment for youth. The race is part of the Vysočina Runner Running Cup and offers refreshments at the start and finish lines.
course_highlights: The course runs on public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
Elevation gain without significant ascent (up to 20 m)
Surface: 95% asphalt, 5% trail or paving
additional: Refreshments are provided at the start and finish areas. Starting numbers for paid registrations before September 1, 2026, include the runner's name. The race offers a medal, refreshments on the track and after the race, facilities with changing rooms, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, musical accompaniment, and professional electronic chip timing with online results. 15% of each registration fee is allocated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. The course includes asphalt roads, trails, and paving; registration is possible online or on-site; the race supports youth sports activities and offers various supplementary events as part of the running day.

name: Běh rodným krajem Emila Zátopka

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Emila Zátopka Running Race through his native land is a traditional event dedicated to the legacy of the famous Olympian Emil Zátopek, held regularly on the Saturday closest to his birthday, September 19. The race starts in his hometown of Kopřivnice at the Emil Zátopek statue and finishes at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm after a challenging 22.3 km course with a hilly profile. The race is open to participants aged 15 and older and also offers accompanying runs for children and the public. After the race, a ceremonial award ceremony takes place with the participation of prominent guests.
course_highlights: Course length of 22.3 km from Kopřivnice to Rožnov pod Radhoštěm
Surface asphalt and gravel in forest sections
Elevation gain of 375 m, undulating and hilly profile
additional: There are three refreshment stations and one hydration station along the route. The race takes place with full road traffic. The time limit is 3 hours from the start, with an intermediate cut-off at 1:20 hours in Veřovice. Changing rooms are available at the Cultural House in Kopřivnice and at the Wallachian Open-Air Museum in Rožnov. Belongings are transported by bus to the finish line. The organizer provides bus transportation from Rožnov to the start and back after the race. Accommodation at the Stadion Hotel in Rožnov pod Radhoštěm is available at the runner's expense. Participants under 18 require parental consent. The event also includes accompanying runs for children and the public. The route includes asphalt and forest paths, registration is required, team and relay races are available, transportation and accommodation are arranged, and prizes are awarded.

name: Kocelovice-Hornosín-Kocelovice
description: Cross-country race Kocelovice - Hornosín - Kocelovice is a traditional sporting event organized by the municipality of Kocelovice in the South Bohemian Region. The race takes place on Saturday, September 19, 2026, and participants can expect a route leading from Kocelovice to Hornosín and back. The event is suitable for running enthusiasts and those active in the scenic tourist and cycling terrain. The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice, where the race organization also takes place. The event lasts approximately 4 hours.
course_highlights: The route passes through the picturesque South Bohemian countryside with ideal tourist and cycling terrain
Start and finish at the building of the former school in Kocelovice
Cross-country race connecting the villages of Kocelovice and Hornosín
additional: The event lasts approximately 240 minutes (4 hours). The start and finish are at the building of the former school in Kocelovice. Organized by the Municipality of Kocelovice. The race is held annually in autumn, with the last edition in September 2023, and the next planned for September 2026. The length of the course is approximately 18 km, with varying levels of difficulty and terrain.

description: The Havlíčkobrod Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Havlíčkův Brod, which will celebrate its 14th edition in 2026. The main half marathon course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River, passing through Havlíčkův Brod Square. In addition to the main race, the event includes children's races, relays, and the shorter Havlíček Five race, allowing broad public participation across various age groups and performance levels. The race offers quality facilities, refreshments on the course and after the race, professional timing, and a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: The course runs along public cycle paths and sidewalks, mostly along the Sázava River
A 5.2 km loop is run four times (half marathon)
Start and finish at Havlíčkův Brod Square, with no significant elevation gain
additional: The registration fee includes a race bib (with the runner's name for registrations paid by September 1, 2026), a medal, refreshments on the course and after the race, free entry to the Vysočina amusement park, facilities (changing room, baggage and bike storage, mobile toilets, drinking water, seating), musical accompaniment, event moderation, professional electronic chip timing, online results display, medical services, and race organization. The half marathon time limit is 3 hours. 15% of each registration fee is donated to support secondary schools and sports programs in the city. Children's and Havlíček Five results count towards the Vysočina Runner running cup. The event traditionally takes place in September and offers a diverse program for all age groups and levels, including relays and children's races.

name: Běh pro Hospic Anežky České
location: Červený Kostelec, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Run for the Anežka Česká Hospice is an open charity race held in Červený Kostelec, offering courses for all age groups. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, and includes children's courses along forest paths and courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain predominantly asphalt with some forest and field roads. The event is part of the Primátor CUP running series and supports hospice services. Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, and the winners of the main race will be announced at 12:00 PM.
course_highlights: Children's courses run along forest paths
Courses of 2, 5, and 10 km on rolling mixed terrain with predominance of asphalt
Beautiful scenery of the Kostelec ponds with views of the Orlické Mountains, Krkonoše, and Hejšovina
additional: Bibs are issued from 8:15 AM, registration closes 30 minutes before the start. A small gift is prepared for the first 300 registered participants. Parking is available on a grassy meadow near Náchodská Street, about a 10-minute walk from the race venue. The race is part of the Primátor CUP 2026 running series with fair-play rules and no accompaniment of dogs, scooters, or bicycles. The race takes place on September 19, 2026, in Červený Kostelec, supports hospice services, with registration and details available on the website.

name: Jilemnice - Žalý
description: Jilemnice - Žalý is an uphill running race with a total elevation gain of 569 meters, held in the picturesque environment of Jilemnice in the Liberec Region. This race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course of 9.5 km. The start is at the square in Jilemnice, and the race is suitable for runners seeking a challenge in hilly terrain. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., which ensures professional organization and support for competitors.
course_highlights: Course length of 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 569 m
Uphill run in the scenic environment of Jilemnice
Start at the square in Jilemnice
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running. The organizer is ČKS SKI Jilemnice, z.s., contact person Roman Koucký, phone 602 265 857. Race regulations are available for download on the official website. The race takes place on a mountain trail; registration details are not specified. Results are announced at the finish line. The event is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running.

name: Soběchlebský Š-krpál
organizer: místní běžečtí nadšenci ve spolupráci s obcí Soběchleby a SDH Soběchleby
price_range: 200 Kč dospělí, 150 Kč kondiční běh, děti zdarma
description: The Soběchlebský Š-krpál is a traditional running race held since 2017 around the village of Soběchleby. The main course measures approximately 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 meters and is 90% on field and forest paved paths. Starting in 2024, the race also includes a fitness run over 6 km, suitable for beginner runners and walkers. The start and finish are at the football field in Soběchleby, where facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments are available. The accompanying program includes children's races for various age groups.
course_highlights: Main course 11.7 km with an elevation gain of 268 m
The route is 90% on field and forest paved paths
Fitness run 6 km with an elevation gain of 137 m suitable for beginners
additional: Registration for children's races is always on-site on race day. For the main race and fitness run, registration is available online or on-site until 11:30. Facilities at the football field include changing rooms, showers, and toilets. Refreshments (soup, beer/non-alcoholic drinks) are provided after the race. Parking is available nearby the venue. The route runs on field and forest paths, with start and finish at the football field, including refreshments, showers, and parking close by.

name: Černošický běh
location: Černošice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Černošice Run is a traditional running race held in Černošice, offering courses for various age groups from young children to adults. The race takes place on a field at the end of Husova Street and includes short courses for children, a family relay, and longer distances for adult runners. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40, allowing participants of different age groups to join comfortably. The event is suitable for families and competitors seeking a sporting challenge in a pleasant city environment.
course_highlights: 200 m course for children born in 2018 and younger
Family relay 3 x 900 m
Longer courses 3 km and 10 km for adults and older youth
additional: Registration begins at 13:00 and ends 30 minutes before the start of each category. Starts are sequential from 14:00 to 15:40. The venue is a field at the end of Husova Street in Černošice. Categories are divided by age and course length, including a family relay. The course is cross-country type, running on asphalt and unpaved paths; participants run at their own risk; the event is sponsored by community activities in Černošice.

name: 17. PKO Bytomski Półmaraton
organizer: Klub MKS MOSM Bytom, Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Bytomiu, Centrum Handlowe Plejada
description: The 17th PKO Bytom Half Marathon is an event promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community of Bytom and surrounding areas. The race takes place on an accredited, asphalt course measuring 21.097 km, which is a single loop. The start and finish are located at the G City Plejada Shopping Center in Bytom. Participants can count on nutrition and refreshment points as well as support from pacemakers, and after the race, there is an option to personalize the medal by engraving the result.
course_highlights: Single-loop half marathon course of 21.097 km with PZLA accreditation
100% asphalt surface with markings every 1 km
Nutrition and refreshment points along the route and a 3-hour time limit
additional: After the race, there is an option to personalize the medal with the result through engraving (cost 25 PLN). Pacemakers with balloons and special T-shirts are present on the route. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours; after this time, participants must stop and reach the finish line by minibus marked END OF THE HALF MARATHON. A group warm-up is scheduled for 9:45 AM. An active zone is prepared for children. The event attracts over 1200 participants annually, offering personalized medals, a 3-hour time limit, and activities for children. Registration is available online and at the race office.

name: PKO Wieczorny Półmaraton Łódź
description: PKO Evening Half Marathon Łódź is a new, atmospheric running event held in the center of Łódź. The start and finish are located at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant, which is now a center of culture and science. The 21.097 km route takes runners through the most recognizable places in the city, combining industrial history with modernity. This race is not only about the result but also about the unique atmosphere and energy of the city.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the revitalized EC1 combined heat and power plant
Route passes through the most recognizable places in Łódź
Evening street race in the city center
additional: The participant limit is 5000 people. The start package includes a souvenir drawstring bag and a medal for everyone who completes the race. There is an option to purchase an official technical T-shirt by SMMASH. The participant limit is 5000, with discounts for PKO Bank Polski customers when paying online. Registrations began a week before the event. The route covers key points of Łódź.

name: 44 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Wzgórza Strzelińskie, Strzelin, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a pedestrian orienteering rally organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Ziemia Strzelińska Branch, since 1996. Teams of 2-5 people plan their own route, aiming within the allotted time to visit as many control points as possible, each with different point values, which requires navigation skills and strategy. The event is open to participants of various ages and skill levels, making it an attractive activity for enthusiasts and families alike. The event takes place in the picturesque terrain of the Strzelin Hills, offering opportunities for contact with nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Terrain of the Strzelin Hills with diverse control points
Route of any length from about 5 km to 70 km, individually planned by teams
Use of map and compass for pedestrian navigation
additional: The competition is held in teams of 2-5 people, who independently plan and can modify their route during the race. Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them. The event is open to everyone, regardless of age and gender, with results divided into age and gender categories. The race includes various route lengths, from 6 to 70 km, with registration and route planning available before the start. The event takes place in the Strzelin Hills, surrounded by forests and terrain with varied topography.

name: Gontyniec Celtic Trail
location: Gontyniec, Chodzież, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: Gontyniec Celtic Trail is a unique reverse-format race lasting 6 or 12 hours on loops of approximately 10 km in the picturesque Gontyńca massif. Participants cover as much distance as possible, benefiting from well-equipped refreshment stations after each loop. The route offers changing landscapes at different times of the day, with beautiful views of the Noteć Valley and unique natural and cultural attractions, such as figurative beehives shaped like ancient gods. This is a special experience for runners seeking challenges and unforgettable sensations.
course_highlights: Non-stop race on loops of about 10 km
Refreshment station after each loop for participants
Views of the Noteć Valley and unique figurative beehives along the route
additional: The race lasts 6 or 12 hours non-stop. The route runs on loops of about 10 km. A refreshment station is available after each loop. Participants can choose the 6- or 12-hour option. The route traverses the Gontyńca massif with scenic views and natural attractions. Trail, mountain, and forest paths, participant limit of 150 in each race, preparations from 8 to 20 weeks.

name: Run in Sopot IV - Opera Leśna
organizer: Miejski Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Sopocie

description: Run in Sopot Opera Leśna is a 5 km race that will take place on September 19, 2026, in Sopot. The start and finish are located at the parking lot near Opera Leśna, and the route runs through scenic areas around this location. The race is part of a series of four events held at different dates and locations in Sopot, offering participants a unique atmosphere and the opportunity to compete over a short distance. The participant limit is 250 people, ensuring an intimate and well-organized event.
course_highlights: Route of 5 km around Opera Leśna in Sopot
Start and finish at the parking lot near Opera Leśna
Race takes place in a picturesque park and green areas
additional: Limit of 250 participants. Only runners with start numbers and organizational staff are allowed on the route. Participants line up at the start in a designated zone. The finish line is located at the same place as the start. The event includes several editions, with the main race on September 19, 2026; discounts available for Sopot residents with the Sopot Card; routes include beach and park areas; participants receive medals and drinks.

name: XIV Jastrzębska Dziesiątka
location: Hala Widowiskowo-Sportowa, Aleja Jana Pawła II 6, Jastrzębie-Zdrój, Poland
description: The 14th Street Run "Jastrzębska Dziesiątka" is an annual street race held in Jastrzębie-Zdrój. Participants cover a distance of 10 km along the city's main streets. The start and finish are located at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The participant limit is 600 people, and the race is scheduled to start at 5:00 PM on September 19, 2026. A companion race takes place from 3:00 PM to 3:50 PM on the same day.
course_highlights: Distance of 10 km through the city's main streets
Start and finish at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at Aleja Jana Pawła II 6
Urban route in Jastrzębie-Zdrój
additional: The registration limit is 600 participants. The race office is open on race day from 2:00 PM at the Sports and Entertainment Hall at Aleja Jana Pawła II 6. The accompanying race occurs before the main race from 3:00 PM to 3:50 PM. The event includes the main 10 km race as well as shorter competitions on site, with a participant limit of 600 people.

description: The PSD Bank Half Marathon in Hamburg is a fast and flat running event that passes through the Wandsbek district and takes runners up to the Berne subway station in the north. The course runs back through Rahlstedt and Tonndorf to the start and finish area on Wandsbeker Marktstraße. The race is characterized by a unique atmosphere with support from spectators and live bands along the route and takes place in late summer at dusk.
course_highlights: Fast and flat course through the Wandsbek district
Northernmost point at the Berne subway station
Strong support from spectators and bands along the route
additional: Drop-off of clothing bags on event day from 08:30 to 13:30 at the Wandsbeker weekly market. The start and finish are located on Wandsbeker Marktstraße in front of the Quarree shopping center. The race bib distribution takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026. Medical emergency services are available, the course is cordoned off and secured, and a finisher medal is awarded. The results list and personalized certificates are available online. The event also includes the Köhlbrand Bridge Run and offers detailed information on the course, registration, and results.

name: 14. Northeimer Tageslicht Ultra
description: The Northeimer Daylight Ultra is a challenging ultramarathon held in Northeim. The course runs through varied terrain and offers a special challenge for experienced ultrarunners. The event has a long tradition with numerous finishers and records, underscoring the high quality and sporting demands of the race. Participants can download the GPX track of the course to prepare optimally.
course_highlights: Long ultramarathon distance of over 100 km
Varied terrain with daylight running character
Course records of over 125 km (men) and 104 km (women)
additional: The GPX track of the course can be downloaded. The event has a long history with finisher numbers and course records. There are no explicit price details or start times available on the pages. The event takes place twice a year in March and September, with multiple editions since 2018. The courses are available as GPX files, facilitating preparation.

name: 21. Fun-Run
description: The 21st Maisel’s FunRun will take place on May 10, 2026, in Bayreuth and is a fixed part of the regional running calendar. The event attracts over 4,000 running enthusiasts annually, from beginners to ambitious athletes. Various distances are offered for adults, including half marathon, quarter marathon, and 5 km run, as well as several children's races without an entry fee. The finish line leads directly to the festival grounds of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest, where runners can celebrate with live music and freshly tapped Maisel’s Weisse. The course is varied and mostly flat, passing the most beautiful spots in Bayreuth and creating an excellent running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Varied and mostly flat course through Bayreuth
Finish directly on the festival grounds of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest
Atmospheric run with loud cheering and live music
additional: Race documents will be sent in advance by mail. An official FunRun shirt from the Bayreuth sports brand CEP can optionally be purchased. No entry fee is charged for children's races (U12, U10, U8, U6). The FunRun is part of the Maisel’s Weissbierfest, which takes place from May 7 to May 10, 2026. Distances: half marathon, quarter marathon, 5 km; children's races (U12, U10, U8, U6); early bird discount until December 6, 2025; start in Bayreuth; flat, varied course; part of the Weissbierfest.

name: 28. Hiddestorfer Rübenlauf
description: The 28th Hiddestorfer Beetroot Run is a family-friendly running event organized by the running club of Sportverein Eintracht Hiddestorf. The event offers courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and the Hemminger Half Marathon (21.3 km). In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a legendary runners' breakfast, cakes, waffles, grilled foods, drinks, and a varied supporting program with face painting for children. The event is open to all runners; membership in a club is not required.
course_highlights: Courses ranging from 1.4 km to 21.3 km (Half Marathon)
Start and finish at the sports field of SVE Hiddestorf
Family-friendly atmosphere with runners' breakfast and culinary offerings
additional: Race bibs and chips will be issued on the day of the event from 7:00 a.m. The timing is done with a chip that must be returned after the run. There is a free Möhrrchen Run (500 m) for children up to 6 years old, without registration or entry fee. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports and tennis hall near the start and finish. Parking is limited and up to 500 meters walking distance. Late registrations are only possible online until the registration deadline. The runners' breakfast is free for all participants and includes cheese, salami, baguette, and red wine (from 18 years). Courses over 1.4 km, 5.2 km, 10.1 km, and 21.3 km; online registration; event takes place at the sports field in Hiddestorf; parking options are limited.

name: 8. Altstadtlauf Salzwedel
description: The Old Town Run Salzwedel is part of the Elbe-Ohre Cup and will take place for the eighth time in 2026. The course runs through the historic old town of Salzwedel on a 5 km loop. The longer distances, 10 km and half marathon, are run with multiple laps. The event is organized by Sportclub Demker '95 e.V. and offers an attractive competition opportunity for runners in northern Saxony-Anhalt.
course_highlights: Loop through the historic old town of Salzwedel
5 km loop as the basis for all distances
Longer distances (10 km, half marathon) with multiple laps
additional: The event recorded 223 finishers in 2023 and offers running opportunities for all age groups, including children’s and youth races.

name: Gau-Algesheimer Alagastaluf
location: Sportpark Binger Straße, Gau-Algesheim, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Gau-Algesheimer Alagastalauf is a traditional community run that has taken place in Gau-Algesheim since the 1980s. The event runs over field paths and streets around Binger Straße and through the old town of Gau-Algesheim. The race offers a sporting challenge in a beautiful autumnal setting and is suitable for runners of all ages. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department and takes place annually in autumn.
course_highlights: Course runs through the old town of Gau-Algesheim
Run over field paths and streets around Binger Straße
Traditional autumn community run with a long-standing history
additional: The start and finish are located at Sportpark Binger Straße. The event is organized by SV 1910 Gau-Algesheim e.V. - Athletics Department. Training times are Tuesdays and Thursdays. There are reviews and galleries of past runs on the website. Terrain details are not specified; registration is expected; the event takes place at Sportpark Binger Straße.

name: Insellauf mit HM, 10km, 3x7km Staffel und Kinderläufen
description: The Reichenau Island Run is a traditional race event held annually in September on Reichenau Island. Various courses are offered, including a half marathon, a 10 km run, a 3 x 7 km relay, as well as children’s and youth races. The race routes lead over diverse and scenic paths around the island. The Island Run attracts numerous runners of all ages and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a variety of running options.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 10 km courses around Reichenau Island
3 x 7 km relay with special baton handovers
Children and youth races with age-appropriate distances
additional: The Island Run takes place at the Baurenhorn sports field in Reichenau. There is a schedule with various races, including children and youth races. The event is organized by the Sports Club Reichenau 1920 e. V., with Michael Rick named as contact person. The event has a long tradition with over 800 participants last year. There is a relay of 3 x 7 km that includes special baton handovers. Courses: half marathon, 10 km, 3x7 km relay, youth race (1.6 km), children’s run (0.9 km). Start and finish at the Baurenhorn sports field. The weather in September is usually mild and cloudy, around 19°C.

name: Internationaler Hugenottenlauf
description: The 49th Hugenottenlauf in Neu-Isenburg will take place on September 20, 2026, and invites runners of all ages to a sporty and communal experience. The event offers various course lengths that run through the city and are suitable for different performance levels. In addition to the athletic competition, music, catering, and professional timing ensure a pleasant atmosphere. The event is part of the Main-Lauf-Cup and features age-appropriate divisions according to DLO.
course_highlights: Various course lengths: 21.1 km, 10 km, 5 km, and 2.95 km school run
Start and finish in Neu-Isenburg with route maps available
Music along the route provides atmosphere
additional: Age group classification according to DLO, timing, bib number distribution, changing rooms and showers, valuables depot, award ceremony, certificates and result lists, raffle, catering, medical service, photos, Main-Lauf-Cup, parking facilities and public transportation are organized. Various running routes, registration with direct debit authorization, family program, well-marked routes

name: Karlsfelder Seelauf
description: The Karlsfelder Seelauf is a traditional running event held at Karlsfelder See. The race offers an attractive course in a natural environment and is suitable for runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld and will take place in 2026 for the 47th time. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Running course around Karlsfelder See
Natural and varied running environment
Suitable for runners of all ages
additional: The Seelauf is organized by TSV Eintracht Karlsfeld. The event is part of the athletics department’s competition offerings. More details about registration and the official announcement are available on the official website. The courses are record-eligible and officially measured, with refreshments on the course and at the finish, pacers, result services, and registration at the stadium.

name: Stadtlauf Erding 2026
description: The Erding City Run is a traditional race event that appeals to runners of all ages. It offers various distances, including children's races, a 5 km run, and a 10 km run, all through the beautiful city of Erding. The race emphasizes inclusion and features special classifications, for example for children from the St. Nikolaus School. The event is organized by the Trisport Erding association and is a popular sporting event in the region.
course_highlights: Children's races with age-appropriate distances from approximately 0.8 km to 2.5 km
Stadtwerke Run over 5 km and 10 km through downtown Erding
Inclusive classification for children of the St. Nikolaus School
additional: The Erding City Run offers special children's races with various distances depending on age group. There is a dedicated classification for children of the St. Nikolaus School over 0.8 km. The event emphasizes inclusion and is open to runners of all ages. Race routes, registration, results, photos, road closures

name: Uentroper Geithelauf
description: The 24th Uentroper Geithelauf will take place on September 20, 2026, and features a run through the green heart of Uentrop. The event is organized by the Turn- und Sportverein 46/68 Uentrop e.V. and offers a sporting community in a natural environment. The running routes lead across fields and forest paths in the surrounding area and are suitable for various fitness levels. The event emphasizes fun, community, and a pleasant atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Running routes through the green heart of Uentrop
Natural paths over fields and forest trails
Suitable for different fitness levels
additional: The running groups are arranged so that no one is overwhelmed and everyone can find their rhythm. Experienced instructors support participants with technique and preparation. The event promotes flexibility and fun in running within the community. Run through the green heart of Uentrop, Date: September 20, 2026

name: Aerzener twinfit-Volkslauf
price_range: € 5,– bis € 9,– je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
