tiers.description: 5 km, 10 km und Walking € 8,– bis zum 19.09.2026

description: The Aerzener twinfit Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event with various distances, starting and ending in Aerzen. Offered are a 5 km and 10 km fun run, a corporate and team run over 5 km, a school run over 1.8 km, and a free children's run. The event takes place on September 20, 2026, and features a pleasant atmosphere with catering and an award ceremony. The runs are scored according to DLV standards, and there are prizes as well as a raffle for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at twinfit, Königsförder Straße 19, 31855 Aerzen
5 km and 10 km fun runs as well as corporate and team run over 5 km
School run 1.8 km and free children's run
additional: Registration on September 20, 2026, from 9:00 to 9:45 a.m., for the school run until 11:45 a.m. Changing facilities with showers available at twinfit. Award ceremony around 1:30 p.m. with certificates for places 1-3 and a raffle. Drinks along the route and snacks at the finish area. Parking available at twinfit. Competitions for children and adolescents, registration from August 1, 2026, late registration on the event day, scoring according to DLV, prizes and certificates, corporate & team run, parking facilities at the event location.

name: Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe
description: The Baden-Marathon Karlsruhe on September 20, 2026, offers a diverse running experience with a marathon, half marathon, team marathon, health run, inclusion run, and mini marathon for children. The flat and fast course leads through the city center, past Karlsruhe Palace and through Citypark Ost, with an atmospheric finish line at the Carl-Kaufmann Stadium. A special feature is the opportunity to be accompanied by marathon angels for the last 4 kilometers, making the run a communal experience. There are attractive shorter distances for beginners and families, emphasizing fun in running.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through Karlsruhe with views of the palace and Citypark Ost
Finish at Carl-Kaufmann Stadium with comprehensive runner support
Marathon switch at km 20.5 allows changing from marathon to half marathon
additional: All registration fees include €3.50 for the dispatch of race numbers, which are sent exclusively by post. Students, apprentices, and university students receive a 10% discount. The last 4 kilometers of the marathon course can be accompanied by marathon angels. The course is measured and approved according to DLV guidelines. There is a marathon switch at km 20.5 where marathon runners can switch to half marathon classification without re-registration. Course map, measurement according to DLV guidelines, multiple marathon gates, finish at the stadium, including art and body painting events.

name: CANOSSA Benefiz Berglauf
location: Burgberg, Bad Harzburg, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The CANOSSA Benefiz Mountain Run® in Bad Harzburg is a challenging charity run through the Harz National Park, taking place on September 20, 2026. Participants can complete the course by running, walking, or hiking, ending at the CANOSSA pillar on Burgberg. The race promotes inclusive children's and youth work in the Goslar district and combines sporting challenge with social engagement. After the race, participants can enjoy a festive after-race event with music, refreshments, and an award ceremony.
course_highlights: Course runs through a nature reserve in Harz National Park
Highest point at Luisenbank above Eckertalsperre (12 km course)
Breathtaking views of Brocken and mixed forests from the horizontal hillside trail
additional: Race number distribution begins at 8:30 a.m. upon signing a liability waiver. Two courses: 12 km run (start at 10:00 a.m.) for runners aged 16 and above, and 6 km run (start at 10:30 a.m.) for runners, walkers, and hikers aged 10 and above. No course signage due to nature conservation; navigation via course marshals and Harz-Club signs. After the race, music and refreshments on Burgberg, award ceremony around 12:00 p.m. with a unique indulgence certificate for all participants. Cable car ascent available for a donation of at least 30 euros. Last cable car descent at 6:00 p.m. The race is open to runners, walkers, and hikers from age 10. There are no course signs, only markings, and the event promotes environmental protection by leaving no waste in nature. The event concludes with a program including music and catering on Burgberg.

name: CEB-Saarwiesenlauf
description: The CEB-Saarwiesenlauf is a running event in Hilbringen near Merzig, organized by the Christian Adult Education in Hilbringen together with the Merzig-Wadern Savings Bank and the Merzig Athletics Club. Despite challenging weather conditions, nearly 500 runners and 16 relay teams participated in a previous edition, indicating strong community involvement. The race offers various distances and allows both individual and relay participation, making it attractive for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Distances: 1.8 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start in Merzig with varied running speeds
Event with strong local and community participation
additional: The race takes place in typical September weather with an average of 19°C (minimum 10°C) and mostly cloudy skies. The course is easily accessible by car. Competitions for children and youth, relay races, participation also for students, weather in September usually around 19°C

name: Citylauf Leer
description: The City Run Leer is a traditional race event taking place on September 20, 2026, in the city center of Leer at Denkmalsplatz. The event offers races for various age groups and distances, including Bambino, Teen, 5 km, and 10 km runs. The course runs on closed circuits through the city center and provides refreshment stations along the route and at the finish area. All participants receive a T-shirt (while supplies last), attractive prizes, and certificates for the top runners. The event is open to individual and team competitions and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Closed 2.5 km circuit (green) for 5 km and 10 km runs in the city center
Closed 1.1 km circuit (yellow) for Bambino and Teen runs
Refreshment stations on the route and at the finish area at Denkmalsplatz
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on the day of the event from 10:00 AM at Denkmalsplatz. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 10:00 AM until 45 minutes before the respective start. Each participant will receive a T-shirt upon return of the race bib, while supplies last. The top three finishers in each race will receive prizes/gift vouchers and a certificate/medal. There is a team classification for the 5 km run with at least 3 runners per team. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Participation with animals is prohibited. The course is on a closed circuit in the city center, with refreshments along the route, online certificate printing, team classification, race bibs with deposit, no participation with animals.

name: Druffeler Volkslauf
description: The Druffeler Volkslauf takes place on September 20, 2026, in Rietberg-Druffel and offers competitive runs over 1 km and 10 km. The event supports a solidarity initiative in sports that promotes running and maintains a relief fund for relatives of injured runners. Members of laufen.de can benefit from the "Book smart, pay less!" formula. The course is officially measured and suitable for competitions.
course_highlights: Competitive runs over 1 km and 10 km
Start in Rietberg-Druffel
Typical September weather with around 19 °C and mostly cloudy sky
additional: The registration supports a solidarity sports initiative and a relief fund for injured runners. Typical September weather includes approximately 19 °C with a minimum of 10 °C and an average of 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. Registration via laufen.de with a discount is possible; supports charitable causes; details should be confirmed with the organizer before registration.

name: EDITH LÜCKE-Frauenlauf TRIER
description: The EDITH LÜCKE Women's Run in Trier is a special race that will hold its sixth edition on September 20, 2026. The 5-kilometer route takes a sightseeing tour through Trier's Roman history, starting in front of the Imperial Baths and culminating in a finish line at the amphitheater. The race is open to women and girls aged twelve and above and emphasizes the joy of movement in community, regardless of performance level. After the race, all participants will be treated to a glass of sparkling wine to celebrate the day.
course_highlights: 5-kilometer route through the former capital of the Western Roman Empire
Start in front of the Imperial Baths
Finish at the historic amphitheater
additional: Race materials will be distributed from 8:00 a.m. on the schoolyard of Friedrich-Wilhelm-Gymnasium. Wearing the high-quality race T-shirt included in the registration fee is mandatory for all participants. No bib number is required. The participant bag contains small gifts from sponsors. The number of participants is limited to 1,000. Participation is open from age 12, including race T-shirt, time measurement via chip, parking facilities in Trier, and preparation courses are offered.

name: Eltviller Familienlauf 2026
price_range: kostenfrei bis 12 Euro (je nach Lauf), Jugendliche bis 16 Jahre frei
description: The Eltville Family Run on September 20, 2026, offers various race distances for all age groups, from toddlers to the 10 km run. The course mainly runs on paved roads with flat cobblestones and a short, slightly uphill section. The event is family-friendly and allows both individual and team registrations. Race packets can be picked up the day before or on race day, and there is a clothing bag storage as well as toilets at the start and finish areas. Youths up to 16 years old can participate in the paid races for free, but registration is required.
course_highlights: Run on paved roads with flat cobblestones
Short, uphill section (about 15 m) over cobblestones
No significant inclines
additional: Race packets and registration on September 19 from 11:00 to 12:30 in the pedestrian zone Schwalbacher Straße 2 and on race day from 8:30 am at the start/finish area at the Rhine embankment. Parking is available at the Rhine embankment/swimming pool, Kiliansring parking garage (fee required), and Weinhohle parking lot (free). Clothing bag storage is available at the start/finish area. Toilets are nearby; no showers. Registration is only online, payment must be made within 5 days. No refunds in case of no start. Various race distances (500 m to 10 km), online registration from summer 2026, start and finish area at the Rhine embankment, results and certificates after the race at br-timing.de, accompanying program with food stalls and music.

name: Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon
description: The Fürst Carl Seenlandmarathon takes place on September 19 and 20, 2026, in Pleinfeld at Brombachsee. The event offers various distances, including marathon, half marathon, relay, hobby run, school run, and children’s run, which run on paved and partly asphalted paths. The marathon and half marathon distances are officially certified by the DLV. The event is open to runners of all ages and features a diverse program with supporting events and catering.
course_highlights: Routes on paved, partly asphalted paths
Officially measured and DLV-certified marathon and half marathon distances
Various distances for all age groups from children to marathon relay
additional: Start times and cut-off times are available on the website's schedule. On the day of the event, race packet distribution and late registration are from 07:00 to 11:00. A free training plan with different performance levels is available for download. Bicycle accompaniment is prohibited and will be sanctioned. The event includes marathon, half marathon, relay, school run, hobby run; family and participation activities; scenic routes around Brombachsee.

name: Grebinlauf
description: The Grebin Run takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026, in Grebin and offers varied courses for runners, walkers, children, and relay teams. The event is characterized by a great atmosphere and a special finish on the Grebin sports field. A highlight is the turnaround point at the Grebiner Mill, which makes the course particularly special. Registration is via the Davengo platform.
course_highlights: Varied courses
Special turnaround point at the Grebiner Mill
Finish on the Grebin sports field
additional: Competitions: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking - 4.5 km; Krümellauf for children - 2.3 km; Registration via Davengo. Competitions: Schmarkrunde / Nordic Walking (4.5 km), Krümellauf for children (2.3 km). Registration via Davengo.

name: Halbmarathon Altötting
description: The Altötting Half Marathon on September 20, 2026, is one of the fastest natural runs in the world and has been awarded 5 stars by the European Athletics Association. The course runs 80% on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest, is flat, wind-protected, and low in asphalt. In addition to the half marathon, the event offers a 6 km run and a hobby run. There is free childcare for children from 5 years old, and numerous bands and music along the route create a lively atmosphere.
course_highlights: 80% of the course runs on paved forest paths in the Altötting Forest
Flat, wind-protected, and low-asphalt course, measured and approved by the DLV
Five refreshment stations along the course and finish line refreshments
additional: Start and finish at the intersection of Burghauser Str./Traunsteiner Str. Bib numbers are non-transferable. Pacemakers are available for 1:30, 1:45, 2:00, 2:15, and 2:30 hours. Changing rooms and showers are available at schools and the sports field. Free city tour on Saturday, 19th September at 4 PM with prior registration. Free childcare for children from 5 years old (advance registration required). Finishers receive a specially designed medal and a personalized certificate online. A free massage is available in the refreshment area. The course is in the forest, with 5 refreshment stations, childcare, changing rooms, showers, start at 10:00 AM, and the event concludes at 1:00 PM.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 20.09.2026
description: The 278th Heidelauf Halle takes place on September 20, 2026, in Halle (Saale) and is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to participate in a traditional race. The course runs around the Heidebad and provides a varied running environment. Registration is possible until the day of the event.
course_highlights: Run around the Heidebad in Halle (Saale)
Various categories for children, youth, active participants, and masters
Traditional event with over 270 years of history
additional: Registration deadline is on the day of the event, 20.09.2026. The organizer is SV Halle Triathlon. The event is classified as a stadium-near event (category 6.5.1). It takes place at Am Heidebad 10 in Halle (Saale). Registration is via email. Different categories are offered for various age groups.

name: Herbstlauf und 29. Wandertag Fleckenberg
location: Sportplatz auf der Latroper Straße, Fleckenberg, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 39th Autumn Run and Hiking Day in Fleckenberg will take place on September 20, 2026, at the sports field on Latroper Straße. The event is a scoring run of the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup and offers a scenic 15 km loop course with varied terrain. The route leads over forest paths, paved ascents, and partly stony passages, ideal for runners with well-cushioned running shoes. Changing and shower facilities are available, as well as a beverage and food sale. After the run, an award ceremony with certificates and trophies will take place.
course_highlights: 15 km loop course starting at the sports field, elevation 360 m
Varied route with paved ascents, solid forest paths, and partly stony terrain
Return route corresponds to the last kilometers of the Rothaarsteig Marathon
additional: Changing and shower facilities are available in enclosed rooms. Beverage and food sales with a wide selection. The award ceremony begins around 12 p.m. with honors for the children and youth runs. Every participant receives a certificate, the fastest runner a trophy. Scoring run as part of the Volksbank Sauerland Lauf Cup; start and finish at the sports field on Latroper Straße; indoor changing rooms, showers, catering, and certificates for all finishers.

name: Horster Löwenlauf
location: Schloss Horst, Gelsenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 2nd Horster Löwenlauf will take place on September 20, 2026, around Schloss Horst in Gelsenkirchen. The sporting event offers a lively and communal atmosphere for all age groups with food and entertainment in the castle park. Following the great success of the inaugural event, the race is organized again as a sporting highlight for the Horst district. The event coincides with World Children's Day, which is seen as a particularly fitting coincidence.
course_highlights: Run around Schloss Horst and the former racecourse
Event in the castle park with food and entertainment
Community sports event for all age groups
additional: Regular registration is possible until September 11, 2026, thereafter until September 18, 2026, with an additional fee. Optionally, a running shirt can be booked (design to follow). The event lasts approximately until 2:00 PM. The event also includes children’s and toddler races, with a special focus on families and community. Registration is available online.

name: Hörnle Berglauf Bad Kohlgrub
description: The Hörnle Mountain Run in Bad Kohlgrub is a traditional mountain race held annually, taking runners to the local mountain Hörnle. The event is characterized by a challenging course with impressive views and a sporting challenge for mountain running enthusiasts. The race takes place in September and attracts both regional and supra-regional participants. The Ski Club Bad Kohlgrub organizes the event with great commitment and offers a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Mountain run to the local mountain Hörnle
Challenging incline and varied terrain
Panoramic view over Bad Kohlgrub and the Ammergau Alps
additional: The Hörnle Run traditionally takes place on September 19th at 3:00 PM at the Town Hall in Bad Kohlgrub. The event is organized by the Ski Club Bad Kohlgrub. There are no explicit price details on the website, but online registration is possible via the provided URL. The event is part of a sports program with other runs such as the Gorge Run. It is held as part of the German Mountain Running Championship 2021, with course routes and hygiene concepts available. Descents with the Hörnle cable car are possible until 5 PM.

name: IWB Laurentiuslauf x Landkreislauf
description: The IWB Laurentiuslauf x District Run takes place annually in Bobingen and is a traditional running event that leads through the unique trails and enchanted paths in Augsburg's western forests. In addition to the sporting competition, supporting an educational project of the Mittelschule Bobingen is a focus, making participation also serve a social purpose. The event also offers a career orientation rally that provides young people with exciting insights into regional training professions. The run is embedded in a lively community with dedicated sponsors and helpers and always takes place on the third Sunday in September.
course_highlights: Run on unique trails and enchanted paths in Augsburg's western forests
Traditional venue Bobingen, mother of German popular running events since 1963
Career orientation rally with an interactive experience course parallel to the run
additional: Participation supports the educational project of Mittelschule Bobingen, with the proceeds from entry fees directly funding this project. Parallel to the run, there is a career orientation rally with stamp stations and a raffle for students from 5th grade onwards. The rally is accompanied by well-known moderators and offers many small prizes as well as a meet & greet with an FCA player for the entire class. Trail terrain, supports regional educational projects, offers diverse running routes, and features a comprehensive supporting program.

name: Kemmerner Kuckuckslauf

price_tiers.distance: Mit Eigen läufts - Jugend U16, Kinder U14
Mit Eigen läufts - Kinder U12-U8 männlich
Mit Eigen läufts - Kinder U12-U8 weiblich

description: The Kemmerner Cuckoo Race is a traditional running event in the town center of Kemmern, taking place on September 20, 2026, for the 16th time. Various competitions are offered for all age groups, including children, school, and youth runs, as well as a 4 km hobby and corporate run and a 10 km main race. The event is characterized by fair sports competitions and a friendly atmosphere with many spectators. Food and drinks for runners are provided at the SC Kemmern sports clubhouse.
course_highlights: Fast street races in the town center of Kemmern
Start and finish at Wagner Brewery, Hauptstraße 15
Course secured by the Kemmern Volunteer Fire Department
additional: Race number pickup from 9:30 AM at the sports clubhouse with ample parking. Late registrations are possible on the event day until 1 hour before the respective start for an additional fee of €4.00. Free fruit and drinks are available at the finish. Showers and changing facilities are available at the sports clubhouse. The award ceremony takes place approximately 1 hour after crossing the finish line at the sports clubhouse. Medical support is provided by Malteser Bamberg. Various race distances, children and youth runs, hobby and corporate runs, 10 km main race, registration and results online, course secured by the Volunteer Fire Department, medical support by Malteser Bamberg.

description: The 10 km race in Röthenbach is an approved event by the German Athletics Association, taking place on September 20, 2026, in Röthenbach an der Pegnitz. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, including a fast, flat loop course with a measured distance certified by the DLV. Timing is done using a chip integrated into the bib number, and the event is family-friendly with races for children and adolescents. Changing rooms, showers, and medical services are available on-site, and the venue is easily accessible by public transportation.
course_highlights: Fast, flat loop course on a DLV-measured track
1 lap of 1.9 km and three laps of 2.7 km
Timing via chip integrated into the bib number
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site from 8:00 AM until 60 minutes before the start, with a late registration fee of 4 EUR. Transfers are possible until the registration deadline on September 7, 2026, via email. Race packets can be collected on-site from 8:00 AM until 30 minutes before the start. Changing rooms and showers are available in the sports hall area. Medical services are provided by BRK. Access by S-Bahn to Röthenbach Steinberg, a 5-minute walk. Road closures during the event, access via Renzenhofer Straße is possible. Registration deadline is September 12, 2026, with on-site registration available. Medical services are provided by BRK, and road closures will be in place within the event area.

name: Laacher See Naturlauf mit 21. VR Bank Cup
location: Maria Laach, Verbandsgemeinde Mendig, Rheinland-Pfalz, Germany
description: The Laacher See Natural Run with the 21st VR Bank Cup is a traditional community race organized annually by the Laacher See Running Community e.V. in Maria Laach. The race takes place on September 20, 2026, and offers runners of all performance levels the opportunity to experience the scenic route around Lake Laacher. The event is part of an active club life that also offers running courses and training groups for beginners and re-entrants. The LG Laacher See looks forward to inviting runners to a sporty and communal experience.
course_highlights: Scenic route around Lake Laacher
Natural running course with volcanic panorama
Suitable for beginners and experienced runners
additional: The club offers a running course "From 0 to Around Lake Laacher" for beginners and re-entrants, starting in spring and ending with participation in the Laacher See Natural Run in September. There are regular running meetups on various weekdays, organized into performance groups. Membership in the club is not required to participate in the running course. Routes: 200 m, 8.5 km; no refreshment stations on the course; mindfulness exercises before the start; environmentally friendly event with strict environmental regulations.

name: Lauf Rund um den Fühlinger See
location: Fühlinger See, Köln, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
price_range: 15€ für 10 km und 5 km, 10€ für Jugend, Kinder kostenfrei, Nachmeldung 5€
description: The Fühlinger See Run is a traditional road race in Cologne, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers a wide range of distances including half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and a 1 km children's run, catering to runners of all ages. The courses run around the rowing regatta course used in the 1998 World Rowing Championships and are officially measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV), enabling record-eligible performances. The race is an ideal preparation for the Generali Cologne Marathon and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, attractive medals, and prizes for age groups.
course_highlights: Course around the rowing regatta course of the 1998 World Rowing Championships
DLV-measured courses with certification
Low-traffic street routes in Cologne-Fühlingen
additional: Timing is done with a disposable transponder embedded in the bib, included in the registration fee. Late registrations are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start (adults 5 €, children/youth free). Race packets will be distributed on the event day from 08:45 at the boathouse at Fühlinger See. Changing rooms and showers are available at the boathouse. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each age group, and attractive medals are given to the top three finishers in each race. The courses are officially measured and certified by the DLV. Start times begin at 09:30. Free parking, changing facilities, and showers are available at the Fühlinger See boathouse. There will be music and food on site.

name: Lohelauf
description: The Lohelauf in Wentorf near Hamburg is a traditional race that will take place for the 21st time in 2026. The event offers various distances for different age groups and skill levels, including runs of 1.5 km to 9 km as well as a 5 km walking route. The race takes place in the beautiful Stiftung Land Wentorfer Lohe and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and team spirit. On the day of the event, there is a tent city with start and finish at the dog meadow, where participants receive their bib numbers and can enjoy the event.
course_highlights: Courses in Stiftung Land Wentorfer Lohe
Various rounds from 1.5 km to 9 km depending on age group
Start and finish at the dog meadow with tent city
additional: The Lohelauf takes place on September 20, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM. On the event day, there is a tent city at the dog meadow serving as the start and finish area. The event is open to all age groups with age-appropriate distances. After the race, results lists and certificates are available online. The Lohelauf offers distances of 1.5 km, 3 km, 6 km, 9 km, and 5 km walking. Registration is via RaceResult, with on-site catering, bicycle parking, medals, and certificates for all participants. The event regularly attracts numerous runners from the region.

name: Memminger Altstadtlauf
description: The Memmingen Old Town Run is a traditional race through the historic old town of Memmingen. The course is a flat, paved loop approximately 1 km long, passing through the picturesque old town. The event is open to club, professional, and amateur runners and features professional timing with a transponder. Start and finish are located at the marketplace, where the award ceremony also takes place. All participants receive a high-quality towel as a souvenir gift.
course_highlights: Flat, paved loop through Memmingen's old town
Approximately 1 km per lap
Start and finish at the marketplace
additional: Number bibs are issued from 12:30 PM at the marketplace. Chip timing via transponder in the bib. In the main race, results are based on net time; in other competitions, on gross time. Changing rooms and showers are available at Bismarck-Elsbethenschule sports hall, St. Josefs Kirchplatz 3. Parking is available in the Stadthalle and Krautstraße parking garages. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Award ceremony begins around 4:00 PM (individual starters) or 4:30 PM (company teams) at the marketplace. Each participant receives a high-quality towel with the event logo as a souvenir. The top three finishers in each age group receive material prizes, certificates for children, and podium awards for the main race. Team rankings are available for authorities and company teams in the main race (5 participants per team, mixed male/female). Moderation and musical entertainment provided by Andreas Schales from Hitradio RT1. Online registration is open until September 16; late registrations are possible for an additional fee. High-quality souvenirs and prizes are awarded. The event takes place in all weather conditions.

name: Mommelsteinlauf
description: The Mommelsteinlauf in Floh-Seligenthal, OT Hohleborn, is a family-friendly running event organized by SV 1962 Hohleborn. From the Bambini run to youth and beginner courses, up to the challenging 32 km trail, every runner and Nordic walker will find a suitable route. The courses are marked and equipped with refreshment points from 8 km onwards. The event offers timing with start number transponders and medical support. At the finish line, participants can enjoy refreshments and a coffee and cake buffet.
course_highlights: Courses from 500 m to 32 km south of the Rennsteig
Refreshment points from 8 km (Holzplatz Brotterode, Weinberg crossing, Tennelberghütte)
Elevation gain up to 1100 meters on the 32 km route
additional: Start times: 09:00 for 32 km endurance trail, 09:10 for 500 m Bambini run, 09:30 for 1 km Fuchstrail, 10:00 for 4 km youth and beginner run, 10:00 for 8 km traditional run & Nordic walking, 10:00 for 16 km traditional run & Nordic walking. The cut-off time for all routes is 13:30. Services include: limited WC & showers, changing rooms, medical support, online certificate printing & results list, coffee & cake buffet, snack provisions. Registration opens on June 1, 2025. Parking available on-site, refreshments at supply points, timing with GO-Timing, various distances for all age groups.

name: Möhnesee-Pokal-Lauf = Mehr als eine Herausforderung
description: The 38th Möhnesee Cup Run, under the motto "More than a Challenge," will take place on September 20, 2026, in Möhnesee-Günne. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 30 km, and challenges participants with a demanding course. The race is known for its varied landscape and the special atmosphere at Möhnesee. Runners can look forward to a sporting challenge in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Running distances of 5 km and 30 km
Event location Möhnesee-Günne with scenic surroundings
Typical September weather with mild temperatures and mostly cloudy sky
additional: The race takes place on Sunday, September 20, 2026. Average temperatures are around 19°C during the day and 10°C at night. Approximately 45 mm of precipitation is expected, mostly cloudy. The race is held in September with typical temperatures around 19°C; it is recommended to check further details with the organizer before registration.

name: Panoramalauf Kriegsheim
description: The Panoramic Run Kriegsheim is a running event in Kriegsheim organized by the LLG Wonnegau. The event is part of the summer race calendar of the club and offers runners an attractive route through the scenic surroundings. The LLG Wonnegau is an active club that organizes additional running and sports events in the region. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and promotes community spirit in running.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque landscape around Kriegsheim
Part of the summer race calendar of LLG Wonnegau
Attractive course for various performance levels
additional: LLG Wonnegau offers additional running events and training. The office is located in Monsheim, Silvanerstr. 4. There are no explicit details about start times, fee structures, or registration procedures for the Panoramic Run Kriegsheim on the searched pages. Start times: 9:45 AM for children’s races, 10:00 AM for main race, 5 km, and walking. Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until one hour before the start. The event is planned in all weather conditions; it may be canceled in case of storms.

name: Seidenraupen Cross
location: Hülser Bruch, Krefeld, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Silk Worm Cross in Krefeld is one of the most interesting cross-country races in North Rhine-Westphalia, organized in a family-friendly atmosphere. Runners can expect challenging courses over 6.5 km and 16 km through Krefeld's largest nature reserve, the Hülser Bruch, featuring steep climbs, fast downhills, and a stunning natural landscape. In addition to the main races, there are also children's races at the Hülser district sports facility. The event offers a varied and natural running experience suitable for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Run through the Hülser Bruch nature reserve with three hills
Steep climbs and fast downhills
Children's races on various surfaces (grass, sand pits, ash track)
additional: Start for hikers, walkers, and Nordic walkers at 10 a.m. Registration is open until one hour before the race. The course lengths are approximately 6.5 km and 16 km, which can also be walked. The children's races take place at the sports facility on Hölschen Dyk. The event supports social projects annually. Trail and cross elements, routes on forest and hiking trails, start and finish at the Hölschen Dyk sports field, registration until one hour before the race.

name: Sonneberger Spielzeuglauf
description: The 6th Sonneberg Toy Run and 2nd Corporate Run will take place on September 20, 2026, in Sonneberg. The event offers several race distances, including the main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, student race, and toddler race, all starting simultaneously and finishing together. In addition to individual rankings, there is a special corporate ranking for the company with the most participants and most creative, as well as the club with the most participants. The Nordic walking race is timed but without an award ceremony. The event is family-friendly and organized by Leichtathletik Sonneberg e. V.
course_highlights: Multiple race distances: main race, beginner race, Nordic walking, student race, toddler race
Start and finish at Ernst-Moritz-Arndt-Straße 26 a in Sonneberg
Joint start and finish for all races
additional: Photos will be taken during the event and published on the website and Facebook page. The corporate race includes rankings for the company with the most participants, the most creative company, and the club with the most participants. Nordic walking is timed but without an award ceremony. Multiple race types, including children’s and corporate races, rankings for companies and clubs, participation at your own risk, photos will be taken.

description: The Sparkassen Coastal Marathon in Otterndorf is a traditional race on the North Sea coast, taking place on September 20, 2026. The event offers various distances from a children's run for kindergarten children to the classic marathon of 42.195 km. The courses lead through the historic old town, along the Elbe dike, and by the water, guaranteeing a varied and scenic running experience. In addition to the marathon, there are also half marathons, 10 km, and 5 km runs, as well as relay and walking competitions. The event emphasizes community, endurance, and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course through historic old town and along the Elbe dike
Marathon over four laps with varied city and landscape running
Half marathon and other distances by the water and on paved paths
additional: The children's run is limited to 300 children from kindergartens in the Samtgemeinde Land Hadeln and has no competitive character. There are various age categories and rankings for students. The event offers free parking, baggage storage, and one hour of free use of the Sole-Therme Otterndorf (excluding sauna) upon presentation of the starting number. There is a Cuxland ranking with cash prizes for runners from the Cuxhaven district. Award ceremonies are held in stages according to distance and ranking at the Historic Town Hall. The event takes place on the Elbe dike and in the historic old town of Otterndorf, with special categories such as handbikers and walkers. It is a family-friendly event with a strong community atmosphere.

name: Tübinger Erbe-Lauf
price_range: 34 € bis 58 € je nach Lauf und Nachmeldung
description: The Tübingen Heritage Run is a diverse running event in the historic old town of Tübingen, taking place on September 20, 2026. The main course covers 10 kilometers, divided into four laps through the old town and the Umbrian-Provençal Market. In addition to the main race, there are other competitions such as the 5K run, the Team Challenge, the Junior Run, and the BG Handbike Challenge. The event offers personal timing, an exclusive finisher medal, and a unique atmosphere in the picturesque city. All participants receive breathable running socks made from organic cotton with their registration fee.
course_highlights: 4 laps through the Tübingen old town
Course over the Umbrian-Provençal Market
Closed, leaderboard-capable course with timing
additional: Free running socks made from organic cotton included in the registration fee (order by June 28, 2026, pick up at the race packet distribution). Free use of public transport within the Neckar-Alb-Donau transport association on race day. Bag storage, catering during and after the race, free massage after the run, downloadable certificate. Exclusive finisher medal. Late registrations online until 2 hours before the start for an additional fee of 5 euros (subject to availability). Race bibs, medals, catering, massage, and public transport included. Registration until September 6, 2026.

name: Uplengener RVB Herbstmarktlauf
location: Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13, Uplengen, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Uplengener RVB Autumn Market Run takes place on September 20, 2026, in Uplengen, Germany. The traditional race was first held in 2002 and offers runs for children and students. The start is at the parking lot of Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13. The event is ideal for runners of all ages who want to enjoy an autumn running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances: 1 km, 6.6 km, and 10 km
Start at the parking lot of Raiffeisen-Volksbank, Reetstr. 13
Typical September weather with about 19°C and mostly cloudy
additional: Please verify the event details with the organizer before registering. Typical September weather with about 19°C, cloudy, average 45 mm of precipitation; ideal for an outdoor autumn run.

name: Weddelbrooker Dorflauf
description: The Weddelbrook Village Run is a traditional race through the village of Weddelbrook and the surrounding farmland. It offers various distances from 900 meters to 10 kilometers, allowing runners of all ages and skill levels to participate. The course leads through scenic areas, including around the lake, and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with many volunteers on site. The race is known for its good organization and the opportunity to compete with other runners or simply enjoy running.
course_highlights: Course through the village, around the lake, and through the farmland
Varied distances from 900 meters to 10 kilometers
Scenic and diverse running routes
additional: The race includes multiple age and distance categories, including a children's run for ages 3-4. Photos from the race can be requested via email with the start number. The event is supported by many volunteers and takes place annually. It offers various distances, including children's and junior races, with results categorized by age. Photos and further information are available upon request.

name: Wilscher FUN-RUN
description: The Wilscher FunRun is a traditional race that has been held annually since 2005 at the sports field Wilsche in Gifhorn. It is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup and offers an attractive running event with a 10 km distance. The race is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and strong participation and is a fixed part of the regional running scene. The start is punctual at 10 a.m., and the event is supported by local organizations such as the fire brigades and the Red Cross (DRK).
course_highlights: 10 km race course as part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup
Start and finish at the sports field Wilsche
Participation of fire brigade and DRK for security
additional: The FunRun is part of the Gifhorn-Wolfsburg Running Cup with a total of 9 races. The event is accompanied by the fire brigades Wilsche and Neubokel as well as the DRK standby vehicle. A children's race and the Wilscher Marathon have been offered since 2015 as part of the Gifhorn Running Day. The registration link for 2026 will be published later. Start at 10 a.m., registration is via the organizer's website, participation is open to all running enthusiasts.

name: Trail Český ráj
location: Branžež, Český ráj, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Trail Český ráj is a popular terrain half marathon that takes you through the heart of Český ráj, including the courtyard of Kost Castle, pine groves, and sandstone cliffs. This race is a continuation of the eleventh edition of the popular ELEVEN HALF MARATHON ČESKÝ RÁJ and offers probably the most beautiful trail of a terrain half marathon in the Czech Republic. The start is at Komárovský Pond and the finish line is a reward for every runner. The race is complemented by rich services for competitors including refreshments, changing rooms, and medical services.
course_highlights: The route passes through the courtyard of Kost Castle
Surroundings of pine groves and sandstone cliffs
Terrain half marathon with beautiful natural scenery of Český ráj
additional: Start and registration take place at the race center near Komárovský Pond. There are changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, and parking available near the race center. Participants will receive an original medal, a start package, an electronic chip for timing, and can use medical services. Photos and diplomas can be downloaded after the race, and the accompanying program and prizes for the top three in categories are provided. The event offers medals, start packages, refreshments, medical support, and parking. Registration is possible online with late registration options. There are also obstacle races and special categories for dogs and children.

name: PoHodová devítka
location: Velká Bíteš, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: PoHodová Devítka is a traditional running race in Velká Bíteš, held every September after the local festivities. The main course is 9 km long and suitable for all runners, with shorter distances available for children. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is open to the general public, including categories for children and youth. The route is approximately one-third on asphalt and two-thirds on unpaved paths, run in full road traffic, and each participant runs at their own risk.
course_highlights: Main course 9 km
Approximately 1/3 asphalt, 2/3 unpaved paths
Race run in full road traffic
additional: Children start according to categories from 11:00, first the youngest, then younger and older pupils. The children's race starts immediately after the main race begins. For children, there is a bouncy castle, face painting, and a small prize for everyone. A raffle for a voucher for an extended PoHodová Devítka running weekend is drawn from start numbers. Registration includes the chance to participate in the raffle for a weekend running package. The race is connected with local festivities and offers various age categories and courses.

name: Memoriál Matěje Mauera
description: Matěj Mauer Memorial is a 9 km running race that mainly takes place on forest paths with one longer ascent. The race is held in the picturesque location of Capartice near Plzeň and is part of the Chodsko Runner series. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in a natural environment with a more challenging course profile. It is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge and wanting to enjoy the atmosphere of a traditional race.
course_highlights: Length of the course 9 km
Mostly forest paths
One longer ascent
additional: The race is part of the 'Best Chodsko Runner' competition, offers various age categories, and detailed results from previous editions. The event takes place on September 20, 2026.

name: 12 Bieg "Król Parku"
organizer: Ośrodek Sportu i Rekreacji w Mosinie
description: The 12th "King of the Park" Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Mosina. The competition takes place in the picturesque surroundings of the city park, offering participants an attractive route and sporting competition. The run attracts both amateurs and more experienced runners, promoting an active lifestyle and integration of the local community. The organizers provide professional service and a rich start package.
course_highlights: The route runs through the city park area in Mosina
Picturesque surroundings with natural greenery
Well-marked and prepared running route
additional: The organizer is the Sports and Recreation Center in Mosina. Phone contact: +48 61 813 29 03. Detailed information and registration will be available soon. The event is part of the sports and recreation events calendar of the Mosina municipality. The event also includes races for children and youth, and participants can expect medals and accompanying attractions. The runs are part of the Mosina Grand Prix cycle.

name: 49 Półmaraton Lechitów
description: The 49th Lechitów Half Marathon is the oldest Polish half marathon, continuously organized since 1978. The race course of 21.0975 km runs from the Small Skansen in Ostrów Lednicki to the finish line at St. Adalbert's Square in Gniezno, referencing the historical journey of Otto III. The race attracts thousands of participants each year and is part of the Polish Half Marathon Crown and the Greater Poland Half Marathon Grand Prix. Organizers ensure professional service, timing measurement, and route security, and participants receive a starter pack with a medal and a recovery meal.
course_highlights: Start from the Small Skansen in Ostrów Lednicki, finish at St. Adalbert's Square in Gniezno
Course length of 21.0975 km with PZLA certification, fully asphalted
5 nutrition points along the route, including water and isotonic drinks
additional: The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours and 30 minutes. Timing is measured using chips in the start numbers. The organizer provides bus transportation to the start in Ostrów Lednicki. The start package includes a set of safety pins for attaching the number, a medal at the finish, and a recovery meal. Registration and packet pickup are at the II LO sports hall in Gniezno, September 19 from 15:00 to 20:00 and September 20 from 7:00 to 9:00. The participant limit is 2000, age restriction is 18 years and older. Transportation is available by bus or personal vehicle.

name: 6 Półmaraton Aleją Dębów Czerwonych
organizer: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Gminny Ośrodek Sportu i Turystyki w Wieruszowie, Spółdzielnia Socjalna Green Service
description: The 6th Red Oak Avenue Half Marathon is a race covering a half marathon distance (21.097 km), scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026, in Wieruszów. The event is organized by the Łęka Opatowska Municipality, the Wieruszów Municipality, and the Wieruszów Sports and Tourism Center. The race is open and friendly to runners, with the course running along the scenic Red Oak Avenue. The race office will be open on the day of the event from 08:00 to 11:30, and timing is recorded electronically. The event is supported by local partners and sponsors, and participants can expect professional organization and attractive start conditions.
course_highlights: Half marathon course of 21.097 km
Scenic Red Oak Avenue
Electronic timing
additional: Race office open on 20.09.2026 from 08:00 to 11:30. Organizers: Gmina Łęka Opatowska, Gmina Wieruszów, Wieruszów Sports and Tourism Center, Green Service Social Cooperative. Partners: Kępno County, Wieruszów County. Main sponsor: HK Meblowa Group. Participants must accept the regulations and consent to personal data processing. A map of the route and authorization for collecting the start package are available. Participant limit: 434. The event promotes physical activity and a healthy lifestyle. Registration details and regulations are available on the official website.

name: 7 H2O Półmaraton
location: ul. Międzyrzecka 3, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 7 H2O Half Marathon is a race covering a distance of 21.097 km, scheduled to take place on September 20, 2026, in Wrocław. The route is flat, asphalted with sections of hardened gravel surface, running one loop starting and finishing at ul. Międzyrzecka 3. The event promotes running and physical culture among Wrocław residents, offering participants professional organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race has a time limit of 3 hours and provides hydration points and a recovery meal after completion.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalt route with approximately 3 km of gravel surface
One loop of 21.097 km with PZLA certification
Three hydration and refreshment points on the route (5, 10, 15 km)
additional: Race office open on race day from 7:00 to 8:30 at the start. Bib pickup also available on Saturday at Decathlon Magnolia store from 12:00 to 20:00. At the finish line, a medal and a recovery meal are provided. Deposit and toilets (toi toi) available at the race office. Overall and age classifications, 3-hour time limit for the half marathon. Online registration, the start package includes a bib, water, meal, medal, and gadget, with attractions for participants and spectators.

name: Bieg Charytatywny
location: Park przy dworcu kolejowym, Oława, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Urząd Miejski w Oławie, Stowarzyszenie Ludzi Aktywnych „Biegnij Oławo”
description: Charity Run FOUR SEASONS - Stage IV is a sporting event organized in Oława, in the park near the train station. Participants can take part in a run of about 5 km or a Nordic Walking walk on the same route. The event has a charitable character and is coordinated by the Association of Active People "Run Oława" and the Oława City Office. The race office is open on the day of the race from 09:30 to 10:30, and the start is scheduled for December 20, 2026. The event is supported by local partners, and timing is provided by ZmierzymyCzas.pl.
course_highlights: Race and walk route approximately 5 km long
Location in the park near the train station in Oława
Opportunity to participate in Nordic Walking
additional: Race office open on race day from 09:30 to 10:30 near the start. Race coordinators: Mariusz Jarosławski (698-025-555) and Mateusz Bularz (721-162-604). Registration for the race has closed. The race takes place in the park near the train station in Oława, with additional attractions and charity collections.

name: Festiwal Górski Maraton Trzech Jezior
description: The Mountain Festival Three Lakes Marathon is a unique running event in the picturesque land of the Beskid lakes, featuring four distances: 3.5 km Czupel Vertical with 600 m elevation gain, 43 km marathon, 21 km, and 17 km. The routes lead through wild, mountainous areas of the Small Beskid, offering participants beautiful views, varied terrain, and contact with nature and the region's history. This event promotes community among runners and encourages an active lifestyle as well as highlighting the tourist and cultural values of this area.
