Route passes by the Böckstiegelhaus and Böckstiegel Museum
Start at Peter auf’m Berge, finish in the center of Werther
additional: Start and finish are at Peter auf’m Berge and at Venghauss-Platz in Werther. Bus services start at 12:00 PM from the Werther bus station to the start. Late registrations are possible on the event day from 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM at Venghauss-Platz, subject to available starting spots. The route is mostly in good condition, but at the junction of the 18/10 km courses at kilometer 3.7, it is very rocky. The courses pass through nature and the city. Registration is already possible, with bus transport to the start. No parking at the start location. Late registrations only if spots are available.

name: Cloppenburger Citylauf
organizer: Stadt Cloppenburg, Lauftreff des SV Bethen
description: The Cloppenburg City Run is a popular running event as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival, which takes place annually on the last weekend of September. The main race starts at the Red School on the marketplace and leads through Eschstraße to the Town Hall Square. In addition to the main race, there is a relay competition where teams of four each complete a roughly 1000-meter course four times. The event is organized by the running club of SV Bethen e. V. and supervised by the NLV district Cloppenburg.
course_highlights: Main race starts at the Red School on the marketplace
Course runs through Eschstraße and ends at the Town Hall Square
Relay race with approximately 1000-meter laps, to be run four times
additional: Relay teams receive a 50% discount on the registration fee if all four runners also participate in the main race. All competitions except the main race start and end at the Town Hall Square. The event is supported by local sponsors and takes place as part of the Cloppenburg City Festival. Competitions for various age groups, start times, course lengths, registration not yet open.

name: Crosslauf Winhöring
description: The cross-country race in Winhöring offers a varied cross-country event on September 26, 2026, for different age groups and performance levels. The event includes a main race over 7.5 km as well as a children's course over 700 meters. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Winhöring and provides a sporting challenge for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the nature around Winhöring
Main race over 7.5 km
Children's race over 700 meters
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19°C daytime high, 10°C low, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event takes place in September, the weather is typically cloudy, and registration is possible on the website.

name: Drei-Täler-Lauf
location: Mettingen, Tecklenburger Land, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 3-Valleys Run organized by TV Mettingen 1930 e.V. will take place on September 26, 2026, and leads participants through varied routes across the three valleys Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental, and Köllbachtal in the Tecklenburger Land. The main race over 14.1 km offers challenging, profiled terrain with impressive views of Querenberg, Schafberg, and Schniederberg. For beginners and experienced athletes, there is also an 8.3 km two-valleys run as well as a Nordic walking option. Children are warmly invited to participate in an 800 m school run and a 400 m toddler run, with fun being the main focus for the little ones. The event is family-friendly and features timing with a disposable chip, as well as showers and changing facilities at Ludgeri School.
course_highlights: Scenic route through Fahlbachtal, Ölmühlental, and Köllbachtal
14.1 km main run with challenging terrain and views of Querenberg, Schafberg, and Schniederberg
8.3 km two-valleys run and Nordic walking option for beginners and experienced athletes
additional: Timing is provided with a disposable chip from Runtiming, integrated into the bib and included in the registration fee. The cut-off time is 4:30 PM; late participants will not be scored. Showers and changing rooms are available at Ludgeri School sports hall. The top three women and men in the main and two-valleys runs, as well as the top three boys and girls in the school run, will receive awards. Personal participant certificates with race times can be downloaded free of charge from the Runtiming homepage. Results are available online at www.tvmettingen.de. Award ceremonies take place after each race. The course runs through the valleys of the Tecklenburger Land, with challenging profiles, children's races, parking available, and online registration possible.

name: Durlacher Turmberglauf
description: The Durlacher Turmberglauf is a flat and fast 10-kilometer race through the historic Durlacher Old Town, along the Pfinz river up to just before Grötzingen and back. The race has established itself as a fixed date for running enthusiasts from the region and offers an attractive course for ambitious runners. Additionally, a children's run takes place in the Durlacher Schlossgarten. The event combines athletic competition with social engagement by collecting donations for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 10 km race through the Durlacher Old Town
Course along the Pfinz river up to just before Grötzingen and back
Children's run in the Durlacher Schlossgarten
additional: Annual fundraising event in support of social projects. Opportunity to join the Africa Runners team and run for a good cause in team jerseys. Race on September 26, 2026, with sponsors from the region, donation campaigns for charitable causes, participation conditions and registration on the official website.

name: Emmertinger Herbstfestlauf
description: The Emmertinger Autumn Festival Run takes place at the sports field in Emmerting and is part of the local autumn festival. The event is aimed at children, adults, club runners, recreational runners, and walkers. There are various distances, including children’s runs, 5- and 10-kilometer races, as well as Nordic walking routes. The family-friendly and festive atmosphere makes the run a popular meeting point for the local running scene.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Emmerting
Children's runs on short forest loops
5- and 10-kilometer races as well as Nordic walking on forest paths
additional: The event is integrated into the local autumn festival with food and drinks available throughout the day. The youngest children run 600 meters on the sports field, older children 2.5 km on a short forest loop. Nordic walkers complete one or two 5 km laps in the forest. The event is a community gathering welcoming runners of all ages and performance levels. It takes place on September 26, 2026, and besides the race program, offers refreshments and a festive atmosphere.

name: Friedrichshaller Runde
description: The Friedrichshaller Runde is a traditional running event in Bad Friedrichshall, taking place on September 26, 2026. It is part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the scenic landscape of the region. The event is aimed at running enthusiasts of all performance levels and combines sporting challenge with scenic highlights. The organization is carried out by the Bad Friedrichshall city marketing, which is also known for other tourist offerings in the region.
course_highlights: Course through the picturesque landscape of Bad Friedrichshall
Part of the 3-Flüsse-Cup with varied terrain
Combination of natural experience and sporting challenge
additional: Distances: 400 m, 10 km; Registration and results via my.race|result; Listed in the lauf.de race calendar.

name: Halveraner Herbstlauf
location: Innenstadt von Halver, Märkischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Halver Autumn Run takes place annually on the last weekend of September in the city center of Halver. Organized by SSV Halver in cooperation with LGHS, the race offers children's and school runs as well as a relay race for amateur athletes. The main race is run as a 4 x 900 meter relay in two scoring classes (U100 and 100+). The event has been a fixture in the local running calendar for over 20 years and runs right through the heart of Halver's city center.
course_highlights: Relay race with 4 x 900 meter laps
Course runs through the Halver city center
Separate races for children, students, and youth
additional: Registrations on the day are possible up to 45 minutes before the start at the registration office or online. An additional fee of €1.50 (online) or €2 (at the registration office) applies for late registrations on the event day. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available at Lindenhof School. Streets will be closed from 12:00 PM for the race. All participants receive a medal, and the top three in each age group are additionally honored with medals and certificates. Relay race, 4 x 900 meters, in the Halver city center, age groups U100 / 100+.

name: Herbstfestlauf
description: The 30th Niederstetten Autumn Festival Run takes place around the town hall in Niederstetten and offers varied courses for all age groups. The shorter runs lead through the city center, while the main race runs along the picturesque Vorbachtal valley. Participants can look forward to beautiful views of the vineyards and Weikersheim Castle. Various race categories from mini run to relay race are available, so everyone can participate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Niederstetten Town Hall
Main race along the Vorbachtal valley
View of vineyards and Weikersheim Castle
additional: The mini runs C and B are held without scoring. There are rankings for school and youth runs, open run, relay race, and main race. The Autumn Festival Run is part of the Tauberfranken Running Community, which organizes several regional running events with scoring for the Tauberfranken Cup. The event includes main, mini, school, and youth runs as well as relay races, with courses through the beautiful region around Niederstetten. The event promotes running in the region and offers attractive prizes for participants.

name: Hofheimer Volkslauf
description: The Hofheim People's Run is a traditional running event taking place on September 26, 2026, at the Sportpark Hofheim in Lampertheim-Hofheim. The race is organized by the Turnverein 1896 Hofheim im Ried e.V. and offers runners of all ages a friendly and family-like atmosphere. The event is known for its good organization and the opportunity to engage in sports and experience community.
course_highlights: Various distances (1 km, 5 km, 10 km)
Running, walking, and Nordic walking competitions
Event location at Sportpark Hofheim with a flat course
additional: Registration is done in writing by downloading a registration form (Word document). Contact persons for questions are Esther Heilmann and Verena Salomon with provided phone numbers and email addresses. There is a contact form on the website for further inquiries. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children and youth competitions. Start times are at 15:15 and 15:30. More details, registration, and the race announcement are available on the website.

name: Hohenlockstedter Pellkartoffellauf
description: The Hohenlockstedt Boiled Potato Race is a traditional running event that has been held annually since 2002 on the Pohl-Boskamp grounds. With race distances of 2.8 km, 5 km, and 10 km, the race offers a suitable challenge for both beginners and experienced runners. The event is particularly family-friendly, featuring special children's races for kids and a varied supporting program with games, a food mile, and entertainment. The event promotes community spirit, fun in movement, and is open to individual participants, school classes, teams, and companies.
course_highlights: Three race distances: 2.8 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Children's races of about 500 m for preschool and first grade
Drink stations during the 10 km race and fruit at the finish area
additional: Registration is possible on the day of the event from 11:30 a.m. at the start/finish area. Late registration for children and adolescents costs €8.00 and is possible up to 45 minutes before the race starts. Award ceremonies for places 1-3 in overall and age categories take place at 2:15 p.m., 4:00 p.m., and 5:00 p.m. On the Friday before the race, the potato-themed program begins with the coronation festivities of the Boiled Potato Queen and an after-show party with free admission. Various race distances, children's races, supporting program, award ceremonies, raffles, after-show party, and registration from 11:30 a.m. on the event day.

name: Hotfoot Run Warstein
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht gelistet)
description: The Hotfoot Run Warstein is a spectacular obstacle race on September 26, 2026, suitable for all fitness levels and age groups with distances ranging from 5 km (Family Edition) up to 20 km. The course runs across the Montgolfiadengelände, the ski slope, and through the quarry, featuring many muddy obstacles, water slides, and foam. The event offers an exciting start show, a unique atmosphere, and has been promoting team spirit and fun since 2007. Whether as a fitness enthusiast, a fun group, or family - everyone will experience an unforgettable adventure in North Rhine-Westphalia.
course_highlights: Start and finish on the Montgolfiadengelände
Course runs over the ski slope and through the quarry
Spectacular obstacles with mud, water slides, and foam
additional: Start occurs in multiple starting groups (Overflieger, Slope Starter, Endurance Runner, Latecomer) for different performance levels. There are affordable group rates from 6 participants with discounts up to 20%. Optional extras include finisher shirts, timing, bandanas, and photo flat. Participants under 18 require a parental consent form. Terrain includes ski slope, quarry, water, and foam elements; registration with group discounts; various distances and a Family Edition; entertainment with bands and DJs.

name: Höhlerfestlauf
location: Stadtwald Gera, Hofwiesenpark, Gera, Thuringia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 22 km Höhlerfest-Cross ab AK M/W U20 (ab 18 J., ab Jahrgang 2008: 25 €)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 km Hauptlauf ab AK M/W U18 (ab 16 J., ab Jahrgang 2010): 15 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 5,0 km Jedermannlauf ab Ak M/W U16 (ab 14 J., ab Jahrgang 2012): 10 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 2,5 km Lauf nur AK U14 und U12 (10-13 Jahre, Jahrgang 2016-2013): 7 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 0,8 km Lauf nur Jahrgang 2017 und später: 4 €

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 12 km Walking (keine Altersbeschränkung) und Handicap (ab Jahrgang 2010) : 10 €

description: The 11th Höhlerfestlauf on September 26, 2026, in Gera offers a diverse running event with courses for all age groups and performance levels. New is the 22 km cross run with obstacles and 420 meters of elevation gain, passing through the Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark. In addition to classic distances from 0.8 km to 12 km, there are also walking and handicap routes as well as the popular parent-child run for preschool children. The event is characterized by its special atmosphere with live music and a family-friendly vibe, supported by the city of Gera.
course_highlights: 22 km Cross run with obstacles and 420 m elevation gain
Courses through the Gera city forest and Hofwiesenpark
Refreshment points at 6, 11, and 17 km as well as at the finish
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start for a late registration fee of 5 EUR. Award ceremonies begin at 12:15 PM, with trophies for the course winners over 22 km, 12 km, and 5 km. The parent-child run is a fun event with medals and certificates for all children. Live music and a specially composed Höhlerfest song create a special atmosphere. Various running routes including obstacle course, parent-child run, live music, obstacle course for participants with disabilities, Stadtwald and Hofwiesenpark as race venues.

name: Kreismeisterschaften Waldlauf (Kreis Ludwigsburg)
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Kreis Ludwigsburg, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remsecker Forest Run is a family-friendly race in the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest, taking place for the sixth time in 2026. The event offers exciting course routes and an unforgettable sporting experience for runners of all ages. The organizing team of SGV Hochdorf also prepares fresh forest run shirts and informative flyers to support participants. The race will be held on September 26, 2026, and warmly invites all sports enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest
New, exciting course routes
Family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Weekly training sessions on Fridays at 6:30 PM in front of the forest entrance as preparation for the race. Forest run shirts are available. The registration portal will open in mid-May. Forest run in Hochdorfer Forest, registration and more information on the website, categories for children, adolescents, active participants, and masters.

name: König Ludwig Lauf - Sommeredition
description: The King Ludwig Run - Summer Edition is Bavaria's most beautiful panoramic run in the Ammergau Alps. The event offers varied courses from 6 km to 21 km, passing through the picturesque nature of the Ammergau Alps Nature Park. A free shuttle bus transports participants to the start in Ettal, and the event is ideal for trail and landscape running enthusiasts. The family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized framework make the run a special experience.
course_highlights: Panoramic routes through the Ammergau Alps Nature Park
Course lengths: 21 km half marathon, 10 km panorama run, 6 km wellness run, kids trail
Free shuttle bus from Oberammergau to Ettal to the start
additional: Registration and bib pickup are available at the start in Ettal on Saturday from 07:00 to 09:15. Online registration closes on the Wednesday before race weekend at 00:00. Parking and stops are available. The region is accessible by car, bus, and train. Airports in Munich, Memmingen, and Innsbruck are nearby. The run takes place in the Ammergau Alps Nature Park region. Registration is possible until September 22, 2026; late registrations on the event day are permitted. Accommodation options are available at the Klosterhotel Ettal.

name: Lauf Rund um den Grengel
location: Engelskirchen, Oberbergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Jugendliche (5 km und 10 km) zahlen nur 7,- €

description: The Rund um den Grengel race is a traditional community run in Engelskirchen, organized annually by VfL Engelskirchen e.V., Department of Athletics & Triathlon. The event offers various distances, including a Bambini run, school runs, a 5 km fun run, and a 10 km main race, some of which are held as municipal championships. The course is flat, passing through sports grounds, streets, and forest paths, and is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV). The family-friendly atmosphere and the involvement of children and adolescents make this race a special event for all age groups.
course_highlights: Flat course over sports grounds, streets, and forest paths
DLV-measured 5 km and 10 km routes
Includes municipal championships over 5 km and 10 km
additional: Late registrations are possible online up to 60 minutes before the respective start for a fee of €5. Changing rooms and showers are available on site. Medical services are provided by the Malteser Engelskirchen. All children in the Bambini run receive a medal, certificates can be viewed and printed online. Awards for the top three overall finishers in the school run, 5 km, and 10 km. The courses are measured by the DLV; start times from 2:00 PM; registration only online; participation open to all age groups; medals for children, digital certificates; medical services on site.

name: Oldersumer Appel-Loop
description: The Oldersumer Appel-Loop is a popular race that runs through the picturesque parks of Oldersum, along the Rorichumer Tief canal, and through the "alte Seilerei" museum. The course ends in the apple park, where the Oldersumer Apple Market takes place simultaneously and offers refreshments. In addition to the main runs over 5 km and 10 km, there is also a 5 km walking route and children's races over 800 meters for various age groups. The race is part of the East Frisian 7 Race Series and provides a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Run through Oldersumer parklands
Course along the Rorichumer Tief canal
Passage through the "alte Seilerei" museum and finish in the apple park
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start of each race. The Appel-Loop is part of the East Frisian 7 Race Series, where participants can receive a series shirt by participating in at least 5 of the 7 races. Races include 800m for children, 5km walking, and 5km and 10km main runs, through parklands and the museum "alte Seilerei".

name: R5K Berlin
description: The R5K Tour Finale 2026 is a youth race held as part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON, where ambitious runners aged 12 to 22 can measure their 5 km times. The final in Berlin is part of a series of three races, with times combined to determine the overall winners in the U20 and U23 age groups. In addition to the sporting challenge, attractive prize money and training camp subsidies are available for the best participants. The event promotes young talent and provides an exciting platform for young athletes in running.
course_highlights: Flat 5 km course in the heart of Berlin with start at Potsdamer Platz and finish at the Brandenburg Gate
Part of the BMW BERLIN-MARATHON with one of the flattest marathon routes among the Abbott World Marathon Majors
Refreshment points and BRITA Refill stations along the route for optimal hydration
additional: Registration is open online from 20.05.2026 to 25.09.2026 via an adult user account. The scoring is in the U20 and U23 age groups, requiring participation in at least three 5 km races of the cup series, including the final in Berlin. Minimum times apply for prize money eligibility. Race packets can only be picked up in person at the MARATHON EXPO. A warming poncho will be provided free of charge to all finishers at the finish area. The R5K is a series of five 5-kilometer races in Germany for youth aged 12 to 22, with overall rankings, prizes for U20 and U23, and training offers.

name: REHAmed Herkules-Berglauf
description: The REHAmed Hercules Mountain Run is a challenging mountain run through the Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park in Kassel, which takes place almost exclusively on paved natural paths. The course passes numerous sights such as the Löwenburg, the Steinhöfer Waterfall, and ends at the Hercules Monument. The race is open to runners and walkers and offers individual and relay categories for teams of three, making it ideal for families, clubs, and companies. Changing rooms and showers are available at the nearby Reform School gymnasium, and a luggage transport to the finish line is organized.
course_highlights: Course almost exclusively on paved natural paths in Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park
Passage of well-known sights such as Löwenburg, Steinhöfer Waterfall, and Hercules
Relay race with three segments and baton exchanges at prominent points
additional: Luggage transport to the finish from 10 a.m. at the starting area. Return to the start is self-organized on foot or by bus line 22. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Reform School gymnasium. The relay is scored by adding the times of the three individual segments; there are no age group categories for relays. The course runs on paved natural paths and asphalt. Registration is online via RaceResult. Start and finish are located in Kassel at Wilhelmshöhe Mountain Park. Medals are made of wood, T-shirts can be ordered, and showers and changing rooms are available at the Reform School gymnasium.

name: Remsecker Waldlauf
location: Hochdorfer Wald, Remseck am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Remsecker Waldlauf is a family-friendly run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest in Remseck. The event offers various courses for children, teenagers, and adults, leading through diverse forest terrain with muddy, uneven grounds and narrow paths. The run combines athletic ambition with nature experience and community spirit, and is open to runners of all ages and skill levels. The event is organized by the Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and will take place in 2026 for the sixth time.
course_highlights: Running routes through the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest
Diverse courses with muddy, uneven grounds and small obstacles
Course lengths from 500 m to 7.5 km for all age groups
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event up to 60 minutes before the start, subject to available starting places, with a late registration fee of 3 euros. Each participant receives a bib with an integrated chip. Optionally, a recycled functional shirt can be ordered (children 15 €, adults 20 €). There are team rankings for the middle-distance race. Bib distribution takes place on Friday evening and Saturday morning at the start/finish area. Registration opens in mid-May, route layouts are being prepared, and training sessions are available before the event.

name: Rodheimer Volkslauf

late_fee.price: Nachmeldung möglich am Veranstaltungstag bis 30 Minuten vor Start

description: The Rodheimer Volkslauf is a family-friendly running event and part of the popular Main-Lauf-Cup running series. The start and finish are centrally located at the sports center on the large playing field, offering an attractive stadium atmosphere for all sports enthusiasts. The event includes various competitions from the Bambini run to half marathon and 10 km run, suitable for children as well as fitness enthusiasts and ambitious runners. The award ceremony is lively, and the event enjoys good participation.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports center on the large playing field with stadium atmosphere
Various distances from 0.15 km Bambini run to half marathon and 10 km
Part of the Main-Lauf-Cup with scoring runs for different age groups
additional: Registrations on the day of the event are possible until about 30 minutes before the respective start. The event offers scoring runs in the Main-Lauf-Cup and BBF-Junior Main-Lauf-Cup. The office is open on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays at specific times. Scenic run, family event, inclusive offerings, various running distances, on-site registration.

name: Schelder Berglauf
description: The Schelder Berglauf is a challenging mountain run in Dillenburg, organized annually by ASC Dillenburg. The course leads through varied terrain with steep ascents and offers runners a sporting challenge in a natural environment. The event attracts both ambitious runners and hobby runners and is a fixed date in the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain course with steep ascents
Natural running route through forest and hills
Traditional event with regional significance
additional: Runner information, terrain, registration, and further details are available on the website.

name: Volksbank-Citylauf Telgte
description: The 19th Volksbank City Run Telgte will take place on September 26, 2026, and offers a diverse program for runners of all ages. The courses lead through the historic old town, along the Ems River, and through the surrounding landscape, vividly reflecting the motto "City, Country, and River." In addition to the main race over 10,000 meters, there are other competitions such as the 5,000-meter run, walking, student and children’s runs, as well as a fun run without timing. The event is suitable for both ambitious runners and casual runners and families, organized by TV Friesen Telgte e.V.
course_highlights: 10,000-meter main run through old town, Ems floodplains, and landscape
5,000-meter run with refreshment station at the halfway point
Varied routes with asphalt, tartan track, paved, and natural paths
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start, with a late registration fee of 2 euros (Bambini run once per family or group). Changing rooms are available in the old double hall at the school center near the start and finish lines. Medals, trophies, and certificates are awarded for various competitions and age groups. The course is diverse, featuring asphalt, tartan track, paved, and natural paths. Photo and video recordings will be made and published. The start and finish are located at the school center sports field, registration is online, changing rooms are in the old double hall, and there is no timing for the children’s runs.

name: Wald-und Hügellauf
description: The Forest and Hill Run in Groß-Umstadt is a traditional race that starts and ends at the Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion on September 26, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: the classic 13.2 km course and the half marathon distance of 21.1 km. The race is part of the Long Distance Cup Jugenheim and is an approved race of the DLV. The route runs through forest and hills, where runners can expect witches in the woods and the "Mountain of Truth." Refreshments are provided along the way, and after the race, there will be an award ceremony as well as showers and changing facilities on site.
course_highlights: Forest and hilly landscape with the "Mountain of Truth"
Refreshment stations with water and fruit (1 for 13.2 km, 3 for half marathon)
Start and finish at Ludwig-Wedel-Stadion Groß-Umstadt
additional: Race bibs can be collected until 1:30 PM on the day of the event. Distribution of race numbers from 12:30 to 13:30. The cut-off time for the half marathon is 5:00 PM; participants arriving after this time will no longer be scored. Showers and changing facilities are available. Participants are asked to bring their own cups to reduce their carbon footprint. Refreshments are provided after the race. Late registration is possible on-site on the day of the event. Terrain: forest and hills. Registration: online. Refreshments along the route. Showers available.

name: Weezer Staffellauf
description: The Weeze Relay Race has been held annually in mid-September since 1985 in Weeze and has established itself as a popular relay race with up to 250 participating teams. The course runs on a 5 km loop along the scenic Nierswanderweg. The race offers various relay categories, including Bambini, school children, and standard relays, attracting runners of all ages. The athletics department of TSV Weeze organizes the event with great commitment and looks forward to numerous participants in 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km loop along the Nierswanderweg
Relay race with Bambini, school children, and standard relays
Race has been held annually since 1985 in mid-September
additional: The 40th Weeze Relay Race will take place on September 26, 2026. Registration details and application process will be announced at the end of July. Up to 250 teams have participated in previous events. The 38th Weeze Relay Race in 2024 recorded 32 Bambini teams, 36 school relay teams, and 55 standard relay teams finishing. Participants can register online until the end of July 2026; the event also includes student and community competitions as well as on-site catering.

name: Mělnický vinařský běh
location: Mělník, Mělník District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Mělník Wine Run is a traditional running race in Mělník, offering courses of 10 km and 21 km. The race takes place on a single loop with beautiful views of the castle and vineyards, with the route passing through historical and natural attractions around the town. After finishing, participants can enjoy a tasting of local wines, a commemorative glass, a free lunch, and a rich raffle. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, who have their own free races. The organizer is the association Run the World, which promotes running as a community and friendly activity.
course_highlights: The course passes through Mělník Castle and vineyards with a view of the Vltava River
The loop includes crossing a lock chamber and passing through Hořín Park
Refreshment stations along the route, including a turnaround point at Vrbno
additional: Registration and changes on race day are not possible. Bib pickup is only available until 9:30. After finishing, each participant receives a commemorative glass and can participate in a wine tasting. Lunch is free for all runners, including a vegetarian option. After the winners are announced, a rich raffle will take place. The race capacity is 500 runners for both the 10 km and 21 km courses. Children's races are free. The registration fee varies depending on the registration date. The event supports charitable causes to help people with cystic fibrosis. The race is limited to 500 runners.

Competitions for all age groups and Nordic Walking
additional: Late registrations are possible until 9:00 AM on the day of the event for a fee of €3.00. Prizes are awarded to the fastest runners, and all participants receive a certificate. The event includes multiple start times for different competitions, e.g., Nordic Walking at 9:30 AM, Kindergarten Mile at 9:35 AM, and various running distances starting from 10:00 AM. Start times are between 9:30 and 10:10 AM, registration until 9:00 AM with a late registration fee, certificates and trophies for participants.

name: Kleeblattultra (100-Meilen-Lauf)
description: The Cloverleaf Ultra is a challenging 100-mile ultramarathon in Schwarme, Lower Saxony, passing through three districts. The event was conceived to establish the first 100-mile race in northern Germany. Organized by TSV Schwarme and a dedicated four-person team, the race offers a unique opportunity for experienced ultrarunners to face a special challenge. The course consists of four cloverleaf sections of 25 miles each, run consecutively. The event emphasizes professional organization with timing, live tracking, and refreshment stations.
course_highlights: 100 miles through three districts
Four individual sections of 25 miles each (cloverleaves)
Start and finish area in Schwarme with sports hall as event center
additional: Check-in on 25.09.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on 26.09.2026 from 07:00 to 08:30. Briefing on 26.09.2026 at 08:30. Cutoff time on 27.09.2026 at 15:00. Participation only from 18 years old. Participant limit: 30 individual runners and 5 relay teams of 2 persons each. Includes timing, live tracking, pasta party, and a hearty breakfast. Relay start possible with adherence to the order of the cloverleaves (South, West, North, East). No shortening of the course allowed. Course length 162 km, registration required, cutoff times, sponsors welcome, volunteer search, GPX data available.

name: Kraichgaulauf
description: The Kraichgaulauf in Sinsheim-Rohrbach is a traditional race taking place on September 27, 2026, offering runners of all performance levels varied courses through the scenic Kraichgau landscape. From the short 5 km route to the popular 10 km run, the challenging half marathon, and the demanding hill marathon with 42.2 km, there is something for everyone. The courses lead through nature and offer breathtaking views, including the landmark Burg Steinsberg. The event is ideal for those who want to combine endurance, nature experience, and sporting ambition.
course_highlights: Hilly marathon with varied elevation profiles and breathtaking views
10 km route with asphalt, paved field paths, and idyllic forest sections
5 km route with panoramic views of the Kraichgau and Burg Steinsberg
additional: Race number pickup until 30 minutes before the start at Kreuzgrundhalle. Changing rooms and showers available at Kreuzgrundhalle and on the sports grounds. Parking around the hall and in the sports field area. Bag storage at the start/finish area (Grundschule Rohrbach). Refreshments with drinks, fruit, and snacks at multiple stations depending on the route. Medal for all finishers. Time measurement with disposable timing chip integrated into the race bib. Late registration possible until 30 minutes before the start, subject to availability. Limited to 1000 participants. Various distances, registration opens on April 15, 2026, focusing on nature and experience.

name: Kurparklauf 2026
location: Kurpark, Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe, Hesse, Germany
description: The Kurparklauf in Bad Homburg v. d. Höhe takes place annually and transforms the Kurpark into an attractive running course. The event offers two distances: a 10 km fun run for experienced runners and a 5 km fun run for everyone who prefers a shorter and more accessible route. Both runs start and end at Brunnenallee and lead over a 2.5 km loop through the green Kurpark, passing meadows, trees, and garden paths, without crossing heavily trafficked roads. The run is an established event, celebrating its 30th edition in 2026.
course_highlights: Run through the green Kurpark of Bad Homburg
Shared 2.5 km loop for 5 km (2 laps) and 10 km (4 laps)
Avoidance of heavily trafficked roads, natural course
additional: Participants can download their certificates after the run. Registration usually begins in early August. The event will be the 30th edition of the Kurparklauf in 2026. Distances: 5 km and 10 km; registration begins in early August; certificates available after the run.

name: Lions - Dietzenbacher Stadtlauf 2026
description: The Lions - Dietzenbach City Run is an established running event in the Hessentagspark Dietzenbach that combines athletic activity with social engagement. Every year, numerous runners of all ages participate, accompanied by families and spectators. The event offers a 4 km fun run, a competition for businesses and clubs, and a 10 km main race. The city run stands for community, movement, and responsibility for the city of Dietzenbach.
course_highlights: Run in the Hessentagspark Dietzenbach
4 km fun run and 10 km main race
Competition for the trophy for businesses and clubs
additional: The city run is a charity event supporting social causes in Dietzenbach. There is a trophy competition for businesses and clubs. The event is supported by numerous volunteers and is a regular part of the city's event calendar. The event promotes social cohesion, with team competitions for local clubs and companies; the net proceeds benefit youth education and youth sports in Dietzenbach.

name: Marner Kohltagelauf
description: The Marner Kohlta Lauf is a traditional race in Dithmarschen and an official part of the Dithmarschen Cup as well as the Dithmarscher Corporate Cup. The event offers various distances from 400 meters for children to 10 kilometers for adults. The routes are traffic-free, well signposted, and each kilometer is marked. Refreshments are provided along the course and at the finish line, and timing is professionally managed with a chip on the start number. The event takes place in almost all weather conditions and offers changing rooms and showers in the Marne swimming hall.
course_highlights: Traffic-free and well signposted routes with kilometer markings
Water stations every 5 km and refreshments at the finish (mineral water, isotonic drinks, fruit)
Timing with chip on the start number without rental fee
additional: Late registrations are possible online up to 30 minutes before the start with a late registration fee of €5. Data adjustments and re-registrations are possible for a processing fee of €5. The event takes place in almost all weather conditions. Changing rooms are available, and showers can be used in the Marne swimming hall. Various race distances, registration until August 2026, routes well signposted, refreshments and changing facilities on site.

name: Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf
description: The 10th Möhrendorfer Karpfenweiherlauf is a traditional scenic race for running and Nordic Walking enthusiasts, taking place on September 26 and 27, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Möhrendorf. The course runs through forest, meadow, and field paths past numerous carp ponds and includes approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km. In addition to the half marathon, there are Nordic Walking and various youth and children’s races. The event offers a diverse and natural race setting for all age groups.
course_highlights: Scenic race over forest, meadow, and field paths
Course passing many carp ponds
Approximately 150 meters of elevation gain over 21.1 km
additional: Registration until September 23, 2026. Start times on September 26 from 14:30, and on September 27 until 13:00. Various participation categories from children’s races (1 km to 4 km) to Nordic Walking (7 km) and half marathon (21.1 km). Minimum age and participant limits apply per category. Scenic race over forest, meadow, and field paths, various distances, children’s and hobby races.

name: Nordahl Grieg Gedenklauf
organizer: Förderverein der Maxim-Gorki-Gesamtschule mit gymnasialer Oberstufe Kleinmachnow

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Organisationsbeitrag: Kinder und Jugendliche (bis 19 Jahre) 3,- € pro Person

description: The Nordahl-Grieg Memorial Run is a traditional race event in Kleinmachnow, taking place on September 27, 2026, at the Maxim-Gorki Comprehensive School. The event offers various competitions for children, students, youth, and adults on loop courses around the school and Kleinmachnow Lake. All participants receive drinks and refreshments at the finish area, as well as medals after crossing the finish line. The event is organized by the Förderverein of the Maxim-Gorki Comprehensive School and is under the patronage of the Norwegian ambassador and the mayor of Kleinmachnow.
course_highlights: Loop course around the Kleinmachnow Comprehensive School (800 m for children)
Loop course around Kleinmachnow Lake, Karl-Marx-Straße, A.-Grimme-Ring, and Schopfheimer Allee
Distances of 3.2 km, 6.4 km, and 9.7 km
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day until 09:30 AM with a late registration fee of 2 euros. The age group classification follows the competition regulations of the DLV. The use of music devices during the run is prohibited. Trophies are awarded to the overall winners of the main race (9.7 km), and certificates are given for places 1-3 in all age categories. A traveling trophy is awarded for the loudest school in the TKS region. The race is open for children, youth, and adults, with various distances, refreshments at the finish area, registration deadline on September 23, 2026.

name: Rheinhöhenlauf - RUN50
description: The Rhine Heights Run RUN50 is a three-day running event with three varied stages covering a total of 50 kilometers and around 1,000 meters of elevation gain. The event combines sporting challenge with a family-friendly and personal atmosphere, ideal for running enthusiasts who want to combine sport with a short vacation. The event is organized by a dedicated team from TV Linz, BBC Linz, and VfB Linz and offers, in addition to the sporting route, an attractive supporting program with catering, clothing transport, finisher medal, functional shirt, finger food buffet, and a ride on a historic railbus. The proceeds benefit the organizing clubs as well as the Förderverein des Franziskus Krankenhauses Linz.
course_highlights: 50 kilometers total distance spread over three stages
Approximately 1,000 meters of elevation in the border area of Westerwald and Siebengebirge
Includes route catering, clothing transport, and a historic railbus ride
additional: The registration fee includes, in addition to the sporting challenge, a high-quality functional shirt, a finisher medal, a finger food buffet called "Das fängt ja gut an," and a ride on a historic railbus. The event is organized in a personal and family-friendly manner with a motivated team of helpers and a successful supporting program. Route catering, clothing transport, finisher medal, functional shirt, finger food buffet, ride on a historic railbus.

name: Ruhstorfer Geländelauf
location: Ruhstorf an der Rott, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Ruhstorfer Cross Country Run is a approximately 7.5-kilometer trail run around Ruhstorf on the Rott, passing through a beautiful landscape with some inclines. The course is about half asphalt and half field and meadow paths. The race is suitable for both ambitious runners and beginners due to the charming natural scenery. It takes place annually and is part of the Grenzland-Laufcup 2024. The event is organized by SVG Ruhstorf e.V. and offers a friendly atmosphere for all participants.
course_highlights: Approximately 7.5 km long trail run
Course half asphalt, half field and meadow paths
Beautiful landscape with some inclines around Ruhstorf on the Rott
additional: Race bib distribution and registration on the day of the event from 08:30. Late registrations are possible online until September 28, 2024, 6 PM and on-site until one hour before the respective race start. Late registration fee is 5 euros. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Award ceremony from approximately 12:30 for youth, women, and men. Distance: approximately 7.5 km through scenic landscape, mixture of asphalt, field, and meadow paths; registration until September 27, 2024; start at 8:30 AM; event held in all weather conditions.

name: Rund um den Kellerskopf
description: Around Kellerskopf is a road race event in Wiesbaden-Rambach, Hesse, organized by TuS Rambach Laufbewerbe since 1960. The event offers various distances, including 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon over 21.1 km, as well as children's and youth races on the same morning. The course is hilly and not a flat city course, making it an attractive challenge for both serious runners and families. Start and finish are at the sports field on Trompeterstraße. The event combines the charm of a local club race with a variety of participation options.
course_highlights: Hilly course profile, not a flat city course
Start and finish at the sports field Trompeterstraße
Children's and youth races with distances from 400 m to 2600 m
additional: Children's and youth races on race morning: 400 m for toddlers, 800 m or 1300 m for younger students, 2600 m for older students. Half marathon open to juniors, men, women, age group runners, and teams. Typical September weather in Wiesbaden: approximately 19 °C max, 10 °C min, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. The event is part of the regional running scene in Wiesbaden, with results and photos available online. The event takes place in September and is very popular among runners of all performance levels.

name: Saaraltarmlauf
description: The Saaraltarmlauf is a traditional running event in Saarlouis that attracts runners from the region and beyond every year. The event offers a well-organized competitive atmosphere with start and finish in Saarlouis. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of the Saaraltarm and provides an attractive challenge for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization by the LSG Saarlouis.
course_highlights: Run along the Saaraltarm with natural sections
Start and finish in the city of Saarlouis
Attractive course for leisure and competitive runners
additional: Registration and late registration are possible from 08:30 AM. Registration is via Meisterchip. The official announcement is available at ladv.de. The Saaraltarmlauf takes place on September 27, 2026. Registration is online, and the starting fee is paid upon collection of the bib number.

name: Schusterlauf
description: The Schusterlauf Preetz is a traditional race event with various course lengths, taking place on September 27, 2026, in Preetz. The challenging 16 km course runs through forests, meadows, and along Lake Lanker, requiring good to very good fitness. In addition to the main race, there are shorter distances such as the Bambini run for children and the Kirchsee and Wehrberg runs. The event is part of the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup, where participants can earn points for the overall standings.
course_highlights: 16 km long course through forests, meadows, and along Lake Lanker
Good, firm hiking trails in Wehrberg and along Kirchsee shore
Challenging course with a turnaround point at Gut Wahlstorf
additional: Number pickup on the day before (19:00-20:00) and on the event day from 08:00 in the Alte Wilhelminenhalle, Schulstraße 2, 24211 Preetz. Automatic participation in the ZIPPEL’S Kiel.Cup with points scoring. No re-registration of start numbers possible. New service: drop-off of bags at the marketplace near the finish in a truck. GPX files of the 5 km and 16 km routes available for download. Routes provided as GPX files, online registration, start and finish in Preetz, including services for bag drop-off and result downloads.

name: Sechs Stunden Urwaldlauf
description: The Six-Hour Jungle Run in Saarbrücken is a unique running event where participants can run as many laps as possible within six hours on a 1.85 km course through the jungle just outside the city. The route combines wide forest paths with idyllic single trails and offers a challenging experience with 46 meters of elevation gain per lap. The event emphasizes mutual respect among runners and environmental protection, supported by a sustainable catering concept and CO2 offsetting. The start is flexible from 10:00 AM, and the finish is at 4:00 PM, allowing everyone to set their own pace and breaks.
course_highlights: 1.85 km long course through the jungle with 46 meters of elevation gain per lap
Alternating between wide forest paths and idyllic single trails
Electronic lap and placement display at the Jungle Hut Neuhaus
additional: Race number pickup from 9 AM on-site. Flexible start time from 10 AM, with the event ending at 4 PM. Participants are advised to bring their own reusable cup to avoid waste. Catering is centrally located at the Jungle Hut Neuhaus with water, isotonic drinks, and runner nutrition. Single-use cups are not allowed on the course. Participant limit is 350. Team scoring with identical team name spelling. Organizers and volunteers work on a voluntary basis. CO2 emissions are offset. The event includes catering, showers, medical support, and an environmentally friendly system with personal reusable cups. The event emphasizes sustainability and respectful interaction with nature and fellow runners.

name: SPORT IN Reisberglauf
description: The 29th SPORT IN Reisberglauf will take place on September 27, 2026, in Lippertshofen. The race is recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), allowing performances to be officially recorded in the athletics best lists. Two distances are offered: a short race over 400 meters and a longer race over 13.8 kilometers. The event provides runners with the opportunity to compete in an official and recognized event.
course_highlights: Two distances: 400 m and 13.8 km
Official recognition by the German Athletics Association (DLV)
Start location in Lippertshofen
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19°C daytime high, 10°C low, an average of 45 mm precipitation, mostly cloudy. Weather in September approx. 19°C, cloudy; race on forest and woodland paths; registration required; various distances; children and adult categories

name: Theodor-Heuss-Lauf
description: Theodor-Heuss-Run is a traditional city race in Brackenheim, held annually at the Wiesentalstadion and the surrounding picturesque landscape. It offers various race distances for all age groups, from children’s and kindergarten runs to student races and main runs over 5 km and 10 km. The course runs along the bike path in Austraße, through the development area "am Blasenberg" and the villages of Meimsheim and Dürrenzimmern back to the stadium. Besides sporting ambition, fun and community are also in the foreground, supported by local partners with attractive prizes and gifts for all participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Wiesentalstadion
Course along the bike path in Austraße and through scenic landscapes
Loop course with 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances
additional: Race bibs with transponder chip will be issued on the Friday before the race and on the event day. Late registrations are possible for a fee of €3.00, both on Friday and on the event day until one hour before the respective race start. There are separate start times: 11:15 AM for Zabergäu Cup, open race, and main race; 2:00 PM for children’s, kindergarten, and student races. Catering, showers, changing rooms, and parking are available on site. The race takes place in September, with start times and various categories such as children’s, kindergarten, student, and main race. The event is organized by the city of Brackenheim and supported by local partners.

name: Topiblütenlauf Staffort
location: Sportanlage des SV Staffort, Staffort, Karlsruhe, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Topiblütenlauf Staffort is a running event held as part of the Stutensee CUP and takes place in the beautiful surroundings of Staffort. The event offers races over 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km race counting as the third race of the Stutensee CUP. The races start at the sports facility of SV Staffort, and the event is open to runners of various age groups. Number pickup begins at 8:30 a.m., with start times at 10:00 a.m. for the 10 km race and 10:15 a.m. for the 5 km race.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports facility of SV Staffort
5 km race without age group classification
10 km race as the third race of the Stutensee CUP
additional: Number pickup from 8:30 a.m.; 5 km race without age group classification; age groups for the 10 km race range from U16 students to main class and seniors in 5-year increments; event as part of the Stutensee CUP. Route map, registration via Racepedia, start times at 10:00 and 10:15 a.m., registration deadline September 21, 2024.

name: Trainingslauf Bottwartal-Marathon
location: Riedstadion, Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a running event set in one of the most beautiful landscapes of southern Germany, featuring gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and an exhilarating atmosphere along the course. The route offers a loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal with varied sections on paved field paths and through historic town centers. The flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim invites a strong final sprint. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, everyone can find their personal running experience here.
course_highlights: Loop through the southern and northern Bottwartal
Passage through historic old towns such as Steinheim, Murr, Gronau, Beilstein, Oberstenfeld, and Großbottwar
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim for an exciting final sprint
additional: Monthly free training runs in various pace groups on the last Sunday of each month in Steinheim. Summer holiday runs every Tuesday evening during the summer break with a 10 km long run. Year-end run as a 10 km race with punch and mulled wine at the end of the year. Registration is via Datasport. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible until shortly before the race. The event includes not only the marathon but also half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and running events for all age groups; it takes place in June 2026 to allow runners optimal preparation.

name: Bergkloster-Lauf
description: The Bergklosterlauf, organized by TuS Velmede-Bestwig in cooperation with Bergkloster Bestwig, will take place on September 27, 2026, in the Sauerland. The races over 6, 10, and 21 kilometers lead through idyllic stream valleys, over ridges with great viewpoints, and through small settlements before ending at Bergkloster Bestwig. In addition to the races, there are children's and youth races as well as a supporting program with live music, childcare, free massages, and extensive catering. The event is also part of the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup of LAC Veltins Hochsauerland. Start and finish are easily accessible and offer ample parking as well as affordable overnight stays at Bergkloster.
course_highlights: Routes pass by idyllic stream valleys
Ridges with great viewpoints
Finish at Bergkloster Bestwig
additional: After crossing the finish line, free massages are offered. Childcare for "running parents" is available. Start and finish are only 600 meters apart and are easily accessible by bus, train, and car. There are 500 parking spaces nearby, including spots for motorhomes. Affordable overnight accommodations are available at Bergkloster. The 10 km run is also open to walkers. Children's and youth races start from 12 p.m. The 10 km race as well as the children's and youth races are scoring events for the Volksbank Sauerland Laufcup. Races over 6, 10, and 21 km, children's and youth races, registration via Race Result, parking and overnight options at Bergkloster, route details at Outdooractive.

name: Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf
description: The Bickendorfer Büdchenlauf is a lively race through the Cologne district of Bickendorf, offering a wide range of different race disciplines suitable for everyone. The event appeals to both ambitious runners and children and hobby runners. The start and finish are located on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf. In addition to the sporting event, participants and visitors can enjoy a varied supporting program with food stalls, exhibitors, and music.
course_highlights: Run through the Cologne district of Bickendorf
Start and finish on Venloer Straße in Cologne-Bickendorf
Varied supporting program with food and music
additional: There is a varied supporting program with food stalls, exhibitors, and music on the event square. The race offers various disciplines for all age and performance levels. Different distances, including children’s and dog runs, registration opens on February 14. Traditional neighborhood race in Cologne-Bickendorf.

name: Bleckeder Storchenlauf
description: The 1st Bleckeder Stork Race will take place on September 27, 2026, offering runners and walkers various distances in the open nature around the sports field in Bleckede. The routes lead through forested areas and open spaces with small to medium elevations, providing varied running conditions. Bib numbers and chips are to be collected 30 minutes before the respective start. The event is organized by VfL Bleckede von 1862 e. V. and is open to participants of all ages, including a toddler race for the youngest.
course_highlights: Routes through open nature, adjacent forest, and open spaces
Small to medium elevations on running and walking routes
Various distances from 600 m to 17.4 km for running and walking
additional: Bib numbers and chips are to be collected 30 minutes before the start. Start times are staggered: 10:00 AM toddler race 600 m, 10:15 AM walking 6.0 km and 10.4 km, 10:30 AM running 17.4 km, 10:45 AM running 6.0 km and 10.4 km. Running and walking routes through nature, small to medium elevations, various distances.

name: Bondorflauf
description: The Bondorf Race is a traditional running event held annually in Bondorf. It offers runners the opportunity to test their endurance and fitness in a friendly and sporty atmosphere. The event is part of the diverse sports offerings of SV Bondorf and is aimed at runners of all performance levels. The race takes place on September 27, 2026, and is a fixed date in the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic surroundings of Bondorf
Various distances for different performance levels
Part of the sports program of SV Bondorf with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: The Bondorf Race is part of the SV Bondorf running club, which trains year-round in various groups with distances from 8 to approximately 14 km. The event is noted in the club's calendar and is accompanied by experienced runners and coaches. It is held as part of a cycling and leisure sports program, with no specific details about the terrain or registration available on the website.

name: City-Lauf Lübeck
price_range: siehe Text (6-30 € je nach Wettbewerb und Anmeldezeitraum)
description: The City Run Lübeck 2026 takes place on September 27 and offers a diverse program for runners of all ages. The event includes a Bambini run, school runs, unicycle race, 5 km run and walk, as well as the 10 km main race. The courses lead through the historic city center of Lübeck, with current construction sites taken into account to ensure attractive and safe running routes. The City Run is open to everyone, even without club membership, and features team rankings as well as a friendly atmosphere for hobby and competitive runners.
course_highlights: Course through the historic Lübeck city center
5 km and 10 km runs with outer laps over Mengstraße
Separate routes for Bambini, school children, and unicycle riders with age-appropriate design
additional: Registrations are possible until September 26, 2026, on the day of the event only for the 10 km run from 9:00 to 10:30 a.m. Mandatory protective gear for unicycle riders (helmet, hand and knee protectors). Team rankings for school and 5 km runs. Bib numbers must not be altered. T-shirts for late registrations while supplies last. Terrain: city run, no official measurement; registration online, by mail, or on-site; bib numbers required; team and individual rankings; various age categories.

name: Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Serie
description: The 39th edition of the Cochem Zeller Crosslauf Series will take place on September 27, 2026, in Ulmen, Germany. The event offers two distances, 400 meters and 8 kilometers, on often record-eligible courses. As part of the solidarity system in sports and running culture, Laufde members benefit from reduced entry fees. The race is known for its varied cross-country courses in the Eifel region.
course_highlights: Record-eligible cross-country courses
Distances: 400 m and 8 km
Scenic surroundings in Ulmen, Eifel
additional: Typical weather in September: around 19°C, low of 10°C, 45 mm average precipitation, mostly cloudy. Weather in September around 19°C, cloudy; multiple venues in the region; certificates and trophies for winners.

name: Crosslauf Friedrichsruh mit Kreismeisterschaft
description: The Friedrichsruh Cross Country Race with District Championship is a cross-country event in Geestland, Germany, held at the Sportzentrum Nordeschweg. The event is organized by TV Langen von 1908 e.V. and offers various distances from 0.5 km for the youngest participants up to 25 km. In addition to the district championship races for children, youth, and adults, there are also open fun runs with distances from 2.5 km to 10 km. The event is characterized by a family-friendly club atmosphere and a focused local running event.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in the terrain at Sportzentrum Nordeschweg
Distances from 0.5 km (Mini Cross) to 25 km
District championship of Cuxhaven district integrated
additional: The youngest U8 runners start in a supervised 500 m Mini Cross. There are special KM Cuxhaven Cross races for school and youth classes. The event typically takes place in mild September weather with about 19 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Trail running, district championship, registration via LADV, various age groups, including children and youth races.

name: Crosslauf und Nordic Walking in Birkenwerder
description: The Cross Country & Nordic Walking event in Birkenwerder will take place on Sunday, September 27, 2026, and is organized by SV Grün-Weiß Birkenwerder e.V. Several race distances from 400 meters to 8.6 km will be offered, as well as a Nordic Walking competition, where the use of poles is mandatory. The event is open to various age groups from children to seniors and provides all participants with a printable certificate and medals for the top three places. Registration is online with a limit of 500 starting spots; late registrations are possible until the day of the event.
course_highlights: Multiple race distances from 400 m to 8.6 km for different age groups
Nordic Walking competition with mandatory pole technique
Event location: Sportplatz Summter Straße 26 in Birkenwerder
additional: Participation is at your own risk; the organizer assumes no liability for accidents or damages. Late registration is available from September 24 until the day of the event via online registration. A total of 500 starting spots are available. All participants receive a printable certificate, medals are awarded for places 1 to 3. For Nordic Walking, pole technique is mandatory. Distances: Cross country 400m to 8.6km, online registration, water and changing rooms on site, medals for certain races, bib number distribution from 09:30 AM.

name: Diezer Stadtlauf mit 10 km (Regionsmeisterschaft)
description: The Diez City Run is a 10 km road race that starts from the marketplace in Diez, Germany, and takes place at the end of September. This edition also serves as the regional championship, giving the race an additional competitive significance. In addition to the 10 km race, there are shorter distances, including a 400 m race for children and 5 km races for various age groups. The event is organized by SV Diez-Freiendiez and offers competitions for children, youth, open runners, and masters with separate classifications for men and women up to higher age groups.
course_highlights: Start at the marketplace in Diez
10 km road race through the city
Includes 400 m children's race and 5 km races for various age groups
additional: The event includes various age and gender categories, including children, youth, open class, and masters. The weather in September is typically mild with about 19°C during the day and 10°C at night, mostly cloudy with an average of 45 mm of precipitation. Race distance is 10 km, in Diez, as part of the regional championship, venue is the marketplace in Diez, weather in September approximately 19°C, including youth races and shorter distances.

name: Einstein-Marathon
description: The Ulm Einstein Marathon is one of the largest running events in southern Germany and takes place on September 27, 2026. The event offers various disciplines, including the classic marathon, half marathon, relay races, and other running and walking formats. The course runs through the city of Ulm, starting at the trade fair grounds and finishing at Münsterplatz. Over 15,000 runners are expected for the 22nd edition, which will be accompanied by a diverse program and a special Einstein collection.
course_highlights: Start at the trade fair grounds Ulm, finish at Münsterplatz
Diverse courses: marathon, half marathon, relays, Nordic walking, inline half marathon
Course through the historic city of Ulm with urban flair
additional: Late registrations are possible online from September 11 to September 22, 2026, until 12:00 PM, and on-site on the day of the event until 1 hour before the start, with a late registration fee of 5 €. Starting places can be transferred digitally until the registration deadline, afterwards only on-site. Changes to other disciplines are possible online until the registration deadline, then only on-site with a fee of 5 €. Race documents can be picked up on September 26, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM and on September 27, 2026, at various times and locations. Travel by public transport is free on the event day with race number or registration confirmation. Strollers, bicycles, dogs, and other aids are not permitted. Registration is open until September 7, 2026. Race documents can be collected in Ulm. No cancellations are allowed. Free travel with public transport, parking available.

name: Elmshorner Stadtlauf
description: The Elmshorn City Run is a traditional running event for the whole family in Elmshorn. The officially measured 5 km loop mainly runs on paved streets through the city center. In addition to the main races over 5 and 10 kilometers, children's runs over 600 m and 1.5 km are also offered. The event is also the SHLV state championship and offers a lively atmosphere with catering and an accompanying program at the town hall square.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km loop through the city center
Paved route with a flat profile
Children's runs over 600 m and 1.5 km
additional: The 10 km race starts at 9:30 a.m., the 5 km races start between 11:15 and 11:20 a.m., children's runs start between 11:20 a.m. and 12:45 p.m. Late registrations are also possible on the day of the event. The event is a fundraising event for the renovation of the Nikolaikirche tower. Catering with sausage, cake, and drinks at the town hall square. Temporary parking restrictions at the railway underpass on race day. Running routes on paved city streets, training courses before the event, registration until shortly before the event, medals for children.

name: Eper Michaelislauf
description: The Michaelislauf in Epe is a traditional, family-friendly race around the town festival in Gronau-Epe. It is recognized as a DLV race and offers affordable entry fees as well as inexpensive catering. The event is characterized by a pleasant atmosphere that appeals to both ambitious runners and recreational runners. Due to possible runoff elections, the race may take place on Saturday in some years.
course_highlights: Loop course around the town festival
Family-friendly route
Affordable entry fee and inexpensive catering
additional: The Michaelislauf is a DLV race and takes place around the town festival. It offers a family-friendly atmosphere with low entry fees and affordable catering. Due to possible runoff elections, the race may be held on Saturday. The race is part of the town festival in Epe, with catering and a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.

name: Esslinger Schurwaldlauf
location: Georgii-Waldstadion, Esslingen am Neckar, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Esslingen Schurwaldlauf is a traditional running event taking place on September 27, 2026, in Esslingen on the Schurwaldhöhe. The start and finish are located at the Georgii-Waldstadion, which is scenically situated between the Neckar and Remstal valleys. The event offers runners of all ages the opportunity to compete in various races, including the Esslingen city championships over 10 km. The course runs through the beautiful nature of the Schurwald and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Georgii-Waldstadion on the Schurwaldhöhe
Scenic course between the Neckar and Remstal valleys
Approximately 10 km course with varied terrain
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event from 8:00 to 9:30 a.m., with a late registration fee of 5 EUR in addition to the entry fee. Changing and shower facilities are available at the stadium. Parking is available nearby at Jägerhaus, Reitstall, or Segelfluggelände. The award ceremony will take place from approximately 12:15 p.m. The medical service is provided by the German Red Cross. The course runs on forest paths in the Schurwald. Registration is online. The race starts at 10:00 a.m. Late registrations on the event day are possible. There is a team classification, with prizes and certificates.

name: GVG Citylauf Erftstadt
description: The GVG City Run Erftstadt is the largest running event in the region and takes place annually in September. It offers a special atmosphere for all running enthusiasts, from children to hobby runners to elite athletes. The main course over 10 km runs four times through the medieval old town and the castle park of Lechenich, lined by numerous spectators. Additionally, there are shorter distances for students, families, and companies, which start and end on a circular route at the marketplace in Erftstadt-Lechenich.
course_highlights: 10 km main race with four laps through the medieval old town and the castle park
Circular course with start and finish at the marketplace in Erftstadt-Lechenich
Officially measured, fast course with few curves
additional: The 10 km main race is also available as a relay race. There is a raffle for a hot air balloon ride for two people among all finishers of the 5 km, 10 km, or relay races. The course is designed so that runners pass the marketplace multiple times and can be cheered on by spectators. For the youngest runners, there is a 750-meter circular course, students run 2.5 km, and the family and company run covers 5 km (2 laps). The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and follows its guidelines. Running event in the medieval old town and castle park, participation for all age and performance groups, including the 2026 running cup.

name: Herdorfer Götzelauf
description: The Herdorfer Götzelauf is a local race in Herdorf organized by DJK Herdorf and is part of the official German race calendar (laufen.de). The event offers two distances, 500 meters and 10 kilometers, and is primarily aimed at the community and regional runners. DJK Herdorf is an active sports club with regional collaborations, making the race a down-to-earth and community-oriented event. Official rankings in the DLV can be maintained for some races.
course_highlights: Two distances: 500 m and 10 km
Local race in Herdorf with club affiliation to DJK Herdorf
Part of the official German race calendar (laufen.de)
additional: Typical weather in September: approx. 19 °C daytime high, 10 °C low, about 45 mm of precipitation, mostly cloudy. Start location is Herdorf, with detailed directions available. Participation is open to all age groups, no detailed course information available, the event is integrated into the endurance cup 2024.

name: Herner St. Martini City-Lauf
description: The Herne St. Martin City Run takes place on September 27, 2026, on Bahnhofstraße Boulevard in Herne. The event offers various races for all age groups, from children to adults, with distances ranging from approximately 400 meters to 5 km. The race courses are officially measured and conducted under official supervision. Timing is done electronically via easychip, and all participants receive a certificate. The event is organized by IG Herne City e.V. and TV Wanne 1885 e.V.
course_highlights: Officially measured race courses with official certification
Various distances from approx. 400 m to 5 km for all age groups
Start and finish on Bahnhofstraße Boulevard in Herne
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 1 hour before the respective race, for an additional fee of €3.00. Race documents can be collected in advance on September 24 and 25, 2026, at the Sports Department in Herne. Timing is done electronically via easychip by the company davengo, Berlin. Result lists can be purchased at the competition office for €3.00. Changing rooms are available in schools. The event includes children's races, school competitions, and race distances for all performance levels. Registration is via an Excel form, and the event emphasizes community and sporting challenge.

description: The International Hochfelln Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race in Bergen, Germany, held annually. The course runs from the valley at the Hochfelln cable car station at 600 meters above sea level to the summit of Hochfelln at 1671 meters, with a length of 7.8 km and an elevation gain of 1071 meters. The race is part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix and offers runners a challenging and scenic mountain running experience. The event includes, in addition to the competition, a pasta party and a variety of catering for participants.
course_highlights: Course length of 7.8 km with 1071 m elevation gain
Start at the valley station of the Hochfelln cable car (600 m), finish at the Hochfelln summit (1671 m)
Part of the Mountain Running Grand Prix with challenging mountain terrain
additional: The registration fee of €40 includes the pasta party on Saturday, downhill ride with the Hochfelln cable car, parking, a comprehensive catering buffet, showers, and luggage transport. Bib number distribution takes place the evening before and on race day. Welcome party with pasta dinner on Saturday evening. Mountain trail terrain, registration required, historic race with multiple editions.

name: Volkswandertag
description: The Volkswandertag in Wymeer on September 27, 2026 invites all running and hiking enthusiasts to explore the diverse landscape around Wymeer. Offered are runs over 6 km, 12 km, and 21 km, suitable for beginners as well as half-marathon fans. Additionally, there are opportunities for hiking, Nordic walking, and cycling on well-marked routes with refreshment stations and friendly helpers. After the sporting activities, participants can enjoy a variety of food and drinks to end the day in a convivial atmosphere. The Volkswandertag promotes community, outdoor activity, and showcases the most beautiful spots of the region.
course_highlights: Runs over 6 km, 12 km, and 21 km for beginners to half-marathon enthusiasts
Hiking, Nordic walking, and cycling through diverse landscapes
Well-marked routes with refreshment stations and friendly helpers
additional: Registration is available online or spontaneously on the day of the event from 8:00 AM on-site. After the activities, there will be offerings of hearty dishes and cakes. The event is aimed at individuals, families, friends, and clubs. It is an opportunity for the whole family to be active and enjoy the nature around Wymeer.

name: Běchovice - Praha, MČR v silničním běhu mužů, žen, juniorů a juniorek
description: Běchovice - Prague is a legendary road race over 10 km with the longest uninterrupted tradition in Europe, held for the 130th time. The race is the official Czech national championship in road running and offers a challenging course of 10,031 meters, which will test every runner. The race atmosphere is exceptional and complemented by modern facilities, including an accompanying program and commemorative medals. The race is open to a wide range of categories from juniors to veterans and also offers a relay race.
course_highlights: The course measures 10,031 meters, 31 meters longer than the traditional 10 km
Start in Běchovice, finish at Pražačka in Prague
Official Czech national championship in 10 km road running with 26 categories
additional: Start numbers are issued at the Masaryk Railway Station hall in Prague on the days before the race and on race day in Běchovice. The race offers a functional Joma T-shirt and a commemorative medal included in the registration fee. The relay race starts simultaneously with the 3rd wave of the race at 11:50, consisting of 4 members with predetermined segments. The race capacity is 3,333 runners. Photos and personalized videos from the race are free of charge. The race is part of the celebrations and tradition of running sports in Prague, offering online registration and start in Českobrodská Street in Běchovice.

name: Běh metropole Praha 1
