The race is open to all age categories, from children to seniors and people with disabilities, who represent their city district. Each start provides points for the competition for the most athletic district of Prague. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, with unique medals and gifts for participants.
course_highlights: Races take place in different districts of Prague, including the city center
Support for a healthy lifestyle and community spirit among Prague residents
Categories for all age groups including people with disabilities
additional: Each participant represents their city district based on permanent residence and contributes to the point evaluation of the districts. The project emphasizes competition among Prague districts for the title of the most athletic district. Participants receive original medals and running magnets for their race bibs as souvenirs. The races feature various distances, are part of a series with medals and updates on the event locations; registration is available online and on-site.

Professional RFID timing

Participants can join the charity route #BiegamDobrze with a free start number. During the same weekend, there are also 10 km races (Warszawska Dycha) and a Mini Marathon for children and youth. The main part of the event is the 13th edition of the half marathon on a distance of 21.0975 km, which traditionally starts and finishes at Polsat Plus Arena in Gdańsk. Night Five - evening 5 km run with light illuminations and fireworks

The event also includes children's races on various distances, warm-ups, award ceremonies, and pre-registration from October 7. Participants can expect attractive cash prizes and record bonuses.

name: 16 Bieg im. Pawła Lorensa

The route is flat and fast, leading along paved pedestrian paths and cobblestone sidewalks. On race day, free children's runs are also organized, which can be registered for on the day of the event.

Free children's races with registration on the day of the event

The event includes an open state championship in mountain running and offers a free shuttle service for the return trip.
course_highlights: 9.4 km mountain run with 550 meters of elevation gain
Start at Spindelfabrik Neudorf (714 m above sea level), finish at the Fichtelberg plateau (1214.6 m above sea level)
Course through asphalt roads and paved paths through scenic sections
additional: Race number pickup from 9:00 to 10:30 a.m. at the festival tent of the Spindelfabrik. Late registrations only on the event day until 10:30 a.m. against a late registration fee. Free shuttle bus for the return trip from Fichtelberg to the start. Luggage transport (max. 1 bag/backpack per runner). Changing and shower facilities on site. Medical service provided by Bergwacht Oberwiesenthal. Lunch service by the Red Cross (pending). No approval for sports equipment or Nordic walking category. Registration opens spring 2026, shuttle service, luggage transport, award ceremony in the festival tent, parking available at the start and train station.

name: NRZ Klosterlauf
location: Kloster Kamp, Kamp-Lintfort, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The NRZ Kloster Lauf takes place on German Unity Day, October 3, 2026, around the Kloster Kamp in Kamp-Lintfort. The event offers suitable competitions for runners of all performance levels with courses over 5000 meters and a half marathon. The detailed regulations and schedule will be published once planning is complete. The run is an established event organized by SV Alemannia Kamp-Track and invites runners to participate on this special day.
course_highlights: Run around the historic Kloster Kamp
Courses over 5000 meters and half marathon
Event on German Unity Day
additional: The regulations and schedule will be published online once the final planning is completed. There are competitions over 5000 meters and half marathon. The event is part of SV Alemannia Kamp-Track and takes place annually on October 3. Distances include 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon; the event is scheduled for October 3, 2026; registration is possible on-site; part of regional running events in the Lower Rhine area.

name: Oberbayerische Straßenlaufmeisterschaften 10 km
description: The Schweiger Forest Run is a traditional running event organized by LG Sempt in Anzing, held annually on October 3rd since 1983. The 44th edition in 2026 offers fast courses and a family-friendly atmosphere in the heart of Anzing Forest. As part of the Forest Run, the Upper Bavarian Championships in the 10 km road race are held. The event is open to runners of all ages and is known for its good organization and large running community.
course_highlights: Traditional run through Anzing Forest
Fast 10 km road race course
Family atmosphere and community race character
additional: Family rate from 4 persons with 25% discount for the same last name. Opportunity to support the SYNGAP parents' aid with donations. RUNNER'S WORLD special: €10 savings when registering with a subscription test offer. The race takes place on a paved course in Anzing. Registration is via the event website. The event is part of the Upper Bavarian Road Running Championships and attracts runners from the entire region.

name: Ochsenweiherlauf Emskirchen
price_range: Hauptlauf 12 EUR, Hobbylauf 8 EUR, Schülerlauf 4 EUR, Bambinilauf 2 EUR

price_tiers.distance: Hobbylauf, Walking, Nordic-Walking 5 km oder 7,5 km

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The Oxen Pond Run in Emskirchen is a traditional running event organized by TSV Emskirchen, taking place annually on October 3rd. The event offers various race distances for all age groups, including a toddler run, youth/school run, hobby run, walking, and the main race over 10 km. The course runs over paved forest paths around the Oxen Pond and is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes. Catering is provided, and the times can be used for the German Sports Badge.
course_highlights: Paved forest paths around the Oxen Pond
Refreshment station passed at every lap
Course lengths from approximately 400 m to 10 km for different age groups
additional: Registration on the day of the event is possible until 1 hour before the start for an additional fee of 2 EUR. The event is approved by the Bavarian Athletics Association and the regulations of the German Athletics Rules apply. Bags can be stored in the changing room; keys and valuables are kept safe upon presentation of the starting number. The times for the main race and the walking/nordic walking 7.5 km can be used for the German Sports Badge. Event in October with catering, park & ride, online registration, no liability for damage or loss of valuables.

name: Odenwälder Herbstlauf
description: The Odenwälder Autumn Run is a traditional running event taking place on October 3, 2026, in Mudau. The event offers five different courses through the beautiful Mudau Odenwald, including a half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking, and a children's run. The courses mostly run on paved, flat forest paths and asphalt without significant inclines, making them both challenging and scenic. Prizes are awarded for best times on the half marathon and 10 km courses, and each registration supports a social cause. The start and finish areas are located at the Odenwald Stadium in Mudau, where race number pickup and award ceremonies also take place.
course_highlights: Courses through the Mudau Odenwald on asphalt and paved forest paths
Flat terrain without significant inclines
Officially measured courses: Half marathon (21.1 km), 10 km, 5 km, Nordic walking (10 km), and children's run (600 m)
additional: Race number pickup on race day from 7:30 AM at the Odenwald Stadium. Timing is gross with an integrated disposable transponder in the race number. Up to five refreshment stations with bananas, isotonic drinks, and water are available along the course. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the TSV club house. Valuables can be securely stored there. Award ceremonies will take place as soon as possible after the races in the stadium. There are age group classifications and a team ranking for the 5 km and 10 km runs. Late registrations are possible on race day until 8:45 AM for a late registration fee of 4 EUR via email or on-site. The race is known for its rolling courses and family-friendly atmosphere. There are also special competitions for children and adolescents.

name: Ortsstraßenlauf
description: The local road race organized by TV Marienhagen has been held annually since 1990 on German Unity Day and is the largest sporting event of the club. The courses run on roads within and outside the town as well as paved forest and field paths. The event is part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup and offers classifications for children, pupils, youth, and seniors. Participation is open to everyone, membership in a club is not required, and there are no more pre-registrations — registration is only possible on-site. Catering is provided during and after the event, and each participant receives a certificate.
course_highlights: Courses over roads, paved forest and field paths
10 km run and 7.5 km Nordic walking as turnaround routes
Part of the Waldeck-Frankenberger Laufcup
additional: Registrations are only possible on-site until at least 45 minutes before the start. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Every participant receives a certificate. No double starts for children and adolescents. Catering is available during and after the race at the village community center at the sports field. The course runs through the town, no pre-registrations possible, catering on-site, certificates for all participants.

name: RheinEnergie Kinderlauf Köln
description: The RheinEnergie Children's Run Cologne will take place on October 3, 2026, at Roncalliplatz near Cologne Cathedral. The event offers several child-friendly races with distances ranging from 500 meters to 2,000 meters, most of which are closed off and secured by course marshals. Before the race, there will be a children's church service at Cologne Cathedral, after which the children will start their races together. Participation is open to children born between 2015 and 2021, and no timing will be conducted — fun and participation are the main focus.
course_highlights: Course passes by Cologne Cathedral
Start and finish at Roncalliplatz
Closed course with course marshals
additional: Race bibs will be distributed on October 3, 2026, in a tent at Roncalliplatz. Registration is also possible on the day of the event from 9:00 AM to 12:15 PM on site. Children will start in multiple waves depending on the number of participants, divided by birth year and/or gender. There is no timing, and children should be able to run the course without parental accompaniment. Multiple races with different distances, no timing, participation from the 2015 birth year, limit of 1000 children, online registration available, race bib distribution on the event day.

name: Rodenbacher Lauftag
description: The Rodenbacher Running Day is a traditional race for peace and democracy in Europe, taking place on October 3, 2026, for the seventh time. The event offers four competitions for the whole family on a flat, asphalted, and IAAF-measured high-speed course through the oxygen-rich Rodenbacher Forest. A special highlight is the stadium run at the end of the 5 km loop, providing exciting impressions for spectators and runners. For the youngest participants, there is an attractive stadium cross with obstacles, commented on by an experienced moderator team. The race is an ideal preparation for the autumn marathon and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization.
course_highlights: Flat, asphalted high-speed course through the Rodenbacher Forest
Stadium run at the end of the 5 km loop with good spectator perspective
Attractive stadium cross with obstacles for children
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event on-site. The course is record-eligible and measured according to IAAF rules. Each finisher receives a special certificate, and numerous athletes are awarded on-site in ceremonies. Courses are measured and verified according to IAAF rules, registration on-site on the day of the event, including children and youth runs as well as a stadium cross for the youngest participants.

name: Rothaarwaldlauf
location: Rothaargebirge, Bad Berleburg-Aue, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Rothaar Forest Run organized by TSV Aue-Wingeshausen is a popular and scenic forest run in the Rothaar Mountains, taking place on October 3, 2026. The event offers various distances, including loop courses and point-to-point runs, appealing to both ambitious athletes and hobby runners. The races are part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup, celebrating its 25th anniversary this year. The course passes through beautiful forest areas with moderate inclines and provides excellent catering as well as a bus transfer to the start points of the longer distances.
course_highlights: Various distances from 400m to 28km, including loop courses and point-to-point runs
Start and finish at the sports field in Aue-Wingeshausen with bus transfer to the start points of the longer distances
Scenic forest routes with moderate inclines and good catering
additional: Start times vary depending on the distance, e.g., 13:30 for the main race. There is a bus transfer from the Aue-Wingeshausen gymnasium to the start points of the long distances (15km and 28km). Race documents can be picked up shortly before the start at various locations. Showers and changing facilities are available at the gymnasium. Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start at the start points. The event is part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup celebrating 25 years. Participants benefit from bus shuttle transport, catering with cake, waffles, and fries, as well as a well-established tradition in the race calendar. The event is part of the Rothaar Run Series AOK-Cup.

name: Saerbecker Kirmeslauf
price_range: Bambinilauf € 1,00; Schülerläufe 1,2 km und 2 km € 3,00; 5 km Jedermannlauf € 8,00; 10 km Hauptlauf € 10,00
description: The Saerbeck Fair Race takes place on October 3, 2026, at the Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck. The course is completely asphalted, flat, and runs along well-developed side streets, enabling fast race times. The event offers races for various age groups with timing via transponder and a ranking based on finish times. Medals are awarded to children, and there is an award ceremony for overall and age group rankings. Participants can print their certificates online.
course_highlights: Well-developed, fully asphalted course
Flat side streets for fast race times
Start and finish at Sparkassen Stadium Saerbeck
additional: Timing is done with a transponder on the back of the bib. The order of finish determines the ranking. An online certificate is available for all participants. The course is secured by volunteers, but traffic rules must still be observed. Each child in the children's races receives a medal. Liability for theft is excluded. Participants must confirm they are in good health. Online registration is possible; late registration on the event day for a fee; event conducted under official supervision according to DLV/IWR rules.

name: Sparkassen-Phoenix-Halbmarathon
description: The Sparkassen Phoenix Half Marathon in Dortmund is a popular half marathon race held annually on October 3rd. The 21.1 km course runs through the southern part of Dortmund, passing Phoenix Lake, Phoenix West, Westfalenpark, and Rombergpark, and is fully measured to allow for personal best times. In addition to the individual half marathon, there are relay competitions and a KNAX Fun Run for children. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, cheer zones, and a rendezvous point for relay runners shortly before the finish line.
course_highlights: Course runs through Phoenix Lake, Phoenix West, Westfalenpark, and Rombergpark
Measured 21.1 km course, eligible for personal bests
Change zones at kilometers 7 and 14 with shuttle bus connections
additional: Race bib distribution on October 2nd from 14:00 to 17:00 and on race day from 8:30. Race bibs are personalized and sent by mail. Late registrations are possible online until October 3rd at 10:00, thereafter on-site for a fee. Relay teams receive a relay baton for timing, which can be picked up on race day with ID. Refreshments are available at kilometers 4, 11, and 17 as well as in the finish area. Changing rooms, toilets, and baggage drop-off are located at the Sparkassen Academy at Phoenix Lake. Shuttle buses transport relay runners to the change zones. A rendezvous point is approximately 150 meters before the finish for relay runners. The course passes through parks and industrial areas. Registration, advertising opportunities, and race on October 3rd.

name: Stauch Cup

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Paul Kleinknecht Kinder- und Jugendlauf 5 Euro

description: The Stauch Cup, also known as the Kupferzeller Kärwelauf, is a traditional running competition in Kupferzell. It offers various race distances for all age groups, including a toddler run, children and youth run, health run, Nordic walking, and the main race. The event takes place around the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, which also serves as the start and finish area as well as for changing and showers. The award ceremonies are held in the hosted hall, creating a pleasant atmosphere.
course_highlights: RECA toddler run over 400 m
Paul Kleinknecht children and youth run over 2,600 m
Main race over 10,000 m
additional: Number bib distribution and late registrations begin at 11:00 AM. The award ceremonies take place in the hosted Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle. The town center will be closed from 1:30 PM due to the race event, parking spaces are signposted, please park outside and walk to the hall. Changing rooms and showers are available at the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle. Various running disciplines, online registration, parking facilities at the Carl-Julius-Weber-Halle, weather in October usually around 14°C with occasional rain.

name: Staufener Altstadtlauf
description: The Old Town Run Staufen is a traditional running event held annually on October 3rd in the historic Old Town of Staufen. The race is part of the Markgräfler Cup and offers runners an attractive course through the picturesque Old Town. The event attracts both amateur runners and ambitious athletes and is a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Run through the historic Old Town of Staufen
Part of the Markgräfler Cup
Scenic route with regional flair
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, and is a popular event for runners of all levels. The course leads through the picturesque alleys of the Old Town, making the run a special experience.

name: Stimberg-Haardlauf
description: The Stimberg-Haardlauf is a traditional race in Oer-Erkenschwick with start and finish at Stimbergpark. Various distances are offered for children, adolescents, and adults, including 500 m, 4.9 km, and 9.4 km. The adult routes are hilly and provide an interesting alternative to flat road races. The race includes individual and team classifications and is aimed at club runners, local teams, as well as youth and adult athletes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Stimbergpark in Oer-Erkenschwick
Hilly routes for adults with 4.9 km and 9.4 km
Shorter distances for children and adolescents, e.g., 500 m
additional: The schedule is organized by age groups and competitions, including categories such as forest run, short and longer cross-country runs. There are individual registrations and team classifications. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The race features a hilly terrain with rolling hills. Registration is done online until shortly before the event, with various categories for different age groups and performance levels.

name: Strausseelauf
description: The Strausseelauf in Strausberg is a traditional running event held annually. The event offers runners of various skill levels the opportunity to compete and enjoy the beautiful surroundings around Lake Straus. The race is organized by the Kultur- und Sportclub Strausberg e.V. and takes place at the Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium in Strausberg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and good organization.
course_highlights: Run around Lake Straus
Start and finish at Theodor-Fontane-Gymnasium
Traditional event with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Application form and flyer for the Strausseelauf are available, results are published on the official website

name: Taubertal 100
location: Rothenburg ob der Tauber, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Taubertal 100 is a scenic ultramarathon with distances of 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, 2 x 100 km, and 100 miles. The point-to-point course runs from Rothenburg ob der Tauber to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, or Gemünden and offers one of the most beautiful ultra-running routes in Germany. The race is IAU Bronze certified and measured, making it eligible for world records. In addition to the sporting experience, there is a runner dinner and organized return transports. High-quality functional shirts, caps, and multifunctional scarves are optionally available.
course_highlights: Point-to-point course from Rothenburg to Bad Mergentheim, Tauberbischofsheim, or Gemünden
IAU Bronze certification and measured routes over 50 km, 70 km, 100 km, and 100 miles
Beautiful landscape images along the route
additional: Runner dinner with lecture on Friday at 6:00 PM at Hotel Rappen (3-course buffet, vegetarian, no drinks). Return transports by buses from various destinations to Rothenburg at scheduled times. Accompanying persons can be brought under the same conditions. Qualification requirements for 100 km, 70 km, and 50 km distances are defined. High-quality functional shirts, sports caps, and multifunctional scarves (Buff) are optionally available, not included in the registration fee. The event is IAU accredited (Bronze for all distances), offers a scenic route, medals for finishers, and is known for its fast and attractive course. The event takes place over a long weekend, ideal for families and running enthusiasts.

name: Treiser Volkslauf
description: The Treiser Volkslauf takes place on October 3, 2026, for the 34th time in Staufenberg-Treis. The event is aimed at runners, walkers, and hikers of all performance levels and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a large cake buffet and delicious pea soup. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup, a popular running series in Hesse and the surrounding area. Registration opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result.
course_highlights: Participation in the Mittelhessen-Cup, a regional running series
Various routes for running, walking, and hiking
Large cake buffet and pea soup as refreshments
additional: Registration for the Volkslauf opens on August 1, 2026, via Race Result. There is a large cake buffet and pea soup for participants. The race is part of the Mittelhessen-Cup running series with multiple events in the region. The club also offers regular running and walking groups as well as beginner courses. Running, walking, and hiking event, community activities, refreshments including cake buffet and pea soup.

name: Volks - und Feuerwehrlauf Rhede
price_range: 2,00 EUR (zusätzliche Gebühr bei Voranmeldung bis Limit)
description: The People's and Fire Brigade Run Rhede is a traditional running event organized by the Rhede Fire Department. The event takes place annually and offers runners the opportunity to participate in a friendly and safe environment. The races start at the Rhede School Center and feature a varied course through the town. Participants receive material prizes for the top four finishers as well as certificates and live results available on-site and online.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Rhede School Center, Büssingstraße 14
Varied course through Rhede
Live results on monitors in the finish area and online
additional: Late registration is possible for a fee of 2.00 EUR until 30 minutes before the respective start. Registration on October 2nd from 18:00 to 19:00 and on October 3rd from 09:00 at the registration office. The use of MP3 players is prohibited for safety reasons. Baby joggers and dogs are not allowed. Material prizes for the top four finishers (male/female). Event at Rhede School Center, registration on October 2nd and 3rd, participation conditions include safety rules such as no MP3 players, strollers, or dogs, results available live and online.

name: Volkslauf SV Traisa
description: The Volkslauf of SV 1911 Traisa takes place annually on October 3rd at the sports field Traisa in Mühltal. The event offers runners a choice between an ambitious half marathon and a classic 11 km run. The course leads through the scenic surroundings and traditionally ends at a large cake table welcoming all participants. The run is a popular opportunity for sports enthusiasts of all ages to compete and enjoy the holiday together.
course_highlights: Half marathon and 11 km course options
Start and finish at the sports field Traisa
Scenic course with elevation profile
additional: The race takes place annually on October 3rd. The event concludes with a large cake table for all participants. The sports field Traisa is easily accessible by car, bus, and regional train. There are no explicit details about start waves or late registration fees on the website. The event begins at 9:00 AM for the main race and at 11:30 AM for the youth race. It is held at the sports field Traisa in Mühltal and is a convivial club race with a community character.

name: 4 Moore Ultratrail-Marathon
description: The 4 Moore Ultratrail Marathon is a non-commercial ultratrail landscape run over 53 kilometers around Langenhagen. The route passes through diverse moor and heath areas, including Kananoher Forest, Black Moor, Otternhagen Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Great Heath, and Bissendorf Moor. The course is unmarked and run via GPS navigation, with a final GPS track and a briefing sent via email beforehand. Three refreshment stations offer drinks and snacks, with participants required to carry their own drinking containers and cups. Participation is limited to 50 runners, with a time limit of 9 hours.
course_highlights: 53 km ultratrail through moors and heath areas near Langenhagen
Route passes through Kananoher Forest, Black Moor, Otternhagen Moor, Helstorfer Moor, Great Heath, and Bissendorf Moor
Unmarked course requiring GPS navigation with pre-provided track
additional: Maximum 50 participants. Time limit 9 hours. Three refreshment stations with cola, water, fruit, and snacks, some unmanned. Bring your own water bottle and cup. At the finish, coffee, cake, bratwurst, and drinks. Participants must be at least 18 years old. Participation at own risk, no liability from the organizer. Trail sections, GPS navigation, 3 refreshment stations, maximum 50 participants, 9-hour limit, start in Kaltenweide.

name: PUMA Třeboňský půl/maraton 10 a 5 km
description: The Třeboň Marathon, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km are races set in the unique natural environment of the Třeboňsko Protected Landscape Area. The routes are flat with minimal elevation gain, mostly on asphalt cycle paths and forest roads, allowing runners to achieve personal bests in a beautiful and peaceful setting. The race starts at the Renaissance square in Třeboň and passes through a historic gate into a nature reserve that is a candidate for UNESCO World Heritage status. The ideal date in October offers pleasant running weather and an inspiring atmosphere with professional pacemakers on the course.
course_highlights: Flat routes with minimal elevation gain in the protected natural area of Třeboňsko
Most of the course runs on asphalt cycle paths and quality forest roads
Start at the Renaissance square and pass through a historic gate into a UNESCO candidate nature reserve
additional: Registration allows for a refund of the entry fee until September 8, 2026, with an administrative fee of 150 CZK, transfer of the registration to another year until September 30, 2026, and after the race, the possibility to receive a voucher for running shoes worth 777 CZK. The race is limited in participant numbers and registration transfer to another runner is not possible. Included in the registration is a free 12-month subscription to the magazine Svět běhu. Routes are available for download in .GPX format. The race includes a half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km, supported by regional authorities, with the option to purchase gift vouchers. The event takes place in October 2026.

name: Run Berounka Run
location: Újezd u Svatého Kříže, Plzeň-sever, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 3,300 Kč za tým; 800 Kč pro jednotlivce v kategorii Ultra

description: Run Berounka Run is a relay race for teams and individuals, running along the Berounka River from Újezd u Svatého Kříže to Prague Radotín. The 130 km route is divided into 6 sections with a total elevation gain of over 3100 meters, mostly on forest and field paths. The race starts on October 3, 2026, at 5:00 AM in several waves, with the Ultra category starting on the evening of October 2. The race is intended for teams of 2 to 6 runners and individuals in the Ultra category, with winners announced in several categories and refreshments provided at the finish line.
course_highlights: 130 km route along the Berounka River divided into 6 sections
Total elevation gain of 3182 m, mainly on forest and field paths
Start in Újezd u Svatého Kříže, finish in Prague Radotín at the Říční Lázně kiosk
additional: Start takes place in waves from 5:00 AM, the Ultra category starts on October 2 at 8:00 PM and at midnight. The time limit for completing one section for teams is 4 hours. Each team receives a starter pack with bib numbers, a GPS chip, and gifts from sponsors. Mobile toilets are available at relay points. Refreshments are provided at the Říční Lázně kiosk at the finish. The maximum number of teams is 80, with up to 6 runners per team, and in the Ultra category, a maximum of 55 individuals. The race begins in Újezd u Svatého Kříže and ends in Prague Radotín, with registration open from November 1, 2025, to September 20, 2026. The Ultra category starts on Friday evening. The route mainly runs on forest and field paths with a total elevation gain of 3182 meters.

name: 24DS (24 Dlouhé Stráně)
location: Kouty nad Desnou, Jeseníky, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné je stanoveno na 900,- Kč / účastník

description: The 24DS is a 24-hour endurance challenge in the unique environment of the Hrubý Jeseník mountains, leading from Kouty nad Desnou to the upper reservoir of the Dlouhé Stráně pumped-storage hydroelectric plant. The race offers stunning views of the Jeseníky and combines daytime and nighttime running with sunrise and sunset. The route is demanding, with an elevation gain of 820 meters and 90% trail surface, suitable for individuals and pairs. The Kouty nad Desnou area provides comfortable facilities including restaurants, accommodation, and parking.
course_highlights: 14.7 km loop with an elevation gain of 820 m
90% trail surface
Views from the upper reservoir of Dlouhé Stráně at an altitude of 1354 m above sea level
additional: Registration runs from May 1, 2026, to August 30, 2026, or until capacity is reached. Each participant must have a GPS tracker, which is activated on race day during check-in. The start package includes a voucher for a cable car ride to view the route. Participants can switch in pairs at will. It is mandatory to follow the rules and have a functioning mobile phone on the route. The organizer provides map materials and marks the route with white spray paint and yellow flags. At the finish line, it is necessary to submit the chip and GPS tracker. The race takes place on October 3, 2026, offers nearby accommodation options, and is associated with supporting the MORAVA FLOW projects.

name: Běh kolem Hejtmanu
location: Chlum u Třeboně, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hejtman Run is a traditional sporting event held in Chlum u Třeboně in the Třeboň region, always on the second Saturday of October. The main race is a 10 km run with a time limit of 1 hour and 20 minutes, taking place on local roads and dikes of ponds in a picturesque environment. The race is open to the public and takes place amidst regular road traffic with an emphasis on safety and adherence to rules. Shorter races are prepared for children and youth up to 15 years old, with presentations directly on site on the day of the race. The organizer is TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně, z.s.
course_highlights: The route of the main race passes over the dike of Hejtman Pond and Staňkovský Pond dike
The race takes place on local roads with scenic views of Třeboňsko
Start and finish are at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium
additional: Registration for competitors takes place on the day of the race from 8:30 to 10:15 at the TJ Jiskra Chlum u Třeboně stadium, where race numbers and chips for the 10 km main race are issued. Participants run at their own risk and must follow traffic rules. For younger competitors up to 18 years old, accompaniment by a legal guardian or a declaration is required. The race is conducted on local roads and a shale track, with registration possible on-site and online. The start is within the stadium area. The races are open to all age groups with different distance options.

name: ČEZ RunTour Praha
distance_verbose: Maraton, Půlmaraton, 10 km, 5 km, 1 km, 0.5 km
description: CEZ RunTour Prague is a family running race offering courses for hobby runners and elites in lengths of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, including children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Ladronka Park and is part of a nationwide series of eight unique locations. Organizers emphasize perfect service, safety, and fun for the whole family, including an accompanying program and a charitable aspect. Each participant receives a start package and has the opportunity to contribute to charity through their participation.
course_highlights: Courses of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km in Ladronka Park
Children's runs of 500 and 1000 meters
Perfect service including guides and medical team
additional: On the course, there are guides, a medical team, and refreshment stations (1 at 5 and 10 km, at least 2 at the half marathon). Each runner receives a gymsack with gifts, children receive a start package from Lidl. There is a children's zone, warm-up sessions for children, and an accompanying program for families. A special emergency phone line is available for the race. More courses, family activities, charitable support, medals, photographs, refreshments, and facilities for participants.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place on the first Saturday of every month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. At the finish line, each participant is rewarded with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: Precisely measured asphalt track of 3.2 km (2 miles)
The course mostly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone
Children's course is 800 m long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years old. Time is recorded for each runner, and the top three places in men's, women's, and children's categories receive small prizes. The recommended access to the start is by bicycle, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus no. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). Regular monthly race, 3.2 km course, road surface, running for all age groups, children's course 800 m, with options to arrive by bike, car, or trolleybus no. 11.

name: Běh na Čerťák
location: Flemmichova zahrada, Rýmařov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma pro děti do 14 let, 150 Kč pro ostatní při online přihlášení, 200 Kč při prezenci na místě

price_tiers.distance: všechny kategorie mimo děti do 14 let

description: The Čerťák Run is a traditional race organized by AK Běžci z Rýmařova, held at the Flemmichovi Garden area in Rýmařov. The race offers routes for various age categories from preschoolers to seniors, with the main trail passing through forest paths and the summit of Kamenná Hora. The start is at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area, and the course includes running on field roads, meadows, and forest trails with beautiful views. After the race, refreshments and results announcements are provided at the SKI area. The race is part of the Great Prize of endurance runners of the Olomouc Region, and winners in categories receive material prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the SKI Flemmichova Garden area
Run over the summit of Kamenná Hora (799 m above sea level) with Čerťák's swinging bridge
Forest and field roads with beautiful views
additional: Registration at the SKI area facilities in Flemdě from 9:30 to 10:30. Men’s categories D, E, and all women run a shortened course. After the race, refreshments: beer, soft drinks, coffee, tea. Results are announced at the SKI area after all competitors have finished. The course includes forest paths and meadows, online registration until October 3, 2025, start at the SKI area in Flemdě. The race takes place on October 3, 2026.

name: Benešovská osmička
location: Benešov u Semil, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Benešovská osmička is a traditional cross-country race in Benešov u Semil, which has been held for over half a century. The race offers courses for the whole family, from preschool children to veterans, with the main race covering 8,000 meters through picturesque countryside around the village and on the slopes of Benešov Hill. The start and facilities are located in the sports complex in Horní Benešov. Prizes and light refreshments are prepared for all participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Main course of 8,000 m mainly runs through meadows, field and forest paths of varying quality
Children's courses run on asphalt within the area
Surroundings of the village and slopes of Benešov Hill (567 m above sea level)
additional: Registration and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. The race is divided into categories: preschool children (50 and 100 m), pupils (400 - 1200 m), youth, women, men, veterans (courses of 2,250 m and 8,000 m). The top three finishers in each category will receive material prizes. Light refreshments are available for participants and spectators. Various courses from 50 m to 8 km, family event, refreshments, material prizes.

name: Běh města Příbrami
price_range: dospělí - předem 200 Kč, na místě 300 Kč; štafety - předem 400 Kč, na místě 600 Kč; děti a studenti zdarma; rodinné startovné 200 Kč
description: The Příbram City Run is a traditional running race held for the 32nd time in the picturesque environment of Nový Rybník in Příbram. The race offers various categories including the main 10 km race, relays, and children's runs, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The event is suitable for families, students, and individuals who want to enjoy a sports day with a friendly atmosphere. Start times and registration are adjusted for each category to ensure everything runs smoothly and organized.
course_highlights: Main 10 km race in the natural environment of Nový Rybník
Categories for children, adults, family and student relays
Traditional race with over thirty years of history
additional: Registration from 8:00 to 10:30 for children, from 10:30 to 11:00 for adults. The school category starts at 9:00, the main 10 km race and relays start at 11:30. Conditions for family relays require a familial relationship, student relays must be composed of students from elementary, secondary, or university schools with possible status verification at registration. Start from 8:00, the main 10 km race begins at 11:30, registration from 8:00 to 10:30, various categories including relays and children.

name: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run
location: Liberec, Jizerské hory, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Mattoni Liberec Trail Run is an outdoor race that offers runners the chance to escape the city hustle and enjoy running through forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains. The race is the final event of the season and takes place through the woods, around the dam, through a granite quarry, and back. Runners can choose between a shorter 12 km route and a longer 22 km route, allowing them to test their strength in beautiful natural scenery.
course_highlights: Forest trails of the Jizerské Mountains
Running around the dam
Passing through a granite quarry
additional: The race takes place on October 3, 2026, with staggered starts from 10:00 to 12:15. There are two routes available: 12 km and 22 km. The event includes an accompanying program and a virtual package. It is part of the RunCzech running league and is in its ninth edition with approximately 2000 participants. The terrain includes forest trails, and the race offers various categories. Registration is possible via a code, and the race map is available in JPG/PNG and GPX formats. Family races are also part of the event.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - říjen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race for all age groups and running levels, whether running for fun, aiming to improve personal bests, or just enjoying a pleasant run in a beautiful park. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park, with adults running two laps (3.2 km) and children under 12 running one lap (1.6 km). After the race, everyone is rewarded with a warm cinnamon pancake. The race is part of the year-round Pancake Cup, which encourages regular participation and performance reflection.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km)
After the race, a warm cinnamon pancake for all participants
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of pre-registration online for faster check-in. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Categories are divided by age and gender, with times measured for each participant and results published online. Adjusted times based on age coefficient count towards the Pancake Cup. The 3.2 km course starts in Stromovka Park, with pre-registration available and on-site registration. The race is suitable for all age groups and running levels.
