description: SILESIA cross 1/2 marathon is a traditional cross-country running race held in Opava-Kylešovice with the center at the U Chovatelů area. The race offers courses of 21 km and 13 km, which pass through scenic locations such as Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava. The course is challenging and partially runs on roads with full traffic, requiring participants to follow fair-play rules and respect nature. Timing is measured electronically without chips, and the results are announced at the finish area. The race is canceled for 2026, but information about previous editions and courses is available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Raduň, Vršovice, Chvalíkovice, Hradec nad Moravicí, Branka, and Opava
The race takes place on roads with full traffic, with electronic timing without chips
Course adjustments due to fenced private land; the 21 km course does not lead to Radun Castle
additional: Participant registration takes place at the race center on Friday from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday from 7:30 to 9:00. The start is at the playground behind the elementary school in Raduň, with the finish at the U Chovatelů area in Opava-Kylešovice. The race occurs on roads with full traffic; participants run at their own risk. Timing is electronic without chips. Due to a small number of participants in the short courses, the 750 m, 1500 m, 3 km, and 5 km races start directly at the finish area. The course is marked year-round, with additional portable signage and course officials. Entry fees increase from October 1, 2025, to 350 CZK for 21 km, 250 CZK for 13 km, and 150 CZK for shorter distances. If the fee is paid by September 26, participants can have a start number with their name. Registration usually takes place in October. The event offers various courses and is known for its specific cross-country terrain. In the past, course changes occurred due to private land.

name: Běh zámeckým parkem
location: Zámecký park ve Vlašimi, Vlašim, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Castle Park Run is a running race held in the picturesque environment of Vlašim Castle Park. The course, 8.4 km long, combines trail and asphalt sections, offering runners a diverse experience. The race is organized by Atletika Vlašim, z.s., and is part of the official Czech Running calendar. The event is suitable for runners who want to experience running in a beautiful park with a historic atmosphere.
course_highlights: Course runs through Vlašim Castle Park
Combination of trail and asphalt sections
Course length of 8.4 km
additional: The race is part of a running series and offers various course lengths, including trail and asphalt sections.

name: Z(a)tracené vrchy
description: Z(a)tracené vrchy is an adrenaline-filled orienteering-beer running-walking-crawling race in teams, held in the picturesque terrain of Bordovice in the Moravian-Silesian Region. Participants must complete the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on their back, complete mini-games at stations, and drink beer at the stations. The race combines physical challenge with team cooperation and fun, with the route passing through varied terrain with ascents and descents. The winning team receives a traveling trophy and gift packages. The event is intended for adults over 18 years old and emphasizes safety and participant responsibility.
course_highlights: The route passes through varied terrain with ascents and descents
Completing the course with a 10-liter beer barrel on the back
Five control stations with mini-games and beer consumption
additional: Mandatory equipment includes a charged phone, a tap (bayonet), a pump, a barrel harness, a trash bag, and a headlamp. Recommended equipment is a basic first aid kit, water, and nutritious food. Beer may only be consumed at control stations, where it is served from a single competition container with a maximum of 0.5 liters. The start of barrel distribution is from 7:30 to 7:35 at the start location. The race is intended for participants over 18 years old who sign a declaration of personal responsibility. The use of transportation devices other than trekking poles is prohibited. The event is part of the ultratrail series, with results from 2024 available, and is aimed at experienced runners seeking a challenge in demanding terrain.

name: Běh Pístovickou riviérou
location: Pístovice, Vyškov, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Pístovická Riviera Run is a traditional cross-country race held on forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera in Pístovice near Vyškov. The race is open to all enthusiasts of healthy movement, from children to adults, and takes place in all weather conditions. The course is uneven, with possible puddles and mud, and includes running and walking uphill and downhill. The organizers from the Vyškov Ski Club warmly invite competitors and spectators to participate and support sports in the region.
course_highlights: Forest paths above the recreational area Pístovická Riviera
Uneven terrain with potential puddles and mud
Cross-country character with runs uphill and downhill
additional: The course is not closed, participants must follow the organizers' instructions. The race takes place regardless of weather, only extreme conditions may cause postponement or cancellation. Runners under 15 years must be accompanied by a person over 18 years old, participants under 18 must have written consent from a legal guardian. A bib number is mandatory and must be visibly worn on the chest. The use of skates, bikes, trekking poles, and shortening the course is prohibited. The race is open to all age groups, offering a rich program, refreshments, and activities for children. The event is supported by the town of Vyškov and Lesy České republiky, s.p.

name: Cibulka - Košířský okruh
description: Cibulka - Košířský okruh is a popular running race held in the Prague district of Košíře, offering a course approximately 4.5 km long. This race is part of a series of local running events and is suitable for both recreational runners and those looking to improve their performance in a natural environment. The course runs through forest paths and trails around the Cibulka lookout tower, providing a pleasant and varied setting for running. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels, emphasizing the joy of movement in nature.
course_highlights: Course approximately 4.5 km long with forest paths and trails
Natural environment around the Cibulka lookout tower in Prague 5
Opportunity to participate as a recreational or competitive runner
additional: The race takes place in Prague 5-Košíře, with the start near the bus stop 'U lesíka'.

name: Běh za bořetickým burčákem
price_range: 150 Kč / 6 EUR pro hlavní závod, zdarma pro mládežnické kategorie
description: Run for Bořetice Burčák is a traditional sporting event held in the picturesque wine-growing village of Bořetice in the heart of the Blue Mountains. The run offers participants the opportunity to experience beautiful scenery with vineyards and wine cellars, which are characteristic of this South Moravian region. The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic and is part of the village's rich cultural calendar. The run is scheduled to start in the afternoon of October 3, 2026, at Sóla near the cultural house.
course_highlights: The route passes through picturesque wine-growing landscapes of Bořetice and Kraví Hora
Surroundings of wine cellars and fertile vineyards
Start and finish at the cultural house in Bořetice
additional: The event is organized by the Cultural Committee of Bořetice, SDH Bořetice, and the Kraví Hora Republic. The race starts at Sóla near the cultural house. Bořetice offers a rich cultural and sports program, complemented by other events throughout the year. The race includes running on asphalt, registration begins at 13:20, there is a bouncy castle for children, and after the race, participants can taste burčák and local specialties.

name: ING Biegnij Warszawo
description: ING Run Warsaw is one of the most recognizable running events in Poland, attracting thousands of participants to the heart of the capital every year. The race takes place on the first Saturday of October and offers a 10-kilometer route through the most characteristic places of Warsaw. The FUNRUN formula emphasizes the joy of movement, without pressure or competition, encouraging running, walking, or jogging at your own pace. Along the route, participants are supported by music zones, cheerleaders, and motivating partner points, and each participant receives a commemorative Nike Dri-FIT shirt and a medal at the finish line.
course_highlights: 10 km route through the most atmospheric and characteristic places of Warsaw
Music zones and cheerleaders along the entire route
Hydration zone at the halfway point and comprehensive medical support
additional: The start package includes a Nike Dri-FIT shirt with a commemorative print, a start number with a chip for timing, gifts from partners, and a commemorative medal. Package pickup is available at Legia Sports Bar at Legia Warsaw Stadium from September 29 to October 3, 2026, with a recommendation for early collection. Drivers using catering services receive 2 hours of free parking. The route is certified by PZLA and is friendly for beginner runners. The event attracts over 6,000 participants, and the route has been changed to the right bank of the Vistula River, with significant involvement from ING employees and a charity collection.

name: XIII Podbieg na Makowicę
location: Rytro, Nowy Sącz County, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th Makowica Ascent is a mountain race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on October 3, 2026, in Rytro, Lesser Poland. The race route features a challenging profile with ascents, making it an excellent challenge for runners who enjoy mountain trails. Organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to various skill levels. The event is part of the TreningBiegacza.pl running calendar, which promotes running activity and supports runners in their preparations.
course_highlights: Mountain trail of 10 km
Challenging ascents on the route
Scenic views around Rytro
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. Organizers encourage using the TreningBiegacza.pl platform, which offers support in preparations and managing race information. The event focuses on trail running, and registration details have not yet been announced. The race is an opportunity to spend active time in the beautiful surroundings of Rytro.

name: 14. Burgdorfer Spargel-Lauf
price_range: Kinder: 5 €, 2.500 m-Lauf: 8 €, 5.000 m-Lauf: 10 €, 10.000 m-Lauf: 12 €, Nordic Walking: 10 €
description: The Burgdorf Asparagus Run is an annual running event held as part of the Oktobermarkt city festival in Burgdorf. On October 4, 2026, the 14th edition of this popular event will take place, welcoming hobby runners of all ages. The courses run along the Aue river and through the city center, starting and finishing at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße. The event offers races over 2.5 km, 5 km, 10 km, as well as Nordic walking and a children's run.
course_highlights: Course along the Aue river and through the city center of Burgdorf
Start and finish at the Auebrücke Poststraße / Braunschweiger Straße
Children's run over 660 meters through central streets of Burgdorf
additional: Timing is done electronically via chip at the start number. Online certificates are available for all participants. Late registration on the day of the event from 12:30 to 13:30 with an additional fee of €4 is possible. Parking options include the train station, Schützenplatz, and Rathaus II. The award ceremony takes place at the Auebrücke after the main races. The run takes place in all weather conditions. The course runs through Burgdorf along the Aue, castle, and city park; registration is open until October 2, 2024; parking is available nearby.

name: 23. Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The 23rd Central German Marathon on October 4, 2026, offers a unique running experience through the Central German metropolitan region with start in Leipzig and finish in Halle (Saale). The course passes through two federal states and two cities, starting at the Sportforum in Leipzig and ending in the over 1,200-year-old cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, Salzwirkerlauf, and the AOK Schnupperlauf. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural highlights and green running routes in the Handel city.
course_highlights: Start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz
Course through two federal states and two cities
Run through the green lungs of the Handel city and the city center of Halle
additional: Start and finish at different locations: start in Leipzig at Sportforum, finish in Halle at Marktplatz. Various disciplines including relay and walking. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. Distribution of start documents takes place in Leipzig. The event combines sporting challenge with cultural and scenic highlights. Multiple distances, start and finish in Halle - Marktplatz as well as Leipzig - Elsterflutbecken; routes are still subject to approval. The weather in October is usually mild with temperatures around 14°C.

name: 26. Generali Köln Marathon
organizer: Kölner Marathon Veranstaltungs- und Werbe GmbH
description: The Generali Cologne Marathon is a unique running experience that combines top-level and recreational sports with carnival, folk festival, and running festival. The course takes runners through lively Cologne neighborhoods such as Rodenkirchen, Lindenthal, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes, ending spectacularly at Cologne Cathedral. With up to 15,000 participants, the marathon offers an exhilarating atmosphere supported by thousands of spectators along the route. The event also emphasizes sustainability and features a diverse accompanying program.
course_highlights: Start in Deutz at Ottoplatz with a panoramic view of Cologne Cathedral and the Old Town
Passage three times at Rudolfplatz with strong spectator support
Course through diverse districts such as Südstadt, Ehrenfeld, and Nippes
additional: The marathon starts in Deutz at Ottoplatz and includes multiple transition zones for relay and school marathons. There are 11 refreshment stations during the marathon and 6 during the half marathon. The event is limited to 15,000 participants for the marathon. The course passes well-known Cologne sights and districts, with the finish line at Cologne Cathedral. The event emphasizes sustainability and offers a diverse program with carnival and running festival. Registration is open, with various race disciplines, limited starting spots, special competitions for students, and a sustainable event.

name: Apfellauf 2026

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr: 19 Euro inklusive Getränke und einem Snack.

description: The Apple Run 2026 will take place on October 4th in Mössingen-Laubuseschbach and offers runners a scenic route through orchards, forest and field paths, as well as on a closed state road. The start and finish are located on the premises of the Heil Cider Mill. Two distances are offered: 5 kilometers (one lap) and 10 kilometers (two laps). The race is open to professional and recreational athletes as well as teams competing together. There is a free children's run for kids up to 9 years old.
course_highlights: Route passes by orchards
Forest and field paths as well as a closed state road L3063
Return route along the bike path to Laubuseschbach
additional: The 5 km run starts at 10:00 AM, the 10 km run at 10:15 AM. There is a free children's run for kids up to 9 years old at 12:00 PM. Teams consist of at least 8 people with at least 2 runners on each distance. The two fastest runners of each route are counted for the team ranking. Finisher shirts could only be ordered until May 15, 2026. Race takes place in a scenic environment, registration until June 11, 2026, finisher shirt offer until May 15, 2026, team and children's runs.

name: Bayerische Halbmarathon-Meisterschaften
location: Auf dem Westring, near Linde MH Arena, Aschaffenburg, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Bavarian Half Marathon Championships will take place on October 4, 2026, in Aschaffenburg on Westring near the Linde MH Arena. The event is organized by TV Haibach and is open to active and masters athletes from Lower Franconia, Bavarian Lower Main, North Bavaria, and all of Bavaria. The championship offers runners the opportunity to compete on an official half marathon course and to win Bavarian championship titles. Online registration is possible until September 22, 2026.
course_highlights: Half marathon course on Westring in Aschaffenburg
Start and finish near the Linde MH Arena
Event as part of the Bavarian State Championships
additional: Registration deadline is September 22, 2026, online registrations are accepted until 11:59 PM. The event is classified as a state championship (category 6.4.3). No information is provided about start times or prize categories on the website. Registration closes on September 22, 2026; location is on Westring near the Linde MH Arena; category: State Championships

name: Boitzer Herbstlauf
description: The Boitzer Autumn Run is a local autumn race with walking in Walsrode, Lower Saxony, organized by the sports club SV Kirchboitzen. The event will take place in 2026 for the 19th time as an in-person event and is open to runners and walkers of all ages. Participants will receive the most important information directly on-site from the organizing team. Additional practical tips will be provided by SV Kirchboitzen.
course_highlights: Distances: 800 m and 14 km
Typical October weather with about 14 °C and mostly cloudy
Event in the Walsrode region, Lower Saxony
additional: The event is a local club race with walking. The most important info is given on-site by the organizing team, with further details provided by SV Kirchboitzen. It is recommended to check the event details with the organizer before registration. The event takes place in autumn weather with temperatures around 6-14°C, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. It is aimed at runners and walkers who want to enjoy the autumn atmosphere.

name: Büdelsdorfer Eiderlauf
description: The Büdelsdorf Eiderlauf is a traditional autumn race in Büdelsdorf, Schleswig-Holstein, organized by SG Athletico Büdelsdorf. It offers classic local road race distances, including 5 km and 10 km, which are flat and easily manageable, making them ideal for hobby runners and beginners. The start and finish are often located at the Eiderstadion, giving the event a family-friendly and straightforward atmosphere. The race attracts children, teenagers, and local club runners and is a regular part of the regional running scene in autumn.
course_highlights: Flat road race distances
Start and finish at Eiderstadion
Family-friendly and local club race
additional: The race takes place in typical October weather with approximately 14°C daytime temperature and mostly cloudy skies. There are various distances from 1.5 km to 11.1 km, including children's races. After a Corona break, the procedure was adjusted to incorporate the start and finish at the stadium. Distances: 1.5 km, 5.3 km, 5.8 km, 10.9 km, 11.1 km; flat routes; event in autumn; start and finish at the stadium; participation open to all age groups.

name: Cottbuser Oktoberlauf
description: The Cottbus October Run is a traditional race event held at the Cottbus Sports Center in the athletics stadium and mainly in the forest on solid paths and bike paths. The event offers various distances from 400 meters up to the half marathon (21.1 km), with partly paved and unpaved routes. There are special races for children and adolescents with obstacles and varied course sections. Participants receive a commemorative medal and can download certificates online. The event is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup and offers trophies and material prizes for the best runners in different age groups.
course_highlights: Courses at the Cottbus Sports Center with start and finish in the athletics stadium
Forest passages with solid paths and bike paths, partly unpaved routes
Refreshment points at the Spree Bridge on the longer distances
additional: Timing is done with an ankle transponder, which must be returned after the race (20 EUR fee in case of loss). The bib number must be visibly worn on the chest. Trophies, certificates, and material prizes are awarded for age groups and overall finishes. Changes to the courses for 5 km, 10.5 km, and 21.1 km should be noted. Late registrations are possible online until October 3, 2025, and on-site until one hour before the start. The race starts at 10:50 AM, participation is part of the Sparkassen Run and Walking Cup, online registration is available, with various categories including children and toddler runs.

name: Gaudilauf 14
organizer: Lauf- und Walkingverein 05 Bad Liebenwerda e.V.
description: The Gaudilauf is a traditional race taking place on October 4, 2026, in Bad Liebenwerda. The route runs from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda back to Munich and offers a scenic course along the Elster. The race is characterized by a friendly atmosphere, where competitive spirit is secondary. Refreshments are provided every 5 kilometers, and at the finish line, participants can enjoy a cozy celebration with drinks and grilled food. A bus transfer from the finish back to the start is available upon request.
course_highlights: Race route from Munich via Bad Liebenwerda and back
Refreshments approximately every 5 kilometers with drinks and apples
Finish with a Maß beer or other drink and a festival tent with grilled food
additional: Number bibs are issued at the respective starting locations until the start time. Bus transfer from Munich to Bad Liebenwerda is possible upon registration (departure around 9:10 AM). Luggage transfer from the start to the finish is offered. Free entry to the festival tent on race day, grilled food for a small fee. Due to current circumstances, the start from Schweinfurth has been canceled. 14 km run/hike, registration via email, bus transfer from Munich, no official timing.

name: Gaudilauf 27
description: The Munich-BaLi-Munich, formerly known as Gaudilauf, is a 27 km road race in Munich, Germany. The race typically takes place in early October with a start in the morning. The event is organized by LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda, indicating a club-organized race with a modest number of participants, fewer than 100 runners. The event offers good organization and value for money, although the course is rated as average in scenic quality.
course_highlights: 27 km road race in Munich
Start in the morning in early October
Small field of participants under 100 runners
additional: The race is organized by the club LWV 05 Bad Liebenwerda. The number of participants is small, with only a few finishers recently. The weather in October is typically cool and cloudy, with an average of 14°C during the day and 6°C at night, and about 40 mm of precipitation. 27 km road race, early October, small participant field, registration via website, scenic course with an average rating.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Autumn Run in Ovenhausen is a traditional race event organized annually on the first Sunday in October by TuS Ovenhausen. The event offers various courses for different age and performance groups, including a challenging 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains as well as shorter runs for young athletes. The race features a diverse route with sections on bike paths, in the Grube Stadium, and in the forest. It is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes and usually takes place in pleasant autumn weather.
course_highlights: 20.8 km tour through forests and mountains near Ovenhausen
Sections on bike paths and in the Grube Stadium
Forest run with varied terrain
additional: The race traditionally takes place on the first Sunday in October. There are various age groups and distances, including a 1,000m run for children and a 4.5 km run, which is also counted as the district championship in cross-country running. The event is organized by TuS Ovenhausen, which works closely with HLC Höxter. Runs on forest paths, district championships, distances from 1 km to 20.8 km, start and finish locations only visible with RUNME Premium.

name: Herbstlauf Ready4Run Niederwangen
description: The Autumn Run Niederwangen takes place annually on October 4, 2026, and is part of the Voralpen VBAO Cup. The race offers a quarter marathon distance and is known for its attractive cup ranking, with the overall victory ceremony held during the Autumn Run. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and is a regular feature of regional running events.
course_highlights: Quarter marathon distance
Part of the Voralpen VBAO Cup with overall ranking
Attractive race route in Niederwangen
additional: The Autumn Run is part of the VBAO Cup, which does not have minimum participation requirements or discard results. The overall victory ceremony takes place during the Autumn Run in Niederwangen. The event occurs in October in Wangen im Allgäu, with various categories including children and youth runs. Registration is online, and the event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a sporting competitive spirit.

name: IRT - Läufermeeting
location: Industriepark Region Trier, Föhren, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The IRT Running Meeting takes place annually in early October at the premises of the Trier Region Industrial Park (IRT) in Föhren. The event offers super flat, very fast, and officially DLV-measured courses that are ideal for personal best times. Disciplines offered include 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km for children and adolescents. Net time measurement is used for all races except the Bambini race, with a single-use bib with an integrated transponder. Changing and shower facilities are available at the nearby Föhren elementary school.
course_highlights: Super flat, very fast, and officially DLV-measured courses
Event held on the premises of the Trier Region Industrial Park (IRT)
Net time measurement with single-use bib and integrated transponder
additional: Late registrations on the day of the event are possible on-site until at least one hour before the start of each discipline for an additional fee (Bambini and children’s races free of charge). Bib number distribution on the day of the event on-site until 5 minutes before the start. Changing and shower facilities are approximately 3 km away at Föhren elementary school. Toilets are available in the start/finish area. The event takes place annually in early October, with online registration via Chiplauf. It offers an excellent opportunity for runners to achieve personal best times and participate in regional competitions.

name: Kalbsvilla Run
organizer: Motor Presse Hamburg GmbH & Co. KG Verlagsgesellschaft
description: The Kalbsvilla Run takes place in Ortenberg, Hesse, with the historic Kalbsvilla at Am Mühltor serving as the start and finish area. Various distances are offered, including a 5 km run, a 10 km run, a half marathon, and 5 km Nordic walking. Additionally, there are races for toddlers, children, and teenagers, making the event family-friendly. Timing is done electronically via transponder through Race Result, and the event supports a good cause as a charity run.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Kalbsvilla at Am Mühltor
Various distances from 5 km to half marathon
Family-friendly races for toddlers, children, and teenagers
additional: Timing via transponder through Race Result; bibs and timing are organized in a tent near the finish line; Charity Run character The event is characterized by an inspiring atmosphere, pacers for the half marathon, and a scenic environment. It is an event suitable for both ambitious runners and families.

name: Luftschifflauf
location: Flughafen Essen/Mülheim, Essen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The TURCK Airship Run at Essen/Mülheim Airport offers a unique running experience on the airport's runway. The flat, fast course without tight turns or elevation changes is ideal for personal bests. The highlight is the spectacular finish inside the impressive WDL airship hangar, making the race an unforgettable event. The family-friendly event includes various distances for children, teenagers, and adults and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course on the airport's runway
Spectacular finish inside the WDL airship hangar
Loop courses around the airship hangar with wide taxiways
additional: Start times staggered: 11:30 AM for children’s runs, 1:00 PM for youth and community run, 1:30 PM for 4x2.5 km relay and 10 km run. A total of 1500 starting places. Re-registrations are possible up to 15 minutes before the respective start. The event takes place in all weather conditions, cancellation only in case of storm warnings. Family-friendly event with on-site catering. Race on airport runway, family-friendly, children’s run, on-site catering, online registration, in all weather, parking outside the premises.

name: Mitteldeutscher Marathon
description: The Central German Marathon is a special running experience in the heart of Germany, connecting the Central German metropolitan region on a fast course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale). The classic marathon route, where the first German marathon was held in 1925, runs from the Bach city of Leipzig to the cultural capital Halle. In addition to the marathon, there are other disciplines such as the Handellauf half marathon, the half marathon relay, 10 km run, 10 km walk, and the Salzwirkerlauf. The event offers a diverse program and is suitable for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Fast marathon course between Leipzig and Halle (Saale)
Start in the Bach city of Leipzig, finish in the cultural capital Halle
Run through one of Germany's greenest cities
additional: For the marathon, there are pacemakers for target times of 3:30, 3:45, 4:00, and 4:15 hours. The bib number includes a ticket from the Central German Transport Association for a free one-way or return trip on the event day between Halle and Leipzig within the respective fare zones. Split times must be adhered to; otherwise, disqualification will occur. Race documents can be collected at various registration offices. Late registrations and re-registrations are possible. The event includes various race types, starts in Halle and Leipzig, and offers a varied route through the Central German region with villages, forests, and floodplains.

name: Soester Stadtlauf
price_range: abhängig von der Distanz (Infos im Anmeldeportal)
description: Experience the traditional Soester City Run, a sporting highlight for young and old in the historic city center of Soest. Whether casual runners, ambitious athletes, or families - together, the day becomes an unforgettable event with a unique atmosphere along the course. The event offers various race distances, an attractive supporting program, and catering for all participants and guests.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the heart of the historic old town
Atmospheric run through the Soest city center
Moderation, music, and catering along the route
additional: Race distances: Bambini runs 475m (start 12:00), school runs 950m (ages 2016-2018, start 12:45) and 1450m (ages 2006-2015, start 14:15), main runs 4km (start 15:00) and 10km (start 15:45). Parking at the outskirts with shuttle service. Beverage and snack stands for participants and guests. Attractive family program and moderation on site. Various race distances, start and finish in the heart of the old town, catering, shuttle service, award ceremony immediately after the races.

name: TrailRUN21
location: Zell am Harmersbach, Ortenaukreis, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The TrailRUN21 in Zell am Harmersbach is a challenging trail running competition in the Black Forest, taking place on October 4, 2026. There are two main distances: the TrailRUN21 with 20.3 km and 710 meters of elevation gain, and the TrailRUN Light with 10.3 km and 390 meters of elevation gain, ideal for beginners. The course is well marked and passes through varied terrain, appealing to both experienced trail runners and newcomers. The race is organized by TV 1898 Unterharmersbach e.V. and emphasizes environmental protection, for example by not providing disposable cups at aid stations.
course_highlights: TrailRUN21: 20.3 km with 710 meters of elevation gain
TrailRUN Light: 10.3 km with 390 meters of elevation gain, ideal for beginners
Courses are well marked with white (TrailRUN21) and blue arrows (TrailRUN Light)
additional: No disposable cups at aid stations; a collapsible cup is recommended (a foldable cup can be ordered for €3 during registration). No late registrations accepted. Age group rankings and separate races for school classes. Organizer: TV 1898 Unterharmersbach e.V. The event takes place on October 4, 2026, with registration already open. It also includes the German Mountain Running Championship 2024 and other championships.

name: UNO URBAN CROSS LAUF
description: The UNO Urban Cross is an urban obstacle race taking place right in the heart of Saarbrücken city center on October 4, 2026. The course spans from 2.5 km to 10 km and features numerous creative obstacles such as scaffolding, tire stacks, cable drums, and hay bales. The race offers a true city adventure for individual and team runners and is supported by Lord Mayor Uwe Conradt. The event promises fun, challenge, and excitement in a unique urban environment.
course_highlights: Course through Saarbrücken city center with new route over Karstadt parking garage, Bahnhofstraße, and Berliner Promenade
Over 200 steps and numerous creative obstacles such as scaffolding, tire stacks, boxing ring, and hay bales
Four distances: 2.5 km sprint cross, 5 km short cross, 7.5 km main cross (3 laps), 10 km main cross (4 laps)
additional: Race packets can be picked up on October 2, 2026, from 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM at Karstadt Saarbrücken or on the event day from 8:30 AM to 10:30 AM at the start/finish area. No changing facilities available on site. Clothing bags can be deposited and retrieved. Entry fee will not be refunded in case of cancellation but will be donated to LAZ Saarbrücken. A discount of 4 EUR applies for individual runs. Course length ranges from 2.5 km to 10 km, obstacles located in the city center, registration possible.

name: OLFINCAR HRADECKÝ PŮL/MARATON
location: Malšovický stadion, Hradec Králové, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: OLFINCAR Hradecký Half Marathon is the largest sporting event in Eastern Bohemia, held since 2013. The race offers certified routes including a marathon, half marathon, relay race, 10 km run, and children's races. The course is among the fastest in the Czech Republic and is considered one of the most beautiful city routes. In 2026, the race will also host the Czech Republic Veteran Half Marathon Championship and the Czech Republic Rescue and Security Forces Half Marathon Championship. The facilities of the new football arena in the city center provide comfortable services for participants.
course_highlights: Certified routes with a fast profile
Course among the fastest in the Czech Republic
Facilities of the new football arena in the center of Hradec Králové
additional: Start times: 11:15 AM (marathon), 12:30 PM (half marathon and 10 km), 12:40 PM (charity run). Facilities include changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, catering, parking, and clothing sales. The starter pack includes an original medal, a gift, a start number, and an electronic chip for timing. Refreshments are provided during the race and at the finish line. Photos and diplomas are available for download (not guaranteed for everyone). There is an accompanying program and prizes for 1st-3rd place in categories. Races include half marathon, marathon, 10 km run, and children's races, with a limit of 3,500 runners, chip timing, and certified routes.

name: Horský běh Alfrédka - Memoriál Miroslava Čermáka
location: Stará Ves u Rýmařova, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Alfrédka Mountain Run - Miroslav Čermák Memorial is a race mainly run on forest paths, covering a distance of 13.6 km with an elevation gain of 430 meters. The race is part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup. It offers a challenging route in the beautiful nature of the Moravian-Silesian Region, which will delight mountain running and endurance discipline enthusiasts. The race takes place in Stará Ves u Rýmařova and is suitable for experienced runners seeking a terrain challenge.
course_highlights: Distance of 13.6 km mainly on forest paths
Elevation gain of 430 m
Part of the Great Prize of Runners of the Olomouc Region and the Czech Mountain Running Cup
additional: The race is part of running series and cups, scheduled for October 4, 2026.

name: Běh okolo Panoramy
description: The Panorama Run is a traditional cross-country race in the challenging mountain terrain around the Jáchymov football stadium. This race is open to all age groups and has been held for the 33rd time. The event is organized by the Jáchymov Physical Education Union and offers sporting activity in the beautiful environment of the Ore Mountains.
course_highlights: Challenging mountain terrain around TJ Jáchymov football stadium
Traditional cross-country race with a long history (33rd edition)
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race starts at the TJ Jáchymov football field. The event is open to the general public and all age categories. The race takes place in the demanding mountain terrain of the Ore Mountains around Jáchymov. The event is suitable for all age groups; registration details are not explicitly provided. The course runs through mountain terrain around Jáchymov.

description: The Orlice Valley Run is a traditional cross-country race held in Klášterec nad Orlicí, offering courses through meadows and local roads with hilly terrain. The race is part of the ISCAREX cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including children and adults. Winners can expect medals, material prizes, and monetary awards. The start and finish are located at the football field near the school, with the main race beginning in the morning.
course_highlights: Cross-country courses through meadows and local roads
3 km loop with 60 m elevation gain
Combination of flat and hilly sections with grassy and field paths
additional: Registrations on site from 8:30 AM. The main race starts at 11:15 AM. Prizes for winners include diplomas, medals, material prizes, and monetary awards for the best in the 6 km and 9 km races. The 9 km course is run in three loops of 3 km each, the 6 km course in two loops. The 3 km loop has an elevation gain of 60 m. Hilly terrain, trail/cross-country, various race lengths, on-site registration, refreshments, and a raffle of start numbers.

name: Slatinský kros
location: Park Terénky, Dědická, Brno-Slatina, Brno, Czech Republic
description: The Slatinský cross-country race is a traditional cross-country running event held in Brno-Slatina, now in its 19th year. The race takes place in Terénky Park on Dědická Street and offers a grassy course with a hilly profile, challenging runners in a pleasant natural environment. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District and is suitable for the general public. Participants can expect cups, medals, and valuable material prizes.
course_highlights: Grassy course with a hilly profile
Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina
Cross-country run in a natural environment
additional: Prizes include cups, medals, and valuable material prizes. Online registration will be launched in summer 2026. The race is under the auspices of the Brno-Slatina City District. The race offers cups, medals, and material prizes; registration is possible online, and the course runs through Terénky Park in Brno-Slatina.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - říjen
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race focuses on the joy of running and competition primarily with oneself. The event takes place in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain, except for some races in June and August, which are held by the river. The run is part of a cup competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated throughout the year.
course_highlights: Distance of 2 miles (3.2 km) with a children's category over 600 m
Event location in Smetanovy sady in Olomouc near the fountain
Races by the river on U Dětského domova street in June and August
additional: Registration takes place from 9:30 to 10:00 AM on race day. The top three places are announced in each category. Results are adjusted according to age coefficient and points are accumulated within the cup competition from September 2025 to August 2026. The course runs on asphalt paths in Smetanovy sady; registration is voluntary, the race is held on October 4, 2026; a children's race over 600 m is also part of the event.

name: Roštejnské stráně
location: Ranč u Lipek, Telč, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Roštejnské stráně is a traditional cross-country run organized by Orel Telč, which is part of the Orel Running League. This 14th edition takes place in the beautiful environment near Ranch u Lipek in Telč and offers runners various categories including family relays and a popular run for beginners. The race is open to all age groups and emphasizes fair play and sporting values. Medals, diplomas, and material prizes are prepared for winners, including special awards for the youngest and oldest runners.
course_highlights: Start at Ranch u Lipek in Telč
Cross-country run in natural terrain
Part of the Orel Running League
additional: Categories include children's runs, family relays (3 members with one child up to 12 years old), and a popular run for beginners over 18 years old. Start times are approximate between 12:30 and 13:20, and it is recommended to arrive at least half an hour before the start. Each participant runs at their own risk and is responsible for their health. The race is part of the Orel Running League, with start times between 12:30 and 13:20, and emphasizes fair play and sporting values.

name: Běh kolem Lužnice
location: TJ Lokomotiva stadion, Veselí nad Lužnicí, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around Lužnice is a traditional running race organized by the Atletika Veselí athletics club in Veselí nad Lužnicí. The race offers a unique opportunity for runners of all ages to enjoy beautiful nature and a sporting atmosphere at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium. The club has been dedicated to athletics and running races for a long time, emphasizing quality organization and a friendly atmosphere. The race is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners and children.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Lužnice with beautiful natural scenery
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium in Veselí nad Lužnicí
Friendly atmosphere and support from the Atletika Veselí athletics club
additional: Athletics training sessions are held outdoors at the stadium according to the spring schedule. Parking is available in the TJ Lokomotiva sports complex. The club also offers the sale of club caps and headbands. Payments and registration are conducted electronically through club membership. The race is open to all age groups, with registration available via the website. The start is at the TJ Lokomotiva stadium, and participants can choose between the 8.09 km and 5.67 km routes.

name: Huť - Bratříkov - Huť
location: Huti, Jablonec nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: Huť-Bratříkov-Huť is a traditional cross-country race held annually on the first Sunday of October in Huta near Jablonec nad Nisou. This race, with a history dating back to 1972, offers a main race of 10 km and shorter variants for different age categories. The course runs through picturesque scenery with a grassy field serving as the start and finish area. The race is suitable for all running enthusiasts, from children to adults, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race of 10 km through scenic nature
Traditional date on the first Sunday of October
Start and finish on the grassy field at the fire station in Huta
additional: Registrations and bib numbers are submitted directly on site at the start. Youth categories register from 08:10 to 09:00, other categories from 08:10 until 15 minutes before the start. The program begins with a collective assembly at 09:10 AM. Categories include preschool children, youth, unregistered men and women, and the main 10 km race. The race takes place on the first Sunday of October on a grassy field near the fire station in Huta, with the possibility of online registration. The course is quite hilly, mainly forest and meadow paths, suitable for trail runners.

name: 25 Poznań Maraton
description: The 25th Poznań Marathon named after Maciej Frankiewicz is a jubilee, 25th edition of the royal distance of 42.195 km, which will take place on October 4, 2026, in Poznań. The race has been attracting thousands of runners and spectators for a quarter of a century, offering a new, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań. Organizers ensure professional medical security, timing measurement, and a rich start package. This is a unique sports celebration with strong support from Poznań fans and a rich tradition.
course_highlights: New, attractive route starting and ending at the International Fairgrounds in Poznań
Royal marathon distance of 42.195 km
Jubilee, 25th edition with rich tradition and support from local fans
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, sponsor materials, professional timing, medical security, nutrition points with isotonic drinks, water, chocolate, fruits, and sugar. The organizer provides free accommodation for 600 people in POSiR sports halls on October 3-4, 2026; participants must bring their own mats and sleeping bags. Numerous parking lots are available near MTP with various prices. Participants of the OK Poznań program receive a 25% discount, and seniors 60+ get a 50% reduction. An official marathon t-shirt can be ordered until September 1, 2026, for 70 PLN. Registration is open until October 1, 2026, with discounts for seniors and program participants, official gadgets and sportswear available, as well as accompanying events like Poznań Run Expo and Kids Marathon.

description: The Olsztyn Half Marathon is an annual race covering a half marathon distance (21.1 km) around the picturesque Ukiel Lake in Olsztyn. The course is mixed, including asphalt, cobblestone, hardened gravel paths, and forest trails, making it attractive and varied for runners. The event is accompanied by 5 km races and children's races, creating a sports atmosphere for the whole family. Organizers provide at least two refreshment zones along the route and professional race office support. It is an excellent opportunity to combine sport with the beauty of nature and active recreation.
course_highlights: Course length of 21.1 km around Ukiel Lake
Mixed surface: asphalt, cobblestone, gravel, forest trails
At least 2 refreshment zones along the route
additional: Start packages can be collected on 13.09.2025 from 14:00 to 20:00 and on race day from 8:00 to 10:45 at the race office at CRS UKIEL. Collection of packages is only in person. The time limit to complete the half marathon is 3 hours, and for the 5 km race 45 minutes. Registration on race day is not possible. The course is not certified by PZLA. The event includes various distances, including the half marathon, 5 km, relays, and the Family Mile. Participants can expect start packages, medals, finisher photos, insurance, and on-site attractions.

description: Wild Run is a charity run organized in Wrocław, with the route passing through the Wrocław Zoo area. The event aims to support the protection of endangered animal species living in Poland, and participants can also run virtually on any route. The main race consists of two loops of approximately 5 km each, and there are also runs for children and youth. All participants receive commemorative medals, and the top runners receive prizes from sponsors.
course_highlights: The main route is two loops of about 5 km each within Wrocław Zoo
Virtual run on any route, 10 km distance
Runs for children (100 m) and youth (about 1 km) with medals and prizes
additional: Start packages are issued on the race day from 12:00 to 15:30 at the zoo ticket offices. It is possible to order an extended package with a T-shirt, towel, or race bib belt. Participants of the main race are asked to return their race bibs, which will be used in subsequent editions. Shipping of start packages for the virtual race is carried out according to the registration deadline. The event includes various attractions, costume contests, support for animal protection, and the opportunity to participate in a virtual run. The run is part of activities promoting nature conservation and an active lifestyle.

name: XRUN Wielki Finał
location: Domu Zdrojowego CECHINI, Żegiestów-Zdrój, Małopolskie, Poland
description: The Grand Finale XRUN is a mountain trail run taking place on October 4, 2026, in Żegiestów-Zdrój, with the base at the CECHINI Spa House. Participants can choose from four distances: 40 km with an elevation gain of 1800 m, 28 km with 1300 m elevation gain, 18 km with 900 m elevation gain, and shorter distances for children. The routes pass through picturesque mountains, offering technical descents and challenging ascents, making the race attractive for mountain enthusiasts. The event is a perfect culmination of the running season, combining intensity with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 40 km route with 1800 m elevation gain, start at 08:00, time limit 8 hours
28 km route with 1300 m elevation gain, start at 09:00, time limit 6 hours
18 km route with 900 m elevation gain, start at 09:30, time limit 4 hours
additional: Race office and start/finish for all distances at the CECHINI Spa House. Age categories for children from 3 to 15 years on distances of 150, 300, 500, 800, 1000 meters. Time limits for individual distances: 8h (40 km), 6h (28 km), 4h (18 km). The routes pass through Pusta Wielka, Jaworzynka, Bacówka PTTK near Wierchomla, and other mountain trails. Participants must be at least 16 years old (younger with written guardian consent). The event also includes family runs for kids and is the finale of the mountain running series in Poland, ending the season at the highest sporting and community level.

Picturesque city views and a sporting atmosphere
