description: The Berounka - Tetín Running Series is a community trail race held on October 5, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of Tetín. The route goes over hills and offers beautiful views of the Czech Karst and the surrounding landscape, including a climb to the lookout over Beroun. The race is part of a series of 12 runs that motivate runners of all levels to stay active in nature with a friendly atmosphere and support from local pubs. Refreshments, baggage storage, and awards for the best in categories are provided on site.
course_highlights: The route passes over Damil hill with views of Tetín and the Czech Karst
The highest point is near Na Koledníku village, then mostly downhill
Picturesque lookout over Beroun and the surrounding landscape before the final descent to the finish
additional: The route is marked with red-white and yellow reflective signs and red ground arrows. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The top three places in each category will receive a diploma and medal. The trail race features a marked route, starting at Hospůdka u Plotice, includes hilly terrain and beautiful views, registration via voucher, with refreshments and baggage storage on site. Bringing a headlamp is advised.

name: Mrdická mašina
location: Heřmanův Městec, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Mrdická Machine is a fast run of 2.0 km across Mrdické meadows in Heřmanův Městec. This race is part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league, which includes ten athletic and cycling events in the vicinity of Mrdice fortress. The race is open to the general public and offers a fun and sporting challenge for all runners. Organized by the Heřmanův Městec Running Club, which supports running and sports activities in the region.
course_highlights: 2.0 km run across Mrdické meadows
Part of the Heřmanoměstecká sports league with 10 races
Surroundings of the historic Mrdice fortress
additional: The race is intended for all running enthusiasts, registration is available in the regulations, and the course runs through meadows and forest paths around Heřmanův Městec.

name: Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf 2026
location: Biberach an der Riß, Biberach, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Biberacher Herbstwaldlauf is a small autumn forest run in Biberach an der Riß, starting at the Burrenwald parking lot. The event is organized by TG Biberach 1847 e.V. and offers runners the choice between 5 km and 10 km. It is a relaxed running event without pre-registration, with registration possible on the day of the race on-site. The course runs through the autumnal Burrenwald area and offers a natural running experience. The entry fee is very affordable at 4 euros and includes refreshments at the finish line as well as a certificate, which can be collected later or sent via email.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Burrenwald area
Start and finish at Burrenwald parking lot
Natural course without stadium sections
additional: No pre-registration required, registration on race day on-site possible. Entry fee 4 euros includes refreshments at the finish and a certificate. Event has been held since at least 2011 with a cancellation in 2020. Local participant field with many repeat runners. Run takes place in Burrenwald, finish line refreshments included, certificate available, autumn weather in October, small and family-friendly event.

name: Herbstcross auf dem Bergfried
price_range: 10,00 € Nachmeldegebühr für Erwachsene/Jugend U18 bis U20
description: The Autumn Cross at Bergfried is a short autumn cross-country race held on the grounds of Bergfried in Saalfeld, Germany. The course lengths range from 800 meters to 4.8 kilometers and are designed for fast trail running, not for long road races. The race takes place outside the stadium and is classified as both a mountain run and a cross-country race. The Saalfeld Athletics Club has been organizing the event for many years with separate races for children and adults as well as various age groups.
course_highlights: Terrain around Bergfried in Saalfeld
Course lengths from 800 m to 4.8 km
Combination of mountain running and cross-country
additional: The race includes categories for youth, open class, masters, and local runners from Saalfeld-Rudolstadt. In a previous edition, approximately 200 children and adolescents participated. Typical weather in October is around 14°C during the day and 6°C at night, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation and mostly cloudy skies. The race is run outside the stadium, including categories for children and adults, trail and mountain running. Registration deadline is September 29, 2026.

name: Warburger Stundenlauf 2026
description: The 34th Warburg Hour Run will take place on October 7, 2026, in Warburg. The competition is open to adults and offers both individual and team categories. The running course is flat, and the event lasts for one hour. Additionally, there are competitions for children and adolescents, with details available in the official organizer's announcement.
course_highlights: Flat course
Duration: 1 hour
Individual and team categories available
additional: A competition for children and adolescents is offered. Start and finish are at Hüffertsportplatz; precise location details require RUNME Premium. The event is part of the RUNME race calendar. Participants receive certificates and trophies; registration is online; the event takes place in good weather in October.

name: Roštejnskou oborou
description: Roštejn Forest Run is a friendly race for the general public held in the picturesque surroundings of the forests near Růžená in the Vysočina region. The course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old, with distances ranging from 300 meters to 8,900 meters. The event is part of the Vysočina Runner Cup and offers a unique experience of running in nature with the opportunity to observe local wildlife. Organized by TJ Růžená, z.s., the race is ideal for families and sports enthusiasts who want to combine sport with nature.
course_highlights: Forest terrain with opportunities to observe local wildlife
Course lengths from 300 m to 8,900 m suitable for all age groups
Part of the Vysočina Runner Cup, ideal for families and sports enthusiasts
additional: The race takes place on October 9, 2026, around Růžená. The main race length is 7.3 km, the course runs through forest paths and is suitable for all age groups from 4 years old.

name: Pražský Kelt
description: Prague Celts is a unique 100 km ultra trail in the heart of Prague, offering runners the opportunity to experience beautiful nature and Celtic hillforts with a total elevation gain of 2500 meters. The route leads through wooded hilly terrain of Prague, including historical sites such as Šance hillfort, Butovice, Závist, Vyšehrad, and others, providing stunning views of the city and surrounding nature. The race starts and ends at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds and is intended for runners who want to experience the atmosphere of an ultramarathon in an unconventional urban environment. The race capacity is limited to 120 participants, ensuring an intimate and friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 100 km route with 2500 m elevation gain in wooded hilly Prague
Connection of three Celtic hillforts and historical sites of Prague
Beautiful views of Prague from Vyšehrad, Branické rocks, and other locations
additional: Start and finish are at the Kunratice Elementary School grounds. The race capacity is 120 people. Bus transportation is available via bus 193 from Kačerov station to Kunratice School (12 minutes). Parking is available around the school. Mandatory equipment is specified in the race rules (chapter 3.3). The route for the new edition is sent via email to registered participants. Refreshment stations are part of the race and highly appreciated by participants. The course is 100 km with 2500 m elevation gain, includes refreshment stations, the option for a relay race, a diploma and medal, registration until September 30, 2026, capacity of 120 persons.

name: 25. Volkslauf um den Altwarmbüchener See
description: The Volkslauf around Lake Altwarmbüchener is part of the Sparkassen Laufpass of the Hanover region, one of the largest running series in Germany with 43 events in 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to explore the Hanover region on foot and participate in a diverse range of running events. Each participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is available both digitally and in traditional form. The event is aimed at recreational athletes and promotes active movement in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Altwarmbüchener
Scenic route in the Hanover region
Part of a large running series with diverse race options
additional: Participation is rewarded with a stamp in the Laufpass, which is also available digitally via the Laufpass app. The Laufpass app offers an event calendar, a digital running diary, and additional information. The Volkslauf is embedded in a series of 43 running events in the Hanover region. The race takes place in Altwarmbüchen, with on-site registration possible, scheduled for March 1, 2026. It is part of the Laufpass series, featuring various distances including 1.6 km, 3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 10.8 km.

name: Abt-Degen-Lauf
description: The Abt-Degen-Run of TV 1884 Zeil is a traditional race event taking place on October 10, 2026, for the 30th time. It offers various distances, including a main race over 11 km, as well as school runs over 1600 m and 800 m, and a toddler run. The event features a well-organized course with timing, bib number distribution, showers and changing rooms, as well as catering and an award ceremony. The race is open to runners of all ages and promotes the sporting community spirit in Zeil am Main.
course_highlights: Main race over 11 km
School runs over 1600 m and 800 m
Toddler run for the youngest
additional: The event offers team scoring, bib number distribution, timing, showers and changing rooms, toilets, award ceremony, food and drinks, medical services, and course security. The course is hilly; races for adults, children, and youth; team scoring; family and team friendly; results published.

name: BKK Walking am Baldeneysee mit Mini-Marathon
description: The BKK Walking at Lake Baldeney is part of the Westenergie Marathon Weekend in Essen and offers a diverse program for walkers, Nordic walkers, and runners. The main marathon runs twice around Lake Baldeney with an additional turnaround loop and is characterized by a flat profile and fast bike paths. The marathon has been held annually since 1963, making it Germany's oldest event of its kind. The event is organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with support from numerous volunteers. The number of participants is limited to 3,000 to avoid bottlenecks on the course.
course_highlights: Flat profile around Lake Baldeney
Two laps with an additional turnaround loop in the first lap
Fast bike paths and early autumn weather
additional: Participant limit of 3,000 due to bottlenecks on the course. Walking program offers routes up to 14 km. Event takes place annually on the second Sunday in October. Organized by the athletics department of TUSEM Essen with volunteer support. Distances: 1.1 km, 7 km, 42.2 km; limited to 3,000 participants; weather in October around 14°C, cloudy; registration recommended with the organizer.

name: Brakelsieker Volkslauf "Am Fuße des Mörths"
location: Sportplatz Brakelsiek, Schieder-Schwalenberg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Brakelsieker Volkslauf "At the Foot of Mörth" is a classic local race, walking, and Nordic walking event in Schieder-Schwalenberg, taking place on a Saturday afternoon in October. Various distances are offered for adults and youths, including 5 km, 9 km, and 15 km running, as well as 5 km and 9 km walking or Nordic walking. The start and finish are located at the sports field in Brakelsiek, and the course runs around the village sports field with a rather hilly, rural profile at the foot of Mörth. The event provides a nice opportunity to experience the autumn landscape in a relaxed atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the sports field in Brakelsiek
Loop course around the village sports field, not a point-to-point course
Hilly course with a rural profile at the foot of Mörth
additional: Offered are running, walking, and Nordic walking distances for adults and youths. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. The course is not considered a tough mountain route but offers moderate elevation gain. Running and walking events, start and finish at the sports field in Brakelsiek, rather hilly course, rural profile.

name: Coesfelder DJK - Citylauf
description: The 32nd Coesfelder City Run will take place on October 10, 2026, in Coesfeld. The event is organized by DJK Eintracht Coesfeld e.V. and offers runners of all ages the opportunity to engage in sports. The City Run combines leisure, competitive, health, and rehabilitation sports and is an established event in the region. Online registration is available through the official website.
course_highlights: Measured, flat city courses through the historic city center
Various running distances for all age and performance groups
Attractive prizes, certificates, and trophies for top runners and groups
additional: The organizer's office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 12:00 and 14:30 to 18:00. The office is closed on December 24 and 31, as well as on public holidays. The website features images from photobello and provides registration lists for individual races. Road/landscape run, registration open, various running distances, start and finish locations in the city center of Coesfeld, age categories for children, hobby runners, club members, and older participants.

name: Damscheider Kuckucks-Trail
price_range: Early-Kuckuck 14,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 18,00 Euro (9,5 km); Early-Kuckuck 21,00 Euro, Kuckuckspreis 25,00 Euro (21 km)
description: The Damscheider Cuckoo Trail on October 10, 2026, offers a varied trail running experience with its three distances in the picturesque landscape of the Rheinhöhen near Damscheid. The 21 km extended route runs through the Damscheid Forest, across natural meadows, vineyards, and the Schwede-Bure-Weg to the valley in Oberwesel and back, with approximately 700 meters of elevation gain. The 9.5 km Best of Trails route provides a classic trail feeling with changing terrain and 240 meters of elevation. For children, there is a about 1 km Kidsrun around the sports field. The event combines sporting challenge with natural enjoyment and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 21 km Extended with approx. 700 meters of elevation through forest, meadows, vineyards, and valley
9.5 km Best of Trails with changing terrain and 240 meters of elevation
Kidsrun approx. 1 km at the forest edge and sports field, child-friendly and fun-oriented
additional: Race number pickup from 11:00 AM at the Damscheid sports field. Personalized race numbers with transponder for timing during the main races. Refreshment stations along the routes, drinks at the start and finish, barbecue stand and cake at the sports field. Showers and changing rooms on site. Dogs are not allowed during the competition. Trail running on hiking trails, route lengths of 9.5 km and 21 km, children's race planned, registration from May 16, 2026, timing with Race Result, personalized race numbers with transponder.

name: Herberts Bremserlauf mit dem TSV Zornheim
description: The Herberts Bremserlauf with TSV Zornheim is a local road race in Zornheim scheduled for October 10, 2026. The race offers 2 km and 10 km distances, providing a club and local race format that differs from stadium events. It is part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region and is aimed at children, students, youth, active athletes, masters, and hobby runners. Changing facilities and showers are available at the nearby Hans-Steib-Halle. Late registrations are possible on-site, but with a small additional fee.
course_highlights: Road race in club and local race format
Part of the Wingertscup series in the Mainz region
Start and meeting point at Herberts Kulturscheune
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site, but incur a small additional fee. Changing facilities and showers are available at the Hans-Steib-Halle at Zum Neuen Sportplatz. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. On-site registration possible, facilities such as changing rooms and showers are available at the Hans-Steib-Halle.

name: Herbstlauf
description: The Autumn Run 2026 will take place on October 10th at the Waldstadion Schutterwald. The course covers 10 kilometers of flat forest and field paths, which are measured and marked according to DLV standards. The event is open to runners of all ages and offers an attractive running opportunity in a natural environment. Registration is available online via my.raceresult.com, and the organizer is happy to answer questions via email.
course_highlights: 10 km flat forest and field paths
Course measured according to DLV standards
Every kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at Waldstadion. Registration online via my.raceresult.com. The registration fee includes a 0.50 euro association fee. Online registration, every kilometer is marked, event with a community character

name: IKK Südwest Freundschaftslauf
description: The IKK Südwest Friendship Run is a traditional hour run in Marpingen, offering various running distances as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The event is not a competition but focuses on community and enjoyment of running. There are courses from 5.5 km to 11 km as well as hiking routes without timing. The run is organized by the Saarland Athletics Association and takes place on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Hour run with distances from 7 to 11 km
Walking and Nordic walking routes between 5.5 and 6.5 km
Hiking without timing
additional: The Friendship Run is explicitly not a competition. No timing is provided. The event includes various running and walking distances as well as hiking routes. Organized by the Saarland Athletics Association. No official competition with timing, no prizes, no competitive scoring; ideal for community and fun of running.

name: Kuppinger Mondfängerlauf
description: The Kuppinger Moon Catcher Run is a special night run that has replaced the well-known Gypsy Mountain Run since 2009. It features illuminated sections of the course, creating a unique running atmosphere. As the sixth and final race of the Schönbuch Cup series, it traditionally takes place on the second Saturday in October. The event is firmly rooted in the region and appeals to runners who appreciate a special atmosphere while running.
course_highlights: Run into the night
Illuminated course sections for a special atmosphere
Final race of the Schönbuch Cup series
additional: Registration and result retrieval are centrally managed via the Schönbuch Cup homepage. The event will take place on October 10, 2026, with start and finish at the Kuppingen Community Hall. A festive running atmosphere is offered for the whole family.

name: Lichterlauf in Steckenborn
description: The Steckenborner Lichterlauf is a popular community run in the Eifel region, distinguished by its unique atmosphere. The course covers 10 kilometers, which are completed on a 2-kilometer loop five times. At dusk, the route is atmospherically illuminated with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches, making the run a special experience. The organizer SC Komet Steckenborn e.V. looks forward to many participants who wish to enjoy this special running event.
course_highlights: 10 km course on a 2 km loop, run five times
Atmospheric lighting with spotlights, lanterns, candles, and torches at night
Community run with a unique atmosphere in the Eifel region
additional: 10 km night run on illuminated course, team competition for youth, registration on the website

name: Lindenseelaufserie
description: The Lindenseelauf series is a traditional running event in Rüsselsheim at Lindensee, held annually. It offers runners of various age and performance levels the opportunity to run on diverse routes around the lake. The series is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized execution. Participants can look forward to a scenic course and a friendly running community.
course_highlights: Running routes around Lindensee in Rüsselsheim
Varied courses for different age and performance levels
Scenic and well-marked running paths
additional: Races in November and January, no series ranking for the 5 km run, start and finish area relocated to a field path, moderate participation fees, awards for top finishers and age groups

name: Loßburger Waldlauf
description: The Lossburg Forest Run is a traditional autumn forest run in Lossburg, Germany, organized by the Ski Club Lossburg. The event takes place for the 30th time and offers runners a varied course on roads and forest paths, with no laps on the track. There are different distances, including a 400 m run for children and adolescents as well as a challenging 10 km run with a hilly profile for adults. The races start in the evening, with the 10 km run beginning at 7:00 PM.
course_highlights: Forest and road run in October
Hilly profile for the 10 km run
Children and youth competitions with 400 m distance
additional: The 10 km run starts at 7:00 PM, while the shorter race (6.7 km) begins earlier in the evening. The event takes place at the school center in Lossburg. Typical October weather is around 14°C with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is held at the school center in Lossburg, with registration until October 9, 2026. It also includes children and youth races as well as various distances, including a 400-meter run for the youngest participants.

name: Muswiesenlauf
description: The Muswiesenlauf is a traditional community run in Hohenlohe, celebrating its 41st edition on October 10, 2026. It is the oldest community run in the region and offers various courses for students, youth, and adults. The routes are officially measured and lead diversely over paved agricultural paths and gravel forest trails. Each participant receives a certificate, and children are additionally given box auto chips. The event is embedded in the historic Muswiese festival, which has been held annually since 1434.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses with distances of 500m, 1km, 2.5km, 5km, and 10km
Varied routes with asphalt and gravel forest paths
Run embedded in the traditional Muswiesenfest in Hohenlohe
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Changing rooms and showers are available at the 2 km distant multi-purpose hall "Forum", simple changing rooms without showers are available at the start area. The award ceremony takes place in the Muswiesenhalle on the festival grounds. Parking is available around the festival grounds and start/finish area; during peak times, traffic congestion may occur. Races over 500m, 1,000m, 2,500m, 5,000m, 10,000m; online registration until one day before the race; late registrations on race day are possible; bib number distribution at Stadel Hofburk.

name: Parforceheide Crosslauf
location: Sportplatz an der Heinrich-Zille-Straße, Stahnsdorf, Brandenburg, Germany
description: The Parforceheide Cross Country has been organized since 2008 by RSV Eintracht 1949 in Stahnsdorf and offers local recreational runners the opportunity to experience the diverse landscape of the Parforceheide. The course runs from the sports field along Heinrich-Zille-Straße past the Southwest Cemetery through forest and nature with small inclines, sandy passages, as well as asphalt and cobblestone sections. Races are offered over 1 km (Bambini), 3 km (school children), 5 km, and 10 km for youth and adults. After the race, the organizer provides refreshments, and football matches often take place on the sports field, creating a fun sports day for participants and spectators.
course_highlights: Course through the Parforceheide with forest and nature passages
Varied surfaces: sand, asphalt, cobblestones
Small inclines provide challenge and variety
additional: There are races for different age groups and distances: Bambini run (1 km), school children run (3 km), 5 km and 10 km for youth and adults. Refreshments are provided on the sports field after the race. The event is part of the Mittelmarkcup and is supported by many volunteers. Football matches on artificial turf often take place afterwards, rounding out the day for families and companions. Terrain includes inclines, sandy passages, asphalt, cobblestones. Registration via www.ziel-zeit.de

name: Pegnitztallauf 2026
description: The Pegnitztallauf is an afternoon event in Vorra, Germany, featuring a flat, single-loop course that does not require multiple laps. Races offered include 5 km for adults and youth, 10 km for adults, and a 5 km Nordic Walking for adults. Children's and youth races complement the program, making the event a local, club-oriented running event. The finish line is at the tennis facility in 91247 Vorra, and the start is at 3:00 PM.
course_highlights: Flat, single-loop course without lap repetitions
Finish at the tennis facility in Vorra
Diverse program with children, youth, and adult races
additional: The event takes place in the afternoon, starting at 3:00 PM. The weather in October is typically around 14°C with a low of 6°C, mostly cloudy, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event is more of a local club race than a pure road race for adults. It is a local club event with a family-friendly atmosphere, welcoming runners of all ages.

name: Ramsthaler Wein-Berg-Lauf
description: The Ramsthaler Wine Mountain Run is a traditional race event held annually in Ramsthal. The race offers various competitions for all age groups, from children (Bambini) to students, teenagers, and adults. The courses lead through the picturesque vineyards of Ramsthal and feature a diverse landscape. In addition to the running competitions, there is also a walking route that allows participants to experience the beautiful surroundings.
course_highlights: Race courses through the scenic Ramsthal vineyards
Various competitions for children, students, teenagers, and adults
8 km walking route through the beautiful landscape
additional: Competitions for different age groups and distances: children (Bambini), students, teenagers, and adults (6.4 km and 10.4 km), as well as an 8 km walking event. Running, Nordic walking, family-friendly activities, scenic vineyard landscape

name: Solvay Lauf
description: The Solvay Run Bernburg is a 5 km race in Bernburg, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on October 10, 2026. The start is at Krumbholzallee 8 at 10:00 AM. The race is part of the Solvay Cup and combines cross-country and road running, making it not a simple flat city course. It is primarily aimed at local clubs and usually attracts 100 to 300 runners. The event offers professional timing, online results, certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and catering at the finish line.
course_highlights: 5 km course with a mix of cross-country and road running
Start at Krumbholzallee 8 in Bernburg
Local race with a manageable number of participants (100-300 runners)
additional: Registration is possible online, in person beforehand, or on the day of the event on site. Chip timing via race result, online results and start lists, photos and reports, printed and online certificates, showers, changing rooms, parking, free bag drop-off, and catering at the finish line. Typical weather in October: around 14°C, mostly cloudy with 40mm of precipitation. The event is not a large-scale event but a local race with typically 100 to 300 participants. It offers not only the race but also a friendly atmosphere with catering, showers, and parking facilities.

name: Viersener Herbstwaldlauf Rund um den Bismarckturm
description: The 79th Viersen Autumn Forest Run around the Bismarck Tower will take place on October 10, 2026, in Viersen. The event offers a 5 km run for adults on a hilly course with a time limit of one hour. Additionally, there is a Walking & Nordic Walking competition over 7.25 km. The age restriction is from 14 to 99 years for the run and 10 to 99 years for walking. The event is traditional and targets runners and walkers seeking a challenging course in an autumnal forest landscape.
course_highlights: Hilly course
Around the Bismarck Tower
Time limit of 1 hour for the 5 km run
additional: There are competitions for children and adolescents, further information can be found in the official announcement of the organizer. Start and finish are the same for all competitions, exact locations are only shown with RUNME Premium. Results are categorized by age groups, with classification based on year of birth. Multiple competitions with different distances, age groups, and start times; participation for youths from 14 years old; results are published on the website.

name: Volkslauf mit Walking um den AWB See
description: The 25th Volkslauf with walking around the AWB Lake is a local running and walking event in Altwarmbüchen, a district of Isernhagen. The event offers short, flat distances around the Altwarmbüchen Lake, with one lap measuring approximately 3.66 km. There are various running and walking routes for adults as well as children and youth races, making the day a communal running experience for the entire region. Start and finish are located at Seestraße 23, and the races take place in the afternoon.
course_highlights: Flat course around the Altwarmbüchen Lake
Lap of about 3.66 km in length
Offers for running and Nordic walking
additional: The races start in the afternoon in the following order: first the 3.6 km run, then the walkers, followed by the 7.2 km run for adults. The event is more a communal running day for the town than a single main race. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with a low of 6 °C and mostly cloudy skies. Course lengths range from 1.6 km to 10.8 km, flat terrain, running and walking events, children and youth races, scheduled for October 10, 2026.

name: Cena Metuje
location: Nové Město nad Metují, Hradec Králové, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub Nové Město nad Metují z.s.
price_range: 300-500 Kč pro dospělé, zdarma pro členy SK Nové Město nad Metují

description: The Metuje Race is a traditional 10 km road run held in Nové Město nad Metují as part of the PRIMÁTOR CUP running series. This 65th edition also features races for youth in various age categories. The course runs along an asphalt road through the valley of the Metuje River to Peklo and back, providing a pleasant yet challenging running experience. The race is suitable for the general public, including children, parents, and grandparents, who can collect points within the series. The winners are announced both in children's categories and in the main race, with monetary and material prizes.
course_highlights: Road course over 10 km through the valley of the Metuje River
The route goes to Peklo and back along an asphalt road
Youth races with various distances from 100 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration is only available online at sportchallenge.cz, including on the race day until 8:00 AM. The race office is open on race day from 8:00 AM at the Sokolovna in Nové Město nad Metují. SK Nové Město nad Metují members have free entry. Children can earn points within the PRIMÁTOR CUP series and receive rewards for participation. Children's races are divided into categories from 9:00 to 10:30, with the main race starting at 10:45. Winners are announced at 10:45 (children's categories) and at 12:00 (main race). The race is part of the Primátor Cup 2025 series and the Grand Prix of Eastern Bohemia, including various age categories and offering prizes and certificates.

name: VOKOLO priglu
location: Brněnská přehrada, Brno, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
price_range: early bird ceny do konce roku 2025, přesné ceny nejsou specifikovány
description: Vokolo priglu is a traditional running race around Brno Dam, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers a unique sporting experience on a 14.1 km course, which is approximately one-third of a marathon. The route is slightly hilly, mostly asphalt with a section of rocky terrain, and offers beautiful views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn forests. The race is open to individuals, pairs in relay teams, four-member teams, companies, and universities, and is known for its friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization.
course_highlights: 14.1 km course around Brno Dam
Slightly hilly profile with 85% asphalt and 15% rocky surface
Views of Brno Lake, Veveří Castle, and autumn Podkomorské forests
additional: The main race starts in waves, timing is measured with chip technology integrated into the race bib, and the time limit for completion is 2.5 hours. There is a sports EXPO, accompanying program for adults and children, changing rooms, mobile toilets, baggage storage, refreshments, and rescue services on the course and at the start and finish areas. Gift vouchers are sent electronically in PDF format. The race offers various categories, the option to purchase official race merchandise, and an eco-friendly solution with electronic vouchers.

name: Běh Borským parkem
description: The Borský Park Run is a traditional autumn sporting event in Plzeň with a history dating back to 1970. The race is suitable for both beginner hobby runners and experienced athletes of all ages. It offers excitement at the starting line, the tension of the competitive atmosphere, and joy at the finish. Organizers ensure a friendly environment for runners and provide local refreshments for all participants.
course_highlights: Race takes place in Borský Park in Plzeň
Traditional autumn running event with a history since 1970
Friendly atmosphere for hobby and competitive runners of all ages
additional: Registration is possible in advance until October 10, 2024, with discounted entry fees at web nazavody.cz. On race day, registration is available at the start area from 8:30 to 9:45 on October 12, 2024. Organizers provide local refreshments for runners. Race in Borský Park, registration at https://www.nazavody.cz/zavod/565-beh-borskym-parkem, start from 8:30 to 9:45.

name: Běhej lesy Lednice
location: Lednice, South Moravian Region, Czech Republic
description: Run the Forests Lednice is part of a popular running series that offers races in the most beautiful natural locations in the Czech Republic. The race in Lednice takes place in the picturesque Lednice-Valtice area, where runners pass through the castle park, around ponds, and past iconic landmarks such as the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple. The routes are suitable for runners of various levels and include a short route Nova 14 km and a longer ČSOB 21 km, both with an international UTMB Index. The race is complemented by speed competitions and an attractive finish straight, providing additional motivation for participants.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Lednice-Valtice area with landmarks like the Temple of the Three Graces and Apollo's Temple
150-meter Conti Speed Section marked with Continental flags
500-meter Generali Investments Finish straight with measured section
additional: The race includes the Conti Speed Section - a 150m speed segment marked with Continental flags and the Generali Investments Finish - a 500m measured finish straight. The fastest man and woman will receive a functional running jersey from the brand Craft. It is recommended to pick up race numbers at least 90 minutes before the start. The event features various distances from 3 to 50 km, is suitable for families and children, includes a charity run, and partners with major companies such as Continental and ČSOB.

name: Hradčanské vlnky
location: Hradčany u Olomouce, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: Hradčanské vlnky is a traditional cross-country trail race in Hradčany near Olomouc, offering three main routes: 5.6 km, 10.4 km, and a half marathon of 21.1 km. The race emphasizes movement in terrain with a predominance of forest and field paths, ensuring an attractive and challenging run. The event also includes children's categories with various distances. Participants are provided with refreshments, chip timing, and extensive facilities including showers. The atmosphere is friendly, and the race is suitable for a wide range of runners from children to experienced trail runners.
course_highlights: Main route 10.4 km with an elevation gain of approximately 260 m, 5% asphalt, 25% field roads, 70% forest paths and trails
Half marathon 21.1 km with an elevation gain of approximately 505 m, a combination of asphalt, field, and stony paths, second half in terrain
Short route 5.6 km with an elevation gain of approximately 155 m, fast and technical blue trail
additional: Registration for children's races begins at 8:30, main races start at 9:45. The half marathon starts at 11:00 from the excursion area, the main route 10.4 km and the short route 5.6 km start from the square. Included in the registration fee are race organization, facilities, showers, food, beer/soft drinks, chip timing, start number, on-trail refreshments, and post-race refreshments. Parking is organized by volunteers with an emphasis on obeying traffic regulations and consideration for Hradčany residents. The race offers various categories, including children's, and is complemented by a rich accompanying program and a raffle.

name: Podzimní běh Olympu
description: The Autumn Run of Olymp is a traditional running race organized by the Police Sports Club Olymp Prague, taking place in the picturesque environment of Stromovka Park in Prague 7. The race offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and a sporting challenge in a pleasant urban park. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes team spirit and an active lifestyle. Organizers welcome all interested participants and provide support during registration and the race.
course_highlights: Run in Stromovka Park, Prague 7
Picturesque urban environment with natural scenery
Traditional autumn running event with a friendly atmosphere
additional: The run takes place in the Stromovka area, registration is possible online via results.bezeckenadeje.cz

name: Benešovský půlmaratón a desítka Pojizeřím
location: Podmošně, Benešov u Semil, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Benešov Half Marathon and Pojizeří Ten is a traditional running race in the picturesque environment of the village of Benešov u Semil in the Liberec Region. The race offers a half marathon and a 10-kilometer route through the beautiful nature of Pojizeří with varied terrain. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and light refreshments for competitors and spectators. The race is suitable for the broad running public and is part of the community's sports activities.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the scenic nature of Pojizeří with forest and field paths
The half marathon course features elevation and views of the Benešov hills
The 10 km offers a faster run on partly asphalt and forest paths
additional: The race facilities are located in the sports complex in Upper Benešov. Registrations and check-in take place at the start area from 12:30 PM, no later than 15 minutes before the start of each category. Light refreshments are available for competitors and spectators. The organizer is TJ Benešov u Semil z.s. with the support of the municipality of Benešov u Semil. The races include the half marathon, the 10 km, and a non-competitive 10 km route, scheduled for October 2026, with the start in Podmošně.

name: Běh Bukovem
description: Bukov Run is an annual sporting running festival held in the beautiful natural surroundings of Bukov and Plískov as part of the Brdy Running Cup. The race takes place exclusively on meadows, forest roads, and trails, offering runners a pleasant experience in nature. The event is suitable for a wide range of age categories, from young children to veterans. It is organized by the municipality of Plískov in cooperation with Farm Ekl and is known for its friendly atmosphere and tradition.
course_highlights: The course runs through meadows, forest roads, and trails in Bukov and Plískov
Various distances for children and adults, from 100 m to 8250 m
Start and finish at the playground near the swimming pool in Plískov
additional: Participant registration takes place on the terrace of the inn in Plískov from 9:00 to 10:50. The race starts gradually according to categories from 10:05 (youngest children) to 11:21 (women, juniors, veterans). Winners are announced continuously for children's categories and after the race for others. Please observe Covid precautions; disinfectant is available at the start. Participants without health restrictions run at their own risk. The race is held in October, with a primarily forest and meadow course, and offers online registration and various race distances throughout the year.

name: Kašavský kros
price_range: 400 CZK dospělí, 200 CZK junioři, 50 CZK děti
description: Kašava Cross is a traditional cross-country running race in the vicinity of Kašava, offering two main routes for competitors aged 16 and above, as well as children's races. The race takes place on Saturday, October 10, 2026, and is known for its proven course with hills and a pleasant atmosphere. The organizer is the VALACHBAJK TEAM KAŠAVA association, which collaborates with the local municipality and school. Children's races are held after the main races and are divided into several age categories with different distances.
course_highlights: Main course 16.6 km with an elevation gain of 679 m
Short course 8 km with an elevation gain of 254 m
Children's races with distances from 100 to 1300 m
additional: Registration for children is only possible on-site on race day. Check-in begins at 10:30 AM, the deadline for check-in for the long course is at 11:30 AM, the start of the long course is at 12:00 PM, the start of the short course is at 12:30 PM. Children's races start at 2:30 PM. The organizer provides a limit of 200 adult participants. After the race, winners are announced and a raffle is held. Terrain: trail, registration: online and on-site, includes children's races and main adult courses.

name: MUTRAverz - Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run (2)
location: Mikulov, Krušné hory, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Mikulovský Ultra Trail Run, z. s.
description: MUTRAverz is an extreme ultra trail race held in the Ore Mountains, specifically in Mikulov and its surroundings. This race is intended for experienced runners seeking a challenging course in beautiful nature with marked tourist trails. Organizers emphasize safety, fair play, and quality organizational support. The race is suitable for runners over 18 years old who are physically and mentally prepared for extreme conditions. We look forward to your participation in the next edition on October 10, 2026.
course_highlights: Extreme ultra trail in the Ore Mountains
Tourist-marked trails in the nature of Mikulov
Challenging terrain suitable for experienced runners
additional: The race is only for persons over 18 years old. Participants must be physically and mentally capable and are obliged to follow race rules and safety measures. The organizer is not responsible for the condition of the courses or any health complications. Runners agree to audiovisual recording of their performance for race presentation purposes. Trail race with over 50 km and 16 km courses, suitable for both experienced and recreational runners, supporting sports performance in nature.

name: Rybský trhák
description: Rybský trhák is a road running race organized by the Emil Zátopek Athletic Club Kopřivnice in cooperation with the municipality of Rybí and TJ Sokol Rybí. The race covers a distance of 7 km with an elevation gain of 135 meters and is intended for various age categories of men and women. The start is at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field, and runners can use secured changing rooms and showers. Refreshments and material prizes are prepared at the finish line for the best runners in each category, including a prize for the oldest participant and the best runner from the village of Rybí.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7 km
Elevation gain 135 m
Start and finish at the TJ Sokol Rybí football field
additional: Changing rooms and showers are provided. Refreshments and treats are available at the finish. Material prizes for the top three runners in each category, a prize for the oldest participant, and the best runner from the village of Rybí. The race takes place on October 10, 2026, starting at 11:00. Registration is at the football field in Rybí. Participants can expect refreshments and material prizes for category winners.

name: Běh pro Kleofáše
location: Lázeňský park Aurora, Třeboň, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Kleofáš Run is a traditional charity run held in the spa park in Třeboň, supporting the local hospice. Participants can choose from several categories, from children's short runs to a 12-kilometer run around Lake Svět. For less experienced runners, a pleasant 4-kilometer route is available, as well as a relay for two or four runners. The event offers a rich accompanying program for children and is part of the Hospice Week.
course_highlights: Beautiful natural route around Lake Svět
Pleasant 4-kilometer route for other runners
Relay race over 4 km for two or four runners
additional: Registration begins at 9:00 AM, with the possibility to register on-site on the day of the event. Children's races are divided by age with distances of 200 m, 450 m, and 1 km. Results are announced gradually after the children's races, as well as the 4 km and 12 km races. The event is part of Hospice Week. The routes include various lengths from 200 m to 12 km, with surfaces of forest paths, asphalt, and trail, with slight or flat elevation. Registration is via an online form or on-site, with the start in the Aurora Spa Park.

name: Malá cena Špindlerova Mlýna
location: Městský úřad ve Špindlerově Mlýně, Špindlerův Mlýn, Krkonoše, Czech Republic
description: The Small Prize of Špindlerův Mlýn is the traditional 34th uphill run held as part of the Czech Cup. The race starts at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn and offers a challenging route of 14 km with an elevation gain of 901 meters. This race is ideal for mountain running enthusiasts who want to test their strength in the beautiful mountain environment of the Krkonoše.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 14 km
Elevation gain of 901 m
Start at the Municipal Office in Špindlerův Mlýn
additional: The race is part of the Czech Cup running series. Organizers call for the protection of the Krkonoše nature. The race offers various categories for men and women, registration is through www.jktiming.cz, and it is known for its difficulty and the beauty of the surrounding Krkonoše nature.

name: Červený okruh
location: Termit, Doksy, Liberec District, Czech Republic
description: The Red Circuit in Doksy is a traditional race as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa, taking place on October 10, 2026. The race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on an interesting course in the natural environment of Termit in Doksy. The event is part of a series of regional running races and attracts both the general public and experienced athletes. Organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for all participants.
course_highlights: Natural terrain in the Termit area, Doksy
Part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa
Traditional autumn running race with history
additional: The race takes place in the Termit area in Doksy, the course runs through forest terrain, registration on-site or via email, suitable for various age groups.

name: Bašťanská šestka
description: Bašťanská šestka is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of the Baška reservoir in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The event is organized by Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s., which has long been dedicated to athletics and promoting sports activities in the region. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity for sporting activity in beautiful nature. Registration and participation are welcome from both experienced runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place on a route around the Baška reservoir
Picturesque natural environment of the Moravian-Silesian Region
A traditional running event organized by the athletics club Slezan Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race takes place on a road circuit around the Baška reservoir, with the start scheduled for 11:00. The event is suitable for all age groups and also offers races for children.

name: Svatováclavský běh - Tyreto RUN
price_range: libovolná cena (dobrovolný příspěvek od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč pro první desítku registrujících)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.price: libovolná částka od 250 Kč do 1000 Kč
tiers.description: Startovné je libovolné v rozmezí 250 až 1000 Kč, výtěžek jde na charitu

description: St. Wenceslas Run Tyreto RUN 2026 is a charity running race held on October 10th in Děčín. The race offers courses for men, women, and children, including a family run, and supports multiple sclerosis patients through proceeds from registration fees. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience while helping a good cause. The first ten registered participants will receive a reward in the form of a discount on tire purchases at Tyreto.
course_highlights: Traditional running race in Děčín
Courses for all age groups: 2.5 km, 5 km, 12 km, and 21 km
Charitable aspect supporting the St. Joseph's Home
additional: The first ten registered participants who pay an entry fee ranging from 250 to 1000 CZK will receive a voucher for a discount equal to the paid amount on tire purchases at Tyreto. Routes for 5, 12, and 21 km, races in Děčín, charity support, musical and accompanying program.

name: 30 Bieg Przełajowy o Nóż Komandosa
location: Stadion miejski, Lubliniec, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 30th Commando Knife Cross Country Run is a prestigious running event organized under the honorary patronage of Bishop of the Polish Armed Forces, Dr. Wiesław Lechowicz. The race takes place at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec and is dedicated to soldiers and uniformed service officers who compete in full field uniform. The event aims to identify the top uniformed services runners in cross country, promote mass running events, and foster integration within uniformed communities. The course runs along the street in front of the stadium to the finish line on the stadium track, with the start at 12:00 for women and 12:27 for men.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec
Course runs along the street in front of the stadium and finishes on the stadium track
Race in full field uniform and special tactical shoes
additional: All participants compete in the OPEN category without age group divisions. Full field uniform with long sleeves and special tactical shoes above ankle height in military colors are required. Additional civilian elements are only allowed if they match the uniform's colors. Approval is at the discretion of the race judge. Participants must be soldiers or officers of uniformed services, either on active duty or reserve. Cross-country terrain, online registration, participant limit until 09/15/2026, entry fees from 150 PLN to 200 PLN, start at 12:00 at the Municipal Stadium in Lubliniec.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The 17th Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, combining a passion for running with an active lifestyle. The event promotes health, integration, and joy of movement, inviting runners of various skill levels and ages. The races take place in the picturesque areas of Mysłowice, creating a friendly atmosphere and a running community. Participants can compete in running, Nordic walking, and canicross, and participation in the Grand Prix is free of charge.
course_highlights: Trails run through the forest above Bolina
Various competitions: running, Nordic walking, canicross
Picturesque areas of Mysłowice conducive to recreation and competition
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the events is free. The event attracts competitors from different cities and clubs, with women making up over 27%. Organizers ensure proper organization and support the integration of runners. The event includes various dates in 2026, focusing on community and promoting an active lifestyle.

name: Berliner Morgenpost Great 10K
price_range: 25,00 € bis 70,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Berlin Morning Post Great 10K is Berlin's fastest 10 km race starting in front of Charlottenburg Palace. The course takes runners through Berlin Zoo and offers a unique running experience in the capital. In addition to the classic 10-kilometer route, there is also a 2x5 km relay as well as a 4.2 km short course from the zoo to Charlottenburg Palace. The event is suitable for all performance levels and ages and features a large running festival for the whole family.
course_highlights: Start in front of Charlottenburg Palace
Course passes through Berlin Zoo
Running festival on the forecourt of Charlottenburg Palace
additional: Timing with shoe transponder, refreshment points and toilets along the route, pacemakers for 10 km and short course, online certificate with personal result, BVG tickets for relay runners, luggage transport from start to finish, medal engraving and event shirts as additional services, HD video of the finish line for purchase, children and toddler runs for ages 2014 to 2021. Course lengths: 10 km, 4.2 km, children and toddler runs, relay competitions; registration until October 20, 2024; start in front of Berlin Zoo, finish at Charlottenburg Palace; event extras such as medal engraving, photos, and videos available.

name: 19. Burger-Rolandlauf
description: The Burger Roland Run is a traditional race that usually takes place in Burg and is organized jointly by the Roland Gymnasium Burg and the LG Ihleläufer Burg. The course runs through the city along the Ihle, through the forest, and past the Bismarck Tower, with a finish at the schoolyard of the Gymnasium. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a lively supporting program with live music, children's activities, and refreshments. In 2026, the event in Burg was canceled due to lack of approval; instead, a replacement event will be held in the Tangerhütte city park.
course_highlights: Course runs through the city of Burg along the Ihle
Forest passage with views of the Bismarck Tower
Finish at the schoolyard of the Roland Gymnasium
additional: The traditional route in Burg was not approved in 2026. Instead, a replacement event will take place in the Tangerhütte city park. Already paid entry fees can be refunded. After the race, there will be a supporting program with music, children's activities, and refreshments. Cancellation in 2026, replacement event in Tangerhütte, course through Burg, children's program, bouncy castle, refreshments

name: Frühstückslauf
description: The breakfast run in Wernigerode is a communal run without timing, leading from the marketplace up to Wernigerode Castle. The route is approximately 3 kilometers long with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The run takes place in a group and is free of charge. After the run, a small snack is served, making it a social event.
course_highlights: Route approximately 3 km long
Elevation gain approximately 100 m
Group run up to Wernigerode Castle
additional: The run is free of charge, conducted in a group, and without timing. A small snack is served afterwards. Group run, no timing, subsequent snack.

name: H/21 Halbmarathon
description: The H/21 Half Marathon Hannover is a new running event in the national calendar, combining urban flair, modern beats, and green route sections. Start and finish are located in the city of Hannover, and the route passes by prominent hotspots through the state capital. The event takes place in autumn and offers a special running experience in a lively city environment. Join the prologue as Hannover writes a new chapter in running history.
course_highlights: Route combines urban flair with green sections
Start and finish in the city of Hannover
Route passes by prominent hotspots of the state capital
additional: Check-in takes place on October 10, 2026, with the start gun firing on October 11, 2026. The event is a fall highlight with urban flair and modern music. There are attractive side events, and the route is secured by security personnel. Participation is at your own risk, and the regulations of the DLV and IAAF apply. In 2026, the route will be run twice over 10 km, later covering the full half marathon distance; registration is open until the day of the event; race features a modern atmosphere and music.

name: München Marathon
price_range: 15 Euro bis 29,50 Euro (Shirt), variiert je nach Anmeldung
description: The Munich Marathon offers a diverse running experience in the Bavarian capital with the disciplines of marathon, half marathon, 10 km run, and marathon relay. The marathon course passes through the Olympic Park, Leopoldstraße, the English Garden, Munich city center, and ends in the Olympic Park. The half marathon starts in the English Garden and also finishes in the Olympic Park. The marathon relay allows teams to complete the 42.195 km together, with handovers at designated kilometer marks. Due to renovation work, the finish line is located at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympic Hall.
course_highlights: Marathon course with sights such as Olympic Park, Siegestor, English Garden, Isartor, Marienplatz, and Odeonsplatz
Half marathon starts at the Chinese Tower in the English Garden and ends in the Olympic Park
Marathon relay with four exchange points at km 9.5, 21.3, 27, and a joint finish
additional: The start and finish are located at Hans-Jochen-Vogel-Platz next to the Olympic Hall due to renovation work at the Olympic Stadium. Marathon relay teams can run the last meters together and receive their finisher medals collectively. The 10 km course is a loop from the Olympic Park through Schwabing and back. The half marathon is designed so that runners with finishing times of up to 3 hours can comfortably complete the distance. Registration is possible until September 27, 2026. The event also includes offerings for children and inclusive running events. The course runs through central Munich districts and provides a festive atmosphere for runners and spectators.

name: Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf
description: The Bad Hersfelder Lollslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Bad Hersfeld, attracting runners of all ages and skill levels. With various distances from a toddler run to a 10 km individual race, the Lollslauf offers a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting. In addition to the competition, community spirit and the joy of running are emphasized. The event is a fixture in the race calendar and draws participants from all over Germany.
course_highlights: 500m toddler run around the marketplace and the oldest folk festival in Germany
Various courses from 500m to 10 km with start and finish at Linggplatz
Run through the historic old town of Bad Hersfeld
additional: Start times: 1.3 km school run at 09:35, 5 km individual race at 10:00, 5 km team race at 10:10, 5 km Nordic walking at 11:30, 10 km individual race at 11:45, 500 m toddler run at 11:15. Certificates available for download digitally, drinks at the finish area. Team race with 5-7 persons per team possible. Trophies for overall winners. Multiple competition classes, registration on site possible, scenic course in Bad Hersfeld.

name: Berglauf
location: Geislingen an der Steige, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The mountain run of the Schneelaufverein Geislingen is a traditional event held annually in Geislingen an der Steige. The course leads uphill and offers runners a challenging experience in a scenic environment. The event attracts both ambitious runners and recreational athletes and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere. Registration is done via MY RACE RESULT, with the registration deadline typically shortly before the race.
course_highlights: Uphill course with a challenging elevation profile
Scenic environment in Geislingen an der Steige
Start and finish at the SVG mountain hut, Dorfstr. 70
additional: Registration and results are handled through MY RACE RESULT. The registration deadline is each Saturday before the race at 12:00 PM. The start and finish are at the SVG mountain hut in Geislingen an der Steige (district Weiler o. H.). The event takes place on October 11, 2026; course and elevation profile are available; registration is via Race Result; the venue is SVG Dorfstr. 70, Geislingen an der Steige.

name: Burscheider Stadtlauf
location: Burscheid, Rheinisch-Bergischer Kreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Burscheid City Run takes place on October 11, 2026, in the city center of Burscheid and offers an ideal environment for runners of all performance levels. There are various distances: the 10-kilometer main race, a 3-kilometer run, and an 800-meter race that serves as a qualification for the sports badge. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and is aimed at both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. All finishers receive the traditional Kretzer City Run bread, and the top places are awarded special trophies.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer main race through the city center
3-kilometer run for recreational athletes
800-meter youth race as a sports badge qualification
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event at the registration office with a late registration fee of €5.00, but late registrants do not receive the Kretzer City Run bread. Race packets will be distributed from 10:30 AM at the Protestant church. Changing rooms and showers are available at the sports hall "Auf dem Schulberg". Free drinks are available along the course and at the finish line. There is an age group classification according to DLO. First aid is provided by the German Red Cross, Burscheid branch. Bib numbers must be worn on the chest. The event also includes children's races, race packets from 10:30 AM, online results, age group classification, as well as medals and trophies. The weather in October is usually mild, making participation comfortable.

name: Citylauf Schwabach 2026
description: The RIBE City Run Schwabach on October 11, 2026 offers a diverse running program for all age groups and performance levels. The event includes courses such as half marathon, relay, main race, hobby run, walking, and children's runs. The races start and end at Königsplatz in Schwabach, and participants can expect a well-organized event with a family-friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the city and provides a special running experience in the goldsmith city of Schwabach.
course_highlights: Half marathon course approximately 21.1 km long
Start and finish at Königsplatz next to the town hall
Various running routes for children, teenagers, and adults
additional: Late registrations are only possible on race weekend if there are still starting places available. The starting spots are limited, and no on-site late registration is possible for fully booked competitions. Eligibility to participate is from 16 years old for main races, with a maximum time of 3 hours. Relay courses are approximately 7 km per segment. The start and finish locations are both at Königsplatz next to the town hall or at Fürstenherberge. Registration is open until October 4, 2026; there are various categories for different age groups and performance levels; refreshments are available at several points along the course.

name: Geilenkirchener Volkslauf und 34. Halbmarathon
description: The Geilenkirchen Volkslauf and Half Marathon is a traditional running event in Geilenkirchen-Gillrath, organized by DJK-Gillrath e. V. The event offers a flat half marathon course over 21.1 km as well as various other distances, including 10 km run, 10 km walking and Nordic walking, 4 km run, youth races, and a children's run. All races end at the Gillrath sports field, where race numbers are also issued. The event is suitable for both recreational runners and ambitious athletes and is part of a five-year series ranking as well as the RAC ranking.
course_highlights: Flat half marathon course, technically easy
4 km course wheelchair accessible
Competition for people with disabilities in 2.5 km and 4 km races
additional: Start and finish at Gillrath sports field; race number pickup on site at the race office; half marathon and 10 km run count towards the five-year series ranking and the RAC ranking; weather in October typically around 14 °C (day maximum) with 6 °C low and mostly cloudy. Multiple competitions for adults and children/youth; barrier-free course sections; participation in series and RAC rankings; registration on site at Gillrath sports field.

name: Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen
price_range: Super Early Bird Preise (spezifische Preise nicht angegeben)
description: The Hotfoot Run Bad Hönningen is an exciting obstacle race taking place on October 11, 2026, suitable for all performance levels with distances ranging from 7 to 26 kilometers. The course runs through the idyllic spa town of Bad Hönningen on the Rhine, passing vineyards, historic buildings, and offering varied terrain with many elevation changes. Participants can expect spectacular obstacles, mud, water slides, and a unique atmosphere with a spectacular starting show alongside the sporting challenge. The race is ideal for individual runners, teams, and families who want to experience fun and adventure together.
course_highlights: Along the legendary Rhine Path with spectacular views into the Rhine Valley
Narrow, steep passages and many elevation meters
Passing Castle Arenfels, two gravel pits, and an abandoned concrete plant
additional: Start and finish are located in the center of Bad Hönningen directly on the Rhine. There is a mega starting show with bands and DJs before the mass start. Group discounts are available for 6 or more participants. The Family Edition is for children from 12 years old with adult supervision on a 7 km course. There are various starting groups (Overachievers, Vertical Starters, Endurance Runners, Late Bloomers) for different performance levels. The event includes water and mud obstacles, group discounts upon registration, music, costumes, and various distances, including a family edition for children from 12 years old with supervision.

name: Int. Schwarzwald-Marathon
description: The Black Forest Marathon in Bräunlingen is a traditional race that has been held annually since 1968 and is known as the world's oldest nature and women's marathon. The course mainly runs over well-maintained forest paths and offers a varied natural experience with a gentle incline up to kilometer 21 and a slight descent afterward. In addition to the classic marathon, there is also a relay marathon, half marathon, 10 km runs, Nordic walking, and other races for different age groups. The event is ideal for runners who want to combine nature and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: 80% well-maintained forest paths, 20% asphalt
Gentle incline up to approx. km 21, then slight downhill
Kilometer markings throughout the course
additional: Late registrations are possible on October 10, 2026, from 12:00 to 18:00 and on October 11, 2026, from 07:00 until 60 minutes before the start at the town hall. The bib numbers are color-coded for better distinction of disciplines. No transfer is offered by the organizer for the relay marathon. Various race disciplines, on-site registration possible, bibs color-coded, program schedule may change at short notice.

name: Klosterlauf Aurachtal

price_tiers.distance: Hauptlauf, Hobbylauf, Jugendlauf B, Nordic Walking

description: The Klosterlauf Aurachtal is a running event with start and finish near the monastery church in Münchaurach. The routes are all kilometer-marked and mainly run on paved paths and gravel roads. Various competitions are offered, including a main race over 10 km, a hobby run, youth races, Nordic walking, as well as children’s and toddler races. The event is open to all healthy individuals with adequate training, membership in a club is not required.
course_highlights: Start and finish near the monastery church in Münchaurach
Routes mainly on paved paths and gravel roads
Kilometer-marked routes
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 1 hour before the respective start for an additional fee of €4. Registration is only valid after payment is received. Refund of the entry fee is possible up to 2 weeks before the competition date. The top 3 finishers in each age group (male/female) receive material prizes. The event is organized by an external service provider. The main race covers 10 km (2 laps), hobby run, youth race B, and Nordic walking 5 km (1 lap), children’s race approximately 1 km (round trip). Routes mainly on paved paths, online registration available, late registrations for a fee, participation from 18 years without club membership, prizes for the best in age groups.

name: Kreuzberglauf mit Ufr. Meisterschaften
location: Schönau an der Brend, Rhön-Region, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Kreuzberglauf in Schönau an der Brend is a traditional race event organized annually by DJK Olympia Schönau. The event attracts runners of various age and performance levels and offers a sporting challenge in the picturesque Rhön region. The course runs through diverse terrain and is part of the Lower Franconia Championships. Participants can look forward to a well-organized event with a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic Rhön region
Part of the Lower Franconia Championships
Varied terrain with diverse course sections
additional: The race takes place on October 11, 2026. Further details about registration and participation are available on the website.

name: Laubacher Ramsberglauf
price_range: bis 20. September vergünstigtes Startgeld, danach zzgl. Nachmeldegebühr
description: The Laubach Ramsberglauf is a traditional race event that starts and ends in the picturesque castle park of Laubach. The event offers various race distances for different age and performance groups, including a 10 km main race, a 5 km fun run, as well as children’s and kids’ races. The races feature a varied course that runs through the beautiful landscape around Laubach. The organization ensures a pleasant atmosphere with refreshments, changing facilities, and an award ceremony directly in the castle park.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Laubach castle park
Varied course through the landscape around Laubach
Refreshments and changing facilities in the sports and cultural hall
additional: Registration is via RACERESULT with a discounted entry fee until September 20, after which a late registration fee applies. Changing and shower facilities are available in the sports and cultural hall. The award ceremony takes place directly in the castle park. Courses: 10 km main race, 5 km fun run, children’s races over 1500 m and 300 m; registration via Raceresult; start and finish in the castle park; refreshments, changing and shower facilities on site; weather in October around 14°C, cloudy.

name: Offenbacher Mainuferlauf
description: The Offenbach Mainuferlauf is an open running event held annually along the Main riverbank in Offenbach. Offered distances include 5 km, 10 km, a half marathon, as well as a 2 km students' run. The course runs along the Main and offers an attractive river scenery, with short-term route changes in 2025 due to construction sites. The event is open to all runners, membership in a club is not required, and it features a family-friendly atmosphere with an engaged organizing team.
course_highlights: Run along the Main with attractive river scenery
Distances of 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
2 km students' run as a separate course
additional: Number bib distribution at Mathildenschule Offenbach, Arthur-Zitscher-Str. Parking garage in the city center near Berliner Straße is recommended (about 750 m away, fee of approximately 1 € per hour). Due to construction sites, the Mainstraße is closed, leading to short-term route changes. The course is not eligible for official rankings this year as no official measurement is possible. The half marathon starts approximately 350 m from the previous start. The 5 km and 10 km races start at the Main through the finish arch. The 2 km students' run starts unchanged at the Main. Photos of the event will be provided by Team Ingo Kutsche. Route changes due to construction, no official ranking course, registration opens on 1.8.2025, weather-dependent conditions, various race distances.

name: Porta Volkslauf
organizer: SC Nammen / SC Porta Westfalica Nammen e.V.
description: The Porta-Volkslauf 2026 is a traditional running event in Porta Westfalica that has been a fixed part of the regional race calendar for over three decades. The event attracts runners of all ages, from ambitious competitors to casual runners. The course runs over streets and field paths around the Nammer sports field and through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve, offering varied, flat sections with a magnificent panorama of the Porta. The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie and takes place at the local sports facility in Nammen. The friendly atmosphere and sense of community make the day a special experience.
course_highlights: Course over streets and field paths around the Nammer sports field
Sections through the Nammer Unterholz nature reserve
Flat and varied course sections with a panorama of the Porta
additional: The race is part of the Mühlenkreisserie (8th race 2026). Course maps for short distance (5.5 km), medium (8.8 km), and long distance (17 km) are available as PDFs. Registration will open soon. The event takes place at the sports facility in Nammen (Poggenbeeke). The courses are flat and offer unobstructed views of nature. Registration and course maps will be available soon. There will be drinks, coffee, cake, and bratwurst at the start-finish area.

name: Salzachbrückenlauf
description: The Salzachbrückenlauf starts and ends at the town square of Burghausen, below the castle of Burghausen, the longest castle complex in the world. The course runs along the Salzach River, which forms the border between Germany and Austria, and includes several border crossings. Various distances are offered, including a 505-meter parent-child run, a 3.2 km fun run, a 5.5 km walk, and the main race of 8.8 km. Over 1,000 participants take part annually, from children and hobby runners to club runners and fast athletes. The race is a charity event organized by nine volunteers, with proceeds supporting local needy people.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the town square of Burghausen below the castle
Course runs along the Salzach River and crosses the German-Austrian border
8.8 km course with four border crossings and sections on gravel paths at the bathing lake
additional: The race takes place annually under the patronage of Bürgerinsel Burghausen. The 8.8 km course includes a second lap and passes by a bathing lake and rowing lake. Typical weather in October is around 14 °C with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Multiple distances are offered, including a 505 m route, charity character, scenic surroundings around Burghausen, participation for children, hobby runners, and competitive athletes.

name: Sebastian Fredrich Gedenklauf (LM/LC/NLC)
description: The Sebastian Fredrich Memorial Run is a traditional race in Lubmin organized by the triathlon and running group of HSG Uni Greifswald. The event offers a sporting challenge in a friendly and well-organized atmosphere supported by many volunteers. The course runs through scenic sections and is suitable for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes. The event is part of an active running and triathlon community in Mecklenburg-Vorpommern.
course_highlights: Running course through scenic sections in Lubmin
Good organization with many helpers along the course and at the finish area
Traditional race with a high number of participants and a positive atmosphere

The event also offers special short distances for youth (U10, U12, U14) and promotes club spirit. The weather in October is usually mild, with temperatures around 14°C, and the event takes place at the seaside resort center near the Baltic Sea.

name: Sparkassen SAARathon
description: The Sparkassen SAARathon 2026 takes place on October 11 in Saarbrücken and offers suitable challenges for runners of all performance levels. The flat and fast courses run along the Saar River, offering magnificent views of Saarbrücken city and the diverse surroundings. In addition to the traditional 10 km Westspangenlauf, there is a young World Heritage Marathon, which will be held for the third time and leads runners to the Völklinger Hütte. The running event combines sporting challenge with scenic beauty and regional culture.
course_highlights: Flat and fast courses along the Saar
Magnificent views of Saarbrücken city and surroundings
World Heritage Marathon to Völklinger Hütte
additional: The event includes various distances: Marathon (with state championships), half marathon, 10 km, 5 km, and 1 km school run. The event is suitable for experienced runners and beginners. The 10 km course, the Westspangenlauf, has a 38-year tradition. The organizers are available by phone Monday to Friday from 8:30 am to 5:00 pm at 0681-927200. Courses for all performance levels, online registration, bib number pickup in Saarbrücken, discounts for groups and people with disabilities, pacemakers available.

name: Storkower See Lauf
description: The Storkower See Run is a traditional running event organized by the Triathlon Club Fürstenwalde 1990 e.V. and approved by the Brandenburg Athletics Association. On October 11, 2026, runners of various age groups and performance levels can participate on different distances around Lake Storkow. The event offers a fair competition atmosphere and is aimed at running enthusiasts of all ages. Online registration opens in January 2026, and participants will be listed in an official participant list.

Running routes around Lake Storkow
Start and finish area with modern race instructions

Award ceremonies will take place from approximately 11:00 AM. Registration becomes valid only upon receipt of payment. Online registration is possible; start times and distances vary. Suitable for runners of all performance levels.
