The courses are officially measured and listed in the running.de race calendar, enabling participation in the German best lists. The race is conducted according to the rules and safety standards of the German Athletics Association (DLV).

A variety of distances from 1 km to 100 km
Event takes place on Neustadtstraße in Styrum

The event also includes shorter distances such as 5 km, 7.5 km, 10 km, 15 km, 20 km, 25 km, as well as special runs for children and youth. The course runs through Neustadtstraße and Sportpark Styrum, with cool October weather averaging 14°C. The event is listed in the official race calendar and complies with the standards of the German Athletics Association.

The course is a measured, flat 5 km loop, also suitable for Nordic walking.

800 m children's run in the tree park directly at Schloss Erbhof

name: Trochtelfinger Nordic Walking Stöckles-Cup

description: The Trochtelfingen Stöckles Cup is a popular Nordic walking nature run on the Swabian Alb, held annually on the second October weekend in Trochtelfingen. The event offers two course lengths of approximately 9 km and 13 km, which lead through the gentle hills of the Sonnenalb and are marked with arrows. Participants can look forward to a friendly atmosphere, a refreshment station along the route, and a raffle with valuable prizes. The run is open to everyone, with or without poles, and promotes fun in movement for young and old.

Refreshment station along the route and marked courses

Participants receive a transponder timing and an online certificate. There are no age or category classifications, only a finisher list for women and men. Trophies are awarded to the three largest groups. A raffle with high-quality prizes begins at 1:15 PM. Refreshments including a standing snack, coffee, and cake are available from 10 AM by TSV Trochtelfingen. The event starts and ends at Tommis Sportshop in Trochtelfingen. Children up to 12 years can participate free of charge. Groups of 10 or more persons receive a discount. The routes are marked, and there is a refreshment station. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels.

name: Wendlandmarathon

The event offers a wide range of distances from the marathon to half marathon and short children's runs, appealing to both long-distance runners and families. The course is measured according to AIMS/IAAF standards and features kilometer markers as well as refreshment stations. Participants have access to practical facilities such as parking, showers, changing rooms, certificates, and finisher medals for children.
course_highlights: Road race with course measured according to AIMS/IAAF standards

Course length up to 42.2 km, on-course refreshments, finisher medals, parking, showers, changing rooms, registration online or on-site.

name: Westenergie Marathon
description: The Westenergie Marathon in Essen is a traditional race around the picturesque Baldeneysee. The event offers not only the classic marathon but also the Westenergie Seerunde, the AllbauTeamStaffel relay race, a mini-marathon for children, and a Walking Day. The course impresses with its scenic beauty and proximity to the lake shore, making the race a special experience for runners of all ages. The event is well organized and attracts numerous participants each year.

For children, there is a mini-marathon over 1.1 km with prizes and medals for all participants. Photobello offers race photos. The Walking Day routes feature various distances with beautiful lake views and also pass through the landscape protection area Heisinger Aue. The marathon is Germany's oldest continuously held marathon, with a flat, fast course, multiple race disciplines, and regional sponsorship. Results and certificates are available online.

name: Borský kros

The organizers ensure a pleasant atmosphere and a high-quality sporting experience for all participants.

The longest course is approximately 6 km for men, women run 2 km, and youth courses range from 300 m to 1500 m. The race is run on a grassy surface, spikes are recommended. Category starts are staggered to allow everyone to have Sunday lunch, and the results are announced shortly after the last men's category finishes.

Longest course approximately 6 km for men, 2 km for women
Staggered category starts with minimal delays
additional: Registration begins at 8:30 AM at the swimming pool. Categories start sequentially with minimal delays to ensure everyone can have Sunday lunch. Spikes suitable for grassy surfaces are recommended. The race is open to the general public, starting at 9:30 AM, with registration from 8:30 AM at the swimming pool. Courses are suitable for all age groups.

name: Lesní běh Říčany XCR
description: The Forest Run Říčany XCR is a popular forest race held in Říčany, offering courses suitable for all age groups from children to veterans. The event is intended not only for sports enthusiasts but also for families with children, who can enjoy running on shorter routes adapted to the age of the participants. Organizer Bežecký klub Říčany invites everyone to active outdoor activity and participation in this traditional event.

Course lengths of 11 km and 5.7 km for adults

description: The Strand Run is a specific uphill running race held at Stránská skála in Brno-Slatině. Participants start individually at one-minute intervals, allowing focused effort on a 450-meter course with an elevation gain of 47 meters. The route goes along a rocky and grassy path, and the race is divided into several age categories from younger pupils to veterans. After finishing, it is necessary to return the bib number, and the results are announced after the last runner finishes. Registration takes place on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00, with the start at 10:01.

Individual starts at one-minute intervals

The race is held in October, with start times from 9:00 to 10:00, registration from 9:00, and an entry fee of 50 CZK. The race is open to the general public, including children and adults.

description: The Cracovia Royal Half Marathon is an international half marathon held in Kraków, a city with a thousand-year tradition and former residence of Polish kings. description: Piwna Mila is a unique race with an adjustable distance from 1700 to 2000 meters, and is the most important event on the third day of the Sun Festival in Wąsowo. Participants start by drinking a beer, and approximately every 500 meters there are refreshment points with beer. This sporting celebration combines runners, spectators, and entire families, offering a unique atmosphere and a special medal for completing the race.
course_highlights: Flexible distance 1700 - 2000 m
Refreshment points with beer every 500 m
Race start by drinking a beer
additional: The start package includes a bib with a chip for timing and 4 craft beers along the route. The bib must be worn on the front of the outfit and cannot be covered or modified. A T-shirt can be ordered during the registration fee payment in the Runner's Panel. The race office is open on 14.08.2026 (17:00 - 19:00), 15.08.2026 (7:00 - 11:00), and 16.08.2026 (11:00 - 11:45). The flexible distance is 1700-2000 meters, beer on the route, online registration from January 1, 2026, to August 12, 2026, with the option to order a T-shirt during the registration fee payment.

name: UltraKotlina
location: Szklarska Poręba, Jelenia Góra County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: UltraKotlina is a mountain ultramarathon held in the Jelenia Góra Valley, covering scenic ranges of Rudawy Janowickie, Gór Kaczawskich, Izerskie, and Karkonosze. The event offers six distances from 15 km to 142 km and a relay race, with the finish line in Szklarska Poręba. The routes are marked and lead through well-known trails and peaceful off-road paths, allowing both experienced ultramarathon runners and beginners to enjoy every kilometer. The event is also an opportunity to bring the running community together and promote the region.
course_highlights: Routes pass through four mountain ranges: Rudawy Janowickie, Gór Kaczawskie, Izerskie, and Karkonosze
Route marked with white tape with reflectors, chalk spray, and directional signs
Scenic views and the opportunity to admire the Jelenia Góra Valley from various points
additional: The start package can be collected at the event base or just before the start. The organizer provides buses to the start from the finish line. The route is marked with tape with reflectors, chalk spray, and signs. The race office operates at different locations and times from October 9 to 11. The time limit for individual distances ranges from 3 to 30 hours. Route verification takes place at control points, where participants must confirm their start number. Distances include ultramarathons and trail running, with mountain and technical control points, and the event is scheduled for October 2026.

name: XIV Biegi Przyjaźni
description: Friendship Run is one of the events within the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland. The race takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Skrzeszewo, offering participants the opportunity to spend active time and discover the charms of Kaszuby. The running series attracts runners of various ages and skill levels, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the integration of the local community.
course_highlights: The route runs through scenic areas of Kaszuby
The race takes place in a natural, friendly environment
The event is part of the Kaszuby Biegają series, the largest running event in northern Poland
additional: The event will take place on October 11, 2026, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. Participants can expect a medal, prizes, raffles, and refreshments.

name: Běh na Kraví horu
location: Kraví hora, Teplice nad Metují, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kraví Hora Run is a public uphill running race with a mass start, held in the picturesque environment of Kraví Hora in Teplice nad Metují. This race is part of the running hill series and offers athletes a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent and beautiful views. The race has a long-standing tradition and is popular among runners who want to test their strength in mountain terrain. Organized by Redpoint Teplice nad Metují, it ensures quality organization and a pleasant race atmosphere.
course_highlights: Challenging uphill run with a mass start
Picturesque environment of Kraví Hora in Teplice nad Metují
Part of the running hill series and hill climbing league
additional: The race takes place on urban and hill terrain, registration and results are managed using professional chip timing, parking and transportation information are available on the website.

name: Běh Heulosem - memoriál Jiřího Šmrhy
location: Lesopark Heulos, Jihlava, Vysočina, Czech Republic
description: Heulose Run - Jiří Šmrha Memorial is a traditional running race organized in the Heulos forest park in Jihlava. The race offers various categories and distances for men, women, veterans, juniors, youth, and children, with color-coded circuits along paths and trails in the forest park. The event has a long-standing tradition since 1977 and is part of the Vysočina Runners series. The start is in the afternoon at the Na Stoupách athletics stadium, with routes suitable for a wide range of runners from the youngest to veterans.
course_highlights: Color-coded circuits along paths and trails in Heulos forest park
Various distances from 300 m for the youngest to 9 km for men and veterans
Start and finish at Na Stoupách athletics stadium in Jihlava
additional: Categories include men, women, veterans, juniors, youth, and children with different race distances. Prizes are awarded to the top three in each category, and youth receive medals and material prizes. This is the 49th edition of the race, supported by the statutory city of Jihlava and the Czech Sports Office. The race is open to the general public, offers trail routes in nature, and is part of the Vysočina Running Cup. The date is set for October 16, 2026.

name: Altmühltrail
price_range: ca. 28-56 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Altmühltrail 2026 takes place on October 17th in Dollnstein in the Altmühltal Nature Park and offers a unique trail running experience that combines sport, nature, and enjoyment. The course leads over challenging trails, impressive rock formations, dense forests, and scenic ridges. In addition to the sporting challenge, enjoyment stations with regional specialties provide a special experience. The children's race with a trail obstacle course also offers young runners the opportunity to gain their first experience.
course_highlights: Challenging trails through the Altmühltal
Impressive rock formations and dense forests
Enjoyment stations with regional specialties along the route
additional: Start of the long-distance hikers and Nordic walkers without timing at 09:30 AM, long-distance runners with timing at 11:30 AM, short-distance runners with timing at 12:00 PM, short-distance hikers and Nordic walkers without timing at 12:15 PM. Race packet distribution on the day before from 5:30 PM to 6:30 PM and on race day from 8:30 AM to 12:00 PM (children's race only until 10:00 AM). Registration opens on February 16, 2026 at 4:02 PM, capacity is quickly reached, and there is a waiting list. The children's race can still be registered separately. Participation in trail running, Nordic walking, or hiking is possible, with catering, showers, awards ceremony, age restrictions.

name: Bad Dürkheimer Berglauf mit RLP-Meisterschaft
location: Sporthalle der Berufsbildenden Schulen, Bad Dürkheim, Bad Dürkheim, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The 29th Bad Dürkheim Mountain Run with Rhineland-Palatinate Championship will take place on October 17, 2026. The course runs from the sports hall of the vocational schools in Bad Dürkheim up to the Bismarck Tower on Peterskopf. Over a distance of 8.7 km, 510 meters of elevation must be overcome, mainly on varied forest paths and trails with stones, roots, and stairs. The race is an officially approved competition by the German Athletics Association (DLV) with various age categories and a team classification. The event offers not only the sporting competition but also a friendly atmosphere with catering and return transport for participants.
course_highlights: 8.7 km long course with 510 meters of elevation
Start at 123 m above sea level, finish at the Bismarck Tower at 493 m above sea level
Varied natural course with forest paths, narrow trails, stones, roots, and stairs
additional: The registration fee includes fees for the association and mountain run cup, timing, rental chip (to be returned at the finish), clothing bag and transport, athlete's drink, bananas, rental cup (to be returned at the finish), photo frame, bus transfer, champagne stand on the return route, as well as free certificate printing via my.raceresult.com. Late registrations are possible on-site but not for the Rhineland-Palatinate Championship. Prizes and special awards will be given at the award ceremony; only present participants will receive prizes. Hilly natural course, trails with stones, roots, stairs; online registration; parking fees nearby; bus transfer included.

name: Bottwartal-Marathon Run und Fun Day
location: Steinheim an der Murr, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Bottwartal Marathon is a unique running spectacle set in the picturesque landscape of southern Germany. The course takes you through gentle vineyard slopes, idyllic old towns, and offers an exhilarating atmosphere at the roadside. Whether beginner or ambitious runner, everyone will find their highlight here. In addition to the marathon, there are a variety of running options from 5 km to ultra, suitable for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Run through historic old towns such as Großbottwar and Steinheim
Course runs along the Bottwar River and through vineyards
Flat finish at the Steppi roundabout in Steinheim
additional: Monthly free training runs with pace groups and guides for preparation. Summer runs during the summer holidays every Tuesday evening. Year-end run with 10 km and afterwards punch and mulled wine. The OPR30 run is limited to 150 participants. All runs have refreshment stations approximately every 5 km. Late registrations are possible until shortly before the event, registration via Datasport. Various distances, including children’s and inclusion runs, registration via Datasport, GPS-based course measurement, medals at the finish line.

name: ENSINGER Laufcup
location: Vaihingen an der Enz, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
description: The Ensinger Laufcup on October 17, 2026, offers runners of all ages and performance levels suitable distances in the beautiful region of Vaihingen an der Enz. The event includes various races from children’s runs to challenging trail courses of up to 24 kilometers and up to 700 meters of elevation gain. Participants can enjoy the diverse landscape with asphalt, gravel paths, and trails. Additionally, the Laufcup is part of a regional sponsorship program that supports schools and promotes community engagement.
course_highlights: Varied courses from 550 m to 24 km with up to 700 meters of elevation
Mix of asphalt, gravel forest paths, and trails
Start and finish area in front of the Ensinger Kelter with good public transport connections
additional: Online registration closes on October 8, 2026, at 23:59. Late registrations are possible online from October 9 to 17, 2026, against a late registration fee, but only if starting places are available. All participants receive a medal at the finish. The event is part of the school sponsorship project of the Alison and Peter Klein Foundation, which covers registration fees and donates €5 to the respective school for each finisher. The start and finish area is at the square in front of the Ensinger Kelter in St. Veith-Straße. Parking is only allowed in designated areas; public transport is recommended. Multiple race distances, trail and asphalt routes, detailed course information available.

name: Falke-Rothaarsteigmarathon
location: Schmallenberger Sauerland, Hochsauerlandkreis, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 23rd FALKE Rothaarsteig-Marathon will take place on October 17, 2026, in Schmallenberger Sauerland. The event offers disciplines for marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, and a 12.5 km AOK run. The course runs through the scenic region of the Rothaar Mountains and is recognized as an approved popular race by the DLV. Over 1,000 active runners participate annually and enjoy the varied trail and forest landscape.
course_highlights: Scenic course in the Rothaar Mountains
Approved popular race with DLV recognition
Various disciplines: marathon, half marathon, walking, Nordic walking, 12.5 km AOK run
additional: Registrations are possible from May 1, 2026. Late registrations are accepted until half an hour before the respective start. The start times are staggered: marathon at 11:00 AM, half marathon at 12:00 PM, walking and Nordic walking at 12:15 PM, AOK run at 11:45 AM. The event location is Latroper-Str. 57392 Fleckenberg in Schmallenberger Sauerland. Registration begins on May 1, 2026. No dog runs are permitted. Detailed course description available. Start times and organizational information can be found on the website.

name: Hachenburger Löwenlauf
description: The Hachenburg Lion Run is a traditional race with a family-friendly character, taking place on October 17, 2026, in Hachenburg. The event offers various distances, including a half marathon, 10.5 km run, 6.3 km fun/run team race, as well as children's races. The courses lead through diverse landscapes of the Westerwald with appealing elevation changes and beautiful views. Since 1989, the proceeds from the race have been donated to social projects, giving the race a special social significance.
course_highlights: Half marathon with the highest point at Gräbersberg (513 m) and varied ascents and descents
10.5 km run mostly on forest paths with the highest point at 439 m above sea level
Start and finish area at the round sports hall in Hachenburg with changing and shower facilities
additional: Electronic timing without chip, certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, special prize for the largest team participation in the team race. Late registration possible on October 16 from 17:00 and on the event day from 09:00. Refreshments with electrolytes, water, tea, cola, and fruit available on the course and at the finish. Changing and shower facilities available at the round sports hall. Various race distances (half marathon, 10.5 km, 6.3 km team and fun run, children's races), start and finish area at Lohmühle, Hachenburg, electronic timing (without chip), certificates for all finishers, prizes for class winners, refreshments on the course and at the finish, registration only online.

name: Herbstlauf der DJK Feudenheim

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei Anmeldung bis zum 11.10.2026 gelten vergünstige Anmeldegebühren.

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Bei Anmeldung bis zum 11.10.2026 gelten vergünstige Anmeldegebühren.

description: The autumn run organized by DJK Feudenheim is a traditional race event in Mannheim-Feudenheim, taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 35th time. The main race covers a 10 km course, to be completed in three laps, with a time limit of 90 minutes. In addition to the main race, there is also a fun run as well as other races for children, toddlers, and inclusion. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with refreshments, changing and shower facilities, and an award ceremony immediately after the races. Registration opens on June 1, 2026, with discounted fees for entries received by October 11, 2026.
course_highlights: 10 km main race in three laps with a 90-minute time limit
Event takes place in all weather conditions
Start and finish at the sports facility of DJK Feudenheim
additional: Timing is done with a transponder on the back of the start number, which must be visibly worn at the front of the upper body. There are no beverage stations on the course; self-supply is required. Warm tea, changing and shower facilities, as well as medical services, are available at the finish. Wearing headphones is not permitted for safety reasons. The award ceremony takes place after the races in front of the tents. Pre-registration from July 1, 2024. The race takes place in all weather conditions, as part of the Engelhorn Sports Run Cup. On-site registration is possible.

name: Herbstlauf des LSV Porz
organizer: LSV Porz / Kölner Lauf- und Nordic-Walkingteam
description: The autumn run of LSV Porz is the oldest road race in Cologne and takes place in the picturesque leisure area of Leidenhausen. The event offers distances from 1 km to 10 km, which are measured according to the guidelines of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and are eligible for best lists. Both ambitious runners and recreational joggers can enjoy the autumnal idyll while running. The 5 km loop is considered one of the fastest running routes in Cologne and the surrounding area and is often used by top runners to check their form.
course_highlights: Running routes in the leisure area of Leidenhausen in autumnal surroundings
5 km loop as one of the fastest running routes in Cologne
Course measurement according to DLV guidelines, eligible for best lists
additional: Start number must be worn on the chest. Timing is provided by time-and-voice.com. Late registration on the event day is possible for a fee of 2 €, students are exempt from the fee. Liability disclaimer for thefts, accidents, or other damages. Payment via SEPA direct debit a few days before the event. No fee will be charged if the event is canceled. Course measured, registration until 14.10.2025, start times from 11:00 am, parking available nearby, participation in running and Nordic walking events.

name: Krummenseelauf
description: The Krummenseelauf is a traditional road race in Mittenwalde, Brandenburg, organized by WSG 1981 Königs Wusterhausen since 1980. The course runs around Lake Krummensee, which is the central feature of the event. Three distances are offered (3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km) as well as Nordic Walking, all starting in the morning. The event typically takes place in autumn and is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup, making it attractive for both beginners and experienced runners.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Krummensee
Start at Krummenseer Straße at the sports field in Schenkendorf
Road race with distances of 3.6 km, 7.2 km, and 15 km
additional: All runs and Nordic Walking events start in the morning within a few minutes of each other. The event is part of the Oder-Spree-Cup and typically takes place in autumn with an average temperature of 14 °C. The event occurs in October, with start and finish in Schenkendorf, Mittenwalde. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the beautiful course around Lake Krummensee.

name: Oberwaldlauf
description: The Oberwaldlauf is an annual race held on the third Saturday in October over 5 km and 10 km through the Oberwald in Karlsruhe. The courses are officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association (Deutscher Leichtathletik-Verband), ensuring the possibility of record listings. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with catering, changing rooms, showers, and a varied program for all participants. Start and finish are located near the clubhouse of TUS Rüppurr, which is also used for bib number distribution and late registrations.
course_highlights: Run through the Karlsruhe Oberwald on well-maintained forest paths and partly paved sections
Officially measured courses over 5 km and 10 km, approved by the DLV
Bib number distribution and late registration in a tent behind the clubhouse
additional: Bib number distribution and late registration from 13:00 to 14:00 in a tent behind the garages near the clubhouse. Free water, tea, and bananas at the finish area for all runners. Toilets, changing rooms, and showers are available in the basement of the clubhouse and in the nearby Eichelgartenhalle. During the event, there will be waffles, coffee, cake, drinks, fries, and sausages. From 13:00, a mobile play area with a bouncy castle and a stand area with catering will be available. The courses include asphalt and forest paths, with family and youth runs, and catering at the finish area.

name: Panoramalauf Niedenstein
description: The 24th Niedensteiner Panorama Run will take place on October 17, 2026, in Niedenstein. The event is organized by SG 1898 Chattengau e.V. and the Niedenstein Running Group. The race offers an attractive course around the Hessenturm Stadium and the club house, set in the beautiful landscape of the region. Participants can look forward to a well-organized running event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Hessenturm Stadium in Niedenstein
Run through the picturesque surroundings of Niedenstein
Event as part of the Schwalm-Eder Running Cup
additional: Hilly terrain, family-friendly, children and youth races, finish at Hessenturm Stadium

name: Prignitzer Moormeile
description: The Prignitz Moon Race in Bad Wilsnack is a traditional run taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 26th time. The event offers various distances from 1 km to 12.4 km, running through Wilsnack forests, the spa park, and around the Karthane Hall. The races are suitable for children, teenagers, and adults and are part of the Prignitz Cup as well as the Brandenburg Cup. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good catering along the route, and professional timing.
course_highlights: 12.4 km and 7.8 km through Wilsnack forests on asphalt and forest paths
3 km course through the spa park
1 km loop course in front of the Karthane Hall
additional: Late registrations are possible on the race day from 08:00 to 09:30, provided the maximum number of participants, 550, has not been reached. The late registration fee is 5 euros in addition to the race fee. Start and finish are at the Karthane Hall in Bad Wilsnack, which also offers showers and toilets. Overall winners receive trophies. Dogs are not allowed during the race. There are refreshment stations on the longer routes. The event offers online registration, catering, showers, and prizes for the top runners. The Moon Race is also known for notable guests such as Dieter Baumann and high participant numbers.

name: Rottachseelauf 2026
description: The Rottachsee Run is a traditional race in Oy-Mittelberg, taking place on October 17, 2026, for the 35th time. Various distances are offered for different age groups, including a main race over 15 kilometers for participants aged 16 and above, as well as children's runs over 2.4 km and 1.2 km. The event is open to runners of all ages and provides a sporting challenge in a beautiful setting. Registration opens in mid-August 2026.
course_highlights: Main race over 15 kilometers
Children's runs over 2.4 km and 1.2 km
Event in the scenic region of Oy-Mittelberg
additional: Registration is via the TSV Petersthal website, with the registration deadline on the day before the race. The event takes place in the picturesque surroundings of Oy-Mittelberg, typically in October conditions with temperatures around 6-14°C and approximately 40 mm of precipitation.

name: Schloss Cross Laupheim
description: The Schloss-Cross Laupheim is a varied cross-country race that takes place on a 1,550-meter loop through the picturesque Schlosspark of Laupheim. Various competitions are offered, including a main race over 9.3 kilometers, a recreational run over 4.65 kilometers, a Nordic walking competition over 6.3 kilometers, and children's races over 1.55 kilometers. The course starts at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße near the cultural center and runs over gravel, cobblestone, and paved paths with an elevation change of 19 meters. The race offers an attractive program for both ambitious runners and recreational and children's runners.
course_highlights: 1,550-meter loop through the Laupheim Schlosspark
Start at the archway on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße near the cultural center
Course with gravel, cobblestone, and asphalt paths with 19 meters of elevation change
additional: In addition to the main race, there are recreational runs, a Nordic walking competition, and children's races. The course has an elevation difference of 19 meters per lap. The start is at the cultural center on Klaus-Graf-Stauffenberg-Straße. Training plans for preparation are offered. The event is organized by Alpsee Bergwelt and features not only the main race but also children's races, Nordic walking, and a school class cup. Exact start times and further details are available on the official website and Facebook page.

name: Schwindegger VR-Bank 6h-Lauf (Deutsche Meisterschaft der DUV)
description: The Schwindegger VR-Bank 6-hour run is the German Championship of the DUV in the 6-hour run and takes place on October 17, 2026, in Schwindegg. The event is aimed at ultrarunners who want to demonstrate their endurance on a flat, well-marked course. The run offers both individual and relay competitions and is a highlight in the German ultrarunning calendar. The friendly atmosphere and long-standing tradition make the VR-Bank 6-hour run a special experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Flat, well-marked loop course
German Championship in the 6-hour run
Event for individual and relay participants
additional: The run takes place on a flat loop course suitable for individual and relay participants. The event is part of the DUV German Championships in the 6-hour run. It is organized by a friendly running group dedicated to ultrarunning. 6-hour ultramarathon, German championship, paved course, charity event for children's cancer aid BALU.

name: Steigerwald - Fackellauf 2026
location: Burghaslach, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Steigerwald Torch Run has been organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach for the 39th time and traditionally takes place on the third Saturday in October. The race offers runners of all performance levels the opportunity to run together through the beautiful landscape of the Steigerwald. The event is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar and promotes community and the fun of running.
course_highlights: Traditional race through the Steigerwald region
Event on the third Saturday in October
Organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach
additional: Registration for the Burghaslacher Torch Run 2026 is possible via the official website. The event is organized by the athletics department of TSV Burghaslach. There are no explicit details about start times, prize categories, or different distances on the website. The event also includes children's runs, community celebrations in the TSV hall, and a festive running atmosphere with food, drinks, and prizes. The main race is regularly won by local personalities, and the event attracts numerous participants from the region.

name: TeutoMarsch
location: Grundschule Hohne, Lengerich-Hohne, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Teutomarsch is a unique hiking and running experience through the Teutoburg Forest and the surrounding area. Organized by the Turnverein Hohne von 1911 e.V. in Lengerich, the Teutomarsch offers two routes designed to inspire participants. The event is very popular and the starting spots are quickly filled. The exact course layout is still being finalized but promises a great and unique route. Participants must be at least 16 years old, and dogs are allowed on a leash.
course_highlights: Unique course through the Teutoburg Forest and surrounding area
Two different routes for a special experience
Nature experience in the Lengerich-Hohne region
additional: Registration for the Teutomarsch 2026 was fully booked within 30 minutes with 500 starting places. There is a waiting list. Participants agree to photo and video recordings and their publication. No refund of entry fees. Minimum age 16 years. Dogs are allowed on a leash. The organizer assumes no liability for personal or property damage as well as loss or theft. Trail running, no timing, refreshment stations along the route, start & finish at the Hohne elementary school, participant limit 500.

name: Vellberger Volkslauf
description: The Vellberg Volkslauf is a local running event in Vellberg, Baden-Württemberg, organized by TSV Vellberg e.V. It is part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series, which also includes races in Michelfeld, Gaildorf, and Bibersfeld. The event offers a classic 10 km run as well as a 400 m race for different age groups. Registration is exclusively online, with late registration possible up to 45 minutes before the respective start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing, and certificates can be printed on-site by participants.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km run
Additional 400 m race
Event in the picturesque town of Vellberg
additional: Late registration is possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Timing is provided by Speed Timing. Certificates can be printed on-site at a terminal. Distances include 400 m and 10 km; registration online; part of the Stadtwerke Läuft bei dir series.

name: Půlmaraton Český les
location: Nemanice, Český les, Plzeňský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 500 Kč předem / 600 Kč na místě (21 km), 300 Kč předem / 400 Kč na místě (7 km)
description: The Český les Half Marathon is a traditional trail run held in the picturesque nature of the Český les in the village of Nemanice. The race offers two routes, 21 km with an elevation gain of 520 m and 7 km with an elevation gain of 80 m, which lead through beautiful scenery with the option to download a GPX route. The longer course declares absolute winners and categories by age, while the shorter course awards the three fastest men and women. The start and finish are located directly in Nemanice with parking available at the start area.
course_highlights: 21 km course with 520 m elevation gain in the Český les nature
7 km course with 80 m elevation gain suitable for fast runners
Start and finish directly in Nemanice with parking at the race site
additional: Parking is available directly at the start and finish. On the 21 km course, absolute winners and 10 age categories for men and women are announced. On the 7 km course, the top 3 men and women are awarded. GPX race routes are available for download. Trail race with accessible GPX routes, registration and categories for men and women, the race is part of the Trail Running Cup series.

name: 5 a 10 km VAŠÍ LIGY 2026 (11) – říjnový
description: The 5 km and 10 km races of YOUR LEAGUE are regular running events in Prague Braník, offering a pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River. The race is part of the 16th edition of the running league, where runners can compare their performance with others and with their previous results. The course is certified, and on the 10 km distance, it is possible to achieve the limit for the Czech Championships. After the race, a relaxed atmosphere is guaranteed with refreshments and the announcement of the best runners.
course_highlights: Pleasant and fast course along the Vltava River in Prague Braník
Course measured with a certified device
Opportunity to meet the limit for the Czech Championships on 10 km
additional: Registration from 18:00, start of 10 km at 19:00, start of 5 km at 19:05. After the race, refreshments and the announcement of the best runners. Possibility to store luggage in the organizer’s tent. Recommended parking at P+R Nádraží Braník, public transport by tram and bus. After the race, free isotonic drink. The race is part of a league with rewards for the best and most loyal runners, including medals and prizes from partners. Registration is via the website, winners and regular runners have the chance to win prizes. The race is part of a series of runs in Prague.

name: Běh kolem Ameriky
location: Lesní park Amerika, Písek, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Run Around America is the oldest forest running race in the Czech Republic and the third oldest race overall, held since 1925 in the America Forest Park in Písek. This terrain race has a tradition of over 100 editions and offers a challenging course of 10.4 km, which has evolved over the years. The race is popular among runners and local residents and is known for its history and atmosphere in a natural environment. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s., and is internationally recognized through cooperation with partner cities in England and Germany.
course_highlights: Forest terrain in America Nature Park
A 10.4 km course with historical significance
A traditional race with over 100 years of history
additional: The race takes place in America Nature Park in Písek and is the oldest terrain race in the Czech Republic. It is organized by Atletika Písek, z.s. The race has a rich history with several categories and is internationally recognized. The 100th anniversary will be celebrated in 2026. In the past, the race was interrupted several times (1942, 2020). The oldest forest run in the Czech Republic, terrain course, 100th anniversary in 2026.

name: ČEZ RunTour Pardubice
location: Velké pardubické závodiště, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: CEZ RunTour Pardubice is a family running race offering seven different runs for all age groups and skill levels. The courses range from 500 meters for the youngest to a half marathon, providing a challenge for everyone. The race takes place at the Velké pardubické racecourse and, besides the sporting experience, offers a rich accompanying program for the whole family. Participants receive a start package and contribute to charity. The atmosphere is friendly and supportive of both amateurs and elite runners.
course_highlights: The course includes distances of 3, 5, 10, and 21.1 km, children's runs of 500 and 1000 m
Start and finish at the Velké pardubické racecourse with a unique atmosphere
Refreshment stations on the course, at the half marathon at least twice
additional: The race offers a special emergency service phone line during the event. Each runner receives a gymsack with gifts from partners. For children, a start package from Lidl and a supervised children's corner are prepared. There are pacemakers on the course to help runners achieve their target times. At the finish line, refreshments are available for children's runs and longer distances have refreshment stations. The event includes multiple courses, medals for participants, refreshment stations, changing rooms, showers, medical support, and post-race photography.

name: Běh podél Halštrova
location: Pramen Halštrova, Aš, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: The run along Halštrov is a traditional race organized by the Jasan Aš Ski Club, held in October at the source of Halštrov. The race offers a running experience in the beautiful nature of Aš and its surroundings, suitable for active athletes and runners seeking a challenge. The Jasan Aš Club is known for its long-standing tradition and support of running activities in the region.
course_highlights: The route runs along the source of Halštrov in a natural environment
Beautiful views and forest terrain around Aš
The race is part of the autumn running calendar of the Jasan Aš club
additional: The event is associated with the end of the running season, offers refreshments at the finish line, and is open to the general public including children.

name: Od radnice k radnici
organizer: Okresní sdružení České unie sportu Náchod
description: From Town Hall to Town Hall is a traditional children's running race organized by the District Association of the Czech Union of Sport Náchod. In 2026, the 7th edition of this event will take place, offering several categories based on children's ages with distances from 150 to 1200 meters. The race is primarily intended for young runners and promotes sports activity among children in the Náchod region. The starts are sequentially from 9:00 AM according to age categories. The event is part of the broader sports program of the Czech Union of Sport in the region.
course_highlights: Categories from the youngest children (born in 2021 and later) to older pupils (2011-2012)
Distances from 150 m to 1200 m tailored to age
Starts divided by categories on a schedule from 9:00 to 10:25
additional: The race is divided into categories based on birth years with a precise start schedule. Results from previous editions are available online. The event is part of the broader sports program of the Czech Union of Sport in the Náchod region. The event takes place within the regional sports calendar, registration is through sportchallenge.cz, and it is suitable for all age groups.

name: Silniční běh Hronov-Náchod
description: The Hronov-Náchod Road Race is a traditional running event with a long-standing history, connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod. The race starts at the town hall in Hronov and finishes at the town hall in Náchod. It offers an opportunity for runners of all levels to enjoy a beautiful route in a picturesque setting. The event is popular among locals and visitors and creates a friendly sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Start and finish at the town halls of both towns
Picturesque environment in Eastern Bohemia
additional: Start at 11:00 AM, the route includes asphalt and cobblestone roads, the race is open to the general public

name: Malá křivoklátská
description: The Small Křivoklát Forest Run is a traditional forest race with a long history dating back to 1973, held in the picturesque valley of the Rakovnický Stream beneath Křivoklát Castle. The main race covers 6,000 meters and is run on two loops with slight elevation changes and a combination of forest paths, asphalt roads, and a ford across the stream. A course for children is available, measuring 600 meters with a flat profile at the Kolečko sports ground. The race facilities are located at Kolečko sports ground, which belongs to the Sokol Křivoklát unit, the event organizer.
course_highlights: Forest run in the valley of Rakovnický Stream beneath Křivoklát Castle
Main course 6000 m on two loops with elevation and ford across the stream
Children's course 600 m flat at Kolečko sports ground
additional: Race facilities and start/finish are at Kolečko sports ground. The main race starts in a mass start, with the course passing over footbridges and a ford across Rakovnický Stream. The children's course is a loop at Kolečko measuring 600 m, run 1-3 laps depending on age. The course is measurable and comparable to previous years since 1975. The course is set in a natural environment, with registration and additional information likely available on the website. The course includes forest and urban sections; the main race consists of two 3000 m segments.

name: Běh okolo Lemberka
location: Jablonné v Podještědí, Liberec, Czech Republic
organizer: Sportovní klub ZŠ Jablonné v Podještědí
description: The Run around Lemberk is a traditional autumn running race held around the chapel near Markvartický Pond between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová. The race offers various distances from children's categories to adult runs of 5 and 10 km, including relay races. The start is on a green tourist trail, and the race is part of the Českolipská District Running League. Participants have access to limited changing rooms, and winners in categories receive diplomas and material prizes.
course_highlights: Trails run along the green tourist trail between Jablonné v Podještědí and Lvová
Various distances from 50 m for children to 10,000 m for adults and veterans
The race is part of the Českolipská District Running League - O pohár Českolipského deníku
additional: Registration from 8:30 AM at the start and finish area. Men's and women's changing rooms are available in limited capacity in a tent near the start. The top three in each category will receive a diploma and a material prize. Veteran categories are only available for the 10,000 m distance. The race is included in the Českolipská District Running League - O pohár Českolipského deníku. Course lengths range from 300 m to 10,000 m, with veteran categories, relay races, public run, registration from 8:30, start at 9:30, limited changing rooms in a tent.

name: Malá Kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4-Kunratice, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Small Kunratice is a traditional running race in Kunratický Forest in Prague, which is already in its 23rd year. The race offers a 3-kilometer course starting in the south of the forest near Kunratický Mill. The event is suitable for the general public and is part of a sport and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where participants and visitors can try various activities such as slackline or disc golf. The race is scheduled to start in the morning, allowing for a pleasant sporting gathering in nature.
course_highlights: 3-kilometer course in Kunratický Forest
Start in the south of the forest near Kunratický Mill
Running in a natural environment with additional sports activities in Nové Roztyly Park
additional: The race is part of a sport and entertainment afternoon in Nové Roztyly Park, where activities such as slackline walking, sack jumping, spider obstacle course, and disc golf are available. The race includes various categories and is part of the SABZO series, featuring a terrain course in the natural environment of Krč Forest.

name: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka
location: Náměstí Republiky, Havířov, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 290 Kč - 700 Kč (on the day), 4000 Kč - 5000 Kč (team categories)
description: Heimstaden Havířovská desítka is a traditional running race held in the center of Havířov, offering several categories and distances for the general public, including children's races and relay races. The course runs through two laps around the city center with start and finish at Republic Square, where the atmosphere is enhanced by fans and spectators. The race has a charitable character and supports disabled athletes from the HSC Moravia club. The 10th anniversary edition attracted a record number of participants and notable sports personalities, such as Pavel Maslák. Registration is possible on the race day, and it also promotes corporate well-being and team cooperation.
course_highlights: Run of 10 km through the center of Havířov (2 laps)
Course runs through the city center with finish at Republic Square
Professional electronic timing with chip
additional: Registration is possible until 11:00 on race day at the Lučina Cultural House. The race is designated as the Czech Republic Veterans Road Running Championship. Start packages can be picked up at the company's headquarters. The race supports disabled athletes from the HSC Moravia club, with part of the entry fee going to their activities. Corporate teams are offered a 12-week training plan and online consultations with a coach. Refreshments are provided on the course and after the race. Breaking the course record is financially rewarded. The race features 2 laps, prize money, discounts for locals and tenants, relay race, corporate categories, and online training support.

name: 67. ročník silničního běhu Hronov - Náchod a 6. ročník dětského běhu
description: The Hronov - Náchod Road Race is a traditional event with a long-standing history, taking place for the 68th time. The race offers a sporting experience on a road course between the towns of Hronov and Náchod and is complemented by a children's run, which encourages participation of younger runners. The event is organized by the District Association of the Czech Union of Sport Náchod, which supports sports and physical education in the region. The race is part of the Sportchallenge ČUS project and is open to the general public.
course_highlights: Road course connecting the towns of Hronov and Náchod
Traditional race with over 60 years of history
Includes a children's run for younger categories
additional: The event includes a road race and a children's run, registration via sportchallenge.cz, and is part of the regional sports calendar.

name: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail
description: Coconaut Pomerania ULTRA Trail is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia with the event base at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The race promotes the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, and participants can enjoy excellent refreshment stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Excellent refreshment stations along the route
additional: The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, and a Junior Trail run up to 1 km. The races take place at KJ Barłomino. The event promotes regional trails and tourist attractions of Pomerania and is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. Supported by Coconaut, with routes of varying difficulty levels, an attractive base in Barłomino, and stunning views of Kashubia.

name: Łemkowyna Trail
location: Krynica-Zdrój, Powiat nowotarski, Lesser Poland Voivodeship, Poland
distance_verbose: Ultramaraton, 100 km, Ultramaraton, 50 km, Maraton, 28 km, 10 km
description: The Lemkowyna Trail is a mountain run along the route marked by the Main Beskid Trail in the Low Beskids. The event takes place around Krynica-Zdrój and Komańcza, offering various distances from 10 km to the 150 km ultramarathon. The route features significant elevation gain and natural, demanding terrain, making it a challenge for trail and mountain adventure enthusiasts. The event has a strong tradition and attracts runners from all over Poland and abroad.
course_highlights: Route marked by the Main Beskid Trail
Significant elevation gains up to +5860 m and -5970 m on the longest distance
Diverse distances from 10 km to 150 km, with time limits
additional: Registration can be transferred between routes until October 1, 2026. Participant limit for each distance ranges from 300 to 550 people. Starts are scheduled for October 17 and 18, 2026, with different times for each distance. Each distance has a time limit. The race takes place on natural mountain trails with substantial elevation gain. The courses include elevation gains reaching up to 740 m for the 30 km and 150 km ultramarathon, with time limits up to 35 hours. Online registration is available, with options for fee refunds and transfer of start packages.

name: Pomerania Ultra-Trail®
description: Pomerania Ultra-Trail® is a series of trail running events held on hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia, based at KJ Barłomino. The event offers five distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, and 11 km, providing a variety of challenges for trail runners. The races promote the beauty of Kashubian landscapes and regional attractions, with well-prepared aid stations along the route. The event is supported by the #ActiveVillage program and organized by the Pomerania Sports Association.
course_highlights: Hilly trails of Pomerania and Kashubia
Beautiful Kashubian landscapes
Well-stocked aid stations along the route
additional: The event takes place at KJ Barłomino. There are 5 main distances: 100 km, 65 km, 42 km, 21 km, 11 km, as well as a Junior run up to 1 km. The organizer is the Pomerania Sports Association. The event promotes long-distance trail running and Nordic Walking. It is supported by the #ActiveVillage program. The event features multiple distances, routes through beautiful Kashubian areas, support from #ActiveVillage, and a base at KJ Barłomino.

name: Dębowiec Nocna Pętla
description: Dębowiec Night Loop is a mountain run on the Dębowiec slope in Bielsko-Biała, taking place on an 8-kilometer route through forest trails from Dębowiec to Wapienica Valley and back. Participants must conquer an intense uphill climb to the Dębowiec cable car station, and at the finish line, there will be a bonfire and a meal. The run is a unique opportunity to actively spend an October evening, and participants receive a start package, medals, and prizes for the best and oldest competitors. Simultaneously, a Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km takes place, also ending at the Dębowiec Shelter 520.
course_highlights: 8 km route through forest trails from Dębowiec to Wapienica Valley and back
Intense uphill climb to the Dębowiec cable car station
Finish at Dębowiec Shelter 520 with a bonfire and meal
additional: Participants must have a headlamp. Prizes in the form of sports equipment vouchers will be awarded to the top three in the Open categories and the top three women. Special awards are planned for the oldest male and female participants. After the run, a bonfire is organized at Dębowiec Shelter 520. A free Nordic Walking march of approximately 4 km takes place simultaneously, starting at 18:00 from the lower station of the cable car on Dębowiec. The race route includes starting at the lower station of the cable car on Dębowiec, an uphill to the clearing, a turnaround 'pin' at the control point, and finishing at Dębowiec Shelter 520. The Nordic Walking route is 6 km, passing through Dylówki Pass and Cyberniok. Participants need a headlamp.

name: IV Wilczy Półmaraton
price_range: 100 zł - 130 zł za dystans, 80 zł za koszulkę
description: The 4th Wolf Half Marathon is a unique trail run held in the picturesque, wild forests of Rybnik Forest District, in the "Głębokie Doły" nature reserve. The half marathon route, approximately 22 km long, runs through unique forest paths, offering runners contact with nature and rare plant species. It is the only such half marathon in Silesia, guaranteeing a large dose of adrenaline and satisfaction for cross-country enthusiasts. Each participant receives a commemorative medal, and the course features amusing, muddy traps. We invite you to Wilczy for an unforgettable sporting experience!
course_highlights: Route approximately 22 km through the forests of Rybnik Forest District
Forest paths of the "Głębokie Doły" nature reserve with a unique microclimate
Natural muddy traps and wild, scenic terrains
additional: Commemorative medal for every participant. Dogs are welcome. The race office is located at the Cultural Center in Wilczy, Karola Miarki 123. A commemorative T-shirt is available optionally for 80 PLN. The route is approximately 22 km, forest terrain, participation options include canicross and Nordic Walking, commemorative medals, online registration with prices depending on the date.

name: MnO Jaszczur - Bludny Balvan
description: MnO Jaszczur - Bludny Balvan is a 10 km race that will take place on October 17, 2026, in Opole. The event is a great opportunity to test your form over a medium distance, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to various levels of advancement. The event is aimed at runners seeking a challenge and the opportunity to optimally prepare for the start under the guidance of experts.
course_highlights: 10 km distance
Street route in Opole
Ability to prepare with training plans from 8 to 20 weeks
additional: Training plans from 8 to 20 weeks are available, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with detailed instructions and expert support. Information about training and preparatory plans, event included in the outdoor activity calendar for 2026.

name: Rajd Waligóry
description: Waligóra Rally is an orienteering rally held in the picturesque areas of Pogórze Wiśnickie near Bochnia. Participants compete by finding control points using a map and compass, combining adventure, movement, and fun outdoors. The routes vary in length and difficulty, suitable for both families and more experienced competitors. The event is recreational and sports-oriented, promoting an active lifestyle and exploring local nature and history.
course_highlights: Routes lead through Pogórze Wiśnickie with charming forest paths and hills
Control points marked with white-orange lanterns with punchers
Ability to independently plan the route and choose the order of visiting points
additional: The start and finish of the rally are located at Arka Cafe in Lanckorona (for the Mini Waligóra Rally). Participants receive a map before the start and can plan their route and start time individually within designated hours. The rally takes place without an official ending and awards ceremony, and results are published on the website. GPS navigation is prohibited in the terrain; a compass is allowed. Terrain orientation, control points, maps, no GPS navigation.

name: 20. Müggelsee-Halbmarathon
price_range: 15 EUR bis 47 EUR je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Müggelsee Half Marathon is a scenic race in the southeast of Berlin, completely circling the Große Müggelsee. The event offers three course lengths: half marathon, 10 kilometers, and 5 kilometers, each designed as either point-to-point or loop courses. The route passes through the historic Spreetunnel and offers an idyllic setting with views of the largest Berlin lake and the surrounding Müggelberge hills. The race is suitable for all runners aiming for personal bests or simply wanting to enjoy the community and nature. Start and finish are at the Müggelseeperle, and the race takes place on October 18, 2026.
course_highlights: Loop course completely around the Große Müggelsee
Crossing the historic Spreetunnel in Friedrichshagen
Idyllic landscape with views of Müggelberge and Berlin skyline
additional: Race bib pickup on October 17, 2026 from 12:30 to 16:00 and on October 18, 2026 from 07:30 at the Müggelseeperle. Late registrations only on October 17, 2026, with a 3 EUR late registration fee; no late registrations on race day. Free boat shuttle to the start on October 18, 2026, at 8:30 from Friedrichshagen/Spreetunnel. Bag drop available, changing tent on site. Optional T-shirt, preferred race number, and boat accompaniment tickets for relatives can be booked. Terrain includes lake and shoreline paths. Online registration, shuttle service, start/finish in the Müggelsee area, various race distances.

description: The Stadtwerke Lübeck Marathon on October 18, 2026 offers runners a diverse selection of distances in the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck. The event includes, in addition to the classic marathon, a duo marathon, half marathon, relay race, and other shorter runs suitable for all age and performance levels. The course runs through the picturesque city and provides a sporting challenge with regional championship scoring. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and emphasizes community and sporting passion.
course_highlights: Marathon with Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring
Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea
Course through the historic Hanseatic city of Lübeck
additional: Free medal engraving available upon registration by January 31, 2026, with name, distance, and finish time. Preferred starting number can be chosen free of charge during early registration phases, subject to availability. Relay race with 10 x 4.2 km segments. Handbike half marathon with the same course as the runner half marathon. Change point for duo marathon in Travemünde on the Baltic Sea. Course catering includes honey gels. Schleswig-Holstein state championship scoring. Registration deadline is September 30, 2026. Various starting number and medal options.

name: Almetal-Marathon
description: The Almetal Marathon 2026 takes place on October 18 and offers runners a scenic route from Büren-Ringelstein to the Ahorn Sports Park in Paderborn. In addition to the classic marathon distance, there are two half-marathon variants as well as a relay race over four segments. The event is characterized by the voluntary commitment of numerous sports clubs and provides a family-friendly atmosphere as well as an impressive natural experience in the Almetal.
course_highlights: Scenic route along the Almetal
Marathon from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn
Two half-marathon variants and a relay race with 4 x 10.5 km
additional: The event is organized voluntarily by twelve sports clubs along the route. District administrator Christopher Rüther is the patron. It offers a family-friendly and accessible atmosphere appreciated by participants and spectators. The route runs from Büren-Ringelstein to Paderborn, including half-marathon variants and a relay race; registration via my.raceresult.com

location: Biberach an der Riß, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
