In addition to the sporting event, participants can expect a creepy atmosphere with costumes, lights, and fog, as well as an award ceremony and a final fireworks display.
course_highlights: Loop course of 8.333 km length, measured by the DLV and eligible for best lists
Courses from 1 km (Spook Run) to marathon (Splatterthon) with a spooky atmosphere
Start and finish area at Werdersee between Finnbahn and Grillwiese
additional: The award ceremony for the Spook Run takes place immediately after crossing the finish line, with others following later. A spectacular fireworks display begins at 18:00. There are also relay competitions for the marathon (5-person relay). The bib with RFID chip serves as a baton and must be brought by the relay team themselves. Costumes are explicitly encouraged but not mandatory. Participants can register online, with various distances and relay options. The event takes place at night and offers a spooky atmosphere.

name: Bredstedt-Cross
description: The 39th Bredstedt Cross will take place on October 31, 2026, at the Bredstedt Sports Park and is organized by Bredstedter TSV. The event offers cross-country runs for a wide age range, from children and adolescents to active participants and numerous master classes. There are short and long cross-country races for men and women, as well as separate age groups from M6/W6 to M75/W75, including youth and U18/U20. The event is listed as a stadium-near category 6.5.1 and offers a diverse competition format for all age groups.
course_highlights: Cross-country runs for children, youth, active participants, and masters
Short and long cross-country races for men and women
Age groups from M6/W6 to M75/W75 as well as youth and U18/U20
additional: Registration deadline is October 28, 2026, with online registrations possible until 23:59. The event is classified as a category 6.5.1 stadium-near event. There are no detailed course lengths or additional practical information available on the website. The registration deadline is October 28, 2026; typical weather in October is around 14°C with approximately 40 mm of precipitation, making the cross-country race a challenging and natural experience.

name: Kreismeisterschaft und 3. Halloween-Crosslauf im Örtzetal zu Munster
location: Sportpark Osterberg, Munster, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The district championship and 3rd Halloween Cross Run in Örtzetal near Munster is a cross-country event taking place on October 31, 2026, at the Sportpark Osterberg in Munster. The event combines the district championship in cross-country running with the third Halloween Cross Run and is aimed at children, youth, open categories, and masters. The courses range from 500 meters to 10 kilometers and offer a local, club-oriented atmosphere without the character of a large city run. The race takes place in the autumnal Örtzetal region and is a popular seasonal event of the Eintracht Munster club.
course_highlights: Cross-country run in Örtzetal with varied terrain
Course lengths from 500 m to 10 km for different age and performance groups
Event at Sportpark Osterberg, Munster
additional: The event was rescheduled due to bad weather and integrates the district championship into the Halloween Cross Run. Typical October weather is around 14 °C with mostly cloudy skies and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The competition is in cross-country format, with a local character, participation for children, youth, adults, and masters, held on Halloween with weather-dependent adjustments.

name: Köstritzer Parklauf
location: Köstritzer Park, Bad Köstritz, Thuringia, Germany
description: The Köstritzer Park Run is a cross-country race held at the end of October in Bad Köstritz, Germany. The course runs in and around Köstritzer Park, off the usual running tracks. The event offers short races for children and adolescents as well as longer distances for adults and masters, ranging from 500 meters to the 12 km main race. The event attracts numerous local and regional clubs, mainly from Thuringia, but also from Saxony and Bavaria. The 27th edition of the race is known for strong regional participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country race in and around Köstritzer Park
Start in the park with a view of blooming dahlias in autumn
Varied distances from 500 m to 12 km
additional: Typical October weather: approximately 14 °C max, 6 °C min, mostly cloudy with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The event includes children’s and youth races as well as main races for adults and masters. It takes place at the end of October, with various race distances and categories for children, adolescents, active participants, and masters. Registration is possible until shortly before the event.

name: Nordhessische Crosslaufmeisterschaften
description: The North Hesse Cross Country Championships are a regional club and district championship in cross country running, held at various locations in North Hesse. The event is primarily aimed at club runners from the region competing for regional and district titles. The course lengths vary from short youth races of 1.2 km to longer senior races of 8 km. The races take place on cross-country terrain, not on closed roads, and are organized by various athletics districts and clubs.
course_highlights: Cross-country terrain instead of road race
Course lengths from 1.2 km to 8 km
Held on sports facilities in different locations in North Hesse
additional: The event is strongly oriented towards club runners. Depending on the course, it is recommended to choose appropriate footwear carefully, e.g., spikes. Results are published as web and PDF lists. Typical weather in October is cool and mostly cloudy with an average high of 14°C and a low of 6°C. Weather in October approx. 14°C, low temperature 6°C, 40 mm precipitation, cloudy; competition on sports facilities in the region, online registration possible, results as web and PDF lists.

name: TEAG – Legend of Cross
price_range: 30 € (Fun- und Nachwuchsläufe), 15 € (JUNIOR), Preise für Hauptrennen nicht explizit genannt

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: SUPERSPRINT (4 km, ab 15 Jahre, Start: 14:00 Uhr, 30 €)

description: The TEAG - LEGEND OF CROSS is Thuringia's toughest and most welcoming cross-country race, taking place on October 31 and November 1, 2026, in Mühlberg at the Three Castles. The event offers challenging trails, more than 30 natural and artificial obstacles, and a unique setting with three castles. Whether individual or team, recreational runners become legends in a strong community. The event includes various distances and difficulty levels suitable for all age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Three different lengths of courses with their own obstacles and difficulty levels
More than 30 natural and artificial obstacles, including water obstacles at the Wechmar dam
Start and finish at the sports field Mühlberg with the historic backdrop of the Three Castles
additional: On Saturday, fun and youth races take place, with main races on Sunday. There are individual and team rankings. For Special Olympics athletes with intellectual disabilities, there is the 4 km SPECIAL CROSS. Registration and late registration are free until mid-October, thereafter a fee of 5 euros applies. A double start offer for both LEGEND OF CROSS events in 2026 costs 99 euros. Multiple distances, obstacles, youth races, team rankings, start and finish at the sports field Mühlberg, water obstacle at the 30 km course.

name: Frankenwaldlauf um den Preis der Kulmbacher Brauerei
description: The Frankenwaldlauf for the Kulmbacher Brewery Prize is a cozy running event in the beautiful Frankenwald town of Ludwigschorgast, organized by runners for runners. The event offers an exciting alternative to the asphalt section with a 1.5-kilometer single trail and is suitable for both ambitious runners and hobby athletes, including fun runs and Nordic walking. Besides sporting ambition, fun in the wild-romantic nature is the main focus. Additionally, the overall winner and overall female winner of the main run are rewarded with a prize, and the team with the most participants receives a financial recognition.
course_highlights: 1.5 km long single trail replaces asphalt section from Wirsberg to the Golden Eagle Hut
Run through the wild-romantic nature of the Frankenwald
Various routes: main run, fun run (5 km), and Nordic walking (8.4 km)
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event at the FC Ludwigschorgast sports hall from 12:30 to 13:30, with an additional late registration fee of 5 euros. All participants receive a small gift from Kulmbacher upon handing in their bib at the finish. At the finish, tea, non-alcoholic drinks, cookies, pretzels, and gummy bears are offered. The bib must be worn visibly on the front of the body; otherwise, disqualification will occur. There is a team classification for the main run with material prizes and a trophy for the fastest men's team. Routes in the Franconian forest region, registration from September 18, late registrations at the start against a fee, catering at the finish, start at 9 a.m., awards at 11:30 a.m.

name: Podzimní běh Dražovkou
location: Dražovka, Hořovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150,- Kč dospělí, 50,- Kč děti a žactvo
description: Autumn Run Dražovkou is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Dražovka near Hořovice. The main course measures approximately 7.2 km and mainly runs through forest paths in hilly terrain, offering runners a pleasant challenge and beautiful natural scenery. The race is suitable for various age categories, including children and youth, who have their own shorter courses. Start and registration are at the same location by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest, ensuring convenient access and a forest running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Main course 7.2 km, women run 3.6 km
Mainly forest paths in hilly terrain
Youth, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap, others run two laps
additional: Start and registration are at the same place by the water tower on Podlužská Street in the forest. The race offers children's races. Youth, women, and veterans over 70 run one lap, other runners two laps. The race includes children's and pupil categories, with start and registration at the water tower in Dražovka, and the course runs through forest paths.

name: Vinařský maraton
location: Velké Bílovice, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_4
tiers.description: 1.090 Kč při on-line přihlášce do 30. 10. 2026 do 23:59 hodin (prosíme, uhraďte startovné převodem nejpozději do 30.10. 2026 12:00, po tomto datu je nutné mít s sebou potvrzení platby nebo uhradit na místě).

description: The Winegrowers Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Báječné ženy v běhu association, held in Velké Bílovice in the South Moravian Region. The race offers a marathon course and a half-marathon route passing through picturesque vineyards and the villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice. The event also features a charity run called Vinařská míle, open to children and adults. The race has a friendly atmosphere and supports the running community as well as local charitable projects.
course_highlights: The route passes through vineyards and picturesque villages of Čejkovice and Vrbice
Marathon and half-marathon courses with beautiful views of South Moravian landscape
Charity run Vinařská míle for children and adults
additional: The race capacity is 800 runners. The registration fee applies also to relay participants, who must register under the same relay name. Changing rooms are available at the school premises, and a baggage storage is provided in a tent at the multifunctional playground. The organizer is not responsible for items left outside the official storage. Payment of the registration fee can be made on-site in cash or via QR code if capacity allows. The race takes place in October, with a capacity of approximately 800 runners. Registration is possible online or on-site. The race routes include various wine regions, including Vrbice, Hradištěk, and Čejkovice, with options to participate in different categories, including relay races and special categories for the visually impaired.

name: Běh Labským údolím
location: Dolní Žleb, Děčín, Ústecký kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: LABÁCI (Děčínský horolezecký oddíl a Klub orientačního běhu Děčín)
description: The Labský Valley Run is a traditional autumn running race held in the picturesque environment of Dolní Žleb near Děčín. The race offers courses of various lengths, mainly along forest roads and trails with varied terrain. It is organized by the Labáci group, which continues a long-standing tradition of local organizers. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup and is suitable for a wide range of runners, including veterans and youth.
course_highlights: 16 km main course and 8 km shortened course in varied terrain
Predominantly forest roads and trails
Picturesque autumn environment of Labský údolí
additional: Registration for participants takes place on the race day from 10:45 AM at the pub "U Kosti" in Dolní Žleb. Recommended arrival by train. The race is part of the Děčín Running Cup. Registrations will open in spring 2026. Registration is open until October 30, 2025, with the race scheduled for November 1 at 12:00 PM, and registration closes at 10:45 AM. There is an option to travel by train from Děčín.

name: Lhotecká Kaštanka
description: Lhotecká Kaštanka is a race approximately 15 km long, running on asphalt and solid forest paths in the Lhota area in the Central Bohemian Region. This run is part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup and offers runners a pleasant route with natural surroundings. The race is suitable for runners seeking quality asphalt and forest running in a picturesque landscape. Come enjoy the sporting atmosphere and test your strength against other runners in this traditional event.
course_highlights: Distance of the route 15 km
Run on asphalt and solid forest paths
Part of the Kladensko and Rakovnicko Runners' Cup
additional: The race takes place on October 31, 2026, in the Lhota area, and is intended for runners who want to enjoy a sports day in nature.

name: Krospůlmaraton
location: Sosnová u České Lípy, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The half marathon in Sosnová near Česká Lípa is a traditional running race organized as part of the District Running League of Česká Lípa. The race takes place on October 31, 2026, and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength in the pleasant autumn environment of the Liberec Region. The event is part of a series of regional runs that promote sports activity and community gathering of runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Natural terrain suitable for cross-country
Included in the regional running league
Held in the picturesque environment of Sosnová near Česká Lípa
additional: The race is part of a regional series of runs; the exact course profile is not specified, but a terrain character suitable for running in nature is expected.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
price_range: wstęp wolny, wymagana wcześniejsza rejestracja i opłata startowa
description: 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in the city park of Gliwice. The event combines sport, a good atmosphere, and contact with nature, offering activities for both experienced runners and those looking to spend time without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts on the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and the race office opens at 9:00 AM. It is an excellent opportunity to actively end February and enter the upcoming spring season with new energy.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the city park of Gliwice
Start on the clearing behind Piast Stadium (entrance from Leśna Street)
The route is suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs
additional: Race office open from 9:00 AM. Prior registration and an entry fee are required to be classified. The event takes place in urban greenery, promoting integration and recreation. The race will be held on October 31, 2026, with the start on the clearing behind Piast Stadium, and online registration is available.

name: 19. Bothfelder Waldlauf
location: Bezirkssportplatz Bothfeld, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Bothfelder Waldlauf is a popular race approved by the DLV, organized by TuS Bothfeld 04 in Hannover. The runs start and finish at the district sports field in Bothfeld and lead through the beautiful Bothfelder Wald on a circular course over forest paths and well-developed forest roads. The race is part of the Laufpass of the Hannover region and offers changing and shower facilities at the finish area. Refreshments include affordable food, drinks, and free hot tea. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children (Bambinis) with short distances.
course_highlights: Circular course through the Bothfelder Wald
Forest paths and well-developed forest roads
Start and finish at the district sports field in Bothfeld
additional: Spontaneous registration on race day is possible online up to 60 minutes before each race, subject to available start places. The late registration fee is €2 in addition to the entry fee. Award ceremonies for the children's races take place approximately 60 minutes after the races, and immediately after the finish for the longer races. On-site certificate printing is available. The 5 km walking starts simultaneously with the 10 km main race. Changing and shower facilities are available. Public transportation is accessible via Stadtbahn line 13, and parking is available nearby. The registration deadline is October 30, 2026; the event takes place in typical November weather in Hannover; it is outside the official stadium calendar.

name: 28. Tangerpokallauf
description: The 28th Tangerpokallauf in Demker is the oldest running event organized by SC Demker '95 and is part of the Elbe-Ohre-Cup. The course runs through the autumnal Tangerniederung between Demker and Weißewarte, past the Deutsches Eck, under the Stendal-Magdeburg railway line, and through the forest area of Süppling. Distances offered include 1.2 km for children and youth, as well as 5.4 km and 12.0 km for older youth and adults. The terrain is predominantly flat with slight elevations caused by the dikes surrounding Demker.
course_highlights: Flat course through the Tangerniederung between Demker and Weißewarte
Route along the Tangers and past the Deutsches Eck
Crossing the forest area of Süppling
additional: Distances: 1.2 km (children/youth), 5.4 km and 12.0 km (older youth/adults). Terrain is consistently flat with dikes as the only elevations. The course crosses the Stendal-Magdeburg railway line. The event takes place on November 1, 2026. Information on registration, results, photos, and accommodations in Demker is also provided.

name: Hockenheimringlauf
description: The Hockenheimring Run 2026 offers runners of all performance levels a unique experience on one of the most legendary race tracks in the world. The flat asphalt course with wide curves and the atmosphere of Formula 1 makes the run a special event for professional and amateur runners. In addition to exciting competitions for children and adults, participants can expect a friendly and motivating atmosphere with refreshments at the finish line. The run is the sporting highlight of the ASG Tria Hockenheim club for the year.
course_highlights: Flat asphalt on the legendary Hockenheimring race track
Wide curves with Formula 1 atmosphere
Refreshments with water, tea, and non-alcoholic Welde Bräu at the finish line
additional: Each participant receives a medal. Overall top 3 finishers receive vouchers from Marathonshop Wiesloch. Age group winners receive trophies, certificates, and from the main class onwards, an additional wine gift. Refreshments at the finish line include water, tea, and non-alcoholic Welde Bräu. The event includes various race categories, online registration, refreshments, medals, and bib numbers included. The event takes place on the race track and is very popular among runners of all ages.

name: Käppelelauf 2026
description: The Käppelelauf is a traditional running event held annually on November 1st in Reudern near Nürtingen. The course covers 8.7 kilometers with approximately 245 meters of elevation gain on gravel forest paths up to the Käppele parking lot. The race is part of the Tälescup running series organized by TSV Beuren and offers a separate classification for Nordic walkers. After the race, there is an award ceremony and a traditional buffet, making the event a social occasion.
course_highlights: 8.7-kilometer course with approximately 245 meters of elevation
Route on gravel forest paths
Finish at the Käppele parking lot
additional: Start at the forest edge in Reudern, lead bicycle ahead of the first woman and the first man, award ceremony and traditional buffet after the race, separate classification for Nordic walkers, part of the Tälescup running series organized by TSV Beuren. Start at 10:00 AM at the Reudern sports field, participation only by prior registration, weather in November usually rainy with temperatures around 2-7°C.

name: LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf 2026
description: The LG Alsternord Herbstwaldlauf is a local autumn run through the forest in Norderstedt, north of Hamburg. Organized by LG Alsternord Hamburg e.V., the race starts at 11:00 AM at the Rantzauer Forst-Thingplatz. Participants can choose between 5 km and 10 km distances, including a cross-country option. The race takes place away from city streets in the Rantzauer Forest area and offers not only running but also walking and hiking options. With a manageable number of participants, usually between 101 and 300 runners, the event has more of a club character than a large-scale event.
course_highlights: Run through the autumnal Rantzauer Forest without city streets
Options for 5 km, 10 km, and cross-country
Manageable participant field with a club race atmosphere
additional: Results are published via race result; there are public start lists, photos, reports, and historical rankings. In addition to the races, there are walking and hiking options, including a 5 km walk. Typical November weather with around 7°C and rainy days. The event takes place in typical November weather with approximately 7°C and rainy conditions. It is aimed at runners and walkers of all ages, with a participant number between 101 and 300.

name: Neustädter Sparkassen Nachtlauf
location: Neustadt an der Aisch, Neustadt an der Aisch, Bavaria, Germany
organizer: Turn- und Sportverein 1861/08 Neustadt an der Aisch e.V.
description: The Sparkassen Night Run in Neustadt an der Aisch is a popular running event featuring various competitions, including a children's run, hobby run, Nordic walking, and main race. The event takes place in the city center with start and finish at the town hall on the marketplace and offers an attractive course that has been adjusted to participant preferences. All runners can pick up their bib numbers at the town hall, and showers and changing rooms are available at the TSV sports field. The award ceremonies are held in the evening before the Sparkasse or at the town hall, and each participant receives a small thank-you bag at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course route through the city center with adjustments to avoid narrow passages
Start and finish at the town hall on the marketplace
Showers and changing rooms available at the TSV sports field
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start at the town hall for a late registration fee of €2. Bib number distribution begins at 15:45 at the town hall. Jackets can be deposited at the town hall or at the Stadtwerke tent at your own risk during the race. For safety reasons, children start in staggered groups: boys 3 minutes before girls. Prize money for the main race: 1st place €150, 2nd place €100, 3rd place €75. Course changes are possible. The distance for the children's run is 1.7 km, the main race is 4 laps, the hobby run is 2 laps. The event takes place in the city of Neustadt an der Aisch with start and finish near the Neustadthalle and at the town hall on the marketplace.

name: Tiergarten-Cross
description: The Tiergarten Cross in Schleswig is a local cross-country race taking place on November 1, 2026. The event offers two main distances of 4.4 km and 8.8 km, which start sequentially so that the runners are separated. The course is hilly and challenges participants with constant rhythm changes, making the race varied. In addition to the main races, there are also children’s and youth races, making the event family-friendly and diverse.
course_highlights: Ends in the Tiergarten Schleswig, the most distinctive point of the course
Hilly course with constant small rhythm changes
Separate start times for the 4.4 km and 8.8 km distances
additional: The event also includes children’s and youth races. Typical November weather in Schleswig is cool with a high of about 7 °C and rainy on most days. The event takes place in the Tiergarten Schleswig, is weather-dependent (mostly rainy in November), and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various race categories.

name: Winterlaufserie 2026/2027, 1. Wertungslauf
description: The Winter Running Series in Hamm is a traditional winter road running series taking place in its 51st edition. The first scoring race covers a distance of 15 km, run off the stadium on roads. The event attracts many club runners from Westphalia and beyond, including teams from Dortmund, Münster, and Bielefeld. The race offers a challenging course in the cool November weather and is a popular start to the winter season for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: 15 km road race off the stadium
Strong club-based participant field from Westphalia and surroundings
Typically cool and rainy November weather conditions
additional: The starting point is Ahnatal. The average November temperature is around 7°C with frequent rain (about 45 mm of precipitation). The event is part of the Winter Running Series, which can take place in typical weather around 7°C with rain. It is the first scoring race of the series, popular among runners from various regions.

name: Motolské jamky
location: Golfový areál Golf Club Praha, Motol, Praha, Czech Republic
price_range: 600 Kč (10 km), 500 Kč (5 km), 100 Kč (dětský závod)
description: Trail Running Cup - Run over Motolské jamky is a running race held in the picturesque environment of the Golf Course Golf Club Prague in Motol. The race offers runners the opportunity to enjoy a challenging trail terrain in Prague 5 with beautiful views and a natural atmosphere. The event is part of the Trail Running Cup series and is suitable for all nature running enthusiasts. The race start is traditionally at 9:00 AM.
course_highlights: Trail run in the Golf Club Prague Motol area
Natural and varied terrain with views
Location in Prague 5 with accessibility
additional: Registration, regulations, and results are available at the external link https://tech.orgsu.org/Site/SG/3. The race is part of the Trail Running Cup series with additional races throughout the year. Trail routes include the golf course, registration closes 30 minutes before the start, parking is available directly at the venue.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - listopad
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, with the start in the morning. The race is organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, which has been supporting the running community for over 35 years.
course_highlights: Length of the course 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Suitable for all age groups and running levels
Picturesque environment near the fountain in the park
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The start location is near the fountain in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The top three places in each category are awarded. The race is part of an annual trophy competition with points awarded based on age coefficient. It is part of a series of 2-mile runs in Olomouc, held on an asphalt track, with registration from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: HRUŠTICE 10 km - Memoriál Zdeňka Drobníka
location: Turnov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The HRUŠTICE Road Race - Zdeněk Drobník Memorial is a traditional race with a history dating back to 1974, which has been run on a new 10 km course through the Jizera Valley since 2024. The race is a popular autumn event that attracts runners from the surrounding area every year and offers beautiful views and an atmosphere connected with local history and traditions. The start and race facilities are in Turnov, where chip timing and professional organization are provided. After the race, a raffle for material prizes takes place, traditionally featuring semi-precious stones from the region.
course_highlights: New 10 km course through the Jizera Valley
Beautiful views from the highland plateau above Turnov
Traditional material prizes made of semi-precious stones from the region
additional: All categories start together. Registration and bib number pickup are from 08:30 to 10:00. On-site registration is possible until 10:00 with a higher starting fee. After the race, there is a raffle of bib numbers for material prizes. The race facilities are at the athletic clubroom of AC Turnov at the Ludvík Dáněk stadium. The race is part of a long-term series and offers various age categories. Registration and results are managed by STOPNI TO s.r.o. The race takes place on a road course and is open to the general running public.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Beroun
location: Hospoda na Černém vršku, Praha, Czech Republic

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races set in the beautiful natural surroundings around the Berounka River, motivating runners of all levels to engage in regular activity. The race in Beroun, held on November 2, 2026, is a night stage passing through the Křivoklát forests with views of the surroundings and a final downhill run from the Děd lookout tower to the finish line. The route is well marked and offers stunning natural scenery, refreshments, and a place to store belongings. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to improve their fitness and enjoy running in nature.
course_highlights: Night stage with headlamp
Route passes through Křivoklát forests with views near the oak alley
Steep climb to Děd lookout tower and downhill back to the finish with views of Beroun
additional: Each participant will receive a start number. Refreshments and baggage storage are available on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp for the night run. The top three in each category will receive diplomas. Night stage, trail running, marked routes, scenic views, on-site registration, start no later than 17:45, refreshments and storage, winners announced in categories, headlamp required.

name: Běžecká série Berounka - Beroun
price_range: 240 Kč (voucher na 12 závodů), 316 Kč (voucher na 6 závodů)

tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 trail races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, taking place from January to December 2026. The routes lead along the best running trails in the area with varying elevation changes and offer stunning views of nature and the surrounding landscape. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners who want to gain motivation for regular running. Starts are mostly accessible by train, and local pubs provide facilities. At the end of the series, there is a ceremonial announcement of winners in several categories.
course_highlights: Routes lead along educational trails and nature reserves with views of Český kras
Challenging ascents and descents with elevation gains of over 330 meters on some routes
Start and finish near train stations with options for refreshments and facilities
additional: Each participant receives a starting number. There are refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms, and showers on site. It is recommended to bring a headlamp due to the nocturnal nature of some races. The series counts the 10 best races of each runner, and at the end, winners are announced in 12 categories. The races take place in various locations around Beroun, with starts mostly accessible by train. The winners are announced in December. The races are divided into 12 categories.

name: Flutlicht-Crosslauf
description: The Floodlight Cross Country Run in Lüchtringen is a traditional race held amidst the beautiful nature of the Weser Uplands and the Solling-Vogler Nature Park. The event offers runners the opportunity to run through varied terrain under floodlight conditions. Lüchtringen, known as the Mason Village, invites you with its idyllic surroundings and sports clubs for a special running experience.
course_highlights: Run through the Solling Cross Park
Atmospheric floodlight ambiance
Nature-oriented course in the Weser Uplands
additional: The 21st Floodlight Cross Country Run will take place on November 6, 2026, at 6:00 PM at the LFL Heim. The event is organized by the Leichtathletikfreunde Lüchtringen association. No published prices or online registration are available on the website. Participants and interested parties can always receive current information via the StadtLand.Funk app. The event takes place in all weather conditions; it may be rainy in bad weather. Registration and further information are available on the website.

name: 14. Sollingquerung
description: The Solling Crossing is a unique race from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen, taking place on November 7, 2026. The route is run exclusively via GPS, as there are no signs, making the race particularly challenging and exciting. The number of participants is limited to 100, creating a family-like atmosphere. The start is at 9:00 AM, after participants are transported by bus from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen at 7:45 AM. A tip for runners: those who complete the marathon course at the Sollinglauf on June 6, 2026, are guaranteed a starting place at the Solling Crossing.
course_highlights: Route from Bad Karlshafen to Dassel
No route signage, run only with GPS
Support stations along the route
additional: Start at 9:00 AM after bus transfer at 7:45 AM from Dassel to Bad Karlshafen. Participant limit of 100. No route signage, run only with GPS. Tip: secure your starting place by participating in the Sollinglauf marathon on June 6, 2026. The route is unmarked, GPS navigation required, weather in November with rain and temperatures around 2-7°C, no late registrations possible, event is quickly fully booked.

name: 6. Weserbergland Backyard Ultra
description: The Weserbergland Backyard Ultra Run is a unique ultramarathon event in Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, held annually in November. Participants run a loop of approximately 6.7 kilometers every hour until only one runner remains. The race is characterized by its special challenge and the camaraderie among runners. The event is known for its demanding course and the impressive performances of participants, who often go on for many hours and kilometers.
course_highlights: Course of about 6.7 km per lap
Loop course with challenging ascents at Heiligenberg
Run through varied terrain in the Weserbergland
additional: The race traditionally starts at 10 a.m. Registration usually opens very quickly, often resulting in the participant field being fully booked early. Currently, there is no waiting list. The event is organized by TuS Lütmarsen e. V. The number of participants is limited to ensure the quality and safety of the event. It is one of the last major backyard events of the year in Germany, with typical November weather and long nights. Registration opens on May 1, 2026.

name: Augsburger AOK-Winterlaufserie Südring
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races that pass through the beautiful Westliche Wälder Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain and require good fitness and health. The event offers classifications for various age groups and an overall ranking with attractive prizes and trophies. The races take place on Saturdays and one Sunday in November and December and are ideal for runners of all ages seeking a varied winter running series.
course_highlights: Running courses through the Westliche Wälder Nature Park with hilly terrain
Course lengths approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
Start and finish area with refreshments and changing facilities
additional: Number bibs are issued at the start/finish area. Mobile WC at the Kathreinerstraße parking lot (races 1-3). Changing clothes/luggage can be stored in tents or pavilions, but without liability. Refreshments include tea, water, and a cake buffet at races 1-3; race 4 additionally features mulled wine and children's punch. Award ceremony after the 4th race with wooden trophies and cash prizes. Parking in Bergheim, Kathreinerstraße, or surrounding streets; not at the Bergheim sports home. Races in November and December, meeting points usually at Kathreinerstraße and Brennhölzerweg in Augsburg-Bergheim, typically rainy weather with about 7°C.

name: Freundschaftslauf der LLG Wustweiler
description: The 22nd Friendship Run of the LLG Wustweiler will take place on November 7, 2026, at the Dorfwaldhalle Wustweiler. The event begins at 1:00 PM with the Wustweiler Beaver Trail (WuBiT), a challenging trail course, followed at 3:00 PM by running and walking groups. The run is not a competition and does not include timing; instead, the focus is on the joy of moving in nature and community. The route leads over official forest paths and trails with a small refreshment station at kilometer 12. Afterwards, there will be a social gathering with food and drinks in the hall.
course_highlights: Challenging route over official forest paths and trails
Small refreshment station at kilometer 12 (no cups)
Three groups with different running paces and LLG support
additional: The run is not a competition and there is no timing. There are three groups with different paces (6-6:30, 7-7:30, 8-8:30 min/km), accompanied by experienced LLG runners. The running/walking groups each run or walk for one hour. The route is approximately 7 to 11 km for runners, 5 to 6 km for walkers/hikers. The GPX file of the route is available for download. The event is part of the LLG Illtal Cup, together with the Illinger City Run and the Benin Benefit Run. Among all participants who complete all three runs, a hot air balloon ride will be raffled (participants must be 18 or older, not LLG members). No competition or timing, challenging forest paths and trails, recommended to wear trail running shoes, participation at own risk, social gathering after the run.

name: Geilenkirchener Crosslauf
location: Teverener Heide, Geilenkirchen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Geilenkirchen Cross Country Race takes place on November 7, 2026, in the Teverener Heide near Geilenkirchen. Organized by ATV Geilenkirchen, the race has offered a compact, local program since 2006 with distances ranging from 1.1 km to 9.2 km for adults, youth, and children. The course is a true cross-country route with some significant undulations and runs through the heathland terrain, starting and ending at the Grotenrath parking lot. With typically 101 to 300 participants, the race fosters a family-like club atmosphere in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Authentic cross-country course with significant undulations
Run through the heathland terrain of Teverener Heide
Start and finish at Grotenrath parking lot
additional: The race takes place in November with typical November weather, around 7 °C and rainy days. The number of participants usually ranges between 101 and 300 runners. There are separate races for adults, youth, and children. Race in the Teverener Heide, cross-country with various distances, more club character, November weather with rain and temperatures around 2-7°C.

name: Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf
description: The Heiner-Mayr-Staffelberglauf is a challenging mountain relay race taking place on November 7, 2026, in Bad Staffelstein. Organized by TSV 1860 Staffelstein e.V. with support from Sparkasse Coburg-Lichtenfels, the course covers 3,960 meters with 260 meters of elevation gain, starting from Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße and ascending to the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel. Participants can expect a demanding race with impressive views over the Franconian landscape. The race is a tribute to decades of dedication to running in the region.
course_highlights: 3,960 meters course with 260 meters of elevation
Start at Hirtengasse-Horsdorfer Straße in Bad Staffelstein
Finish on the Staffelberg plateau at the Adelgundis Chapel with panoramic views
additional: Mountain relay, start at 2:00 PM, finish on the Staffelberg plateau, registration until November 6, 2026, participation open to all age groups

name: Internationaler Fackellauf
description: The 45th International Torch Run in Rodenbach will take place on November 7, 2026, and offers a challenging 7 km course for adults. The route is a hilly loop with a total of 92 meters of elevation gain and descent, appealing to runners, walkers, and Nordic walkers alike. In addition to the main competition, there are also events for children and adolescents, with details available in the official organizer's announcement. The start is at 6:00 PM, and the finish line is the same for all competitions.
course_highlights: 7 km hilly loop
92 meters of elevation gain and descent
Very challenging mountainous course
additional: Competitions for children and adolescents are offered; detailed information can be found in the official organizer's announcement. The finish location is the same for all competitions. Precise finish line information requires RUNME Premium. The run takes place on November 7, 2026, starting at 6:00 PM, with accommodation options near the start and finish areas. The event is part of the international humanitarian efforts of the Red Cross, conveying a message of hope and peace.

name: Lauf der 17. OIE-Nahe-Crosslaufserie
description: The OIE-Nahe Cross Country Series is a traditional running series held in the region around Idar-Oberstein. It includes several races on varied cross-country courses that appeal to both middle- and long-distance runners. Participants who take part in at least four races of the series will receive a series gift, which this year is sports socks. The series is organized by TuS Oberbrombach and emphasizes community and sporting fun.
course_highlights: Varied cross-country courses in the Idar-Oberstein region
Middle- and long-distance races with challenging sections
Series ranking with attractive gifts for frequent participants
additional: Participants who take part in at least four races of the series will receive a series gift (sports socks for middle- and long-distance). The sock size must be provided during registration. There is a different gift for children's races. After a weather-related cancellation, a replacement date has been set for 08.02.2026. Registrations remain valid; in case of non-participation, the entry fee can be refunded. Events take place in various locations, registration includes sock size, weather-related date change, series ranking, WhatsApp channel.

name: Limes- Winterlaufserie - 1. Lauf über 10 km
description: The Limes Winter Running Series is a three-part winter running series in Pohlheim, where the first race over 10 km forms the basis for the overall ranking. The series attracts runners from the region, especially from the Lahn-Dill district, and has a long tradition with the 49th event scheduled for 2026. The race offers a good opportunity to compete with other runners during the cold season and to kick off the winter running series.
course_highlights: 10 km race through Pohlheim, Watzenborn-Steinberg
Part of a three-part winter running series
Popular race with regional participation, especially from the Lahn-Dill district
additional: Typical November weather conditions: around 7 °C, mostly rainy with an average of 45 mm precipitation. Please check details with the organizer before registration. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a wintery atmosphere. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and also provides results and participant lists.

name: Pokallauf
description: The Pokallauf "Rund um Marienberg" is a traditional running event held in the Marienberg region. The competitions are conducted in classic and free technique, with race distances of 5 km and 10 km, each run on a 2.5 km loop. The event offers athletes of various age groups and performance levels a sporting challenge in a scenic environment. Due to current snow conditions, there are technical and route-related adjustments that affect the course execution.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km courses on a 2.5 km loop
Classic technique for U6-9, free technique from U10
New course length of 10 km from H21
additional: The event is organized by ATSV Gebirge/Gelobtland e.V. The announcement has not been updated. The technical requirements of the competitions depend on age: U6-9 classic with double start, from U10 free technique with double start. The race route may vary depending on snow conditions, with adjustments in technique and course length. It is a popular event for runners seeking nature and challenge.

name: Rülzheimer Crosslauf
description: The Rülzheimer Cross Run, organized by LG Rülzheim, takes place on November 7, 2026, at the Peter-Becht Stadium in Rülzheim. The event includes two distances, 1.1 km and 8.4 km, and offers a compact cross-country course within the stadium grounds and adjoining areas. Unlike road races, the course runs over varied terrain with new obstacles introduced by the organizer Otto Pfadt. The race is part of a series of events by LG Rülzheim, including the South Palatinate Runs near the Moby Dick leisure center.
course_highlights: Compact cross-country course within the stadium and adjacent areas
New obstacles on the course
Event in November with typical cool and rainy weather
additional: Start is at the Peter-Becht Stadium in Rülzheim. Typical November weather with around 7 °C and frequent rain. The course is not a road race but a cross-country race with obstacles. Race within the stadium grounds, obstacles present, weather-dependent conditions possible in November, details to be inquired on-site.

name: SCC Cross Country
description: The SCC Cross Country is a forest run in Berlin at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage in Westend. Two clear cross-country courses are offered: 4 km for U16 to adults and 9 km for U18 to adults, both races start in the morning. The run is intentionally simple and targets club runners, youth, and adults who want to run short off-road rounds, which is distinctly different from the large street races in the city. The course runs over paved and unpaved forest paths, where rhythm, clean footwork, and a fast finish are more important than scenic views. Awards are given to the top three in each age and gender category, as well as a prize for the fastest final lap for men and women.
course_highlights: Forest run on paved and unpaved forest paths
Two courses: 4 km for U16 to adults, 9 km for U18 to adults
Focus on rhythm, clean footwork, and a fast finish
additional: For SCC members, the start is free. Late registrations are possible shortly before the start for an additional fee. There is a results archive documenting the race. The event takes place at the Julius-Hirsch-Sportanlage on Harbigstraße in Westend, Berlin-Charlottenburg. Typical November weather is around 7°C with rainy days. Forest run on paved and unpaved forest paths, entry costs for non-members, late registration against fee, weather in November approximately 7°C, rainy.

name: Schkölener Stadtparklauf
description: The Schkölener Stadtparklauf is a traditional running event in Schkölen, Thuringia, taking place on November 7, 2026. Organized by TSV 1885 Schkölen and the SSV Friedrich-Schiller-Gymnasium Eisenberg, the race offers various distances for children, adolescents, and young adults. The courses run through the city park and include small to large laps, which are combined depending on age group. The event emphasizes clear age group separation and is especially aimed at young runners.
course_highlights: Course lengths from 0.6 km to 5 km, tailored to age groups
Laps in the city park with a combination of small and large laps
Age group separation by calendar year for fair competitions
additional: The age groups are determined by the calendar year, e.g., a 6-year-old runner in 2025 belongs to the age group 6. Participants are asked to correctly register their age groups during late registration. Various race distances, age group separation, registration with correct age information, running in laps on the sports field.

name: Sparkassen-LüneCross
description: The Sparkassen-LüneCross is an exciting and challenging cross-country event set amidst nature and the city of Lüneburg. The varied course runs over sandy and root-covered paths, meadows, forest trails, and gravel tracks, demanding endurance, strength, and running technique. Main races are offered over 4 km and 8 km, with shorter distances for children and adolescents as well as relay competitions over 8 km. Besides the sporting experience, the focus is on the fun of running and community, with a school ranking and a social award ceremony afterwards.
course_highlights: Varied terrain with sandy and root-covered paths
Courses through meadows, forest trails, and gravel tracks
Relay races over 8 km with 3 to 6 runners possible
additional: There is a school ranking with prizes for schools with the highest participation rate. Catering is provided, and after the races, an award ceremony and social gathering take place. Relay competitions can be formed with 3 to 6 runners from family, company, team, or friends. The course runs through nature, including forest trails, meadows, sand, and gravel; registration required; family and group events possible.

name: TSV Bayer 04 Talent- und Speed-Cross
description: The TSV Bayer 04 Talent and Speed Cross in Leverkusen is an established cross-country race, primarily serving as a selection race for school classes up to U16 as well as for the U18 age group and older. The event is a regular part of the North Rhine Cross Cup and features a varied course on the synthetic track beside the Fritz-Jacobi facility. With a tight schedule and exciting races, including cross sprints, the event offers an exhilarating experience for both participants and spectators. The race has seen increasing participation numbers and is accompanied by good catering and professional moderation.
course_highlights: Varied course on the synthetic track beside the Fritz-Jacobi facility
Part of the North Rhine Cross Cup for age groups M/W 11 to 15
Exciting cross sprints especially in the U18 category
additional: The event recorded an increase of nearly 200 participants. There is good catering and professional moderation. The races are scheduled back-to-back in a tight timetable. Dates in November 2026, cross-country race as part of the North Rhine Cross Cup, various age groups, competition on unpaved terrain.

name: Westerwinkellauf
location: Wasserschloss Westerwinkel, Ascheberg-Herbern, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Westerwinkellauf is a traditional fun run around the Wasserschloss Westerwinkel in Ascheberg-Herbern. The course mostly runs on park paths and offers a scenic running environment. The event is open to runners and walkers of all ages and is timed with modern Race Result technology. The start and finish areas are located at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern. A pleasant atmosphere is ensured by refreshments from local partners and professional moderation.
course_highlights: Course mainly on park paths around Wasserschloss Westerwinkel
Start and finish at the sports and swimming hall in Herbern
Scenic running environment with good infrastructure
additional: Timing is done with Race Result using multiple chips in the bib number, which are collected at the finish. No refunds for non-participation. Parking is available in the schoolyard of Mariengrundschule. Moderation by Janik Broszeit from Dortmund. Refreshments for participants and spectators provided by Getränke Zimmermann. Routes, start times, site plan, registration, results, certificates, running and walking categories, participation for school groups, free participation for registered students.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional race event that has been held in Rodgau since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series includes four dates, each featuring 5 km and 10 km courses through the Jügesheimer Forest, described as fast and flat. The event takes place at the Maingau Energy Stadium in Rodgau Jügesheim and offers team rankings for men's, women's, and mixed teams. The organization is highly praised, and there is a corona-compliant outdoor changing area. Timing is done with a bib chip.
course_highlights: Flat, fast course through the Jügesheimer Forest
Event at the Maingau Energy Stadium Rodgau Jügesheim
Team rankings for men's, women's, and mixed teams
additional: Start times: 5 km at 14:00, 10 km at 15:00. Chip timing with bib chip (button timing). The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Club members get a 50% discount on the entry fee when registering via email. Payment is cash on site. There is a corona-compliant outdoor changing area (covered). The course is very popular for personal bests. The event takes place on four Saturdays: 01.11.2025, 06.12.2025, 03.01.2026, 07.02.2026. The series includes multiple runs, with chip timing and refreshments at the stadium. Teams of three are possible. The event is also geared towards winter training, with provided training plans.

name: TRAIL LÁZNĚ VELICHOVKY
location: Lázně Velichovky, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Lázně Velichovky Trail is the third annual autumn trail race held in the historic Velichovky Spa. It offers a diverse and beautiful running terrain with start and finish on the spa colonnade, where covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant are available. The race is complemented by spa services including a café and provides original medals, gifts, and a race packet. The atmosphere is friendly and the race is suitable for all trail running enthusiasts and spa environment lovers.
course_highlights: The most colorful autumn running terrain
Start and finish on the spa colonnade
Covered facilities with changing rooms and a restaurant
additional: The race includes an original medal, a race packet, an electronic chip for timing, refreshments during and after the race, changing rooms, baggage storage, toilets, medical services, and an accompanying program. There is also a sale of Gladiator Race clothing and parking near the race center. Registration is available online via reg-sportvisio.cz. Medals, chip timing, race photos, diplomas, refreshments, and spa services are provided.

name: Jizerun
location: stadion Čelákovice, Čelákovice, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
organizer: přátelé a sportovní nadšenci z Hitgymu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: RUN AND FUN - pouze do 31. 8. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: NO FUN, JUST RUN - pouze do 24. 10. 2026 nebo do vyprodání kapacity.

description: Jizerun is a relay running race that connects Prague and the Jizera Mountains. Teams of 4-5 members run a total of 164 km along cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains over the course of one day. The race offers a unique team experience with the option to choose from two start packages, which include various benefits such as a sports T-shirt, headband, evening buffet, and finisher medals. The event is suitable for men's, women's, mixed, and corporate relays and is supported by the main partner Metrostav a.s.
course_highlights: 164 km route from Prague to the Jizera Mountains
Combination of cycle paths and trails in the Jizera Mountains
Relays of 4-5 team members with at least 3 segments per runner
additional: Start packages are team-based for 5 people. The RUN&FUN package includes T-shirts, headbands, dinner in the form of a buffet, finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking, and a finisher party with live music. The NO FUN, JUST RUN package includes finisher medals, refreshments, race bibs, GPS tracking, and a finisher party. There are mobile toilets, showers at the finish, medical services, a speaker, and full event organization. When registering, it is necessary to fill in the team captain's details and later add the team composition and T-shirt sizes. Each team member must run at least 3 segments, and only one car per team is allowed. The race supports a fundraising campaign for hospice and hospice care in the Czech Republic. Registration begins in April 2026.

name: Běh kolem Práchně
description: The Práchně Run is a traditional running race in Horažďovice, offering a course length of 9.5 km. From 2024, an updated route will be used, which follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway. The start and finish are located in front of Envicentrum PROUD, where facilities for runners including changing rooms, toilets, and refreshments are provided. The results are announced approximately at 12:00 after the race. The event is organized by DDM Horažďovice and KČT Horažďovice, who ensure a pleasant atmosphere and smooth course of the event.
course_highlights: The 9.5 km course follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway
Start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD with full facilities
Mixed race type in the picturesque environment of Horažďovice
additional: Results are announced approximately at 12:00 in Envicentrum PROUD, where refreshments, changing rooms, and toilets are available. The course follows the Horažďovice Green Walkway, with start and finish in front of Envicentrum PROUD, and facilities provided after the race.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race on a 3.2 km course designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The route mainly passes through gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone and consists of nearly two laps around a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon flatbread as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Timing is recorded for each runner, and the top three in both adult and children categories receive small prizes. The recommended ways to reach the start are by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The races are held on the first Saturday of each month, starting at 9:00 AM, with registration from 8:15 to 8:55. Participants can arrive by bike, on foot, by car, or by trolleybus. The main course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with a length of 3.2 km, and the children's course is 800 meters long.

name: Memoriál MUDr. Josefa Podmolíka - Běžecký festival Otrokovice 2026
description: The Otrokovice Running Festival is a traditional sporting event offering a wide range of races including a marathon, half marathon, relay half marathon, decimarathon, and youth races. The Memorial of MUDr. Josef Podmolík is the highlight half marathon race, held in the beautiful environment of Otrokovice. Participants can enjoy a quality course with electronic timing and the atmosphere of a running festival with a rich program for all age groups. Registration and winners' ceremony take place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall.
course_highlights: Half marathon and marathon course in Otrokovice with chip timing
Decimarathon circuit of 4.2195 km
Youth races with various distances from 200 m to 1700 m
additional: Registration of participants takes place at the Otrokovice Municipal Sports Hall. Runners are required to pick up their start number and chip for electronic timing. Winners are announced gradually after each race, and attendance at the awards ceremony is mandatory. Registration is done via email. The event includes various age categories and races on city streets and in the sports hall.

name: Svatojánská 20
location: TJ Lokomotiva Beroun, Beroun, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Svatojánská 20 is a traditional running race held in Beroun, offering two main routes of 11 and 18 kilometers. The start and finish are located at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium. The routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream, with turnarounds in V Kozle settlement (11 km) and in Svatý Jan pod Skálou (18 km). The race is open to a wide age category and offers refreshments at the finish line, as well as monetary and material prizes for the best runners.
course_highlights: Routes mainly run on asphalt and cycle paths along the Berounka River and Loděnický Stream
Turnaround for the 11 km route is in V Kozle settlement, for the 18 km route in Svatý Jan pod Skálou
Start and finish at the TJ Lokomotiva Beroun athletics stadium
additional: Registration and check-in on-site on race day from 11:00 to 12:40. Pre-registered runners with payment by November 5th will receive a start number with their name. Refreshments at the finish line include tea and cookies. The race takes place in full road traffic; participants must follow traffic rules and run at their own risk. Parking is available around the stadium; nearby parking lots are recommended due to blue zones. The race offers online registration as well as on-site registration, medals, certificates, and monetary prizes are awarded.

name: Kovářská pětka
location: Baťovský areál, Zlín, Zlínský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Kovárna VIVA a spolkem Běhy Zlín
description: Kovářská pětka is a traditional city road race 5 kilometers long, held in the Baťovský area in Zlín. The race is intended for both adults and children, organized by Kovárna VIVA in cooperation with Běhy Zlín. The event offers a quality sports experience in the center of the regional city with international participation. It attracts a wide running community every year and is known for its friendly atmosphere and well-organized course.
course_highlights: The route passes through the former Baťovský area in Zlín
Road race over 5 kilometers in an urban environment
The race is suitable for adults and children
additional: The race is part of the year-round Zlín running competition. Organizers provide online results and event photos. Children's categories are also offered within the race. The organization ensures quality timing and supports the regional running community. The race is part of a series of runs in Zlín, offering various age categories and is suitable for the general public.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - listopad
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is suitable for slow and fast runners, experienced and beginners who want to improve their personal best, train, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for each participant, and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.
course_highlights: The course runs on asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children run 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka Park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended arrival by bike, on foot, rollerblades, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is available at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings (unattended) and a mobile valuables storage. WC cabins are available on site. The start is at 9:07 AM, registration from 8:15 to 8:45 AM, online registration available. The race takes place in Královská obora - Stromovka Park, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, with changing rooms and toilets available.

name: Labský půlmaraton
location: Lysá nad Labem, Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský, Czech Republic
description: The Labský Half Marathon is a running race held in Lysá nad Labem, offering two routes approximately 12.5 km and 21.3 km long. The routes run through flat Polabian forest with surfaces combining paved and unpaved roads, footpaths, and short sections of asphalt or concrete. The start and finish are at the racecourse, which provides refreshments, baggage storage, and other facilities. The race is suitable for the general public, with a capacity limited to 700 participants. The program also includes children's races of various lengths depending on age.
course_highlights: Routes run flat through the beautiful Polabian forest
Start after about 1 km on the racecourse
Refreshment stations at 8 km and 17 km (21 km route), one station at 8 km (12 km route)
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 participants. Baggage storage, changing tents, toilets, refreshments, and a raffle are available for runners. Parking is available on-site for a fee of 50 CZK per car. Children's races range from 200 to 1000 meters depending on age. The route is marked with flags, signs, and flour arrows, with each kilometer approximately indicated. The race includes children's races, online registration is possible, and the route may be adjusted due to nearby reconstruction.

name: Závod dvojic
description: Hostivařské dvojice is a relay running race for pairs, offering a unique team running experience in the beautiful environment of Hostivař. The race is designed for pairs who want to enjoy a sporting challenge while experiencing the atmosphere of a friendly race. The course runs through scenic terrain and is suitable for runners of all levels. Come run and enjoy a great sporting event in a friendly community.
course_highlights: Relay run in pairs
Scenic environment of Hostivař
Friendly race atmosphere
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, in Kladno. It is a team relay discipline, with registrations available online.

name: Hornická desítka
location: Národní dům, Frýdek-Místek, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
description: Hornická desítka is a traditional running race held in Frýdek-Místek, which has been taking place since 1980 with breaks and a revival of the tradition in 1996. The race offers various running disciplines including youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The event celebrates movement and sportsmanship, attracting hundreds to thousands of participants of all ages and is known for its excellent organization and friendly atmosphere. The start is at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and the race is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: The course runs around Frýdek-Místek with a history dating back to 1980
Main race of 10 km with accompanying youth races and a health run
Start and finish at the National House in Frýdek-Místek
additional: The race includes a non-competitive run for parents with children, youth races, a health run, and the main 10 km race. The event is known for its excellent organization and relaxed atmosphere. The organizer is Tělovýchovná jednota Slezan Frýdek-Místek, z.s. The race takes place on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at the National House in Frýdek-Místek, and includes road closures and traffic measures.

name: Malá Pardubická cross country
location: Labe and vicinity, near TJ Dynamo canoe club, Pardubice, Czech Republic
description: The Small Pardubice Cross Country is a traditional cross country race organized by the athletic club AC Pardubice. The race takes place around the Labe River and near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club. Organizers warmly invite all runners and running fans to this popular event, which offers a sporting experience in a natural environment. Regulations and further information are available on the club's website.
course_highlights: Cross country race in natural terrain around the Labe River
Start and finish near the TJ Dynamo Pardubice canoeing club
Traditional running event organized by AC Pardubice
additional: The race takes place on November 7, 2026, is open to the general public including children and youth, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Gorlicki Bieg Górski
location: Wysowa-Zdroju, Powiat Gorlicki, Województwo Małopolskie, Poland

tiers.description: 60 zł brutto płatne przelewem w terminie do 30.06.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 80 zł brutto płatne przelewem w terminie do 31.10.2026 r.

tiers.label: tier_2

description: The Gorlicki Mountain Run is an annual running event held in the picturesque surroundings of Radocyna and Magura Małastowska in the Low Beskids. The competition offers three distances: 7.6 km, 23.9 km, and a Vertical run of 2.3 km with significant elevation gain. The race attracts both amateurs and elite runners, providing a unique atmosphere and cash prizes. The participant limit is 400 people, with start and finish located at the State Forests OSW "Radocyna" and Magura Ski Park. This is the eleventh edition of this event, which combines sporting competition with the beauty of mountain nature.
course_highlights: 24 km route with 610 m elevation gain
7 km route with 160 m elevation gain
Vertical 2.3 km with 340 m elevation gain to Magura Małastowska
additional: Participant limit: 400 people (150 for 7 km, 250 for 24 km). Start and finish at the State Forests OSW "Radocyna". The race office is open from 7:45 to 10:00. The time limit for the 24 km is 5 hours. Participants must have race numbers attached to the front of their shirts or shorts. Individuals with a Rate My Trail ranking of 730 points or higher start free of charge. The routes include mountain trails with muddy sections, and the start is scheduled for 10:30. The event attracts both amateurs and experienced trail runners.

name: Heidelauf Halle am 08.11.2026
description: The 280th Heidelauf Halle will take place on November 8, 2026, in the Dölauer Heide in Halle (Saale). The traditional running event is organized by SV Halle Triathlon. The event offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to compete on a nature-oriented course in the forest area. The Heidelauf is known for its varied route and family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Run through the Dölauer Heide, a large forest area
Nature-oriented and varied forest course
Suitable for children, adolescents, active runners, and masters
additional: Registration deadline is on the day of the event, November 8, 2026. The organizer is SV Halle Triathlon. The event includes various age and performance categories. Categories for children, youth, active runners, and masters; the event takes place in the Dölauer Heide.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen event. It is organized by the local running community, which also manages the historic Wellen Marathon, one of the oldest marathons in Germany. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere with various course options and strong local support from volunteers, sponsors, and the local fire brigade. The organizers emphasize maintaining the proven challenge and familiarity of the event.
course_highlights: Part of the traditional Rund um Wellen event with four courses
Rural, family-friendly atmosphere organized by a local club
Strong local support from volunteers and fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather with an average of 7 °C (minimum 2 °C) and frequent rain (45 mm precipitation). Start location is Beverstedt-Wellen. Terrain: mixed, registration: not specified, further notes: part of the Rund um Wellen event, local support and volunteers involved

name: Winterlaufserie
description: The Nuremberg Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in multiple stages around Dutzendteich and Silbersee in Nuremberg. The races take place on gravel and partially paved paths, with snow and ice possible on the course, emphasizing the winter character. The series offers various distances from 5 km to 20 km and is aimed at recreational athletes of all ages. The event is open to all runners, and club membership is not required. Times are measured electronically, and there is a cup ranking for participants who take part in all three races.
course_highlights: Running course around Dutzendteich and Silbersee
Gravel and partially paved paths
Possible ice and snow conditions on the course
additional: The winter running series consists of three races with distances of 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 20 km spread over three dates. Participants must register for all three races to be eligible for the cup ranking. The bib number is non-transferable and must be visibly worn. Refreshments are available at the start/finish area. The course may change due to official orders. Routes around Dutzendteich and Silbersee; snow and ice possible; no accompaniment on sports equipment allowed; no aids such as inline skates; start times between November 2025 and February 2026.

name: Winterlaufserie TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen, 1. Lauf
description: The winter running series of TSV Blau-Weiß Ippinghausen is a traditional running event held at the Weidelsburg Stadium in Wolfhagen-Ippinghausen. It includes several races with distances from 310 meters to 15 kilometers on paved and tarmacked forest paths. The series is open to all age groups and offers individual and team rankings with certificates and awards. The event is approved by the Hessian Athletics Association and emphasizes fair conditions, for example, wearing spikes is not allowed.
course_highlights: 15 km on paved and tarmacked forest paths
Additional distances: 4.2 km, 2 km, 940 m, and 310 m on paved forest paths
Start and finish at Weidelsburg Stadium / sports field in Ippinghausen
additional: Late registrations are possible on race day for a fee of 2 EUR. The age groups are based on DLV rules 2025. The event is approved by the HLV, spikes are not allowed. There are individual and team rankings with certificates and awards. Registration opens 14 days before each race. Multiple distances, registration via Raceresult, no spikes allowed, series ranking based on the best three runs, events take place in all weather conditions.

name: 50. Hermann-Löns-Park-Lauf
location: Hermann-Löns-Park, Hannover-Wülferode, Hannover, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Hermann-Löns-Park Run in Hannover-Kirchrode is a traditional road and community run held annually in early November. The event offers various distances from 400 meters to 10 kilometers, which are officially measured and approved by the German Athletics Association. The race features a family-friendly atmosphere with volunteer support and professional timing. Participants can enjoy a raffle and refreshments at the finish area, making it a popular event in the region.
course_highlights: Officially measured 5 km and 10 km courses according to DLV standards
Run through Hermann-Löns-Park in Hannover-Kirchrode
Various distances from 400 m to 10 km for all age groups
additional: Late registrations are possible on-site on Saturday from 2 pm to 4 pm and on Sunday from 9 am until 45 minutes before the start. Bib numbers can be collected on both days. Electronic timing with results linked to the bib number will be used. Spikes are not allowed and may lead to disqualification. The event takes place in all weather conditions. A deposit of 2€ is required at registration for the bib. Distances from 1.5 km to 10 km, marathon relay, registration and results available online.

name: Bibersfelder Herbstlauf
description: The Bibersfeld Autumn Run is part of the race series "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir" and offers suitable courses for runners of all ages. The event is characterized by varied routes, with the classic 10-kilometer run at its center. Participants can look forward to a family-friendly atmosphere, welcoming both individual runners and teams. All finishers receive certificates and gifts, and younger runners also receive medals. Registration is exclusively online, and late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before the start.
course_highlights: Classic 10-kilometer run
Family-friendly event with courses for all age groups
Part of the regional race series "Stadtwerke - Läuft bei dir"
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 45 minutes before the start. Certificates are provided digitally and can be printed on-site or conveniently from home. The award ceremony of the Cup Quartet takes place after the fourth race in Bibersfeld around 2:00 PM. Various running and walking distances, online registration only, certificates can be printed on-site or at home, including a ten-kilometer run and half marathon.

name: Braunschweiger Speed5
description: The Braunschweig Speed5 is the fastest public race in the city of Braunschweig, organized by the Police Sports Club Braunschweig and the Braunschweig Running Club. The running event on November 8, 2026, offers exciting competitions with an 800 m children's run, a 1-mile school run, and a measured 5 km race for recreational and ambitious runners of all ages. The event features professional chip timing, a clear time limit for the fast 5 km race, and a friendly atmosphere with finish line refreshments and musical accompaniment. The award ceremonies honor the best female and male runners in various age groups and main races.
course_highlights: Measured 5 km course with a target finish time of 22 minutes in the fast race
Children's run over 800 m and school run over 1 mile
Professional chip timing and awards for top finishers
