additional: Number pickup from 09:15 AM at the Police Sports Club grounds. Finish line refreshments for runners and musical entertainment by DJ Carlito. Paramedics are on site for safety. There is a pacemaker in the slow 5 km race to enable times under 20 minutes. Certificates can be downloaded online or on-site after the race. Course: 5 km measured, children's and school runs, registration via RaceResults, parking along Georg-Westermann-Allee and Ebertallee, event held in Prinzenpark.

name: Friesenheimer Eulenlauf
description: The Friesenheimer Owl Run returns after a six-year break on November 8, 2026, organized by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. Participants can choose from classic 10 km races, a school run, a 400 m toddler run, and a new 3 km course for beginners and newcomers, which also hosts the school run. The event is open to runners of all ages and skill levels and takes place on the club grounds in Ludwigshafen-Friesenheim. The organizers look forward to many participants and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Classic 10 km course
School run and toddler run over 400 m
New 3 km course for beginners and newcomers
additional: The school run takes place on the 3 km course. Registration is via br-timing. The event is held by SVF Ludwigshafen 1898 / 1946 e.V. on the club grounds at Teichgasse 31, 67063 Ludwigshafen am Rhein. Registration is possible until November 6, 2026, with late entries available for a fee. The courses are measured, and weather conditions are expected to be rainy in November.

name: Hohen Neuendorfer Herbstlauf
description: The Hohen Neuendorf Autumn Run is a traditional running event that has been held in Hohen Neuendorf since 1900 and is considered the birthplace of cross country running in Germany. The race attracts numerous participants from the region and beyond each year and offers courses for all age groups, from toddlers' runs to longer distances. The event is intergenerational and supported by many volunteers and local partners. It traditionally takes place in November and is a fixed part of the regional sports calendar.
course_highlights: Traditional cross country race with history since 1900
Intergenerational participation from 3 to over 90 years old
Support from local clubs and reservists along the course
additional: The race includes various distances, including a 400-meter toddler run and a 5.5 km course. The event is supported by many volunteers, including reservists from Roter Adler in Lehnitz. The autumn run is one of the largest running events in the Oberhavel district and attracts participants from different regions. The autumn run takes place at the Rudolf-Harbig sports field and is weather-dependent. Registration is via MyRacepartner. The event is known for its historical significance in cross country running in Germany and promotes community spirit in sports.

name: int. Hohenzollern Berglauf
description: The International Hohenzollern Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race organized by the Ski-Club Hechingen e.V. The challenging course starts from the Hechinger Weiherstadion and leads up to Hohenzollern Castle, demanding a lot from the runners. The race attracts both beginners and experienced mountain specialists and is characterized by a special atmosphere with music and enthusiasm along the route. With over 70 volunteers and a large number of participants, the race is a highlight in the regional race calendar.
course_highlights: Start at Hechinger Weiherstadion
Challenging ascent from kilometer 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle
Atmospheric music along the route (Runner’s Dixxies at km 3, Schnorchelhuaschter at km 5.5)
additional: The race is organized by the Ski-Club Hechingen with over 70 volunteers. The course begins relatively flat and becomes increasingly steep from kilometer 4 to the finish in the courtyard of Hohenzollern Castle. The event offers a special atmosphere with live rock music at the start and musical ambiance along the route. Participants include both beginners and experienced mountain runners, some of whom have been running for over 30 years. Registration is open until November 5, 2025, with a shuttle service to the castle and a supporting program including an award ceremony.

name: Int. Martinslauf
description: The International Martinslauf in Losheim am See is a popular community run that takes place annually in the village center and at the Losheim reservoir. The event attracts up to 1,500 runners and offers courses over 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km, which are scenically located around the reservoir. Runners can register until shortly before the start, making the race attractive for last-minute participants. The Martinslauf is a well-established event in Saarland and is organized by TV 1929 Losheim e.V.
course_highlights: Running courses around the Losheim reservoir
Course lengths: 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Start and finish in the village center of Losheim
additional: Registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the respective start. Parking is available at several locations in the Losheim village center. With up to 1,500 participants, it is one of the largest community runs in Saarland. Courses around the reservoir, relay and individual races, online registration, parking in Losheim, running events in June, April, September 2024, 2025, 2026.

name: Karlsbader Volkslauf
description: The Karlsbad People's Race is a traditional running event that has been firmly established in the calendars of many runners for over three decades. The event offers various races, including the main 10 km race, a 2 km Sparkassen school run, and a 400 m toddler run for the youngest participants. Despite changing weather conditions, the People's Race attracts numerous participants and is characterized by good organization and a family-friendly atmosphere. The course runs through the beautiful surroundings of Karlsbad-Langensteinbach and offers an attractive running experience for both ambitious runners and recreational athletes.
course_highlights: Main race over 10 km with a challenging course
2 km Sparkassen school run for the youth
400 m toddler run as a premiere last year
additional: The People's Race includes youth races for children and teenagers. The event is known for its good organization and regularly attracts over 200 finishers. Mayors and local representatives praise the event, which also attracts numerous participants in rain. The event features youth races for children and teenagers as well as various race distances for all age groups. The event takes place in all weather conditions and is very popular among participants.

name: Lauf am Lech - 2. Lauf der Jedermannserie
description: The Lech Run is the second race in the recreational series organized by LG Donau-Ries, a fall running series in the Donau-Ries region in Bavaria. The race takes place at the Georg-Weber-Stadium in Rain and offers courses of 3 km and 10 km. The series is aimed at both recreational athletes and experienced runners and takes place from location to location, with each race held at a different venue. Bib numbers are equipped with transponders and must be collected at least 20 minutes before the start. An online pre-registration is recommended to avoid waiting times on race day.
course_highlights: Start at Georg-Weber-Stadium in Rain
Course lengths of 3 km and 10 km
Part of a multi-event running series through various locations in Donau-Ries
additional: Bib numbers with transponders, collection at least 20 minutes before start, online pre-registration recommended to avoid queues on race day. Participants can pre-register online; the series includes multiple locations in the region; weather in November is usually rainy.

name: Lauf der 39. Crosslauf-Serie 2026 Cochem-Zell in Kaisersesch
description: The 3rd race of the 39th Cross Country Series 2026 in Kaisersesch takes place at the forest sports field in the Eifel and offers courses for children, students, hobby runners, and adults. The distances range from 300 meters for the youngest to 8.2 kilometers in the main race for U20 and older participants. The course runs around Kaisersesch, with children and adolescents running a slightly adjusted loop. The race is part of the Cochem-Zell Cross Country Series, where participants earn points for the overall standings and can compete for the district championship title. The event is organized by the local athletics club with support from volunteers for catering and organization.
course_highlights: Course around Kaisersesch
Adjusted loops for children and adolescents
Part of the Cochem-Zell Cross Country Series with overall standings
additional: The race is organized by the local athletics club, with volunteers for cake donations, sales, and the start-finish area. In one of the previous editions, 145 participants competed across all distances. Typical November weather with around 7°C and rainy days is expected. The courses vary from 300 meters for the youngest to 8.2 kilometers for the main race; the event is rooted in the Cochem-Zell region and takes place in typical November weather.

name: Lauf Rund um den Höglwörther See
description: The run around Lake Höglwörth is a traditional race in Teisendorf that delights with a scenic course around Lake Höglwörth. The event offers various distances, including a 13 km run, a 4.2 km charity run, as well as children’s and kids’ races. The atmosphere is characterized by a sense of community, live music, and great catering at the finish line. The event also supports regional donation projects and promotes team spirit through team rankings.
course_highlights: 13 km course around Lake Höglwörth with scenic nature
4.2 km charity run as a loop around the outskirts of Teisendorf
Children’s and kids’ races with child-friendly routes in the town center
additional: Race number pickup from 08:30 in the Teisendorf gymnasium near the start/finish. Timing is done with a disposable transponder attached to the race number. There is a refreshment station on the course and a free catering stand at the finish with tea, coffee, water, fruit, and cake. Live music along the route and DJ/announcer at the finish. Team rankings for clubs/companies with special prizes and brewery tour for the winning team. Late registrations are possible on the event day until 11:00 (for an additional fee). Terrain/charity run/community event, course lengths of 4.2 km and 13 km, starting in the Teisendorf gymnasium.

name: Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh
location: Wildenloh bei Oldenburg, Landkreis Oldenburg, Niedersachsen, Germany
description: The Lop dwasch dörn Wildenloh is a traditional cross-country race held in early November on the beautiful trail in Wildenloh west of Oldenburg. The name means "Run across Wildenloh" and reflects the rustic character of the event, which takes place in the forest without showers. The event is organized by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V., which ensures a family-friendly and natural running atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on the local trail in Wildenloh
Rustic forest course without showers
Traditional event with regional character
additional: The race takes place on a rustic forest course without showers. There are multiple race distances (short distance 1600m, medium distance 3200m) with result lists from previous years available. The event is organized by the sports club Team Laufrausch e.V. It occurs annually in November, no showers on site, results are published, including children and adult categories.

name: Martinslauf
location: Unterbacher See, Düsseldorf, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: SFD '75 e. V., pulsschlag, SC Grün Weiß Paderborn, Friedrich-Rister-Gedächtnislauf
description: The Martinslauf is organized by SFD '75 e. V. for the 48th time around Lake Unterbach in Düsseldorf. The event offers a variety of races for all age groups, including children and youth runs, an inclusion run, and Nordic walking. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a diverse course that provides both sporting challenges and fun for the whole family. After the races, award ceremonies are held for various age groups, and there is an option to purchase a personalized finisher medal.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Unterbach
Various distances from 150 m to 10 km
Start and finish at the South Beach of Lake Unterbach
additional: Race bibs can be collected by mail (additional charge of 4 EUR) or on-site. Late registrations are possible with a fee of 3 EUR. Timing is done with a chip integrated into the start number, no rental fee. Showers are available at the nearby campground. Free parking is available at South and North Beach of Lake Unterbach. Finisher medals with name engraving and time can be ordered for 13 EUR and will be handed out on the event day. The 10 km race finishes by 13:15, with the event ending around 14:00. The Martinslauf offers a mix of popular runs, family events, and evening light runs, focusing on running fun, community, and a special atmosphere. Participation is at your own risk, with various race distances and activities for children and adults.

name: Mausebergecrosslauf
description: The Mauseberge Cross Run is an autumn cross-country race held in the Mauseberge Forest near Husum in northern Germany. The course runs over natural forest paths with uneven terrain, mud, and several inclines. The event is organized by the athletics department of the Husum Sports Club, and it is a traditional race in the regional calendar.
course_highlights: Natural forest paths in Mauseberge Forest
Uneven terrain with mud
Several inclines
additional: Start location is Husum, accessible by car. Typical November weather with an average of 7°C (minimum 2°C) and frequent rain (about 45 mm of precipitation). The race takes place in November with typical autumn weather, temperatures around 2-7°C, and rain. Registration with the organizer is recommended, and start spots are available for various distances, including 1 km, 3.35 km, 5 km, 6.67 km, and 8.33 km.

name: Obersulmer Volkslauf
description: The Obersulmer Volkslauf takes place on November 8, 2026, around Lake Breitenauer and offers an attractive running experience for runners of all ages. The event includes various distances such as the main race over 10 km, the fun run over 5 km, as well as walking and Nordic walking routes. The course is scenic with moderate elevation changes and is accompanied by enthusiastic spectators. The family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the Volkslauf a popular running event in the region.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Breitenauer
5 km route with 227 m start and 233 m elevation
Attractive course with split and gravel surfaces
additional: Professional timing with transponder in the bib. Bib to be worn at the front. Medals for children and students at the finish line. Award ceremonies directly after the races at the construction yard premises. The top three finishers in the fun run, main race, and walking/nordic walking receive a wine gift. Free parking directly at Lake Breitenauer. The course runs over an attractive loop with split and gravel surfaces. Course profile: 5 km and 10 km rounds, refreshments along the route, catering by the lake kiosk, medical services provided by the German Red Cross, free parking at the lake, participation in any weather, personal data will be used in accordance with data protection regulations.

name: Quickborn Run über 5 km und 10 km
description: The Quickborn Run is organized by TuS Holstein Quickborn and will take place in 2026 for the 47th time. There are two race distances, 5 km and 10 km, starting on November 8 in Quickborn. A childcare service is offered for families with young children, allowing parents to participate as well. The event provides changing facilities, free parking, and a free rental chip for timing. The races are open to youths from 12 or 14 years old and follow the rules of the German Athletics Association.
course_highlights: 5 km and 10 km race distances
Start and finish at the Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium in Quickborn
Free rental chip for timing
additional: Start times: 10:00 AM for the 5 km race, 11:00 AM for the 10 km race. Race packets can be picked up from 8:00 to 10:30 AM at the Dietrich-Bonhoeffer-Gymnasium. Changing facilities are available in the sports hall. Free parking is available at the sports hall and in the AKN train station parking garage. Participation is open from age 12 for the 5 km and from age 14 for the 10 km. Registration opens on July 1, 2026, via the Race Result portal. Late registrations on the event day are possible but with limited participant numbers, especially for the 5 km race. Course lengths: 5 km and 10 km, starting from age 12 for 5 km, age 14 for 10 km, limited start spots, parking available at the sports hall and AKN train station parking garage.

name: Refrather Herbstlauf
location: Königsforst, Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Refrather Autumn Run is a traditional race classic in the Königsforst near Bergisch Gladbach-Refrath, taking place annually since 1986. The event offers races over 5 km, 10 km, and a half marathon, all measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and eligible for best lists. The courses lead through the autumnal forest and feature turnaround sections with challenging yet scenic segments. The race attracts both competitive athletes and recreational runners and concludes with prompt award ceremonies for all age groups.
course_highlights: Turnaround sections through the autumnal Königsforst
DLV-measured courses over 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Scenic forest trails with challenging segments
additional: Start times: 5 km at 10:00 AM, 10 km at 11:00 AM, half marathon at 12:30 PM. Award ceremonies follow shortly after crossing the finish line. Parking is available at Rather Weg, approximately 1.2 km from the A4 exit Bensberg. Public transport access via KVB line 1 to 'Refrath'. The 5 km and 10 km courses are measured by the DLV and eligible for best lists. Participants can register online. The courses are gently hilly with a elevation difference of about 6 meters for the 5 km race and 20 meters for the 10 km race. The event has been a fixture in the regional running calendar for many years.

name: Rursee-Marathon
description: The Rursee Marathon takes place on November 8, 2026, in Simmerath-Einruhr and offers runners a unique natural experience in the Eifel National Park. The marathon route leads on a profiling loop along the Obersee, Urftsee, and Rursee lakes with magnificent autumn impressions and diverse landscapes. In addition to the marathon, there are other competitions such as the ultra run over 52 km, a 16.5 km run, a 5 km run, and children's races. The event is known for its challenging course and picturesque surroundings, making every run a special experience.
course_highlights: Profiling loop along Obersee, Urftsee, and Rursee
Course through wooded areas with magnificent autumn impressions
Circumnavigation of the entire Rursee with challenging sections and 370 meters of elevation
additional: The marathon starts on November 8, 2026, at 10:30 AM. The course consists of 70% field and forest paths and 30% asphalt. There are 7 refreshment points plus finish area refreshments. Other runs during the weekend include a 5 km run on November 7, 2026, at 3:30 PM, a 52 km ultra run on November 8, 2026, at 9:00 AM (cut-off at 4:30 PM), children's races, and Nordic walking. The event offers perfect orientation on race day and is part of the Eifel Cup. Multiple race options, online registration, event photography, early bird discounts until the end of August, and late registration fees up to 5 euros.

name: RWW-Herbstwaldlauf
description: The RWW Herbstwaldlauf in Bottrop is a traditional race taking place on November 8, 2026. It is part of the international marathon and ultracup and offers various courses for beginners and experienced runners. The event is held at the Jahnstadion, where the tradition of the Herbstwaldlauf has been rooted since 1973. Participants can look forward to a sporting challenge in a picturesque forest setting that combines community and passion for running.
course_highlights: Run through the scenic forest landscape of Bottrop
Start and finish at the historic Jahnstadion
Part of the international marathon and ultracup
additional: The finish time for all races is 3:30 PM. There is a human support vehicle available. T-shirts can be ordered in advance. The event takes place at the Jahnstadion, where the training groups of Adler-Langlauf Bottrop are also active. The race occurs in November, with routes through forests and nature, offering a friendly club atmosphere for runners of all levels.

name: Steinhart500 - KLIMANEUTRAL
description: The Steinhart500 is a climate-neutral marathon taking place on November 8, 2026, in Steinfurt. The course runs through varied terrain with a special focus on environmental protection, including planting trees as CO2 offset. From 28 kilometers, flexible tickets are available, allowing runners to shorten the distance during the race and still be officially timed. Since 2022, there has also been a shortened 7-kilometer loop, ideal for beginners, offering a challenging but manageable course with 50 meters of elevation gain, including a demanding hill leading to the Finnish track.
course_highlights: Climate-neutral race with CO2 offset through planted trees along the course
Flexible tickets from 28 km allow early finish with official timing
7 km beginner-friendly loop with 50 meters of elevation and a challenging hill to the Finnish track
additional: All tickets from 28 kilometers are flexible, allowing for a reduction in distance during the race. The event is climate-neutral, with particular attention to waste reduction and minimizing environmental impact from travel. The 7 km loop has been introduced since 2022 and leads left under the B 54 underpass to the Finnish track, featuring a hill that presents a challenge for beginners. Registration opens on September 1, 2026. Flexible tickets are available, with no refunds for non-participation. Changes may occur in case of force majeure. Detailed course information is available online.

name: Steinheimer Geologenlauf

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voranmeldung ist Online bis Mittwoch, 05. November 2025, 20:00 Uhr möglich (incl. personifizierte StartNr)

description: The Steinheimer Geologenlauf is a traditional race that has been taking place for over 35 years in the beautiful Steinheimer Basin. The main course is 10 km long, mostly asphalted with two smaller inclines, and offers an attractive challenge for both ambitious runners and beginners. The program is complemented by a 5 km fitness run, team run, walking, and school runs, suitable for all age and performance levels. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, a dedicated team of volunteers, and good catering at the club center.
course_highlights: 10 km course mostly asphalted with two smaller inclines at 3.2 km and 6.4 km
5 km fitness run, very flat and suitable for beginners
Start and finish at the club center in Steinheim am Albuch
additional: Late registrations are possible online after the end of pre-registration and on the day of the event on site until 60 minutes before the respective start, but without a personalized bib number. Changing facilities and showers are available at the club center. Catering includes cake and grilled sausages outdoors. The top three women and men in each age group will be honored. Various race disciplines, online registration, results, and photo galleries are available. Event in November.

name: Süderelbe Halbmarathon durch das Alte Land
price_range: 20 Euro Halbmarathon, 18 Euro 10 km, 5 Euro Kinderlauf
description: The 50th Süderelbe Half Marathon through the Old Land will take place on November 8, 2026. The course runs from the CU Arena at the Neugraben S-Bahn station through the Old Land to Neuenfelde and back again. In addition to the half marathon, there are also races over 10 and 5 kilometers, a 5-kilometer walking competition, and a 1.2-kilometer children's run. The event is organized by the Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V. and offers a diverse program for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the CU Arena, S-Bahn station Neugraben
Course through the picturesque Old Land to Neuenfelde
Return on the same route to the starting point
additional: The program includes races over 10 and 5 kilometers, a 5-kilometer walking competition, and a 1.2-kilometer children's run. The organizer is Hausbruch-Neugrabener Turnerschaft von 1911 e.V., with office hours Mon-Fri 09:00-11:00 and Mon-Thu 16:00-18:00. The course runs through the Old Land with various race distances, children's run, walking competition, cut-off time at 12:30 PM, parking available at the P+R of Neugraben S-Bahn station, bib numbers on race day, refreshments along the course, medals and certificates for participants.

name: Wernigeröder Armeleuteberglauf
description: The Wernigerode Armory Mountain Run is a challenging trail race in November that starts and ends at Haus Blume in Wernigerode. The course takes runners to the Kaiser Tower and offers a varied challenge with narrow forest paths, muddy sections, and steep ascents. In addition to the main races over 5.4 km and 10 km, there are also children's races over 1 km and 2.1 km. The event is organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V. Wernigerode and is a popular local tradition with about 160 participants, including a pasta party on the eve.
course_highlights: Trail race with narrow forest paths
Steep ascents to the Kaiser Tower
Muddy and fast downhill sections
additional: The event includes four distances: 1 km and 2.1 km for children, as well as 5.4 km and 10 km for the main races, which start together later in the morning. A pasta party on the evening before is a small local tradition. Trail character with challenging ascents, registration by email, pasta party on Saturday evening at the Waldgasthaus Armeleuteberg.

name: Westfalenparklauf
location: Westfalenpark Dortmund, Dortmund, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
organizer: Lauftreff Bittermark Dortmund, LT Bittermark Dortmund, Dortmunder Volksbank

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Onlineanmeldung bis 27.10.2026, 23:59 Uhr zum regulären Beitrag

description: The Dortmund Volksbank Westfalenparklauf on November 8, 2026, is a sporting event in Westfalenpark Dortmund that appeals to runners of all ages. The event offers various distances, including Bambini, school, and main runs over 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km with electronic timing. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and runs through the beautiful Westfalenpark. All finishers receive medals, and the fastest runners are honored. The event emphasizes a safe and fair execution with medical support and catering at the finish area.
course_highlights: Course in Westfalenpark Dortmund with start and finish at the Ruhrallee entrance
DLV-measured routes over 2.5 km (1 lap), 5 km (2 laps), and 10 km (4 laps)
Electronic timing and lead bicycle for the main runs
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on race day until 45 minutes before the respective start. No changing facilities are available, but bag storage is provided without liability. Headphones, dogs, and strollers are not permitted. The Bambini run is without timing, only a certificate. Awards for 1st-3rd place male/female in 5 km and 10 km as well as age group winners. Medical support is available on the course and in the start/finish area. Lead bicycles are used for 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km runs. This is a local event with traditional character, including medals for finishers, online registration, and medical assistance on the course. Certain participation conditions apply, such as no dogs or umbrellas allowed.

name: Žandovská desítka
description: Žandovská desítka is a traditional 10-kilometer race held in Žandov in the Liberec Region. The event is part of the District Running League Českolipsko and welcomes runners of all ages. The course runs on roads and in terrain, offering a diverse environment for competitors. The race is a popular event within the regional running community and provides opportunities for personal achievements and meeting running enthusiasts.
course_highlights: The course runs on roads and in terrain
Part of the Českolipsko regional running league
Suitable for all age groups
additional: The race takes place in November 2026, registration and further details are not specified, the event is part of a broader series of regional runs.

name: Dobřichovický běh
location: Škvárový stadion TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Dobřichovice, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobřichovice Run is part of the Brdy Running Cup and offers runners a course approximately 6 km long. The race starts at the ash track stadium of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice and runs along field paths, ensuring a pleasant terrain for running. The event is suitable for both adults and children, who have their own races. The start of the main race is at 1:00 PM, and the organizer is ASK Dipoli.
course_highlights: Course length approx. 6 km
Start at the ash track stadium of TJ Sokol Dobřichovice
Course runs along field paths
additional: Start location: TJ Sokol Dobřichovice, Pražská 375. The course is GPS-measured at 5.72 km, officially listed as 6 km. The race is part of the Brdy Running Cup, which also includes children's races. The surface of the course is a combination of ash track stadium and field paths. The course includes an ash track stadium and field paths; online registration available; races suitable for all age categories.

name: Velká kunratická
location: Kunratický les, Praha 4, Praha, Czech Republic
description: The Velká kunratická is one of the oldest running races in the Czech Republic, held annually on the second Sunday of November in Kunratický Forest in Prague. The race has been held continuously since 1934 and is known for its challenging profile and variable weather, which contribute to its unique atmosphere. It attracts a wide range of runners from young children to veterans, competing on six courses ranging from 370 to 3100 meters. The organizer is the athletic club Spartak Praha 4.
course_highlights: Challenging course profile in Kunratický Forest
Six courses from 370 m to 3100 m
Interval start in pairs with a 10-second gap
additional: All categories start in pairs with a 10-second interval. Official BUSHMAN brand T-shirts can be purchased exclusively during registration. Pickup of ordered T-shirts takes place at the tent on the dam. The total number of participants is limited to 3600, with 2700 runners crossing the Hrádek. Changes to registration are possible until October 14, 2026 via email, thereafter only upon presentation. The race takes place in November, with a limited number of participants set at 3400, online registration opens on October 5, 2026, on-site registration available, with various age and performance categories.

name: Marceliński Bieg Jesienny 2026
description: Marceliński Autumn Run 2026 is a cross-country race organized in Poznań by running enthusiasts from the Biegi.Wlkp. group. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the location. Since 2014, the organizers have focused on popularizing cross-country running in Greater Poland, offering participants a unique running experience in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes in Poznań
Routes highlighting the aesthetic qualities of the location
Organized by experienced running enthusiasts from Greater Poland
additional: The race route is available on Garmin Connect. Participants can pick up their race kit with an authorization form. Cross-country event held in Lasek Marceliński, November 8, 2026. Medals in the form of puzzles. Forest routes.

name: Karneval-Marathon
description: The Carnival Marathon in Cologne-Pesch combines a passion for marathon running with enthusiasm for Cologne Carnival. The event takes place on November 11, 2026, and is a unique event marking the start of the fifth season. The course is measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and runs on a flat, paved loop around Pesch Lake, which is repeated multiple times. The number of participants is limited to 50, and costumes are explicitly encouraged to increase the fun factor.
course_highlights: 15 laps of 2.732 km each plus a 1.215 km shuttle stretch at the beginning for the marathon distance
Flat loop around Pesch Lake in a nature reserve
Refreshment station at the start/finish area, passed every 2.7 km
additional: Race bibs are issued from 9:30 to 10:30 a.m. at the playground at Pesch Lake. Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are available at the nearby clubhouse of FC Pesch 1956 e.V. Timing is done manually by clipping the lap numbers on the race bib. After the run, participants receive Kölsch beer and a unique finisher carnival badge. The event is non-commercial, and proceeds are donated to Cologne carnival societies. The course is on a paved 2.7 km loop, with no lighting or medical station, limited to 50 race bibs, and no refunds in case of non-participation or force majeure. Participants must be at least U20.

name: Běh na Dobrošov
location: Náchod-Běloves, Náchod, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Dobrošov Run is a public uphill race with a mass start, held in Náchod-Běloves in the Hradec Králové Region. This race is part of the Běžecké vršky series and offers athletes the opportunity to test their strength on a challenging course leading uphill. The race is organized by the Redpoint Teplice nad Metují club and is popular among runners who enjoy challenges in a natural environment. Traditionally, runners of all ages and performance levels gather here.
course_highlights: Uphill run with a mass start
Challenging course in the natural environment of Náchod-Běloves
Part of the Běžecké vršky series
additional: This is a public mountain run with various categories, including historical information about the race and related events.

name: 36. Bieg Niepodległości w Warszawie
description: The 35th Independence Run in Warsaw is an annual running event organized on the occasion of National Independence Day. The main 10 km race takes place on the streets of the capital city, with start and finish lines located on Aleja Jana Pawła II. The event attracts both experienced runners and amateurs, offering also a Nordic walking category and a commemorative mile race over 1918 meters. The main race starts in waves, ensuring comfort and safety for participants. Organizers provide a rich program and efficient service, including the collection of race numbers at convenient times before the race.
course_highlights: Certified route by PZLA measuring 10 km through Warsaw streets
Start and finish on Aleja Jana Pawła II, at ul. Miła
Wave start of the main race divided into zones based on expected times
additional: The main race starts at 11:11 with a wave division into time zones. The Independence Mile begins at 10:00. Participants in active wheelchair, handbike, and tandem categories start at 11:08. Race numbers can be collected at Westfield Arkadia from November 7 to 10; on race day, the race office is closed (except for packet pickup for participants from outside Warsaw between 8:00 and 10:00). Participants are asked to line up at the start in white or red shirts, forming a white-red flag. The route is well-known and loved, with about 20,000 participants taking part. The event includes various categories such as the main race, Nordic walking, and virtual options available until November 17. In previous years, it was the most numerous running event in Poland.

name: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości – Kocham Polskę!
location: Strzeszyn, Poznań, Greater Poland Voivodeship, Poland
price_range: 20 zł za koszulkę techniczną, wpisowe na stronie nie jest wyraźnie podane
description: Poznański Bieg Niepodległości - Kocham Polskę! is cross-country race organized in picturesque locations in Poznań, especially at Strzeszyn near Malibu Beach. The event is part of activities by a group of running enthusiasts who have been promoting cross-country running in Greater Poland since 2014, emphasizing the aesthetics of the routes and the sporting character of the event. The race has a patriotic dimension, taking place on November 11, combining sport with honoring Poland's independence. We invite runners to participate in various distances in beautiful natural surroundings.
course_highlights: Cross-country route around Strzeszyn and Malibu Beach
Picturesque green areas of Poznań
Patriotic race organized on November 11
additional: The organizer is a group of running enthusiasts from Greater Poland, active since 2014, specializing in cross-country races. The race takes place on green areas of Strzeszyn, near Malibu Beach. The event has a patriotic character and is part of the Poznań Running Trilogy. Participant limit is 750, with scenic routes and cross-country races.

name: 10 Bieg Niepodległości z wąsem
location: Stadion Olimpijski, Wrocław, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Wrocław Independence Run with a mustache is an annual running event organized at the Olympic Stadium in Wrocław, commemorating the 107th anniversary of Poland regaining independence. Participants can choose between a 10 km or 5 km distance, and the main race route is certified by PZLA. The race takes place on closed roads, and at the finish line, runners receive a medal and a recovery meal. Free accompanying runs are organized for children, and participants can purchase a high-quality technical T-shirt with the race logo.
course_highlights: 10 km route certified by PZLA, consisting of two 5 km loops
Start and finish at the Pergola of the Olympic Stadium
Route runs on asphalt and gravel roads at the foot of flood embankments
additional: Race kits are issued at the event office at the Olympic Stadium on November 10 and 11. The kit includes a start number, mustache socks, a stick-on mustache, sponsor products, a calendar, a T-shirt (if ordered), a medal, and a recovery meal. There is a hydration point along the route. The race is held on roads closed to traffic. Free accompanying runs for children are organized. Technical T-shirts can be ordered until October 16, 2025, for 90 PLN. Changing rooms and deposit facilities are available on site. The 5 km race starts at 10:11, and the 10 km race at 11:11. The race takes place on closed roads, with accompanying runs for children, the option to purchase a T-shirt during registration on DataSport, medals for participants, and registration on the day of the event.

name: 9 Olsztyński Bieg Niepodległości
location: Centrum Rekreacyjno-Sportowe Ukiel, Olsztyn, Warmian-Masurian Voivodeship, Poland
description: Olsztyn Independence Run is an annual patriotic sporting event held in Olsztyn, combining the joy of running with the celebration of Independence Day. The event is open to everyone, from experienced runners to families with children. The races take place at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center and include 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and short children's races up to 400 meters. The atmosphere is lively despite the autumn weather, and the number of spots is limited, with online registration open until November 6th.
course_highlights: The 5 km and 10 km race routes run through the Ukiel CRS area and nearby streets: Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska
The event combines athletic competition with patriotic celebration
Nordic walking marches and children's races up to 400 meters are also available
additional: Start and finish are located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center. The event takes place on November 11th, with online registration open until November 6th. Participants can choose from 5 km and 10 km runs, Nordic walking marches, and children's races up to 400 meters. Due to the race, traffic disruptions are expected on the route. Road traffic restrictions will be in place on the course, with the start at 9:00 AM, registration until November 6th, and the event held at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center as well as on Sielska, Schumana, and Kapitańska streets.

name: Gdyński Bieg Niepodległości
description: The Gdynia Independence Run is an annual running event organized in Gdynia, as part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026. The main race on a 10 km distance attracts runners of various ages, and there are also children's and youth races. The event has a sports-recreational character, and participants can expect professional organization and an atmosphere celebrating Polish independence. During the event, photos and video materials are taken for promotional purposes by the organizers.
course_highlights: Main race on a 10 km distance
Children's and youth races
Part of the Gdynia Grand Prix 2026
additional: During the event, photos and video materials will be taken for promotional purposes of events organized by GCS and the Gdynia City Municipality. Registration is open until October 28, 2026. Results, photo galleries, and partner information are available.

name: II Bieg Legionów Polskich
description: The Polish Legion Run II is a race commemorating the anniversary of Poland regaining independence, held on two distances: 5 km and 10 km. Starts take place in scenic seaside locations: Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra. The organizer provides transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations and opens the race office the day before and on the race day. The race route is available online, allowing participants to familiarize themselves with the course before the start.
course_highlights: The race route passes through Władysławowo, Rozewie, and Jastrzębia Góra
10 km start from the Haller monument at Morska Street in Władysławowo
5 km start from the bust of Marshal Piłsudski at Garnizonowa Street in Rozewie
additional: Transportation from Jastrzębia Góra to the start locations is provided. The race office is open on November 10, 2025, from 14:30 to 15:30 at OSiR Władysławowo and on November 11, 2025, from 10:20 to 10:50 in Jastrzębia Góra. The race route is available online at https://www.traseo.pl/trasa/bieg-legionow-polskich. Registration is open from September 22 to November 5, 2025; the event takes place on moderately elevated routes, starting in Władysławowo and Rozewie.

name: XIV Bieg Niepodległości
description: The 14th Independence Run is an annual street race covering a distance of 10 km, organized in Rzeszów to promote an active lifestyle and running in the Podkarpacie region. The start and finish are located at the Rzeszów Market Square, and the race takes place on November 11th, on Poland's Independence Day. Participants compete in various age categories and special classifications, including for doctors and lawyers. Participants receive a race kit with a T-shirt, number, and chip, and a commemorative medal at the finish line. The participant limit is 3000 people, and participation requires confirmation of fitness to run through a medical certificate or declaration.
course_highlights: Street race over 10 km with start and finish at the Market Square in Rzeszów
Separate age and special classifications (e.g., doctors, lawyers)
Commemorative medal for every participant at the finish
additional: The participant limit is 3000 people. Participants must be at least 16 years old on the day of the race. Minors participate with parental or legal guardian consent. The race kit includes a T-shirt, race number, and chip. Custom engraving on the medal is available for an additional fee of 30 PLN. The registration fee is non-refundable. On race day, race kits are available only in cash and in limited quantities. Participants can expect a well-marked route, detailed safety regulations, and information on registration and participant limits. The race takes place in Rytro, and the event is part of the celebrations of National Independence Day.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 1. Event
description: The Alten-Busecker Winter Running Series is a traditional race event held in the Buseck/Alten-Buseck region. It includes multiple races over various distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and half marathon (21.1 km). The races start at 2:00 PM at the Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck and offer a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages and skill levels. The series promotes community spirit with a series ranking for participants who take part in all three races. After crossing the finish line, there are refreshments and an award ceremony for the fastest runners.
course_highlights: Route profiles available on Komoot for 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Hall in Alten-Buseck
Timing with passive transponders from Raceresult
additional: Timing is done via passive transponders from Raceresult. There is a series ranking for participants who take part in all three races of the series. After crossing the finish line, runners receive a free refreshment. Coffee and cake are available for purchase. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available at Harbig Hall. The award ceremony takes place after the competitions, honoring the top three fastest individuals (M/W) per race as well as the age group winners at the end of the series. Winter running series, cross-country character, multiple race distances, community event in November 2026.

name: Alzauenlauf TSV Trostberg

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: 10 km: Männer und Frauen, Senioren und Seniorinnen: 22 €

description: The Alzauenlauf in Trostberg is a traditional race taking place on November 14, 2026. The main course over 10 km runs through the picturesque Trostberger Alzauen, an idyllic forest area along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee. The route combines pleasant natural forest paths with a lap in the stadium, offering a varied running experience. In addition to the main race, there are shorter distances for children and adolescents. All participants receive refreshments at the finish area as well as changing rooms and showers in the nearby Alois-Böck-Turnhalle.
course_highlights: 10 km course through the scenic Trostberger Alzauen with natural ground surface
Start and finish in the stadium with one and a half laps before the forest section
Course runs along the Alz, the outflow of Lake Chiemsee
additional: Number bib collection from 10:30 to 13:00 in the Alois-Böck-Turnhalle. Electronic timing via chip integrated into the bib. Changing rooms and showers are available in the Alois-Böck-Turnhalle. Participants who register at least 14 days before the race for the 10 km distance will receive a functional shirt, while supplies last. Late registrations are possible with an additional fee of €5. The race takes place in any weather. Refreshments are provided at the finish for all participants. Participants must accept the DLV terms and conditions. Event includes refreshments, changing rooms, showers, and chip timing; online registration available; family-friendly and suitable for all age groups.

name: Bezirksmeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The district championships in cross-country running in Velpke are a traditional cross-country competition organized by the NLV District Braunschweig. The event offers runners of various age groups, from children to masters, the opportunity to compete in cross-country. The course runs through varied terrain and presents a challenging experience for all participants. Online registration is possible until February 1, 2026, and the event takes place on February 8, 2026.
course_highlights: Cross-country through varied terrain
Competition for children, youth, active athletes, and masters
Organized by the NLV District Braunschweig in Velpke
additional: Online registrations are possible until 01.02.2026 23:59. The organizer is the NLV District Braunschweig. The event category is 6.4.2 District Championships. Cross-country terrain, registration deadline is February 1, 2026, various course lengths including children and youth categories.

name: Biegerparklauf
location: Biegerpark, Duisburg-Huckingen, Duisburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Biegerparklauf in Duisburg-Huckingen is an officially DLV-measured race on asphalt with distances over 1.2 km for students, 5 km for everyone, and 10 km for youth and adults. The races take place on a loop course through Biegerpark, with the last 300 meters on the stadium's cinder track. All participants receive certificates, students and children receive Weckmänner, and the top runners are awarded medals. The event is organized by the Sportgemeinschaft Duisburg-Süd 98/20 e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Loop course through Biegerpark with asphalt surface
10 km runners complete 3 laps, 5 km runners 2 laps
Last 300 meters on the stadium's cinder track
additional: Late registrations are possible on the day of the event until 30 minutes before the start in limited numbers. Certificates are issued online and on-site with a waiting period. Weckmänner are provided at the finish for students and children. The event offers a sports liability insurance as part of the Sporthilfe insurance contract NRW. The last 300 meters are run on the stadium's cinder track. The course is a loop through Biegerpark with asphalt paths, with the final 300 meters on a cinder track; dates and registration via email; start times for different age groups; medals and Weckmänner for children.

name: Bokeler 6 Stundenlauf
description: The Bokeler 6-Hour Run is an established ultramarathon challenge in northern Germany, taking place in Bokel, Schleswig-Holstein. Participants run on a loop course approximately 3.67 kilometers long, aiming to complete as many laps as possible within six hours. The event attracts endurance athletes looking to test their limits and offers a family-friendly atmosphere in a scenic environment.
course_highlights: Loop course with a length of 3.67 km
Flat terrain in Schleswig-Holstein
Six-hour endurance run with individual distance
additional: The course is a loop course that is run multiple times. The event is traditional and held annually. Results from previous years can be viewed on the website. The race takes place on a 2040 m loop course, with increasing participant numbers and a legendary refreshment buffet. In 2023, a participant record was set, and the event is already fully booked for 2024. The weather in November is usually cool and rainy, which adds to the challenge.

name: Deutsche Polizeimeisterschaften Crosslauf
description: The German Police Championships Cross Country are the official championship of the police in cross country running and focus on competition within the police force. The event takes place in the Ravensberger Forest in Potsdam and includes distances of 3.6 km and 9 km. The races are part of a larger German running series regulated by the German Athletics Association (DLV), with officially measured courses and professional timing. Registration is usually handled through the regional athletics associations. The race offers a challenging cross country experience under typical November weather conditions with cool temperatures and frequent rain.
course_highlights: Cross country running in Ravensberger Forest
Officially measured courses over 3.6 km and 9 km
Part of the DLV-regulated police championships
additional: Typical weather in November: approx. 7 °C, low of 2 °C, with an average of 45 mm of precipitation and rainy days. Registration is usually through the regional athletics associations. The event is not an open street race but exclusively for police runners. No open public participation, organized within the police, with a demanding course featuring uphill and downhill sections, sandy terrain.

name: Graal-Müritzer Schneckenlauf
description: The Graal-Müritz Snail Run is a traditional running event held annually at the Waldstadion Graal-Müritz. Runners and walkers of all ages can choose from various distances, including a toddler course, 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good organization, and the honoring of the strongest classes and best teams. Especially popular are the cinnamon rolls, which are served after crossing the finish line.
course_highlights: Red route: 2 km run
Blue route: 5 km and 10 km (two 5 km laps)
Start and finish at Waldstadion Graal-Müritz
additional: Start times: 10:00 AM for the toddler course, 10:30 AM for the 2 km run, 11:00 AM for the 5 km and 10 km runs. Walkers start 5 minutes after the runners. Training for children takes place on Wednesdays from 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM in the sports hall of the Ostseegrundschule. Traditional honors are awarded for the strongest class and best team. Cinnamon rolls are a popular refreshment after the run. The race takes place at the Waldstadion, registration is possible in advance, and there are categories for children and adults as well as team and class competitions.

name: Gudensberger Crosslauf 2026 Hermann Kilian Gedächtnislauf
description: The Gudensberg Cross Country Hermann Kilian Memorial Run is a traditional cross country race in Gudensberg, offering short distances in the terrain. The start and finish are located on a field path and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool on Schwimmbadweg. The course mainly runs over unpaved paths, which is emphasized by the permission to wear spikes, maintaining the classic cross country character. The event commemorates Hermann Kilian, a dedicated runner and coach of TSV Obervorschütz.
course_highlights: Start and finish on a field path and meadow below the Terrano swimming pool
Course mainly over unpaved paths, spikes allowed
Three distances: 1000m (two small laps), 2000m (two large laps), 4000m (longer lap)
additional: Depending on the announcement, district championships may be integrated. Typical November weather with approximately 7°C and rainy days is expected. Weather in November is mostly rainy, terrain in cross country style, honoring Hermann Kilian, who distinguished himself through his commitment to the sport.

name: Herzowerke-Trail 2026
location: TSH sports grounds, Herzogenaurach, Bavaria, Germany
description: The 3rd Herzowerke Trail will take place on November 14, 2026, in Herzogenaurach. The trail starts and ends at the TSH sports grounds and runs through the Dohnwald around the town. There are several distances from 0.5 km to 16 km, with the longest route can be run as one or two laps. The trail is a true forest trail with the permitted use of poles, with no refreshment stations along the way, only at the start and finish areas. The event is organized by the running department of Turnerschaft Herzogenaurach.
course_highlights: Trail through the Dohnwald around Herzogenaurach
Authentic trail with permitted use of poles
Refreshments only at the start and finish areas, no supply stations along the route
additional: There are multiple distances: 0.5 km Bambini Trail, 2 km Kids Trail, 4 km Youth Trail, 8 km Speed Trail, and 16 km (one or two laps). The route is self-sufficient, with no drink or supply stations in the forest. Times, result lists, and rankings are published online. The top three will be honored. Trail with various distances, self-supply in forest sections, start and finish at the TSH sports grounds, online results and rankings, potentially cool and wet November weather.

name: Int. DEULUX-Lauf
description: The International DEULUX Race takes place annually on the second Saturday in November in Langsur and offers four different races for all age groups. From a 360-meter race for the youngest to the 10-kilometer road race, the most popular race in Rhineland-Palatinate, there is something for everyone. The event is part of the 4-Regio Cup and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and professional organization. Runners can look forward to varied courses and special awards.
course_highlights: Four different races from 360 m to 10 km
Most popular 10 km road race in Rhineland-Palatinate
Family-friendly event with special awards for every participant
additional: Start times: Race for the youngest at 1:30 PM, children's race at 2:00 PM, youth race at 2:30 PM, main race at 3:00 PM. All children's races are free of charge. RFID chip timing for children's and youth races. Late registrations are not possible, not even on the day of the event. Multiple race distances, including children's and youth races, registration will open in a few weeks. The event takes place in Langsur.

name: Kerner Nachtlauf
description: The Kerner Night Run is a atmospheric autumn run taking place on Saturday evening, November 14, 2026, in Kernen. Runners start at dusk on a course approximately 4.5 km long, which runs on illuminated paths through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets around Kernen. An additional 10 km distance is also offered. The event stands for running passion and communal sports experience in a special atmosphere.
course_highlights: A round of about 4.5 km through illuminated paths
Course passes through gardens, vineyards, and residential streets
Start at dusk on Saturday evening
additional: Run through illuminated paths, options of 4.5 km and 10 km, atmosphere with lights and torches, finish at the stadium with snacks and drinks

name: Landesoffener Crosslauf des KLV Segeberg
description: The State Open Cross Country Race of the KLV Segeberg takes place annually in November at the Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park. It offers races for children, youth, adults, and masters with distances ranging from approximately 625 meters to 7.9 km. The event is open to participants from all over Schleswig-Holstein. The course runs through meadows, parks, and wooded areas, providing a varied alternative to traditional road or track races. The event is organized by KLV Segeberg and Kaltenkirchener TS, who also host on-site.
course_highlights: Course lengths from approx. 625 m to 7.9 km
Run in Kaltenkirchen Leisure Park over meadows, parks, and wooded areas
Open to all of Schleswig-Holstein with categories for children, youth, adults, and masters
additional: Typical November weather with around 7°C and rainy days. The event is part of the KLV Segeberg Cross Country Championship series, which also includes other local club locations in the Segeberg district. Cross country in November with typical weather featuring rain and temperatures around 2-7°C, outdoor terrain, suitable for trail running and cross-country enthusiasts.

name: Neusser Erftlauf
description: The Neuss Erftlauf is a traditional running event organized annually by DJK Novesia 1919 Neuss e.V. The 53rd edition will take place on November 14, 2026, and offers runners of various performance levels an attractive course along the Erft. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere, good organization, and support from numerous sponsors. The 15 km main race is particularly popular and has gained many participants in recent years.
course_highlights: 15 km main race with construction site detour, 5 km loop capable of ranking lists
Course along the Erft with varied terrain
Refreshment stations and cool drinking water at the thirst quencher
additional: The Erftlauf is supported by numerous volunteers who ensure smooth operations at the course, start and finish areas, and refreshment stations. The event is sponsored by organizations such as RheinLand Versicherungsgruppe, Stadtwerke Neuss, and other partners. There is a construction site detour on the 15 km route, but the 5 km loop remains capable of ranking lists. An extensive photo album is available online. The course runs on paved paths and roads; spikes are not allowed. Registration opens online from September 1, 2025. Start times begin at 11:30 AM. Medals are awarded to children, and material prizes to winners. Limited parking is available. Showers are provided.

name: Potsdamer Cross im Rahmen der 22. DPM
description: The 2nd Potsdam Cross, part of the 22nd German Police Championships (DPM), will take place on November 14, 2026, in Potsdam. The event is organized and hosted by OSC Potsdam Luftschiffhafen e.V., Athletics Department. The event offers runners the opportunity to compete in a challenging cross-country race and to be part of a long-standing competition series. Registration is open until November 9, 2026.
course_highlights: Participation in the German Cross Championships (DPM)
Terrain outside the stadium in Potsdam
Event as part of a national championship
additional: Registration deadline is November 9, 2026; the terrain is scenic and offers a varied cross-country course

name: Potzberg-Berglauf
description: The Potzberg Mountain Run is a traditional mountain race organized by TuS Glan-Münchweiler. The course covers 8.2 kilometers with 350 meters of elevation gain and offers runners a challenging experience in the beautiful landscape around Potzberg. The race takes place annually and attracts both ambitious runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The organizer thanks the sponsors and is happy to answer any further questions.
course_highlights: Course length: 8.2 kilometers
Elevation gain: 350 meters
Landscape around Potzberg
additional: The Potzberg Mountain Run is the 4th race in the year 2026. Results from previous races are available on the website. There are no listed events or registration dates on the website. For more information, TuS Glan-Münchweiler can be reached by phone. The race is part of the Palatinate Mountain Running Cup, with categories for adults and youth, as well as convenient luggage and clothing transport to the finish line. The event takes place in November.

name: Steverlauf
location: Sportpark Senden, Senden, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The Steverlauf is an established running event at Sportpark Senden, taking place annually and welcoming runners of all ages. The officially measured courses by the DLV over 5 km and 10 km lead along park and canal side paths and offer an attractive running environment. There is a separate participation option for children and adolescents at a reduced entry fee. The event takes place in all weather conditions and provides changing and shower facilities as well as catering with coffee, cake, soup, and sausages. The organizing team looks forward to numerous participants and a successful event.
course_highlights: Officially measured courses by the DLV over 5 km and 10 km
Running routes lead along park and canal side paths
Changing and shower facilities at Sportpark Senden
additional: Catering with coffee, tea, cake, cookies, as well as soup and sausages by roterkeil Senden e.V. The event takes place in all weather conditions. No liability for damages. Changing and shower facilities are available. Routes pass through Senden Castle, the canal, and Königspark; good supply of cake, drinks, and warm food; possible in any weather.

name: Waldlauf
location: Remsecker Waldlauf, Hochdorfer Wald, Büchenbach, Bayern, Germany
description: The Remsecker Waldlauf is a family-friendly run through the picturesque Hochdorfer Forest, appealing to runners of all ages and skill levels. The event offers various distances, from a toddler run to school and youth races, as well as short, medium, and long-distance runs. The diverse forest trails with muddy, uneven surfaces and small obstacles make the run an impressive and adventurous experience. The race is organized by the Sport- und Gesangverein Hochdorf e.V. and emphasizes community and nature experience.
course_highlights: All courses lead through the beautiful Hochdorfer Forest
Muddy, uneven surfaces and narrow paths with small obstacles
Various distances for children, youth, and adults
additional: Number bib distribution on Friday from 16:30 to 18:00 and Saturday from 9:30 onwards. Each participant receives a number bib with an integrated chip. Optional recycled functional shirts can be ordered online until 05.09.2026 (Children 15 €, Adults 20 €). Late registration on the event day is possible up to 60 minutes before the start, with a late registration fee of 3 €.

name: Zeiler Waldmarathon
location: Zeil am Main, Haßberge, Bavaria, Germany
description: The Zeiler Waldmarathon takes place on November 14, 2026, in Zeil am Main and offers challenging running routes through the Haßberge Nature Park. The course mainly runs on paved forest paths with a varied route over the Schlossberg, Bischofsheimer Höhe, and past several lakes. There are competitions for marathon, half marathon, as well as walking/nordic walking over 21.1 km and 7.5 km. The event is organized by TV 1884 Zeil and features professional timing with an integrated chip.
course_highlights: Challenging course through the Haßberge Nature Park on almost continuously paved forest paths
Route over Schlossberg, Bischofsheimer Höhe, and past the Seven Lakes
Refreshment stations every 5 km with mineral water, tea, isotonic drinks, and snacks
additional: Start and finish at the Setzbachbrunnen in the Zeil am Main running park. Timing with integrated chip. Marathon runners can switch to the half marathon after one lap. Parking is available at the indoor pool and school parking lot as well as Tuchanger parking lot with city bus transfer. Bib number pickup at the school on Friday evening and Saturday morning. Showers and changing rooms are available in the school gymnasium. No clothing storage at the start/finish area. Free bus transfer every 5 minutes from the school building to the start line. The course runs almost exclusively on paved forest paths in the Haßberge Nature Park. There are refreshment stations every 5 km, bib numbers with chips, parking at the indoor pool and school parking lot, as well as showers and changing rooms in the school gymnasium. Medals are awarded to all participants after the race, and there is an option for a free bus transfer.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race around Pilsen, offering scenic routes in nature with minimal asphalt. The race is suitable for both enthusiasts of healthy outdoor activity and competitive athletes and top trail runners. Participants can choose from routes of 42 km with an elevation gain of 700 m, 22.5 km, 7 km, and shorter children's and pupils' courses including a multigenerational relay. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora, where the start and finish are also held. Organizers adhere to the motto "I don't run on asphalt" and prepare the race with an emphasis on running in nature and beautiful views.
course_highlights: Scenic trails along footpaths on both banks of the Berounka River valley
Forests around Bolevecké ponds
Climb to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 m on the marathon route
additional: There are three main routes (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km) and shorter children's and pupils' courses including a multigenerational relay. The race is part of the Pilsen Running Cup. The race center is in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora. Terrain: trail, cross-country; the race takes place in November 2026, specific registration details are not provided.

name: BoBoBěh
description: BoBoběh is the final mountain run of the BoBoloppet trilogy, taking place through the beautiful Jizera Mountains. The race offers a challenging route of 30 km with ascents to Olivetská Mountain, passing over the Černá Nisa dam, and a steep climb through Bílý Štolpich. For less experienced runners, there is a shorter 10 km route and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The race is open to all running and nature enthusiasts, whether registered for the entire trilogy or just participating in this race.
course_highlights: 30 km mountain run across the Vysoký Hřeben and Kanál
Twice ascending Olivetská Mountain and passing over the Černá Nisa dam
The toughest climb in the Jizerské Mountains - Bílý Štolpich
additional: The race does not have a mass start; the start corridor is open for two hours, allowing runners to choose their start time. The route is not marked; the race is partially orienteering. There are three variants available: 30 km, 10 km (fit), and a children's MINI run of 1 km. The event is open to all interested participants, offering registration options for different routes, and emphasizing the natural beauty and sporting experience in the mountain environment.

name: Běh přes Černovírský les
description: The run across Černovírský Forest is a flat 10 km race held in Hlušovice near Olomouc. The race is part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region and attracts regional runners who enjoy a course that runs along cycle paths and asphalt. The event is suitable for runners of all ages and offers not only a sporting experience but also an opportunity to meet the local running community. The race is a welcome opportunity to enjoy the autumn atmosphere and actively spend time in nature.
course_highlights: Flat course running along cycle paths and asphalt
Part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
Opportunity to participate in various age categories
additional: race over 10 km, part of the Great Prize of Long-Distance Runners of the Olomouc Region, flat terrain, participation of regional long-distance runners

name: Běh Dlouhými záhony
description: The Long Flowerbeds Run is a challenging cross-country race 6.8 km long with significant elevation changes, held in Úpice. The race is part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League of the Jestřebí Mountains. The course offers runners a challenge with hilly terrain and beautiful natural scenery of the Jestřebí Mountains. This race is suitable for experienced runners seeking a technically demanding mountain run.
course_highlights: Challenging cross-country with large elevation differences
Course length of 6.8 km
Part of the Czech Mountain Running Cup and the Winter Running League
additional: The race is part of the Winter Running League and the Czech Mountain Running Cup, with an evaluation of the best mountain runners in the Czech Republic after the race.

name: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec
description: Hannah Pilsen Trail Krkavec is a traditional autumn trail race in Pilsen, held in the picturesque nature of Bílá Hora. The race offers three main routes of 42 km, 22.5 km, and 7 km, including shorter categories for pupils and children. The course runs along paths around the Berounka River, through forests near Bolevecké rybníky, and includes a challenging ascent to Krkavec with an elevation gain of 700 meters. Organizers emphasize running in nature without asphalt, which is appreciated by both recreational runners and top trail runners. The race center is located in the suburban part of Pilsen - Bílá Hora.
course_highlights: Picturesque trails along paths around the Berounka River
Forests around Bolevecké rybníky
Challenging ascent to Krkavec with 700 m elevation gain
additional: There are three main routes (42 km, 22.5 km, 7 km) and shorter pupil and children’s routes, including a multi-generational relay for children with parents or grandparents. Organizers emphasize the motto "I don't run on asphalt." The race is part of the Pilsen Running Cup. The race center is located at the restaurant area in Háj na Bílá Hora. The course is recommended to be uploaded to smartwatches, registration includes refreshments and a medal, registration is available online or on-site, with a time limit of 6.5 hours for the marathon. The event is part of a series of races in 2026.

name: Svatomartinský běh
location: Petřkovice u Starého Jičína, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: St. Martin's Run is a traditional running race held in the picturesque environment of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín in the Moravian-Silesian Region. The race offers a sporting experience in beautiful nature with a route approximately 5.5 km long, suitable for the general public. The event is organized in the grounds of the Berchtold Castle Hotel, which provides facilities and comfort for participants and spectators. The race is ideal for all runners who want to combine sport with a pleasant atmosphere and beautiful views in the surroundings.
course_highlights: Route approximately 5.5 km long in natural environment
Picturesque surroundings of Petřkovice near Starý Jičín
Start and finish at the grounds of Berchtold Castle Hotel
additional: Results from previous editions are available online. The route is set in a natural environment with predominantly forest and field surfaces. The Berchtold Castle grounds offer facilities for participants including parking and refreshments. The race takes place in November 2026, specific details regarding registration and routes are not provided, and the event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle.

name: Ludgeřovický kros

price_tiers.distance: běh 10 km, 4 km, Nordic walking 9 km, děti

description: Ludgeřovický cross-country is a traditional running race in the natural environment of the village of Ludgeřovice, attracting both young and old runners every year. The main course measures 10 km and passes through varied terrain - forest paths, field trails, and around local landmarks. In addition to the main race, shorter runs of 4 km, Nordic walking of 9 km, and children's courses by age categories are available. The race is part of the Prajzsko-opavská running league and bears the subtitle Veterans' Run, paying tribute to heroes not only from the past.
course_highlights: Main course 10 km with 140 m elevation gain
Terrain includes forest roads, field trails, and surroundings of local landmarks
Additional races: 4 km run, 9 km Nordic walking, children's courses 100 and 500 m
additional: Metal finisher medal of own design, commemorative magnet for the first 200 participants at the presentation, book "Ještě jeden maraton" for the first 300 registered, monetary prizes for the winners of the main race, chip timing for children as well, awards including 4th place in all races, accompanying program Veterans' Day Ludgeřovice, personal videos and photos from the race, changing rooms, showers, and convenient parking, children's races with awards and raffle. The course includes 10 km, 9 km, 4 km, children's runs, uncertain weather, connection with Veterans' Day.

name: Půlmaraton pátera Václava Kosmáka
description: The Pater Václav Kosmák Half Marathon is a road loop race running from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back. This race offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a half marathon course in the picturesque environment of the Vysočina region. The race is suitable for all runners seeking a quality road race with a traditional atmosphere. Organizers welcome both experienced and beginner runners and look forward to your participation.
course_highlights: Road loop race from Moravské Budějovice to Lukov and back
Picturesque environment of Vysočina
Traditional half marathon course
additional: The race is open to all age groups and is part of a running league, offering a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to participate as a recreational runner.

name: Hrouzovka 2026
description: Hrouzovka 2026 is a running race taking place on November 14, 2026, in Krnov. This race offers a course approximately 15 km long, passing through hilly terrain with a variety of surfaces, including asphalt, grass, and rocky paths. The event is intended for runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment and wishing to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful setting. Details about the organizer and registration have not yet been published, but the race is part of the local running calendar.
course_highlights: 15 km course through hilly terrain with diverse surfaces
Running in the natural environment of Krnov
Part of the local running calendar
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, offering an opportunity to enjoy a sporting atmosphere in a beautiful natural environment.

name: 1. Volkslauf Seelze
description: The ADAC Marathon Hannover offers a diverse running experience with distances ranging from 4 to 42 km, including the marathon, half marathon, relay marathon, 10 km run, and handbike marathon. The course is one of the flattest in Germany with only 19 meters of elevation change, which favors personal best times. The event is characterized by urban flair, modern music, and green sections of the course that pass through the city center and notable hotspots of Hannover. In addition to the athletic competition, participants can enjoy a comprehensive supporting program with an expo, power party, and finisher celebration.
course_highlights: Flat course with only 19 m elevation change
Course passes through the city center and notable hotspots of Hannover
Various distances from 4 to 42 km including relay and handbike
additional: Race bibs are issued at the marathon expo during the marathon weekend. The course is very flat and thus ideal for personal best times. Live tracking is available via the ADAC Marathon app. There is a massage area and showers. The supporting program includes the ROSSMANN Power Party, expo, and finisher party at the brewery. Free public transportation on the event day is included. Information about the course, registration, results, and photos can be found on the event website. The race is part of a broad running pass program with various events in the Hannover region.

name: Bremer Kuhcross QX
description: The Kuhcross is a challenging and varied cross-country race organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen. It offers runners the opportunity to compete on a demanding course and experience ultimate cross-country fun. The event traditionally takes place in November in Bremen and attracts cross-country enthusiasts from the region.
course_highlights: Challenging and varied cross-country terrain
Event in Bremen with a traditional character
Organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen
additional: The race is open to children, teenagers, and active runners, with various categories and a family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Geislinger Volkslauf
description: The Geislingen Volkslauf is a traditional running event held annually in Geislingen. The race offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all ages, including school runs and an inclusion run. The course starts at the Schlossparkhalle and is known for its varied and well-organized route. The event is a popular sports occasion in the region and is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V.
course_highlights: Start at Schlossparkhalle Geislingen
School run for all school classes
Inclusion run for inclusive participation
additional: The Volkslauf takes place on Sunday, November 15, 2026. There are school runs and an inclusion run. The event is organized by TSV Geislingen 1895 e.V. The start is at 10:30 AM at the Schlossparkhalle. Runners can register online until November 12, 2025; the event includes children, youth, active, and masters competitions.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Probelauf
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf in Tübingen is a traditional half marathon that has been organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for best lists. The running route leads over finely gravelled forest paths and paved sections with moderate inclines, and several refreshment stations offer water, tea, and special sports drinks. All participants receive a high-quality functional shirt included in the entry fee, which can be picked up at the runner's expo.
