description: Stupenská sedmička is the sixth edition of a trail running race held on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at the TJ Sokol Stupno grounds. The race offers a 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt, suitable for both experienced runners and beginners of all ages. The race atmosphere is friendly and relaxed, with ample facilities and refreshments after the run. The registration fee includes a participant medal, timing, race photos, material prizes, and a raffle. The race is open to all athletes considering their health and abilities.
course_highlights: 7.2 km loop mainly on forest paths with minimal asphalt
Forest trail with tree roots and several forest hills
Crossing a road under volunteer supervision and running along an MTB trail
additional: The registration fee includes refreshments after the race such as tea, water, mulled wine, beer, soda, homemade buns, salty snacks, Christmas rolls, bananas, and energy bars. After the race, winners will be announced and a raffle will be drawn. The start number is equipped with a chip for timing, which must be returned after the race (500 CZK fee for loss). Race facilities include toilets, changing rooms, and parking at TJ Sokol Stupno. Participants are advised to write any allergies and emergency contact on the back of their start number. A medical professional will be present at the start and finish area. Registration includes gift vouchers, with proceeds supporting charity. A detailed route description is available.

name: Gliwicka Prowokacja biegowa
organizer: Miejski Zarząd Usług Komunalnych w Gliwicach
description: 146th Gliwice Park Run Provocation is an annual running event held in Gliwice that combines sport, a good atmosphere, and contact with urban greenery. The run is open to both experienced runners and those looking to spend active time without the pressure of competition. The race traditionally starts on the clearing behind the Piast stadium, and participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and an active way to end February. The event is an excellent opportunity to start the new month with energy and good spirits.
course_highlights: Start on the clearing behind Piast stadium (access from Leśna Street)
The route runs through urban greenery
The event combines sport with a good atmosphere and recreation
additional: Race office open from 9:00 AM. To be classified, prior registration and an entry fee are required. The event takes place on the last day of February, encouraging an active end to the month. trail run, online registration, start and finish on the clearing behind Piast stadium

name: Jesienny Ultra Świr
description: Autumn Ultra Świr is a mountain ultra race held in Grybów, challenging long-distance running enthusiasts in natural terrain. The course mainly runs through forest and gravel paths, with minimal asphalt sections, providing an authentic trail experience. The event offers various competition formats, including timed runs and Nordic Walking marches, tailored to different skill levels. Organized by experienced enthusiasts who ensure a good atmosphere and participant safety.
course_highlights: 98% of the course runs through forest and gravel paths
Minimal asphalt participation - only 2%
Start and finish at the Winter Sports Center in Ptaszkowa
additional: Start and finish as well as the race office are located at the Winter Sports Center in Ptaszkowa. The race office is open on race day from 06:45 to 07:30 for the 6/12/24-hour distances and until 9:30 for Nordic Walking and single lap runs. In the 6h and 12h races, the winner is the participant who completes the greatest number of full 17 km laps. Running during the Nordic Walking march is prohibited, and judges are present on the course to monitor proper technique. Participants must verify their identity at the race office with an ID and have the mandatory equipment. The event is part of the Autumn Ultra Świr series, which includes various distances and activity formats, with online registration. The course may change due to weather conditions.

name: XXIII Maraton Komandosa
description: The 23rd Commandos Marathon is a demanding marathon race covering a distance of 42.195 km, organized in Lubliniec. The event will take place on November 28, 2026, and is organized by the Military Running Club "Meta" Lubliniec. The race route has recently been changed and is available online. Participants can expect professional timing measurement and full technical support for the event.
course_highlights: New race route available online
Marathon distance 42.195 km
Organizer: Military Running Club "Meta" Lubliniec
additional: Race office open on 28.11 from 15:00 to 20:30 and on 29.11 from 07:00 to 08:40. The start fee is payable only via an individual link to quick online payments at tpay.com sent by email. After 31.10.2026, the fee is only available with the organizer's approval and without a full start package. The participant limit has been reached, registrations are suspended. New race route; participant limit reached; urban and forest terrain; electronic timing measurement.

name: Christmas Run To Tree
description: The Christmas Run To Tree is a festive forest run in the Klövensteen Forest near Hamburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. Participants can choose between two distances: 6 km or 12 km. The run combines athletic activity with the special experience of buying a Christmas tree. The event offers a family-friendly atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Forest run through the picturesque Klövensteen Forest
Choice between 6 km and 12 km distances
Start number in the shape of a Christmas tree
additional: Race bib distribution on the event day from 09:00 to 11:15. Start numbers in the shape of a Christmas tree, to be worn visibly on the chest. Clothing bag drop-off with coupon available at the start. No late registrations are possible. Participant transfers are possible for a fee until November 25. Award ceremony for 6 km at 11:15, for 12 km at 13:00. The event includes bib number distribution, certificates, Christmas activities, and a festive atmosphere.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Schiffenberger Wald, Gießen, is a flat race held annually in November. It offers courses over 5 km and 10 km for adults as well as competitions for children and teenagers. The event is ideal for runners seeking a fast, flat course in a natural setting. Start and finish are at the same location, with exact details available via RUNME Premium. The race takes place on Sunday, November 29, 2026, starting at 10:15 AM.
course_highlights: Flat course in Schiffenberger Wald
5 km and 10 km distances for adults
Competitions for children and teenagers
additional: Start and finish are the same for all competitions. Exact start and finish locations are only visible with RUNME Premium. There are also walking and Nordic walking competitions over 5 km. Results are usually published shortly after the finish on the RUNME results page. The race is open to adults, children, and teenagers, with start times in the morning. Exact start and finish locations are only visible with RUNME Premium.

name: Adventslauf SV Weiden e.V.
description: The Advent Run of SV Weiden e.V. is a traditional community race that has been held for over three decades on the first Sunday of Advent in the Rottweil region, near Fuchswald on the sports grounds. The varied course mostly runs on forest and farm roads and offers a beautiful running experience for participants of all performance levels. In addition to the main race and the middle-distance race, there are also children's races and a toddler's race, making the event suitable for the whole family.
course_highlights: Course mostly on forest and farm roads
Main race 10.7 km and middle-distance race 5.9 km
Children's races and toddler's race on sports field and field paths
additional: The Advent Run is aimed at Nordic walkers, hobby, and ambitious runners. There are numerous training plans for preparation. Participant numbers exceed 200 runners, with 28 children and adolescents in the children's races. The toddler's race (350 m) takes place on the sports field. The routes are natural and family-friendly, including Nordic walking options.

name: FORD Advent-Lauf
location: Leinpfad, Daarler Brücke, Saarbrücken, Saarland, Germany
description: The FORD Advent Run is a traditional road race held at the end of November in Saarbrücken at the Daarler Bridge on the Leinpfad. It is part of the Sparkassen City Run series and offers a variety of distances including 10 km, 5 km, and 2 km for experienced runners, beginners, and children. The event is organized by SV GO! Saar 05 Leichtathletik e.V. with support from SparkasseSB, Ford, and LottoSaartoto. Registration is available via meisterchip.de, and the courses are officially measured, allowing participation in record lists.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Leinpfad Daarler Bridge in Saarbrücken
Part of the Sparkassen City Run series
Offers 2 km, 5 km, and 10 km distances for different runner groups
additional: Typical November weather with an average of 7 °C, lows around 2 °C, and rainy days. The race is listed in the German race calendar system, and the courses are officially measured. The event takes place in Saarbrücken, with start and finish at the Leinpfad Daarler Bridge. It is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and is a great opportunity to start the Advent season with a sporting event.

name: Friedeholz Cross
description: The Friedeholz Cross is a traditional forest cross-country race in Syke, Lower Saxony, which is part of the Syke-Weyher Cross-Series. On November 29, 2026, races will be held over various distances, from a 1.3 km school run to the 10.3 km main race, suitable for children, teenagers, and adults. The course mostly runs on forest paths with a short asphalt section before the finish line in the Syke Forest Stadium. The event offers a varied cross-country experience in an autumnal atmosphere and is ideal for runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Mostly forest paths with only about 100 m asphalt
Start and finish in the Syke Forest Stadium
Part of the Syke-Weyher Cross-Series with multiple distances
additional: Four distances on race day: 1.3 km school run, 3.6 km middle distance from U16, 10.3 km main race from U20. The event is part of a series of three races with series scoring when registering before the first race. Switching between middle and long distance is possible but does not count as a series switch. Forest paths, cross-country, series scoring, registration required for series scoring, limited shower and changing facilities in the Syke Forest Stadium.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbacher Winter Running and Walking Series is a traditional race series in the Langenhainer Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, taking place on five Sundays during the winter half-year. Participants can choose between 10 km and 20 km routes, which are permanently signposted and can also be used as walking or hiking routes. The start is free, there is no timing, and the event is based on communal running without competitive character. On race Sundays, runners are supplied with tea at a refreshment station, and after the run, there is coffee and cookies in the sports hall. On the last date, soup, wheat beer, coffee, and cake are also served.
course_highlights: Permanently signposted 10 km route in the Langenhainer Forest
Additional loop for the 20 km round, signposted from late November to mid-February
Provision of warm tea at the refreshment station near the Waldparkplatz Bahai’i (approx. km 6.4)
additional: Start is individual without timing, no registration required, participation is free with voluntary donations. Changing rooms are available in the sports hall at Schinderwald on Sundays from 8:00 to 13:00. After the run, coffee and cookies; on the last date, soup and wheat beer. Bring your own foldable cup for tea. Route profiles are available on Komoot. Routes: 10 km and 20 km, challenging and varied routes, no timing, individual starts, GPS track via Komoot, refreshment station with tea, coffee, cookies, soup, wheat beer, coffee and cake, changing rooms in the sports hall, parking at the sports field and Park&Ride, no registration required.

name: Pfungstädter Advents-Crosslauf
description: The Pfungstädter Advent Cross Run is a traditional cross-country event that will celebrate its 57th edition in 2026. The races take place on a proven course with cross-country conditions and offer attractive competitions for all age groups from children to seniors. The event is integrated into the long-distance cup and the district cross ranking of the HLV Darmstadt-Dieburg district. Start times are staggered, allowing exciting races over various distances and age groups.
course_highlights: Cross course approximately 3700 m for middle distance
Long distance approximately 7300 m over 6 cross rounds
Sprint course approximately 850 m for children and youth
additional: Race documents for schools will be issued on the hard court, all other participants will receive their documents in the youth room. No late registrations or changes on site are possible. The start times are approximate and may be slightly changed. Registration only online until 28.11.2025; no late registrations on site; catering available; toilets at Ludwig-Crössmann-Heim; no changing or shower facilities.

name: Ratzeburger Adventslauf
description: The Ratzeburg Advent Run is a traditional race around Lake Ratzeburg, taking place on November 29, 2026. The main course covers 26 kilometers, mostly on hiking trails with scenic sections and historical references. Additionally, there is a 7.5 km run around Küchensee and a 1.5 km children's race, making it accessible for beginners. The event combines athletic challenge with nature experience and a family-friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: 26 km around Lake Ratzeburg with approximately 80% hiking trails and 20% asphalt
Five refreshment points along the course at km 5, 10, 15, 20, and 22.5
7.5 km scenic course around Küchensee, as well as a 1.5 km children's race with audience support
additional: New since 2022 is the intermediate timing at the 26 km course, allowing spectators and athletes to track split times. The races start simultaneously, with a sorting at the start on the right side at Königsdamm. The children's race is supported by Dein-Holzpferd.de. Courses around Lake Ratzeburg and Küchensee, online registration from September 1, 2026, maximum participant numbers for each distance, timing with Race Result.

name: Schlößlelauf - 4. Lauf der Jedermannlaufserie
description: The Schlößlelauf in Donauwörth is the 4th race in the amateur running series and offers an attractive competition opportunity for runners of all ages and performance levels. The event is organized by LG Donau-Ries and traditionally takes place in late autumn. The course runs through the scenic surroundings of Donauwörth and is part of a popular running series in the region. The event promotes recreational sports and is aimed at children, teenagers, and active runners.
course_highlights: Part of the amateur running series
Various categories for all age groups
Run in the historic city of Donauwörth
additional: Registration is via email, the event includes running and cycling activities as well as terrain and sport type filters.

name: Schmachtendorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Schmachtendorf Nikolaus Run is a traditional running event held at the end of November in Oberhausen-Schmachtendorf, organized by Spvgg. Sterkrade-Nord 1920/25 e.V. The event offers races for all age groups, from a 300-meter children's run to a 10 km race for adults. The course mainly runs on forest paths in Dunkelschlag and around the Buchenweg sports field. Each participant receives a Stutenkerl, and the award ceremony takes place promptly after each race with prizes for the best runners in each category.
course_highlights: 300-meter loop around the artificial turf field at Buchenweg (children's run)
10 km race mostly on forest paths in Dunkelschlag
Start and finish at Buchenweg sports field, no traditional city center course
additional: Electronic timing with chip in the start number by TAF-TIMING. Certificates are issued on the day of the event or later online. Parking is available at Heinrich-Böll-Gesamtschule and the Schmachtendorf marketplace, indicated by signs. Distances: 300 m for children, 10 km for adults; course on forest paths and sports field; categories for children and adults; weather conditions may be rainy in November.

name: Uplengener Adventslauf
description: The Uplengen Advent Run is a traditional cross-country race that takes place for the 54th time. The races lead through the Hollsand Nature Reserve and offer challenging courses depending on the weather conditions. The event is one of the oldest running events in the region and is often used as preparation for cross-country championships. Various course lengths allow youths and adults to achieve personal bests or improve endurance. The Förderverein of the Remels Elementary School provides food and drinks, including coffee and cake.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Hollsand Nature Reserve
Challenging courses depending on weather conditions
Various course lengths for different age groups
additional: Youth U14 can choose between 1450 m and 3100 m, U16 can start on the 4450 m middle distance. The red loop is approximately 3000 m plus a 100 m starting zone. The race uses a junction system for route guidance. Cross-country race in the Hollsand Nature Reserve, course lengths vary, registration and results online, coffee and cake from the Förderverein of the Remels Elementary School.

name: Volksbank WeinstadtCross mit DM Cross und Deutschem Cross Cup
description: The Volksbank WeinstadtCross is a traditional cross-country race taking place on November 29, 2026, in Weinstadt. The event includes school championships, children’s and youth races, and the open cross on Saturday, while the German Cross Championships are held on Sunday. The challenging course runs cross-country over uneven terrain, through mud and steep inclines, offering runners of all ages and performance levels a true running experience. The WeinstadtCross is part of the German Cross Cup and attracts participants from all over Germany.
course_highlights: Cross-country over uneven terrain
Course with mud and steep inclines
Race on a course worthy of a German Championship
additional: On Saturday (28.11.26), school championships, children’s and youth races, as well as the open cross, will take place. On Sunday (29.11.26), the German Cross Championships will be held. The event is open to all age and performance groups. It includes school, youth, and open races, takes place in typical November weather with rain and temperatures around 2-7°C, and features a challenging cross-country course with national significance.

name: Weihnachtsmarktlauf
description: The Christmas Market Run in Landstuhl is a traditional race held annually on November 30th. It offers a sporting challenge for various age groups with a main race over 7.6 km and a student race over 1.3 km. The event is organized by LLG Landstuhl e.V. and is characterized by a friendly atmosphere and a ranking for clubs and groups. Registration is open from October 15th to November 28th, with late registrations allowed on-site.
course_highlights: Main race over 7.6 km
Student race over 1.3 km
Ranking by age groups and group classification
additional: Registration is open from October 15th to November 28th. Late registrations are possible on-site. There is a performance and group ranking with prize money for the best participants and groups. The race takes place on November 30th, with online registration available, prizes for individual and group rankings, and the course runs through the festively decorated city.

name: Überruhrer Adventscrosslauf
description: The Überruhrer Advent Cross Run takes place on November 29, 2026, in Essen-Überruhr and offers a cross-country course that, fittingly for Advent, guides runners through the wintery nature. The event is open to all age groups from children to seniors and is conducted according to the German Athletics Association (DLO) regulations. The award ceremony and certificate presentation are held directly next to the race course, creating a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere. A catering stand at the finish area provides warm and cold drinks as well as snacks.
course_highlights: Cross-country course in the nature of Essen-Überruhr
Classification for all age groups from U8 to seniors M/W 80
Award ceremony and certificate presentation directly next to the race course
additional: Parking is available in the adjacent residential area, with a recommended parking spot at Marktplatz Überruhr (about 500m walk). Public transport connections include bus lines SB15, 144, 166, 177. At the finish area, there is catering with cold and hot drinks, cake, and sausages. The race office is located in the park. Certificates can be printed via Race Result. The run takes place on the first Sunday of Advent, typically with November weather, temperatures around 2-7°C, often rainy. The event is open to everyone who enjoys cross-country running and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with onsite award ceremonies.

name: 45 Strzeliński Rogaining
location: Kamiennik, Strzelin County, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
organizer: Polskie Towarzystwo Turystyczno-Krajoznawcze Oddział Ziemi Strzelińskiej
description: Strzeliński Rogaining is a pedestrian orienteering rally where teams of 2-5 people plan their own route to visit as many control points as possible within a designated time. The points are located in the terrain and marked on the map. The event is open to participants of all ages and skill levels, including enthusiasts and recreational participants, such as families. Rogaining has a tourist-sport character and allows for flexible route modifications during the competition, making it an attractive outdoor activity. The event is organized by the Polish Tourist and Sightseeing Society, Strzelin Branch, which has been hosting orienteering competitions in the region for years.
course_highlights: Teams move exclusively on foot, using a map and compass for navigation
Control points have different point values depending on the difficulty of finding them
Participants can choose and change their route freely, from 5 to 70 km in length
additional: The competition is open to all age groups and genders. Teams consist of 2-5 people. Rogaining is a tourist-sport activity suitable for both advanced competitors and families. Routes can be modified during the event. In 2026, four editions of rogaining are planned around Strzelin, including the 45th edition in November. The events cover various distances from 5 km to 70 km, with maps and compasses, catering to different skill levels, with options for recreational and competitive participation.

name: Wiedenbrücker Christkindllauf
description: The Wiedenbrück Christkindllauf is a popular race around the Christkindlmarkt in the festively illuminated old town of Wiedenbrück. The course is a loop over five laps with a length of approximately 10.2 km and is not officially measured. The race traditionally takes place in December and offers a festive atmosphere in the city center. The event is organized by LG Burg Wiedenbrück and attracts numerous runners from the region.
course_highlights: Loop course over five laps around the Christkindlmarkt
Festively illuminated old town of Wiedenbrück
Course length approx. 10.2 km, running direction clockwise
additional: Start and finish on Lange Straße in Wiedenbrück. Distribution of race bibs on December 5, 2025 from 15:00 at the Luise-Hensel-Saal in the Stadthaus. Registration only online from October 8, 2025, 21:00. No late registrations on the event day. Time limit 75 minutes. Wearing headphones or earphones is prohibited and will lead to disqualification. Participants are asked to run as far to the right as possible and not form groups due to overtaking. Participant limit 1100, registration only online, medals can be reordered, race starts on December 4, 2026.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Gdansk
description: Garmin Ultra Race Gdańsk is a unique trail running event taking place on December 5, 2026, in the picturesque Trójmiejski Landscape Park. The route combines a seaside climate with varied mountainous terrain, offering runners challenging ascents, valleys, gorges, and ravines. It is an excellent opportunity to end the season in an atmosphere of sporting competition and contact with nature. The event is part of a nationwide mountain running series that promotes physical activity and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: The route runs through Trójmiejski Landscape Park with proximity to the sea
Varied terrain with dense forests, valleys, gorges, and ravines
Challenging elevation changes and natural ascents characteristic of trail running
additional: Start packages are issued on December 4-5, 2026, at the race office. Starts are staggered: a 6 km night run at 19:00 on December 4, and on December 5, races on distances of 101 km (05:00), 53 km (07:45), 27 km (10:30), 12 km (13:30), as well as Garmin Junior runs for children. The time limit for completing the distances ranges from 2 to 15 hours depending on the course length. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. The athlete card is available 5 days before the race after logging in at startlist.pl. Distances range from 12 km to 86 km, with time limits, qualification points for Ultra Trail du Mont Blanc, and accompanying races for children and youth.

name: /10k Rainbow Run 2026
location: Frankfurt am Main, Frankfurt City Forest, Hesse, Germany
description: The 5/10k Rainbow Run is a forest run in the Frankfurt Stadtwald Goldstein, taking place on December 5, 2026. Participants can choose between a 5 km loop or two loops for 10 km. The course mainly runs on solid forest paths with some asphalt sections, making it suitable for both beginners and runners seeking a faster pace. The race is part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend and advocates against homophobia in sports by promoting an open and tolerant society. The event targets a diverse running community, including queer athletes, allies, and people of all ages and backgrounds.
course_highlights: Forest course in Frankfurt Stadtwald Goldstein
Solid forest paths with some asphalt sections
Part of the traditional FVV XMAS Tournament with over 30 years of LGBTIQ* sports history
additional: The FVV XMAS Tournament includes, besides the run, a Saturday evening party, a Sunday brunch, and a city tour. Typical December weather is around 3 °C with frequent snowfall and an average of 40 mm of precipitation. Part of the FVV XMAS Tournament weekend with social events such as party, brunch, and city tour, including support for LGBTQ+ causes.

name: Berliner Nikolauslauf 2026
price_range: 5,00 Euro bis 30,00 Euro (je nach Kategorie und Anmeldungstermin)
description: The Berlin Nikolaus Run 2026 is a traditional race around the picturesque Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke in Berlin's Grunewald. The course runs along a measured lakeside path of 5.3 kilometers, appreciated by both leisure seekers and competitive athletes. The race offers various distances for the whole family, from the Bambini Marathon to the Big 5 Marathon, and is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and scenic surroundings. The event takes place on December 6, 2026, and is organized by DIE LAUFPARTNER e.V.
course_highlights: Loop course around Schlachtensee with 5.3 km per lap
Nature-oriented route in Berlin's Grunewald with forested setting
Popular training route for top athletes and leisure runners
additional: Race bib distribution on race day from 8:00 AM at Fischerhüttenstraße 137, 14163 Berlin, near the turnaround circle between Schlachtensee and Krumme Lanke. Late registrations are possible online on race day, but with an additional fee. The event offers a variety of distances for runners and Nordic walkers as well as relay races. Courses range from 330 m to 26.8 km, registration online or in writing, late registrations on race day only online for a fee, race bib pickup in Berlin.

name: Forchheimer Nikolauslauf
description: The Forchheimer Nikolauslauf is a traditional running event organized by LG Forchheim on the Sports Island in Forchheim. The 46th edition will take place on December 5, 2026, and offers races for children and youth as well as a fun run over 5.3 km and a 10 km main race. The course runs on a new loop heading south, with the 10 km race circling the Sports Island four times. The event regularly attracts over 600 participants and offers a family-friendly and sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Children and youth races in the morning from 11:20 am
Fun run over 5.3 km on a new loop (4 times) heading south
10 km main race with four laps around the Sports Island

name: Glücksburger Nikolaus-Crosslauf
location: Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2, 24960 Glücksburg, Schleswig-Holstein, Germany
description: The Glücksburg Nikolaus Cross Run is a cross-country event held in December in Glücksburg on the Baltic Sea, organized by TSV Glücksburg 09. The races start and end at the Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2. Adults and older teenagers can choose between a 4.1 km medium and an 8.2 km long cross-country race, while younger children participate in shorter, playful runs. The event features a Santa Claus theme with a piggyback race for parents with babies and various children’s and youth races. Each participant receives a chocolate Christmas Santa as a gift.
course_highlights: Cross-country on varied terrain by the Baltic Sea
Start and finish at Schwennau Arena, Flensburger Straße 2
Diverse distances from 100 m to 8.2 km for all age groups
additional: The youngest races are not timed to maintain the playful character. The event takes place in typical December weather with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. The event also includes volunteer assignments at the start, finish, and along the course as well as refreshments with coffee, tea, and cake. Registration is online, and the event takes place at the Schwennau Arena in Glücksburg.

name: Nikolauslauf
description: The Nikolaus Run in Schnaitheim is a traditional running event held annually at Moldenberg. The event offers various courses for students, fitness runners, and trail runners, including 5 km, 10 km, and 12 km trail runs. Participants can expect a diverse route in a sporty and family-friendly atmosphere. TSG Schnaitheim Athletics looks forward to welcoming all participants on December 5th.
course_highlights: Student races with child-friendly routes
5 km fitness run and walk on varied terrain
12 km trail run with natural sections
additional: The Nikolaus Run takes place at Moldenberg. The event is organized by TSG Schnaitheim 1874 e.V. There are different race courses for various age and performance groups. Results and leaderboards from previous races are available for download. The event occurs on December 5, 2026, featuring course analyses, elevation data, and result downloads. It is a popular event for runners and walkers in the region.

name: Steinfurter Nikolauslauf 10 km
description: The Steinfurt Nikolaus Run 10 km is an annual pre-Christmas road race in Steinfurt, Germany, held as part of the Nikolaus Market. The race starts at the historic marketplace in Burgsteinfurt and ends at the Nikolaus Market. The course initially leads through the historic old town, then over natural forest paths around the recreational area Bagno, and back to the market. Since its founding in 1975, the race has established itself as a fixture in the local running calendar and attracts both club and recreational athletes from the region.
course_highlights: Start at the historic marketplace in Burgsteinfurt
Course through the historic old town
Loop on natural forest paths around the recreational area Bagno
additional: Typical December weather: around 3 °C, mostly snow-covered with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. 10 km race, typical December weather with possible snowfall, participation mainly by local clubs and hobby runners.

name: Winterlaufserie Rodgau Jügesheim (2)
description: The Rodgau Winter Running Series is a traditional running event that has been taking place in Rodgau-Jügesheim since 1980, attracting both recreational runners and top athletes from Germany and abroad. The series includes four dates, each featuring 5 km and 10 km courses starting at the Maingau Energy Stadium. In addition to competitive running, the event emphasizes community spirit, supported by team rankings for men's, women's, and mixed teams. The event is easily accessible by public transportation and offers professional timing with a race bib chip.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the Maingau Energy Stadium in Rodgau-Jügesheim
Course lengths of 5 km and 10 km
Easily accessible by S-Bahn (S1) with only a 1 km walk from the station
additional: Team ranking for teams of three persons (men, women, mixed). Chip timing with button timing recorded by the company MA:XX-. The first 250 series registrations receive a gift. Series dates: November 1, 2025; December 6, 2025; January 3, 2026; February 7, 2026. The series includes multiple runs, allowing team rankings. The courses are paved and on asphalt forest paths, which may often have snow or frost in winter conditions. Training plans for various target times are offered to optimally prepare runners for the races.

name: Maraton Praha – Dobříš
location: A Park, Braník, Praha 4, Prague, Czech Republic
description: Prague - Dobříš Marathon is a traditional trail run taking place on December 5, 2026. The race offers three courses: 42 km with individual start, 21 km, and 10 km with mass start. The route runs from Prague 4, Braník through Dobříš to Kytín, with elevation gain from 125 to 593 meters. Participants can use transportation for their belongings from the start to the finish line and are awarded absolute winners as well as category winners by age and gender. The event is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment with various race distances.
course_highlights: 42 km course with 593 m elevation gain
Start in Prague 4, Braník, finish in Kytín
Transport of participants' belongings from start to finish
additional: The 42 km race has an individual start, while the 21 km and 10 km races have mass starts. Aid stations are located at 10 km, 16 km, 27 km, 33 km, and at the finish line for the 42 km course. Parking is available near the start and finish areas. Participants run at their own risk and should exercise caution when crossing roads. The course is suitable for runners of all levels. Registration is available online, and maps of the route and information about participant categories are provided.

name: Mikulášský běh Čimelice
description: St. Nicholas Run Čimelice is a traditional annual race held in Čimelice, a popular event with a long history that usually takes place in early December. This event attracts local runners and visitors who can look forward to a sporting experience in a friendly atmosphere. Specific details about the course and race distance are not currently available, but the race is part of the local sports calendar and has a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Traditional race with a long history in Čimelice
Held annually in December
Friendly atmosphere and local community
additional: The race is part of the local sports calendar, and results from 2025 are available online.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín - Příluky is an open race on a 3.2 km course designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The route mostly passes between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of less than two laps on a precisely measured asphalt circuit. The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant is rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon roll as a token of appreciation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt circuit of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long
additional: Registration takes place in front of the Madal Bal company building from 8:15 to 8:55. Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each competitor, and the top three places in adult and children categories are awarded small prizes. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, by car, roller skates, or trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The course is a precisely measured asphalt circuit, with the children's course being 800 meters long. The race is open to all age groups, with categories for men, women, boys, and girls. Start options include cycling, walking, driving, roller skating, or trolleybus No. 11.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - prosinec
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka Park is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, including children up to 12 years old who run 1.6 km. The race is friendly and encourages joy in running, whether you want to improve your personal best or just enjoy a pleasant run in a beautiful park. After finishing, everyone is greeted with a warm cinnamon pancake. The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park; adults run two laps, children run one lap.
course_highlights: The course runs along asphalt paths in Stromovka Park
Adults run 2 laps (3.2 km), children up to 12 years run 1 lap (1.6 km)
Beautiful environment of the Royal Game Reserve - Stromovka
additional: Registration takes place at the Brussels Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Categories are divided by age, with an age coefficient for the year-round Lívancový Cup. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). There are tents for changing clothes and storing belongings, a mobile valuables storage, and WC cabins. Parking is recommended near the bridge to Císařský Ostrov on Za elektrárnou street. The course length is 3.2 km, asphalt surface, registration is voluntary, and running without bibs is possible.

name: LEKI WINTER SkyRace®
description: LEKI WINTER SkyRace® is a winter skyrunning race held at Ještěd in the area near the ski jumps. The race offers a challenging royal route of 22 km with an elevation gain of 1180 meters, closing the skyrunning season of 2025. In addition to the main race, shorter routes and children's races are available, allowing participation from a wide range of runners. The race atmosphere is complemented by the announcement of winners and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: Royal route Winter SkyRace®: 22 km with 1180 m elevation gain
Other routes: Winter Trail 12 km / 520 m+, Winter Easy 6 km / 220 m+
Children's races on 200 m, 500 m, and 1200 m
additional: The winners are announced from 15:30. The race takes place in the area near the ski jumps at Ještěd. There are also Canicross races of the same lengths as the main routes. The race is part of the LEKI JEŠTĚD SERIES. winter mountain race, multiple routes, children's races, canicross, registration, race equipment, and refreshments.

name: LEKI JEŠTĚD SkyRace®
description: LEKI Ještěd SkyRace® is a trail running race held on the Ještěd ridge in the Liberec region. It offers challenging courses with beautiful views and natural scenery appreciated by both experienced runners and mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the JEŠTĚD SKYRACE series and is known for its friendly atmosphere, quality organization, and rich accompanying program including healthy refreshments and a partner zone. Participants can also purchase original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race.
course_highlights: Trails on the Ještěd ridge with beautiful views
Challenging mountain terrain with various course lengths (22 km, 13 km, 6 km)
Rich accompanying program including healthy and diverse refreshments
additional: Participants receive a specially prepared race kit. There is healthy and diverse catering including meat, vegetarian, and vegan options, as well as quality coffee. The event also features a TV studio with interviews and competitions, and an expanded partner zone with equipment and accessories for runners. Original merchandise for the 10th anniversary of the race is available. Races on different courses, a series of races in summer and winter, registration options, results, and rules are available on the official website.

name: Čertovská 5
description: Čertovská 5 is a traditional winter run in Unhošť covering a distance of 5.7 km, offering not only a sporting experience but also social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup. Runners are welcome to participate in devil costumes, which adds a unique atmosphere to the race. The race is divided into categories based on age and gender, allowing for fair competition. The event takes place at the Sokol Hall and is popular among locals and visitors.
course_highlights: Traditional winter run over 5.7 km
Runners in devil costumes are welcome
Announcement of the Sokol Cup after the race
additional: The race takes place on December 6, 2025, from 08:00 to 11:00 in Unhošť, Sokol Hall, Melicharova Street. Categories are divided by age and gender (men and women in various age groups). After the race, there will be social gathering and the announcement of the Sokol Cup results. Terrain: winter course, registration via naZávody.cz, suitable for all age groups and mask enthusiasts.

name: Běh do vrchu Ráztoka-Pustevny
description: The Ráztoka-Pustevny uphill run is a traditional mountain race held in Ráztoka and around Pustevny. This race offers a challenging course with elevation gain that tests runners' endurance and strength in the beautiful environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids. The event is popular among athletes of all levels and has a rich history dating back to 1969. It welcomes all who enjoy mountain running and want to experience the unique atmosphere of this race.
course_highlights: Ascent to Pustevny with an elevation gain of 400 m
Course length approximately 5.7 km
Mountain environment of the Moravian-Silesian Beskids
additional: The race is suitable for children, weather can affect conditions, registration details are not specified, the event has a long tradition and is very popular.

name: XVII Grand Prix Mysłowic
description: The XVII Mysłowice Grand Prix is a series of races organized by the Truchtacz Mysłowice Association, promoting a healthy and active lifestyle as well as the integration of runners at various levels of advancement. The event takes place in Mysłowice and is open to all age groups and running levels. Participants can expect a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity to compete within the entire Grand Prix series. Registrations are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race, and participation in the event is free of charge.
course_highlights: 10 km race in the picturesque surroundings of Mysłowice
A series of seasonal events promoting a healthy lifestyle
Running community and integration of the local community
additional: Registrations for the Grand Prix series are only possible at the Race Office on the day of the race. Participation in the Grand Prix events is free of charge. The event is open to everyone, regardless of skill level and age. The event focuses on promoting physical activity, health, and the running community, with various routes and seasonal editions.

name: Adventslauf
description: The Advent Run in Lage is a traditional running event organized by the running department of TG Lage. The course takes place through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park and features well-maintained forest paths, partly along the well-known Hermannsweg. The run is suitable for runners of all performance levels and takes place annually in December. The event is part of the diverse running and walking offerings of TG Lage, which also provides beginner courses and training opportunities.
course_highlights: Course through the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park
Well-maintained and easy-to-run forest paths
Sections along the well-known Hermannsweg
additional: The running department of TG Lage also offers a beginner's course for Nordic walking, which covers basic techniques in 4 sessions of 60 minutes each. Rental poles are available. Additionally, there is a 10-session card for limited-time training participation, valid for 6 months and 10 training sessions. The office is open on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Run on forest and field paths in the Teutoburg Forest Nature Park, on the 2nd Advent, easily accessible, festive setting in the gymnasium.

name: Barbara-Runde
description: The Barbara Run is a traditional race event in Bergkamen-Oberaden, organized annually by SuS Oberaden 1921 e.V. It offers various running distances, including 10 km, 5 km, children’s races, and walking, attracting numerous runners. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and a dedicated organizing team that ensures smooth proceedings. The course is known for its fast times and has been awarded multiple course records.
course_highlights: 10 km course with a record time of 30:56 minutes
5 km course with fast times for men and women
Various courses for children, students, runners, and walkers
additional: The event includes a children’s run (340 m), student races (800 m, 2,000 m, 3,000 m), main races over 10 km, 5 km run and walk, as well as a 5 x 2,000 m relay. Results can be accessed on my.race|result or RaceResult. The event takes place at the Römerbergstadion in Bergkamen. The organizing team thanks the many volunteers for their commitment. The event also features walking, children’s races, and student competitions. It is popular with approximately 300 to 1,000 participants, offering a family-friendly atmosphere and a spirit of sporting community.

name: Fischteiche Cross
description: The Fish Ponds Cross is a traditional cross-country race in the Langenberger Forest near Leck, organized by SV Enge-Sande. It concludes the Cross-Cup series and offers races for various age groups and distances, from 0.8 km for the youngest children to 9.6 km for adults and seniors. The event is characterized by its varied forest course and ends with an award ceremony and on-site catering.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through the Langenberger Forest
Course lengths from 0.8 km to 9.6 km depending on age group
Varied forest course with typical December weather
additional: Start according to age groups and suitable distances; registration and results via myraceresult; catering with coffee and cake on site; award ceremony after the race. Cross-country race in the Langenberger Forest, distances for all age groups, registration via myraceresult, weather-dependent with possible winter conditions, including catering with coffee and cake.

name: FT Jahn Nikolauslauf
location: Jahn Vereinsheim, Landsberg am Lech, Bavaria, Germany
description: The FT Jahn Nikolauslauf in Landsberg am Lech is a traditional running event held annually in December. It offers various distances for all age groups and fitness levels, from 1 km for children to 10 km for endurance athletes. In addition to running, Nordic Walking is also a discipline. The event combines sporting ambition with a friendly community atmosphere in one of Germany's most beautiful cities and invites everyone to start the Advent season actively.
course_highlights: Distances from 1 km to 10 km for different age groups
Winter atmosphere in the historic city of Landsberg am Lech
Combination of running and Nordic Walking competitions
additional: Start times staggered by distance: 1 km and 2 km runs start at 11:00 AM, 5 km run & Nordic Walking at 11:30 AM, 10 km run at 11:45 AM. Minimum age varies by distance (6 years for 1 km, 12 years for 2 km, 16 years for 5 km and 10 km). The event location is the Jahn club house in Landsberg am Lech. Running and Nordic Walking distances from 1 km to 10 km, various age groups, winter atmosphere, registration required.

name: Heeslinger Nikolauscross
description: The Heeslingen Nikolaus Cross Run is a popular cross-country race held annually in Heeslingen, Lower Saxony. The event attracts athletes and families from the region and is known for sporting challenges at a high level. At the same time, the races determine the titles of the district champions of the Rotenburg/W. district. The Heeslingen SC as the organizer is an established contact point for sports enthusiasts and volunteers from the surrounding communities.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through varied terrain
Determination of the district champions of Rotenburg/W.
Event in the Heeslingen region with a family-friendly atmosphere
additional: Routes and participation conditions can be found in the respective announcement; no participation fee required. The event is open to runners of all ages, including children, adolescents, active athletes, and masters.

name: Ilsfelder Nikolauslauf
price_range: 6,00 € bis 12,00 € je nach Lauf und Anmeldung
description: The Ilsfeld Nikolaus Run is a traditional running event taking place on December 6, 2026, in Ilsfeld. The races lead along scenic circular routes along the Schozach through the municipality. Whether beginner or professional, the focus is on the fun of movement. In addition to individual and group registrations, there is a Nikolaus classification for runners in Nikolaus costumes. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association and takes place in all weather conditions.
course_highlights: Run along the Schozach on a scenic circular course
Distances: 1.6 km school run, 5 km Volksbank run, 10 km TRZ Siegele run
Nikolaus classification for runners in Nikolaus costumes (except school run)
additional: Timing is done as net time with a disposable transponder system in the bib. The award ceremony takes place in the community hall. There are material prizes for Nikolaus costume winners, largest group, fastest group, and solo runners. The courses are not officially measured and not record-eligible. Registration is possible until November 25, 2026, with a personalized bib, afterwards only a standard bib. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Running in all weather, Nikolaus costume requirement: pants (including skirt), top, hat, group and individual starts, Nikolaus classification with gifts, online registration, timing with transponder, award ceremony in the community hall.

name: itdesign-Nikolauslauf Tübingen
description: The itdesign Nikolauslauf Tübingen is a traditional half marathon that has been organized by Post-SV Tübingen since 1976. The course is officially measured and recognized as a road race, making it eligible for best lists. The route runs over finely gravelled forest paths and paved sections with moderate inclines, providing a varied challenge. Refreshment points along the course and at the finish line ensure good supply for the runners. In addition to the main race, the event offers a 10 km school competition and a virtual 10 km run.
course_highlights: Officially measured half marathon (21.1 km), eligible for best lists
Finely gravelled forest paths and approximately 8.5 km of paved roads
Maximum elevation difference approx. 82 meters, total ascent approx. 300 meters
additional: Start and finish are located at Waldhäuser Straße 120, 72076 Tübingen, about 200 meters from the runner's expo. The runner's expo, race documents, and the race office are situated in the sports hall of Geschwister-Scholl-Schule, Berliner Ring 33, 72076 Tübingen. Refreshments with water, tea, and UltraSports products are available at kilometers 5, 11, and 17, as well as at the finish. At the finish, there are raisin rolls from Bäckerei Gehr. There is a Nikolauslauf app for current information, bib numbers, and results. The event takes place annually in December, including trial runs in November, with environmentally friendly travel options via the naldo network, anniversary and special shirts, and routes in the Schönbuch Nature Park.

name: Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf
description: The Klausdorfer Nikolauslauf is a traditional running event on the east bank of the Kiel Fjord, taking place on December 6, 2026, in Schwentinental, OT Klausdorf. It is the 41st time this race is held and attracts runners from the region. The event offers a festive atmosphere during the pre-Christmas season and is a sporting highlight for all age groups. Official registrations are expected to open after the summer holidays in 2026.
course_highlights: Run along the east bank of the Kiel Fjord
Traditional running event with a festive atmosphere
Event in Schwentinental, OT Klausdorf
additional: The official registration page is expected to open after the summer holidays in 2026. Course maps are available as images on the website. Registration is expected to be available after the summer holidays 2026 on the official website; the event is known for its good value for money and family-friendly atmosphere.

name: Kölner Nikolauslauf
organizer: Leichtathletik Team der Deutschen Sporthochschule Köln

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den KIDS RUN: 11,00 EUR

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Top und FunRun: 19,00 EUR bis 01.10.

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Startgebühr für den Top und FunRun: 21,00 EUR ab dem 02.10.

description: The Cologne Nikolaus Run is a traditional popular race taking place on December 6, 2026, for the 29th time. The event offers three different races: the ambitious TopLauf over 10 km, the FunLauf with variable distances from 3.4 km to 10 km for all running enthusiasts, and the KidsLauf for children with a distance of 3.4 km. The races lead through the beautiful Cologne city forest on a certified circular course measured by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and create a pre-Christmas, sporty atmosphere for the whole family. The event is organized by the athletics team of the German Sports University Cologne and emphasizes community and fun in running.
course_highlights: Circular course through the Cologne city forest
DLV-certified route with route certificate
Three laps for the 10 km TopLauf, variable distances in the FunLauf
additional: Start times: TopLauf 10:00 AM, KidsLauf 11:30 AM, FunLauf 11:35 AM. FunLauf participants can choose between 3.4 km, 6.7 km, or 10 km. Preferred start number for an additional fee of €3.00. Late registration on-site possible with an extra charge of €5.00. For each sold Santa hat, €1 will be donated to the Lindenthaler Animal Park. Race bibs include B-tags for timing. Registration is closed, late registrations possible, race bib distribution in Cologne.

name: landesoffener Nikolaus-Waldlauf
description: The 46th open Nikolaus Forest Run will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Arnstorf School Center. The event offers various competitions for adults, teenagers, and children on hilly forest courses with distances ranging from 2.7 km to 7.2 km. Start and finish are at the Arnstorf School Center, which is accessible by a free bus transfer. There are also award ceremonies and shower facilities available. The event is part of the Grenzland Run Cup and features age group classifications for students.
course_highlights: Hilly course in the forest area
Start and finish at the Arnstorf School Center with shower facilities
Free bus transfer to start/finish
additional: The course length varies between 300 m and 8.7 km with age group classifications for students. Competitions are offered for children, teenagers, adults, and Nordic walking. Access to the school center is signposted. Various course lengths, start at the Arnstorf School Center, free bus transfers, shower facilities, winter running event in the forest area.

name: Lauf 38. Winterlaufserie
description: The Winter Running Series by LSV Porz begins with the race in Ochtendung on December 6, 2026. The race offers various distances, including 0.4 km and 8.1 km, and is open to runners of all performance levels, including students and Nordic walkers. Participants who successfully complete the series will receive an award such as a trophy or a towel. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not barrier-free.
course_highlights: Distances: 0.4 km and 8.1 km
Start location: Ochtendung
Typical December weather with snow cover on most days
additional: The Winter Running Series includes multiple distances and is aimed at students, walkers, and road runners. Participants who successfully finish the series exchange their bib number for a trophy or a towel. Students receive a commemorative medal at the start. Dogs are not allowed, and the event is not barrier-free. Multiple distances, start in Ochtendung, typical winter weather in December.

name: Melsunger Adventslauf Rund um die Koppe
description: The Melsungen Advent Run is a traditional running event held annually on the second Sunday of Advent in Melsungen. It offers various distances from 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km to 10 km, with the 10 km course consisting of two laps of the 5 km route. The race attracts runners of all ages and provides a family-friendly atmosphere with special appreciation for children and hobby runners. The event is organized by the running club of the Melsungen Gymnastics Club 1861 e.V. and is a regular feature of the North Hesse popular race calendar.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km, and 10 km
The 10 km course consists of two laps of the 5 km route
Family-friendly event with special childcare
additional: Results and certificates are provided via My Race Result. The event takes place annually on the second Sunday of Advent. Children receive a small reward (e.g., chocolate waffles) at the finish area and a medal and certificate at the award ceremony. The event is organized by the MT Melsungen / Department of All Sports / Running Club team. Course profiles: 1.2 km, 1.6 km, 5 km, 10 km; registration and results at My Race Result; winter weather possible.

name: Nat. Nikolaus Volkslauf
description: The 46th National Nikolaus Volkslauf in Mingolsheim (Bad Schönborn) is a traditional running event held on field and forest paths, starting and finishing at the Schönbornhalle. The race is open to children, youth, active runners, and masters, offering a sporting challenge in a natural environment. The event is organized by SG Bad Schönborn and warmly invites runners of all ages to participate in this popular folk run.
course_highlights: Running route on field and forest paths
Start and finish at Schönbornhalle
Natural running environment in Mingolsheim
additional: Registration deadline is December 2, 2023. The event is open to children, youth, active runners, and masters. Registration is done online via the SG Bad Schönborn homepage. The event category is 6.5.1 Stadium-remote events. The race takes place on December 6, 2026, and offers categories for children, youth, active runners, and masters. Typical weather in December is cold, with temperatures around 3°C, and snow is possible. The event is a great opportunity to actively celebrate the pre-Christmas season.

name: Nikolaus-Lauf in Ochsenfurt
description: The Nikolaus Run in Ochsenfurt is a traditional running event organized annually by the Turnverein Ochsenfurt 1862 e. V. The event offers various races for toddlers, schoolchildren, youth, hobby athletes, and a main race. The courses are suitable for all age groups and promote the sporting community spirit in the region. The run traditionally takes place in early December and attracts numerous participants from the area.
course_highlights: Various race categories for all age groups
Festive atmosphere in December in Ochsenfurt
Annual event with tradition and community spirit
additional: The Nikolaus Run, in addition to the competitions, features a convivial atmosphere, ideal for families and running enthusiasts. Results from previous years can be viewed on the website.

name: Oelder Nikolauslauf
location: Oelder Jahnstadion, Oelde, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 52nd Oelder Nikolauslauf will take place on December 6, 2026, at the Oelder Jahnstadion and invites children, teenagers, and adults to a diverse running experience. With four different race distances as well as a Nordic and walking distance, which is recognized as a performance track for the German Sports Badge, the race offers the right challenge for every age and performance level. The courses lead through the stadium and the surrounding landscape, including challenging ascents in the Limberger Forest. The event is a popular tradition on Nikolaustag and promotes amateur sports in the region.
course_highlights: 0.6 km loop for children up to 7 years in the stadium
3 km fitness run on paved economic paths through the Bauerschaft Bergeler
11.5 km cross-country run with ascents in the Limberger Forest
additional: The 7.5 km walking and Nordic walking route is barrier-free and also accessible with a wheelchair. An age group classification is offered for walking. The event is recognized as a performance track for the German Sports Badge. Various running and walking routes, including Nordic walking, are barrier-free, with performance routes for the German Sports Badge, as well as children and youth races.

name: Saalfelder Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run Around the Cat in Saalfeld on the Saale is a traditional 15 km road race that has taken place in winter since 1982. The course starts at the sports field on Langenschader Straße and circles around the local landmark "Cat" through Langenschade and Schloßkulm back to the start. The race is officially measured and scored in age categories by the DLV, making it particularly attractive for club runners of all ages. The event is modest with usually fewer than 100 participants and offers simple organization with online registration, changing rooms, and showers on site.
course_highlights: Officially measured 15 km road race course
Loop around the landmark "Cat" in Saalfeld
Course passes through Langenschade and Schloßkulm
additional: The event offers changing rooms and showers at the sports field on Langenschader Straße. The number of participants is usually under 100 runners. Scoring is done according to DLV age categories. The weather in December is typically cold with an average of 3 °C and frequent snowfall. The race provides online registration, changing rooms, and showers at the venue, and results are scored by age categories.

name: Werdener Crosslauf
description: The 12th Werdener Cross Country Race is a local cross-country event organized by the athletics department of the Werdener Turnerbund, a versatile sports club with numerous departments. The event takes place in Essen and offers two distances of 570 meters and 5.1 kilometers. The course is officially measured and is especially appreciated by club runners and running enthusiasts from the region. The event thrives on the commitment of volunteer helpers and is part of the popular race calendar in Germany.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on an officially measured course
Distances: 570 m and 5.1 km
Event in nature around Essen
additional: Typical December weather conditions: around 3 °C, mostly snow-covered, with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The start location is in Essen. The event relies on volunteer support. Cross-country race in December, weather-dependent, more suitable for club and hobby runners.

name: Zülpicher Seepark Nikolauslauf mit Fun/Firmenstaffel
description: The Zülpicher Nikolauslauf is organized by the athletics department of TuS Chlodwig Zülpich and Seepark Zülpich. The races take place through the wintery Seepark, including along the shores of the water sports lake, and offer various competitions for youth, general participants, corporate and club relays, as well as the main race. The event is held at the Seehaus in Zülpich and invites both runners and spectators to a festive Nikolaus celebration with mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch. Changing rooms and showers are available on site, and race bibs are distributed at the pavilion behind the main entrance.
course_highlights: Run through the wintery Seepark Zülpich
Course along the shores of the water sports lake
Start and finish at the Seehaus with changing rooms and showers
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 60 minutes before each race for a late registration fee of €2.00. Entry to the Seepark is free of charge. Race bibs are distributed at the pavilion behind the main entrance. Refreshments including mulled wine and non-alcoholic punch are provided. Various race categories, online registration, start and finish at the Seehaus, changing rooms and showers available, fixed date on December 8, 2024.

name: Malá cena Velké Verandy
description: The Little Prize of Velká Veranda is a traditional forest cross-country race held in Chocen. The race is 4,300 meters long and runs along forest roads and paths with an elevation gain of approximately 200 meters. The route is marked with flags and includes a short section of asphalt. This race is also a Memorial of Jirka Švadlena and is popular among runners seeking challenging terrain with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: 4,300 meters through forest roads and paths
Hilly profile with approximately 200 meters of elevation gain
Route marked with flags, approximately 400 meters of asphalt
additional: The race offers approximately 400 meters of asphalt, suitable for runners seeking a challenge in a natural environment, and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Olomouc - prosinec
description: The 2-Mile Run Olomouc is an open race over 2 miles (3.2 km) designed for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. There is also a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficient and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM, with the start at the fountain in the park.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.2 km) in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc
Race suitable for all age groups and running levels
Picturesque park environment with a fountain as the starting point
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The race location is at the fountain in Smetanovy Sady, except for two races in June and August, which are held by the river on U Dětského domova street. The top three places in each category are awarded. The race is held on an asphalt track, registration is from 9:30 to 10:00, and the event is part of a series of runs in Olomouc with multiple dates throughout the year.

name: Běžecká série Berounka – Nižbor
price_range: 390 Kč za závod, 1 900 Kč za 6 závodů, 2 900 Kč za celou sérii

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Voucher na celou sérii 12 běhů = 2 900 Kč (240 Kč/závod)

description: The Berounka Running Series is a series of 12 races in the beautiful surroundings of the Berounka River from Radotín to Nižbor, taking place from January to December 2026. The routes run along trails with stunning views and diverse terrain, often near nature reserves and historic sites. The series is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with the goal of motivating regular running. Starts are usually at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs. At the end of the series, winners are announced and prizes are awarded in 12 categories.
course_highlights: Trails run along with views of the Berounka River and the Czech Karst Protected Landscape Area
Challenging ascents and natural reserves, such as Klapice and Radotín Rocks
Starts at accessible locations with train connections and facilities in local pubs
additional: On-site at the races, there is the possibility of refreshments, baggage storage, changing rooms with showers, and race numbers. It is recommended to bring a headlamp. The ranking is based on the 10 best scored races in the series. Starts are mostly near train stations and in local pubs that provide facilities. Trail races around Berounka, mainly accessible by train, winners announced in December, 12 categories, scoring based on the best 10 races.

name: Adventscrosslauf
description: The Wilscher Advent Cross Run Gifhorn is a traditional cross-country race held during the Advent season in Gifhorn, Lower Saxony. The main distance is 7.5 km and runs through the winter landscape of the Wilsche district. The race starts at 2:00 PM at the meeting point An der Masch 4. The event is organized by VfR Wilsche/Neubokel, with an entry fee of 7 euros.
course_highlights: Cross-country race through winter landscape in Gifhorn-Wilsche
Main distance 7.5 km
Start and meeting point at An der Masch 4
additional: Meeting point and start is at An der Masch 4 in the Gifhorn district of Wilsche. Typical weather in December with temperatures around 3 °C and snow cover on most days. The race begins at 2:00 PM, with the meeting point at An der Masch 4 in Gifhorn. Registration is via the club's website. The event is a great opportunity to actively and socially enjoy the Advent season.

name: Alten-Busecker Winterlaufserie - 2. Event
description: The Alten-Busecker Winter Running Series is a traditional race event organized by TSG Alten-Buseck. It includes multiple runs over various distances, including 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and half marathon (21.1 km). The races take place during the cold season and offer a great opportunity to experience the winter landscape around Alten-Buseck together with other runners. The event is open to all age groups and performance levels, with special races for children and adolescents. After crossing the finish line, there are refreshments and an award ceremony for the fastest participants.
course_highlights: Courses over 2 km, 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and 21.1 km
Start and finish at Harbig Halle in Alten-Buseck
Wintery race routes with possible route changes due to construction
additional: Timing is done via passive transponders from Raceresult. Award ceremonies take place after the competitions, honoring the top 3 fastest participants of the day (M/W) and age group winners. Certificates, results lists, and photos are available online. After crossing the finish line, there is a free refreshment drink; coffee and cake are sold. Toilets, showers, and changing facilities are available at Harbig Halle. Limited parking at Harbig Halle. The Bambini race starts around 2:15 PM (only in December). Distance options: 700 m and 15 km; the event is expected to take place under winter conditions; start location in Alten-Buseck, Buseck.

name: Bühlerzeller Winterlauf
distance_verbose: 10 km, 6.5 km, 5 km, 5 km, 3000 Meter, 0.9 km
description: The Bühlerzeller Winterlauf is an established winter running event in Bühlerzell, Germany, organized by the Sportfreunde Bühlerzell. With at least 21 editions, the event offers various distances from 900 meters to 10 kilometers, including 3 km, 5 km, and 6.5 km. The program is aimed at younger runners, beginners, and experienced road runners and takes place in typical December weather with mostly snow-covered courses.
course_highlights: Various distances from 900 m to 10 km
Wintery running conditions with snow
Start and finish in Bühlerzell
additional: The event offers very short runs alongside the 10 km race to include different runner groups. Typical December weather with temperatures around 3°C and frequent snowfall characterizes the event. Races in various distances, including walking, in winter in Bühlerzell; typical temperatures around 3°C; details should be checked with the organizer before registration.

name: Ellewicker Adventslauf
price_range: 4 Euro für Kinder- und Schülerlauf, Nachmeldegebühr 2 Euro
description: The Ellewicker Advent Run is a traditional running event in Vreden-Ellewick, held annually in December. It offers a 1.5 km children and students run as well as a 5 km run, each on two laps. The event is family-friendly and supported by an engaged organizing team. It provides runners of all ages the opportunity to engage in sports and enjoy the Advent season together.
course_highlights: 1.5 km children and students run on 2 laps
5 km run on 2 laps
Course through the village of Ellewick
additional: Photographs and videos are taken during the event for press and social media use. Participant data will be used for race evaluation and can be deleted upon request. Terrain: round course of 0.5 km and 2.5 km, online registration until 12.12.2025, trophies, certificates, and raffle, weather-dependent conditions with snow cover and temperatures around 3°C

name: Jahresendlauf
location: Bad Berka, Weimarer Land, Thuringia, Germany
price_range: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 EUR, ab 17 Jahren: 8,00 EUR, zusätzliche Servicegebühr bei Anmeldung am Tag vor Ort

tiers.description: bis 16 Jahren: 4,00 Euro bei Vor-Anmeldung im Portal

tiers.label: tier_2
