description: The year-end run in Bad Berka is a traditional running event held annually in December. The courses lead through the scenic areas of Dreiteichs, Dammbachs, and Kohlgrund on asphalted, gravel, and forest paths. The run offers various distances, including a free 400m mini loop for children as well as longer distances for youth and adults. The event is open to all running enthusiasts and is organized by the sports club Spielvereinigung Bad Berka e.V.
course_highlights: Courses in Dreiteichs, Dammbachs, and Kohlgrund
Asphalted, gravel, and forest paths
Start and finish at Ilmtalstadion Bad Berka
additional: The 400m mini loop is free of charge. Registration on the day of the event on-site is possible, but with an additional service fee (€1.00 for under 16, €2.00 from 17 and above) and cash payment only. Changing and shower facilities are available. Parking is available at the sports field and in Tannrodaer Straße (about 500 meters walk). The race office opens at 9:00 AM. The courses have a hilly profile, registration is online, with shower and changing facilities, and parking at the sports field and in Tannrodaer Straße.

name: MB Brandschutz-Nachtwächterlauf
description: The MB Fire Protection Night Watchman Run is a winter race in Ottweiler, usually held before the New Year's Eve races. Short road race distances of 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km are offered, suitable for both beginners and club runners. The event is organized by the athletics department of TV Ottweiler. Registration is possible individually or as a group, facilitating team registrations.
course_highlights: Short road race distances: 2.5 km, 5 km, and 10 km
Winter race with typical December weather around 3°C, often snow-covered
Start location in Ottweiler
additional: The race usually takes place before the New Year's Eve races. Younger participants are allowed in the 2.5 km race, while higher age limits apply for 5 km and 10 km. Registration is also possible as a group, making team registrations straightforward. Typical December weather is around 3°C with frequently snow-covered streets. Winter race, road race, registration possible as individual or group, age limits depending on distance.

name: Rietberger Adventslauf
location: Innenstadt von Rietberg, Rietberg, Nordrhein-Westfalen, Germany
description: The Rietberg Advent Run is a traditional race taking place on December 12, 2026, in the city center of Rietberg. The course is expected to be a 2.5 km loop that matches the special atmosphere of the Advent Run. Participants will run two laps for the 5 km race and four laps for the 10 km race. The event offers changing rooms, showers, and toilets at the school center, as well as additional portable toilets at the start/finish area. Organizers emphasize safety and request participants to refrain from using music devices and headphones to ensure attention during the race.
course_highlights: 2.5 km loop through the Rietberg city center around the cloister garden
Start and finish near the school center with changing and shower facilities
Extra portable toilets at the start/finish area and additional toilets along the course
additional: Race documents are available from 2 p.m. on the event day at the Tourist Information (Rathhausstraße 38). Changing rooms, showers, and toilets are open at the school center from approximately 4 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. Parking is available on the paved area of the shooting range at Torfweg, among other locations. The course is narrow in places, so participants are asked to refrain from using music devices, headphones, and mobile phones to ensure safety. The exact route has not yet been finalized. Parking is available at the event location. Safety measures will be in place. Results will be posted on Race Result after the race. Participation with baby jogger or dog is not allowed.

name: Winter Milada Run
location: Chabařovice, Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: WINTER Milada Run is a winter running race held in the unique landscape of the former lignite mine, which has been transformed into the beautiful natural environment of Lake Milada on the border of the Ore Mountains and the Central Bohemian Uplands. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, in Chabařovice and offers routes of 12.5 km and 5.3 km, including children's races Olympia. The event marks the end of the running season in northern Bohemia and attracts hundreds of runners each year to the magical snowy and icy scenery of the lake. All races have a family-friendly and friendly atmosphere and are suitable for children, families, and adult competitors.
course_highlights: Routes lead through the natural environment of the former lignite mine transformed into Lake Milada
Winter run in the snowy and icy landscape of Lake Milada
Two main routes: 12.5 km and 5.3 km, plus children's races
additional: Start packages and medals for all participants. The official Milada Tour 2026 T-shirt can be ordered during registration and picked up on race day. A children's T-shirt is provided free to the first 100 registered children. The race capacity is limited to 500 runners. The accompanying program includes St. Nicholas, Krampus, and the Angel, as well as the Olympia children's corner. Terrain in the area of the former mine, winter/ice conditions, family and children's categories, on-site registration, medals for all participants, official T-shirts available for purchase.

name: Mikulášský běh Úpice
location: Náměstí v Úpici, Úpice, Czech Republic
description: The Mikulášský Run in Úpice is a traditional running race organized by the physical education club Maratonstav Úpice. The race takes place at the square in Úpice and offers categories for children and adults. The start number is valid for the entire series of races organized by the organizer. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners of various levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the square in Úpice at A. Jiráska Theatre
Categories for children and adults with separate starts
Friendly atmosphere and the possibility to participate in the race series
additional: The race office is open one hour before the start of the first category. Registration closes at 13:30 for children’s categories and at 14:00 for adults. The start number is valid for the entire race series and must be with you for each subsequent race. Results are not announced after individual races but are published on the organizer's website. The race takes place on December 12, 2026, at the square in Úpice, with the start scheduled at 14:00 for children and 14:30 for adults. Registration is conducted one hour before the start, and results are published online.

name: Zručský adventní běh
location: Zruč nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zruč Advent Run will take place for the seventh time on December 12, 2026, and has both charitable and competitive aspects. The goal of the race is to motivate more people to engage in sports, help those in need, and offer participants a way to escape pre-Christmas stress by running through the Christmas-lit Zruč. The course passes through a beautiful castle park and surrounding areas with a Christmas atmosphere, which can be viewed in a video or downloaded as a GPX file for smartwatches. After the race, a warm soup and mulled wine are prepared for a pleasant conclusion to the event.
course_highlights: Run through the Christmas-lit Zruč
The route passes through a castle park and surroundings with a Christmas atmosphere
Option to download a GPX file of the route for smartwatches
additional: The race has a charitable character and after the run, participants are served warm soup and mulled wine. The absolute winner and winner have a record time of 19:10. The course is illuminated with Christmas lights, and the atmosphere is enhanced by Christmas decorations. The event offers two routes of 900 meters and 5500 meters, suitable for children and adults, and is associated with a Christmas atmosphere and the possibility to download a GPX file of the route.

name: Předvánoční běh
description: The pre-Christmas run is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1984, held in Frýdek-Místek. The race offers courses for youth and adults, with youth running on asphalt circuits in the stadium area from 180 meters to 1.7 km. Adults run on one-kilometer circuits, men 8 km and women 3 km, with the possibility of different lengths within the stadium area. The race is suitable for the general public and is part of the TJ Slezan Frýdek-Místek athletics calendar.
course_highlights: Asphalt circuits in the stadium area for youth from 180 m to 1.7 km
One-kilometer circuits in Staré Město for adults - men 8 km, women 3 km
Race history since 1984 with a long-standing tradition
additional: Race in the stadium area with on-site registration, refreshments at the stadium clubroom, various courses from 200 m to 8 km

name: 9 Bieg Śladami Żubra
description: The Trail of the Bison Run is an annual running event organized by the Sports Association "Active Pszczyna" in Studzienice, held in December. The race course runs over one or two loops through the Studzienice forest, part of the Pszczyna Forest, offering picturesque forest landscapes. The event features various distances, including Costume Run, races for children, as well as 6 km and 12 km runs and Nordic Walking, as well as a half marathon and marathon. Participants can expect medals, awards for costumes, and traditional pea soup at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course through Studzienice forest, part of Pszczyna Forest
Competition over one or two forest loops
Scenic forest landscapes and natural mud
additional: Start times are scheduled at different hours: 08:00 for the marathon, 08:30 for the Costume Run (1.8 km), 10:10 for the half marathon. For children, races are prepared over distances of 200m, 400m, 800m, and 250m, 400m, 850m depending on age. Medals and awards for the most interesting costumes are available at the finish. A team classification (top 4 times after 1 loop) is organized. The course is also used for Nordic Walking. Traditional pea soup is served at the finish. GPX files for the half marathon, marathon, and 6 km and 12 km runs are available. The new marathon distance, changed start and finish locations, culinary and recovery attractions, honorary patronages, additional cross competitions, and team classification are also featured.

name: Adventslauf
price_range: 10,00 € bis 16,00 € je nach Strecke und Anmeldedatum
description: The Advent Run in Hamm is a traditional winter race that takes place on officially measured turnaround courses through the Lippeaue nature reserve and the spa park in Bad Hamm. The start and finish are located on the tartan track in the Jahnstadion, creating a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all ages. The event offers two distances, 5 km and 10 km, with net and gross time measurement using a chip. In addition to sporting ambition, charity is also a focus, as a donation is collected for the Hamm hospice support association.
course_highlights: Officially measured turnaround courses
Lippeaue nature reserve
Spa park in Bad Hamm
additional: Youth and young adults up to age category U20 receive a 50% discount on the entry fee (excluding donation and deposit). Additionally, a €3.00 deposit is charged for the bib number (refunded upon return) and a €1.00 donation is collected for the Hamm hospice support association. Timing is done with Race Result systems via a chip in the bib number. The timing is capable of official rankings and is forwarded to the DLV association. During the race, headphones, dogs, and baby joggers are prohibited. The award ceremony takes place approximately 45 minutes after the first runner crosses the finish line. Discounted entry is available at the nearby adventure swimming pool "Maximare". The course features timing via Race Result, bib number with chip, award ceremony about 45 minutes after the finish, and entry to Maximare is possible.

name: Ismaninger Winterlaufserie
description: The Ismaninger Winter Running Series is a traditional running event held in multiple stages from December to February. It offers races for various age groups and distances, including 13 km, 17 km, and half marathon, as well as youth and speed runs. The races take place in the beautiful surroundings of Ismaning and are ideal for runners who want to stay active during the winter. A free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station makes travel easier, and the finish line catering invites participants to stay and relax.
course_highlights: 13 km, 17 km, and half marathon courses
Separate youth and speed runs for different age groups
Free shuttle bus from Ismaning S-Bahn station
additional: Finish line catering with your own cup possible; free shuttle buses from Ismaning S-Bahn station; races for youth and speed runs for U16 and older; GPX data of the routes available. The event also includes youth and speed runs, with shuttle bus transport from Ismaning S-Bahn station. Results and historical data are available on the website.

name: Lauf Winterlaufserie 2026/2027
description: The 1st Winter Running Series 2026/2027 in Beverstedt-Wellen is a winter running series associated with the traditional Rund um Wellen. The event is organized by the local running community, which also manages the Wellen Marathon, and offers a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere away from large city events. The course includes multiple distances and runs through the rural surroundings with support from local volunteers, sponsors, and the fire brigade. The series maintains its traditional character and provides runners with a challenging and authentic winter running experience.
course_highlights: Rural course with traditional character
Event with a family-friendly, club-like atmosphere
Support from local volunteers and fire brigade
additional: Typical November weather conditions: approx. 7 °C, mostly rainy; start location Beverstedt-Wellen; event is part of a series with multiple distances (3 km and 11 km). Distances: 3 km, 11 km; traditional, communal, weather in December usually cool and rainy

name: Sparkassen Advents-Cross der LG Nordheide
location: Jahnplatz, Schützengehölz, Winsen (Luhe), Lower Saxony, Germany
price_range: U10-U16 2,50 Euro, U18-U20 3,00 Euro, Erwachsene 5,00 Euro
description: The Sparkassen Advent Cross organized by LG Nordheide will take place on December 13, 2026, in Winsen (Luhe) at the Schützengehölz near Jahnplatz. The event is open to participants from across the country and offers competitions for all age groups from U10 to seniors, including age categories up to M/W 95. The races feature various distances ranging from approximately 1,400 meters to 9 kilometers. Team competitions are held separately for male and female participants. The event provides changing rooms and sanitary facilities as well as marked parking areas nearby.
course_highlights: Various distances from about 1,400 m to 9 km
Competitions from U10 to senior categories, including M/W 95
Event location in Schützengehölz with marked footpaths
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the respective start for an additional fee of 50%. Registrations via email incur a surcharge of 1.00 Euro per start. Changing rooms and sanitary facilities are available. Parking is available behind the town hall and at the town hall parking lot, with the event location approximately 300 meters on foot through Schützengehölz. Registration includes consent to publish name, year of birth, club, as well as photo and video material in results lists and media. Distances range from about 1,400 meters to longer distances. Registration deadline is December 6, 2026. Late registrations are possible for an extra fee. Changing rooms and sanitary facilities are available, with parking behind the town hall.

name: Winterlauf
description: The Winter Run in Aachen is a traditional race covering a distance of 16.1 kilometers, running from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to ATG-Sportplatz Am Chorusberg. The race takes place annually in December and attracts numerous runners of all ages. The course runs through the Voreifel and the city area of Aachen, offering a varied and scenic running route. The event is well organized, with bib number distribution on multiple days, bus transfer to the start, and refreshments at the finish line.
course_highlights: 16.1 km long course from Bürgerhaus Venwegen to ATG-Sportplatz Am Chorusberg
Run through the Voreifel and the city area of Aachen
Start at Bürgerhaus Venwegen with heated lounge and refreshments
additional: Bib number distribution on multiple days before the race at various locations. Free bus ride from Chorusberg to the start from 8:15 a.m., early buses are recommended. Heated Bürgerhaus Venwegen serves as a lounge and refreshment area. Clothing transport from the start to the finish line. Late registrations are not possible. Race number exchange is possible up to one hour before the race via an individual change link or email. The Winter Run will take place on December 13, 2026; further information on start times, registration, and logistics is available on the website.

name: X-MAS Trail
description: The X-MAS Trail in Weiskirchen is a challenging winter trail run through the picturesque landscape of the Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park. Three demanding courses with single trails and technical sections lead through moss-covered forests, over small bridges, and past rock formations. The event requires good equipment and experience in handling winter conditions, as runners are autonomous. The route is marked with flagging tape and spray chalk, and a route briefing is provided before the run. This is not a road race but a genuine trail run with strict cutoff times.
course_highlights: High proportion of single trails with many technical sections
Winter landscape in Hunsrück-Hochwald Nature Park with mossy forests and watercourses
Passage over small bridges, rock formations, and the spectacular Felsenpfad
additional: Mandatory equipment is necessary, especially for the long distances. The route will be finalized shortly before the race and provided for download. The long courses are part of the ITRA National League Challenge. Cutoff times are strictly enforced; sweepers may remove very slow participants from the race. The event is not suitable for hikers. There are refreshment points on the long courses. A headlamp is recommended; for the long course, it is mandatory. Winter trail conditions, technical sections, no hikers allowed, mandatory equipment required, route changes possible, no dogs allowed.

name: Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank-Adventslauf
location: Zell an der Mosel, Cochem-Zell, Rhineland-Palatinate, Germany
description: The Zeller MEHR Raiffeisenbank Advent Run is a festive race in Zell on the Moselle, traditionally held during the Advent season. The event offers runners a celebratory atmosphere and an attractive course through the picturesque Moselle landscape. The race is open to all age and performance groups and combines athletic ambition with Christmas cheer.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Moselle landscape
Festive atmosphere during the Advent season
Suitable for all age and performance groups
additional: Multiple categories, registration from September to December, event on December 13, 2026

description: Panewnicki Wild Boar Run is a recreational running and Nordic Walking event held in the picturesque forests of Panewniki in Katowice. The competition takes place on a loop approximately 4,882 meters long, which can be completed up to four times. The event promotes an active lifestyle and education about proper behavior in forest areas. Participants can start individually or in pairs, and the event is open to both amateurs and athletes affiliated with sports clubs.
course_highlights: Route through the Panewniki forests approximately 4882 meters long
Loop marked every 1 km
Ability to complete the route up to 4 times
additional: The time limit for completing the route in running and Nordic Walking is 3 hours. Participants over 18 must sign a declaration of participation at their own risk or present a medical certificate. Minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during verification. There is an option to purchase a start package for the entire year. Entry fees are non-refundable but can be transferred to the next start if registered by Thursday before the event at 3:00 PM. The competition is recreational, with a 3-hour time limit, electronic registration, and non-refundable fees. The event also has an educational aspect, promoting proper behavior in forest areas.

name: Bieg po moczkę i makówki
location: Szkoła Podstawowa w Stanowicach, Stanowice, Opole, Poland
description: The Moczka and Makówki Run is an annual friendly running event held in Stanowice, which has been a fixture in the Christmas race calendar since 2012. The course is 10 km long, divided into four loops of 2.5 km each, with the option to finish early after any number of loops. After the race, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki, as well as hot coffee and tea. The event is characterized by a relaxed, friendly atmosphere, as well as a contest for the most interesting costume and a fan contest with prizes.
course_highlights: 10 km course divided into four 2.5 km loops
Start and finish at the Primary School in Stanowice, ul. Szkolna 17A
Option to complete the race after any number of loops
additional: After the race, participants receive handmade gingerbread medals and a portion of traditional holiday dishes: moczka and makówki. There is a fan contest with prizes, as well as a contest for the most interesting holiday-carnival costume, both individual and group. The event features a relaxed, friendly atmosphere and encourages active cheering. The event includes costume contests, recreational activities, a base at the Primary School in Stanowice, and the opportunity to participate in a 10 km race. The race usually takes place in December during the holiday season.

name: Augsburger AOK Winterlaufserie Weihnachtslauf
description: The Augsburg AOK Winter Running Series organized by TG Viktoria Augsburg consists of four races that pass through the beautiful Westliche Wälder Nature Park. The courses run through hilly terrain in the western forests of Augsburg and require good endurance. The series offers classifications for various age groups and an overall ranking with attractive prizes. The races take place in November and December, with the Christmas Run serving as the finale of the series.
course_highlights: Running courses through the Westliche Wälder Nature Park
Hilly terrain with challenging sections
Course lengths approximately 2.8 to 3.2 km per race
additional: Race number pickup is at the start/finish area. Mobile toilets are available at the Kathreinerstraße parking lot (races 1-3). Changing clothes/luggage can be stored in tents or pavilions, but without liability. Finish line refreshments include tea, water, and a cake buffet for races 1-3; the Christmas Run additionally offers mulled wine and children's punch. Award ceremony after the 4th race from 11:45 a.m. at the forest hut with wooden trophies and cash prizes. Online registration closes each Thursday at 10 p.m. before the respective race. Part of the AOK Winter Running Series, typical winter weather in December, online registration possible, courses in hilly terrain, start and finish locations in Augsburg.

name: Int. Weihnachts-Crosslauf
location: Ravensberger Stadion, Borgholzhausen, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The International Christmas Cross Country Race is a cross-country event held shortly before Christmas at the Ravensberger Stadium in Borgholzhausen. The event is organized by LCS Olbä and offers various distances, including 16 km, 10 km, 5 km, as well as a 7.5 km walking/nordic walking route. The 16 km course consists of two laps with partly hilly terrain around Borgholzhausen and a loop around Barenberg, which is run twice. The course is a genuine cross-country challenge with ascents and descents, with start and finish sections on paved paths where spikes are not allowed. The race attracts a diverse field of participants, from elite runners to recreational and older runners as well as walkers.
course_highlights: 16 km course with two laps and hilly terrain
Loop around Borgholzhausen including Barenberg loop
Start and finish at Ravensberger Stadium with paved sections
additional: The event takes place in typical December weather conditions with temperatures around 3 °C and frequent snowfall. There are various distances, including Nordic Walking. Spikes are not permitted on the paved start and finish sections. The event includes multiple race distances and walking options; the course is partly hilly and on natural trails, with the first and last meters on asphalt paths; spikes are not allowed.

name: Lorsbacher Winterlauf- und Walkingserie
location: Langenhainer Wald, Hofheim-Lorsbach, Hochtaunuskreis, Hessen, Germany
description: The Lorsbacher Winter Running and Walking Series is a traditional race series in the Langenhainer Forest near Hofheim-Lorsbach, taking place during the winter season from November to February. The series includes five dates, during which runners and walkers can complete the challenging, varied course of 10 km or 20 km. The 10 km route is permanently signposted, and the 20 km loop is seasonally marked. The event is open to everyone, no registration is required, and there is no participation fee. Participants start individually and run together without timing, emphasizing the community aspect.
course_highlights: Permanent signposted 10 km route in Langenhainer Forest
20 km loop with seasonally marked second lap
Refreshments with hot tea on the course and coffee/cookies in the sports hall
additional: Start is individual from 8:00 AM at the sports hall at Schinderwald, no timing. Changing rooms are open on race days from 8:00 AM to 1:00 PM. There is a tea station on the course with hot tea (please bring your own foldable cup). On the last date, participants are served soup, wheat beer, coffee, and cake. Participation is free of charge, voluntary donations are appreciated. The event is insured through a sports insurance of the LSB Hessen. GPS tracks of the routes are available via Komoot. Distances are 10 km and 20 km, with challenging and varied courses, no timing, individual starts, GPS track via Komoot, tea stations with tea, coffee, cookies, soup, and wheat beer, parking at the sports field or Park&Ride, accessible by train.

name: Weihnachtslauf Lipperreihe
description: The Christmas Run Lipperreihe is a traditional running event held annually on the 4th Sunday of Advent in the district of Lipperreihe, Oerlinghausen. The loop course starts and ends at the Lipperreihe elementary school and is precisely measured with a hilly, medium-difficulty profile. The scenic route is recorded with the professional race|result timing system. The event is open to adults and youths and offers a friendly atmosphere for runners of all performance levels.
course_highlights: Precisely measured course with a hilly profile
Medium-difficulty run through scenic surroundings
Start and finish at Lipperreihe elementary school
additional: Online registration is possible until 7 a.m. on the day of the event. Late registrations are accepted until 30 minutes before the start with a registration fee of 5 EUR, payable in cash only. Animals are not permitted. An optional event shirt in French navy color can be ordered. Timing is done with the race|result system, since 2019 with dual transponder in the bib. Information for residents regarding traffic restrictions and road closures will be provided. Precisely measured course, timing with race|result, online registration until 7 a.m. on the event day, cash payment only, no animals allowed.

name: 406. Malá cena Monaka – Vánoční
description: The Little Monaka Prize - Christmas is a traditional running race held in Slatiňany in the Pardubice Region. This Christmas race is part of the Little Monaka Prize series and offers runners the opportunity to compete in a pleasant pre-Christmas atmosphere. The race is suitable for the general public and is known for its friendly organization and sporting spirit. The organizer is KRB Chrudim, which has been organizing running events in the region for many years.
course_highlights: Traditional Christmas run in the picturesque environment of Slatiňany
Friendly atmosphere and quality organization
Part of the Little Monaka Prize series with a long-standing tradition
additional: The race takes place on December 20, 2026, in Slatiňany, Pardubice Region, and is part of the Little Monaka Prize series. The event is suitable for all age groups and running levels.

name: Vánoční běh Opava
description: The Christmas Run Opava is a traditional running race organized by the BěhOpava - spolek team. The race takes place on a 4.7 km course leading from Englišova Street towards Gappay (Latarna) along a rural asphalt road with several turns and returning back to the finish line. The course is marked with kilometer signs to help runners monitor their performance. The race is open to various age categories from pupils to men in several age groups. Organizers provide small prizes for the top runners and hold a raffle for additional prizes.
course_highlights: 4.7 km course along a rural asphalt road
Kilometer markers on the course for orientation
Start and finish at Englišova Street - Školní statek gate
additional: The course record is held by Petr Gebel from 1994 with a time of 13:39. The race is run at your own risk with a warning to be cautious when crossing roads and to follow the instructions of the organizers. The finish line judges are members and supporters of the BěhOpava association. The race takes place on an asphalt course with a slight incline, starting at Školní statek, and is complemented by small prizes and a commemorative run.

name: Vánoční běh v Ďáblickém háji
location: Ďáblický háj, Praha 8, Hlavní město Praha, Czech Republic
description: Christmas Run in Ďáblický háj is a non-competitive running event held in the health area of Ďáblický háj in Prague 8. The route goes through two loops in Ďáblický Forest, mainly flat with one gentle hill, making it suitable for runners of all levels. The event traditionally takes place on December 24th, with the first category starting at 10:00 AM. Organized by AVC Prague, the run is free of charge, fostering a friendly and community atmosphere.
course_highlights: Two loops in Ďáblický Forest
Flat terrain with one gentle hill
Forest environment in the health area
additional: The race is non-competitive, starting in the health area of Ďáblický háj, and the run is free. Organized by AVC Prague, contact: Zdeněk Weig, phone: 733 690 323. The course is suitable for all age groups. The event takes place on Christmas Eve, December 24, 2026, in the health area of Ďáblický háj.

name: 21. Wolfshäger Gänsebraten Fettverbrennungslauf
location: Wolfshagen im Harz, Lower Saxony, Germany
description: The Wolfshäger Goose Roast Fat Burning Run is a traditional race held annually on December 26th in Wolfshagen in the Harz. The event is open to runners of all ages and performance levels and offers a sporting way to actively end the Christmas season. Organized by the Wolfshagen in the Harz Running Team e.V., a non-profit organization that promotes running sports in the region. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the sense of community among runners.
course_highlights: Run through the picturesque Harz landscape
Family-friendly course for all ages
Traditional year-end race on December 26th
additional: The race is organized by the Wolfshagen in the Harz Running Team e.V., an association that also hosts charity fun runs. The event is open to hobby and competitive runners as well as children and teenagers. No published prize information or start times are available on the website. For questions, the organizer can be contacted via email. Information on distances and registration is available on the website; the event promotes health and community spirit.

name: Schokocross
description: The Chocolate Cross is a cross-country event organized by ATS Buntentor Bremen at the Kuhhirten sports facility in Stadtwerder, Bremen. The event offers short, terrain-based races for adults over distances of approximately 2.2 km, 4.2 km, and 8.2 km, as well as children's runs over 400 m for those under 10 years old and 800 m for those under 14. It is a local club race with competitions for children, youth, women, and men, particularly family-friendly, providing attractive competitive opportunities for both young and adult runners. The event traditionally takes place on December 26 and is known for its winter conditions.
course_highlights: Terrain run at the Kuhhirten sports facility in Stadtwerder
Various distances from 400 m to 8.2 km
Competitions for children, youth, and adults
additional: Typical weather in December: around 3 °C, down to -2 °C at night, an average of 40 mm of precipitation, mostly snow-covered. The event is a local club race with competitions for various age groups, including U8 and U10. Cross-country race under winter weather conditions, categories for children, youth, and adults. Registration deadline is December 22, 2026.

name: Štěpánský běh Prachatice

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Startovné činí 150 Kč při přihlášení do 25. prosince 2025

description: The St. Stephen's Run in Prachatice is a traditional sporting event held for the forty-fourth time, open to the general public from children to veterans. The morning program begins with children's and youth categories, with the main 10 km race and the 5 km hobby race starting at 11:00 AM. The route runs along an asphalt road with an elevation gain of 176 meters on the main course and 68 meters on the hobby course. The race takes place in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice and is part of the South Bohemian Running Cup 2025.
course_highlights: Main course 10 km with an elevation gain of 176 meters
Hobby race 5 km with an elevation gain of 68 meters
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Stadium in Prachatice
additional: Runners have access to changing rooms and showers in the stadium stands, and refreshments (tea and bread) are available at the finish line. Start numbers and chips are issued during registration and are to be returned to the organizers after the race. Prizes include trophies, material prizes, and monetary rewards for breaking the course record. The first 100 registered and paid participants of the main races will receive gifts from sponsors. The race includes 5 km and 10 km courses, registration is available via maraton.cz, and showers, refreshments, and facilities for competitors are provided.

name: Štěpánský kros pro děti všech kategorií a Lidový běh
location: Svitavy, Svitavy District, Pardubice Region, Czech Republic
description: Stěpánský cross country for children of all age categories and the People's Run is an open running race held in Svitavy, offering courses for children and adults on a mixed surface of asphalt and grass. The race is suitable for all age groups, from the youngest children with a 100-meter course to adults with the adult People's Run over 4,200 meters. The event takes place in all weather conditions and offers a sporting atmosphere and support for all participants. Registrations are possible online, via email, or on-site on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Mixed surface course - asphalt and grass
Categories for children from 4 years old to adults
Adult People's Run over 4200 meters (2x large loop)
additional: Registration on-site takes place from 8:45 to 9:45 AM, children's categories until 9:30 AM. Changing rooms are available at the stadium stands but are public and the organizer is not responsible for lost items. Registrations can be submitted electronically until December 23, 2025, via email, QR code, or in person on the race day. The course has a mixed surface - asphalt and grass; registrations online or on-site; different distances for different age groups; changing rooms available; the event is suitable for all age groups.

name: Štěpánský běh Zlín
location: Příluk u Zlína, Zlín, Czech Republic
price_range: zdarma (dětské běhy), ceny za dospělé od 300 Kč výše
description: Stěpánský běh ve Zlíně is a traditional running race organized by Běhy Zlín association in Příluky. The main race over 10 km is divided into three laps and starts at the football field at 10:00 AM. The event also includes free children's runs held after the main race. The race offers awards for adult runners and unique medals for winners in various categories. The event attracts runners from the wider area and is part of the Běhy Zlín series.
course_highlights: Main 10 km course divided into three laps
Surroundings of the football complex in Příluky
Children's runs after the main race
additional: Winners will be announced at 11:45 AM on site. Category winners will receive original medals and possibly material prizes. Children's runs are free with a small reward for each child, without winner announcements. The race is part of Christmas celebrations, with winners announced at 11:45 AM, and offers various categories and prizes for winners. The event takes place around the football complex in Příluky and is suitable for all age groups.

name: Vánoční běh Třtice
description: The Christmas Run Třtice is a traditional running race held annually on December 26th in the village of Třtice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is 4.8 km long and is run in categories based on age and gender. This run is a popular sporting event that continues a long-standing tradition and attracts runners from the surrounding area. The race is part of the village's sports activities and offers a pleasant atmosphere for athletes and spectators.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 4.8 km
Categories by age and gender: A (up to 39 years), B (40-49 years), C (50-59 years), D (over 60 years), E (women)
Traditional Christmas run organized since 1976
additional: The race is run in the same categories as the summer Třtice Sock Run. Results from previous years are regularly published on the village's website. The village of Třtice offers sports facilities including a children's playground and a multi-purpose sports field. The race takes place on December 26, 2026, with approximately 200 runners participating. The course is about 4.8 km long with an elevation gain of approximately 50 meters. The race is suitable for the general public and promotes the Christmas sporting atmosphere.

name: Internationaler Sparverein Silvesterlauf Saarbrücken
description: The International Sparverein Silvesterlauf Saarbrücken is a traditional race to mark the end of the year, taking place on December 27, 2026, at the Sportcampus Saar. The main distance is an officially measured 10 km loop course, mostly running through the Saarbrücken city forest, with start and finish lines located in the stadium of the Sportcampus. In addition to the main race, there are other competitions for students and children on flat loop courses. The race attracts numerous participants and spectators each year and offers a special atmosphere with sporting highlights and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: 10 km loop course with start and finish in the stadium of the Sportcampus Saar
Course runs mostly through the Saarbrücken city forest
Flat loop courses for students and children races
additional: Registrations are possible online until December 27 at 10:00 AM, as well as on-site on December 27 from 3:00 PM to 5:00 PM and on December 28 from 10:30 AM until one hour before the respective start. On-site registration is cash only. Parking is free in the parking garage of the University of Saarland, about a 5-minute walk to the start area. Certificates can be printed online at www.meisterchip.de. There are trophies and vouchers for the top finishers in various categories, as well as medals for children races. Race takes place in winter, free parking available in the university parking garage, on-site registration only cash.

name: (Před)Silvestrovský běh Lysá nad Labem
location: Lysá nad Labem, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
organizer: Tělocvičná jednota Sokol Lysá nad Labem
description: The New Year's Run Lysá nad Labem is a traditional race organized by the Physical Education Union Sokol Lysá nad Labem. This run takes place at the end of December and attracts runners who want to enjoy sports activity even in the winter season. After a two-year break, the event is once again welcoming participants who can enjoy a pleasant atmosphere and a sporting challenge in Lysá nad Labem. The event is part of a long-standing tradition and promotes physical fitness and the spirit of sport.
course_highlights: The course runs through the city streets of Lysá nad Labem, including the city center
Available routes are 6.2 km and 3.1 km long
The race is part of a traditional year-end celebration with a Christmas atmosphere
additional: The race starts and ends in Lysá nad Labem, it is a traditional annual event supporting sports activity in the community

name: Aschauer Vorsilvesterlauf
organizer: Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. und Gewerbeverein Aschau e.V.
description: The Aschau New Year's Eve Run is a popular running event in Aschau in the Chiemgau region, organized since 2009 by the Verein Lauffeuer Chiemgau e.V. and the Gewerbeverein Aschau e.V. With a flat and fast 5 km course through the town center and a children's run over 1.7 km, the race offers an attractive event for both hobby and competitive runners. The event is known as South Bavaria's biggest running party between the years and attracts numerous participants and spectators annually. Besides sporting ambition, community and fun are also in the foreground, supported by a diverse accompanying program and an afterrun party.
course_highlights: Flat, fast 5 km course through the town center of Aschau
Children's run over one lap of 1.7 km
Three laps in the hobby and night run, totaling 5 km
additional: Race bib distribution on December 27, 2025 from 5 PM at Chalet Aschau. Loan chips for timing will be issued and must be returned by 9 PM, otherwise a fee of €30 applies. In the finish area, there will be mulled wine (also non-alcoholic), gingerbread, and stollen. Every finisher receives an edible medal. After the night run, there will be an award ceremony and afterrun party at the chalet. Parking is available at the festival hall, tourist information, sports hall, and train station. Changing rooms and toilets are available at the Red Cross home and train station. 5 km run, children's run, community event, held annually on December 28, festive atmosphere, medals and refreshments included.

name: Silvesterlauf Bremen
description: The Bremen New Year's Eve Run is a popular running event on December 31st that welcomes runners of all ages and skill levels. The event offers various distances from 400 meters for children and beginners to 10 kilometers for experienced runners, passing through the beautiful surroundings of Lake Werder. In addition to the sporting year-end, festive music and New Year's Eve atmosphere create a special experience. Costumed participants are warmly invited to creatively participate and run into the new year together.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the scenic surroundings of Lake Werder
Barrier-free 2.5 km route for beginners and people with special needs
Festive New Year's Eve atmosphere with music and medals for all finishers
additional: Start times vary by route: 5 km run at 12:00 PM, 2.5 km walk at 12:30 PM, 5 km and 10 km walk at 12:50 PM, children's run 400 m at 12:55 PM, kids run 1000 m at 1:00 PM, 10 km run at 1:15 PM. Shipping of start documents is possible for a fee. Barrier-free 2.5 km route suitable for all. Costumes are explicitly encouraged for a special New Year's Eve feeling. Various routes, including children’s and walking options, festive atmosphere, medals for all, creative costumes allowed.

name: Silvesterlauf Hannover
description: The New Year's Eve Run at the Leine in Hanover is a traditional end-of-year race held on December 31st. The event features a 7.7 km loop course, primarily on paved paths through Steintormasch, to Wasserkunst, and along the Stichkanal to the Ihme. The race starts at 1:00 PM at the clubhouse of the Hanover Cycling Club at Weddigenufer. After the race, participants can enjoy mulled wine and bratwurst and receive a finisher wheat beer glass as a memento. The event is known for its cozy atmosphere and mass start.
course_highlights: 7.7 km loop course on predominantly paved paths
Course passes through Steintormasch to Wasserkunst and Stichkanal
Start and finish at the clubhouse of the Hanover Cycling Club at Weddigenufer
additional: Mass start, mulled wine and bratwurst at affordable prices after the race, each finisher receives a 0.5l wheat beer glass in event design, late registration on the day of the event from 12:00 PM on-site (cash or PayPal payment). The race takes place on December 31st, with online registration until 31.12.25 10:00 AM. There are mass start and festivities that make the race a convivial end-of-year celebration.

name: Silvesterlauf Wernigerode
description: The 49th Wernigerode New Year's Eve Run is the culminating event of the year in the Harz district for all running enthusiasts. The race takes place on December 31, 2026, at Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode and offers a festive atmosphere to ring in the new year. Organized by Harz-Gebirgslauf 1978 e.V., this race is a popular event for runners of all ages and skill levels.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the historic Marstall/Schlosschaussee in Wernigerode
Run through the picturesque old town of Wernigerode
Festive atmosphere to close the year in the Harz district
additional: The course runs around Wernigerode Castle, start and finish at Marstall, no shower facilities, multiple events including youth competitions and training offers

name: Silvesterlauf Burgwedel
description: The Burgwedel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31st in Burgwedel. The races cover various distances, including 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 2 km for children, offering a scenic route with start and finish lines at the modernized stadium on Ramhorst. The event attracts numerous runners and spectators and is organized by the Burgwedel Swimming Club. It is a popular sporting year-end event with a family atmosphere and diverse participant groups.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the newly modernized stadium on Ramhorst
Course lengths: 10.6 km, 5.3 km, and 2 km children's run
Beautiful blue running track in the stadium
additional: The starting shot is fired promptly at 12:00 PM by the local mayor. The event traditionally takes place on Ramhorst, where the series began in 1984. There is a ranking for the largest group, and the event is supported by numerous volunteers, sponsors, and spectators. Distances: 2 km, 5.3 km, 10 km; weather in December is usually cold and snowy; event with local clubs, fire brigades, and families; course records have been set.

name: Silvesterlauf Salzgitter
organizer: Move SZ - Wir fördern Sport e.V.
description: The New Year's Eve Run at Salzgittersee is a traditional running event held on the last day of the year. The event offers various running and walking routes for different age groups and performance levels. The race is a sporting highlight and meeting point for runners and spectators who want to end the year actively. In addition to the sporting competition, there is a team ranking and an award ceremony that particularly honors the children's races.
course_highlights: Running routes at Salzgittersee with 5.7 km and 11.4 km
Children's race over 1.2 km for birth years 2013 to 2019
Team ranking with addition of the three fastest times per team
additional: Number bib collection and late registrations (additional 3 €) from December 16 to December 28, 2025, at the ticket office of the Salzgitterbad. Re-registrations and late entries on December 30 (15-17 hours) and December 31 (11-13 hours) in the foyer of the Salzgitterbad are possible. Online registration until December 31, 2025, at 10:00 AM without extra fee, unless sold out. Team ranking with addition of the three fastest times per team. Race bibs do not need to be personally collected. Online registration until December 31, 2025. Race bib collection at Salzgitterbad. Catering at the finish area. Parking facilities at Salzgittersee. Dogs and running strollers allowed.

name: Silvesterlauf Magdeburg
description: The Magdeburg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional popular race that has been taking place for over 50 years on the last day of the year. It brings together runners of all ages and skill levels in the city of Magdeburg. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and serves as a sporting conclusion to the year, with over 900 participants crossing the finish line. The race is part of the Magdeburg City Ranking and is very popular in the region.
course_highlights: 5 km loop, run twice
10 km distance as the main race
1.5 km children's race for the youngest participants
additional: The New Year's Eve Run is the final, eighth competition of the Magdeburg City Ranking. Over 950 children and adults participate. The event is organized by the Magdeburger LaufKultur 08 e.V. club. Routes, registration, results, photos, press reports; weather in December is usually cold and snowy.

name: Silvesterlauf Berlin
description: The Berlin New Year's Eve Run on December 31 offers runners the opportunity to end the year actively. The event features three different courses (4 km, 6 km, and 10 km) through the scenic Grunewald with challenging sections such as the Drachen- and Teufelsberg, which reward with great views over Berlin. Besides the sporting experience, fun is the main focus, especially through the possibility of running in costumes and the awarding of the most creative outfits. All finishers can enjoy a delicious pancake as a sweet memento at the finish line.
course_highlights: Course through the Grunewald with Drachenflieger- and Teufelsberg
Spectacular views over all of Berlin before the New Year
Varied distances: 4 km, 6 km, and 10 km
additional: Start and finish are located near the Mommsenstadion (Waldschulallee 34, 14055 Berlin). Start passes and bib numbers will be sent in advance via email. Race documents can be collected on the event day from 10:00 AM on-site. Timing is done with disposable transponders on the bib. The time limit is 1:30 hours. Water, tea, and pancakes are available at the finish. Reusable cups are used exclusively. Changing facilities are available at the Mommsenstadion, but no clothing drop-off. Results and certificates are available online in the evening. The courses vary between 2, 4, 6, and 10 km; open to all age groups; start and finish at the Mommsenstadion; includes refreshments with pancakes and awards for top placements as well as for the most creative costumes.

name: Silvesterlauf München
description: The MRRC New Year's Eve Run Munich is a traditional running event held annually on December 31st in the Olympic Park Munich. With over 4,300 participants from 54 nations, the New Year's Eve Run is one of the largest New Year's Eve runs in Germany. The races take place on loop courses through the Olympic Park with start and finish near the lake shore close to the Olympic Tower. The event offers routes for all age groups and performance levels, providing an energetic and festive way to end the year.
course_highlights: Loop courses through the Olympic Park Munich
Start and finish at the lake shore near the Olympic Tower
10 km race measured by DLV and suitable for best lists
additional: Race bibs can be picked up on December 30th from 5 to 7 pm and on the event day from 9:30 am. Race bibs with QR code must be worn visibly on the chest. Safety pins are provided. Pacemakers are available for the 5 km and 10 km races. Start and finish are at the lake shore near the Olympic Tower. No late registrations are possible. Changes to the start number are possible until December 23, 2025, for a fee. Public transportation and bicycles are recommended for travel. Annual participant numbers range from 1,600 to over 2,900, including results, photos, and videos. Online registration is available.

name: Silvesterlauf Neuss
description: The Neuss New Year's Eve Run is an established 10 km race that starts at 12:00 PM on December 31, 2026, at the Uedesheimer Deichtor. The course offers beautiful views of the Rhine as it passes through the Rhine meadows and Uedesheimer fields, providing a perfect athletic year-end. The running event is suitable for all runners, from beginners to professionals, combining athletic challenge with a festive year-end atmosphere. Additionally, the race supports the Balloon Action, the Förderverein of the children's clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss, through donation collections.
course_highlights: 10 km course with DLV approval
Start at Uedesheimer Deichtor with Rhine view
Run through Rhine meadows and Uedesheimer fields
additional: Supporting program at the start/finish area at Deichtor creates a festive year-end atmosphere. The race raises funds for the Balloon Action, the Förderverein of the children's clinic at Lukaskrankenhaus Neuss. Record number of participants in 2025 with 1,040 registrations and 859 finishers. The event begins on December 31, 2026, at 12:00 PM at Uedesheimer Rheindeich, with a 10 km course. Training plans are also offered, and the event is known for its friendly atmosphere and beautiful running scenery.

name: Silvesterlauf Nürnberg
description: The New Year's Eve Run Nuremberg is a traditional race event held annually on December 31st around Lake Wöhrder. Various races are offered for all age groups, from the Bambini race to school and hobby runs, up to the 10 km main race. The course is mostly flat and fully asphalted, allowing for fast times. The event is open to runners of all performance levels and offers a festive atmosphere to close out the year.
course_highlights: Loop course around Lake Wöhrder, fully asphalted
Flat course, ideal for fast times
Pendel routes for Bambini and school runs along the north shore
additional: Start and finish are in front of Café Tante Noris at Wastl on Johann-Soergel-Weg. The race bibs are distributed at Sebastianspital. Nordic walking poles and baby joggers are allowed in the hobby run but not in the main race for safety reasons. Participant limits are 150 for Bambini and school runs, 1300 for hobby and main runs. A long-sleeve shirt for the New Year's Eve Run can be ordered for an additional fee, with children's sizes only available until November 16, 2025. Races take place on December 31st, registration is open until December 18, 2025, with limited participant numbers. Late registrations on race day are possible for certain runs. Bib pickup is at Sebastianspital. Participation is restricted based on birth year.

name: Silvesterlauf Schifferstadt
description: The New Year's Eve Run Schifferstadt is a traditional running event held annually on December 31st at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg. The flat and fast courses run over asphalted and paved paths and feature a spectator-friendly finish in the stadium. In addition to the main race, there is also a mini run for children, accommodating the increasing number of participants. The event is approved by the German Athletics Association (DLV) and attracts runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Flat, fast courses over asphalted and paved paths
Finish in the stadium with a course adapted to ease congestion at the narrow points
Mini run for children with its own course
additional: The finish area was adjusted in 2012 to relieve congestion in the stadium. The event is approved by the DLV. There is an participation option for children aged 2-5 years. Bib numbers are issued to all participants. The event takes place at the School and Sports Center on Neustückweg, registration begins in October 2025, including course maps and children's runs.

name: Silvesterlauf Zossen-Ludwigsfelde
description: The 46th New Year's Eve Run Zossen-Ludwigsfelde is a traditional race approximately 18 km long from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde. The start takes place at Zossen Town Hall square with an honorary start at 9:00 a.m. and the official start at 9:15 a.m. at the outskirts of Zossen. The course runs over firmly frozen paths, which are easy to run on in good weather. At the finish in the Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium, participants receive a commemorative medal and a Prosecco as a reward.
course_highlights: Approximately 18 km course from Zossen to Ludwigsfelde
Start at the outskirts of Zossen behind the level crossing of the old B246
Finish at Ludwigsfelde Forest Stadium with medal and Prosecco
additional: Honorary start at 9:00 a.m. at Zossen Town Hall square. The course is firmly frozen due to frost and easy to run. Finishers receive a commemorative medal and a Prosecco. Registration deadline is December 28, 2025. The course is frozen due to weather conditions. Event is stadium-remote.

name: Silvesterlauf Gießen
description: The traditional Sparkasse Gießen New Year's Eve Run takes place on December 31, 2026, in Gießen-East and offers runners a varied race event with four courses: children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon. The event is fully booked with 1,800 starting places and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and high-quality organization. Start and finish are located at Karl-Reuter-Weg, and all finishers receive a medal sponsored by Autohaus Erben. In addition to the races, there are classifications and awards for walkers and Nordic walkers, as well as a team competition with attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Karl-Reuter-Weg in Gießen-East
Four courses: children's run, 5 km, 10 km, and half marathon
Separate classification and award ceremony for walkers and Nordic walkers
additional: Race bib pickup before Christmas at the Sparkasse Gießen premises and on the day before the race at Sporthalle-Ost. Changing and shower facilities available at Sporthalle Ost. Every finisher receives a medal; for the first time, there will be fruit provision at the finish area. Start times are staggered to ease the course. The participant limit is 2,200, medals are awarded to the first 2,000 finishers. Finisher shirts can be ordered additionally. Parking is available at Philosophikum I and the Studentenwerk in Otto-Behaghel-Straße. Courses are available as GPX files and can be used with navigation apps. Registration is online until December 27, 2025. Bib pickup is on December 27, 2025. Medals for the first 2,000 finishers. Entry fee includes a deposit. Shower and changing facilities are available at Sporthalle Ost.

name: Silvesterlauf Frankfurt
location: Deutsche Bank Park, Frankfurt, Hesse, Germany
description: The Spiridon Mainova New Year's Eve Run in Frankfurt is a traditional 10 km race held on December 31, 2026, at the Deutsche Bank Park. The course is mostly flat and runs through forest areas as well as on asphalt and paved forest paths. The race is precisely measured according to AIMS rules and open to club and recreational runners. In addition to the main race, there are also school and children’s runs, which are particularly popular and regularly set participation records. The event is organized by Spiridon Frankfurt e.V. and offers a family-friendly atmosphere with a broad participant field.
course_highlights: 10 km course, mainly forest, asphalt, and well-maintained forest paths
Mostly flat and precisely measured according to AIMS rules
Each kilometer is marked
additional: Start and finish at the winter sports hall at Deutsche Bank Park. Participation is limited to a maximum of 3,000 athletes. Race documents will be sent to pre-registered participants; late registrants will receive them on site. There are school runs over 2 km and 4 km as well as children’s runs. The race is eligible for rankings and is part of the Rosbacher Main Run Cup 2025. District championships of the HLV Frankfurt district will be held as part of the race. The New Year's Eve Run is open to club and recreational runners, with start and finish at the winter sports hall at Deutsche Bank Park. Registration is exclusively online, with start numbers including chips, refreshments at the finish, as well as showers and toilets in the hall.

name: Silvesterlauf Bad Staffelstein
description: The New Year's Eve Run Bad Staffelstein is a traditional race event held annually on December 31st. The event attracts both amateur and competitive runners and offers an attractive course in the Bad Staffelstein region. The race is known for its team rankings and personal best times achieved by participants. The event is organized by the Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. club, which also provides professional training programs.
course_highlights: 10-kilometer race course
Team ranking with strong participation
Attractive race course in Bad Staffelstein
additional: The Böhnlein Sports Bamberg e.V. club offers professional training with experienced coaches. The event is part of the club's calendar and is organized by a dedicated team. There is a strong team ranking, and personal best times are often achieved. The event takes place at the Adam-Riese-Halle in Bad Staffelstein and offers both individual and team competitions. It is a popular opportunity to conclude the year with a sporting event.

name: Silvesterlauf Tuttlingen
description: The Tuttlingen New Year's Eve Run is a popular race event with a flat, officially measured course along the Danube, eligible for record listings. Offered are races over 5 km, 10 km, as well as walking, complemented by children's and school runs with shorter distances. The event attracts many participants annually and offers a family-friendly atmosphere supported by numerous helpers and sponsors. name: Kieler Silvesterlauf
description: The Kiel New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held on December 31st in Kiel-Ellerbek at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz. The event is organized by LTV Kiel-Ost e.V. and offers a limited number of 250 participants. In addition to the athletic competition, there is a costume contest for individuals and teams as well as a prize draw. The award ceremony takes place in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School, and each participant receives a memento as well as the opportunity to order a certificate.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Klausdorfer Weg / Rohdehoffplatz
Participant limit of 250 runners
Costume contest for individuals and teams with prizes
additional: Race materials can be picked up on December 30, 2026, from 15:00 to 16:30 and on December 31, 2026, from 11:00 to 12:30 at the sports hall. Late registrations incur a fee and can secure starting places if still available. The award ceremony is approximately at 14:30 in the gymnasium of Ellerbeker School. There are no age group classifications, but separate rankings for men and women. Participants who return their bib after the race are entered into a prize draw, attendance is required. Participant limit is 250, with start times on December 30 and 31, 2026. Late registration possible. The award ceremony is around 14:30. Certificates and prizes are available.

name: Kißlegger Silvesterlauf
price_range: kostenlos für Kinder und Bambini, sonst nicht explizit angegeben
description: The Kißlegg New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event held annually on December 31st in Kißlegg. The race offers runners of all ages the opportunity to end the year actively. The event is organized by the Sports Community 1865 Kißlegg e.V. and is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and well-organized execution. Registration is done online, and results are published promptly.
course_highlights: Various race distances including a 7.7 km main race
Festive atmosphere with music and creative costumes
Free participation for children and toddlers
additional: Late registrations are possible up to 30 minutes before the start for a late registration fee of 3 euros. The entry fee is collected during online registration and includes the chip number. The event was photographed, and images are available for download. The event features music, costumes, prizes, a festive atmosphere, free participation for children and toddlers, and catering by partner Linde.

description: The Cologne GAG New Year's Eve Run celebrates its 50th edition on December 31, 2026, and invites both experienced runners and newcomers to a traditional athletic year-end event. The race course runs through the traffic-free park area of Merheimer Heide, is flat, fast, recognized by the German Athletics Association (DLV), officially measured, and eligible for rankings. Start and finish are located in front of the stadium, with the 10 km course consisting of three large laps and the 5 km course of two shortened laps, each with a lap through the stadium. Relay teams share the course and change in the stadium. The event offers races over 950 meters for students, 5 km, 10 km, and relay races.
course_highlights: Course through traffic-free park area of Merheimer Heide
Flat and fast, recognized by DLV and officially measured
Start and finish in the stadium with laps through stadium and park
additional: Online registration is possible until December 27, 2026, at 24:00. Late registration on the event day until 45 minutes before the start. Registration office at the tennis clubhouse of TuS Köln rrh. Race bibs can be picked up on the event day from 09:45 to 12:45. Relay exchange zone is located in the stadium. Changing rooms and showers are available. Courses run through Merheimer Heide. Registration online until December 27, late registration on event day, start and finish in the stadium, timing with Raceresult system.

description: The Münz New Year's Eve Run in Montabaur is a sporting highlight at the end of the year that excites runners of all ages. The event offers various running courses, including children's, youth, and family runs, as well as 5- and 10-kilometer races through the Montabaur city forest with challenging elevation gains. The friendly atmosphere and professional organization make the New Year's Eve Run a popular event that invites participants with music, refreshments, and a special mood to ring in the new year.
course_highlights: 5 km course with 70 meters of elevation
10 km course with 150 meters of elevation
Run through the Montabaur city forest
additional: Registration is possible until 30 minutes before the respective race start. Race numbers can be picked up from December 16, 2025, no shipping available. Strollers, walking sticks, bicycles, and dogs are not allowed on the course. Free drinks and a large, freshly baked pretzel at the finish line are included. Prizes are awarded for the largest participant groups and awards for the fastest runners. Race courses, on-site registration, race numbers from December 16, 2025, participation for children and adults, donations for clubs/schools/running groups, extras included at the anniversary event.

name: Nellschützer Silvesterlauf
description: The Nellschützer New Year's Eve Run is a traditional 10 km road race in Lützen, Saxony-Anhalt, taking place on the morning of December 31st. Since 2000, it has been a fixed part of the local running calendar and offers a communal year-end for runners in the Burgenlandkreis. The race starts near the church in Nellschütz and is officially organized within the German athletics framework, including insurance and scheduling. Characterized by a relaxed running style, participants often run in small groups and chat rather than aiming for personal best times. After the race, participants are traditionally served warm food, tea, and mulled wine on the farm of the Kitze family.
course_highlights: 10 km road race through Lützen and surroundings
Dedicated refreshment station along the route
Finish area with warm food, tea, and mulled wine on the farm of the Kitze family
additional: Typical weather in December: around 3 °C, lowest temperature -2 °C, mostly snow-covered with an average of 40 mm of precipitation. The race is designed as a communal year-end event, run in small groups. Start is near the church in Nellschütz. The event is known as a family-friendly year-end run with a relaxed atmosphere.

name: Oberlichtenauer Silvesterlauf
description: The Oberlichtenauer New Year's Eve Run is a traditional race to close the year in Pulsnitz, Saxony. It offers a sporting program for all age groups and performance levels with a children's run over 1.2 km, a popular race over 4.8 km, and a long-distance race over 9.2 km. The race is a popular event for runners and spectators and always takes place on New Year's Eve to bid farewell to the year in a sporty manner. The event is characterized by a family-friendly atmosphere and dedicated organizers.
course_highlights: Children's run over 1.2 km
Popular race over 4.8 km
Long-distance race over 9.2 km
additional: The race traditionally takes place on December 31 and includes three distances for different age groups. The event is known for its family-friendly atmosphere and the sporting conclusion of the year. There are no details about start times or fee structures on the website. Organizers ensure a pleasant running environment with mulled wine and a gymnasium as a meeting point. Start times on December 31, 2025, are at 13:10, 13:50, and 14:00; registration is possible on-site; race distances are 1.2 km for children, 4.8 km for the popular race, and 9.2 km for the long-distance race; refreshments are provided by club members.

name: OTB Silvesterlauf
description: The OTB New Year's Eve Run in Osnabrück is a traditional year-end race that appeals to hobby runners, walkers, and ambitious athletes alike. On the last day of the year, participants can choose from various routes, including a main race over 10 km, walking routes, a short distance of 5.6 km, a barrier-free open race, and a children's run. The event offers a festive atmosphere and modern timing with disposable chip timing. The race takes place through scenic areas such as Lake Rubbenbruch and Natruper Holz and has been a fixture in the Osnabrück running calendar since 1980.
course_highlights: 10 km main race leads to Lake Rubbenbruch, through Natruper Holz, and over Finkenhügel back to Illoshöhe
Walking route along Lake Rubbenbruch (approx. 8 km), no timing
Barrier-free open race on the tartan track at Illoshöhe with up to 5 laps of 400 m
additional: Timing is done with a disposable chip on the bib (except for walking, which has no timing). The children's route will run through the 'big goal' starting in 2025. The barrier-free open race is new from 2025. Start times vary by route: Walker at 11:20 am, Children's run at 11:30 am, Open race at 11:50 am, 5.6 km short distance at 12:10 pm, 10 km main race at 12:20 pm. Spikes are not allowed on the 10 km and 5.6 km routes. Various routes including barrier-free race, children's run, and walking; spikes not permitted; online registration available; participant limit of 3,000 runners.

name: Ottenbacher Silvesterlauf
description: The Ottenbacher New Year's Eve Run is a traditional running event in Ottenbach that takes place annually at the end of the year. The event offers runners of various age groups and performance levels the opportunity to be active together and to end the year with a sporting highlight. The courses lead through the scenic surroundings of Ottenbach and offer varied running conditions. The event is organized by TSV Ottenbach and is a popular meeting point for the regional running scene.
course_highlights: Running courses through the scenic surroundings of Ottenbach
Various distances for different age and performance groups
Traditional New Year's Eve run atmosphere to close the year
additional: The event is organized by TSV 1904 Ottenbach e.V. Information on directions and parking options is available on the website. Registration is done online via the official registration page. The event includes different age groups and running distances; details about the courses are available on the website. The race takes place on December 31st, with online registration possible. The course is approximately 10.4 km long; details are available on the official website.

name: Pönitzer Silvesterlauf
description: The Pönitz New Year's Eve Run is a traditional New Year's Eve road race in Pönitz, a district of Scharbeutz in Schleswig-Holstein. On December 31, 2026, runners start at 9:00 AM for either 7.5 km or 15 km on a flat course ending at Lindenstraße 34. The event is organized by SVG Pönitz and features electronic timing. After the race, participants receive a hot drink, a Berliner (jelly-filled pastry), a commemorative medal, and optionally a personal certificate.
course_highlights: Flat course in Pönitz ending at Lindenstraße 34
Electronic timing
Traditional New Year's Eve event with refreshments and medal
additional: Registration is straightforward on race day. The event has a long tradition with over 40 editions and attracts numerous runners and walkers even in adverse weather conditions. Typical December weather is around 3 °C with occasional snowfall. Traditional New Year's Eve run event with community spirit, electronic timing, and year-end celebrations.

name: Silvestrovský běh Jistebnice

The race takes place amidst full road traffic with support from organizers at key intersections and offers a sporting experience for the general public. The organizers warmly invite all sports enthusiasts to participate and wish everyone an enjoyable experience and a great start to the new year.

Includes scooter races and children's races
Traditional New Year's Eve run with a long-standing history (43rd edition)

The routes lead through the picturesque environment of Hrabová and are suitable for various performance levels. Photos and videos are taken for event promotion. There is an option to find relay partners and participate in the New Year's Eve relay. The event takes place annually on December 31st, with participants able to choose from different categories and distances. Registration is available on the website.

The race is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant sporting atmosphere at the end of the year. description: The New Year's Eve Run in Karviná is a traditional road race over 10 km, held annually on December 31st. The route passes through the outskirts of the city with an elevation gain of over 100 meters, presenting a challenge for every runner. The event also includes children's runs in the local forest park on tracks ranging from 200 m to 1.8 km, which are free of charge. Registration and check-in take place at the city stadium, where the entire event is also based. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and an award ceremony for medalists in various categories.

Children's runs in the forest park on tracks of 200 m, 350 m, 900 m, and 1.8 km

The race starts at 10:00, children's runs at 10:05. Registration is open until December 28 or 29. The event takes place at the City Stadium and in the forest park.

name: Silvestrovský běh Havlovicemi

The event is suitable for adults, juniors, and youth and concludes with New Year's Eve refreshments at the finish line. The start is at the HAPO complex in Havlovice, where athlete registration is also arranged. This run is part of a long-standing tradition of running races in the region.
course_highlights: Main race 6.6 km - 4 laps on a new route

New Year's Eve refreshments at the finish

The race is suitable for the general public, including youth and juniors, and is part of the Zlín Running Series. Winners are announced shortly after the race with material prizes for the best in each category.

The race includes courses of 5 km and 10 km, online registration, category winner announcements, photographs, and results available.

The race offers a 10.5 km course mostly off-road, with start and finish in the KERMI area. The run is suitable for all runners who want to end the year actively and pleasantly, with the option to start in different waves according to speed. After the race, results will be announced, and participants can enjoy seating and refreshments. The organizer is KERMI Stříbro, which ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: 10.5 km course mostly off-road

The race includes a trail at KERMI and a historic city run. Registration is possible on-site or via email. The start is at 10:00 AM. The race is suitable for the general public.

Participants can choose between the main races of 9.84 km and 4.92 km, a popular run of 1.64 km, and children's categories starting from 100 meters. The course is asphalt with a combination of paved paths, and runners will enjoy a pleasant atmosphere to end the year in motion.
