Results will be posted continuously at the start/finish area and subsequently published on mslavia.cz and atletika.cz. The top three finishers in each category will receive material prizes, and children at the finish line will receive a small prize. In the Popular Run, prizes will be drawn among three participants. Entry to two races is only possible for categories up to older youth. The course consists of asphalt and paved paths; online registration is open from November 20, 2025, to December 29, 2025; the event includes various age categories and a popular run for all ages.

name: Silvestrovský běh Kolín
location: Lesopark Borky, Kolín, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The New Year's Run in Kolín is a traditional three-kilometer race held in the Borky forest park. In 2026, the race will be held unconventionally — the course will be marked from December 30 to January 1, and each participant can complete it individually. Results can be sent to the organizer via email or SMS and will subsequently be published in the results list. The start is at the FK Kolín football field, and the course runs along roads, a cycle path, and a chestnut alley with the finish at the athletics stadium.
course_highlights: Traditional three-kilometer course in Borky forest park
Start at FK Kolín football field with artificial surface
Route runs along roads, a cycle path, and a chestnut alley around STAP
additional: The race can be completed individually from December 30 to January 1, with results sent via email or SMS. The start is at FK Kolín football field, and the finish is on the cycle path at the athletics stadium. The results list will be published on January 2. The race is not a traditional mass event due to pandemic measures. Modified format due to pandemic, individual participation, trail marked from Dec 30 to Jan 1, results submitted via email/SMS, results published Jan 2.

name: Půlnoční silvestrovsko - novoroční běh metropolí
description: The Midnight New Year's Eve Run of the metropolis is a unique sporting event held in the night Prague just before midnight on New Year's Eve. The race starts at Galerie Butovice and offers the last run in Europe in 2025. It is intended for both recreational runners and more experienced competitors who want to celebrate the arrival of the new year actively and sportingly together. The start is scheduled for December 31, 2025, at 11:50 PM, with registration possible in advance and on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Night run in a unique Prague atmosphere
Start at Galerie Butovice
Last race in Europe in 2025
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race at the registration desk. Detailed information about the route, rules, safety measures, and videos from previous editions are available at www.behmetropole.cz. Start at Galerie Butovice, register at www.behmetropole.cz, route and safety information on the website.

name: Silvestrovský běh Přerov
description: We invite you to the traditional Přerov New Year's Eve Run, which takes place on December 31st with a start at 10:00 AM from the boat dock. Men run a 7.5 km course, while women, juniors, and junior girls run a 5 km course, consisting of two laps of 2.5 km each. The race offers a pleasant atmosphere at the end of the year and the opportunity to compete in the beautiful environment of Přerov. Registration is possible in advance online or on the race day at the race office. We look forward to your participation!
course_highlights: The course runs around the boat dock and skatepark in Přerov
Men run 7.5 km, women and juniors 5 km (2 laps of 2.5 km)
Start at 10:00 AM from the boat dock

The course consists of a loop around the boat dock and skatepark, 2.5 km long, with men running 3 laps (7.5 km), women and juniors 2 laps (5 km). The race takes place on December 31, 2026, with registration available online or on-site on the race day, starting at 10:00 AM.

name: Běh od Hasy k Hase

Timing measured by chip timing

name: Běh kolem Žabárny

The race offers a start for children's categories and the main race, which follows immediately after the children’s race. The event is part of the Winter Running League and is suitable for the general public, including families with children. The start and registration take place directly in Rtyně v Podkrkonoší, ensuring convenient access and a pleasant race atmosphere.

Start for children's categories and the main race at one location
Part of the Winter Running League with year-round validity of registration fee

name: Zimní běh na Blaník
description: The Winter Run at Blaník is a legendary January race in the picturesque town of Načeradec, taking place on January 16, 2027. The race offers two main runs - a challenging main race of 19.9 km across Velký and Malý Blaník, and a supporting race of 11.2 km. The routes lead through beautiful nature of Podblanicko with significant ascents, forest sections, and views from the lookout tower on Velký Blaník. The start and finish are directly in the center of Načeradec with cozy facilities. The race capacity is limited to 700 runners, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization.
course_highlights: Main race 19.9 km with an elevation gain of 542 m across Velký and Malý Blaník
Supporting race 11.2 km with an elevation gain of 238 m and views from Malý Blaník
Refreshment stations along the route in Býkovice and at the lookout tower on Velký Blaník
additional: The start and finish are behind the building of the Municipal Office in Načeradec, approximately 270 meters from the race facilities. Parking is available at several designated areas with traffic signs and assistance from volunteer firefighters. The race is limited to 700 runners. Organizers offer free valuables storage in the changing rooms of the elementary school. The start of the supporting race is at 10:45 AM. The registration fee includes the option to order functional accessories from the J&O 2025/2026 collection. In adverse conditions, the race may be adjusted to individual starts or postponed. Registration is possible online with a refund option until December 31, 2026. The race takes place in January with a capacity of approximately 700 runners. The course mainly runs on forest and field paths. The main race starts at 10:10 AM.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski 2027
description: The Winter Holy Cross Mountains Marathon is a unique tourist event held in the picturesque Holy Cross Mountains, around Chęciny and Ciekoty. Participants can choose between two routes: the Royal Battle and the Knight's Charge, which lead through natural terrain in challenging winter conditions. This challenge attracts hundreds of runners and hiking enthusiasts from all over Poland each year, offering a unique atmosphere and beautiful views. Organizers ensure the safety and comfort of participants by providing refreshment and control points along the route.
course_highlights: Two routes to choose from: the Royal Battle and the Knight's Charge
Routes pass through natural terrain of the Holy Cross Mountains in winter conditions
Refreshment and control points along the route and the option to download a GPX file
additional: Start packages can be collected in person at designated dates and locations, including the Regional Tourist Information Center in Kielce and the European Geological Education Center in Korzecko. The Royal Battle starts at 7:00 AM, and the Knight's Charge at 9:00 AM. Participants must have mandatory equipment and prepare for winter conditions. The start package is issued only to individuals with a signed Athlete Card and an ID document. The event does not conduct official time measurement, focusing on tourism and outdoor activity, with tourist attractions and a community atmosphere. Registrations are available through the B4SPORTONLINE platform.

name: Zimowy Maraton Świętokrzyski
description: The Winter Świętokrzyski Marathon is a mountain challenge held in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains, in the town of Chęciny. The event combines running, walking, and Nordic walking, offering participants the opportunity to explore the beautiful and picturesque terrains of this region. Organizers have been promoting outdoor activity and mountain tourism for years, creating and renewing tourist trails. This event is for enthusiasts of long-distance challenges and nature contact.
course_highlights: Mountain routes in the heart of the Świętokrzyskie Mountains
Picturesque landscapes and natural tourist trails
Routes adapted for running, walking, and Nordic walking
additional: Organizers also focus on renewing and promoting tourist trails in the region. The event is part of a broader outdoor activity offer in the Świętokrzyskie Mountains. Participants have access to refreshment and control points, the possibility to download a GPX file with the routes, and the event is aimed at runners and hikers in challenging winter conditions.

name: Běh po Bremstě
location: Malé Svatoňovice, Královéhradecký kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 100 Kč dospělí, 30 Kč děti za závod
description: The Bremsta Run is part of the Winter Running League organized by TJ Maratonstav Úpice in the Jestřebí Mountains region. The race offers courses for adults approximately 5 to 7 km long and shorter courses for youth from 0.5 to 3 km, with possible adjustments depending on weather conditions. The start is in Malé Svatoňovice, where the race registration and office are also located. The race is suitable for runners of all ages and is part of a series where the five best races are scored. The organizer emphasizes safety, including mandatory reflective elements for all participants.
course_highlights: Course in the Jestřebí Mountains region with a length of 5 to 7 km for adults
Short courses of 0.5 to 3 km for youth with possible adjustments depending on weather
Start and registration in Malé Svatoňovice (SŠBPA)
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM, children's categories start at 10:00 AM, the main race begins immediately after the children finish. The number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in all weather conditions and at participants' own risk. All runners must have reflective elements. The race office is open one hour before the start of the first category. The races are open to the general public, registration is possible 15 minutes before the start, reflective gear is required, and weather conditions may affect the course conditions.

name: Běh Velbabou
description: The Velbabou Run is a traditional winter cross-country race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná Jednota Úpice in the village of Radeč. The race takes place as part of the Winter Cross-Country League and offers starts for children's categories as well as the main race. The course runs through a scenic environment with a museum in Radeč as the starting point. The event is suitable for all age groups and runners who want to enjoy winter running in a friendly atmosphere.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the museum in Radeč
Part of the Winter Cross-Country League with overall validity of the start fee
Race courses for children and adults
additional: The main race starts immediately after the children's categories finish. Registration is possible until 9:30 AM at the race office on site. The start number is valid for the entire Winter Cross-Country League series. The race takes place in winter, registration includes fees, the course is not specified.

name: Běh po cyklostezce
description: The running race along the cycle path is a traditional race organized by the physical education club Maratonstav Úpice. The race takes place in Úpice near the tennis courts by the river Elbe and is part of the Winter Running League. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. Participants can enjoy running in a picturesque environment with good organization and a long-standing tradition.
course_highlights: Start and finish at the tennis courts in Úpice
The route runs along the cycle path by the river Elbe
Part of the Winter Running League with children's categories
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories. The number is valid for the entire Winter Running League series. The race takes place in February 2027, registration is possible on-site or via the website. The course is approximately 4.6 km long, starting at the tennis courts in Úpice.

name: Běh Kvíčalou
description: The Kvíčala Run is a traditional winter cross-country race organized by Maratonstav Tělovýchovná jednota Úpice. The race takes place in Úpice in the Hradec Králové Region and is part of the Winter Cross-Country League. It starts on Saturday morning, with children's categories running first, followed immediately by the main race. The event offers a friendly atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including children and adults.
course_highlights: Winter cross-country race in Úpice (Kvíčala)
Children's categories start at 10:00, main race begins after children finish
Part of the Winter Cross-Country League with tradition and community
additional: Registration until 9:30 AM. The number is valid for the entire Winter Cross-Country League series. The main race starts immediately after the children's categories. Registration is possible online. The race takes place in February and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.

name: Winter TRAIL 2026
price_range: Early od 0 Kč, běžná od 149 Kč
description: Winter TRAIL 2027 is a road run with the spirit of an excursion, offering courses of 5 km, 10 km, half marathon, and 21 km relay through meadows and scenic hills of the Chřiby region. The race takes place in Halenkovice and offers beautiful views, diverse terrain, and a pleasant atmosphere. It also includes a 2 km family orienteering run for parents with children. The start is at the New Elementary School in Halenkovice, and race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 9:30. The event is suitable for the general public and emphasizes safety and fun in nature.
course_highlights: Diverse terrain between meadows and scenic hills of Chřiby
Beautiful views during the run
2 km family orienteering run for parents with children
additional: Race bibs are issued from 8:00 to 9:30. The run is at participants' own risk, with first aid available on the course. Increased caution is recommended at crossing points with ground communications. Virtual trail race with elevation gain, flexible timing, no fixed route, participants can choose time and place of running, multiple course lengths, registration via email, option to purchase awards and merchandise.

name: Úpická desítka
description: The Úpice Ten is a traditional road race over 10 km held in Úpice. The course is precisely measured, flat, and runs on an asphalt road from the city center towards Havlovice into Ratibořické údolí and back. The race is suitable for the general public, including youth runners who may start with the approval of the race director. After the race, results are announced in the Municipal Hall in Úpice with monetary prizes for the best in adult categories.
course_highlights: Precisely measured 10 km course
Flat asphalt road
Start and finish in front of the Municipal Hall in Úpice
additional: Children's categories start without an entry fee and register only on the spot. Youth runners (born 2009-2010) can participate in the main race after approval by the race director. Registration is open until 12:00 for children and until 12:30 for youth and adults. Results are announced at 15:00 in the Municipal Hall in Úpice. The race is governed by athletics and road traffic rules, participation is at your own risk. Registration is possible online and on-site. The race takes place under favorable conditions on an asphalt road, with categories for children and adults. Winners in categories will receive prizes.

name: 01. Godelheimer See Marathon
location: Godelheimer See, Höxter, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
description: The 1st Godelheimer See Marathon/Ultra in Höxter will take place on May 25, 2026, and is a premiere with DUV rating. The event offers runners the opportunity to experience a new course around Godelheimer See. The race is aimed at marathon and ultramarathon runners and promises a varied and challenging route in a natural environment. The organizer is the 100 Marathon Club Germany, an association for experienced marathon runners.
course_highlights: Course around Godelheimer See
Premiere with DUV rating
Natural and varied running route
additional: The event offers both marathon and ultramarathon distances, with a special focus on scenic beauty and sporting challenge.

name: Malá cena Kunětické devítky Duben 2
location: Kunětická hora, Ráby, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: První start v roce – Dlouhý okruh – 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Každý další start v roce – Dlouhý okruh – 50 Kč

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Velká cena Kunětické devítky – Dlouhý okruh – 150 Kč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: První start v roce – Krátký okruh – 100 Kč

tiers.label: tier_2
tiers.description: Každý další start v roce – Krátký okruh – 50 Kč

tiers.label: tier_3
tiers.description: Velká cena Kunětické devítky – Krátký okruh – 150 Kč

description: Kunětická devítka is a traditional Wednesday cross-country run around Kunětická Mountain, offering two routes - a short loop of 4.5 km suitable for everyone and a long loop of 9 km for more experienced runners. The race is known for its friendly atmosphere, where runners of all levels meet, and emphasizes the joy of racing rather than time. The course includes various surfaces, long straight sections, narrow paths, and a challenging climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain. The event is the largest sporting running event in the Pardubice Region held on a weekday and is part of a series of Wednesday races.
course_highlights: Short loop of 4.5 km suitable for all runners
Long loop of 9 km with terrain, narrow paths, and a climb up the stairs to Kunětická Mountain
Start and finish at the parking lot near the Old Czech Inn under Kunětická Mountain
additional: Registration takes place at the finish area from 17:00 to 17:50 from April to August. The race is held in all weather conditions unless safety is at risk. An isotonic drink is available after the race. Results are not announced on-site but are published within 24 hours on the website. The start number for the entire series can be purchased for 50 CZK once at the first start of the year. Terrain running routes with on-site registration, a series of races with scoring and categories for different age groups.

name: Bratrušovské vrchy
description: Bratrušovské vrchy is a cross-country race organized by volunteer firefighters in Bratrušov, which is part of the Chlapácký běh series. The race offers a challenging route approximately 10.7 km long with an elevation gain of 418 meters, starting from the football field in Bratrušov. There is a shorter course for children, 2 km long with an elevation gain of 80 meters. The race is suitable for runners seeking a terrain challenge with a hilly profile.
course_highlights: Route length of 10.7 km with an elevation gain of 418 m
Children's course 2 km with an elevation gain of 80 m
Start at the football field in Bratrušov
additional: The race is part of the Chlapácký běh series. Organized by the Volunteer Fire Department of Bratrušov. In 2025, the race was held on April 16th starting at 17:00. The race will take place on April 15th, 2026, as part of the Chlapácký běh series, with results available on the organizer's website.

name: Zbraslavská pila VAŠÍ LIGY 2026
description: The Zbraslavská VAŠE LIGA 2026 is a mountain cross race in Prague-Zbraslav, presenting a challenging challenge with a elevation gain of 500 meters over a 7 km course. During the race, participants will face three demanding ascents and descents that test their strength and endurance. The race starts at 6:00 PM at the Prague-Zbraslav train station and is suitable for runners seeking an intense trail experience in an urban environment with natural elements. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA under the leadership of Petr Lundák.
course_highlights: 7 km mountain cross/trail race
Elevation gain of 500 meters
Three demanding ascents and descents
additional: The race is a mountain cross/trail with significant elevation gain and challenging sections. The organizer is VAŠE LIGA, contact person Petr Lundák. The start is at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of the VAŠE LIGA series. The course is designed for trail runners, registration is possible online, and the start and finish are at the Prague-Zbraslav train station. The race is part of a series of mountain runs and offers both a challenge and beautiful natural scenery.

name: Jarní běh Olympu
description: Spring Olymp Run is a traditional cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful surroundings of Stromovka Park in Prague 7, at the OLYMP CSMV complex. It offers three courses of different lengths (5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km), which run through nature and are suitable for runners of various levels. The race is organized by PSK Olymp Prague and is part of the running community of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 18:55, allowing runners to enjoy the evening atmosphere of the race.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail character of the courses in Stromovka Park
Three course lengths: 5.5 km, 4.4 km, and 3.3 km
Start and finish at the OLYMP CSMV complex in Prague 7
additional: Registrations are only possible online until October 8, 2026, at midnight; registrations on the race day are not accepted by the organizers. The first category starts at 16:00, the main category starts at 18:55. The organizer is PSK Olymp Prague, z.s., contact person Jindřich Linhart. The race takes place in the Olymp complex area, with various age categories, online registration until October 8, 2026, course lengths of 3.3 km, 4.4 km, and 5.5 km, and is open to the general public.

name: Olomoucká desítka
description: Olomouc Ten is the third edition of a 10 km running race held in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc. The course runs on asphalt paths and participants complete three laps of 3.343 km each, with the first lap being slightly shorter. The race is part of the Hanácký Running Cup 2026 and offers categories based on age as well as an open run regardless of age. The award ceremony takes place at the Music Pavilion, and runners receive small sweet gifts for placing on the podium.
course_highlights: A 3.343 km lap on asphalt paths in Smetanovy Sady
The race is run 3 times, with the first lap being 28 meters shorter
Start and finish at the Music Pavilion in Smetanovy Sady
additional: Pre-registration of participants takes place on-site. Runners must have a chip card with a credit of at least 70 CZK, which will be deducted during registration. Items can be stored in the start/finish area. The race is run according to road running rules, each participant at their own risk. The event takes place in April 2026, with information available about registration, prices, and rules, and is part of the local running series organized by TJ Liga stovkařů.

name: Noční běh pro světlušku Olomouc

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Cena startovného je 500 Kč. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do projektu Světluška na úhradu nákladů běhu. Částka 250 Kč je příspěvkem do veřejné sbírky Světluška na přímou pomoc těžce zrakově postiženým.

description: Night Run for Světluška in Olomouc is a charity run held on April 16, 2026, in Flora Park. The race starts at 9:00 PM, and participants can choose between a 2.5 km course (1 lap) and a 5 km course (2 laps). The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which covers the event costs and the other half goes to support people with severe visual impairments. The event offers an accompanying program including a concert and starter packs with a headlamp or sports headband. Capacity is limited for safety and participant comfort.
course_highlights: Course in Flora Park in Olomouc
Option to choose between 2.5 km and 5 km routes
Night run with a headlamp or sports headband
additional: Registration counters are open from 7:00 PM. Starter packs are available with options including a headlamp or sports headband. Holders of TP, ZTP, and ZTP/P cards with an escort can enter for free and can purchase a starter pack on-site for 250 CZK. The event capacity is limited for safety and comfort. The accompanying program includes a concert by Rodan from 8:00 PM. The route is also suitable for walking. The registration fee supports the visually impaired. The start is from 7:00 PM to 8:45 PM, the accompanying program runs from 7:30 PM to 9:00 PM, and the starter pack includes a headlamp or sports headband.

name: Kateřinský běh Hrabovou
location: Kostel svaté Kateřiny, Ostrava-Hrabová, Ostrava, Moravian-Silesian Region, Czech Republic
price_range: Cena je při registraci a zaplacení do 15.4.2025
description: We invite all runners to the traditional 18th edition of the Kateřinský Run in Hrabová, which will take place on April 16, 2026, in Ostrava-Hrabová. The main route runs around the historic St. Catherine's Church, giving the race a unique atmosphere. The event offers courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, children's races, and Nordic Walking on 5 km. Participants will enjoy a friendly atmosphere, refreshments, and an accompanying program.
course_highlights: The route runs around St. Catherine's Church in Ostrava-Hrabová
Available courses of 5 km and 2.5 km, including children's races and 5 km Nordic Walking
Start and registration at the Cultural House Ostrava - Hrabová, Bažanova Street
additional: The maximum number of participants is 400. The start number is with a chip and is refundable. The registration fee includes a medal for those registered by April 13, 2026, post-race refreshments, changing rooms and toilets, SMS result service, and participation in the Hrabovský and Moravian-Silesian Running Cups (for 5 km). Recommended transportation is buses DPO lines 27, 41, 39, 77 with a stop at Hrabová, kostelík. Results are announced within 20 minutes at the registration site after the race. For safety reasons, the use of headphones during the race is not allowed. The 5 km and 2.5 km courses include running, Nordic Walking, and children's races (150 m, 300 m, 600 m, 1000 m). The surface is asphalt, suitable for all age groups, promoting a healthy lifestyle.

name: Mistrovství Moravy a Slezska v půlmaratonu + 24. Hanácký půlmaraton
location: TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Moravia and Silesia Half Marathon Championship along with the 24th Hanácký Half Marathon is a traditional running event organized by the Olomouc Athletic Club. The race takes place in the heart of Olomouc and offers quality organization at the home stadium of TJ Lokomotiva Olomouc. The club boasts a rich history and participation of its athletes in major European and world competitions. The race is suitable for a wide running public, who can enjoy the atmosphere of a championship half marathon in the beautiful environment of Moravia.
course_highlights: Regional Championship of Moravia and Silesia in Half Marathon
24th Hanácký Half Marathon with a traditional venue in Olomouc
Opportunity for runners of all levels to participate in a friendly atmosphere
additional: The races include various runs and events, detailed course information and registration have not yet been published

name: Běh Javorkou
location: Javorka, Česká Třebová, Pardubice, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč (předem), 200 Kč (na místě) pro dospělé; 30 Kč (předem), 50 Kč (na místě) pro děti; 50 Kč za štafetu
description: The Javorka Run is a traditional spring running race with many years of history, held regularly in April in the beautiful environment of Javorka Park in Česká Třebová. The main race over 6 km is among the fast races because the course runs on hard park paths and is only slightly hilly. The race is part of the regional running series ISCAREX Cup and offers quality performance experiences for runners of all categories. In addition to the main race, there are also children's categories and team relays.
course_highlights: The 6 km course runs on hard park paths (gravel, paving)
Loop courses from 200 m to 1200 m, marked with flags according to categories
Slightly hilly profile of the track in a beautiful park environment
additional: Registration is possible in advance online or on the day of the race no later than 20 minutes before the start of the respective category. The race facilities are at the outdoor stage (Music Pavilion) next to Javorka Restaurant. Starts: children's categories at 9:30, main race at 11:30, team relays at 12:10. The race takes place in Javorka Park, registration is possible online or on-site, the track is surface-paved with gentle inclines and turns. The race is part of the ISCAREX Cup and offers various categories including athletes with disabilities.

name: Žehrovický Kalspotkros
location: Kamenné Žehrovic, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Zehrovický Kalspotkros is a cross-country running race covering a distance of 6.2 km with a hilly profile, held in Kamenné Žehrovice in the Central Bohemian Region. The race is part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup and offers runners an interesting and challenging course in a natural environment. This race is suitable for trail running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in the form of hilly terrain. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality race atmosphere and sporting experience.
course_highlights: Cross-country course of 6.2 km
Hilly profile with undulating terrain
Part of the Kladno and Rakovník Runner Cup
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026, with the start scheduled for 10:30 AM and registration from 9:00 to 10:00 AM. More information is available in the regulations on the official website.

name: Listonošův krpál
location: Praha - Jarov (u Zbraslavi), Praha, Czech Republic
description: Listonošův krpál is a hill race in Prague - Jarov near Zbraslav, measuring 2.88 km with an elevation gain of 150 meters. This race is part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and the surrounding area and offers runners a challenge in the form of a demanding ascent. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts and uphill runners who want to test their endurance and strength in hilly terrain. The course is short but intense, providing a dynamic and attractive racing experience.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2.88 km
Elevation gain 150 m
Part of the Hill Runs series in Prague and surroundings
additional: The race takes place on April 18, 2026. Registration details are not specified. It is part of the mountain running series in Prague.

name: Cena Tolštejnského panství Jiřetín pod Jedlovou – Jedlová
location: Jiřetín pod Jedlovou, Lužické hory, Czech Republic
description: The Tolštejn Estate Race Jiřetín pod Jedlovou - Jedlová is a mountain uphill run 6 km long with an elevation gain of 340 meters, aiming to reach the summit of Jedlová in the Lusatian Mountains. The race is part of the Czech Cup in uphill running and offers a challenging course with beautiful views. This race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge in a natural environment. Come and enjoy the sporting atmosphere and the beauty of the Lusatian Mountains.
course_highlights: Length of the course 6 km with an elevation gain of 340 m
Finish at the summit of Jedlová
Part of the Czech Cup in uphill running
additional: The race is open to the general public, registration is possible online, and children can participate for free. The event is combined with opportunities for trips around the area, including visits to the Jedlová lookout tower and the Tolštejn ruins.

name: SAFARIBĚH
location: Safari Park Dvůr Králové, Dvůr Králové nad Labem, Czech Republic
description: Safariběh ČSOB: I Don't Want to Be Last is a running race held in Dvůr Králové Safari Park, offering a unique experience of running in an African and walking safari environment. The race is open to the general public and offers three routes: 2 km family run, 5 km, and 10 km race, with the 10 km route being two laps of the 5 km course. The surface of the routes is mainly paved asphalt, with start and finish at the main entrance to the safari park. Included in the registration fee is free entry to the safari park on race day and support for the rescue of bald zebras.
course_highlights: The route passes through African and walking safaris
Mainly paved asphalt surface
Start and finish at the main entrance to Dvůr Králové Safari Park
additional: Race bibs are equipped with a chip that remains with the runner. The registration fee includes free entry to the safari park on race day, a registration bag with gifts from partners, a meal voucher for refreshments after the race (one drink and one meal), a commemorative medal, light refreshments at the finish line (water, fruit), and accompanying activities for children at the main partner ČSOB's stand. The race is suitable for families and more experienced runners, with online registration available for various dates. The event is combined with activities in the safari park and supports nature conservation.

name: Jarní běh Dražovkou
description: Spring Run in Dražovka in Hořovice is a traditional trophy race that invites competitors of all ages to an active sporting experience. The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Dražovka and offers an opportunity for sports enjoyment and meeting other runners. Registration is possible online at brdskypohar.cz or directly on-site on the day of the race. We look forward to your participation and wish everyone much success and joy in running.
course_highlights: Trophy race in the picturesque environment of Dražovka
Suitable for both large and small competitors
Online registration available as well as on-site
additional: Registration is preferred online at www.brdskypohar.cz, but on-site registration on the race day is also possible. Trail run suitable for all age groups, registration via the website, same-day registration on-site is available.

name: Husínský kros
location: Tajanov u Klatov, Plzeň, Czech Republic
description: Husínský cross-country is a traditional spring running race in Tajanov near Klatovy, which was created as a replacement for the canceled Klatovská patnáctka. The race has been held since 2012 and is part of the prestigious Ešus league series. Men run three laps, women and girls two laps, with each lap approximately 3.6 km long and mostly on forest paths with a section on smooth asphalt. In recent years, the course has returned to the original longer variant around the Husín forest. The main referee is running legend Vlastík Zwiefelhofer.
course_highlights: Circuit approximately 3.6 km with two-thirds on forest paths
One-third of the course runs on smooth asphalt
Course runs around the Husín forest
additional: The race is part of the Ešus league series, which will have its 42nd edition in 2026 and includes 22 races. Men run 10.5 km (3 laps), women and men over 70 run 7 km (2 laps). The start is at the volleyball courts in Tajanov. The organizer is Jiří Přibík (tel. 608279305). The race is part of the prestigious Ešus league series, which has previously been held virtually due to the pandemic. The event attracts a wide participation and has a long tradition in the region.

name: Bakovský půlmaraton
location: Bakov nad Jizerou, Central Bohemia, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 300 Kč pro předem přihlášené s platbou předem do 16.4.2026

description: The Bakov Half Marathon is a traditional running race held in Bakov nad Jizerou, now in its 43rd year. The race takes place on a certified course of 21.097 km, which runs along a hilly asphalt road with varying surface quality and includes ascents and descents. The start is at 10:00 AM at the square in Bakov nad Jizerou, and the race offers monetary and material prizes for the best men and women. Registrations are possible in advance with a lower starting fee or on the race day for a higher fee.
course_highlights: Certified course of 21.097 km
Hilly asphalt road with variable surface quality
Refreshment stations at 9.7 km, 14.5 km, and at the finish
additional: Registration of participants takes place from 8:00 to 9:45 AM in a building approximately 150 meters from the start. Categories are divided by age for men and women. A prize of 2000 CZK is awarded for breaking course records in the absolute categories of men and women. The entry fee can be paid by bank transfer or on the race day at the venue. The route runs along a hilly asphalt road with alternating surface quality, there are refreshment stations on the course, and categories are announced by age, with the possibility of winning prizes for records.

name: Ještěd SkyRace®
location: Ještěd, Liberec, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Ještěd SkyRace® is a traditional trail running race held in the beautiful environment of the Ještěd ridge near Liberec. The race offers several route options, including the premier SkyRace route with a length of 22 km and an elevation gain of 1390 m, as well as shorter trails Trail (13 km) and Easy (6 km). The event is suitable for runners of all levels, including races for children and canicross. The start and finish are located in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd, providing stunning views and challenging terrain. The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM.
course_highlights: Premier SkyRace route: 22 km with 1390 m elevation gain
Other routes: Trail 13 km / 945 m+, Easy 6 km / 300 m+
Start and finish in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd
additional: The award ceremony takes place from 4:00 PM. The races include children's categories and canicross. Start and finish are in the area near the ski jump towers on Ještěd. The routes are challenging with significant elevation gain, suitable for mountain running enthusiasts. Distances are 6 km, 13 km, and 22 km; accompanying events, trail camps, merchandising, registration, entertainment, and nutrition are available during the race weekend.

name: Pyšelský kopeček
organizer: parta běžců z Pyšel a Kopeček 2016, z.s.
description: Pyšelský Kopeček is a traditional trail run in the picturesque environment of Pyšel, offering routes for all levels of runners from recreational to ultramarathoners. The course is 90% forest trails and includes loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km. Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are designated as UTMB index races, attracting experienced runners. The start and finish are at the football field in Pyšel, which provides facilities including changing rooms, showers, and refreshments. The event is suitable for the general public and is accompanied by children's races and canicross.
course_highlights: Course is 90% forest trails
Loops of 6.5 km, 11.5 km, 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km
Races of 21 km, 52 km, and 105 km are UTMB index races
additional: The race has a limit of 250 participants. Changing rooms, toilets, and showers are available at the start and finish area. Parking is available at designated spots outside the start area, respecting residents. For canicross, there are refreshment stations for dogs along the course. Children's races have manual timing, adult categories use electronic timing. Starts are divided into waves from 10:00 to 14:15 with winners announced at 17:00. The proceeds from registration fees and accompanying activities are donated to support families with children with autism.

The park operates with safety measures; registration is possible with options for transfer or refund of the registration fee. description: Petřín Three Ways is a unique race in Prague where participants conquer Petřín Hill in three different ways: by interval running up 299 steps of the Petřín Lookout Tower, running uphill with a mass start, and interval running down a slope on an unpaved path and stairs. additional: Children's races start at 9:30, the main races of 10 km and 2.7 km begin at 11:00 and 11:05. Parking is available at several locations in Polanka nad Odrou. T-shirts for the run can be purchased online until April 11, 2026, or on the race day until supplies last. The team competition is free and counts the three best times from each team. The event takes place at the Workers' House in Polanka nad Odrou, with parking available at several sites, and proceeds are donated to support neonatology.

name: Běh Přerovským luhem
location: Přerov na naučné stezce Přerovským luhem, Přerov, Olomouc, Czech Republic
description: The Přerov Meadow Run is a traditional tourist race organized by the Czech Tourist Club in Přerov. The race follows an educational trail through the Přerov Meadow, offering beautiful natural scenery and an opportunity to explore the local landscape. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes active outdoor movement. Organizers invite all runners and tourists to participate in this popular event.
course_highlights: The route follows an educational trail through Přerov Meadow
Natural scenery and forest environment
Opportunity to learn about the local landscape and nature
additional: The run is part of a series of outdoor activities organized by the Czech Tourist Club, focused on running tourism and nature exploration.

name: Cross Coutry Race – Hruboskalský půlmaraton
location: Kemp Sedmihorky, Český ráj, Liberecký kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Hruboskalský Half Marathon is a traditional running race held on April 25, 2026, in the picturesque environment of the Bohemian Paradise, at the Sedmihorky campsite. The race offers two routes - a half marathon approximately 21.8 km long with an elevation gain of 500 m, and a shorter route of 12.5 km with an elevation gain of 300 m. The course runs on paved and unpaved roads, paths, and hiking trails, including stairs and stones, and is suitable for nature lovers and those seeking a more challenging terrain. The race is part of the Cross Country Race series and is known for its atmosphere and beautiful views in the Bohemian Paradise Protected Landscape Area (CHKO).
course_highlights: Undulating course with a 500 m elevation gain on the half marathon route
Combination of paved roads, paths, stairs, and stones
Course runs on marked tourist trails with approximate kilometer markers
additional: Start numbers are color-coded (red, green, yellow for children). The route is marked with flags and signs on trees, with approximate kilometer markers every kilometer on the half marathon course. In case of wet conditions, the route may be muddy; trail shoes with a rugged sole are recommended. The race capacity is limited and often filled in advance. Participants receive payment instructions via email after registration. The race is part of the 2026 running series, with registration available through the official website. The course has been adjusted due to road reconstruction, and the capacity was filled quickly. Runners can expect a challenging and beautiful race in the natural environment of the Bohemian Paradise.

name: Běh na rozhlednu Veselý vrch
location: Chotilsko, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Veselý vrch lookout tower run is a forest cross-country race held along a scenic route by the Vltava River in the Chotilsko-Prostřední Lhoty area. The race offers a sporting challenge in a natural environment with elevation gain and is suitable for the general public, including children who start independently. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská, who ensures a friendly atmosphere and quality organization. The main category starts traditionally at 10:30, allowing comfortable participation even for families with children.
course_highlights: Forest cross-country trail along the Vltava River
Distance of 5.3 km with natural terrain
Children's separate start at 10:35
additional: Children start independently at 10:35. The organizer is Libuše Vlachynská. The race is part of the Czech Run, a service of the Czech Athletic Federation for runners and running. Terrain: trail/cross-country, registration: in advance or on-site, date: April 25, 2026

name: Posázavská trilogie
location: Týnec nad Sázavou, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Posázavská Trilogy is a legendary race that traditionally kicks off the summer season. The race combines three disciplines: running, water, and cycling, offering a diverse and challenging experience in the beautiful nature around the Sázava River. The start is in Týnec nad Sázavou and the route passes through Hradištko and Pikovice. The race is suitable for individuals and pairs and is known for its friendly atmosphere and retro refreshments after the finish.
course_highlights: Running 7 or 14 km in loops around Týnec nad Sázavou
Water segment 16 km from Týnec nad Sázavou to Pikovice without markers
Cycling 25 km from Pikovice back to Týnec nad Sázavou with marked route
additional: Mandatory equipment includes your own tourist boat (maximum length 3.5 m), vest, helmet, and cycling helmet. Kayak paddles are not allowed. Canoes can be rented at Bisport with a 20% discount using the code "Posázavská trilogie". After the race, retro refreshments are provided, including water, beer, cheese, and apples. Registration of participants takes place from 7:00 to 8:30 at the start location, where they also receive a chip and timing device. The start is in front of the Bisport building in Týnec nad Sázavou. The race includes various disciplines, mandatory equipment such as a tourist boat, helmet, and vest, and is open to the general public of different age categories.

name: Pohoda Run Únanov
location: Autokemp Pohoda Únanov, Únanov, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Pohoda Run Únanov is a running race held in the beautiful environment of Autokemp Pohoda Únanov. It offers two races - Hobby over 6.7 km and the main race over 10.1 km, both run on a single loop with mostly field and forest paths. The course is suitable for nature lovers and trail runners with gentle elevation changes. The race is part of the Znojmo Running Cup and provides a pleasant atmosphere and sporting challenge.
course_highlights: Hobby race: 6.7 km, 60% field and forest paths, 40% asphalt
Main race: 10.1 km, 70% field and forest paths, 30% asphalt
Gentle elevation with hills up to 101 m of ascent
additional: The race starts at the gate of Autokemp Pohoda Únanov. Both races are run on a single loop. The terrain is a combination of field, forest paths, and asphalt. Registration is also possible on-site from 8:50 to 10:00; the race takes place on April 25, 2026; the event also includes children's races and is suitable for the broad running public.

Suitable for children and adults

Mountain sprint at the top of the climb at 35 km

Fan zones along the route supporting runners

The race takes place annually in spring and attracts athletes who want to test their limits in a beautiful but demanding landscape.

The race is part of a series of trail events in the Czech Republic, offering various course levels, family categories, and an accompanying program for all age groups.

Registration takes place on the race day from 8:45 to 9:45, with the start of the main race scheduled after registration. Participants will receive a start package including a chip and refreshments.

description: Obora Trail Run is a challenging trail race held in Dolní Lhota near Ostrava, offering runners the opportunity to test their endurance and strength in a natural environment. For 2026, a program focused on safety and fairness is prepared, with winners announced and participation medals for all. The race is suitable for a wide range of runners, from children to experienced ultramarathoners, emphasizing respect for nature and race rules.

Canicross races with categories Racing Dog and Hobby Dog with various distances

The Ultra 9H race is an extreme endurance run with mandatory headlamps from 16:00 to 18:00. Facilities for competitors are at the start and finish with a party tent and resting area. name: Dokola Kletě

The race is intended for runners seeking a tough spring fitness test in the terrain, suitable for both amateurs and experienced ultramarathoners. The course runs on forest and field paths, trails, and asphalt with clear markings and refreshment stations. The start and finish are in Třísov near Český Krumlov. The race takes place on April 25, 2026.

Long ascents and technical descents on forest trails
Views from around Klet and four refreshment stations on the course

The time limit for the long route is 8 hours with a checkpoint at the halfway point. Mandatory equipment includes a personal cup, mobile phone, rescue foil, and suitable clothing. Parking is available directly at the start in Třísov, with limited capacity; carpooling is recommended. The race includes registration, parking, and safety rules, which are detailed on the website. There are various course lengths available, including 45 km and 44 km, with support and timing services.

name: VOKOLO trail
organizer: Brněnský klub běžeckých a sportovních aktivit z.s.
description: Vokolo TRAIL is a spring running race held on April 25, 2026, around the Brno Dam. It offers a beautiful, hilly course in natural terrain with stunning views of the water surface and the historic Veveří Castle. The race is designed for runners who want to experience a personal challenge and push their limits on a moderately difficult course. It also features a unique steamer relay, combining running and boat travel on the dam. The organizer is the Brno Club of Running and Sports Activities z.s., which emphasizes quality facilities and participant safety.
course_highlights: 18 km hilly course in natural terrain along both banks of the Brno Dam
Stunning views of the water surface and Veveří Castle
Unique steamer relay 2x 9 km with crossing the dam
additional: The race capacity is limited to 700 runners. The start package includes a bib with a chip, safety pins, a locker tag, partner vouchers, a voucher for hot soup after the race, and a ticket for the tombola. There are separate changing rooms, a guarded baggage storage, and storage for bikes and scooters. Timing is done with chip technology with real-time results. Medical support is available on the course, at the finish, and in the facilities. The start of the first relay segment and the main race is between 9:45 and 9:55, the second relay segment starts at 9:20 with departure to the steamer. The race is limited to 700 participants and includes timing, technical facilities, medical support, and refreshments on the course and at the finish.

The race offers the opportunity to test your endurance by running as many laps as possible on a course measuring 6180 meters. In addition to the main individual race, a new event for pairs has been introduced, allowing participants to share the experience with a partner. The event also includes children's runs and shorter races for the general public, all in a friendly and supportive atmosphere. The organizer is the Benešováci z.s. association, which emphasizes sportsmanship, fair play, and support for an active lifestyle in the region.

Flat asphalt terrain without significant elevation changes
Beautiful natural environment of Hlučín Gravel Pit

The course is flat asphalt with low difficulty. Each participant receives a bib number and an ID chip; the bib number must be worn visibly. The organizer recommends a medical check-up before the race, and participation is at your own risk. A t-shirt for ultramarathoners is included. Facilities are located in a camp directly at Hlučín Gravel Pit. 24-hour ultramarathon, course length 6180 meters, held at Hlučín Gravel Pit, possibility of pairs race, accompanying activities.

name: Rychlebský maraton

The routes lead along perfect mountain trails, through deep valleys, deserted cliffs, old mountain meadows, and abandoned settlements, offering runners an unforgettable experience of wilderness and stunning views. The race is suitable for everyone who wants to explore the Rychlebské Mountains through the eyes of experienced locals and enjoy running in nature with minimal asphalt. Available routes are 26 km, 46 km, and 76 km, with the longer variants also passing into neighboring Poland.

Accommodation in a secondary gym in Javorník is available for 150 CZK/night. Trail ultramarathon on mountain trails, registration information, special programs including evening lectures, and location changes for race day.

The 20 km course runs along field and forest paths, partly on asphalt, starting at the memorial oak of St. Wenceslas with the finish line in the brewery premises of Krušovice. The terrain is very varied, combining asphalt, dirt, and grass, making the race attractive for both experienced and beginner runners. The program also includes shorter races for children and juniors, held at the PRIMÁTOR brewery premises. Organizers have also prepared an accompanying athletics program for children and awards for the best runners and the oldest participant.

The route passes through the town park, along the Labe cycle path, and over two bridges, with a total length of 21.1 km. The event also offers an accompanying program and the possibility to participate in special editions with a modified route.

location: Lukov u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
description: The Avanti Lukov Run is a race in Lukov near Znojmo, offering a main race of 9 km for men and 4.5 km for women, complemented by children's races of various lengths depending on age. The course mainly runs on paved surfaces, asphalt, and field roads, with a significant ascent in the upper part of Lukov. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement of the entire Znojmo Running Cup series with awards for the best runners and light refreshments. The event is organized by the Rabbits Znojmo team, which invites all runners to participate and to meet afterwards.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs on asphalt and field roads
Significant ascent in the upper part of Lukov
Two loops for men (9 km), one loop for women (4.5 km)
additional: Registration and sign-up take place on-site at Penzion Adalbert in Lukov near Znojmo. Children's races start at 9:15 AM, the main race at 10:00 AM. After the race, there is a ceremonial announcement of the entire Znojmo Running Cup series with handcrafted trophies and prizes from sponsors. Light refreshments are provided for participants. Organizers welcome feedback and suggestions for improvement. Following the race, there is a ceremonial announcement and refreshments; the race is open to the general public, including children.

name: Barvám Neutečeš České Budějovice
location: Sokolský ostrov, České Budějovice, Czech Republic
description: Color Run is a colorful race and all-day entertainment for all age groups, families, and friends held on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. There are two routes to choose from - 5 km with five color zones and 1.5 km with three color zones and an interactive sports zone. The event is not about speed, but about joy, friendship, and unforgettable experiences full of colors, music, and fun. Come enjoy a day full of laughter, dance, and shared energy, where no one escapes the colors.
course_highlights: 5 km route with 5 color zones
1.5 km route with 3 color zones and an interactive sports zone
Color zones shower runners with colors from head to toe
additional: The event takes place from 9:00 to 16:00 on Sokolský Island. It features musical performances, themed zones, photo booths, 360° videos, and accompanying programs. The event is suitable for everyone regardless of performance level; children can start on shoulders, scooters, or strollers. The event will be held on May 3, 2026, on Sokolský Island in České Budějovice. Registrations are available both on-site and online, with various packages for individuals, teams, and corporate participants. It includes a charitable aspect and various city accompanying activities.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Zlín - květen
location: Madal Bal, Příluky, Zlín, Czech Republic
description: The 2-mile run in Zlín in Příluky is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and running levels, from beginners to experienced runners. The course mainly runs between gardens in the Příluky industrial zone and consists of just under two laps on a precisely measured asphalt track. The race takes place on the first Saturday of each month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. Each participant will be rewarded at the finish line with a warm cinnamon roll as a token of participation.
course_highlights: The course runs mostly between gardens in the Příluky-Zlín industrial zone
Precisely measured asphalt track of just under 2 laps (3.2 km)
The children's course is 800 meters long

Categories are divided into men and women aged 13 and older, and children up to 12 years (boys and girls). Time is measured for each runner, and the top three in each category receive small prizes. It is recommended to arrive by bike, on foot, by car, rollerblades, or by trolleybus No. 11 (stop Průmyslová zóna). The course length is 3.2 km, with the start at 9:00 AM at the Madal Bal company. Registration is held on the first Saturday of each month from 8:15 to 8:55. The run is open to all age groups and focuses on the joy of movement.

name: Kokina běh
location: Horka nad Moravou, Olomouc, Czech Republic

The race is 15 km long and is part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region. The Liga stovkařů club specializes in fitness and performance running and offers participants a quality sports experience in the picturesque environment of Central Moravia. The race is suitable for runners of various performance levels who want to test their strength on an interesting course.
course_highlights: Race length of 15 km
Picturesque environment of Horka nad Moravou
Part of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region
additional: Registration is open until May 1, 2026. Participants agree to the race rules and participate at their own risk. The organizer is not responsible for any injuries. The race is part of the series of the Great Prize of Long-distance Runners of the Olomouc Region. The race takes place within the regional series and offers not only sporting experiences but also the opportunity to meet the local running community.

name: 2 míle s úsměvem Praha - květen
description: The 2-mile run in Prague's Stromovka is an open race covering 3.2 km, suitable for all age groups and skill levels, including children up to 12 years old running 1.6 km. The race is ideal for those who run for fun, want to improve their personal best, or simply enjoy a pleasant run in the beautiful park environment. After the race, every participant is served a warm cinnamon pancake. The time is measured for each runner and results are published online, counting towards the annual Pancake Cup.

Adults run 2 laps (2 miles, 3.2 km), children 1 lap (1.6 km)
The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Královská obora - Stromovka park
additional: Registration takes place at the Bruselská Gate area (under the Marold Panorama building) from 8:15 to 8:45, with the option of prior online registration for faster check-in. Recommended transportation includes cycling, walking, rollerblading, or tram (stop Výstaviště). Parking is recommended at the bridge to Císařský Island on Za elektrárnou street. There are changing tents and a non-guarded storage for belongings, as well as a mobile valuables storage. WC cabins are available on site. The race is part of the year-round Cup, starting at 9:07, registration from 8:15 to 8:45, online registration available, parking at the bridge to Císařský Island, changing rooms and toilets available, participants are divided into categories by age.

name: Letohradská pětka
location: Orlovna na Orlici, Letohrad, Pardubický kraj, Czech Republic

The race course is between 100 and 5000 meters long depending on the category and mainly runs through field and forest paths. The race offers a friendly atmosphere and is part of the Orel Running League. Registration takes place in the morning, and the main race starts at noon.

Course length from 100 to 5000 meters depending on the category
Start at Orlovna on Orlice

Sokol Roudnice nad Labem, ensuring a pleasant atmosphere and quality facilities for competitors and spectators.

name: Hornobludovická sedmička
location: Horní Bludovice, Moravskoslezský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Hornobludovická sedmička is a traditional running race in Horní Bludovice, held on a challenging, hilly course approximately 7 km long with an elevation gain of about 100 meters, including 63 steps on the Žermanice Dam embankment. The race is part of the Karviná District Running Cup and offers beautiful sporting experiences on a mixed surface of road, gravel, and field paths. After the race, results will be announced, a raffle will be held, and there will be seating with refreshments at the FC Horní Bludovice football complex, which provides facilities including changing rooms and showers. It welcomes runners of all categories and age groups with material prizes for the top three in each category.

Mixed surface: road, gravel, field path
Challenging hilly and varied course

Facilities with changing rooms and showers at the football complex. Parking at the football field. The race will take place on May 2, 2026, with registration open from January 1 to May 1, 2026, and it is part of the Karviná Cup 2026.

name: Běh Klobasnou

The race offers various categories including a family run over 1 km and children's races, where participants receive medals, trophies, and material prizes. Registration is possible in advance and on the day of the race, making organization easier and reducing waiting times. The event takes place in a pleasant sports atmosphere and is suitable for the general public, including families with children.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a 64-year history
Family run over 1 km and children's categories
Pleasant atmosphere and sports complex in Veselí nad Lužnicí
additional: Registration is possible in advance and on the day of the race from 9:00 to 11:00 AM, no later than 30 minutes before the start. On race day, only the entry fee is paid and the start number is collected. Children’s categories and the family run receive a participation medal. The club also offers the sale of jerseys, caps, and headbands. Parking is available in the sports complex. The race includes various routes, including children's and family runs, with on-site or pre-registration, forest and gravel paths, and a hilly profile of the courses.

name: Mistrovství ČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The Czech Republic Marathon Championship 2026 for men and women is a prestigious race on the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, taking place on May 3, 2026, in Prague with the start at Old Town Square. The race is open to men, women, and juniors over 18 who meet the specified participation limits. Registration is conducted via the RunCzech website until April 15, 2026. The race office will be open on May 1 and 2, 2026, at the Exhibition Grounds in Holešovice. The race starts at 08:00.
course_highlights: The marathon route begins at Old Town Square in Prague
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km
The race is part of the prestigious RunCzech running series
additional: The race office is open on May 1 and 2, 2026, from 10:00 to 20:00 at the Křižík Pavilion at the Exhibition Grounds in Holešovice. Inclusion is decided by the technical delegate, and participants will be informed via email. Registration is open until April 15, 2026, with a participant limit set from January 1, 2024. The race is part of the national marathon championship.

The race takes place every first Saturday of the month with registration in front of the Madal Bal company building and starts at 9:00 AM. The course is precisely measured and suitable for all running levels.

name: Prague International Marathon 2026
description: Prague International Marathon 2026 is a prestigious running event held in the historic center of Prague. The race offers a traditional marathon course of 42.195 km, passing through iconic city landmarks. The running weekend also includes accompanying races for families and children, creating a friendly atmosphere for all age groups. The start is scheduled for May 3, 2026, at 8:00 AM at Old Town Square.
course_highlights: The route passes through the historic center of Prague with views of landmarks
Start and finish at Old Town Square
Marathon distance of 42.195 km with timed results
additional: The running weekend also includes races such as Active Breakfast Run (4.2 km), dm Family Mile (1.609 km), and dm Bambini Run (children's races 100-200 m). Participants can use the RunCzech mobile app for race information and a virtual packet. The race is part of the RunCzech running league and offers special categories, including the Czech Republic Championship in the men's and women's marathon. The 42.195 km race starts on Sunday, May 3, 2026, at 8:00 AM; registration includes access to additional events like Active Breakfast Run, dm Family Mile, and dm Bambini Run.

name: Běh 2 míle Olomouc

The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc, where everyone can enjoy running for fun and compete primarily with themselves. It also includes a trophy competition, where results are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners collect points throughout the year. Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The top three places in each category are awarded.
course_highlights: Race in Smetanovy Sady in Olomouc near the fountain
Distance of the course 2 miles (3.2 km), children's course 600 m
Friendly atmosphere for runners of all levels and age categories
additional: Registration takes place on the race day from 9:30 to 10:00 AM. The race location is near the fountain in Smetanovy Sady, except for two races in June and August, which are run along the river on U Dětského domova street. Results are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners earn points for the trophy competition for the period September 2025 - August 2026. The race includes categories for all age groups, with the best in each category announced; the course runs through Smetanovy Sady and along the river, with registration from 9:30 to 10:00.

name: ORLEN Maraton Praha, MČR v maratonu mužů a žen
description: The ORLEN Prague Marathon is a prestigious marathon race held in the historic center of Prague, which also serves as the Czech Republic's championship for men and women in marathon running. The race traditionally covers the classic marathon distance of 42.195 km, starting at Old Town Square. The event attracts thousands of runners and offers a unique atmosphere with beautiful views of Prague's landmarks. It is part of the RunCzech running league and is known for its professional organization and support for the running community.

The route passes through the historic center of Prague with views of landmarks
Classic marathon distance of 42.195 km

The event features various categories, including relay races and accompanying runs, and is a significant sporting event with international participation. The route is challenging but offers a unique experience of running in the historic environment of Prague.

The start and finish are located at the Řevnice brewery, where refreshments and baggage storage are provided. The race is suitable for runners who want to enjoy nature and the community atmosphere of the running series.

Views of the surrounding fields, meadows, and forests with a return around the cemetery and Havlíčkovy Sady park

The top three places in each category will receive diplomas. The race includes a natural terrain course, registration is also possible on-site, and race numbers, refreshments, and awards for the best in each category are provided.

name: Jarní kros Písařova

Traditional spring cross-country race in the village of Písařov

name: Běh lesoparkem Praha Hostivař

The race takes place in the picturesque environment of Hostivař Forest Park in Prague 10 and is part of the SABZO series. This run is suitable for everyone who wants to enjoy running in nature with gentle elevation and a pleasant atmosphere. The race is ideal for trail running enthusiasts and offers the opportunity to compete with other runners in the beautiful setting of the Hostivař forest.

Two course lengths: 3.5 km for women and 7 km for men
Part of the SABZO series

description: Chernyák is a trail race run along the paths of the Black Forest near Zelená Hora and the surrounding meadows towards Vysoký. The 7 km course with an elevation gain of 180 meters offers varied terrain with 90% off-road surface and 10% asphalt, reminiscent of Scottish fell running races. The race is popular among local runners and features beautiful views of the town Žďár nad Sázavou and the UNESCO monument - the pilgrimage church of St. John of Nepomuk at Zelená Hora. The start and finish are at the parking lot by the church at Zelená Hora. The entry fee is donated to a charity collection for a sports prosthesis for student Alex Vondra.
course_highlights: 7 km trail race with an elevation gain of 180 m
Course runs along paths of the Black Forest and meadows towards Vysoký
Final climb up the stairs to the church at Zelená Hora, a UNESCO monument
additional: Start and finish at the parking lot by the church at Zelená Hora. Trail shoes are recommended. The entry fee is donated to a charity collection for a sports prosthesis. description: Night Run for Svetluška in České Budějovice is a charitable running event taking place on May 6, 2026, starting at 9:00 PM near the sports hall by Stromovka. The registration fee is 500 CZK, half of which goes directly to aid for the severely visually impaired. The event offers start packages with a headlamp or sports headband and an accompanying program including a concert by the band Byt číslo 4.

Charitable run supporting the severely visually impaired

An entry ticket with a unique code (printed or on mobile) is required to access the area. The program includes a concert by the band Byt číslo 4 from 20:00. The route options are 2.3 km or 4.6 km, with an accompanying program, benefits for the Svetluška project, registration via GoOut.cz, tickets with codes, and free entry for ZTP and ZTP/P cardholders.

name: Mistrovství ČR v silničním běhu na 1 míli a 5 km mužů a žen

description: The Czech National Championship in road running for 1 mile and 5 km in Poděbrady is the inaugural open championship of the Czech Republic on these distances. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of the spa promenade with certified, very fast, and flat circuits that directly invite personal bests. Organized by the Czech Athletic Federation, the event is an ideal opportunity for runners of all levels to compete against the best in the Czech Republic. The day after the race, the European Championship in race walking is held on the same courses.
course_highlights: Certified circuits in the spa promenade
Very fast and flat course
Beautiful environment of Poděbrady

description: Victory Run Jihlava - Třešť is an annual running event held on May 8, 2026, offering various race categories including adults, juniors, and children. Part of the Vysočina Running Cup with online registration options

description: The Victory Run through the Lány Castle Park is a traditional running race with a history dating back to 1972, held annually on May 8th in the castle park in Lány. The race offers a wide range of categories for children and adults with distances from 60 meters up to 7800 meters. The surface of the routes is mainly sandy, gravelly, and grassy, creating a pleasant and diverse running environment. The races start at 8:20 AM and continue throughout the morning, with spectators also able to enjoy the atmosphere. Organized by TJ Sokol Lány and the Charlotta Garrigue Masaryk Elementary School under the auspices of the Lány Municipality.

Children's routes from 60 m to 1500 m with color-coded laps
