Hranická Twenty runs through forest paths with elevation profile
Combination of stadium and trail courses around Hranice
additional: The races are part of the SK Hranice athletics calendar and the Czech Athletic Federation. Photos from previous editions are available online. The races will be held on Saturday, April 11, 2026. Children's categories have their own training and race schedules. The races include various categories from children to adults, registration is possible on the website, the event is part of the regional running series, and also offers trail courses.

name: Velká Morava
description: Velká Morava is a multimedia exhibition dedicated to the history of the Great Moravian Empire, presenting visitors with the story of the archeologically named warrior Mojslav from the 9th century. The exhibition features life-sized historical dioramas depicting key historical moments and everyday life of the inhabitants of Great Moravia. It also includes an introductory film, an electronic guide, computer animations, and 3D models of reconstructed buildings. Texts and audio guides are available in several languages, and the exhibition is adapted for visually impaired and blind visitors.
course_highlights: Life-sized historical dioramas with figures
3D models of reconstructed churches and fortifications of Veligrad
Audio guide and texts in Czech, English, German, and Russian
additional: The recommended visit duration is 60 minutes. The exhibition is adapted for visually impaired and blind visitors. The virtual guide also offers Russian language. The event focuses on education and popularization of Great Moravia's history, suitable for the general public and schools.

name: Jarní bahno - Goethovka
location: Goethova vyhlídka, Karlovy Vary, Karlovarský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Spring Mud is a traditional and iconic series of XC races in Karlovy Vary, celebrating its 25th edition in 2026. The series includes four races in mountain biking, running, and canicross disciplines, with the final race Goethovka offering a fast and dynamic course around Goethova Lookout. The races are suitable for all age groups and levels, emphasizing a friendly atmosphere and the opportunity for sports enthusiasts to meet after the winter break. The organizer is the association A.M.bike, which also organizes the region's largest cycling event, the Karlovy Vary AM Bike Marathon.
course_highlights: Fast and dynamic course near Goethova Lookout with a length of 5.8 km and an elevation gain of 240 m
Four races in the series with various terrains from hilly to rugged
Opportunity to compete in mountain biking, running, and canicross
additional: MTB starts take place in three waves from 12:00 to 12:15, the fourth race is an individual time trial with interval starts from 12:00. Free bottled water and hot tea are available at each race, refreshments are provided at selected locations. During registration, a timing chip is loaned; a fee of 500 CZK applies for non-return. The organizer reserves the right to change the program and conditions; participants agree to the taking of photographs and videos during the race. The race is part of a series with four disciplines - mountain biking, running, and canicross; registration and details are available on the website; medals and diplomas are awarded to the best.

name: Jarní rozBěh
location: Husinec - Řež, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run is a cross-country and trail run held on April 11, 2026, in the picturesque surroundings of the villages Husinec and Řež in the Central Bohemian Region. The race offers three courses with lengths of 11.4 km, 7.4 km, and 5.7 km, which lead through nature and are suitable for runners of all performance levels. The organizer is the municipality of Husinec - Řež, which invites all runners to enjoy running regardless of fitness. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation, ensuring quality organization and atmosphere.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail course characteristics
Course lengths of 11.4 km, 7.4 km, and 5.7 km
Picturesque environment of the villages Husinec and Řež
additional: The race is open to everyone regardless of fitness. The organizer is the municipality of Husinec - Řež. The event is part of the Czech Running Club and the Czech Athletic Federation. The event focuses on fun, promoting an active lifestyle, and community cohesion, with participants receiving medals, and local volunteers and the fire brigade participating.

name: Štěpánovský trhák
location: U Dub, Trhový Štěpánov, Czech Republic
description: Stěpánovský Trhák is a traditional running race that will take place for the eleventh time in 2026. After a one-year break, the race moves to a new location at U Dubu in Trhový Štěpánov, where participants can enjoy a new course through the forest, along forest paths, and partially on a cycle path. The race offers an atmosphere of friendly sporting gathering with children's and main races. The start and facilities are arranged to support the comfort and safety of participants.
course_highlights: New course at U Dubu
The route goes through the forest, along forest paths, and partially on a cycle path
Mostly natural terrain with slight elevation
additional: Registration for the main race is available online and on-site on the race day from 12:30. Children's races start at 13:40, the main race at 15:00. Parking is available on Lesní, Lipová streets, and surrounding areas; race facilities are located in a place where vehicle entry is not permitted. The results announcement for the main race is scheduled for approximately 16:00. The race includes a 7 km main course, children's categories, and a charity walk. Registration is open online and on-site. The event is part of the Běžec Podblanicka series.

name: Peršlácký kros
location: Fabián - Homolka, Nový Vojířov, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Peršlácký cross country is a running race for the general public, suitable for all performance levels and age groups. The race takes place in the Fabián - Homolka nature reserve near the Novomlýnský pond, under the Forest Hotel Peršlák in Nový Vojířov. The 10 km long route is gently hilly and runs on asphalt and forest paths, well marked. After the race, participants can enjoy refreshments and changing facilities in a tent at the start and finish. The race offers medals and prizes for the best runners and is supported by local sponsors.
course_highlights: The route runs around the Fabián - Homolka nature reserve
Distance of the route is 10 km, gently hilly
Track surface: 60% asphalt, 40% forest paths
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race at the venue no later than one hour before the start. Bib pickup begins at 9:00. Children's races start at 10:00, children's race awards at 11:30, main race awards at 13:30. Parking is approximately 1 km from the start on a meadow; it is recommended to arrive early. There is a tent for changing and storing belongings under organizer supervision. After the race, refreshments are available, and there is an option for lunch at the Forest Hotel Peršlák restaurant. Trail race with refreshments, runner facilities, online and on-site registration, limited parking about 1 km from the start.

name: 7 pohoří Jizerské hory
location: Severák, Janov nad Nisou, Liberec, Czech Republic
description: The Jizerské hory 2026 race will take you to a new location with start and facilities at Severák in Janov nad Nisou. You will run mainly on forest paths and terrain around Smržovka, Josefov Důl, and Maxov. The routes were prepared by mountain rescue worker Michal Zavadil from the Jizerské hory Mountain Rescue Service. There are three tracks of different lengths and elevation gains, offering technical trails and epic views. The registration fee includes a professionally marked route, timing measurement, a commemorative medal, and refreshments on the trail and at the finish line.
course_highlights: Technical trails around Smržovka, Josefov Důl, and Maxov
Main course 25 km with an elevation gain of 860 m
Alternative course 14 km with an elevation gain of 400 m
additional: The time limit to complete the race is 4 hours; after that, the participant is marked as DNF. Participants can store small items at the registration booth. The event takes place in all weather conditions. Recommended gear includes a windbreaker and a charged mobile phone with the rescue app. Each participant will receive a commemorative finisher's medal and refreshments on the trail and at the finish. The course is technically demanding, passing through spruce and deciduous forests, and has been prepared by local mountain rescue members. Registration is based on the date of registration; the event is suitable for all weather conditions.

name: Jarní běh Plzeň
description: Spring Run Plzeň is a friendly cross-country and trail race held in the beautiful environment of Homolka Park in Plzeň. It offers courses of 6 km, 2 km, and a relay race, making it suitable for the general public, including children and adults. The event is characterized by a joyful atmosphere and support for athletic performances. Registration is possible online and on-site, providing easy access for all interested participants.
course_highlights: Cross-country and trail course characteristics
Course lengths of 6 km, 2 km, and relay race
Environment of Homolka Park in Plzeň
additional: Registration is available online and on-site. The race is part of the Czech Running Club. Categories include children, adults, and relays. The race features children's races from 300 m and the main race of 6 km, complemented by family activities and a sports atmosphere in nature.

name: Jarní stodůlecký kros
description: Spring Stodůlky Cross is a single-loop challenging cross-country race that introduces runners to various corners of Prague 13. The course passes through the Stodůlky residential area, Central Park, and rocky areas above the Prokop Valley. The race offers medals and diplomas for the top three in each category and material prizes for the fastest. After the race, all participants are served tea, sweets, and enjoy a pleasant atmosphere of a small race.
course_highlights: Single-loop cross-country race in Prague 13-Stodůlky
The route passes through the residential area, Central Park, and rocky areas above the Prokop Valley
Challenging terrain with diverse surfaces
additional: Medals and diplomas are awarded to the top three in each category, with material prizes for the fastest. All participants receive tea and a small sweet. Organized by TJ Stodůlky Praha, contact Martin Žežulka. The course is diverse, including urban and trail sections. Registration is online. The race is suitable for the general public.

name: Běh lipovou alejí – Nymburská desítka
location: Nymburk, Nymburk District, Central Bohemian Region, Czech Republic
description: The Linden Alley Run is a traditional road race in Nymburk, held for the 31st time. The race offers a loop course of 10 km, mainly on asphalt paths along Tyršova Island and the athletic stadium with a synthetic surface. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and youth, for whom shorter distances are prepared. The atmosphere of the race is friendly and sporting, with an emphasis on a quality course and organization.
course_highlights: Loop course of 10 km with predominantly asphalt surface
Initial and final section of 1,800 m on the athletic stadium with a synthetic surface
The route passes around the Elbe River, Sports Center, and Tyršova Island
additional: Children's and youth categories register only on the day of the race, no later than 30 minutes before the start of the respective category. The main men's and women's race over 10 km starts at 11:15 AM. The course is measured according to IAAF/AIMS rules and meets their standards. Running segments are also available on Garmin and Strava platforms for individual training. The race includes the main 10 km course, children's categories, and the evaluation of the best runners. The start is on a tartan track, the course includes three asphalt loops, and the last 800 meters are on tartan.

name: Horské běhy v Novohradských horách
location: Hojná Voda, Novohradské hory, Jihočeský kraj, Czech Republic

price_tiers.distance: Easy – Běh Pro Paměť národa 2,2 km

description: Mountain runs in the Novohradské Mountains are traditional spring races held in the beautiful environment of the Novohradské Mountains with the center at Hojná Voda. They offer various routes from children's categories through shorter runs to a demanding ultra trail of 63 km with an elevation gain of 2050 m. The races are suitable for men, women, and canicross, providing a sporting experience in nature with the opportunity to discover the beauty of the Novohradské Mountains. The organizer is Martin Brožka and the team of Sportcentrum Novohradské hory, who prepare detailed maps and facilities for competitors.
course_highlights: Ultra trail 63 km with an elevation gain of 2050 m
Classic route 19 km with an elevation gain of 660 m
Experience 12.4 km with an elevation gain of 430 m
additional: Registration is also possible on the race day at Hojná Voda - U Lípy from 9:30 to 10:30 for children and from 12:00 to 13:45 for other categories. Participants have access to detailed route maps in the Mountain Running section and in printed form at the start. A final raffle with valuable prizes including accommodation in the Alps and a subscription to the magazine Svět běhu is prepared for participants. Route maps, online registration, raffle, accommodation options nearby, weather usually around 19°C.

name: Kyfův Jarní běh
location: Hrušov, Senohraby, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Kyfův Spring Run is a traditional running race organized by TJ Sokol Senohraby, held on a meadow beneath the former ski jump in Hrušov. The race is part of the Ladov Region Cup and offers sporting experiences in a spring environment with courses that include crossing a stream. Participants can also enjoy a mobile café serving hot drinks. The courses are known for their natural difficulty and atmosphere, attracting runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Course 1.8 km with stream crossing and wading for younger participants
Meadow beneath the former ski jump in Hrušov
Natural surface with unevenness caused by wildlife
additional: The race is part of the Ladov Region Cup. The 1.8 km course includes stream crossing; it is recommended to bring change shoes. A mobile café with coffee and hot chocolate is available. The courses are marked and manually maintained, but the terrain under the jump is uneven due to wild boar activity. The event takes place on April 12, 2026. The course includes forest and cross-country sections. Registration is recommended in advance. The entry fee is often donated to charity. The event is part of local community activities.

name: Kros Sázava
location: Pikovice u fotbalového hřiště, Příbramsko, Středočeský kraj, Czech Republic
description: Cross Sázava is a running race in Pikovice near the football field in Příbram district, offering three routes with different lengths and elevation gains. The longer route measures 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approximately 500 meters, the middle route is 10 km with an elevation gain of about 230 meters, and the hobby route is 5 km with an elevation of 120 meters. All routes are exclusively in natural terrain, ensuring beautiful and challenging running experiences. The race is suitable for runners of various levels who want to enjoy cross-country running in the picturesque landscape of the Central Bohemian Region.
course_highlights: Longer route 15.5 km with an elevation gain of approx. 500 m
Middle route 10 km with an elevation gain of approx. 230 m
Hobby route 5 km with an elevation of 120 m
additional: The course is technically demanding with forest trails and natural obstacles; the race takes place on April 12, 2026.

name: Žďárská 10
location: Žďár nad Sázavou, Žďárské vrchy, Czech Republic
description: Žďárská 10 is a fast road race over 10 km that opens the spring season in the heart of the Žďár Hills. The route runs from the center of Žďár nad Sázavou along cycle paths to the end of Pilská Reservoir and back, offering beautiful nature and minimal elevation gain. The race is precisely measured and starts in a mass start, ensuring a fair and competitive environment. It is organized by Sportovní klub Žďárák z.s. and is scored within the Žebříček 2025.
course_highlights: Road route with minimal elevation gain
Runs along an asphalt cycle path around Pilská Reservoir
Short section of 200 m on Dvorská Street with low traffic
additional: Registration is also possible on race day from 9:45 to 10:45 at the start area in front of the Cultural House. Parking is available at the Municipal Office and nearby areas. Results will be announced at 12:30. Children's races are organized separately with pre-registration via a form. The race takes place on a measured route, with online registration and on-site registration, start at 11:00, results at 12:30, and children can participate in accompanying races.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem v Krásném dvoře
location: Krásný Dvůr, Karlovy Vary, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run through the Castle Park "Memorial of Jaroslav Štůla" is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the castle park near the state castle Krásný Dvůr. The race is open to all age categories, from young beginners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, providing an interesting and enjoyable running experience. Participants have the opportunity for refreshments, and the best in each category are awarded prizes.
course_highlights: The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the castle park
Start and finish at the courtyard of the state castle Krásný Dvůr
The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups
additional: The start and finish of the race are at the courtyard of the state castle. Registrations can be sent via the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00 PM. Participants have the opportunity for refreshments. Full entry fee is 20 CZK. The route runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, the race is suitable for all age categories, refreshments are provided, registration is open until 10.04.2026, with the start at 9:15 AM.

name: Lahofer run
location: Suchohrdly u Znojma, Jihomoravský kraj, Czech Republic
price_range: 150 Kč pro hlavní závod, 50 Kč pro děti
description: Lahofer Run is the first edition of a running race as part of the Znojmo Running Cup, starting from the premises of the new Vinařství LAHOFER building in Dobšice. The approximately 8 km course runs around local vineyards and combines 80% forested and paved paths with 20% asphalt. Spectators can watch the finish from the unique roof of the winery with a view of the surrounding area. A children's race will also take place before the main race.
course_highlights: Course approximately 8 km around vineyards
80% forested and paved paths, 20% asphalt
Start and finish at the same place with a view from the winery roof
additional: Parking is available at the Vinařství LAHOFER premises. The children's race will take place before the start of the main race. The race is scheduled for April 12, 2026, with routes including 3 km, 6 km, and 9 km. Participants can also take part in children's races. The race course includes both asphalt and forest paths.

name: Korunou za korunu
location: Nové Město na Moravě, Vysočina, Czech Republic
organizer: TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s.
description: Korunou za korunu is a short cross-country run around the dyke of Cihelský Pond in Nové Město na Moravě. The race is suitable for runners who prefer trail running and can use spikes. It is organized by TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s. and is part of the running activities of the Czech Athletic Federation. The main category starts at 11:20 and the race offers a pleasant atmosphere in the beautiful Vysočina region.
course_highlights: Short cross-country run around Cihelský Pond
Option to use spikes
Trail course in the Vysočina region
additional: The first category starts at 9:30, the main category starts at 11:20. The organizer is TJ Nové Město na Moravě z.s., contact Petr Hubáček, phone 776 046 260. The race is cross/trail type and takes place on the dyke of Cihelský Pond. The race will be held on April 12, 2026, with a course length of 3.2 km for men and 1.6 km for women, running around Cihelský Pond. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Jarní běh zámeckým parkem
location: Krásný Dvůr, zámecký park, Czech Republic
description: Spring Run through the Castle Park "Memorial of Jaroslav Štůla" is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of the castle park in Krásný Dvůr. The race is open to all age groups, from young beginners to adults, and offers 19 different categories. The course runs along natural paths in the hilly terrain of the park, providing an interesting and enjoyable running experience. The start and finish are located in the courtyard of the state castle, where refreshments and awards for the best competitors in each category are also provided.
course_highlights: The course runs along natural paths in the castle park
The hilly terrain of the park offers an interesting run
Start and finish in the courtyard of the state castle
additional: The race offers 19 different categories for all age groups. The start and finish are in the courtyard of the Krásný Dvůr state castle. Registrations can be sent via the registration form until 10.04.2026 at 12:00 PM. Participants have the opportunity to enjoy refreshments. The entry fee for the event is 20 CZK. Course distances: 6,541 m, 4,082 m, 3,136 m; park, flat routes; various age categories; online and on-site registration; refreshments and prizes for winners.

name: Jaroměřský kros
description: Jaroměř Cross is a cross-country race held in the unique environment of the fortress and underground tunnels in Jaroměř - Josefov. The race takes place on April 12, 2026, and features a varied course profile with undulating terrain, hills, and grassy sections without obstacles. The start is beneath the fortress walls, adding a magical atmosphere of a Terezian fortress. Participants of all ages, from children to seniors, take part in the race, which is organized according to athletics rules with chip timing.
course_highlights: Unique environment of the fortress and underground tunnels
Varied course profile with undulating terrain and hills
Start beneath the fortress walls with a magical atmosphere
additional: Registration and chip pickup begin at 9:00 AM, with registration closing 30 minutes before the start of each category. Chip timing is worn on the shoe and bib numbers are worn on the chest. Changing rooms are available in tents near the race office, and there is quick refreshment and first aid provided by ČČK Jaroměř. Parking is available at the parking lot or along the road. Accommodation can be arranged through TJ Sokol Jaroměř or in the offerings of the town of Jaroměř and the surrounding area. Terrain, online registration until April 8, 2026.

name: Přespolní běh Cvikováčku
location: Cvikov, Liberec District, Liberec Region, Czech Republic
description: Cross-country run Cvikováček is a traditional running event organized by the House of Children and Youth Cvikováček in Cvikov. The race takes place on Sunday, April 12, 2026, and is open to the general public, including children and youth. The event offers an opportunity for sports activities in a pleasant environment of Cvikov region and promotes active leisure time. The start list and results are available online, and registration is conducted through a specialized registration system.
course_highlights: Trail mostly on forest paths
Part of the regional running league
Available distances of 9.1 km and 2.7 km
additional: Start list and results are available online at irontime.cz. Registration is possible via an online form on irontime.cz. The event is part of the activities of the House of Children and Youth Cvikováček, which also offers other leisure clubs and activities in the region. The race is part of the series of running races called District Running League Českolipsko, with registration possible through the organizer's website.

name: Běh u Chlumce
location: Louka u hrušňového sadu, Chlumec u Ústí nad Labem, Czech Republic

tiers.label: tier_1

description: We invite you to the 2nd annual run for the whole family - NaPOLEon run, which takes place on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec. Races of various lengths and difficulties will take you through the beautiful landscape of Chlumecko. Registration is possible in advance by email or directly on the day of the race. The entry fee is symbolic 50 CZK for adults, making the event accessible to all runners and families with children.
course_highlights: Routes of different lengths: 500 m, 1 km, 5 km, and 10 km (2x 5 km loop)
Beautiful landscape of Chlumecko
Start and finish under a shelter on the meadow near the pear orchard
additional: Registration is also possible on the day of the race from 9:00 to 10:00. The start and finish are located under a shelter on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec. Routes from 500 m to 10 km, registration via email or on-site, taking place on the meadow near the pear orchard in Chlumec.

name: 57. Běh vítězství, 53. Hranická dvacítka a 10. Hranická desítka
location: Areál DDM Ježkovka, Heřmanův Městec, Czech Republic
description: Victory Run, Hranická Twenty and Hranická Ten are traditional running races organized by SK Hranice, held at the DDM Ježkovka area in Heřmanův Městec. The races include various distances, from short children's runs on the stadium oval to longer trail courses. The event is open to the general public and offers a sporting experience in a pleasant environment with a history dating back several decades. The races take place on Saturday, April 11, 2026, and are popular among runners of all ages.
course_highlights: Races from 100 to 500 meters take place on the stadium oval
Hranická Twenty and Ten partly run through forest paths
The course profile includes various elevation changes (see attached profiles)
additional: The races have a long tradition (57th Victory Run, 53rd Hranická Twenty, 10th Hranická Ten). Photos from previous editions are available online. The courses are detailed in attached maps and profiles. The races are part of the broader athletic activities of SK Hranice. They are organized as part of a sports day with the possibility of pre-registration; the races are suitable for the general public and experienced runners.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz – edycja wiosenna 2026
description: Botaniczna Piątka Bydgoszcz - spring edition 2026 is cross-country running organized by running enthusiasts since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz, emphasizing the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and enjoy the beauty of nature during the spring run.
course_highlights: Cross-country run on scenic routes in Bydgoszcz
Routes with aesthetic and natural characteristics
Organization with passion and experience since 2014
additional: Cross-country run, terrain, registration on the website, location in Myślęcinek Botanical Garden, spring event

name: Wings for Life 2026 Gdańsk Południe
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race that takes place simultaneously worldwide. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants race against a virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the runners and gradually increases its speed until it catches the last participant. In Gdańsk Południe, the race will be held on May 10, 2026, starting at 13:00 near the finish area at Parkrun Gdańsk-Poludnie. The route is a loop approximately 3 km long on a paved surface, with a minimal incline on the connector. All proceeds from the entry fees support spinal cord research.
course_highlights: Walking and running route approximately 3 km long on a loop
Paved surface, uneven in some areas near a large reservoir
Minimal incline on the connector towards the smaller reservoir
additional: The race is accessible to runners and wheelchair participants. The Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the runners, at a speed of 14 km/h, and gradually accelerates. 100% of the entry fees are allocated to spinal cord research. Participants use the Wings for Life World Run app to track the race and results. The race begins at 13:00, with participants registering and tracking progress via the app. The event is open to runners and wheelchair users.

name: Wings for Life World Run 2026 Poznań
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race where all participants start simultaneously worldwide, running to escape from the Catch Car. The race has no traditional finish line — participants run as long as they can before being caught by the car. All proceeds from registration fees are donated to research on spinal cord injury treatment, making this race not only a sporting challenge but also a charitable event. You can participate locally or via the app, allowing you to run from anywhere in the world.
course_highlights: Simultaneous start worldwide
No traditional finish line — chased by the Catch Car
Race for runners, wheelchair users, and beginners
additional: Participants can join the race locally or through the Wings for Life World Run app, which tracks time and distance. 100% of registration fees support spinal cord research. Marketing tools and promotional materials are available for local race organizers with the app. Participation supports research on spinal cord injury treatment; the event includes merchandise sales and the option to join remotely, with all proceeds dedicated to scientific causes.

name: 5. Festiwal Gorski Jedlina-Zdroj
price_range: od 120 zł do 250 zł, mieszkańcy gminy 50 zł
description: The 5th Mountain Festival Jedlina-Zdrój is a mountain running event taking place on May 10, 2026, in Jedlina-Zdrój. Participants can choose from three distances: 10 km, 23.5 km, and 50 km, with start and finish located at the Jedlinka Palace. The race route runs through the scenic areas of the Wałbrzych Mountains, including Mount Borowa with a newly built viewing tower, offering challenging ascents and diverse surfaces. The event is an excellent opportunity for active recreation and to explore the region's charms.
course_highlights: The route leads through Mount Borowa with a new viewing tower
Diverse surfaces: gravel roads, asphalt, forest and mountain trails
Distances of 10 km, 23.5 km, and ultra 50 km with refreshment and control points
additional: The total participant limit is 600 people. The festival t-shirt is available for pre-order until April 19, 2026, at a price of 90 PLN, made from high-quality technical material Attiq. The ultra 50 km route features 7 refreshment points and 5 control points for timing. Start and finish are at the Jedlinka Palace, ul. Zamkowa 4. The organizer reserves the right to modify the route up to a week before the start. The mountain route is demanding, with various surfaces, a participant limit of 600, online registration, possible date changes due to sanitary restrictions, accommodation options, and festival t-shirts available for participants.

location: Pszczew, Międzyrzecz County, Lubusz Voivodeship, Poland

description: The Pszczew Twenty is an annual half marathon organized since 1984 in the welcoming town of Pszczew, attracting runners from all over Poland and abroad, including people with disabilities. The event takes place in May and, in addition to the main 20 km race, features street runs over shorter distances for children and youth. The competition has a family character and promotes community integration as well as running enthusiasts. The half marathon route runs through the picturesque streets of Pszczew, offering participants a unique sporting experience.
course_highlights: 20 km half marathon route

Start and finish within the MOSiR sports complex at the Paprocany Recreation Center
Scenic areas of the Paprocany Recreation Center in Tychy
additional: The race office, changing rooms, start, and finish are located within the MOSiR sports complex at the Paprocany Recreation Center. The event includes various competitions and is part of local celebrations aimed at supporting children in need.

name: IV Honorowy Bieg Kadecki
description: The 4th Honorary Kadecki Run is a unique sporting event organized by I LO PUL Kutno - Military High School, held in celebration of the Regiment Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment. The run is a tribute to local history and military traditions, with participants covering a 5.5 km route with obstacles at the military training ground in Kutno. The event is under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno, Mr. Mariusz Sikora, and invites all sports enthusiasts to compete and have fun. The race is scheduled for May 24, 2026, at 1:00 PM at the AMZ S.A. Training Ground in Kutno, located at Metalowa Street.
course_highlights: Route of 5.5 km with obstacles
Race takes place at the AMZ S.A. military training ground in Kutno
Event related to military tradition and Regiment Day of the 37th Infantry Regiment
additional: The race takes place on a military training ground with obstacles, emphasizing its military character and uniqueness. The event is under the honorary patronage of the Mayor of Kutno. Registrations are conducted through the Chronotex platform. Online registration is open until the end of April; limited number of spots; cross-country race with natural and artificial obstacles.

name: Kęcka Piątka
description: Kęcka Piątka is a street race covering a distance of 5 km, held in the picturesque town of Kęty. The race route is certified and runs through the streets of the town, ensuring participants safe conditions thanks to securing key turns and intersections. The race is a local sporting celebration promoting a healthy lifestyle and physical activity among residents and visitors. It is organized by the Sports and Recreation Center in Kęty under the patronage of the Mayor of Gmina Kęty. We invite runners from 14 years of age to participate in this energetic event.
course_highlights: Certified route of 5 km length
Runs through the streets of Kęty on asphalt surface
Route secured at key turns and intersections
additional: Race office open on 23.05.2026 from 10:00 to 16:00 at the OSiR Kęty Sports Hall and on 24.05.2026 from 8:00 to 10:30 at the Municipal Market. Participants aged 14 and above are allowed to start, a statement of no health contraindications is required. The race takes place with limited road traffic, the route is completely closed to traffic during the start time. Certified route through the streets of Kęty; participation from 14 years old; limited spots; prizes and medals; traffic disruptions on May 11, 2025.

name: Mucharskie Pętle
description: Mucharskie Loops Run is a unique running event held in the picturesque scenery by Lake Mucharskie and the hills of the Small Beskid Mountains. The route is suitable for both beginner runners and those seeking a more challenging trail run. Organizers invite all running enthusiasts and those looking for a good sporting atmosphere to participate in the event, which will take place on May 24, 2026, in Mucharz. The number of spots is limited, and registration is conducted online.
course_highlights: 5 km route with +125 m elevation gain, asphalt surface
10 km route with +400 m elevation gain, asphalt, gravel roads, and forest trails
Nordic Walking 3 km with approximately 30 m elevation gain, asphalt surface and gravel section
additional: Three distances to choose from: 5 km asphalt, 10 km mixed route (asphalt, gravel, forest trails), Nordic Walking 3 km. The number of spots is limited. Online registration. Information and updates available on the Mucharskie Pętle Facebook profile. The event is organized by the Spartak Running Group and the Mucharz Municipality, with participant limits and various routes tailored to different skill levels.

name: Prusice Biegają - etap 2
location: ul. Żmigrodzka, Prusice, Lower Silesian Voivodeship, Poland
description: The 13th edition of the Prusice Running event is a sports event taking place on Żmigrodzka Street, next to the Prusice Fitness Center in Prusice. The route runs through the streets of Prusice via Pietrowice Małe, offering participants scenic and friendly conditions for running. The event is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and compete within the local running community.
course_highlights: Route through the streets of Prusice
Passing through Pietrowice Małe
Start and finish at Prusice Fitness Center
additional: The event will take place on Żmigrodzka Street, near the Prusice Fitness Center, and is part of a series of runs held from January to November 2026.

name: VI Niechanowska Dyszka i Piątka
location: Planty Niechanowo, Gmina Niechanowo, Powiat Gnieźnieński, Wielkopolska, Poland
description: The 6th Niechanowska Ten and Five Kilometers is an annual race organized in the picturesque Park Planty in Niechanowo. The event offers two popular running routes: 10 km and 5 km, attracting both amateurs and more experienced runners. The event has an athletics character and is an excellent opportunity to spend active time outdoors in a friendly atmosphere. Organizers provide professional timing measurement and technical support.
course_highlights: The route runs through the charming Park Planty in Niechanowo
Two distance options: 10 km and 5 km
The race takes place on a flat, asphalt surface conducive to fast times
additional: Electronic timing measurement provided by a timing company cooperating with the organizer. Online registration available through the platform DO:ST:AR:TU. The event takes place in a single start wave. Payment can be made by card or e-transfer via Dotpay.pl. The race includes various age categories, including races for children, and offers online registration. The event promotes physical activity and integration of the local community.

name: XII Bieg z książką

tiers.label: tier_1

description: The 12th Book Run ON THE TRAIL TO THE GOAL is an open running event organized by the UMK Alumni Program and the UMK Marathon Club, dedicated to the community of Nicolaus Copernicus University in Toruń and enthusiasts of running and reading. The race takes place on the university campus in Bielany, Toruń, and its route runs through forest paths and avenues of the academic grove. Participants must cover the distance while holding a book weighing at least 100 grams, highlighting the event's unique nature that combines sport with the promotion of reading. The patron of the race is Robert Małecki, a crime novelist and UMK alumnus, who actively participates in the run and meets with participants after the competition.
course_highlights: The route runs through forest paths and avenues on the campus in Bielany and adjacent areas
The main race distance is 27,000 wolf tracks, referencing 27 crime novels by Robert Małecki
The route requires running with a book weighing at least 100 grams, which is a unique element of the race
additional: Race office open from 9:30 AM. Electronic registration until May 20, 2026, and in-person registration on race day. Entry fee payable cashless on site (by card or Blik). After the race, a meeting with patron Robert Małecki during the Picnic with a Pump on the occasion of the 25th anniversary of the UMK Alumni Program. Additional classification "With Małecki" for runners with the author's book, with results calculated by an algorithm considering time and book parameters. Forest terrain, electronic and in-person registration, approximately 3.51 km distance, promoting reading and physical activity, participation of Robert Małecki.

name: XIV Panewnicki Bieg Dzika (5)
organizer: Akademia Wychowania Fizycznego im. Jerzego Kukuczki w Katowicach
price_range: 20-110 zł (indywidualnie), 220-800 zł (pakiety), zniżki dla seniorów i studentów
description: The 14th Panewnicki Wild Run is a street race covering a distance of 10 km, scheduled to take place on May 24, 2026, in Katowice. It is an excellent opportunity for runners of various skill levels to test their form on a scenic route. Organizers encourage preparation with dedicated training plans tailored to individual levels. The event is open and friendly to runners, promoting physical activity and a healthy lifestyle.
course_highlights: Street route of 10 km
Scenic areas of Katowice
Route of moderate difficulty
additional: Training plans are available from 8 to 20 weeks, tailored to the runner's VDOT level, with instructions and expert support. The event also includes an educational component about forest behavior and the possibility of using professional timing services.

name: XVII Bieg Uliczny o Łaziskie Liście
location: Stadion miejski w Łaziskach Górnych, Łaziska Górne, Mikołów, Poland
organizer: Miasto Łaziska Górne, MOSiR Łaziska Górne
description: The 17th Street Run for the "Łaziskie Liście" named after A. Kaleja is an annual running event held in Łaziska Górne, which will take place in 2026 on May 24 at the municipal stadium. Participants can compete in distances of 5 km and 10 km, with the 10 km route being two laps of the 5 km course. The event also features races for children, youth, and seniors, which take place the day before, creating a sports integration of generations. Registration for the main races and Nordic walking is only available online. The event is organized by the Municipal Sports and Recreation Center in Łaziska Górne, which ensures accessibility and support for all participants.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the streets of Łaziska Górne
10 km distance is two laps of the 5 km route
Supporting races for children, youth, and seniors at the municipal stadium
additional: Supporting races for children, youth, and seniors will take place on May 23, 2026, at the municipal stadium. A new addition is the senior march and run. Registration for the main 5 km and 10 km runs as well as the 5 km Nordic walking is only online. The event runs from 10:00 to 12:00. The organizer provides accessibility and support for people with disabilities. Online registration, a time limit of 45 minutes for the 5 km, 1.5 hours for the 10 km, medals and starter packs, a sporting event for various age groups.

name: XXII Bieg Sanguszków
organizer: Uczniowski Klub Sportowy „OGRODNIK” i Zespół Szkół Ekonomiczno-Ogrodniczych w Tarnowie
description: The 22nd Sanguszków Run is an annual running event held on May 24, 2026, in Sanguszków Park in Tarnów. The race is organized by Kępa Sport, LKS Burzyn, and the Youth Sports Club "OGRODNIK". The goal of the run is to popularize running and foster community among runners. Participants can expect electronic timing and professional event organization.

Electronic timing ensuring accurate results
An event for the community and spectators
additional: The organizer provides electronic timing and community events for spectators. Participants must accept the regulations and privacy policy and consent to the processing of personal data and images. The race is part of the Pogórzański Running Festival - Summer. The event promotes physical culture and a healthy lifestyle, is family-friendly, and suitable for participants of all ages, with routes adapted to different age groups.

name: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice 2026
description: Garmin Ultra Race Myślenice is a mountain trail running event taking place on May 9, 2026, in the picturesque Beskid Wyspowy, near Kraków. The routes lead through forest paths with numerous steep ascents and breathtaking views, offering challenges for runners of various skill levels. Myślenice is a place that combines natural beauty, history, and modern infrastructure, making the event an attractive activity for active recreation enthusiasts. The Garmin Ultra Race series promotes running in harmony with nature, fair play, and supporting the running community.
course_highlights: Forest trails of Beskid Wyspowy with natural ascents
View of the Tatra Mountains from selected points on the route
Various distances from 13 km to 78 km with a total elevation gain of up to 2300 m
additional: Race packets are issued at the event office on May 8-9. Starts are staggered according to distances, with the longest distance of 78 km starting at 05:00. The time limit to complete the 78 km distance is 15 hours. Discounts are available when registering for more than one event in the series. Athlete cards can be downloaded 5 days before the event after logging in at startlist.pl. Award ceremonies take place after the completion of each distance. Distances range from 6 km to 101 km, with time limits from 1 hour to 17.5 hours, various start packages, the possibility to start on multiple distances within the Challenge, mountain terrain, medical security, trail marking, nutrition points, GPS tracker (only for 78 km).

name: Bieg Herosa
description: The Hero Run is a unique running event held in Klucze near Olkusz, offering various distances and competition formats on challenging, sandy terrain. The most extreme competition is Nomad 9h, where participants fight against desert sand and their own limits for 9 hours, emphasizing strategy and endurance. Shorter distances are also available, such as Nomad 3h, dynamic 5- and 7-kilometer loops, as well as races for children and special dog runs that highlight cooperation and trust between the handler and the dog. This event is for those seeking a sporting challenge and contact with nature in a unique desert climate.
course_highlights: Sandy, desert-like terrain requiring good technique and endurance
Long-distance competition up to 9 hours in extreme conditions
Special routes for dog runs and for children on distances from 200 to 1000 meters
additional: The event includes various forms of races: an extreme 9-hour run, 3-hour run, short loops of 5 and 7 km, races for children, and dog runs that require cooperation and trust between the competitor and their pet. The event focuses on overcoming personal limits, endurance, and strategy in difficult terrain conditions.

name: Blue Power Run
organizer: Fundacja Pełnoprawni MY i Stowarzyszenie Pomocy Dzieciom z Autyzmem SENSE
description: Blue Power Run is an inclusive race organized for people on the autism spectrum, their families, and friends. The event aims to support social integration through a shared sporting event that connects participants and raises awareness about autism. The race takes place on an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area in Szczecin, and participation is primarily about personal satisfaction and overcoming oneself, regardless of the finishing position. The event also features joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers, which further promotes integration.
course_highlights: The route runs along an asphalt pathway at Arkonka Bathing Area
Inclusive race for people on the autism spectrum and their families
Joint activities coordinated by therapists and volunteers
additional: The number of spots is limited to 300 participants. Start packages can be collected at the Race Office on Friday, May 16, from 10:00 to 12:00 and 14:00 to 16:00, as well as on the day of the event from 12:00 to 13:00. Starts are divided into age categories with different distances from 200 to 600 meters. The Race Office and start are located at the Szyszka restaurant. The race is inclusive, with routes for children and adults, taking place on an asphalt trail in Arkonka, with online registration available until May 10, 2025. The race is scheduled to start at 13:00.

name: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź
description: Botaniczna Piątka Łódź - spring edition 2026 is a cross-country race organized by running enthusiasts who have been promoting this sport since 2014. The event takes place on scenic routes that highlight the aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations. It is an excellent opportunity to spend active time and enjoy the beauty of nature in Łódź.
course_highlights: Cross-country race on scenic routes
Aesthetic qualities of the proposed locations
Organized with passion since 2014
additional: cross-country, scenic routes, spring 2026 event

The event will take place on May 9, 2026, and offers an excellent opportunity for sports competition and exploring local attractions such as the largest chodak and a banquet table. Participants can prepare by using certified Nordic Walking routes available in the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality.
course_highlights: Red route measuring 8.2 km
Picturesque but challenging terrain
Local attractions: banquet table, largest chodak, and tobacco box
additional: The event starts at 11:00 AM. Registration is open from March 18, 2026, to May 7, 2026. The route runs through the Nowa Wieś Lęborska municipality, encouraging the use of certified Nordic Walking trails available in the region. The event offers sporting challenges, beautiful views, and local attractions to enrich participants' Nordic Walking experience.

name: III M Park4RUN
description: The III M Park4RUN Half Marathon is a race approximately 21.2 km long, scheduled to take place on May 9, 2026, in Tarnów, at the M Park Shopping Center. The race route is 100% asphalt, flat, and marked every 1 km, with limited road traffic during the event. The event promotes popularization of running and recreation as well as integration of the local community. In addition to the main race, there are also races for children and youth on various distances suitable for their age. Participants of the main race receive a starter pack containing items from sponsors as well as informational and promotional materials.
course_highlights: Route approximately 21.2 km, 100% asphalt
Flat route, marked every 1 km
Refreshment points at 5 km, 10 km, 15 km, and finish
additional: The main race has a time limit of 180 minutes. The race office is open from 7:30 to 9:15. The office for children opens at 10:00, with children's and youth races around 12:00-12:30, and awards ceremony approximately 12:30-13:00. Right-hand traffic is enforced on the route. Classifications include OPEN women and men as well as age categories for adults and children. Approximate distances for children: 100 m (preschoolers), 250 m (grades I-III), 500 m (grades IV-VI), 800 m (grades VII-VIII). Registration for the event was available online. The event also includes races for children and community activities.

name: IV Płużnicka Piątka
description: The 4th Płużnicka Five-Kilometer Run is a race covering 5 kilometers held in the picturesque town of Płużnica. The course features varied surfaces, making it attractive for both amateurs and more experienced runners. Participants start in the town center, and the event includes children's races and a ceremonial award ceremony. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, as confirmed by positive feedback from previous participants.
course_highlights: 5 km course through the center of Płużnica
Surface: 71% asphalt, 23% dirt road, 6% cobblestone
Scenic views and varied terrain
additional: Program of the day: 10:40 official start, 10:50 warm-up, 10:55 lining up at the start, 11:00 race start, 11:50 children's races, 12:15 award ceremony, 12:45 official end. The route starts in the town center. After the race, prizes and a friendly atmosphere with refreshments are provided. The participant limit is 200. The race is part of the Grand Prix of Chełmno Land. Online registration, timing measurement, and live results are available.

The first race in picturesque Krobielowice
Course adapted for various runner categories

The event is dedicated to runners of various skill levels, and participants can benefit from training plans tailored to their individual level and needs. The race is of moderate difficulty and takes place on an asphalt urban route. Organizers provide expert support and detailed training instructions to help everyone prepare optimally for the start.
course_highlights: Street route of 5.5 km length
Race on asphalt surface in Łódź city
Customized training plans from 8 to 20 weeks

Training lasts from 8 to 20 weeks, allowing for optimal race preparation. The race covers a distance of 5.5 km, with online registration, an eco-friendly event, categories for children and adults, support for foundations, starter packs with gifts, parking, and a meal after the race.

description: Beskidy Short Race is a European adventure race held in the picturesque Beskid Mountains, on the border between Poland and Slovakia. The competition includes various disciplines such as MTB, trekking, kayaking, climbing, and orienteering, with routes leading through mountainous areas offering beautiful views and challenging sections. The event is designed for teams of two or individual participants, providing an intense challenge for adventure and outdoor sports enthusiasts. The start and finish are located in the Koszyce area, and organizers provide professional support and assistance.
course_highlights: Approximately 200 km route with MTB, trekking, and kayaking
Traversing the Beskid Mountains and Orawa region
Varied mountain terrain with orienteering and climbing elements
additional: The race lasts about 30 hours plus an additional 2 hours. Teams can be mixed 4-person or 2-person of any gender. The race office and start/finish: Dworek nad Wisłą, Wyzwolenia 65, 43-460 Wisła, Poland. The race includes disciplines such as climbing, kayaking, navigation, and field tasks, with routes passing through scenic areas of Polish mountains, including caves and rock formations.

name: VIII Ultramaraton Warmiński Warneland
description: The 8th Warmia Ultramarathon Warneland is a unique running event held in the picturesque Olsztyn. The route takes runners through charming Warmia trails, along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake, offering contact with nature and beautiful views. The event is a great opportunity for active recreation, suitable for both experienced ultramarathon runners and younger running enthusiasts, who can participate in the children's races Ultra Warmiaczek. The atmosphere of the competition fosters integration and shared sporting adventure.
course_highlights: Picturesque Warmia trails around Olsztyn
Route along the Łyna River and Ukiel Lake
Contact with nature and charming views
additional: Packet pickup takes place on May 9, 2026, from 17:00 to 21:00 at the Best Western Plus Olsztyn Old Town Hotel and from 07:30 to 10:00 at CRS Ukiel for children's races. The start times for the W50+ and W25+ distances are at 08:00. The time limit for completing the W50+ race is 10 hours, and for W25+ it is 5 hours. After this time, participants must leave the course and remove their bib numbers. The Ultra Warmiaczek children's races start at 11:10. The race village is located at the Ukiel Recreation and Sports Center, near numerous hotels and apartments. The event includes distances of 53 km, 32 km, 19 km, and children's races, with time limits of 10 and 5 hours, and the start and finish are at CRS Ukiel in Olsztyn. Participants can expect medical and logistical support. Registration closes on April 26, 2025.
